Dutch MPs asked the government whether it knew of Lithuanian advice against buying Xiaomi phones over possible censorship software, whether Dutch authorities use Xiaomi devices, and whether risk analyses and investigations are planned. The government answered that it sees no reason for a similar warning now, that civil servants' procurement follows a risk-based framework with agencies responsible for their own choices, and that existing regulators could act if censorship were found to be active.
All government organisations are themselves responsible for their operations and for the security of information and information systems.
Alle overheidsorganisaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun bedrijfsvoering en de beveiliging van informatie en informatiesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de hoge benzineprijzen

An MP asked why petrol prices are high while oil prices fall, whether government can lower them, whether it will ask the competition authority to investigate abuse of market power, and whether it will compensate for the cost-of-living effect. The government answered that pump prices depend on market factors and that it has no direct influence beyond excise and VAT, will forward the abuse questions to the ACM which sets its own priorities, and declined a separate compensation.
I can however commit to forwarding these questions to the ACM.
Ik kan wel toezeggen dat ik deze vragen zal doorgeleiden aan de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Peters over het bericht ‘Kloosters kijken nog steeds uit naar coronasteun’

MPs asked the government about religious institutions such as monasteries, churches and mosques that reportedly struggle with lost income and get little corona support. The government answered that religious organisations can use the TVL and NOW schemes on the same terms as others, reported 79 religious TVL applications (66 granted, EUR 1,001,482), and said it had held talks with religious umbrella bodies.
For the NOW, it was not separately registered whether religious institutions made use of the NOW.
Voor de NOW is niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd of religieuze instellingen gebruik hebben gemaakt van de NOW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Ellian over het bericht ‘Duizend inhuurkrachten WhatsApp lezen mee in chats’

Two MPs asked the government about reports that WhatsApp moderators can read the last five messages of a reported user, questioning whether this undermines end-to-end encryption and transparency under GDPR Article 12. The minister answered that the ProPublica article was corrected, that reporting only shares the messages the reporter chooses to send so encryption is not broken, and that no indications of an Article 12 breach were found.
When a WhatsApp user reports another WhatsApp user, the reporting user sends WhatsApp the most recent messages received from the other user.
Wanneer een WhatsApp-gebruiker een andere WhatsApp-gebruiker rapporteert, dan stuurt de rapporterende gebruiker aan WhatsApp
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de Garantieregeling evenementen

MP Westerveld asks whether event organisers pass on the full government-guaranteed compensation to freelance artists and suppliers, and whether the subsidy conditions should require this. The minister acknowledges signals of underpayment, says it is a private-law matter beyond government's view, explains why pass-through was not made a subsidy condition for administrative reasons, and points to sector outreach and a Taskforce review.
I have no insight into the contractual relationships of individual organisers and their suppliers, including artists and other self-employed workers.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de contractuele verhoudingen van individuele organisatoren en hun toeleveranciers, waaronder ook artiesten en andere zelfstandigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Keijzer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht “Albanese maffia slaat hier zijn tentakels uit”

MPs Omtzigt, Keijzer and Van Toorenburg asked about reports of Albanian organised crime in the Netherlands, including whether a visa requirement should be reintroduced under EU rules and whether Albania should keep candidate status. The minister answered that Albanian-national suspects rose to about 700 in 2016, that the government will await the Commission's Western Balkans monitor before considering the EU emergency brake, and that the answers were delayed beyond the two-week target.
I will make this report available for confidential inspection by your House until the end of the year.
Deze rapportage leg ik tot het einde van het jaar ter vertrouwelijke inzage in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Keijzer over het bericht dat medicijnenproductie verdwijnt uit Nederland

Two CDA MPs asked the Economic Affairs and Health ministers about reports that medicine production is leaving the Netherlands, its consequences for innovation and jobs, and how supply shortages would be prevented. The minister answered that production has been largely abroad for years, that Nederland specialises in R&D, that topsector policy and acquisition efforts continue, and that the medicines register and shortage reporting body would monitor any relocation.
The largest part of medicine production has been taking place outside the Netherlands for a very long time.
Het grootste deel van de geneesmiddelenproductie vindt al heel lang buiten Nederland plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'COA informeert Nijmegen over aso-asielzoeker'

MPs Keijzer and Van Toorenburg asked whether the mayor of Nijmegen was not informed in advance about the placement of nuisance-causing asylum seekers, and whether all mayors should be notified beforehand. The Secretary of State said there is no direct prior notification, but local cooperation structures exist, and Nijmegen agreed with the police and the asylum chain on intensified information sharing, with two extra supervised locations opening in autumn.
Therefore the municipality of Nijmegen, the police and the asylum chain have made agreements on intensifying the integrated approach and the necessary information exchange.
Daarom hebben de gemeente Nijmegen, de politie en de vreemdelingenketen afspraken gemaakt over de intensivering van de geïntegreerde aanpak en de noodzakelijke informatieuitwisseling hierbij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Keijzer en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Nederland op het spoor is van contacten tussen hulporganisaties en smokkelbendes

MPs Knops, Keijzer and Van Helvert asked the ministers about reports that Dutch and German intelligence were tracking contacts between aid organisations and smuggling networks in the Mediterranean, and about EU operation Sophia and a near-collision with the Libyan coast guard. The government declined to discuss intelligence operations, said it awaits the outcome of an Italian fact-finding investigation, and noted that Sophia's mandate does not cover combating contacts between aid organisations and smugglers.
No public statements are made about operations of the Dutch intelligence services or about the exchange of information with partners.
Over operaties van de Nederlandse inlichtingendiensten en het uitwisselen van informatie met partners worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over dure geneesmiddelen die in de toekomst door apothekers veel goedkoper gemaakt kunnen worden

An MP asked the health minister about a pharmacist-led device that could make biological medicines cheaply for individual patients, whether the curriculum should change, whether legal limits on magistral preparation hinder it, and what the biosimilar initiative is doing. The minister said the research is at proof-of-principle stage with results expected next year, deferred curriculum questions to universities, and will explore with the researcher and inspectorate whether current rules allow the approach, while listing existing biosimilar promotion activities.
I have invited Prof. Schellekens to explain his article and ideas.
Ik heb prof. Schellekens uitgenodigd om zijn artikel en ideeën toe te lichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Van Dam over het bericht ´Politie bood zwijgdeal’

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a Telegraaf report that police offered a 'silence deal' on data about asylum seekers and criminal suspects, and about how many asylum seekers and status holders came into contact with criminal law in 2014-2016. The minister denied any silence deal, said police do not routinely record residence status and that a WOB request is being reassessed, and provided 2015-2016 figures while admitting 2014 figures were not available.
On which analyses and/or monitors are or are not kept in which units, I will inform the House after the WOB request has been processed.
Over de vraag welke analyses en/of monitors in welke eenheden nu wel of niet worden bijgehouden zal ik uw Kamer informeren nadat het wob-verzoek is afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Azmani over het bericht dat hulporganisaties mensensmokkelaars faciliteren

Two MPs from CDA and VVD asked whether NGOs rescuing migrants at sea cooperate with smugglers, whether Dutch organisations or subsidised groups are involved, and whether the government will act against such aid. The government says it has no evidence of direct contact between some NGOs and smugglers, welcomes Italian investigations, names Dutch NGOs without state subsidy, and says it will continue dialogue while stressing that the discussion belongs at EU level.
The cabinet has no indications that there is direct contact between some aid organisations and criminal smuggling networks.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over aanwijzingen dat er sprake zou zijn van rechtstreeks contact tussen sommige hulporganisaties en criminele smokkelbendes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, Sjoerdsma en Bisschop over het bericht "Zorgeloos in Eritrea"

MPs asked whether Eritrean refugees holding asylum status who travel back to Eritrea should lose their status, how often this is checked and enforced, and whether travel can be traced. The State Secretary says such travel can trigger review or withdrawal of temporary permits, reports withdrawals of a few dozen permits, no Eritreans among checked cases, and that tracing all Eritrean travellers is not possible.
It is not possible to determine how many Eritreans from the Netherlands have travelled to Eritrea or neighbouring countries in recent years.
Het is niet mogelijk om te achterhalen hoeveel Eritreeërs uit Nederland de afgelopen jaren naar Eritrea of omringende landen zijn gereisd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Peters over onterechte verdenkingen van kindermishandeling

CDA MPs Keijzer and Peters asked the state secretary about research suggesting that child-abuse screening questionnaires used by doctors lead to mostly unfounded suspicions, and about the training, procedures and data retention affecting wrongly accused parents. The state secretary disputes that the research shows over 90% unfounded suspicions, says screening is only an alert tool, promises to explore having Veilig Thuis itself initiate destruction of files when suspicions are refuted, and notes that training is left to field parties without a separate budget.
Together with the Landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis I consider it desirable that Veilig Thuis, when the suspicion has been refuted, itself takes the initiative to destroy the file.
Samen met het Landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis vind ik het wenselijk dat Veilig Thuis, als het vermoeden is weerlegd, zélf het initiatief neemt tot vernietiging van het dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Van Klaveren en Voordewind over de vluchtelingendeal met Turkije

MPs from several parties asked whether PM Rutte and Chancellor Merkel made a gentlemen's agreement with Turkey to resettle 150,000-250,000 Syrian refugees a year, and whether the government asked Turkey to postpone a visit by Minister Cavusoglu. The government denied any side agreement, pointed to the EU-Turkey statement of 18 March 2016 and ongoing EU resettlement talks, denied any request to postpone the visit, and declined to answer the questions one by one before the requested deadline.
No. Agreements have only been made at European level on resettling Syrian refugees from Turkey.
Antwoord 4 Er zijn enkel in Europees verband afspraken gemaakt over het hervestigen van Syrische vluchtelingen vanuit Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Keijzer en Ten Broeke over uitspraken van de president van Mali over terugname van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers en illegalen

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the ministers whether Mali's president's statements that Mali would never sign a readmission agreement undermined the EU-Mali migration deal and whether Mali was cooperating enough on returning its nationals, and whether pressure or aid conditionality should be used. The government answered that the joint declaration remains valid, that Mali is bound by international law to cooperate on returns, that only about ten Malians returned voluntarily since 2014 and none forcibly, and that it prefers a broad pragmatic approach over negative incentives such as cutting aid.
The cabinet is of the view that measures to encourage this cooperation are most effective when they are part of a broader package.
Het kabinet is van mening dat maatregelen om deze medewerking te stimuleren het effectiefst zijn als zij onderdeel zijn van een breder pakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Asielcheck totaal fiasco"

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister and State Secretary of Security and Justice why the promised inspection report on asylum identification was delayed until December, why phone and data-carrier checks are not always fully carried out due to time, capacity and equipment limits, and whether the registration process can detect trafficking and terrorism signals. The government answers that the inspection finds the process now carefully executed with some improvement points, that devices are largely in order, that the delay was due to a procedural cycle with a publication on 21 December, and that further measures and a follow-up inspection on signal handling are underway.

With this, the commitment made by the Minister of Security and Justice during the General Consultation on Counterterrorism of 24 November 2016 to send the Inspection report with policy response to the House of Representatives before the Christmas recess has been fulfilled.

Daarmee is voldaan aan de toezegging van de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Terrorismebestrijding van 24 november 2016 om het Inspectierapport met beleidsreactie nog voor het kerstreces aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Dik-Faber over vastgoed in de zorg

MPs Keijzer and Dik-Faber asked the State Secretary about vacant care property, waiting lists and the ending of the care infrastructure subsidy. The State Secretary answered that the NZa sees no continuity risk for elderly care, that property decisions lie with providers, and that a successor regulation will be developed.
I want to work towards a national regulation with regional involvement that will replace the care infrastructure subsidy scheme.
Ik wil toewerken naar een landelijke regeling met regionale betrokkenheid, die de subsidieregeling zorginfrastructuur zal vervangen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het nog steeds niet op een juiste wijze uitvoering geven aan de Wmo 2015 door gemeenten in vervolg op de uitspraken van de Centrale Raad van Beroep op 18 mei jl.

An MP asked whether the municipality of Katwijk is implementing the Wmo 2015 correctly after Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings, and whether other municipalities' household-help schemes comply. The State Secretary says Katwijk has not sufficiently complied with his urgent request, so he is starting the formal instruction procedure under Wmo 2015 (art. 2.6.8), while declining to name a firm deadline for the rest of the questions.

With this response, the municipality of Katwijk has not sufficiently complied with my earlier urgent request to adjust the ordinance, policy rules and implementation of the policy as soon as possible and bring them into line with the Wmo 2015.

Met deze reactie geeft de gemeente Katwijk onvoldoende gehoor aan mijn eerdere, dringende, oproep om op de kortst mogelijke termijn de verordening, de beleidsregels en de uitvoering van het beleid aan te passen en in lijn te brengen met de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over geregistreerde meldingen en incidenten op en rondom COA-opvanglocaties

An MP asked why COA-registered aggression incidents at asylum reception centres far exceed the number of police reports and criminal complaints, and asked about the nationalities involved, refused residence permits and deportations. The State Secretary explained that COA registers all incidents, that not every report leads to a complaint or prosecution, that nationality data cannot reliably be linked to incidents, and that the average IND processing time for safe-country applicants was ten days.
I cannot rule out that there were cases involving material damage or a victim where no complaint was filed or no prosecution was instituted.
Ik kan niet uitsluiten dat er gevallen zijn waarbij er wel materiële schade of een benadeelde was, maar geen aangifte is gedaan of vervolging is ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het artikel "Wethouder Fles en CDA Noordwijk nemen elkaar de maat"

A CDA MP asks the State Secretary whether the Noordwijk case shows that 'self-reliance' is used inconsistently under the Wmo, whether municipalities must act to prevent harm from closing a building without consulting partners, and whether the municipality wrongly treats prevention and early signalling as outside the Wmo. The State Secretary answers that municipalities may assess self-reliance within the law, that a legal definition is undesirable, that the municipality does provide support and prevention, and that the council has the power to ask questions.
Municipalities can assess the degree of self-reliance of residents.
Gemeenten kunnen de mate van zelfredzaamheid van inwoners beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over de huur van panden voor een azc in Maastricht

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked about the COA's lease of Parkweg 20 and Blekerij 52 in Maastricht for an asylum centre, including the rent, the transaction history, vetting of the owner, and links to an FIOD investigation. The State Secretary answered that rents are not disclosed for commercial reasons, that the COA checked the owner via a notary who found no links, and that the FIOD does not inform other bodies about its investigations.
The COA does not make lease contracts public. A lease contract contains information that affects the economic and financial interests of the COA.
Het COA maakt geen huurcontracten openbaar. Een huurcontract bevat informatie die de economische en financiële belangen van het COA raken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Zorgverzekeraars claimen 50 miljoen bij aanbieders wijkverpleging en het bericht van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland dat zorgverzekeraars verbaasd zi

MPs Keijzer and Bruins Slot asked about reports that health insurers claim 50 million from home-care providers for exceeding revenue caps, and about insurers' duty of care for insured persons. The State Secretary answered that such contractual revenue caps and clawbacks are a matter between insurers and providers, that insurers' statutory duty of care remains intact, and described the dispute-resolution route and the numbers of additional contracts and care hours.
This concerns a component of a contractual agreement between an individual care provider and an individual health insurer, of which I am not a party.
Dit betreft een onderdeel van een contractuele overeenkomst tussen een individuele zorgaanbieder en een individuele zorgverzekeraar waarin ik geen partij ben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het aftreden van de voltallige Adviesraad Sociaal Domein van de gemeente Katwijk

An MP asked the State Secretary about the resignation of the entire Katwijk social domain advisory council over the municipality's Wmo implementation, including whether the municipality complied with Central Raad van Beroep rulings and whether it used individual assessments. The State Secretary answered that Katwijk had partly corrected its ordinance, that the remaining fee-discount scheme does not fit the Wmo 2015, and that he has written to the municipal executive requesting a response on bringing policy into line.

I have therefore, in accordance with the rules of inter-governmental supervision, requested in writing that the Katwijk executive inform me promptly of how the municipality will bring its policy and implementation in line with the Wmo 2015.

Ik heb het college van B en W van de gemeente Katwijk daarom, conform de spelregels van het interbestuurlijk toezicht, schriftelijk verzocht mij op korte termijn te informeren over de wijze waarop de gemeente beleid en uitvoering in lijn brengt met de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Inburgeren vrijblijvend”

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that newcomers are not informed that failing integration requirements can lead to loss of residence permits, and whether national and international rules prevent such revocation. The government answered that newcomers are informed via IND and DUO materials, that no permits have yet been revoked for non-compliance, and that EVRM and the Family Reunification Directive limit revocation for some groups, referring to an earlier letter.
No, this is not correct. Newcomers are informed through various channels about the (residence-law) consequences of failing to meet the integration obligation.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Nieuwkomers worden via diverse kanalen geïnformeerd over de (verblijfsrechtelijke) gevolgen bij het niet voldoen aan de inburgeringsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Onderzoek gevolgen eigen bijdragen Wmo flink vertraagd”

An MP from the CDA asks why the CBS study into the effects of higher Wmo co-payments is delayed again and whether care avoidance is included. The State Secretary answers that the data were not ready for preliminary results before summer, final tables are expected in November 2016, and care avoidance falls outside the CBS study, to be covered by complementary qualitative research.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Azc's krijgen vertrouwenspersonen voor homoseksuele asielzoekers’

MPs Van der Staaij, Keijzer and Voordewind asked whether asylum reception centres have dedicated confidants for vulnerable groups such as gay asylum seekers and Christians, about prosecution of crimes against vulnerable groups, and about cameras protecting them. The State Secretary answered that a coordinating confidant function and staff confidants serve all residents without targeting specific groups, that training is being shaped with NGOs, that a new report will show incident-to-prosecution figures without group breakdown, and that cameras are used under an internal framework.
The registration does not break down cases by specific target groups.
In de registratie wordt geen uitsplitsing gemaakt naar specifieke doelgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de screening van asielzoekers in 2015 naar aanleiding van een enquête onder 800 politieagenten in Europa door de Europese Politievakbond

The MP Keijzer asked whether the government accepts the screening deficiencies flagged in an EU police union survey and the Inspectorate report, whether the 58,000 asylum seekers of 2015 were fully registered and checked, and where they now reside. The government admits the 2015 registration was basic and backlogged but says all were registered, checked against security databases without findings, and that tracking is limited because the group is not followed as a cohort.

It is not easy to establish how many of the more than 58,000 asylum seekers in the immigration chain systems have a known residence in the Netherlands, because this group is not tracked as a group (cohort approach).

Het is niet eenvoudig in beeld te brengen van hoeveel van de ruim 58.000 asielzoekers in de systemen van de vreemdelingenketen een verblijfplaats in Nederland bekend is omdat deze groep niet als een groep wordt gevolgd (cohortbenadering).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht ‘Ontslag voor 250 huishoudelijke hulpen Zorggroep’

MP Keijzer asked the State Secretary about the planned dismissal of 250 domestic helpers at Zorggroep Oude en Nieuwe Land and whether the hourly rates paid by three municipalities allow a sound business and meet municipal duties under the Wmo 2015. The State Secretary answered that the municipalities' policy does not comply with Wmo 2015 rules after recent court rulings, that temporary and structural arrangements are being prepared, and that the rates meet the Code and sufficient budget exists.
The three municipal executives acknowledge this and will propose to their councils in the short term to adjust the local Wmo policy for cleaning support.
De drie colleges van burgemeester en wethouders erkennen dit feit en stellen op korte termijn de gemeenteraden voor het lokale Wmo-beleid voor schoonmaakondersteuning te aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bruins Slot over het bericht “Wijkverpleegkundigen helpen steeds vaker met huishoudelijke taken”

MPs Keijzer and Bruins Slot asked whether district nurses increasingly perform household tasks, what hourly rates apply, and whether gemeenten and insurers coordinate home care sufficiently. The state secretary said district nurses should not normally do household work, saw no link to volume and tariff cuts, and agreed to raise the issue with the VNG, while declining to collect data on how often it happens.
I do not have figures on this. Requesting them would lead to additional administrative burdens for district nurses.
Ik heb hier geen cijfers over. Het uitvragen hiervan zal leiden tot extra administratieve lasten voor wijkverpleegkundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters en Keijzer over het bericht ‘Subsidie voor een werkster ook al verdien je genoeg’

MPs Potters and Keijzer asked whether it is undesirable that municipalities using ministry HHT funds offer subsidised household help to all residents, not only those with a Wmo indication, and whether the arrangement conflicts with HHT conditions. The state secretary replied that municipalities are free to design the HHT, that it does not replace Wmo help, that he sees no reason for further investigation, consultation or a data request, and that the spending is accountable to the municipal councils.
I therefore see no reason to consult with the municipalities of the Gooi and Vechtstreek region and the VNG on the spending of the HHT funds.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden voor overleg over de besteding van de HHT middelen met de gemeenten van de regio Gooi en Vechtstreek en de VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de CIZ (Centrum Indicatiestelling Zorg) - beleidsregels indicatiestelling Wlz 2016 (Wet langdurige zorg) in relatie tot kinderen

An MP asked the state secretary about the CIZ eligibility rules for children under five seeking Wlz long-term care, including when constant care is considered ordinary parental care and how decisions are made. The state secretary replied that the 2016 rules changed only in examples, that under-five children can qualify for Wlz mainly if severely multiple disabled, and gave application figures for the first four months of 2016.
Yes, I am aware of the content of the 2016 Wlz indication policy rules.
Ja, ik ben op de hoogte van de inhoud van de beleidsregels indicatiestelling Wlz voor het jaar 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over de uitgaven wijkverpleging 2015 en de inkoop wijkverpleging 2016

MPs Bruins Slot and Keijzer (CDA) asked the State Secretary about 2015 spending overruns, 2016 volume and tariff cuts, shortages of community nurses, the new 'Beloning op maat' payment, administrative burden, and coverage of on-call services. The State Secretary answered that the 2015 overrun of EUR 37.7 million is modest, that contracting is a shared responsibility of insurers and providers, and listed measures on staffing, innovation and administrative burden, with a monitor from the NZa promised, but gave no data on specific care volumes.

I have no figures on the volumes of specific care forms such as intensive child care and palliative care, because these care forms are declared under the regular nursing and care services and insurers and providers keep no separate registration.

Ik heb geen cijfers over de volumes van specifieke zorgvormen zoals intensieve kindzorg en pallatieve zorg omdat deze zorgvormen worden gedeclareerd onder de reguliere prestaties verpleging en verzorging en er geen aparte registratie wordt bijgehouden door verzekeraars en aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Keijzer over verdringing op de woningmarkt door statushouders

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister for Housing about reports that statushouders (refugees with status) take up a third of freed-up social homes, displacing others, and about whether gemeenten can meet their housing quotas. The minister said the Companen figures come from a survey not a study, stressed local tailoring, pointed to existing subsidy and agreement instruments, and promised follow-up on the motion De Vries.
I am of the view that housing policy is best implemented at local level, with as little as possible imposed from above.
Ik ben van mening dat het woningmarktbeleid het best op lokaal niveau kan worden ingevuld waarbij zo min mogelijk van bovenaf moet worden opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Toorenburg, Knops en Keijzer over de zaak Saban B. in Turkije

CDA MPs asked about the case of Saban B., convicted in the Netherlands to 7 years 9 months for trafficking and assault but still free in Turkey, and about Turkey's cooperation on enforcing Dutch sentences. The minister answered that Turkish proceedings are still pending, that Dutch requests since 2010 cover 23 persons with at least 6 granted, and that a memorandum of understanding is being negotiated, but did not provide a complete list or the requested one-week timeline.

In the context of protecting the privacy of the persons concerned, I can only inform you that since 2010 the Netherlands has, under the Wots, expressed to Turkey the wish to transfer enforcement of a Dutch sentence for 23 persons.

In het kader van bescherming van de privacy van de betrokken personen, kan ik u slechts mededelen dat Nederland vanaf 2010 op grond van de Wots ten aanzien van 23 personen aan Turkije de wens kenbaar heeft gemaakt de tenuitvoerlegging van een Nederlands vonnis aan Turkije over te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Bijna 40 procent uitzettingen mislukt"

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice to confirm a report that nearly 40 percent of deportations fail, and whether the chain's return procedures are undermined, along with questions on last-minute asylum applications, notice periods, source-country cooperation and departures without supervision. The State Secretary says the 40 percent refers to cancelled booked flights (not all forced departures), argues that rising self-departure shows return is improving, and promises further analysis of EU rules and the revision of the Dublin and Procedures Directives.
The 40% figure is correct, but it does not refer to the number of failed deportations as the headline suggests, but to the number of booked flights that are cancelled.
Het percentage van 40% is correct, maar ziet niet op het aantal mislukte uitzettingen zoals de titel van het bericht doet vermoeden, maar op het aantal geboekte vluchten dat wordt geannuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Gave: ook christenen in Nederlandse azc’s bedreigd’

MPs from SGP, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that Christians in asylum centres are threatened, including comparisons with Germany and reporting and information measures. The State Secretary declined to make quantitative comparisons with other countries, said each incident requires a firm approach, and pointed to earlier letter measures on reporting encouragement, safety across locations and information for asylum seekers.
I do not have information on the basis of which I can make such quantitative comparisons with Germany or another country.
Ik beschik niet over informatie op basis waarvan ik dergelijke kwantitatieve vergelijkingen kan maken met Duitsland of een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Keijzer over het bericht ‘Lastpak naar aso-azc’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Keijzer asked whether the state secretary had examined using the former PI Tilburg or the Zeist detention centre as a stricter facility for rule-breaking asylum seekers, and about the regime, timing, and pros and cons. The state secretary answered that the Tilburg option was not linked to the planned separate facility, that COA is exploring suitable locations (requiring local consent) and a stricter regime not based on immigration detention, and that a criminal investigation follows any offence as usual.
This exploration is currently ongoing, and I will inform your House about it at a later moment.
Momenteel is deze verkenning gaande waarover ik uw Kamer op een later moment zalinformeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht ‘Veel meer asielaanvragen uit de Balkan, IND ‘verrast’

An MP asked why asylum applications from safe countries rose in 2015, whether Dutch law invites such applications, how the IND prioritises them, and what lessons to draw from Bavaria's border procedure. The State Secretary answered that no separate study exists, outlined the new fast-track 'spoor 2' procedure with detention and removal steps, and said Dutch capacity for detention is sufficient, while not answering on the timing of the requested Tilburg prison study.
There is no separate study into the causes of this.
Er is geen separaat onderzoek naar de oorzaken hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Keijzer over het onderzoek inzake de kunstroof in het Westfries Museum in Hoorn

Two Christian Democrat MPs asked why Ukraine appears not to take the Hoorn museum art theft investigation seriously, including questions about unheard suspects and the Ukrainian security service's role. The Ministers answered that Ukraine is conducting a criminal investigation, that the Netherlands cannot comment on an ongoing prosecution, and that cooperation is satisfactory, while declining to share case progress details with Parliament.
Since this concerns an ongoing criminal investigation, no statements about it will be made to the House.
Gezien het een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek betreft, worden hierover geen mededelingen aan de Kamer gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Accountants worstelen met administratieve chaos bij gemeenten en zorginstellingen”

MP Keijzer asked about reports that accountants struggle with administrative chaos at municipalities and care providers, and what instruments exist to verify the lawfulness of Wmo and Jeugdwet spending in the transition year 2015. The Secretary says instruments such as the model rechtmatigheid protocol were developed and promoted, while refusing to loosen audit requirements because that would require changing the audit decree and reduce transparency to the council.

Because such a change would undermine the desired transparency towards the municipal council, ignore the differing starting positions of municipalities and is also legally and operationally complex, the Minister of BZK, in line with current cabinet policy, has not proposed any changes.

Omdat een dergelijke wijziging afbreuk doet aan de gewenste transparantie naar de gemeenteraad, de verschillende uitgangsposities van gemeenten miskent en bovendien juridisch en uitvoeringstechnisch complex is heeft de Minister van BZK, in lijn met het vigerende kabinetsbeleid, geen wijzigingen voorgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Keijzer over de opvang van statushouders

CDA MPs Ronnes and Keijzer asked the Minister for Housing about Brabant municipalities lacking housing for refugees, rising social-housing waiting times, whether municipalities can meet their 2016 placement quotas, and the status of alternative housing under the Bestuursakkoord. Minister Blok answered that waiting-time effects cannot be precisely isolated, that municipalities should be able to meet quotas, and that 325 subsidy applications for about 1,647 places were under review.
I committed to your House on 26 November 2015 to have a study carried out into waiting times for social rental housing.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 26 november 2015 toegezegd een onderzoek te laten uitvoeren naar de wachttijden voor sociale huurwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over wachttijd voor een vervangende rolstoel

A CDA MP asked the state secretary about a seven-month wait for a replacement wheelchair, the duty of municipalities to ensure timely supply, whether VWS will agree concrete arrangements with the VNG, and the number of wheelchair suppliers and mergers. The secretary said the Wmo 2015 contains timeliness safeguards, the responsible municipal social service apologised and resolved the case, municipalities hold the responsibility for procurement and oversight, and no VNG agreement is currently planned.
I currently see no reason to consult with the VNG on how municipalities provide assistive devices under the Wmo 2015, or to make concrete arrangements with municipalities on this.

Ik heb op dit moment geen aanleiding om over de wijze waarop gemeenten hulpmiddelen in het kader van de Wmo 2015 verstrekken in overleg met de VNG te gaan en of daarover concrete afspraken te maken met gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Zilveren kruis smeert verstandelijk beperkten wurgcontract aan"

MPs from nine parties asked the State Secretary about a Zilveren Kruis settlement agreement offered to persoonsgebonden budget holders, and whether it should be withdrawn and whether the motion to halt recovery was being implemented. The State Secretary answered that the zorgkantoren act on agreements made with them, that the settlement need no longer be signed pending a good-faith assessment, that recovery of alleged improperly paid budgets is suspended until good faith is assessed by 1 May 2016, and that other zorgkantoren operate under the same agreements.
By 1 May 2016 or as soon as possible, zorgkantoren will have assessed in all currently open individual cases whether the budget holder acted in good faith.
Uiterlijk 1 mei 2016 of zoveel eerder als mogelijk, hebben zorgkantoren in alle op dit moment openstaande individuele casuïstiek beoordeeld of de budgethouder te goeder trouw heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Bestuurder in de buurt weegt mee bij locatie AZC”

An MP asked whether a list of 36 residents near the Prinses Julianakazerne, some of them officials, was compiled as part of a site assessment for an asylum centre and whether locations were rejected because administrators lived nearby. The government answered that the list was an inventory linked to a possible change of use, that the presence of administrators is not a relevant factor for the COA, and that no locations were rejected for that reason.
That may not and cannot be the case.
Dat kan en mag niet het geval zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Tellegen over de berichtgeving dat de politie in Zweden kennis over de achtergrond van daders van aanrandingen niet naar buiten heeft gebracht

MPs Keijzer and Tellegen asked whether situations like the Cologne New Year's assaults had occurred in the Netherlands, what the National Police's policy is on publicising incidents that could cause social unrest, and whether police transparently report the origin of perpetrators of group sex crimes and theft. The Minister answered that there are no signals of such incidents in the Netherlands, that disclosure is the responsibility of the local authority and/or Public Prosecution Service, and that police record suspects' birthplace and nationality and inform the competent local authority.
Disclosure of incidents and reports falls under the responsibility of the local authority and/or the Public Prosecution Service.
Het openbaar maken van incidenten en meldingen valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag en/of het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de telefonische bereikbaarheid van de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) over problemen met het persoonsgebonden budget (PGB)

An MP asked the State Secretary why the SVB's phone number for persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) problems was not displayed prominently on its website, and about call volumes and waiting times. The State Secretary acknowledged the website had been reorganised, added the phone number to all answers and contact pages, and reported that telephone accessibility was in order apart from one morning with higher call volume.
Meanwhile, on 8 January the SVB added the phone number to every question and answer on the contact page.
Inmiddels heeft de SVB op 8 januari jl. het telefoonnummer opgenomen bij elke vraag en antwoord op de contact-pagina
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Ronnes over het bericht dat Eritrese vluchtelingen in Boxtel tijdelijk naar het azc in Oisterwijk moeten verhuizen

MPs Keijzer and Ronnes asked whether about thirty Eritrean teenage girls in Boxtel must move to the Oisterwijk reception centre, a distance of about 13-14 km, and why that move is needed when they are already in a safe environment. The State Secretary confirms the move is due to closing the Boxtel crisis emergency shelter under the new agreement between national and municipal government, that safety plays no role, and that the centre has specialised staff for unaccompanied minors.
The agreement between national government and municipalities in the recently concluded administrative agreement is that the CNO is to be phased out as quickly as possible.
De afspraak tussen Rijk en gemeenten in het recent gesloten bestuursakkoord is dat de CNO zo snel als mogelijk wordt afgebouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer inzake het bieden van veilige opvang aan LHBT-asielzoekers en statushouders

An MP asked about a Zaanstad project supporting LHBT asylum seekers and refugees, and whether a letter to Regenbooggemeenten encouraged separate Amsterdam-style shelter for LHBT asylum seekers. The minister answered that the letter was informative only, that the Amsterdam emergency shelter was an exceptional case, that perpetrators of discrimination should be prosecuted or relocated, and that a policy tightening on asylum permit revocation was announced.
The Cabinet will inform the House shortly by letter about COA's efforts on this point.
Het Kabinet zal uw Kamer op korte termijn middels een brief te informeren over de inzet van COA op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het bericht “Brabant Zorg sluit geen contract af met DSW en Menzis voor wijkverpleging in 2016”

MPs Bruins Slot and Keijzer asked about BrabantZorg not contracting DSW and Menzis for district nursing in 2016, the price and budget figures, and how insured people are protected. The Secretary of State says the zorgplicht ensures insured people keep access to care, reports preliminary 2015 spending figures that may exceed the budget by about €50 million, and says the MBI would only be considered after definitive figures and analysis of causes.
Before the MBI is applied, several steps will be carried out.
Voordat het MBI wordt ingezet zullen er verschillende stappen worden doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Keijzer over een wijziging van het procesreglement Civiel Jeugdrecht

CDA MPs Oskam and Keijzer asked whether the change to the Civil Youth Law procedure rules, which stops non-guardian parents from relying on their rights as interested parties, could be reversed by a judge and how many parents are affected. The Minister answered that the judge decides who is an interested party, that no body records how many parents are affected, and that the Adviescommissie Burgerlijk Procesrecht is advising, with a report expected in spring 2016.
We have asked the Adviescommissie Burgerlijk Procesrecht to advise on the concept of interested party within the meaning of article 798(1) Rv in cases concerning supervision orders.
Wij hebben de Adviescommissie Burgerlijk Procesrecht verzocht om te adviseren over het begrip belanghebbende in de zin van artikel 798 lid 1 Rv in zaken betreffende de ondertoezichtstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de stand van zaken bij Fokuswonen

An MP asked the state secretary about Fokus Wonen's 2014 and expected 2015 deficits, its compliance with subsidy rules and IGZ requirements, the future of ADL clustered housing, the budget increase for the Wlz subsidy, criteria for extra funds, and court rulings on linking tenancy and care contracts. The state secretary explained the deficits and stated that Fokus meets its obligations, that a multi-year budget increase applies to all ADL projects, and that case law on linking housing and care contracts is limited and depends on circumstances, though the answers were sent late.
Incidentally, the business operations of Fokus and the choices it makes are the primary responsibility of the board member(s) concerned.
Overigens is de bedrijfsvoering van Fokus en de keuzen die men daartoe maakt de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van de betrokken bestuurder(s).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de derde voortgangsrapportage hervorming langdurige zorg (HLZ) d.d. 3 november 2015

An MP asked the state secretary whether care for people with mild intellectual disabilities under 18 and the shift of ZZP VG3/VG4 care to municipalities under the Wmo had changed, and how many people need temporary protected housing, while questioning the sharp fall in CIZ indications. The secretary denied any policy change, said Wlz eligibility criteria differ from the former AWBZ, that municipalities are responsible for temporary needs, and that an external study on the target group and budget will follow.
Analysis of data has shown that it is not possible to obtain clarity in the short term on the size of the target group per municipality and the budget involved in support.
Uit analyse van data is gebleken dat het niet mogelijk is om op korte termijn duidelijkheid te krijgen over de omvang van de doelgroep per gemeente en het met de ondersteuning gemoeide budget.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Verhoeven en Keijzer over kosten van RADAR

MPs from SP, D66 and CDA asked about the cost of the RADAR ICT system, including the value of the Capgemini delivery contract, extra work paid after termination, and external staffing costs. The State Secretary corrected earlier figures, estimated about 350,000 euro extra for Capgemini's support on the KvK interface, declined a detailed breakdown of staffing costs as too burdensome, and promised a planning for that answer.
I therefore suggest, given the administrative burden, that you refrain from this effort.
Ik geef u daarom in overweging mee, met het oog op administratieve lastendruk, af te zien van deze inspanning.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Keijzer over het openbaar maken van het oordeel van de Chief Information Officer van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport én het openbaar maken van de verslagen

MPs Bergkamp and Keijzer asked why the CIO assessment of the SVB's ICT system and the minutes of the PGB Trekkingsrecht steering group have not been made public, and why a Wob request was answered late. The state secretary replied that the CIO assessment and steering group minutes were made available to parliament confidentially, that officials' and external participants' views are not published, and that the Wob deadline was exceeded due to processing delays.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Keijzer over zorg na coma

MPs Dik-Faber and Keijzer asked the health minister about care after coma, including the Zorginstituut's review of early intensive neurorehabilitation for adults over 25, misdiagnosis and poor diagnostics in prolonged disorders of consciousness, and a national expertise network. The minister said the Zorginstituut expects to publish its review in spring 2016, and that diagnosis, treatment and knowledge development are the responsibility of professional bodies rather than the government.
It is up to the representative professional groups to interpret the knowledge development on this and, where necessary, incorporate it into the (new) guidelines for responsible care.
Het is aan de representatieve beroepgroepen om de kennisontwikkeling terzake te duiden en zo nodig te verdisconteren in de (nieuwe) richtlijnen voor verantwoorde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over kindermishandeling

An MP asked the government about forensic pediatric examinations in child abuse cases, the expertise and budget of the NFI versus the FPKM, and why the NFI became the single point of contact for acute and complex cases. The minister answered that the NFI is the preferred supplier for the justice chain, that it expanded its child forensic team, and that private institutes can be used for peak demand or counter-expertise, while denying any termination of cooperation with the FPKM.
The NFI is the preferred supplier for the police and the public prosecution service in the criminal justice chain.
Het NFI is voor de politie en het OM de preferred supplier in de strafrechtketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Keijzer over de gevolgen van een wijziging van een procesreglement van de rechtbanken

MPs Oskam and Keijzer asked whether a 2015 change to the Civil Youth Law procedural regulation, based on a Supreme Court ruling, removed parents without custody from the status of interested party in child supervision and placement cases, along with their rights to information, file access and participation, and what support they would receive. The minister confirmed the change, said the removal of automatic party status is a consequence of the ruling, that no data on the group exist, that parents should not be blamed and the consequences will be examined, and that no extra measures are planned because information provision is considered adequate.
That a parent without custody is no longer (by default) regarded as an interested party therefore means that the abovementioned rights lapse.
Dat een ouder zonder gezag niet langer (standaard) als belanghebbende wordt aangemerkt betekent dus dat de hierboven genoemde rechten vervallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Otwin van Dijk over de zware belasting van de mantelzorger

MPs Keijzer and Van Dijk asked the State Secretary about the heavy burden on informal carers caused by overlapping laws and bureaucracy, citing a case broadcast on De Wachtkamer. The State Secretary said the 'one family, one plan' principle is built into the new system, that signals are discussed with stakeholders and obstacles will be removed where needed, and pointed to a pilot for an integrated PGB and the experiment clause in the Wlz.
When obstacles in laws and regulations are experienced, I am willing to look at them and remove them where necessary.
Wanneer er belemmeringen in wet- en regelgeving worden ervaren, ben ik bereid daarnaar te kijken en deze waar nodig weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Keijzer over het bericht dat het kabinet lak heeft aan het medisch beroepsgeheim in de jeugdzorg

MPs Bergkamp and Keijzer asked whether the 25 June 2015 agreement on a temporary ministerial regulation for youth care billing, which lets invoices carry personal and diagnostic data, respects medical confidentiality and was a proper procedural route given a pending bill. The state secretary replied that the temporary regulation, approved by the Dutch Data Protection Authority under conditions, rests on the Youth Act and will be replaced by the Veegwet, and that the regulation will take effect as soon as possible.
The Cbp has indicated it can agree to this temporary ministerial regulation under conditions, and we will honour these conditions.
Het Cbp heeft onder voorwaarden aangegeven te kunnen instemmen met deze tijdelijke ministeriële regeling en deze voorwaarden zullen door ons worden gehonoreerd.
Vragen van het lid Keijzer (CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «De PGB-affaire 3: Uitweg uit de crisis» (ingezonden 17 juni 2015).

An MP asked the State Secretary about a column on the PGB (personal budget) scandal, including the SVB's Treks system, data linkage, open-sourcing the code, a proposed PGB data authority, and internal SVB culture. The State Secretary answered that a full automated tracking system is not yet in place but is planned, that a rebuild is unnecessary since the system can be developed further, that the SVB owns the code and open publication poses security risks, and that a separate data authority is rejected in favour of a simplification review.
Publishing the source code increases the risk that unauthorised persons find ways into the system to search for and manipulate privacy-sensitive information.
Door het openbaar maken van de broncode wordt het risico vergroot dat onbevoegden mogelijkheden vinden in het systeem privacygevoelige informatie op te zoeken en te manipuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Van Helvert over jeugdzorg voor gezinnen die in het buitenland wonen, maar werken en/of schoolgaan in Nederland

MPs Keijzer and Van Helvert asked how youth care applies to families living abroad but working or schooling in the Netherlands, and whether the Jeugdwet decentralisation removed their access to youth mental health care. The state secretary answered that the residence principle of the Jeugdwet excludes these children, that EU social security coordination covers only insured care, and that a transitional arrangement runs for a maximum of one year.
I will check with the VNG whether there are specific bottlenecks in implementing the transitional arrangement.
Ik zal met de VNG wel nagaan of er bij de uitvoering van het overgangsrecht specifieke knelpunten zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over contra-expertise (Eerste deelrapportage, tweede deelrapportage en eindverslag) opgesteld door M&I/Partners met betrekking tot het uitvoeren van het trekkingsrecht door de Socia

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Health about a contra-expertise by M&I/Partners on the SVB's implementation of the trekkingsrecht (payment-entitlement system) for personal budgets, probing the evidence base, ICT robustness, architecture, costs and fraud-fighting rationale. The State Secretary answered that the report found the current system functioning technically, that further stabilisation and a verbeterplan will follow, and that some information (such as source code) cannot be published for security reasons.
On the basis of the Roadmap Implementation drawn up by the SVB, I issued the assignment at the time.
Op basis van de door de SVB opgestelde Roadmap Invoering heb ik destijds de opdracht verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het Keijzer over het bericht “Mantelzorgers melden zich vaker ziek op werk”

The MP asked the state secretary about reports that informal carers are taking more sick leave, cuts to day activities and home help, and what the government will do to relieve carers. The state secretary answered that the Wmo 2015 strengthens the carer's position, that municipalities must assess carers' capacity, and that a leave-regulation campaign and projects with employers are underway, while stating that continuity of support must not be compromised and that municipal cuts are for municipalities to decide individually.

I trust that parties will take their (statutory) responsibility and shape it in such a way that the continuity of support for the target group, elderly and/or people with dementia, is not jeopardised.

Ik ga er vanuit dat partijen hun (wettelijke) verantwoordelijkheid nemen en hier op een zodanige wijze invulling ingeven dat de continuïteit van de ondersteuning voor de desbetreffende doelgroep, ouderen en/of mensen met dementie, niet in het geding komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “ Mensen verdwalen in de nieuwe zorgregels”

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health about press reports that people get lost between care counters under the new long-term care, Wmo and health insurance rules, including the role of MEE client support, the Wmo 2015 melding-before-application procedure, a missing urgent procedure when insurers refuse care, and the complexity for people with mild intellectual disabilities. The State Secretary acknowledged that responsibility boundaries are not always clear in practice, pointed to ongoing guidance, client support and a self-test for municipalities, said existing complaint and dispute routes suffice without a special urgent procedure, and promised to respond to a SCP report in spring.
I find this situation undesirable. There is therefore ongoing attention to improving this situation.
Ik vind deze situatie onwenselijk. Er is daarom doorlopend aandacht voor verbetering van deze situatie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over opgevraagde documenten bij het algemeen overleg van 3 maart 2015 en het algemeen overleg van 26 maart 2015 over de Voortgang van de uitbetalingsproblematiek van persoonsgebonde

MP Keijzer asked the State Secretary to send the documents requested at the 3 March and 26 March 2015 committee meetings on the PGB payment problems at the SVB, and to provide the updated budget covering all extra costs. The State Secretary sent most listed documents, promised to report total extra costs by mid-May, and offered confidential inspection of CIO opinions and steering committee minutes, while declining to release source code for security and intellectual property reasons.
I see no good way to make the source code available in an accessible and understandable manner.
Ik zie geen goede mogelijkheid om de broncodes op een toegankelijke en begripvolle manier beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het onderzoek van ActiZ naar de inkoop wijkverpleging 2015

Two MPs from the CDA asked the minister about an ActiZ study showing large volume cuts (up to 40%) imposed by health insurers on district nursing providers in 2015, and the resulting threats to waiting lists, specialised care, budgets and contract terms. The state secretary answered that the cuts are within the agreed framework, insurers have a duty of care, budgets are monitored, and the issue of splitting segment 1 and 2 will be addressed in a forthcoming letter.
The NZa supervises health insurers' implementation of the Zvw and enforces when necessary.
De NZa houdt toezicht op de uitvoering van de Zvw door zorgverzekeraars en handhaaft wanneer noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, de Rouwe en Pieter Heerma over de mantelzorgboete

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers about the AOW cost-sharing norm, the municipal rules and evidence required for exempt mantelzorg (care-related) dwellings, and related questions on house numbers and social security treatment. The government answered that the AOW household norm is postponed to 1 July 2016 with a report on care effects expected before summer 2015, that municipalities assess mantelzorg needs with open-ended evidence, and that social security uses the actual living situation rather than the building rule.
The decision-making on the cost-sharing norm in relation to its effects on informal care is expected to be sent to your House before summer 2015.
De besluitvorming over de kostendelersnorm in relatie tot de effecten op mantelzorg zal naar verwachting voor de zomer van 2015 naar uw Kamer worden gezonden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over de ICT-problemen bij de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) met betrekking tot het niet uitbetalen van pgb’s (persoonsgebonden budgetten)

An MP asked the state secretary many detailed questions about the SVB's ICT problems with paying personal budgets (pgb), including fraud controls, data flows from municipalities, fallback scenarios, costs, and oversight of the SVB by the ministry's CIO. The state secretary answered in detail, acknowledging teething problems but defending the trekkingsrecht system, rejecting a fallback to the old system and an independent feasibility study, and committing to a repair plan and improved oversight.

In the general debate with your House on the pgb trekkingsrecht of 3 March, I committed to drawing up an improvement plan with the parties involved before this summer and informing the House about it.

In het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer over het trekkingsrecht pgb van 3 maart jl. heb ik toegezegd om voor deze zomer in overleg met betrokken partijen een verbeterplan op te stellen en de Kamer daarover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de vermelding van zorgzwaartepakket 4 Verpleging en Verzorging

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Health about differing descriptions of care package ZZP 4 Verpleging en Verzorging across websites, the criteria for eligibility (including whether early dementia or alarm-button capability matters), indication numbers, and CIZ assessment practice. The State Secretary answered that providers are responsible for their own descriptions, that the Wlz care profiles are set in regulation and unchanged in substance, gave indication figures and a 2015 contracting estimate, and explained that the CIZ indicates under the Wlz criteria without an 'able to press an alarm' criterion.
However, I will point this out to the sector organisation.
Ik zal de branche-organisatie er evenwel op wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Keijzer over de hulp aan gewonde oud-militair die met Koerden vocht tegen ISIS

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Health about the plight of a seriously wounded former conscript who fought alongside Kurds against ISIS, and whether the government would help repatriate and treat him. The government answered that he was not a veteran, that consular assistance was provided, that he left Northern Iraq, and that without adequate insurance the state does not finance treatment or repatriation.
With due regard to the security aspect, the usual consular assistance was provided to the person concerned.
Met in achtneming van het veiligheidsaspect is aan betrokkene de gebruikelijke consulaire bijstand verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de ICT-problemen bij de SVB met betrekking tot het niet uitbetalen van pgb’s

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Health about ICT problems at the SVB that prevented PGB payments, covering agreements, system design, cost, fraud control and oversight. The State Secretary answered at length, largely describing agreements, the Nestor/Treks systems, the fallback scenario and planned reviews, and committed to an independent problem analysis.
At the request of the House, an independent problem analysis will be carried out.
Op verzoek van de Kamer zal een onafhankelijke probleemanalyse worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bruins Slot over minutenregistratie voor persoonsgebonden budgetten

MPs Keijzer and Bruins Slot asked whether insurers' requirement to declare personal budget care in five-minute blocks, and their earlier promise to act against minute registration, would be addressed. The Secretary of State says insurers will change their declaration method in consultation with ZN and Per Saldo so pgb holders can declare in a way comparable to the AWBZ, with some insurers needing time to adjust their forms.
In consultation with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) and Per Saldo it was discussed that this creates an undesirable situation for pgb holders.
In overleg met Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) en Per Saldo is besproken dat dit voor pgb-houders een onwenselijke situatie oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Aanvraag bij Wet Langdurige Zorg stagneert, omdat oudere geen paspoort of ID heeft”

An MP asked why residents of care institutions must submit a copy of their passport or ID for Wlz applications from 1 January 2015, whether this delays applications, and how elderly or demented people can apply for identity documents without visiting the town hall or signing. The state secretary explained the statutory identity check, acknowledged the requirement will be amended since a citizen service number suffices, and said municipalities can use mobile equipment and home visits at their discretion.
Article 9.1.1, sixth paragraph of the Wlz will therefore be amended.
Artikel 9.1.1, zesde lid van de Wlz zal daarom worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Leijten over de uitbetaling van zorgverleners van pgb-houders door de Sociale Verzekeringsbank

MPs Leijten and Keijzer asked about SVB payments to care workers of personal budget (pgb) holders, including leaked contracts with citizen service numbers, the number of monthly versus declaration-based workers, and the Rapid Response Team. The State Secretary acknowledged the incidents, gave partial figures (68,000 monthly-paid workers, about 130,000 declaration-based), refused a breakdown by pgb type for now, and promised to share the steering group documents in the evaluation.
Within the short timeframe for answering these questions, it is not possible to provide a breakdown into Wlz-pgb, Wmo-pgb and Jeugdwet-pgb.
Binnen de korte termijn voor beantwoording van voorliggende vragen is het niet mogelijk om een uitsplitsing te geven in Wlz-pgb, Wmo-pgb en Jeugdwet-pgb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de Nieuwsuur uitzending “De gemeente moet het doen”

An MP asked the state secretary about a Nieuwsuur broadcast showing municipal Wmo home-care intake conversations, and whether Apeldoorn's practice breached the Wmo 2015 investigation duty and its approach to self-reliance. The secretary said the broadcast excerpt cannot support conclusions about the adequacy of the investigation, reiterated that all municipalities were reminded of their duties, and noted the municipality says it follows the Wmo structure.
I cannot tell from the broadcast that Apeldoorn interprets self-reliance as financial self-reliance.
Ik kan uit de uitzending niet opmaken dat Apeldoorn zelfredzaamheid uitlegt als financiële zelfredzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over verkeerde beddenproblematiek Verpleging en Verzorging (V&V) en Geestelijke Gezondheidszorg (GGZ)

An MP asked about patients with GGZ-C psychiatric problems receiving V&V nursing care, the loss of coverage after the transfer of GGZ-C to municipalities, and whether these clients must arrange their own GP and paramedical care. The Secretary of State answered that municipalities are responsible for the care, that GP and pharmacy care stays covered under the Zvw, and that access to the Wlz for GGZ clients will be based on objective criteria pending a Zorginstituut framework.
As promised to your House, there will in future also be access to the Wlz for GGZ clients based on objective, substantive criteria.
Zoals aan uw Kamer toegezegd zal er in de toekomst ook voor ggz-cliënten toegang zijn tot de Wlz op basis van objectieve, inhoudelijke criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht op de site van de Algemene Rekenkamer “Aandachtspunten bij begroting 2015 Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport”

An MP asked the state secretary about Court of Audit warnings on risks to PGB (personal budget) payments in 2015, including whether data transfers and contract approvals would be ready in time and what fallback arrangements exist. The state secretary answered that fallback scenarios have been agreed with VNG, ZN and SVB to keep care continuous, including ex officio approval and payment outside the SVB system, and that municipalities are not obliged to issue new decisions to existing budget holders.
In consultation with the parties involved (VNG, ZN and SVB) I have developed fallback scenarios in case matters are not yet completed by crucial dates.
Ik heb in overleg met de betrokken partijen (VNG, ZN en SVB) terugvalscenario's ontwikkeld mochten er op cruciale data zaken nog niet afgerond zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Modale inkomens veel meer kwijt aan eigen bijdragen”

MP Keijzer asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about press reports that middle-income households pay much more in co-payments, including whether the VNG model regulation on co-payments for general provisions should include an anti-cumulation rule and whether income-based co-payments for general provisions amount to income policy. The State Secretary answered that municipalities, under council control, must set proportionate co-payments and consider cumulative effects case by case, that the model regulation need not include generic anti-cumulation rules, and that no separate study of the effects was planned.
I consider it important that municipalities, supervised by the municipal council, pursue an appropriate co-payment policy for the use of general provisions by people with disabilities.
Ik vind het van belang dat gemeenten, gecontroleerd door de gemeenteraad, een passend eigen bijdragebeleid voeren ten aanzien van het gebruik van algemene voorzieningen door mensen met beperkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het artikel op de site van Binnenlands Bestuur "Gemeenten vrezen big bang rondom trekkingsrecht"

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a Binnenlands Bestuur article on municipal fears over the PGB trekkingsrecht (payment authorisation) launch, including extra costs shifted to municipalities, unpaid care providers and ICT misalignment with the SVB. The State Secretary answered that the process is being intensified with the VNG, that continuity of care is the priority, that costs and financing are still under discussion, and that fallback scenarios exist for specific parts rather than a single go/no-go moment.
I am currently in consultation with the VNG on the further elaboration of the fallback scenarios.
Ik ben momenteel in overleg met de VNG over de nadere uitwerking van de terugvalscenario's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het invriezen van een deel van de eierstokken zonder medische noodzaak

An MP asks the health minister to explain her stance that she has no principled objection to freezing part of an ovary for non-medical reasons, and whether this is desirable or should be permitted given that some US employers pay for egg freezing. The minister answers that the technique is still experimental and that, once proven safe and effective by doctors, she sees no reason for government to ban it, with the woman bearing the costs, while the age limit and reimbursement questions are left to doctors and remain premature to settle.
For a medical procedure, it is first of all important whether the technique applied is proven to be safe and effective.
Het is bij een medische ingreep allereerst van belang of de toegepaste techniek bewezen veilig en effectief is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het advies objectief verdeelmodel Wmo 2015 van de Raad voor de financiële verhoudingen

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government will adopt the Rfv's advice against introducing the objective Wmo 2015 distribution model for centre municipalities on 1 January 2015, given large redistribution effects and cuts, and about transition arrangements, contracts and GGZ-C criteria. The state secretary agreed the model should not be introduced in 2015, kept historical budgets for next year, committed to a transition path and consultation with the VNG and providers, but referred some matters to municipalities and the Zorginstituut.
I share this conclusion. It was never the intention to introduce an objective distribution model on 1 January 2015.
Ik deel deze conclusie. Het is ook nooit de bedoeling geweest een objectief verdeelmodel per 1 januari 2015 in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het voorkomen van onnodige ziekenhuisopnames in de laatste levensfase

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister how to prevent unnecessary hospital admissions at the end of life, including discussing non-treatment options, reimbursing conversations about end-of-life care, and financing palliative home-care consultations. The minister agreed that doctors should raise non-treatment options, pointed to existing and planned tariffs and the National Palliative Care Programme, and said funding for palliative home-care teams is being examined.
I therefore agree with the suggestion that GPs, but also other doctors, raise the option of not treating with people who are terminally ill.
Ik ben het daarom eens met de suggestie dat huisartsen, maar ook andere artsen, de optie «niet behandelen» aan de orde stellen bij mensen die ongeneeslijk ziek zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Focus op: toegang op orde/crisisopvang"

MPs Keijzer and Bergkamp asked the state secretary how municipal procurement agreements could conflict with the direct referral route by GPs and specialists under the Youth Act, and whether a persoonsgebonden budget could cover providers without a municipal contract. The state secretary replied that municipalities must ensure the youth care is available, that procurement cannot be a reason to refuse necessary care, that interbestuurlijk toezicht is the lever in extreme cases, and that a pgb is one option among others.
Should it appear that a municipality acts in breach of the Youth Act when procuring youth care, the instruments of interadministrative supervision under the Municipalities Act are available to me.

Mocht blijken dat een gemeente bij de inkoop van jeugdhulp in strijd met de Jeugdwet handelt, dan staat mij het instrumentarium van het interbestuurlijk toezicht op grond van de Gemeentewet ter dienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de IKON-uitzending de Wachtkamer ‘Vechten voor hoop’

MPs Keijzer, Dik-Faber and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a broadcast on coma patients and whether care depends on age and insurer. The minister said no current figures exist for all coma patients, that care follows scientific insight, that the Zorginstituut judged early intensive neurorehabilitation not insured for adults in 2009, and that the institute will re-examine it and may talk to the Zorgen na Coma foundation.
No figures are available on the total number of coma patients, only on the group eligible for early intensive neurorehabilitation.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het totale aantal comapatiënten, wel over de groep patiënten die in aanmerking komt voor vroege intensieve neurorevalidatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bergkamp over het bericht dat er geen sprake is van een zachte landing voor de overheveling van zorgtaken en het bericht ‘Brandbrief gemeenten aan Kamer over cijfers’

MPs Keijzer and Bergkamp asked whether the state secretary knew of reports that the client data handed to municipalities for the transfer of care tasks were unreliable, incomplete or unclear, and what would be done about differing figures and late data. The state secretary answered that the data are consistent with earlier policy information, that differences are explained in an information card, and that talks with municipal and care bodies on solutions are ongoing.
Following the reports, I had further analyses carried out on the data.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving heb ik nadere analyses laten uitvoeren op de gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Keijzer over het btw-tarief voor dirigenten

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance to clarify the VAT rate applicable to conductors leading rehearsals, for both permanent and substitute conductors, and how the Tax Authority assesses whether rehearsals are necessary for performances. The State Secretary answered that rehearsals closely linked to and necessary for public performances fall under the reduced rate for performing artists regardless of whether the conductor is permanent or substitute, that the Tax Authority accepts the Haarlem court ruling and will include this in a new decision, and that conductors can demonstrate necessity with a written statement from the choir or orchestra.
This position will be included in a new decision on goods and services subject to the reduced VAT rate, to be published soon in the Staatscourant.
Dit standpunt zal worden opgenomen in een nieuw besluit over goederen en diensten waarvoor het verlaagde btw-tarief geldt dat binnenkort in de Staatscourant zal worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht ‘Overheveling zorgtaken naar gemeenten beter een jaar uitstellen’

An MP asked whether Senator Van Boxtel's call to postpone the Wlz (long-term care act) and the Wmo 2015 transfer to municipalities was justified, and what the effects of a postponement would be. The State Secretary answered that Van Boxtel asked for postponing only the Wlz, that municipalities differ in readiness, that a postponement would keep a narrowed AWBZ in 2015 without changing client entitlements, and that no consultation with opposition parties took place.
In the short term I will inform the House by letter about the progress of the Wmo 2015 transition.
Op korte termijn zal ik de Tweede Kamer per brief informeren over de voortgang van de transitie Wmo 2015
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Keijzer over de berichten waaruit blijkt dat een consulent van Stichting De Einder adviezen over zelfdoding geeft

MPs Van der Staaij and Keijzer asked whether a counsellor of Stichting De Einder giving concrete suicide advice and a supplier address to a young woman was acceptable, and whether it was criminal, asking the government to act against the foundation and the Chinese supplier. The minister confirmed the reports, said the Openbaar Ministerie has opened an investigation and declined to comment on it, noted that article 294 Sr is not met since no suicide followed, and pointed to existing medicines-law and economic-offence powers against the supplier.
The Public Prosecution Service (OM) is launching an investigation following the reports mentioned.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) stelt een onderzoek in naar aanleiding van voornoemde berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht dat het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport 800.000 AWBZ-cliënten aanschrijft over de veranderingen in de langdurige zorg
