An MP asked whether the health ministry may write to 800,000 AWBZ care recipients about long-term care reforms and whether the data transfer from CIZ and CAK respects privacy rules. The state secretary answered that information will flow through general channels and municipalities, that data go to municipalities under Wmo 2015 article 8.2, and that the ministry itself holds no individual client data and will send no individual letters.
VWS is legally not competent to hold clients' data.
VWS is juridisch niet bevoegd om over de gegevens van cliënten te beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Blinde paniek door zorgbrief”

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health about press reports that a letter to 800,000 AWBZ care recipients would cause panic, asking about its timing, content, individual consequences, data administration, helpdesks and transitional rules. The State Secretary declined to send a personal letter, outlined a staged communication plan via the Rijk, municipalities and insurers, said a central CAK helpdesk will open on 1 September, and maintained that transitional rules are adequate and the reforms are not too fast.
VWS does not have, and is not authorised to have, individual data on AWBZ-indicated persons.
VWS beschikt niet, en is niet bevoegd om te beschikken, over individuele gegevens van AWBZ-geindiceerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over de aftrek weekenduitgaven voor gehandicapten

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Health about tax deductibility of weekend care costs for severely disabled institutional residents, including the 'moral obligation' criterion and a specific case where the child's own income may have excluded deduction. The government affirms that the moral-obligation test is marginal in practice, that the Belastingdienst applies it generously, and it will propose extending the deduction to curatele (curatorship) alongside mentorschap in a future law change.
I will submit a legislative amendment to this end when the opportunity arises.
Ik zal hiertoe bij gelegenheid een wetswijziging indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over de aftrekbaarheid van trapliften als specifieke zorgkosten

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance why a stairlift, previously deductible as a specific care cost, was made non-deductible from 2014 despite the Tax Authority's website having said otherwise, and whether the cost should be allowed under the legitimate expectations principle. The State Secretary answered that the 2014 exclusion of home adaptations was deliberate, that the website disclaimer warned rules could change, that cash-basis rules mean 2014 payments are not deductible, and that no legitimate-expectations exception applies to general public information.
Providing general information by the Tax Authority cannot lead to treatment deviating from the law by applying the legitimate expectations principle.
Het verstrekken van algemene voorlichting door de Belastingdienst kan niet leiden tot een van de wet afwijkende behandeling met toepassing van het vertrouwensbeginsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Hijum en Keijzer over stijging van de zorgpremie

MPs Bruins Slot, Van Hijum and Keijzer asked why the CPB projects the nominal health insurance premium rising by EUR 144 to 2015 when the minister had claimed an increase of at most EUR 20 from the transfer of AWBZ care, and asked about funding, compensation and the own-risk increase. The minister answered that the EUR 20 figure covers only the transfer effect, that the remainder stems from the 50/50 rebalancing, reserves and autonomous cost growth, that the temporary state contribution is covered within the revenue framework, and that low-income households are fully compensated via the healthcare allowance, including for the own-risk rise.

The premium increase of at most EUR 20 mentioned in the letter of 4 March 2014 relates only to the expected rise in the nominal premium under the Health Insurance Act (Zvw) in 2015 due to the transfers.

De premiestijging van maximaal € 20 die wordt genoemd in de brief van 4 maart 2014 heeft enkel betrekking op de verwachte stijging van de nominale premie in de Zorgverzekeringswet (Zvw) in 2015 door de overhevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Keijzer over het ouderschapsplan

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and Keijzer asked the government about reports that children in high-conflict divorces are in a difficult position, the effectiveness of the parenting plan, and whether relationship counselling is covered by basic insurance. The government answered that it has sent an implementation plan to parliament, that a WODC evaluation is preliminary, that basic insurance does not cover relationship problems without a psychiatric diagnosis, and that municipalities may buy such help from 2015.
To this end, we sent an implementation plan to your House by letter of 31 March 2014.
Daartoe hebben wij bij brief van 31 maart 2014 een uitvoeringsplan naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Keijzer over orgaanroof in China

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Dutch government about organ harvesting from prisoners of conscience in China, EU and UN concerns, Dutch patients travelling abroad for transplants, and Dutch hospital ties to Chinese hospitals. The government said it shares the concern, cannot independently verify the allegations, will keep raising the issue in EU and bilateral channels, and knows of no Dutch hospital ties to suspect Chinese hospitals.
The Netherlands will continue to make efforts to keep this issue on the EU agenda.
Nederland zal zich blijven inspannen om deze kwestie op de agenda van de EU te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht op de site van de VNG waarin een handleiding aan gemeenten wordt aangereikt ten behoeve van de inkoop van (specialistische) jeugdzorg

An MP asked the state secretary about a VNG handbook for municipalities on purchasing specialist youth care, including whether it wrongly limits direct GP referral and makes social teams gatekeepers. The state secretary answered that the handbook was revised so that GPs can refer directly without passing through the social team, and that the social team need not give prior approval before payment, while noting municipal sturing and payment choices remain open.
I have therefore asked the authors to amend the text (section 6.3.2) of the handbook to the following passage.
Ik heb daarom de stellers gevraagd de tekst (par. 6.3.2.) in de handreiking te wijzigen in de volgende passage
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht ‘Komende acht jaar tekort woningen voor ouderen en gehandicapten’

CDA MP Keijzer asked the State Secretary for Health about a report predicting a shortage of suitable homes for elderly and disabled people, and whether municipalities under the Wmo 2015 will bear the cost of home adaptations and be constrained by budget cuts. The State Secretary answered that municipalities will receive additional funds and that people should be supported to remain in their homes, while promising a letter on housing and care to parliament in early April 2014.
I expect to inform your House in early April.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer begin april te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht dat 15.000 ouderen plots te gezond zijn voor het tehuis

An MP asks whether reports that 15,000 elderly people are suddenly too healthy for care homes are accurate, and how the stricter ZZP care-package rules, cuts to home care and phased implementation affect people staying at home. The State Secretary confirms the ~15,000 figure as a projection of residents leaving institutions under the extramuralisation policy, denies that it is sudden, says on-demand care is budgeted, and promises to send the NZa report in spring 2014.
In a thirty-member debate with your House on 16 January 2014, I committed to expecting the NZa report in spring 2014 and to presenting it to your House.
In een dertigledendebat met uw Kamer op 16 januari 2014 heb ik toegezegd dat ik het rapport van de NZa in het voorjaar van 2014 verwacht en aan uw Kamer zal aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer, Dik-Faber en Krol over de publicatie ‘Over(-)behandelen. Ethiek van de zorg voor kwetsbare ouderen’

Members of parliament asked the health minister about a publication on over-treatment of frail elderly patients, including whether over-treatment should be curbed, adopting decision-making methods and ethical frameworks, and cost limits. The minister answered that shared decision-making, professional standards set by stakeholders, and a new 'intensive consultation at end of life' activity code are the preferred routes, with no binding new rules or cost ceilings.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de korting van 89 miljoen euro

Keijzer (CDA) asked the state secretary whether the planned 89 million euro cut to home care (huishoudelijke verzorging) would be withdrawn, what it means for Wmo tasks and municipal funding, and how the policy of keeping people living at home squares with the cuts. The state secretary answered that the 2014 cut will not go ahead, that the CPB and the Algemene Rekenkamer are reviewing municipal financing, and that a monitoring commitment on the Keijzer motion will be pursued.
I have also, in consultation with the VNG, asked the Netherlands Court of Audit to review the method of calculating the funds linked to the decentralisation.
Ook heb ik, in overleg met de VNG, de Algemene Rekenkamer gevraagd een toets te doen op de wijze van berekening van de met de decentralisatie samenhangende middelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Keijzer over de uitleg hervorming Langdurige Zorg

An MP asks the state secretary whether his explanatory animation on the long-term care reform, which mentions severely demented elderly and people with serious disabilities as examples of those who keep access to care, is consistent with his April 2013 policy letter, notably the 50% figure for ZZP4 V&V clients staying at home. The secretary answers that the examples are not exhaustive, that the 50% figure is unchanged, that he sees no contradiction and will not amend the text, and promises the Wmo and core-AWBZ bills with clearer eligibility criteria this autumn.
I see no contradiction between the policy letter of 25 April 2013 and the text of the explanimation.
Ik zie geen tegenstelling tussen de hoofdlijnenbrief van 25 april 2013 en tekst van de explanimation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Keijzer over het extramuraliseren van ZZP 1 en 2 en het inkoopbeleid van zorgkantoren

MPs Leijten and Keijzer asked the state secretary about the extramuralisation of care packages ZZP 1 and 2 at a care home, the withdrawal of funding for residents with heavy care needs, and care purchasing policy of care offices. The state secretary answered that existing clients' rights to residence will be respected, that the transition plan and contracting framework will be sent to parliament, but declined to give a count of closing care homes and referred to workforce effects being mapped.
As I indicated in my answer to question 3, the care office has, from a quality perspective, started the discussion about purchasing care without the treatment component.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 3 heb aangegeven, is het zorgkantoor vanuit kwaliteitsoogpunt de discussie gestart over het inkopen van zorg zonder de behandelcomponent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het bericht ‘dat er nog altijd veel mis is in de gehandicaptenzorg’

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about a Nieuwsuur report on continued problems in disability care, including untrained staff in risky situations, low staffing scores, and high rates of unjustified coercive measures. The state secretary answered that inspection signals do not show more untrained staff, disputed the comparability of the inspection figures, and pointed to the Zorg en dwang bill and the Actieprogramma onvrijwillige zorg as the response.
With the Action Programme on involuntary care I am stimulating that.
Met het Actieprogramma Onvrijwillige zorg stimuleer ik dat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Keijzer over discriminatie van zwangere vrouwen op de werkvloer

MPs Heerma and Keijzer asked about the College voor de Rechten van de Mens finding that 45% of pregnant or new-mother workers had possibly discriminatory experiences, and whether the government would act. The minister replied that discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to information provision and an SER advisory request due late 2013, and said pregnancy discrimination will be considered in the work-and-care summit.
Following this advice it will be considered whether, and if so which, follow-up actions on labour market discrimination are needed.
Naar aanleiding van dit advies zal worden bezien of en zo ja welke vervolgacties op het gebied van arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over regeldruk bij de nieuwe Jeugdwet

Keijzer (CDA) asked the state secretary about regulatory burden under the new Youth Act, including Actal's advice on centring young people and families, national certification, quality registers, inspections and accountability information. The government answered that the Act aims to reduce burden and strengthen families, that gemeenten bear responsibility for their own information gathering, that certification and inspections are coherent, and that a minimal uniform dataset will replace the current reporting format.

Together with the VNG, the creation of a uniform set of accountability information is being investigated, which municipalities can request in a standardised way from institutions through a shared facility.
Met de VNG wordt de totstandkoming van een uniforme set verantwoordingsinformatie onderzocht, die gemeenten gestandaardiseerd via een gemeenschappelijke voorziening bij instellingen kunnen uitvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Bergkamp over het formuleren van kritische succesfactoren ten aanzien van de Transitie Jeugdzorg

MPs Keijzer and Bergkamp asked whether critical success factors with SMART indicators should be formulated to monitor the youth care transition and what conditions must be met by 1 January 2014 for a responsible transition on 1 January 2015. The state secretary answered that the Transitieplan Jeugd, the spoorboekje and the independent Transitiecommissie Stelselherziening Jeugd, which will assess regional arrangements on three criteria, serve as the steering instruments, without publishing SMART success factors.

The Transitiecommissie Stelselherziening Jeugd (TSJ) will assess the regional transition arrangements on the basis of three criteria: realisation of continuity of care, realisation of the required infrastructure and limiting the friction costs resulting from the transition.

De Transitiecommissie Stelselherziening Jeugd (TSJ) zal de regionale transitiearrangementen beoordelen op basis van drie criteria: realisatie continuïteit van zorg, realisatie benodigde infrastructuur en het beperken van de frictiekosten als gevolg van de transitie.

Vragen van de leden Keijzer (CDA) en Bergkamp (D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Financiën over de toekomst van de collectie van het Geldmuseum in Utrecht (ingezonden 8 juli 2013).

MPs Keijzer and Bergkamp asked why the Finance Ministry ended its relationship with the Geldmuseum, what the collection costs and who will fund it, why the Finance working group's plan was not pursued, and what happens to the collection and building. The minister answers that the owners are in talks on a shared vision, closure followed the conclusion that continuity was no longer guaranteed, and future costs and collection arrangements are still under study, to be reported to the Chamber later.
No statements can yet be made about the amount of savings to be realised over time, because future storage and management of the collection, and its costs, are still being examined.

Over de hoogte van de op termijn te realiseren besparingen kunnen echter nog geen uitspraken gedaan worden, omdat toekomstige opslag en beheer van de collectie, alsmede de kosten hiervan, nog nader worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Leijten en van het Leijten over het bericht dat zorgjongeren aan hun lot worden overgelaten

MPs Keijzer and Leijten asked the state secretary how care for youths was left unprovided after the bankruptcy of care provider Sterk!Zorg, and what role the Inspectorate, the care office and youth bureau had. The state secretary answered that replacement care was arranged via a takeover by De Driestroom, that the Inspectorate acted after an anonymous report, and that responsibility for PGB-funded care lies with the client, while the care provider failed.
The inspectorate will monitor the quality of care by re-checking within three to four weeks.
De inspectie zal de kwaliteit van zorg volgen door binnen drie à vier weken opnieuw te toetsen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Keijzer over het bericht dat een meisje misbruikt is door haar groepsleider in de instelling van de Hoenderloo Groep waar zij verbleef voor behandeling als gevolg van misbruik door l

MPs Oskam and Keijzer asked whether a youth care group leader's abuse of a girl at the Hoenderloo Groep was reported to the Inspectie Jeugdzorg, what the institution did, whether other victims were investigated, the status of the criminal case, and whether the suspect could still work with minors. The government answered that the inspectorate required improved reporting and protocols, no other victims were found, the investigation is in its final phase, and mandatory VOG screening for youth care staff is being introduced.
The inspectorate pointed out to the Hoenderloo Groep that in future it must itself report such an incident promptly.
De inspectie heeft de Hoenderloo Groep (DHG) erop gewezen dat zij in het vervolg een dergelijke calamiteit zelf en tijdig dient te melden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht  ‘Ouderen sluizen massaal geld weg’

Member Keijzer (CDA) asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that elderly people were giving away assets to avoid the new asset-income surcharge on long-term care contributions, and whether the government had anticipated this behaviour. The secretary replied that people may legally reduce their assets through gifts, that the effect on the surcharge's revenue is hard to estimate and will be monitored with first figures around Prinsjesdag, and that the surcharge does not affect the planned raise of the in-facility contribution, so no reconsideration is needed.
The revenue of the assets-income surcharge will be monitored.
De opbrengst van de vermogensinkomensbijtelling zal gemonitord worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over Turkse pleegkinderen in Europa

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked about a Turkish parliamentary committee chair's claim that Turkey might reclaim Turkish children placed with Christian or gay foster families in Europe, the Hague Convention, and foster-care numbers. The government rejected any idea of Turkish reclaiming of children under the 1961 Convention, said it does not hold the data on Turkish-passport children in care, and offered only to explain Dutch foster-care decision-making if Turkey asks.
I do not have this information.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Keijzer over de berichtgeving over de NMa-boetes van € 9 miljoen aan een aantal taxibedrijven vanwege kennelijk schending van mededingingsregels

An MP asked whether NMa fines of €9 million on taxi companies for competition violations affect the award of the Valys patient transport contract to the same companies, and why the award was not reconsidered. The state secretary answered that the violations did not concern the Valys tender itself, that he has been fully informed and is satisfied on continuity, and that he will await the summary proceedings before signing.
A careful weighing starts with having the necessary, complete information.
Een zorgvuldige afweging begint met het beschikken over de daarvoor noodzakelijke, volledige informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht ‘Kritisch rapport over voortgang jeugdzorg’

An MP asked the state secretaries about a critical report on the progress of the youth care decentralisation, and whether the government shares its concerns. The government says the findings match its agenda, commits to reporting deadlines and a transition plan to parliament, and describes the consultation arrangements with field organisations.
Yes, we commit to that. These points will be included in the transition plan.
Ja, dat zeggen we toe. In het transitieplan zullen deze punten terugkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Keijzer over het bericht dat orgaandonoren geconfronteerd worden met inkomstenverlies en medische kosten

Two MPs asked the health minister about reports that living organ donors bear income loss and medical costs, citing a scar claim refused by an insurer, an out-of-pocket echo, and a self-employed donor's compensation gap. The minister answered that medical costs necessary for care are covered by insurance within 13 weeks (and by the donor's insurance thereafter), that a subsidy scheme compensates self-employed donors' income loss for up to 13 weeks, and that a dedicated arrangement for rare complications is not feasible within the current social security system.
It is not for me to judge in an individual case whether medically necessary care is involved.
Het is niet aan mij om in een individuele casus te oordelen of hier sprake is van medisch noodzakelijke zorg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Keijzer over mensen met een complexe meervoudige zorgvraag

An MP asks the state secretary about the timeline for implementing the Denktank Complexe zorg report, sufficiency of places and CCE request volumes, extreme care budgets, CCE access to institutions, and Inspectorate complaints about people with complex multiple care needs. The secretary points to the Actieplan Onvrijwillige Zorg and the Zorg en dwang bill, acknowledges long waiting times, gives figures on requests and budget, and reports few complaints, with no full answer on how many dependents live at home.
I do not know how many situations there are of children/young people living at home who could not or would not be admitted to an institution.
Ik weet niet hoeveel situaties er zijn van thuiswonende kinderen/jongeren die niet in een instelling zouden kunnen of willen worden opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen Keijzer en Omtzigt over casussen van verontruste burgers

CDA MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked the state secretary of Health about anonymised citizen cases showing sharply higher care contributions from the asset-income surcharge (VIB) and about treatment of homes, letselschade, landgoederen and the pocket-money threshold. The secretary answered most questions in substance, admitted some cases did not reconcile with available data, pointed to CAK follow-up, and said the revenue estimate was still too early to confirm.
I am consulting with the CAK to determine how this limited group of clients should be handled.
Ik ben in overleg met het CAK om te bezien hoe met deze beperkte groep cliënten om kan worden gegaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Keijzer over het faillissement van De Pier op Scheveningen

An MP asked the minister about the bankruptcy of the Pier Vastgoed company and whether De Pier in Scheveningen, a post-war landmark, could be preserved by granting it national monument status, and about the land-lease arrangements. The minister said there is no route to national monument status because the building fails the criteria on integrity and condition, and that the Rijk has no responsibility for preservation or demolition beyond its lease terms.
I see no possibility of preserving De Pier at national level.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheid om De Pier van rijkswege te behouden.
Antwoord vragen Keijzer over de berichten ‘Dreigend ontslag 287 thuiszorgmedewerkers’ en ‘Honderden medewerkers thuiszorg Rotterdam op straat’

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary about reports of dismissal threats for home-care workers in Rotterdam and the uncertainty this causes for staff and clients, and whether municipalities comply with article 10a of the Wmo on staff transfer between providers. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for overseeing transfer talks, that the statutory duty is sufficient, that no overview exists of how municipalities apply it, and that he is willing to discuss it with the VNG.
I am willing to discuss with the VNG whether it could be useful to additionally point municipalities to the different ways they can give effect to article 10a.
Ik ben bereid met de VNG in gesprek te gaan om te bezien of het zinvol kan zijn om gemeenten aanvullend te wijzen op de verschillende manieren waarop zij invulling kunnen geven aan artikel 10a.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Keijzer over de bezuiniging op dagbesteding in 2013

MPs Leijten and Keijzer asked how the planned 2013-2014 savings on day care (dagbesteding) and personal care under the AWBZ-to-Wmo transfer were built up, and about client numbers, new applications, admissions to institutions and costs per ZZP. The state secretary gave partial figures, explained the savings assumptions, said the final implementation may differ, and promised a letter to the House in early 2013 on the policy.
No data are available on clients assessed by the Bureaus Jeugdzorg.
Van de cliënten geïndiceerd door de Bureaus Jeugdzorg zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Keijzer en Heerma over de impact van voorgenomen bezuinigingen in het regeerakkoord voor de langdurige ouderenzorg in Nederland

CDA MPs Keijzer and Heerma asked whether the government accepts Gupta's finding that proposed long-term care cuts could cut purchasing power by up to 63% for heavy care users, and whether older people and middle/higher-income groups would be disproportionately hit. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that outcomes depend on how cuts are implemented, that no income guarantees are given, and that the proposals will be worked out with municipalities and target groups.
The cabinet never gives purchasing-power guarantees, so it cannot do so in this case either.
Het kabinet geeft nooit koopkrachtgaranties, dus kan dit in dit geval ook niet doen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de aanpak van speculatieve grondhandel en de uitkomsten van het ambtelijk onderzoek hiernaar

An MP from the SGP asks why the outcome of a promised ministerial study into speculative land trading in split agricultural plots has not yet been shared, and raises consumer rights, fragmentation, cadastral registration, supervision by the AFM, and proposals on notaries and the Kadaster. The minister replies that the findings were sent to parliament on 20 November 2025, outlines consumers' private-law remedies, announces an exploration of a statutory cooling-off period, and says existing supervision and notarial duties are considered sufficient while the government keeps monitoring.
Your House was informed by letter of 20 November 2025, jointly on behalf of the Minister of Finance and the State Secretary of Justice and Security, about the outcome of the official study
Uw Kamer is op 20 november 2025 bij brief, mede namens de Minister van Financiën en de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid, geïnformeerd over de uitkomst van het ambtelijk onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over het bericht 'Nederland koopt opvang migranten af voor 33 miljoen euro'

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports that the Netherlands would pay 33 million euros to offload reception of 1,650 migrants, why the EU solidarity figures were kept confidential, whether asylum seekers can re-apply after relocation, and whether the Netherlands should seek exemption or refuse the pact. The minister answered that the solidarity pool was agreed at 21,000 relocations (420 million euros), the Dutch share is 5.2% (about 21.9 million), the proposal was confidential by law until Council agreement, and that the Dublin rules and the pact's border measures remain binding, with no Dutch exemption sought.
The document has been shared confidentially with your House.
Het stuk is vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de kamerverhuurvrijstelling

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about the room-rental tax exemption, its lack of monitoring data, budget figures, and options to double it for a second room, and whether these options are feasible. The minister answered that effectiveness cannot be firmly established due to missing data, that monitoring would require structural changes to the tax return, that the second-room option is not feasible before 2030, and that no firm policy choice or cost-benefit analysis has yet been made.
In the tax return it does not have to be declared that use is made of this.
In de belastingaangifte hoeft niet opgegeven te worden dat hier gebruik van wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel ‘Arbeidsinspectie luidt noodklok over misstanden bij asbestsaneringen’

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the government about an Arbeidsinspectie signal that over a third of asbestos inspection firms perform final assessments poorly, including homes wrongly declared asbestos-free, possible commercial dependence between sanitation firms and inspectors, and falsified measurements. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said existing rules and controls are sufficient for now, that health effects cannot be tracked, and that the planned licensing requirement from 2027 plus a review with stakeholders are the main responses, rejecting structural measures like forced rotation or removing inspections from commercial parties.

With the implementation of the Asbestos Directive 2, this will additionally be supplemented with a licensing requirement for asbestos removal, making it much easier to keep poorly performing companies off the market.

Met het implementeren van de Asbestrichtlijn 2 wordt dit bovendien aangevuld met een vergunningplicht voor het verwijderen van asbest, waardoor het veel beter mogelijk wordt om slecht presterende bedrijven van de markt te weren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Grinwis over het artikel 'Doek valt voor Winst Uit je Woning, dat gemeenten helpt met isolatie van woningen'

MPs Welzijn and Grinwis asked the Minister of Housing about the bankruptcy of Winst Uit Je Woning, an intermediary used by municipalities for insulation under the national insulation programme, and its effects on delays, costs, monitoring and contract lessons. The Minister said the matter is mainly between municipalities and the firm, noted a doorstart, offered regional support funds, and largely declined to change municipal freedom, giving partial answers on costs, monitoring and energy poverty.
This is mainly a matter between the municipalities concerned as clients and Winst uit je Woning.
Dit is voornamelijk een zaak tussen de betreffende gemeenten als opdrachtgever en Winst uit je Woning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over overlastgevers in Ter Apel

Deputy Podt (D66) asks about the number of places in the Ter Apel procedure availability location, the enforcement of the area ban with the local tri-partite consultation in Westerwolde, the transfer of overlast-causing Dublin claimants and minors, and perspective-oriented care for juvenile offenders. Minister Keijzer answers that the pilot can expand beyond five places, that the ministry will supply extra boa's to Westerwolde, that Dublin claimants are being transferred but capacity is limited, and that Nidos and COA are working to expand intensive-care locations, with evaluation results promised in Q1 2026.
The functioning of the procedural availability pilot will be evaluated with the chain in the coming period.
De werking van de pilot procesbeschikbaarheidsaanpak wordt de komende tijd met de keten geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over woonfraude

An SP MP asked the ministers about rental fraud in The Hague, including whether it should be added to the victimisation survey, separately registered by police, supported by the Fraudehelpdesk, and whether it strengthens the case for a national rental register. The ministers answered that the survey and registration questions will be explored in 2026, the Fraudehelpdesk already warns and supports victims, and a rental register is being examined with a consultation expected in early 2026.

I am currently examining the added value of a rental register, following various motions from the House, in which a rental register is seen as an instrument to bring private rental into view and better tackle fraudulent rental practices.

Ik onderzoek op dit moment de meerwaarde van een huurregister, dit n.a.v. van verschillende Kamermoties, waarin in een huurregister een instrument wordt gezien om particuliere verhuur in beeld te krijgen en frauduleuze verhuurpraktijken beter aan te kunnen pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over het bericht 'Het kabinet wil twee Afghaanse vrouwen terugsturen ondanks vrouwonvriendelijk bewind van de Taliban'

MPs Podt and Paternotte asked the Asylum and Migration and Foreign Affairs ministers about a report that the cabinet wants to return two Afghan women despite Taliban oppression, citing a UN human rights warning and a court ruling against the IND. The minister answered that the IND assesses each case individually under the Vreemdelingencirculaire, that Afghan women facing discriminatory measures generally receive asylum permits, that Nederland co-initiated a Women's Convention liability claim against Afghanistan, and that no change to country policy is planned, while declining to comment on the individual case.
As your House is aware, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het bericht 'Woningbouw in gevaar door nieuwe regels netcongestie'

Two CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Climate and Green Growth and of Housing about press reports that new grid-congestion priority rules could endanger housing construction, and about the four municipalities' warnings. The minister answered that the ACM will publish a new priority framework by 1 January 2026 keeping housing priority, that interim rules apply until 1 July 2026 with gradual release of reserved capacity, and that municipalities and provinces will be involved in further talks.
As mentioned in the annex 'progress grid congestion policy' to the parliamentary letter of 6 October, grid operators currently reserve capacity for connecting all (future) small consumers.

Zoals genoemd in de bijlage «voortgang beleid netcongestie» bij de Kamerbrief voortgang netcongestie van 6 oktober 4 , reserveren de netbeheerders momenteel capaciteit voor het aansluiten van alle (toekomstige) kleinverbruikers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de kabinetsreactie op het adviesrapport STOER en de uitvoering van het amendement-Welzijn (fatale beslistermijnen bij omgevingsvergunningen)

An MP asks the Minister of Housing about the government's rejection of the STOER advice and the amendment on fatal decision deadlines for environmental permits, questioning why the government will not implement it. The minister answers that an implementation assessment showed the amendment would not speed up housing construction, would create implementation risks, and so will be removed via a novelle, while pointing to other measures.

Based on the UDO, I conclude that this amendment will not lead to faster permit granting, while it does have significant consequences for implementation practice and disproportionately intervenes in administrative relations.

Op basis van de UDO kom ik tot de conclusie dat dit amendement niet tot versnelling van de vergunningverlening zal leiden, terwijl er wel significante gevolgen zijn voor de uitvoeringspraktijk en het disproportioneel ingrijpt in de bestuurlijke verhoudingen.
Antwoord op van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'Kabinet plant grootschalige woonwijken bij vier Nederlandse steden'

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the housing minister about land ownership, pre-announcement land purchases, speculation, planbaten recovery and public land acquisition for the large-scale housing locations in the draft Nota Ruimte. The minister answered that the ministry has no complete overview of ownership, that some municipalities bought or used pre-emption rights, that no planbatenheffing agreements exist, and that public acquisition was chosen only at some specific locations.
The ministry does not have a complete overview of the ownership situation of the plots within the nationally large-scale housing locations.
Het ministerie heeft geen compleet overzicht van de eigendomssituatie van de percelen binnen de nationaal grootschalige woningbouwlocaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het artikel 'Wethouder eist dat ontwikkelaar niet meer dan 2 procent winst maakt'

An MP asked the Minister of Housing whether a municipality's 2% cap on developer profit and overheads in a partner selection for housing deters investors and breaches national frameworks. The minister agreed such limits can harm the investment climate, said deviating local rules is undesirable, will discuss the consequences with Heemskerk, and pointed to the Wet Versterking Regie and a planned complaints point for technical building rules.
I will discuss with the municipality of Heemskerk the consequences this has for area development and the effects of imposing such conditions on area developments in general.

Ik ga met de gemeente Heemskerk in gesprek over de consequenties die dit heeft voor de gebiedsontwikkeling en over de gevolgen van het stellen van dergelijke voorwaarden bij gebiedsontwikkelingen in het algemeen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over hospitaverhuur en het Huurregister

An MP asked the housing minister why the hospitaverhuur (room rental) bill and the rental register keep slipping, and whether timelines and effects can be made public. The minister answered that the bill goes to the Raad van State and parliament in the first half of 2026, cited complexity and stakeholder consultation as causes, and said the register will be outlined in an early-2026 note, without committing to earlier dates or phased entry into force.
My aim is to submit the bill to your House for consideration in the first half of 2026.
Mijn inzet is om het wetsvoorstel in de eerste helft van 2026 voor te leggen aan uw Kamer ter behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Van Hijum over het artikel ‘Migratie is niet hét probleem van de woningmarkt: 'Dat is onzin'’ geschreven voor nu.nl.

Two MPs from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Minister of Housing about the role of migration in the housing shortage, including its share of housing demand, its effect on starters, and measures for migrant housing and quality. The minister answered that migration drives most population growth and thus housing need, outlined existing instruments such as flexible housing funding and the Wet goed verhuurderschap, and acknowledged gaps in data on migrant housing, though many answers referred to general policy or other responsibilities.
No data are available on the number of dwellings owned by temporary employment agencies and private investors who rent housing to such agencies.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal woningen dat in handen is van uitzendbureaus en private investeerders die woonruimtes verhuren aan uitzendbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Korte over het bericht 'Meer plek in verpleeghuizen, ouderen worden liever thuis verzorgd'

Members of parliament De Korte asked the health and housing ministers about vacancies in nursing homes, the growth of commercial care homes with separated housing and care, rents charged for such homes, and whether these fall under rent regulation. The state secretary said the RIVM is studying the drop in demand, that no registration of vacancies or commercial providers exists, and that she plans to talk with the sector about which care dwellings fall under rent regulation.
There is currently no insight into the number of vacant places in regular and commercial nursing homes because no registration of these exists.
Er is momenteel geen zicht op het aantal leegstaande plekken in reguliere en commerciële verpleeghuizen omdat daarvan geen registratie bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Huurder Elsbeth wordt wakker met piepende ademhaling: ‘De laatste jaren woon ik hier niet meer met plezier’

An SP MP asked the housing minister about Heimstaden's plan to sell 12,000 social rental homes after years of poor maintenance, and whether the government would force maintenance, ensure the homes return to a housing corporation, and act against speculative investors. The minister answered that landlords must follow maintenance rules, pointed to municipal enforcement and the Huurcommissie, declined to judge Heimstaden's conduct, and stated no preference for who owns the homes.
Municipalities, from their responsibility for the built environment, are authorised to enforce when relevant building regulations are not complied with.
Gemeenten zijn – vanuit hun verantwoordelijkheid voor de gebouwde omgeving – bevoegd om handhavend op te treden wanneer relevante bouwregelgeving- en voorschriften niet worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het NOS-artikel ‘Raad van State kraakt plan om voorrang statushouders te schrappen, Keijzer zet door’

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked Minister Keijzer how she reconciles the planned abolition of priority for refugee status holders (statushouders) in social housing with the equal treatment principle and the Council of State's critical advice, and about the share of vacated social rentals going to them. The minister defended the ban as objectively justified, pointed to accompanying measures and a phased entry into force, and said several data questions could not yet be answered fully or on time.
I have studied this advice carefully.
Ik heb dit advies zorgvuldig bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'RvS keihard over schrappen voorrang statushouders: strijdig met de Grondwet'

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about a report that the Council of State considers abolishing priority for status holders in social housing unconstitutional, and how housing for status holders will be ensured during the transition, including temporary housing and monitoring. The minister answered that the priority ban is part of a package of asylum measures, that a phased introduction and expanded housing options (SFT regulation, transition locations, co-living) are planned, that monitoring runs monthly, and that the questions were answered as far as possible.

The cabinet expects that the inflow-restricting measures, combined with the proposed phasing and the expansion of housing options and participation of status holders in society, will lead to a normalised position of permit holders relative to other housing seekers on the housing market.

Het kabinet verwacht dat de instroombeperkende maatregelen, in combinatie met de voorgestelde fasering en de inzet op het uitbreiden van huisvestingsopties en het laten meedoen van statushouders in de samenleving, zullen leiden tot een genormaliseerde positie van vergunninghouders ten opzichte van andere woningzoekenden op de woningmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de uitzending Pauw & De Wit van 9 oktober 2025

An MP asked the minister for the formal and factual basis of the claim that statushouders received 25-30% of vacant social rental homes, and asked for an answer by 29 October. The minister answered that the share depends on the comparison group, cited a 32% estimate from Jan van de Beek for a comparable group in 2015-2018, and said general allocation rates of 6-10% are less representative of pressure on the housing market.
The allocation share of statushouders to social rental housing depends on the group of housing seekers with which the comparison is made.
Het toewijzingspercentage van statushouders aan sociale huurwoningen is afhankelijk van de groep woningzoekenden waarmee de vergelijking wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de Kamerbrief 'Evaluatie CO-stelsel - nadere informatie opvolging aanbevelingen'

An MP asks the Minister of Housing about simplifying the CO-certification scheme for sole traders and small firms, stronger enforcement by municipalities, a maintenance obligation for gas appliances, and public information on certified installers. The Minister responds that simplification initiatives are underway within the legal framework, rejects a mandatory maintenance check for now, says enforcement is being studied with the VNG and IPO, and promises further monitoring and information only in part.
I am in consultation with the VNG on the state of supervision of the legal provisions arising from the Building Works Living Environment Decree (Bbl), which also involves the CO-system.
Ik ben in overleg met de VNG over de staat van het toezicht op de wettelijke bepalingen volgend uit het Besluit Bouwwerken leefomgeving (Bbl), waarbij ook het CO-stelsel wordt betrokken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Saris over de berichten ‘Meer buitenlanders kopen woning in Nederland, verdubbeling in vijf jaar’ en ‘Steeds meer woningen verkocht aan expats, ‘terwijl zoveel Nederlanders juis

MPs Welzijn and Saris asked the government about reports that expats and international buyers are increasingly purchasing homes, and about calls to end the 30% tax ruling, restrict expat admission and require municipal consent in scarcity areas. The minister answered that international buyers account for about 1.6% of purchases, with local price effects, that existing municipal tools suffice, that the 30% ruling is kept for business continuity, and that the government will address the shortage by building more homes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'gemeente Utrecht treedt op tegen verkoop losse kamers'

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about the sale of individual rooms as exclusive use rights outside formal apartment splitting, asking about legal basis, transparency, mortgage financing, buyer protection and possible national measures. The Minister answered that municipalities can enforce via their housing ordinances under the Huisvestingswet, that no national data or measures exist, and that no new legislation or policy is currently planned.
I will keep in contact with the VNG on this point and inform the House if that changes.
Ik zal contact houden met de VNG op dit punt en de Kamer informeren als dat verandert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Wie ruzie krijgt met huisbaas Vesteda, moet stevig in zijn schoenen staan'

MP Beckerman asked the minister about Vesteda's eviction request to tenants in The Hague, its exclusion of the Vesteda Platform, and whether the Overlegwet is adequately enforced and protects tenant organisations. The minister answered that compliance is for the courts to judge, that Vesteda says it informed the tenant organisation, and that the Overlegwet will be evaluated and information improved, without committing to statutory changes now.
It is not for me to assess to what extent an individual case complies with the legislation. That is a matter for the court.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen in hoeverre een individuele casus in overeenstemming is met de wetgeving. Dit is aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Patijn over het FNV-rapport “De problemen op Schiphol”

Two MPs (De Hoop and Patijn, GroenLinks-PvdA) asked eight questions about an FNV report on working conditions at Schiphol, including exposure to hazardous substances, workload, staff turnover, and the duty to ensure safe conditions. State Secretary Nobel answered that employers including Schiphol are responsible for safe working conditions, that the Arbeidsinspectie monitors progress, and that the government will raise the issue in regular consultations, while declining to impose specific obligations on Schiphol.
As State Secretary, I cannot impose obligations or measures on specific companies, as you intend in your question.
Als Staatssecretaris kan ik geen verplichtingen of maatregelen opleggen aan specifieke bedrijven, zoals u in uw vraag bedoelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over hospitaverhuur en het landelijk huurregister

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about the rise of room rental (hospitaverhuur) and the delayed national rental register, including tenant protection and timing. The minister agreed room rental can ease the housing shortage, defended a bill that weakens tenant protection, and said the rental register will be delayed until scenarios are consulted in early 2026.
However, tenant protection for tenants will become more limited.
De huurbescherming voor huurders wordt echter beperkter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Van der Burg over de aankondiging van Netanyahu dat migratiestromen uit Gaza zullen ontstaan

MPs Rajkowski and Van der Burg asked the government whether Netanyahu's announcement of Palestinian departures from Gaza would cause migration flows to the EU, how screening would catch Hamas members among asylum seekers, and how the Netherlands would press Israel and support the region. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes forced displacement, screens asylum seekers for war-crime indicators, works on regional reception and EU migration measures, and continues diplomatic pressure for a ceasefire.
For Dutch policy it is beyond question: Gaza belongs to the Palestinians.
Voor het Nederlands beleid staat buiten kijf: Gaza is van de Palestijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat Oekraïense mannen zelf huisvesting moeten regelen

An MP asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration whether Ukrainian men who work should be excluded from Temporary Protection Directive rights and asked about reports that Ukrainians must arrange their own housing. The minister answered that able ontheemden are urged to find their own housing to free up scarce reception places, that no specific group can be excluded from protection under the Directive, and that a review with VNG is underway with a further letter expected.
Not granting temporary protection to displaced persons who already hold it in another member state is being examined as part of the TPD extension decision.
Het niet verstrekken van tijdelijke bescherming aan ontheemden die tijdelijke bescherming in een andere lidstaat hebben, wordt als onderdeel van het RTB-verlengingsbesluit onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en De Hoop over de aanpassingen van de Wet betaalbare huur

Two opposition MPs asked why the government put out consultation on changes to the Affordable Rent Act during the summer holiday, despite a parliamentary majority motion against amending it, and questioned the rent and tenant-security effects of four proposals. The minister defended the timing and the proposals as targeted relief for landlords that keeps the rent protections in place, and said no alternatives or further delay were needed.

At the same time as sending this reply, I am starting the formal pre-consultation procedure for the draft decree, so that your House still has the opportunity to express its views on the desirability of the measures.

Gelijktijdig met verzending van deze beantwoording start ik de formele voorhangprocedure voor het ontwerpbesluit, waardoor ook uw Kamer nog de gelegenheid heeft zich over de wenselijkheid van de maatregelen uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en van Nispen over het bericht dat commerciële beunhazen tientallen miljoen verdienen door een tekort aan structurele opvangplekken

SP MPs asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration how intermediary René Derkzen earned 44 million euros in emergency asylum reception contracts, whether the prices were market-conform, and how such commercial emergency reception will be ended. The minister acknowledged prices were too high, terminated the intermediary contract, said COA now contracts hotels directly, and pointed to the ongoing FIOD/Public Prosecution investigation as reason not to comment further on the case.
At this moment, pending the investigation by the FIOD and the Public Prosecution Service, I cannot respond further on substance to this matter.
Ik kan op dit moment, hangende het onderzoek van de FIOD en het Openbaar Ministerie, niet verder inhoudelijk reageren op deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het bericht “Arbeidsmigrant heeft vaker ongeluk op de werkvloer. Weinig aandacht voor arbeidsveiligheid”

An MP asks the Minister and State Secretary of Social Affairs about the higher accident rate among migrant workers, flexible employment, language barriers, unclear responsibility between employment agency and employer, and enforcement by the Labour Inspectorate. The government acknowledges the disproportionate accident rate, points to planned measures such as a reporting obligation for temp agencies and the Arbovisie 2040, and promises a full response to the Safety Board report by year-end.
As promised at the parliamentary committee debate on labour migration on 11 September, a response to the OVV report on the safety of migrant workers will follow before the end of the year.

Zoals toegezegd bij het commissiedebat Arbeidsmigratie op 11 september jongstleden zal er voor het einde van het jaar een reactie komen op het rapport van de OVV over de veiligheid van arbeidsmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Verdachte aangehouden voor ernstig zedenmisdrijf op Amsterdamse Weesperzijde

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether the rule of law applies to asylum seekers, whether consequences such as withheld allowances or asylum withdrawal always follow offences, how repeat offending is prevented, whether an amendment on unwelcome declarations should be used, whether experts should be consulted, and how unpaid public transport fines are charged to asylum seekers. The minister replied that criminal law applies equally, that lik-op-stuk policy and asylum withdrawal on public order grounds are applied, that existing measures suffice for now, and that fine collection is the responsibility of carriers, with ongoing talks with COA and other parties.
The collection rate is commercially confidential information and cannot be shared for either company.
Het inningspercentage is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan voor beide bedrijven niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans en De Hoop over het negeren van de Grondwet door een kabinetslid

Opposition MPs Timmermans and De Hoop ask why Minister Keijzer will not amend a bill banning priority housing for status holders despite a severe Council of State advisory opinion that it conflicts with equal treatment under the Constitution, and whether the cabinet backs submitting it unchanged. The minister answers that she is still studying the advice, will send a further report to parliament shortly, and that the bill's draft report has yet to be discussed in cabinet.
I expect to send a further report to the House shortly addressing the advice.
Ik verwacht op korte termijn een nader rapport naar de Kamer te sturen waarin wordt ingegaan op het advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over alternatieve plannen voor Tata Steel Nederland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government about the Wijmond business case for alternative uses of the Tata Steel IJmuiden site, including financial risks of the Green Steel plan, reductions of pollution, soil remediation liability and housing and nature scenarios. The state secretary answers that the government remains committed to the Green Steel plan and ongoing negotiations, does not consider new research necessary, and declines to disclose negotiation details.
The cabinet cannot make further public statements about what forms part of the negotiations on tailored agreements.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen verdere mededelingen doen over wat onderdeel is van de onderhandelingen over maatwerkafspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het bericht ‘Communicatieplannen grote fondsen laten tegenvallers onbesproken’

A member of parliament asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether large pension funds' communication plans for the transition to the new pension system adequately address setbacks, as the AFM had warned. The minister acknowledged the importance of realistic transition communication, said regulation on transition information will be tightened by year-end, and stated that the AFM supervises the legal requirement to show worst-case pension outcomes.
The aim is to include this in regulations by the end of the year.
Het streven is om dit voor het eind van het jaar in regelgeving op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over slecht verhuurderschap in Harderwijk

An MP asks the Minister of Housing about a Harderwijk landlord charging excessive rents, failing to fix facilities and imposing high service costs, and asks what tools municipalities have, whether tenants can report anonymously and whether the minister will contact local officials. The minister answers that the matter is before a court brought by the municipality, outlines the Wet goed verhuurderschap and Wet betaalbare huur enforcement tools and the Huurcommissie route, and declines to intervene locally.

This concerns, among other things, the Wet goed verhuurderschap and Wet betaalbare huur, as a result of which municipalities can enforce against abuses such as intimidation, discrimination, unreasonable service costs and excessive rents.

Het gaat hier onder andere om de Wet goed verhuurderschap en Wet betaalbare huur, als gevolg waarvan gemeenten kunnen handhaven op misstanden als intimidatie, discriminatie, onredelijke servicekosten en te hoge huren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel ‘Spanje wil 53.000 vakantiehuizen van onlineplatforms verwijderen’

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about Spain's plan to remove 53,000 holiday homes from online platforms and whether the Netherlands should follow. The minister replied that Dutch municipalities already have tools under the 2021 short-stay law, that no national figures on non-compliant listings exist, and that the impact on the housing crisis would be very small.
National figures on how many dwellings do not meet the requirements set by municipalities are not available.
Landelijke cijfers hoeveel woningen niet voldoen aan de eisen die gemeenten stellen zijn niet voorhanden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de berichten ‘Wonen boven winkels komt niet van de grond: gemeentelijke eisen vaak hindernis’ en ‘Parkeernormen houden ombouwen lege verdiepingen boven winkels naar woningen te

The MP Boswijk asked the minister why around 50,000 empty upper floors above shops are not being converted into housing, and what barriers municipalities and owners face, including parking norms, fragmented ownership and lack of expertise. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to existing instruments (Transformatiefaciliteit, Versnellingsagenda, City Deal, Nationaal Transformatieloket, Expertteam Woningbouw) and says the government will keep supporting municipalities without committing to a new concrete step.
I consider tackling vacancy important to alleviate the housing shortage in the Netherlands.
Ik vind het aanpakken van leegstand van belang om de woningnood in Nederland te verlichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht 'Door nieuwe verhuurregels komen studenten nóg moeilijker aan een kamer'

An MP asked the minister about reports of a sharp fall in student rooms and the effect of the Wet betaalbare huur and the WWSO revision on rental supply. The minister answered that the national stock fell about 4%, that a full evaluation is planned for 2027, and that new measures such as temporary student contracts and hospitaverhuur are in preparation.
The Landelijke Monitor Studentenhuisvesting published on 4 September estimates the total supply at 322,400 housing units.
In de Landelijke Monitor Studentenhuisvesting die op 4 september is gepubliceerd, wordt het totale aanbod geschat op 322.400 wooneenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het benoemen van vier nieuwe grootschalige woonwijken

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about land ownership, prior land purchases, land-value effects, planning-gain recovery and public land acquisition for four newly announced large housing sites. The minister answered every sub-question with a single cross-reference, stating that the named locations do not match those designated in the June Bestuurlijke Overleggen and that final designation will follow the Nota Ruimte.
The locations you refer to in the question do not correspond with the municipalities named in June in the Bestuurlijke Overleggen Leefomgeving.
De locaties waarna u verwijst in de vraag komen niet overeen met de gemeenten die afgelopen juni zijn benoemd in de Bestuurlijke Overleggen Leefomgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het programma Verbouwstromen

An MP asked the minister about the Verbouwstromen renovation programme: its preconditions, success factors, funding, evaluation and continuation. The minister answered at length, describing the programme's adaptation after weak initial partnerships, its evaluation, unspent funds of about 1.5 million euro, and a 2026-2029 continuation with no additional money freed for parliamentary reallocation.
No additional funds will become available for alternative use and decision-making by the House.
Er komen geen (aanvullende) middelen alsnog beschikbaar voor alternatieve inzet en besluitvorming door de kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Nederland mag van rechter geen mannelijke asielzoekers terugsturen naar België: 'Enorm frustrerend''

An MP asks the government about a court ruling that bars the Netherlands from returning single male asylum seekers to Belgium under Dublin, and what this means for migration control, the reception shortage and plans to restore transfers. The minister acknowledges the ruling undermines the Dublin system, reports about 170 affected men, and says talks with Belgium aim to resume transfers, with further steps on reception restrictions.
On that basis, the cabinet will consider whether the transfer of Dublin claimants can be resumed as soon as possible.
Het kabinet zal op basis daarvan bezien of de overdracht van Dublinclaimanten weer zo spoedig mogelijk hervat kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het item Ondanks woningnood blijft snel bouwen lastig in de uitzending van Nieuwsuur van 2 augustus 2025

An MP asked the housing minister about the Valkenhorst housing project in Katwijk, delayed for about 20 years, including preparation times, nature protection, industrial building, the Council of State's handling of appeals, and what the state can do to speed it up. The minister answered all ten questions on substance, describing acceleration measures, the Wet Versterking regie volkshuisvesting, prioritised Council of State handling, and state-municipal preparations, without withholding information.
As a result, the Council of State has handled around 140 housing plans with priority since last year.
De Raad heeft daardoor sinds vorig jaar zo’n 140 woningbouwplannen met voorrang behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over discriminatie van jongeren en mensen met een beperking op de woningmarkt.

MP El Abassi asked the Minister of Housing about housing discrimination against young people and people with disabilities, including low reporting, weak enforcement, and the non-binding nature of College voor de Rechten van de Mens rulings. Minister Keijzer acknowledged the problem, said no data on discrimination reports is kept centrally, pointed to a declining discrimination trend in the third national monitor, and promised a fourth monitor and an inventory of municipal reports by 2026.
There is no insight into how many reports of housing discrimination have been received by municipalities.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel meldingen van woondiscriminatie er binnen (zijn) gekomen bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht ‘Massale antikraak: hedgefondsen Capreit en Rubens Capital mogen verbod op leegstand omzeilen’

An MP asked the Minister of Housing whether landlords using bruikleen (loan) contracts to fill vacant flats circumvent the ban on temporary leases and lack tenant protection, and what will be done. The minister replied that bruikleen contracts are not rentals, that Utrecht successfully enforced occupation under the Leegstandwet, and that a bill to make forced occupation structural is being prepared.
The possibility of enforcing occupation I will anchor structurally.
De mogelijkheid om een ingebruikname af te dwingen ga ik structureel verankeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over ‘Hoogkarspel Zuid krijgt vorm: geen rijkssteun, wel plannen voor supermarkt en levendig buurtcentrum’

An MP asked the housing minister why Hoogkarspel Zuid was not selected for national funding for large-scale housing, whether the selection criteria changed after the application, and what this means for smaller municipalities. The minister denied any change in criteria, said the selection was based on existing deal data and open sources without contacting municipalities, and pointed to a package of schemes open to all municipalities, including a single-municipality application rule.
There has been no change to the assessment framework.
Er is geen sprake geweest van een wijziging van het beoordelingskader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘COA opnieuw honderden miljoenen extra kwijt aan asielopvang’

An MP asked the minister about reported unlawful spending of 655 million euros by the COA asylum reception agency in 2024 and the causes, measures and reporting. The minister acknowledged the irregularities, attributed them to high reception pressure and urgent need, listed categories and measures, and pointed to annual financial reporting rather than periodic briefings to parliament.
The COA reports on unlawful spending annually in its financial accountability report.
Het COA rapporteert in haar financiële verantwoording jaarlijks over onrechtmatigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de Kamerbrief ‘Voortgang versterking NRVT’

MPs asked the minister how foundation risks are addressed in strengthening oversight of the valuers' register NRVT, including convenant targets, independence, fallback to a ZBO, cooperation with supervisors and fraud signalling. The minister answered that foundation information is a standard part of valuation reports, that a convenant with NRVT is being prepared with evaluation and monitoring details still to come, and deferred several specifics.
I aim to inform the House as soon as possible about the content of this convenant.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer zo snel mogelijk nader te informeren over de inhoud van dit convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over berichtgeving over bijbetalen aan verwarming door ‘slecht onderhoud flat’

An NSC MP asked the Ministers of Housing and Climate about reports of residents in IJmuiden protesting high district-heating bills linked to poor building maintenance, asking about transparency, verification, cost structure, overpayments and whether the government will publish data and act. The minister answered that current rules (Warmtewet, Wcw, tenancy law) already provide sufficient safeguards, that data on back-payments is not held by government, and promised only limited further steps such as reporting on complaints via the ACM and monitoring the upcoming Wcw implementation.
The cabinet is of the view that the policy to safeguard transparency, reliability and affordability is in order.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat het beleid om de transparantie, betrouwbaarheid en betaalbaarheid te borgen op orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht dat een 100-jarige vrouw een woning vindt na drie jaar op straat te hebben geleefd in Tilburg

MP El Abassi asked ministers about reports that a 100-year-old woman lived on the street in Tilburg for three years, and whether this exposed failures in the safety net for elderly people. The state secretary answered that the woman did not live on the street but stayed with family in Morocco after leaving in 2022, that no national figures on homeless elderly exist, and that municipalities are responsible, so no mandatory reporting structure is planned.
Based on this case, I see no reason to impose on municipalities, in this decentralised system, an obligation to set up an active signalling structure and a national reporting point.
Op basis van deze casus zie ik geen reden om in dit gedecentraliseerde stelsel gemeenten een verplichting op te leggen tot een actieve signaleringsstructuur en een landelijk meldpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het feit dat de eerder vermeende dakloze 100-jarige vrouw in Tilburg helemaal niet op straat zwierf, maar verbleef bij familie in Marokko

Dutch MP El Abassi asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister for Housing about reports that a 100-year-old woman in Tilburg was homeless for three years when she had in fact stayed with family in Morocco, asking about verification, the municipality's role, and whether guidelines or lessons would follow. The State Secretary confirmed the facts, said journalists are responsible for verification and the municipality could not give more detail for privacy reasons, and refused to draft new guidelines for municipalities while pointing to the existing National Action Plan on Homelessness.
It is the responsibility of journalists to verify reporting.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van journalisten om berichtgeving te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Welzijn over het Interdepartementale Beleidsonderzoek (IBO) Huursector

MP Welzijn (NSC) asked the Minister for Housing about the IBO Huursector report, including its conclusions on tax advantages, housing for starters and middle incomes, a rental register, housing reuse, and a national allocation system. The minister declined to go into the report's substance pending a cabinet response this autumn, but described concrete steps on hospitaverhuur, home sharing and splitting, and said a national allocation system would require the central government to take the lead.
I will not anticipate this cabinet response in this letter and therefore will not go into the conclusions and recommendations of the report on substance.
Ik zal in deze brief niet vooruitlopen op deze kabinetsreactie en ga daarom niet inhoudelijk in op de conclusies en aanbevelingen van het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Boswijk over mantelzorg- en familiewoningen bij woonwagens en op kampjes

Two CDA MPs asked whether residents of caravans (woonwagens) and kampjes can use the planned permit-free rules for mantelzorg and familiewoningen, and about housing shortages for caravan dwellers. The minister confirmed the permit-free option excludes woonwagens for ruimtelijke reasons, except for existing structures, and said the housing programmes must address caravan residents' needs.
The permit-free options for using outbuildings for housing related to mantelzorg and familiewoningen indeed do not apply to woonwagens.
De vergunningvrije mogelijkheden om bijgebouwen te gebruiken voor de huisvesting in verband met mantelzorg- en familiewoningen geldt inderdaad niet voor woonwagens.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Van Nispen over het artikel 'Rijk of arm geen factor bij overleg over asielopvang'

An SP MP asked whether the sociaaleconomische status (SES-WOA score) is ignored in the regional asylum reception talks, despite the Spreidingswet amendment, and what the minister will do. The minister answers that the SES-WOA score was built into the indicative distribution used in the talks and in the distribution decisions, so socioeconomic capacity is already considered, and sees no reason for new guidelines.
Through this score, socioeconomic differences are not ignored in the distribution of asylum reception places.
Middels deze score worden sociaaleconomische verschillen niet genegeerd bij de verdeling van asielopvangplekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Netversterking midden-Nederland jaren vertraagd'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Ministers of Climate and Green Growth and of Housing and Spatial Planning about the reported multi-year delay of grid reinforcement in central Netherlands, its effects on households and businesses, site selection, land acquisition, municipal planning and the grid check in spatial policy. The minister answers that the delay is disappointing, that several questions depend on forthcoming grid forecasts and studies, and that the government will take concrete steps such as a planned Nota Ruimte, an exploration of proactive spatial steering, and letters to Parliament on progress.
The cabinet is doing its utmost, together with all parties involved with TenneT and the province of Utrecht in the lead, to seize every opportunity to accelerate the realisation of this project.

Het kabinet spant zich tot het uiterste in om, samen met alle betrokken betrokken partijen, TenneT en de provincie Utrecht voorop, iedere mogelijkheid om de realisatie van dit project te versnellen aan te grijpen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hartsuiker over het bericht 'Kabinet zet nieuwe stap op weg naar Nota Ruimte over inrichting Nederland' en het artikel 'Kabinet plant grootschalige woonwijken bij vier Nederlandse steden'

An MP asked why Zuidoost-Drenthe was assigned the 'versterken' label rather than 'initiëren' despite the Nedersaksenlijn investment, and what the new regional large-scale housing label entails. The minister answered that the region lacks the basis for large-scale development (universities, high urbanisation, international infrastructure), so it stays under 'versterken' while the Nedersaksenlijn offers an impulse to be concretised with the province, and explained the two types of large-scale housing locations and their financial support.
Zuidoost-Drenthe does not fall under 'initiëren' because the basis for large-scale development, which we expect under the 'initiëren' strategy, is insufficiently present.
Zuidoost-Drenthe valt niet onder «initiëren», omdat de basis voor een grootschalige ontwikkeling, die we verwachten bij de strategie «initiëren», onvoldoende aanwezig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over het bericht “Jongvolwassen Oekraïners tussen wal en schip: geen recht op onderwijs, geen toekomstperspectief”

MPs Podt and Paternotte (D66) asked ministers about reports that young adult Ukrainians lack access to education and prospects, including tuition and student finance parity with EU/EEA students, lower institutional tuition, Piri motion follow-up, Dutch language provision and support for vulnerable newcomers. The government replied that temporary protection runs to 4 March 2027, that tuition-level decisions rest with institutions, and that details of a return programme and transition document will be sent to parliament in September 2025, without changing current rules in the meantime.
Pending final decision-making on this temporary national status for displaced persons from Ukraine, I do not intend to amend current laws and regulations in advance.
In afwachting van finale besluitvorming over deze tijdelijke nationale status voor ontheemden uit Oekraïne ben ik niet voornemens om vooruitlopend daarop de huidige wet- en regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over verduurzaming van huurwoningen en energiearmoede, zie 'Energiearmoede steeg vorig jaar fors door stopzetten steunmaatregelen'

An MP asked the government about agreements with private landlords on home insulation, annual insulation numbers for housing corporations and private landlords, how to speed up renovation, phase-out timing for low energy labels, tenants' options to push landlords, progress on a motion about nature permits, and funding for an energy-poverty fund. The minister answered that no performance agreements exist with private landlords, that a 2012 covenant missed its target, outlined planned minimum energy requirements from 2029, a support package for private landlords, and that the public energy fund could be operational by late 2026 with funding subject to a new cabinet.
The cabinet has decided, subject to approval by the European Commission, to use €174.5 million from the SCF funds for a public energy fund to be set up.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, onder voorbehoud van goedkeuring van de Europese Commissie, uit de middelen voor het SCF € 174,5 miljoen in te zetten voor het in te richten publiek energiefonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de flinke toename van energiearmoede door het wegvallen van overheidssteun

An MP from DENK asked the ministers whether the rise in energy poverty to 510,000 households in 2024 reflects the end of crisis support measures, and why those measures were withdrawn without structural alternatives. The government acknowledges the increase, argues that targeted structural measures (Social Climate Fund, insulation, a noodfonds subsidy) are preferable to the broad energy allowance, and declines to reinstate a price cap or allowance now.

The cabinet therefore chooses to focus on structural targeted measures, such as the Social Climate Fund approach described under question 2 and targeted insulation of homes in specific neighbourhoods.

Het kabinet kiest er daarom voor om in te zetten op structurele gerichte maatregelen, zoals de bij vraag 2 beschreven inzet vanuit het Social Climate Fund en gerichte verduurzaming van de woningen in specifieke wijken.
