Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de evaluatie van de Omgevingswet

An MP asks the Minister of Housing and Spatial Planning whether the first monitoring results of the Environment and Planning Act (Omgevingswet) show integrated, one-government working, and whether the transition will stall, with municipalities relying on temporary BOPA instruments and old working methods. The Minister answers that implementation is a gradual cultural change managed by each competent authority, that the monitoring and independent evaluation commission will track progress, and that participation support and the Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting are being backed by ministry-led support measures.
I, but certainly also the evaluation commission, will continue to pay attention to this in the coming years within the framework of monitoring and evaluation.
Ik, maar zeker ook de evaluatiecommissie, zullen hier de komende jaren in het kader van de monitoring en evaluatie aandacht voor blijven hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht 'Nieuwbouwhuis raakt hitte slecht kwijt, we bouwen voor klimaat van 15 jaar geleden'

An MP asks the Minister of Housing about news reports that new homes overheat and that building rules reflect a climate of 15 years ago, asking about health risks, cooling, building standards, neighbourhood greenery and integrating heat stress into housing projects. The Minister answers that current rules limit overheating risk, outlines the 2025 heat approach and the planned national adaptation strategy, and commits to further instruments and reviews.
To limit the effects of heat in the built environment, an integrated approach is required.
Om de effecten van de gevolgen van hitte in de gebouwde omgeving te beperken, is een integrale benadering vereist.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de uitvoering en effecten van het programma Schrappen Tegenstrijdige en Overbodige Eisen en Regelgeving (STOER)

An MP asked the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning about the implementation, expected housing gains, costs, monitoring and energy-grid constraints of the STOER deregulation programme, and about the timing of EU energy-performance rules. The minister mostly deferred quantification to the cabinet response after summer, outlined which laws would change and committed to further review and a joint consultation, while stating that quality remains a benchmark.

At the committee debate on building regulations on 12 June I indicated that further clarification of this motion will be included in the cabinet response after the summer to the committee's final report.

Tijdens het commissiedebat Bouwregelgeving van 12 juni jongstleden heb ik aangegeven dat verdere duiding op deze motie wordt meegenomen in de kabinetsreactie ná deze zomer op het eindrapport van de commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht 'Nieuwe bouwcrisis dreigt als omslag naar duurzaam ontworpen woningen uitblijft'

An MP asked the housing minister about a news report warning that a new construction crisis looms unless buildings shift to sustainable design, and about the Rli advice, sustainable materials, heat resilience and the STOER deregulation project. The minister acknowledged the report, pointed to the EPBD-IV whole-life carbon rules and a routekaart due by 2027, but rejected the crisis framing, gave no firm timeline for STOER changes beyond a 2026 voorhang, and left some questions (heat research, biobased effects) pending further study.
Before 1 January 2027 the Minister of VRO will publish a roadmap and notify the European Commission of it.
Voor 1 januari 2027 zal de Minister van VRO een routekaart publiceren en daarover de Europese Commissie in kennis stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Inge van Dijk over consumentenbescherming bij erfpacht

CDA MPs asked the housing minister about a report claiming ground-lease (erfpacht) canon increases in Amsterdam are unjustified, including questions on independence of expert advice, consumer protection and a possible inquiry. The minister answered that the municipality has its own responsibility, that existing dispute routes (three-expert procedure, complaints commission, ombudsman, courts) are adequate, and that she will only informally raise consumer protection with Amsterdam.
I do not see a role for me to have a judgment on this.
Ik zie voor mij hier geen rol om hier een oordeel over te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht ‘Meer woningen krijgen vergunning zonder bouwstart

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about reports that homes receive permits but construction does not start, and about the financial consequences for builders and buyers. The Minister acknowledged the problem, attributed it mainly to economic conditions and listed measures (Woontop agreements, parallel planning, nitrogen and appeal-procedure measures, investment incentives), while declining to offer financial compensation.
I do not have a complete and up-to-date picture of the precise financial consequences.
Ik heb geen volledig en actueel beeld van de precieze financiële gevolgen.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht 'gemeente vs. echtpaar Bos in Bruinisse: 'Onwerkelijk hoe ons leven zo verdwijnt''

MP Wijen-Nass asked the Minister of Housing about a couple in Bruinisse facing heavy penalties and strict enforcement for permanently living in a holiday home, and whether municipalities should be more lenient pending new rules. The Minister said she cannot judge individual cases, has urged municipalities to show restraint, and expects new regulation allowing legalisation under conditions to take effect in 2026.
I assume that most municipalities heed my call to be restrained in enforcement.
Ik ga er vanuit dat het grootste deel van de gemeenten gehoor geeft aan mijn oproep om terughoudend te zijn met handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Vijlbrief over het amendement Mooiman op de Wet versterking regie op de Volkshuisvesting

Two MPs (Grinwis and Vijlbrief) asked the minister to assess the consequences and feasibility of the adopted Mooiman amendment fully excluding urgent housing priority for status holders, to explain how it differs from her own bill, and to answer before the votes. The answer is that the questions were answered in a separate letter on the feasibility of adopted amendments, referred to by document number.

The written questions from MPs Grinwis and Vijlbrief on the Mooiman amendment to the Housing Market Steering Act (submitted 2 July 2025) have been answered in a letter on the feasibility of adopted amendments.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Grinwis en Vijlbrief over het amendement Mooiman op de Wet versterking regie op de Volkshuisvesting (ingezonden 2 juli 2025) zijn beantwoord middels een brief over Uitvoerbaarheid aangenomen amendementen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Paternotte over het tekort aan studentenhuisvesting in Delft en elders

MPs Vijlbrief and Paternotte asked about a shortage of student housing in Delft and elsewhere, including the threatened loss of student rooms, the effect of the rent freeze, the exclusion of students from the rent allowance (huurtoeslag), falling student purchasing power and rent-regulation rules. The minister responds by pointing to the national student housing action plan, a 25% rise in the WWSO point price, planned temporary contracts and hospitality rental incentives, a new subsidy scheme, and reasons why rent allowance extension is not currently feasible, while deferring several items to future reports.
The current cabinet is continuing this approach.
Het huidige kabinet zet deze aanpak voort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Vedder over de toepassing van module D in product-LCA’s voor milieuprestaties van bouwproducten

MPs Bontenbal and Vedder asked the housing minister whether the use of module D in product LCAs distorts building product environmental performance scores, punishing frontrunners and reducing incentives for direct decarbonisation. The minister acknowledged the criticism, announced an evaluation of module D, disagreed in part with the analysis and said adjustments would depend on that evaluation and on building costs and housing targets.
At present I am preparing an evaluation of module D. I will share its outcomes with your House.
Op dit moment bereid ik een evaluatie van module D voor. De uitkomsten daarvan zal ik met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Brandweer ziet lastig te blussen branden door ontploffende zonnepanelen toenemen’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that firefighters face hard-to-extinguish fires from exploding solar panels, and about installation quality, oversight, and training. The minister answered that the risk is small, relying on TNO/NIPV research, existing municipal and sector oversight, and a planned handbook on hazardous deposition, while declining to tighten oversight or create new protocols.

The limited number of incidents involving solar panels relative to the total number of installations in the Netherlands, and the initiatives by the sector, give me no reason to improve oversight of the quality of solar power installations.

Het beperkt aantal incidenten met zonnepanelen in verhouding tot het totale aantal installaties in Nederland en de initiatieven door de sector geeft voor mij geen aanleiding om het toezicht op de kwaliteit van zonnestroominstallaties te verbeteren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de uitvoering van de motie-Welzijn (Kamerstuk 34 293, nr. 143) inzake risicobeheersing Binnenhofrenovatie naar aanleiding van de 13de voortgangsrapportage Binnenhof

An MP asked the Minister of Housing whether the Binnenhof renovation risk management, as requested by a parliamentary motion, goes beyond identifying risks to adding mitigating measures such as independent audits, a political stop point, a scope freeze, a public risk dashboard and benchmarking. The Minister answered that risks are managed at several levels with described strategies, but declined to provide per-risk detail for confidentiality and practicality reasons, said an independent audit is not planned, rejected an extra political stop point, said a scope freeze is already in place, and was willing only to explore a risk dashboard within confidentiality limits.
Given the number of risks and associated control measures, the information per risk is too extensive to send to your House in progress reports.
Gegeven de hoeveelheid risico's en bijbehorende beheersmaatregelen is de informatie per risico te uitgebreid om in voortgangsrapportages aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Mooiman over recente artikelen ’Zonnepanelen ontploffen en zorgen voor problemen' en 'Expert: Stop met brandbare isolatie'

Two MPs asked the minister about fires involving external insulation and solar panels in Arnhem and Didam, and about fire safety rules for renovation and sustainability projects. The minister answered that existing Bbl fire rules apply, that monitoring and follow-up research (TNO, NIPV, Royal Haskoning DHV, NEN) are underway, and that no new national rules, action plan or structural programme is considered necessary.
Banning combustible insulation materials in the building envelope of homes is not appropriate.
Het verbieden van brandbare isolatiematerialen in de gebouwschil van woningen ligt niet in de rede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de position paper van TNO 'Goede binnenluchtkwaliteit voor onze gezondheid'

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the housing minister about a TNO position paper on indoor air quality, its proposed health-policy, ventilation, monitoring and regulatory measures. The minister largely judged existing building and tenancy rules sufficient, while committing to a ventilation-focused awareness campaign and declining a national monitoring programme, a TNO structural role, and fixed ventilation subsidies for now.
However, I see no need for a large-scale monitoring programme in the existing building stock to shape policy on the indoor environment.
Ik zie echter geen noodzaak voor een grootschalig monitoringsprogramma in de bestaande bouw om beleid ten aanzien van het binnenmilieu vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over de uitbreiding van militaire trainingsfaciliteiten op ’t Harde

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked how long permit procedures for expanding military training facilities take, whether this slows defence readiness, and how regulations, nature protection and noise concerns will be handled. The government acknowledges lengthy permit procedures and the tension with defence urgency, outlines short- and long-term steps such as accelerating existing permits, the NPRD programme and a planned bill, but gives no average processing time.
An average processing time for permit procedures for expanding Dutch military facilities cannot be given.
Een gemiddelde doorloopsnelheid van vergunningsprocedures voor uitbreiding van de Nederlandse militaire faciliteiten is niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de overhandiging van de ‘Housing Hotline Policy Brief 2024’ vanuit de LSVb

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about the LSVb's Housing Hotline 2024 policy brief on rental abuses, uneven municipal tenant support, a national quality mark for tenant teams, data sharing between municipalities, and online rental scams targeting students. The Minister answered that existing laws and municipal complaint points suffice, that municipalities decide on tenant teams, that a national mark is not seen, and that the scam signal will be passed to the Justice Minister.
At the table of the National Platform for Student Housing I will speak with the Network of Knowledge Cities to encourage them to have their information provision to tenants in order.
Aan tafel van het Landelijk Platform Studentenhuisvesting zal ik in gesprek gaan met het Netwerk Kennissteden om ze aan te moedigen hun informatievoorziening richting huurders op orde te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht 'Woningbouw in het nauw; Onderzoek: kwart van miljoen nieuwe huizen op de tocht door milieubeleid'

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the housing minister about a Telegraaf report that a quarter million planned homes are threatened by water, soil subsidence and nitrogen rules, and whether the risk map and grounds for building restrictions are justified. The minister disputed the newspaper's reading of the EIB report, said the water and soil framework is non-binding, and outlined measures such as raising ground levels, subsidies and a nitrogen permitting overhaul.
The decision-making framework with its accompanying maps was made to support authorities in choosing locations for new spatial developments, and has no legally enforceable status.
Het afwegingskader met daarbij behorende kaarten is gemaakt ter ondersteuning voor overheden bij de locatiekeuze voor nieuwe ruimtelijke ontwikkelingen, en heeft geen juridisch afdwingbare status.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Deze wijk verdwijnt, maar bewoners zijn tegen: 'Dit ga je toch niet slopen?''

JA21 MP Eerdmans asked the minister about the planned demolition of the temporary Mrija housing district for Ukrainian refugees in Vlaardingen to make way for a wastewater treatment plant, and urged reuse for housing seekers. The minister answered that the flexible homes will be transferred to housing corporation Waterweg Wonen after 2026, that there is no demolition, that the matter is primarily local, and that no intervention is planned.
I see no reason to do so. This is primarily a local matter.
Daar zie ik geen aanleiding toe. Dit is primair een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over de uitzending van Radar van 31 maart 2025 en dan specifiek het onderwerp 'Senioren geweigerd voor tijdelijke lening ondanks overwaarde'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vedder (CDA) asked the Ministers of Finance and Housing about a Radar broadcast reporting that seniors with home equity were refused bridging mortgages. Minister Keijzer (Housing) said such refusals are undesirable, that she will consult ouderenorganisaties, banks, NVB and supervisors, and will raise bridging credit in the monitoring of the Convenant Ouderen & Toekomstbestendig Wonen.
Therefore I want to consult stakeholders to find out why seniors have difficulty obtaining a bridging mortgage.
Daarom wil ik in gesprek met stakeholders achterhalen waarom senioren moeilijk een overbruggingshypotheek kunnen krijgen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de brandbrief die Amsterdamse kerken aan de burgemeester van Amsterdam stuurden in verband met het gebrek aan fysieke ruimte om hun diensten en activiteiten plaats te laten vinde

MP Ceder asked whether the government recognises the shortage of physical space for church services in Amsterdam, whether Article 6 of the Constitution guarantees such space, and whether the government will press municipalities, including Amsterdam and Rotterdam, to reserve space for religious communities. The minister answered that space allocation is a municipal matter, that Article 6 imposes no obligation to guarantee physical space, that the state can only intervene if freedom of religion is rendered illusory, and that existing guidance is sufficient, with no concrete new action committed.
Article 6 of the Constitution, however, does not impose on the government an obligation of result to make sufficient physical space available for holding religious services.
Artikel 6 van de Grondwet legt de overheid echter geen resultaatsverplichting op om voldoende fysieke ruimte beschikbaar te maken voor het houden van erediensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de sloop van sociale huurwoningen in o.a. Meezenbroek en Versiliënbosch in Heerlen, de Pompenburgflat in Rotterdam en Prinsejagt in Woensel

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the housing minister about demolition of social rental homes in Heerlen, Rotterdam and Eindhoven, citing resident exclusion, heritage value, and carbon concerns, and asks why residents were poorly informed and whether tenants should have a veto like the 70% consent required for renovation. The minister answers that local parties hold primary responsibility, points to the Nationaal sloop- en renovatiestatuut and the Huurders-Verhuurder overleg rules, declines to judge individual cases, and rejects a tenant veto over demolition while promising a study on demolition versus renovation due in 2025.
For far-reaching measures such as demolition, consultation with residents is required.
Bij ingrijpende maatregelen zoals sloop moet worden overlegd met de bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'De bonafide particuliere belegger kan niet meer rendabel verhuren'

The MP Welzijn asked Minister Keijzer about a Volkskrant article claiming private investors can no longer rent profitably, about first-time buyers, family gifts with tax exemptions, the share of middle-rent homes held by private landlords, and the rent levels of those homes from 2015 to 2024. The minister answered in detail with WoON survey data, acknowledging that many private rental homes are in the low segment and that rents often diverge from maximum prices, and admitted the answers were delayed because the data could not be published before 10 April 2025.
Answering the questions properly required data from the WoON2024 survey.
Voor goede beantwoording van de gestelde vragen waren gegevens uit het WoON2024-onderzoek nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over digitale sloten in studentenwoningen

An MP asked the government about a housing corporation's plan to switch student housing in Enschede to digital locks, including privacy risks, registration of entries and exits, and the Finnish regulator's ruling on a similar practice. The minister replied that the government has no say over private organisations' technology use, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is responsible for GDPR enforcement, and that the government has no overview of such locks nationally.
However, it is not for the cabinet to investigate or, in individual cases, whether privacy legislation is being breached.
Het is echter niet aan het kabinet om onderzoek te doen of in voorkomende gevallen de privacywetgeving wordt geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over de combinatie box 3 en Wet betaalbare huur belangrijkste reden om uit te ponden

Two CDA MPs asked whether a survey of 368 property investors showing box 3 tax and the Affordable Rent Act as main reasons for selling rental homes reflects the real drivers, and whether ministries should urgently study the cumulative effects and tighten the box 3 counter-evidence rule. The minister replied that a mix of rent regulation, tax changes and a stronger owner-occupied market drives sales, promised a broader integrated assessment and a later report on middle-segment investment, and deferred the counter-evidence question to a separate state secretary letter.
We will inform the House later this year about the outcomes of this research.
Wij zullen uw Kamer later dit jaar informeren over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Dakloos door zwarte lijsten van woningcorporaties’

MPs Beckerman and De Hoop asked the housing minister about black lists of tenants kept by housing corporations that leave people homeless, and whether the state is meeting its homelessness goals. The minister says corporations act only as a last resort, that black lists are regional and not monitored nationally, that tenants can challenge listings via the Data Protection Authority or the courts, and that homelessness is handled through gemeenten and existing shelter, without committing to new measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, De Hoop en Kostić over renovatie van wijken met erfgoedwaarde zoals Meezenbroek

MPs Timmermans, De Hoop and Kostić asked the housing minister about demolition of the historic Meezenbroek neighbourhood in Heerlen, residents' right to return, tenant protections, consultation, and the financial and environmental case for renovation over demolition. The minister answered that housing corporations decide locally, that tenant protections and a national demolition-and-renovation statute apply, that no absolute right of return is desirable, and that a national study on demolition is due end 2025.
Given the major impact demolition/new construction has on residents, I attach importance to involving residents in good time in such projects.
Vanwege de grote invloed die sloop/nieuwbouw op bewoners heeft, hecht ik waarde aan het tijdig betrekken van bewoners bij dit soort trajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over de situatie in de middenhuur

An MP from BBB asks the Minister for Housing about the very high demand for mid-rent homes (10,000 applications for 200 units), the investment climate for mid-rent construction, the effects of the Affordable Rent Act on unit size, and whether local authority demands are discouraging building. The Minister acknowledges the shortage, points to fiscal and rent-regulation measures, promises to inform parliament on a joint study with the Finance State Secretary later this year, and says local authorities will not impose stricter technical requirements, with exploitation demands to be addressed under the STOER programme.
I will inform parliament later this year about the outcomes of this study.
Wij zullen uw Kamer later dit jaar informeren over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel ‘Volop trucs om huurregels te ontwijken, maar huurcommissie veegt 'shortstaycontract’ van tafel’, uit het FD van 25 februari jl

An SP MP asked the Minister of Housing about reports that landlords use short-stay and friends contracts to circumvent the rent rules, and what the government will do about it. The minister says these contracts are restrictively applicable, that the rent-regulation framework was clarified, that no monitoring data exist, and that the short-stay issue will be covered in the evaluation of the new rental laws.
It is always undesirable when the law is circumvented.
Het is altijd onwenselijk als de wet wordt omzeild.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over een Nationaal Aanvalsplan Schimmelwoningen

MP Vedder (CDA) asked the Minister of Housing and Spatial Planning, following a Kassa report, about a national action plan on mould in rental homes, dedicated mould teams for housing corporations, follow-up care, financing, enforcement of local agreements, and related policy. Minister Keijzer answered that existing national performance agreements, local agreements, an independent mould-expert arrangement under discussion, and the Huurcommissie instruments are the main tools, and that the government did not consider a separate national plan necessary.
No, I do not share this view. Damp and mould do not belong in a home, and I agree on the need to tackle this kind of problem.
Nee, ik deel deze opvatting niet. Vocht en schimmel horen niet in een huis en ik ben het dan ook eens met de noodzaak om dit soort problematiek aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ‘Huurders eisen nu echt actie tegen schimmel in huis’

An MP asks the minister about mould in rental homes, the failure of housing associations to take responsibility, and whether current law protects tenants' health. The minister replies that the National Performance Agreements and local agreements address mould, that the existing rules are sufficient, and that landlords carry primary responsibility.
I am of the view that the current laws and regulations are sufficient.
Ik ben van mening dat de huidige wet- en regelgeving voldoende is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'Gemeente checkt of huurders niet te veel betalen; ‘Het is bij de beesten af’'

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about a news report on tenants paying hidden extra rent above the legal rent, and what the Wet goed verhuurderschap has achieved so far. The minister acknowledges such practices are unlawful, says no central data exist on their scale or on municipal reports and enforcement, promises monitoring and a report by year end, and points to tenants' existing remedies.
The number of reports at municipal reporting points and the number of enforcement actions are not centrally registered, so precise figures are not available.
Het aantal meldingen bij gemeentelijke meldpunten en het aantal handhavingsacties wordt niet centraal geregistreerd, waardoor precieze cijfers hierover niet beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Welzijn over de antwoorden op eerder gestelde vragen over het bericht ‘Woningsplitsing levert nog weinig extra huizen op’

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about data on home splitting and conversions, the BAG registry, the delay in 2024 figures, and the progress of housing projects and policy programs. The minister answered that CBS derives splitting figures from the BAG, that splitting and other conversions cannot always be separated, that a new scan and a Kamerbrief will follow, and that data gaps are not a major problem because total new homes are known.
I want to emphasise that the total number of new homes is fully known to CBS and that in that sense no information is missing.
Ik hecht er daarbij aan te benadrukken dat het totaal aantal nieuwe woningen dus volledig bekend is bij het CBS en dat in die zin geen informatie wordt gemist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de ontwikkelingen van hypotheken in 2024

An MP asked the minister for housing about 2024 mortgage and home price developments, including breakdowns by price segment, the share of mortgages used for energy-saving and foundation repair, and the effect of these on mortgage sizes. The minister gave quarterly price figures, said price-segment data for new builds is not available and is being investigated by CBS, and reported that about 15% of 2024 mortgage applications financed energy-saving measures while foundation-repair financing data is limited.
The ministry does not have a breakdown by price segment per quarter of sales prices for existing and new-build homes.
Het ministerie beschikt niet over een onderverdeling in prijssegmenten per kwartaal van de verkoopprijzen bij bestaande en nieuwbouwwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vijlbrief over de uitspraak van de Raad van State om een bouwplan voor jongerenwoningen te schrappen vanwege een afrondingsverschil in de parkeerbehoefte

An MP asks the housing minister about a Council of State ruling that struck down a Haarlem zoning plan for young people's housing over a rounding issue in parking requirements, and whether the process should be faster. The minister says multiple defects, including use of unadopted parking policy, were found, expresses regret about the delay, and points to existing procedural options and the housing bill without committing to new legislation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Westerveld over het beboeten van dakloze mensen

MPs Beckerman and Westerveld asked why municipalities still fine homeless people for sleeping rough, begging and camping, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary agrees fines worsen homelessness, says municipalities set these rules under their own powers, and says talks with the VNG about alternatives are ongoing.
Municipal councils have, however, under Article 147 of the Municipalities Act, the power to adopt bylaws that they consider necessary in the interest of the municipality.
Gemeenteraden hebben echter op grond van artikel 147 Gemeentewet de bevoegdheid om verordeningen vast te stellen, die zij in het belang van de gemeente nodig achten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en De Hoop over de Spaanse heffing op buitenlandse huizenkopers

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked whether the Netherlands should raise transfer tax to 100% for home buyers from outside the EU, after Spain proposed such a levy. The government answered that non-EU buyers account for only about 0.3% of purchases, so the price effect is minimal, that a 100% rate would cost about 14 million euros per year, raise legal and administrative problems, and that it will not introduce the measure.
In view of the answers to questions 4 and 5, the cabinet is not willing to introduce such a measure.
Gelet op het antwoord op de vragen 4 en 5 is het kabinet niet bereid een dergelijke maatregel in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Peter de Groot over het artikel ‘Duizenden Amsterdammers wacht erfpacht-strop: ’Van tientje naar 216 euro per maand’

An MP asked the housing minister whether she knows of a Telegraaf report on steep erfpacht (ground lease) increases in Amsterdam, whether she can accept the burden, whether she will talk to the municipality and the homeowners' foundation, and what remedies exist. The minister declined to judge the amounts or the municipality's conduct, pointed to the municipality's responsibility and existing dispute procedures, and mentioned a handbook for municipalities and a hardship scheme in Amsterdam.
As regards erfpacht, I have no legal basis on which to intervene in the ground rent agreed between the leaseholder and the ground lessor, including the procedure for setting a new rent.

Voor wat betreft erfpacht heb ik geen wettelijke basis waarop ik een ingreep in de tussen erfpachter en erfverpachter overeengekomen erfpachtcanon, inclusief de procedure om tot een nieuwe canon te komen, kan baseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Rooderkerk over de klimaataanpak van de minister

Two MPs from D66 asked the minister for Housing and Spatial Planning about the climate approach for the built environment: emissions, energy-cost differences by label, buildings in the public sector, grid congestion, labour shortages, funding, the heat pump subsidy and whether targets could be dropped. The minister answered with emissions and cost tables, described existing public-sector instruments and funding, said the grid and labour effects were not fully quantified, and deferred the overall climate package and the question of dropping targets to the Minister of Climate and Green Growth and the spring budget decision.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het AD-artikel 'Starter moet vette spaarpot hebben voor eerste woning: eigen vermogen van 91.000 euro vereist'

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about an AD article claiming starters need about 91,000 euro in own funds for a first home, and whether official data on equity contributions exist and what effects larger equity contributions have. The minister answered that HDN data show equity contributions of starters have been fairly stable 2020-2024, that larger equity is not clearly driving house prices, and that the questions were answered before the committee debate.
I do not consider further figures necessary.
Verdere cijfers acht ik niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht ‘‘Den Haag laat kinderen op straat slapen’, woede over beperken opvang van dakloze gezinnen’

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked about The Hague's decision to restrict shelter for non-entitled homeless families, and whether it conflicts with children's rights and national homelessness ambitions. The State Secretary replied that municipalities are responsible for solutions, that the ambition of no children on the street is essential, and that the government is mapping homeless families and discussing regional housing measures.
It is the responsibility of municipalities to arrive at appropriate solutions for (threatened) homeless persons, including cases involving minor children.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om te komen tot passende oplossingen voor (dreigend) dakloze personen, inclusief gevallen waar dat minderjarige kinderen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over het uitsluiten triple glas en kozijnen bij isolatiesubsidie 'maatregel 29’ van Nij Begun

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked why triple glazing and window frames were excluded from the Groningen insulation subsidy (maatregel 29) and why this fits earlier promises of full subsidy. The minister answers that these measures are not necessary to reach the insulation standard, grants 50% or 100% retroactive coulance for those who already invested, and offers 30% under ISDE for new applications.
We have listened carefully to the responses to the internet consultation and have adjusted and supplemented the scheme on this point.
Wij hebben goed geluisterd naar de reacties op de internetconsultatie en de regeling op dit punt aangepast en aangevuld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht ‘Woningsplitsing levert nog weinig extra huizen op’

An MP asked the housing minister about reports that home splitting yielded few extra homes in 2024, the causes, and how the government will force a breakthrough toward 100,000 homes. The minister said full 2024 figures are not yet available, that the split/merge balance is small, and listed measures such as the housing regulation bill, funding, and planned guidance and possible permit-free splitting.
Precise figures on the number of splits are not known.
Precieze cijfers over het aantal splitsingen zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel '’Expats only’: Nederlandse woningzoekers buitenspel door nieuwe wet'

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about reports that short-stay rentals are being used to bypass the Wet vaste huurcontracten and to exclude permanent housing seekers, including questions on segments, prices, enforcement and fiscal treatment. The minister answered that the data is not available nationally, that short-stay contracts must be applied very restrictively and fall to the courts to judge, that gemeenten handle permit questions, and that the government will consider broader amendments to the sale-related termination rule and the Leegstandwet.
It is not for me as legislator to pass judgment on specific cases mentioned in the article.
Het is niet aan mij als wetgever om een oordeel te geven over specifieke (in het artikel genoemde) gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en De Hoop over een leegstandsheffing

MPs Stultiens and De Hoop asked about vacant housing in Rotterdam, the number of empty homes, and whether a national or municipal vacancy levy should be introduced. The minister answers that about 30,000 homes are administratively long-term vacant, mostly for explainable reasons, and that she will prepare a bill giving municipalities more powers against vacancy rather than introducing a levy now.
As I indicated in my letter mentioned above, I am adopting these recommendations and am now preparing the drafting of a bill to give municipalities more powers to tackle vacancy.

Zoals ik in mijn bovengenoemde brief heb aangegeven neem ik deze aanbevelingen over en tref ik thans de voorbereidingen voor de uitwerking van een wetsvoorstel om gemeenten meer slagkracht te geven bij de aanpak van leegstand.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rajkowski en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Helft van het aantal asielopvangplekken in 2026 bezet door statushouders'

MPs Rajkowski and De Groot (VVD) asked about projected statushouder occupancy of asylum reception places, rising family reunification, and housing for status holders after the taakstelling is abolished. The Minister of Asylum and Migration answered that the government is pursuing stricter family reunification rules, expects a two-status system to reduce reunification, and will bring forward measures and temporary housing plans with local authorities, without giving a firm timeline for permanent solutions.
The cabinet has included in its Coalition Agreement and Government Programme that family reunification will be further restricted.
Het kabinet heeft in haar Hoofdlijnenakkoord en in het Regeerprogramma opgenomen dat nareis verder wordt beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de beperkte investeringscapaciteit van woningcorporaties in Waddinxveen en Midden-Holland

An MP asked the minister about housing corporations in Waddinxveen and Midden-Holland lacking investment capacity to build social rental homes despite many available sites, and about adjusting project support, a collective instrument, to help. The minister acknowledged the regional shortfall, pointed to inter-corporation solidarity, planned changes to project support and a legislative proposal, but declined to commit to using collective project support in this case now.
I still stand by the principle that collective project support can be deployed if, after all efforts in the region, it proves additionally necessary.
Ik sta nog steeds achter het uitgangspunt dat collectieve projectsteun ingezet kan worden als dit na alle inspanningen van de regio aanvullend noodzakelijk blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Vijlbrief over de verplichte jaarlijkse WOZ-waardebepaling door gemeenten

MPs Sneller and Vijlbrief asked the government about replacing the mandatory annual WOZ property valuation with a biennial one, following a VNG motion, and about related costs and private users. The state secretary replied that a VNG-commissioned study is underway, that no reaction is yet warranted, that municipalities cannot set their own valuation frequency due to uniformity requirements, and that the cost and revenue data are not available, promising to consider the option in the Ombuigingslijst.
At this moment such figures are not available.
Op dit moment zijn dergelijke cijfers niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het debat Staat van de Volkshuisvesting op 23 januari 2024

An MP asked the housing minister, in 14 questions, about the corporation sector's ability to fund 30,000 social rental homes a year, the box 3 tax timing, flex housing, hospitality rental, and conditional municipal subsidies. The minister answered that financing is broadly feasible nationally with regional gaps, that the target is now 2029 with 2027 as an ambition, and that subsidy design is still being worked out, but gave no answer to question 14 on timing.
The definitive budgetary decision-making, including the coverage for box 3, however takes place in the spring.
De definitieve budgettaire besluitvorming, inclusief de dekking voor box 3, vindt echter plaats in het voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht 'Onnodig veel geld kwijt aan dubieuze huursites’

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about reports that dubious rental websites mislead housing seekers, and whether the ACM lacks capacity to intervene and whether a national platform should be created. The Minister acknowledged the signals, said the ACM is independent and prioritises cases, pointed to existing consumer remedies and rules for intermediaries, rejected a national platform as not a government task, and saw no need for additional measures.
Because of the ACM's independent position, I see no possibilities to actively have the ACM intervene in signals of misleading practices by rental websites;
De onafhankelijke positie van de ACM maakt dat ik geen mogelijkheden zie om de ACM actief in te laten grijpen bij signalen van misleidende praktijken door huursites;
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Beckerman over het ontbreken van huurdersbelangen bij de Woontop

MPs De Hoop and Beckerman asked why the Woonbond did not sign the Woontop housing agreements, what the government did to keep it on board, and about rent increases, financing gaps and the impact on tenants. The minister regrets the Woonbond's refusal, describes efforts to reach agreement, defends the 4.5% social rent-increase cap and the 7.7% middle-segment cap as political trade-offs, and says the financing gaps are manageable with regional solidarity and municipal co-financing.
I will work with the parties to see how these uncertainties can be made smaller and/or controlled.
Ik ga samen met de partijen kijken hoe die onzekerheden kleiner en/of beheerst kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Noodfonds Energie stopt in 2025 door gebrek aan bedrijfssteun'

An MP from D66 asked ministers whether the Noodfonds Energie (emergency energy fund) should end in 2025 for lack of business contributions, and whether other parties such as grid operators could contribute. The government answered that talks with energy suppliers and grid operators continue, that the fund is needed for 2025, and that the sector's contribution to administrative costs is required to avoid state aid risk, with a request under the Comptabiliteitswet to start disbursement quickly.
The cabinet is actively looking for a solution to make this possible.
Het kabinet zoekt actief naar een oplossing om dit mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de evaluatie van de ATAD-richtlijn per 31 juli 2024

Member Welzijn asks whether the earnings stripping rule under the ATAD implementation in the Dutch corporate tax Act disproportionately burdens housing associations, which must finance through debt, and asks why no exemption is possible or what other EU states do. Minister Keijzer answers that the rule is a generic interest-deduction limit required by ATAD1, that exemptions for housing associations are not permitted under the directive or state aid rules, that the government raised the deduction percentage to 24.5% for a relief of 69 million euros for housing associations, and that the ATAD evaluation by the European Commission is awaited before further steps are decided.
To determine our specific position, we first await the outcomes of the ATAD evaluation currently being carried out by the European Commission.
Voor het bepalen van onze specifieke inzet wachten wij eerst de uitkomsten van de evaluatie van ATAD af die momenteel wordt uitgevoerd door de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over de kosten voor kwaliteitsborging van verplaatsbare tiny houses

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about the costs of private quality assurance under the Wkb for movable tiny houses, including claims that they cost up to four times as much as municipal checks and must be re-inspected at each relocation. The Minister denied the fourfold claim, said costs are comparable to the prior municipal leges for standard dwellings, but agreed to study simpler re-inspection and a standardised approach, while rejecting a price cap for now.
Recently I informed the Senate that I will examine, for the renovation, the extent to which the current quality assurance system is appropriate.
Recent heb ik de Eerste Kamer aangegeven dat ik voor verbouw zal nagaan in hoeverre de huidige systematiek van kwaliteitsborging passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het artikel 'De Raad van State versnelt de bezwaarprocedures woningbouw'

An NSC MP asked the Minister of Housing why she distinguishes between the acute housing shortage and other projects, what would be needed to bundle permits and tackle obstacles across the whole shortage, and how many projects are stalled by delays and costs. The minister answered that she treats all housing equally, relies on local acceleration tables and the STOER programme to remove conflicting rules, and gave partial figures while deferring some questions to letters.
Realising 100,000 homes a year is our shared goal.
Het realiseren van 100.000 woningen per jaar is ons gezamenlijk doel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omzigt, Welzijn en Joseph over de Woontop, waar pensioenfondsen schitteren door afwezigheid

MPs Omtzigt, Welzijn and Joseph asked why pension funds were absent from the Woontop housing summit, whether they had been invited and how their participation would be secured. Minister Keijzer answered that the Pensioenfederatie was invited but declined to sign commitments on individual investment decisions, and that talks with the pension sector and a joint investment-climate picture within six months would continue.
I cannot make statements about confidential conversations.
Ik kan geen mededelingen doen over vertrouwelijke gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de Woontopafspraken 2024

An MP from Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked Minister Keijzer about the 2024 Woontop housing agreements: which parties signed, the potential for densification and splitting, the role of banks, pension funds and cooperatives, the 100,000-homes target, grounds for withholding information, rent and middle-segment shares, land-price instruments and subsidy earmarking. The minister answered most questions substantively, committed to further analyses and a Raad van Woningzoekenden, and declined to give a figure for middle-rent homes and some other numbers, citing ongoing work or lack of data.
It is not possible to state what the cost reductions would be from removing rules and requirements that are still unknown.
Het is niet mogelijk aan te geven wat de kostenverlagingen zijn als gevolg van het schrappen van, nog onbekende, regels en eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Omtzigt, Mooiman en Wilders over het bericht ‘Maximale huurverhoging vanaf 1 januari 2025: 4,1% voor vrije sector en 7,7% voor middenhuur’

MPs asked the Minister of Housing whether the 7.7% maximum rent increase for mid-segment rentals in 2025 is acceptable for households, and whether additional measures, a transitional arrangement, or a structural change to the mid-rent increase system are planned. The minister answered that the increase follows from the Wet betaalbare huur tied to collective wage growth, that the actual increase will often be lower, and that no legislative change is planned before the 2027 evaluation, while declining to calculate household income effects.
I therefore cannot make a calculation of the effects on the purchasing power figures.
Ik kan dan ook geen doorrekening maken van de effecten in de koopkrachtplaatjes.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het intrekken van vergunningen bij onderbezetting van stallen

An MP asked the ministers whether they were aware of Council of State rulings requiring municipalities to justify not withdrawing unused livestock-housing permits, and whether this creates legal uncertainty for farmers. The minister said the duty to give reasons was not tightened, that good reasoning is possible, and that he will talk with the VNG and Omgevingsdienst NL about ensuring legal certainty within the existing framework.

Therefore I will, possibly together with my colleagues of Housing and Spatial Planning and of Public Transport and Environment, enter into discussion about permits with the VNG and Omgevingsdienst NL to see what is needed to secure the desired legal certainty in practice.

Daarom ga ik, eventueel samen met mijn collega van Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening (VRO) en mijn collega van Openbaar Vervoer en Milieu (OVM), in gesprek over vergunningen met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) en met de Omgevingsdienst NL om te bezien wat er nodig is om in de praktijk de gewenste rechtszekerheid daarvan te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over zakelijke en financiële belangen

MP Dijk asked ministers and state secretaries about their financial and business interests, whether these could influence cabinet decisions, and whether such interests should be made public, including holdings under 25,000 euro. The government confirmed that some ministers have such interests, said a procedure was followed to prevent conflicts of interest, and refused to disclose the information, promising only to review the framework before the next formation.
Referring to the answers to questions 1 through 7, I will not provide this information.
Onder verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vragen 1 t/m 7 zal ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over financiële en zakelijke belangen

An SP MP asked several ministers and state secretaries whether their financial and business interests, including stakes in Dutch and American companies, could affect cabinet decisions and whether such interests should be disclosed. The state secretary confirmed the interests exist, said the procedure to prevent conflicts was followed and the framework will be reviewed before the next formation, but refused to disclose the details of the interests.
Referring to the answers to questions 1 through 7, I will not provide this information.
Onder verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vragen 1 t/m 7 zal ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over financiële en zakelijke belangen

An SP MP asked several ministers and state secretaries whether their financial and business interests, reported in the formateur's final report, could affect cabinet decisions, and whether such interests should be disclosed. State Secretary Szabó confirmed the interests, said the appointment procedure ensured no objective risk of conflict of interest, and declined to share details of the interests, while saying the existing framework will be reviewed before the next formation.
Referring to the answers to questions 1 through 7, I will not provide this information.
Onder verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vragen 1 t/m 7 zal ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over financiële en zakelijke belangen

An SP MP asked several ministers and state secretaries about their financial and business interests, whether these could influence cabinet decisions, and whether such information should be public. The Minister for Housing answered that the procedure was followed carefully, that the framework for conflicts of interest will be reviewed before the next formation, and declined to disclose the interests requested.
Referring to the answers to questions 1 through 7, I will not provide this information.
Onder verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vragen 1 t/m 7 zal ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over financiële en zakelijke belangen

An MP asked ministers and state secretaries about their financial and business interests, including whether their holdings are below 25,000 euro, whether these could influence cabinet decisions, and whether they would disclose them. The state secretary confirmed the interests, said a formation procedure safeguarded against conflicts of interest, and declined to share details of the holdings, pointing to the earlier answers.
Referring to the answers to questions 1 through 7, I will not provide this information.
Onder verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vragen 1 t/m 7 zal ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over "staatscommissie demografie"

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about the government's position on the State Commission's demography report, including which scenario policy follows and whether the programmatic governance approach and a four-yearly demography report will be adopted. The minister answers that the cabinet endorses steering toward moderate population growth, plans an annual monitor and knowledge infrastructure, and will report on the governance exploration in spring 2025, but declines to answer the questions in time for the debate.

Following the caretaker cabinet's commitment in its letter of 24 May 2024, in November 2024 an assignment was given to ABDTOPConsult for an exploration of how to achieve a cross-domain, multi-year programmatic approach within the central government.
Naar aanleiding van de toezegging van het demissionaire kabinet in de Kamerbrief van 24 mei 2024 is in november 2024 een opdracht verstrekt aan ABDTOPConsult voor een verkenning
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het bericht ’Huurprijzen in de vrije sector stijgen verder, maar niet overal’

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about media reports that the Wet betaalbare huur is reducing rental supply and that landlords are selling rental homes, and asked when an early evaluation could be brought forward. The Minister answered that signals are monitored, the Kadaster figures show no growing trend in sell-offs, it is too early to judge proportionality, and the full evaluation follows within three years, with a weighing planned in Q1 2025.
The first full evaluation of the law, looking at its effects on the rental market as a whole, follows within three years of the law entering into force.
De eerste volledige evaluatie van de wet, waarbij ik in het geheel kijk naar de effecten daarvan op de huurmarkt, volgt binnen drie jaar na inwerkingtreding van de wet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Bezwaren van buurtbewoners en milieuclubs zorgen voor flinke rem op woningbouw’

An MP asks the Minister of Housing about reports that residents' and environmental objections are slowing housing construction, the number of completions, builder bankruptcies, investment in rental housing, and whether objection-related lawsuits could be restricted or penalised. The minister answers that delays should be minimised, outlines the bill on faster appeals to the Council of State and STOER regulatory review, and rejects penalising objectors because legal protection is a core element of the constitutional state.

Legal protection is after all an essential part of the democratic constitutional state, whereby an interested party can, if desired, have the government's weighing of interests reviewed by an independent judge.

Rechtsbescherming is immers een wezenlijk onderdeel van de democratische rechtsstaat, waarbij een belanghebbende de door de overheid gemaakte belangenafweging desgewenst door een onafhankelijke rechter kan laten toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de uitzending van Pointer ‘Ik mag niet kleiner wonen’ op donderdag 24 oktober 2024 over woningruil

An MP asked the minister about a Pointer broadcast on housing swaps, long social-housing waiting times, and corporations refusing swap requests due to passend toewijzen rules and rent increases. The minister said no data exists on how many tenants want to swap, pointed to municipal and corporation tools, noted limited use of the 5% discretionary allocation room, and said it will be reviewed in 2025.
In 2025 we will review the passend toewijzen instrument and examine, among other things, whether it is necessary to widen the 5% free allocation room.
In 2025 bekijken we het instrument passend toewijzen en onderzoeken we onder andere of het noodzakelijk is de 5% vrije toewijzingsruimte te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Van Vroonhoven en Omtzigt over een plan om het verhuren van een kamer aan studenten veel gemakkelijker te maken

MPs Welzijn, Van Vroonhoven and Omtzigt asked the government about making it easier to rent rooms to students through hospita arrangements, covering housing shortages, mortgage and bank consent, the WWSO rent rules, the kostendelersnorm, huurtoeslag and the income-dependent rent increase. The minister answered that the rent-rule and hospita exception is already in place, that a bill to end hospita contracts on sale is being prepared, that banks' consent is being pursued, and that several questions (MKBA, huurtoeslag, exemption thresholds) are under study or not feasible now.
At present I am preparing a legislative amendment that should allow the rental contract to be terminated upon sale, only in the case of hospita rental.
Op dit moment bereid ik een wetswijziging voor die er toe moet leiden dat het huurcontract – alleen in het geval van hospitaverhuur – bij verkoop kan worden beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Van Oostenbruggen en Six Dijkstra over het artikel inzake het plegen van hypotheekfraude door drugscriminelen

MPs Welzijn, Van Oostenbruggen and Six Dijkstra asked about reports that criminal networks, including drug criminals, commit large-scale mortgage fraud and whether police and prosecutors can detect and prosecute it. The government answered that the problem is recognised but not systematically registered, that data-sharing options with banks and the Tax Authority are being explored, and that police knowledge of new modus operandi will be shared with lenders.
Mortgage fraud is not registered separately by the police or the Public Prosecution Service, because it consists of the offences of forgery, fraud and/or money laundering.
Tot slot wordt hypotheekfraude niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd bij de politie of het OM, omdat hypotheekfraude bestaat uit de delicten valsheid in geschrifte, oplichting en/of witwassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over VvE’s die in de knel komen door de Gasketelwet

An MP asks the minister about housing associations (VvE's) facing high costs under the Gas Boiler Act, specifically replacing collective flue systems older than fifteen years, and about a feasible route forward. The minister responds that the CO-regime is important for safety, points to a new trade handling framework and a forthcoming NEN practice guideline, notes that flue inspection certificates are available, and promises further talks with the sector and consumer organisations.

In the coming period I would like to enter into discussion with the sector and consumer organisations about the bottlenecks with collective flue systems at VvE's identified in the evaluation and the letter from Vereniging Eigen Huis.

Ik ga komende tijd graag in gesprek met de sector en consumentenorganisaties over de in de evaluatie en de brief van Vereniging Eigen Huis geconstateerde knelpunten met collectieve rookgasafvoeren bij VvE's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht ‘Hoe een volhardende buurvrouw protesteert tegen een bouwproject op de Müllerpier en zich voor 400.000 euro laat afkopen’

An MP asks the housing minister how to respond to a report that a resident was paid 400,000 euros to withdraw objections to a Rotterdam housing project, and whether the buyout creates precedent and whether ministry officials' conduct is involved. The minister says objection and appeal rights must be preserved, contract freedom means she will not intervene in such settlements, the Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting would accelerate appeals, and the official's conduct is a private matter.
However, I also consider it important that an interested party can lodge an objection or appeal when they suffer disadvantage or harm from a planned construction project.
Ik vind het echter ook van belang dat een belanghebbende bezwaar of beroep kan instellen wanneer deze nadeel of schade ondervindt van een voorgenomen bouwproject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over verschillende vormen van woonegoïsme

CDA MPs asked the housing minister about residents who file objections or appeals against housing projects to extract buyouts, and about procedural delays in housing construction. The minister condemned appeals made purely for financial gain but said it cannot be measured, defended the right to appeal, and pointed to the Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting to speed up housing-project litigation through single-instance appeal.
It is not possible to determine how many objections and appeals have been withdrawn in recent years on such suspicion.
Het is niet mogelijk om te achterhalen hoeveel bezwaar- en beroepschriften de afgelopen jaren vanwege een dergelijk vermoeden zijn ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over de ondersteuning van gemeenten bij de beleidsvorming van het woonwagenbeleid

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Housing and Spatial Planning how many municipalities have adopted new mobile-home (woonwagen) pitch policy since 2018, why municipalities fail to meet targets, what role the national government plays, and how it will support municipalities. The minister replied that 105 of 273 responding municipalities have specific policy, that the national government supports municipalities through knowledge programmes, subsidies and monitoring, and that it will keep supporting them without binding targets.
I will continue to support municipalities in housing vulnerable groups, including mobile-home residents.
Ik zal gemeenten blijven ondersteunen bij de huisvesting van aandachtsgroepen, waaronder woonwagenbewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vijlbrief over het bericht «Klimaatminister voorspelt dat haar eigen beleid niet voldoende is»

An MP asks the housing minister whether she agrees that the coalition programme is insufficient to meet 2030 climate targets, whether dropping the hybrid heat pump norm and energy tax change cuts CO2 reductions, whether additional buildings policy is needed, and how often she has met the climate minister. The minister agrees there is a considerable challenge, refers the quantitative and policy questions to the climate minister's answers to other MPs, says she is in frequent contact with the climate minister, and admits the answers could not be provided before the budget debate.
For the answer to these questions I refer to the answers of the Minister of KGG to the questions with the same intent.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik naar de antwoorden van de Minister van KGG op de vragen met dezelfde strekking
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Peter de Groot en Van Eijk (allen VVD) over het artikel 'Enorme ozb-verhoging Amsterdam ’Middenklasse maximaal uitgekleed”

VVD MPs asked the government about a steep property tax (OZB) increase proposed by Amsterdam, its effect on household costs, parking charges and erfpacht, and whether the government would engage Amsterdam to cap OZB rises. The minister declined to comment on Amsterdam's local tax decision as a matter for the municipal council, provided cost data, and committed to talks with municipalities on capping OZB increases.
It is up to the municipal councils to make choices here, weighing among other things the tax burden, service levels and other matters.
Het is aan de gemeenteraden hierin keuzes te maken, waarbij onder meer belastingdruk, voorzieningenniveau en andere zaken tegen elkaar worden afgewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de sloop van sociale huurwoningen in Roofvogelwijk (Spoorlaan, Landweerstraat-Noord, Sperwerstraat, Wouwstraat en Vijversingel) te Oss

An SP MP asks the housing minister about BrabantWonen's plan to demolish social rental homes in the Roofvogelbuurt in Oss, after residents were told of renovation, and whether this breaches consultation law, the minister's view on resident participation, and the Ombudsman's recommendations. The minister says the tenant-landlord consultation law leaves this to the Huurcommissie or civil courts, points to the new national demolition and renovation statute for earlier participation, and declines to intervene locally, leaving the decision to the corporation and Oss.
It is not for me to judge in an individual case whether there is a breach of the Tenant-Landlord Consultation Act.
Het is niet aan mij om in een individueel geval te oordelen of er sprake is van schending van de Wet op het overleg huurders en verhuurder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over het bericht “Grote verhuurders: geen verkoopgolf door middenhuurwet, huren dalen beperkt”

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about press reports that large institutional landlords will not sell off housing due to the middle-rent law and that rents will fall only modestly, and why private landlords depend on high rents and what would help both private and institutional investors. The Minister acknowledges the picture, explains the differing position of institutional and private landlords, outlines tax measures and a Housing Investment Monitor, and largely answers the questions on substance without committing to new concrete legislative change.
I recognise this picture. One of the starting points of the Affordable Rent Act is that it must remain attractive for (institutional) investors to invest in middle-segment rental housing.
Ik herken dit beeld. Een van de uitgangspunten van de Wet betaalbare huur is immers dat het voor (institutionele) beleggers aantrekkelijk moet blijven om te investeren in middenhuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ’Nieuwe huurregels kunnen studenten hun woning kosten’

An MP asks the Minister of Housing whether the Wet betaalbare huur is causing students sharing rented homes to lose their housing, and requests figures and remedies. The minister says there is no data on how many students were affected, that non-renewal may stem from interest rates, taxation or other rules rather than the Act, and that tenants with open-ended contracts are protected and can contact municipal reporting points.
No figures are available on the number of students whose expiring temporary contract was not renewed since the Wet betaalbare huur took effect on 1 July 2024.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal studenten waarvan een aflopend tijdelijk contract niet verlengd is sinds het ingaan van de Wet betaalbare huur per 1 juli 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over het bericht ‘Drijfveren en barrières van de leden van VvE’s bij verduurzamingsopgaven

An MP asked the minister about barriers to sustainability upgrades in homeowners' associations (VvE), including cost-allocation keys in deeds of division. The minister answered that the main barriers are technical, financial and unanimity in decision-making, pointed to the 2023 Versnellingsagenda with planned progress reporting in early 2025, and said deed changes cannot be made free of charge by notaries.
It is of great importance to implement this agenda as quickly as possible.
Het is van groot belang deze agenda zo snel mogelijk tot uitvoering te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de prognose van Rabobank dat koopwoningen dit jaar met 9,1% en volgend jaar met 10,7% in prijs zullen stijgen

MP Baudet asks the housing minister about Rabobank's forecast of 9.1% and 10.7% house price rises, the causes of housing scarcity, the role of immigration, the costs of sustainability upgrades, and the position of first-time buyers. The minister attributes price rises mainly to wage growth and lower mortgage rates, acknowledges immigration as a major driver of housing need, and points to the 100,000 homes per year target and a 70 million euro fund for starters.
I am committed to building 100,000 homes per year, two-thirds of all new construction to be affordable housing.
Ik zet mij er voor in dat er 100.000 woningen per jaar worden gebouwd, waarvan twee derde van alle nieuwbouw moet bestaan uit betaalbare woningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het waarderen van de zonnestroomboiler ofwel PV-zonneboiler in de NTA 8800

An MP asked whether PV-solar boilers (electric boilers fed by own solar power) are a proven technique, whether they help with grid congestion and self-consumption, and why they cannot be credited in the NTA 8800 energy performance calculation for new buildings, asking for a fix before a committee debate. The minister answers that such boilers suit some homes with panels but heat pumps are more efficient, that grid-congestion benefits are limited, and that NTA 8800 will be revised in the EPBD-IV implementation, where own storage valuation will be assessed.
In NTA 8800, the calculated annual yield of the PV panels is fully offset against the calculated total fossil energy use of the building-related installations.
In de NTA8800 wordt de berekende jaaropbrengst van de PV-panelen geheel verrekend met het berekende totale fossiele energiegebruik voor de gebouwgebonden installaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Vijlbrief over de financiële positie van studenten

MPs Paternotte and Vijlbrief asked the government about student financial pressure: whether to lower interest on student loans, avoid cutting the basic grant, drop the long-study fine, and extend the supplementary grant to mbo students. The minister answered that there is no room for further measures, that the temporary grant increase ends and a higher basic grant cannot be applied retroactively, and that a second loan compensation of 1.4 billion euro is planned.
That is why this cabinet has chosen to invest 1.4 billion euro one-off to raise the compensation for student-loan-system students.
Daarom heeft dit kabinet ervoor gekozen om incidenteel € 1,4 miljard in te zetten voor het verhogen van de tegemoetkoming van leenstelselstudenten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en De Hoop over het bericht dat ondanks het verbod op tijdelijke huurcontracten, er nog altijd honderden woningen met een tijdelijk contract aangeboden worden

MPs Grinwis and De Hoop asked the housing minister how the government enforces the ban on temporary rental contracts after reports that hundreds of such homes are still offered. The minister answered that the Wet vaste huurcontracten has no enforcement instruments, that wrongly offered temporary contracts automatically become indefinite, and that municipalities have no enforcement task, while promising information campaigns and openness to talks with landlord organisations.
The Wet vaste huurcontracten has no enforcement powers of its own.
De Wet vaste huurcontracten kent geen eigen handhavingsmogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Joseph over hittestress

MPs Welzijn and Joseph asked the minister about heat stress in homes, including the claim that half of Dutch residents live in overheating homes and whether heat should count as a defect. The minister partly recognises the problem, says the claimed figures cannot be confirmed, outlines existing measures and says the heat-as-defect question is under review.
The cited Investico research refers to 1 in 2 people, whereas the recently published Statistics Netherlands (CBS) research refers to 1 in 3 households.
Het aangehaalde onderzoek van Investico spreekt namelijk van 1 op de 2 mensen terwijl het recent gepubliceerde Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) 9 onderzoek spreek van 1 op de 3 huishoudens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over oververhitting

An MP asked the minister about the health risk heat poses to seniors in homes that overheat in summer, the number of non-compliant homes, protective measures, and information for residents. The minister acknowledged seniors as a heat-risk group, listed national and local heat measures and information channels, but said there are no specific plans to speed up home adaptation and gave no estimate of non-compliant dwellings.
No, there are no specific policy plans to adapt homes more quickly to heat stress.
Nee, er zijn geen specifieke beleidsplannen om huizen sneller aan te passen aan hittestress.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over Hittegolven

An MP asked the Minister of Housing and Spatial Planning what crisis plans exist to protect vulnerable people during heatwaves, what policy applies to extreme heat like the 2021 Canadian heat dome, and whether cooled shelters can be organised locally. The government replied that the National Heat Plan is activated during heat periods and is being evaluated by RIVM, that current policy would continue in extreme heat with more emphasis on self-reliance, and that cooled shelters are a local matter that is not simple to organise.
In 2024 the Ministry of VWS commissioned RIVM to evaluate the National Heat Plan.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft in 2024 het RIVM opdracht gegeven om het Nationaal Hitteplan te evalueren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht «Ook in Breda en Zwolle betalen studenten nu 30 procent meer voor een kamer»

An SP MP asked the housing minister how to lower student room rents, protect students from malicious landlords, and reconsider the exemption of students from the ban on temporary leases. The minister answered that the Affordable Rent Act now caps rents, the Good Landlordship Act gives municipalities enforcement tools, the temporary-lease exemption is retained, and new funding and a student housing plan aim to add affordable units.
The cabinet maintains the policy of exempting students from the Fixed-Term Rental Contracts Act.
Het kabinet handhaaft het beleid om studenten uit te zonderen van de Wet vaste huurcontracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de evaluatie van de Europese Commissie naar de Anti Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD)

An MP asked the Minister whether the ATAD interest-deduction limit should apply to housing associations, how Dutch implementation differs from the EU directive, and its effect on social housing construction. The Minister answered that the earnings-stripping rule is deliberately stricter than the EU minimum, that a specific exemption for housing associations is not possible under ATAD1, and that the effect on construction cannot be determined, while promising to review the directive after the Commission's evaluation.
To determine our specific position, we will first await the outcomes of the evaluation of ATAD1 currently being carried out.
Voor het bepalen van onze specifieke inzet wachten wij eerst de uitkomsten van de evaluatie van ATAD1 af die momenteel wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Vroonhoven over de Belastingdruk op middenhuurwoningen

MPs Omtzigt and Van Vroonhoven asked the government to calculate the costs and returns of a private landlord's rental home in box 3 for 2016 to 2025, including the effects of tax and rent regulation measures, and whether mid-rent housing is in shortage and how box 3 burdens could be eased. The government answered that the example is illustrative only, showed the 2023 and 2024 figures, explained the box 3 tax rate rise to 36%, the updated leegwaarderatio and the Wet betaalbare huur, and said the Supreme Court's June 2024 rulings will lead to a counter-evidence scheme for actual returns.
No figures are kept on the number of homes rented out in box 3.
Er worden geen cijfers bijgehouden van het aantal woningen dat in box 3 wordt verhuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over het bericht “Overzicht eerste half jaar 2024” op www.hypotheekshop.nl

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about inconsistent treatment of student debt in mortgage capacity calculations after new DUO debt rules, and whether they would adopt clearer rules. The minister acknowledged the signals, said the 2025 amendment regulation will clarify how lenders calculate student loan payments (including temporary reductions), and that consultation responses will be considered.
I intend to include this point in the annual amendment regulation on mortgage credit.
Ik ben voornemens dit punt mee te nemen in de jaarlijkse wijzigingsregeling hypothecair krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over het bericht ‘Een hypotheek voor een tiny house, Esther kreeg het voor elkaar: ‘Ik kan het nog steeds bijna niet geloven’’

CDA MPs asked the housing and finance ministers about difficulties obtaining mortgages for tiny houses and flexible homes and the resulting inequality. The minister said the government will study mortgage rules for movable homes with the Ministry of Finance, NHG and the market, and will discuss with the NVB, but defended current lender risk-based conditions and gave no data on tiny house mortgages.
There are no figures available on the owner-occupied sector.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de koopsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het toewijzen van sociale huurwoningen aan statushouders

An MP from the CDA asks the ministers whether municipalities must house refugee status holders, whether priority allocation of social housing to them is being abolished, and what the consequences of banning such priority would be for asylum flow, dispersal and costs. The government confirms the statutory housing quota and gives the half-year figures, but says the share of social housing allocated to status holders is not tracked nationally, and defers the substance of the priority ban and its consequences until the coalition programme is further elaborated.
Currently it is not possible to provide insight into the percentage of social rental homes allocated to status holders over the past five years, because this is not tracked nationally.
Momenteel is het niet mogelijk om inzicht te bieden in het percentage sociale huurwoningen dat de afgelopen vijf jaar is toegewezen aan statushouders, omdat dit niet landelijk wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over onduidelijke communicatie inzake meerdaagse (zakelijke) evenementen
