An MP asked why multi-day business events such as trade fairs and congresses were believed to be cancelled until 1 September 2021 due to unclear government communication, and asked for clearer guidance. The minister acknowledged the confusion, said communications were adjusted and that multi-day business events without overnight stays could go ahead, and described economic support measures for the events sector.
Discussions with the sector showed that the wording sometimes caused confusion.
Uit gesprekken met de sector is gebleken dat de omschrijving soms voor verwarring zorgde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de opinie 'Kost het banen?'

An MP from the CDA asks the minister whether productivity and innovation should take priority over direct job creation in subsidies and whether process-innovation instruments suit the manufacturing sector. The minister answers that both job loss and creation are needed, that innovation policy is the focus, that process-innovation schemes are broadly used, and that further studies and advice are forthcoming.
Direct employment is not the primary criterion there.
Directe werkgelegenheid is daarbij niet het primaire criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Ierse privacywaakhond onderzoekt hoe TikTok gegevens van kinderen verwerkt'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Amhaouch (CDA) asked about TikTok's processing of children's data, the Irish DPC investigation, and related Dutch actions. The minister replied that the Dutch AP fined TikTok in 2021, transferred its 2020 investigation to the Irish DPC, has no evidence of data sharing with China, and will follow the DPC's second investigation while a cybersecurity study for apps is being commissioned.
The AP cannot make any statements about the content of that investigation.
Over de inhoud daarvan kan de AP geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de stand van zaken rond de IPCEI’s Micro-elektronica 2 en Cloud Infrastructuur en Services

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and Climate about Dutch participation in the IPCEI Micro-electronics 2 and Cloud Infrastructure and Services, including the status of project proposals and the national financial contribution. The minister answered that the government has reserved 230 million euros for ME2 and 70 million for CIS, that selection of projects is still pending European Commission review, and that a decision on other IPCEIs will be made case by case by the new cabinet.
Only when the assessment by DG Competition has taken place later in the process will it be clear which projects can formally become part of the IPCEIs.
Pas als later in het proces de beoordeling door DG Mededinging heeft plaatsgevonden, zal duidelijk zijn welke projecten formeel onderdeel uit kunnen maken van de IPCEI's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Palland en Amhaouch , over het bericht ‘Opnieuw problemen met Keolis-bussen die plotseling uitvallen'

MPs from the CDA asked the government about recurring failures of BYD-built Keolis buses in the Overijssel emergency concession, including whether provinces can exclude foreign manufacturers and how the EU International Procurement Instrument would affect bus procurement. The minister replied that the faults were limited and did not endanger safety, that provinces have limited ability to set origin requirements for privately purchased buses, and that the IPI would apply to public tenders but not private purchases, with information to provinces to follow once it takes effect.
In theory the province could purchase the buses itself, but in practice this almost never happens.
In theorie zou de provincie de bussen zelf kunnen inkopen, maar in de praktijk gebeurt dit vrijwel nooit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het voornemen om te stoppen met coronasteun aan de zwaar getroffen horecasector

An MP asks the minister whether ending corona support for the hospitality sector, which warns that businesses will fail, is justified and why festivals cannot reopen when stadiums and Formula 1 can. The minister answers that generic support ends on 1 October 2021 because the economy is recovering, that targeted measures such as guarantee schemes and payment arrangements remain, and that festivals are judged riskier than seated events because of mixing crowds.

Now that the restrictive measures have largely been phased out and economic prospects are good, the expectation is that continuing generic support (TVL, Tozo, TONK, NOW) increasingly obstructs the normal dynamics of business formation and closure.

Nu de beperkende maatregelen (grotendeels) zijn afgebouwd en de economische vooruitzichten goed zijn, is de verwachting dat continuering van generieke steun (TVL, Tozo, TONK, NOW) de normale dynamiek van bedrijfsoprichting en – beëindiging steeds meer in de weg gaat zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Vier grote radiozenders dreigen 7- tot 13-voudige te moeten betalen voor verlenging FM-vergunning'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the renewal prices for commercial FM radio licences are 7 to 13 times higher than current fees, and whether this conflicts with a motion calling for proportionate fees. The State Secretary defended the SEO-calculated, market-conform prices as based on the licences' future earning potential under the Telecommunications Act and state-aid rules, provided the SEO report, and described consultation with the sector and the next procedural steps.
I have therefore, as with previous extensions, asked SEO Economic Research (SEO) to come with an independent advice.
Ik heb daarom, net als bij eerdere verlengingen, SEO Economisch Onderzoek (SEO) gevraagd met een onafhankelijk advies te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Miljoenenstrop dreigt voor vier grote zenders bij verlenging FM-vergunning'

MPs Grinwis and Rajkowski asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why the proposed fee for the emergency three-year extension of four national commercial FM radio licences is many times the current price, and how this fits with motions on digitalisation and COVID relief. The State Secretary answered that SEO's market-conform valuation, based on opportunity costs and CPB growth projections, was adopted, that the fee is not meant to compensate losses, and that the extension serves sector stability while digitalisation continues.
I am willing to extend the commercial licences for the requested period of three years.
Ik ben bereid om de commerciële vergunningen te verlengen voor de gevraagde periode van drie jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de hoge aardgasprijzen en leveringszekerheid

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about high gas prices, the decline of domestic production, storage fill levels, strategic gas reserves, long-term contracts and security of supply. The minister answered that prices reflect several market causes, that existing storage agreements and a planned risk evaluation and expert consultation address supply security, and that a strategic gas reserve is not currently deemed necessary.
I will therefore organise consultation with experts from the gas sector, including Gasunie Transport Services (GTS), in the short term to discuss the developments and their possible consequences.
Ik organiseer dan ook op korte termijn overleg met deskundigen uit de gassector, waaronder Gasunie Transport Services (GTS), om de ontwikkelingen en de mogelijke gevolgen daarvan te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht 'Nederlandse' robotarm gaat na 35 jaar toch nog de ruimte in'

The MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the European robotic arm ERA, Dutch space-sector strategic importance, lessons for space policy, future projects, a long-term national space programme, and fragmentation of space policy. The government answers that space policy will be set by the next cabinet within budget limits, that a Nota Ruimtevaartbeleid 2019 already set priorities, and that some questions are for the next cabinet.
The budgetary framework for space policy will be set by a new cabinet.
Het budgettaire kader voor het ruimtevaartbeleid zal door een nieuw kabinet worden vastgesteld.

Antwoord op van het lid Tony van Dijck over de berichten dat bedrijven voor ruim €4 miljard aan loonsteun moeten terugbetalen en dat dit voor veel ondernemers dreigt uit te draaien op een financiële strop

MP Tony van Dijck asked ministers whether reports that firms must repay over 4 billion euro in NOW wage subsidy, with a risk of financial ruin due to delayed accountant certificates, are accurate, and about the scope of repayments in other Covid schemes and conditions for repayment. The government answered that the repayment estimate is uncertain and partly based on incomplete data, that a 14-week extension is available for accountant and third-party certificates, that repayment terms are generous and interest-free, and that no compensation for accountant costs is planned.
The determination process for the NOW is still ongoing, so it is still unclear how much NOW support will ultimately be paid out.
Het vaststellingsproces van de NOW loopt nog, waardoor het nog onduidelijk is hoeveel NOW-steun er uiteindelijk wordt uitgekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de postbezorging in Kattendijke

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about postal delivery problems in Kattendijke and whether PostNL would be asked to find a structural solution with the municipality and residents. The State Secretary answered that PostNL acknowledged delayed deliveries caused by non-compliance with its quality norms, apologised, redelivered the post, and took measures, and that no regions currently show structural labour shortage problems.
Yes, I have made inquiries with PostNL.
Ja, ik heb navraag gedaan bij PostNL.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over de uitfasering van ISDN30 en de mogelijke onveilige situaties, door minder betrouwbare bereikbaarheid van particuliere alarmcentrales (PACS’s) en zorgcentrales

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the phase-out of ISDN30 lines and the risk that alarm and care centres lose reliable connections, particularly given the differing deadlines of KPN (1 April 2022) and Tele2 (1 October 2021). The state secretary answered that the phase-out is a logical modernisation, that KPN extended its deadline, that Tele2 has put interim measures in place, and that ACM allows KPN to temporarily reactivate the TDM interconnection as a safety net.
Together with the ACM, I will continue to keep a close watch on this.
Samen met de ACM blijf ik hierbij de vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Van der Werf en Sneller over het niet uitvoeren van de wens van de Tweede Kamer om het privéadres in de KvK af te schermen

MPs from D66 asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the Chamber's wish to shield private addresses in the Chamber of Commerce register had not been carried out, after the murder of a lawyer whose address was reportedly found through it. The State Secretary answered that home addresses will be shielded by default via a planned amendment, but shielding registered business addresses that are also home addresses conflicts with EU law and is only done in exceptional cases on request, with a further letter promised.
I have further made a proposal to lay down in the Trade Register Decree 2008 that the Chamber of Commerce will from now on shield registered home addresses by default.
Ik heb voorts een voorstel gedaan om in het Handelsregisterbesluit 2008 vast te leggen dat de Kamer van Koophandel als zodanig ingeschreven woonadressen voortaan standaard afschermt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch, Ellemeet en Bromet over de wateroverlast in Limburg

MPs asked the government about the flooding in Limburg: the adequacy of responders, damage estimates, applying the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen to victims, flood buffers and climate adaptation funding, and the long-term aid. The minister answered that the government will apply the compensation law, outlined eligible damage categories, said a damage quick scan is being prepared, and described responder support, climate-adaptation programmes and a planned evaluation table.
Given the nature and scale of the disaster, the cabinet has decided to apply the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts).
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, gelet op de aard en de omvang van de ramp, de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) toe te gaan passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het naleven van de Europese privacyregels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) bij (uitvoerings)instanties

An MP asks multiple ministers whether a long list of public bodies (DUO, CBR, SVB, IND, DJI, UWV, OM, FIOD and others) collect and process personal data in line with GDPR, and whether any are not yet compliant. The government replies per organisation, generally stating compliance, while noting ongoing work and specific gaps such as UWV's SONAR system, SVB processes still in development, and CAK access management.
UWV is working hard to comply with the GDPR.
Het UWV werkt hard om aan de AVG te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Zonnepaneel stoort communicatie van hulpdiensten'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate, together with the Justice Minister, about reports that solar installations with non-compliant inverters interfere with the C2000 emergency communication network and aviation/maritime radio. The government acknowledged the problem, said it is being addressed urgently with the supplier and network manager, and explained that Agentschap Telecom supervises EMC compliance and has enforcement powers, including recalls and sanctions.
Agentschap Telecom assesses such situations and has the powers to intervene.
Agentschap Telecom beoordeelt dergelijke situaties en heeft de bevoegdheden om op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over winkelstraten

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate what the government is doing to keep shopping streets viable, including financial support for retailers, spatial planning guidelines, and an action plan. The state secretary pointed to the Retailagenda platform, a 100 million euro Impulsaanpak for shopping areas, a shift back to normal retail conditions after COVID support, and an approach that leaves specific measures to local actors rather than issuing general guidelines or an action plan.
The instruments of spatial planning play an important role in preventing "Swiss cheese scenarios" in shopping streets.
Het instrumentarium op het gebied van ruimtelijke ordening speelt een belangrijke rol bij het voorkomen van «gatenkaasscenario’s» in winkelstraten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Aartsen over het bericht 'Winkelleegstand loopt snel op door corona'

MPs Romke de Jong and Aartsen asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about rising shop vacancy in big cities due to COVID-19, including the government's plans and support for municipalities. The State Secretary acknowledged the rising vacancy and negative effects, pointed to the Retailagenda platform, a G6 exploration with three ministries, and the 100 million euro Impulsaanpak Winkelgebieden, while offering no firm new commitments beyond ongoing work.
It is expected that the results of this will form the basis for a subsequent administrative process.
Naar verwachting zullen de resultaten hiervan de basis vormen voor een bestuurlijk vervolgtraject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat grote steden verloedering van winkelstraten vrezen nu de leegstand in winkelstraten oploopt

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about rising shop vacancy in city high streets, requesting data, causes, and support measures. The state secretary said complete data is sold commercially by Locatus and withheld, described vacancy as a symptom of structural trends accelerated by COVID-19, and pointed to the Impulsaanpak winkelgebieden (100 million euro over four years) with willingness to consider bringing funds forward.
If I were to make this data public free of charge, it would undermine the business model of Locatus.
Wanneer ik deze gegevens gratis openbaar zou maken, dan zou daarmee het verdienmodel van Locatus worden ondergraven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Ondernemer moet weer langer wachten op coronasteun; “Ik ben met stomheid geslagen”

An MP asks why the TVL fixed-cost subsidy for Q2 2021 was delayed despite earlier promises, why RVO did not keep its promise to speed up payments after a court case, and why advance payments were not used. The state secretary explains the delay through extended Q1 applications and a reference-system decision, denies breaking any promise, says advance payments are legally barred, and states the Q2 scheme opens on 25 June.
I should have communicated this delay more clearly to your House.
Deze vertraging had ik duidelijker aan uw Kamer moeten communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over mobiele bereikbaarheid en overal in Nederland 112 kunnen bellen

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile coverage for emergency number 112 in various Dutch regions, requesting a coverage map and additional measures. The State Secretary answered that 112 is reachable on all networks, via WiFi and abroad, that 100% coverage is physically impossible, that a 2015 study found coverage adequate, and that a coverage map and possible measures for 'white areas' will follow by early 2022.
A map showing the combined outdoor coverage of the mobile networks is currently being created.
Er wordt momenteel gewerkt aan het creëren van een kaart die de gezamenlijke buitenhuisdekking van de mobiele netwerken inzichtelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Aartsen over het bericht 'Coronavirus bereikt onze winkels: producten worden duurder'

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports of higher retail prices during the early coronavirus pandemic, including whether price regulation was applied, the causes of price rises, and shortages affecting medicines and medical supplies. The state secretary answered that no overviews of price-regulating firms are known, that no concrete signs of serious consumer harm have emerged, and pointed to general economic support packages and letters on medicine supply and stockpiling.
No overviews are known to me of businesses and shops that may have applied price regulation at the start of the coronavirus pandemic.
Mijn zijn geen overzichten bekend van bedrijven en winkels die mogelijkerwijs prijsregulering hebben toegepast aan het begin van de coronapandemie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Nederland verliest controle op beveiliging van het internet’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Rajkowski asked about the Cyber Security Council's warning that the Netherlands is losing control over internet security and growing dependence on foreign technology, including whether vital processes depend on foreign providers and how much EU recovery funds will support digital investment. The minister answered that digital autonomy is a means rather than a goal, that a full inventory of foreign-provider dependence is not realistic so a risk-based approach is used, and that the telecom sector has a structural approach with other vital sectors to be assessed later.
It is not systematically tracked to what extent service provision within vital processes takes place by, or depends on, foreign providers.
Er wordt niet integraal bijgehouden in hoeverre de dienstverlening binnen vitale processen plaatsvindt door of afhankelijk is van buitenlandse aanbieders
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het nieuwsbericht 'Open of dicht? Hoe het misging met signalen van Economische Zaken aan winkels'

The D66 MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how conflicting signals about whether partly essential retailers could open reached shops in December 2020, and why the ministry allegedly sent a supportive message to a retail chain. The government answered that the closure rules were clarified and tightened on 16 December, regretted the resulting confusion, denied issuing signals contrary to cabinet policy, and provided the message history and related documents.
Yes; I refer to the previous answers and the annexes.
Ja; ik verwijs hiervoor naar de vorige antwoorden en de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht 'Hoe het CBS en T-Mobile de privacy schonden'

An MP asked the government about reports that Statistics Netherlands (CBS) ran a large-scale mobile location data pilot with T-Mobile, whether parliament was informed, and related privacy concerns. The minister answered that CBS is an independent body whose contracts and methods the minister does not direct, that the pilot is under investigation by the Agentschap Telecom with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and declined to say more on the ongoing probe.
No statements can be made about the investigation at this time.
Over het onderzoek kunnen op dit moment geen uitlatingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het bericht dat het CBS toegang kreeg tot privacygevoelige locatiedata van klanten van T-Mobile

MP Buitenweg asked about reports that Statistics Netherlands (CBS) had access to sensitive location data of T-Mobile customers, raising privacy, legal basis, oversight and contracting concerns. Minister Blok answered that the Agentschap Telecom and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are investigating, that CBS says it only received anonymised or aggregated data, and that CBS is an independent body the minister cannot instruct on individual contracts.
The Agentschap Telecom and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are currently jointly investigating the matter as supervisors following the NRC article.
Het Agentschap Telecom en de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens doen op dit moment als toezichthouders samen onderzoek naar aanleiding van het NRC-artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Hoe het CBS en T-Mobile de privacy schonden'

MP Van den Berg (CDA) asked the government about press reports that Statistics Netherlands (CBS) and T-Mobile breached privacy through a mobile data pilot, including the agreements, whether customers were informed, and whether CBS should be stopped pending investigation. Minister Blok answered that the regulators (Agentschap Telecom and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens) are investigating, that CBS is independent so the minister cannot direct it, that the agreement has been published, and that CBS's competition safeguards have been implemented with a Competitive Neutrality Officer and a complaints committee, with the results to be shared with parliament.
The Agentschap Telecom and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are currently jointly investigating, as supervisory authorities, following the NRC article.
Het Agentschap Telecom en de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens doen op dit moment als toezichthouders samen onderzoek naar aanleiding van het NRC-artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Aartsen over de steunmaatregelen voor de bruine vloot

MPs Aukje de Vries and Aartsen (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about support measures for the historic sailing vessel ('bruine vloot') sector, including what was meant by statements at a March 2021 symposium, the delayed opening of the scheme, sector losses, EU state aid talks, consultations and reopening conditions. The State Secretary answered that the scheme would open around end of June 2021 after EU state aid talks led to using the de minimis regulation, that the sector lost about 77% of turnover in 2020, and that reopening steps are set out in the phased plan.
I understand the impatience of entrepreneurs and am glad that in my letter of 27 May 2021 I could indicate that the scheme is expected to open at the end of June.
Ik snap het ongeduld van ondernemers en ben blij dat ik in mijn brief van 27 mei 2021 hebben kunnen aangeven dat de regeling naar verwachting eind juni open kan worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Palland over het bericht ’Wijs bruine vloot aan als werelderfgoed’

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet and Palland asked the government whether the Dutch 'bruine vloot' (heritage sailing vessels) could be designated UNESCO World Heritage, whether Dutch vessels receive less subsidy than abroad, and whether the government would engage with provinces and the sector. The minister replied that movable objects like ships cannot be listed under the World Heritage Convention, pointed to intangible heritage routes and existing COVID support schemes, and offered to talk with the sector while info on foreign subsidies was still being gathered.
I asked the RCE to gather information through its international network, but this will take some time.
Ik heb de RCE gevraagd via zijn internationale netwerk informatie te verzamelen, maar dit zal enige tijd in beslag nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over de 'Reactie van de Kamer van Koophandel (KVK) op de petitie de Goede Zaak over privacy'

Two VVD MPs asked why the government is consulting on privacy of home addresses in the Trade Register rather than simply implementing their motion to shield residential addresses from public view, and whether the consultation scope and timeline are adequate. The state secretary answered that full implementation is not possible under EU law and Wwft obligations, that the motion is only partly feasible, that a broad consultation will explore all interests, and that a first indication of solutions is expected before the summer recess.
The motion cannot, as stated, be implemented in full because that is not (fully) possible.
De motie kan, zoals gezegd, niet onverkort worden uitgevoerd omdat dat niet (volledig) mogelijk is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Van der Lee over de petitie voor het beschermen van adresgegevens in het Handelsregister van de Kamer van Koophandel

MPs Bouchallikh and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary about a petition to shield home addresses of sole traders in the Trade Register from misuse for intimidation, and about the public role of business addresses for due diligence and legal certainty. The State Secretary agreed that intimidation is a concern, is amending the Trade Register decree to shield registered home addresses, but will not shield business seat addresses due to EU law and anti-money-laundering obligations, and will consult stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over Gronings restaurant met eigen bezorgdienst krijgt minder steun

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether restaurants delivering their own food receive less TVL support than restaurants using delivery platforms, and whether this is unfair. The State Secretary answered that TVL uses gross turnover, that the outcome depends on contract terms and can go either way, that RVO does not track such cases, and that the scheme already moves with each business's turnover loss, so no change is planned.
For the TVL it does not matter whether you use an own or an external delivery service.
Voor de TVL maakt het niet uit of je gebruik maakt van een eigen of een externe bezorgdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Tjeerd de Groot over vertragingen bij de herbeoordeling van TVL-aanvragen

MPs Romke de Jong and Tjeerd de Groot asked about delays in re-assessing TVL aid objections caused by SBI-code problems, including progress, the Q4 2020 backlog, sailing-vessel skippers, and the application form. The State Secretary answered that 97.5% of re-assessments are done, the remainder will follow shortly, RVO has added capacity to prioritise these cases, and the system was adjusted so entrepreneurs see the correct SBI code.
The objections relating to the SBI problem are being handled with priority, also because of the effect on an application in the next application period.
De bezwaren die betrekking hebben op de SBI-problematiek worden met voorrang opgepakt, ook vanwege het effect op een aanvraag de volgende aanvraagperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het bericht dat Huawei toegang had tot gegevens van miljoenen Telfort-klanten

MPs Buitenweg and others asked whether Huawei had access to millions of Telfort customers' data, as revealed by a 2011 internal KPN audit, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary answered that the vulnerable legacy system was retired in 2018, that Huawei had only maintenance access with no known data theft, that the government will require mobile operators to use only trusted vendors in critical network parts, and that it declined to say which parts are critical.
The cabinet makes no public statements about which parts have been designated as critical.
Het kabinet doet geen openbare uitspraken welke onderdelen als kritiek zijn aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over snel internet voor iedereen

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about universal fast internet, the updated broadband map, whether monitoring suffices to reach 100 Mbps coverage by 2023, the role of government versus the market in hard-to-reach areas, and municipal support. The State Secretary answered that the broadband map has been published, that monitoring is combined with consultation with provinces, that the market has largely delivered but some areas need local tailored solutions with provinces and municipalities, and that discussions with provinces and the VNG continue.
I have agreed with the provinces to discuss the progress and results of those actions with each other in the periodic consultations.
Ik heb afgesproken met provincies om de voortgang en resultaten van die acties in de periodieke overleggen met elkaar te bespreken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Boswijk en Palland over Nederlandse (midden en klein-)bedrijven meer laten profiteren van grote overheidsaanbestedingen zoals de renovatie van de Afsluitdijk

CDA MPs asked whether Rijkswaterstaat ensured that the Afsluitdijk renovation contract, awarded to Levvel, would use innovative Dutch small and medium enterprises and avoid leakage of money abroad (e.g. Chinese valve products). The minister answered that the contract was tendered as a whole for integrality, that EU procurement law prevents mandating product origin, and that a large share of investment benefits the Dutch economy, though exact figures are withheld for competition reasons.
I cannot make precise figures public for reasons of competition.
Precieze cijfers kan ik uit concurrentieoverwegingen niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhouach en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'TT te vroeg voor financiële compensatie, Mulder stelt Kamervragen'

Two CDA MPs asked whether the TT Assen motorcycle race and other events planned before 1 July 2021 can be compensated under the temporary COVID-19 event subsidy scheme, given that the Drenthe safety region bars large events until 1 June. The minister answered that events can be moved to a date between 1 July and 31 December or receive support if they meet the scheme's conditions, and that the scheme was developed in consultation with the sector and safety regions.
Events planned before 1 July can be moved to a date between 1 July and 31 December, provided it fits the local agenda and a permit is granted.
Evenementen die voor 1 juli staan gepland kunnen worden verplaatst naar een datum binnen de periode 1 juli–31 december, mits dat in de lokale agenda past en er een vergunning verleend wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Aartsen over de steunmaatregelen voor de bruine vloot

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why a EUR 15 million support scheme for the historic 'bruine vloot' sailing charter fleet had not yet been opened, and when entrepreneurs would receive funds. The State Secretary answered that a supplementary scheme is still being developed, requires EU state-aid approval, and is expected to open by end of Q2 2021, while existing COVID support measures are also available to these entrepreneurs.
I am in discussion with the European Commission on whether this scheme fits within the state-aid frameworks for culture and preservation of heritage.
Ik ben met de Europese Commissie in gesprek of deze regeling past binnen de steunkaders voor cultuur en instandhouding van het erfgoed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Aartsen over de steunmaatregelen voor de bruine vloot

MPs Aukje de Vries and Aartsen asked the State Secretary about delays in the support scheme for the historic 'bruine vloot' sailing ships, mooring fees, and whether existing aid is sufficient. The State Secretary answered that a targeted scheme is being developed subject to European Commission approval, that existing TVL/TOGS aid already reaches many operators, and that some questions are deferred or fall to municipalities.

After a positive opinion from the Commission, the scheme can be further elaborated and published, and the House will be informed, after which the scheme, as announced in my letter of 17 February, can open at the end of the second quarter.

Na een positief advies van de commissie kan de regeling nader worden uitgewerkt, gepubliceerd en zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd, waarna de regeling, zoals aangekondigd in mijn brief van 17 februari jl., eind tweede kwartaal kan worden opengesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong, Tjeerd de Groot en Wuite over de steunmaatregelen voor de bruine vloot

D66 MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about delayed and narrowly defined support for the historic sailing 'bruine vloot' affected by the COVID-19 crisis, including why advance payments are not possible and why ideal-purpose and other heritage vessels are excluded. The state secretary answered that existing TOGS/TVL schemes fit these entrepreneurs, that advances are legally barred, that the dedicated scheme targets commercial sailing ships aged 50+ under specific SBI codes, and that opening is still expected by end of the second quarter 2021 pending European Commission approval.
It is not possible to pay advances before a scheme is published because under the General Administrative Law Act subsidies may only be granted on the basis of a statutory provision.

Het is niet mogelijk voorschotten uit te betalen voorafgaand aan publicatie van een regeling omdat volgens de Algemene wet bestuursrecht subsidies alleen op grond van een wettelijk voorschrift mogen worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het uitblijven van branchespecifieke coronasteun voor de bruine vloot

An MP asked the government about the lack of sector-specific corona support for the traditional sailing ship (bruine vloot) sector, including delays in a promised 15 million euro scheme and wrongly assigned SBI codes forcing repeated objections. The state secretary answered that existing TVL/TOGS support fits these businesses, that the new scheme aims to open in June, and that RVO.nl is speeding up objection handling.
By May at the latest, the Ministers of Finance, Economic Affairs and Climate, and Social Affairs and Employment will come with a proposal on what the support will look like in the third quarter.
Uiterlijk in mei komen de Ministers van Financiën, Economische Zaken en Klimaat en Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid met een voorstel hoe de steun eruit zal zien in het derde kwartaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de voorgenomen verkoop van het gemeentelijk recreatieoord Hoek van Holland

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked the Minister of Interior about the planned sale or long lease of Rotterdam's municipal recreation park at Hoek van Holland, tenant rights, consultation, and whether the municipality should keep it in public hands. The Minister answered that the decision is the municipality's competence, that existing tenancy contracts transfer to a new landlord, and that the Rijk has no role or intention to intervene.
As Minister of BZK I have no role or competence in this matter.
Als Minister van BZK heb ik in deze kwestie geen rol of bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over hoe baggeraars zich verweren tegen Chinese concurrentie

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked the Ministers of Foreign Trade and Economic Affairs about unequal competition from Chinese dredging firms in EU tenders and the lack of reciprocal market access. The government acknowledged the problem and pointed to existing tools and EU instruments under development (IPI, foreign subsidies white paper) without committing to new sector-specific measures.
The cabinet is increasingly concerned about an unequal playing field between European and Chinese companies.
Het kabinet maakt zich in toenemende mate zorgen over een ongelijk speelveld tussen Europese en Chinese bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht dat de startersregeling Tegemoetkoming Vaste Lasten (TVL) pas medio mei open zal gaan

MP Aartsen asked why the TVL starter scheme for businesses registered between October 2019 and June 2020 will not open until mid-May, why Q4 2020 is not compensated, and what prospects exist for affected entrepreneurs. The state secretary explains that the scheme's design, EU pre-notification and system-building take time, that Q4 is not compensated to avoid double subsidy, and points to other measures and a forthcoming economic recovery letter.
I do not consider compensating the fourth quarter of 2020, whereby these companies would again receive double subsidy, defensible compared with other companies that can use only one of the schemes.

Ik vind het vergoeden van het vierde kwartaal van 2020, waarbij nog een keer al deze ondernemingen dubbele subsidie zouden ontvangen, niet verdedigbaar ten opzichte van andere ondernemingen, die slechts van één van de regelingen gebruik kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Bromet, Kröger en Buitenweg over misstanden in de transportsector

MPs asked whether TLN and PostNL tried to influence a study into criminal abuse and labour exploitation in the transport sector, and what the government will do with its findings. The minister answered that TLN commissioned the study, that the ministry only co-sat on the steering group and held a subsidy, that the methodology was judged sound, and that a cabinet response will follow in spring.
I will study the outcomes and discuss them with TLN and the Minister of SZW, among others.
Ik ga de uitkomsten bestuderen en onder meer met TLN en de Minister van SZW bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Buitenweg over het bericht dat Huawei in technologie investeert voor de etnische profilering van Oeigoeren

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether Huawei and other Chinese tech firms are developing facial recognition to identify Uyghurs, and what Dutch and EU responses, export controls and standards safeguards could address this. The government answered that it cannot confirm Huawei's denial, raised the issue with the company, noted that Dutch export controls do not cover ethnic-identification technology, and said it will consider EU human rights sanctions and due diligence obligations.
The cabinet cannot confirm this explanation from Huawei on the basis of its own information.
Het kabinet kan deze uitleg van Huawei op basis van eigen informatie niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de uitrol van 5G

An MP asked the government about the health effects of 5G radiation and whether more independent research should precede rollout, citing a Journal of Epidemiology article calling for the precautionary principle. The government replied that ICNIRP limits, endorsed by the Gezondheidsraad and confirmed by a court, adequately protect health, and that it will pursue further research such as the COSMOS project.
The cabinet will, as advised by the Health Council, pursue more research.
Het kabinet zal zoals geadviseerd door de Gezondheidsraad inzetten op meer onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Leijten over fraude met tegemoetkoming vaste lasten-subsidie

SP MPs asked the government about suspected fraud with the TVL fixed-cost subsidy, including suspicious bank transactions, the number of FIOD-handled reports, weak controls and the use of dormant company registrations. The State Secretary answered that the government is in close contact with FIU-Nederland, the FIOD and banks, has tightened risk controls and checks against tax data, and will revoke subsidies, file reports and seize accounts where fraud is confirmed, while withholding some figures pending ongoing investigations.
The investigation into the reports is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de meldingen loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over het ondersteunen van start-ups en innovatieve scale-ups met een diversiteitsoogmerk

MPs Bergkamp and Van Weyenberg asked what the government has done to promote gender diversity among government-backed start-up and scale-up investment, including at Invest-NL and the Dutch Future Fund, and whether lack of experience unfairly excludes new groups. The Secretary of State replied that female representation on EZK advisory committees rose to 41.9%, that several diversity initiatives are underway, that Invest-NL and the EIF do not treat lack of experience as a decisive rejection criterion, and that diversity is monitored but not a formal DFF selection criterion.
Invest-NL has so far rejected 58 applications that met the intake criteria for financing.
Invest-NL heeft tot heden 58 aanvragen die voldeden aan de intake criteria, afgewezen voor financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Palland over het bericht 'Gaat de Nederlandse industrie aan boord van Nederlandse onderzeeboten?'

MPs Van Helvert and Palland (CDA) asked about concerns that Dutch industry may not be included in the new submarines given the three-yard competition, the cost burden on SMEs, and knock-out criteria for industrial participation. The government replied that essential security interests and strategic autonomy will be secured through primary and secondary requirements in the procurement, that a parallel industrial cooperation agreement led by EZK will pursue broader Dutch involvement, and that no fixed participation percentage is imposed in advance.
Defence will, after testing in the dialogue, set requirements in the D-phase to safeguard essential national security interests and strategic autonomy.
Defensie zal daarbij, na toetsing in de dialoog, in de D-fase eisen stellen ter borging van het wezenlijk nationaal veiligheidsbelang en de strategische autonomie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over berichten die bij de SP-fractie zijn binnengekomen over compensatie voor vergunninghouders radiofrequenties

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about compensating radio frequency licence holders for COVID-19 losses, including extending FM licences and treatment of low-power medium wave and local DAB licensees. The government answered that FM licences will be temporarily extended with pricing studied by SEO, that LM and DAB licensees are not separately compensated but can use general support measures, and that Agentschap Telecom fee exemptions are not appropriate.
As indicated above, I have heeded the wish of the sector and your House and the motion by Van den Berg et al. is being implemented.
Zoals hierboven reeds aangegeven heb ik aan de wens van de sector en uw Kamer gehoor gegeven en wordt er uitvoering gegeven aan de motie Van den Berg c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Domper voor winkeliers: PostNL verlaagt vergoedingen'

CDA MPs asked the Minister whether PostNL may cut the compensated hours for shopkeepers hosting parcel service points from eight to six, given that the parcel boom boosts PostNL's turnover, and whether this was decided without consulting retailers. The Minister answered that the carriers voluntarily offered temporary extra compensation, that PostNL may freely end it, and that she sees no reason to intervene in company policy or the civil-law relationship with shopkeepers.
I do not consider it desirable to interfere in PostNL's business operations or in the civil-law relationship between the parcel carrier and the shopkeeper who manages a postal and parcel point.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk om mij te mengen in de bedrijfsvoering van PostNL of in de civielrechtelijke relatie tussen de pakketvervoerder en de winkelier die een post- en pakketpunt beheert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Palland over de telefonische bereikbaarheid in Overijssel

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile phone coverage in Overijssel, especially around Vilsteren and Hoge Hexel, and the status of a planned KPN mast. The State Secretary agreed coverage should be optimal everywhere, said KPN plans to realise the Hoge Hexel site by the end of the second quarter of 2021, and said coverage in Vilsteren is not optimal but plans there are less concrete, pointing the municipality of Ommen to existing guidance.
Improving coverage has the attention of mobile operators.
Het verbeteren van de dekking heeft de aandacht van mobiele operators.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de passage in Kamerstuk 35420, nr. 235 waarin staat dat ondernemers tot eind maart moeten wachten tot zij TVL kunnen aanvragen vanwege het feit dat de Europese Commissie dan pa

An MP asked why TVL support for small businesses and non-SME firms was delayed until the European Commission approved the scheme, and whether advances could be paid meanwhile. The minister explained the Commission's approval timeline, that advance payments are not permitted under the General Administrative Law Act and EU Treaty rules, and that the scheme opened on 15 February.
It is not possible to pay advances because under the General Administrative Law Act subsidies may only be granted on the basis of a statutory provision.
Het is niet mogelijk voorschotten uit te betalen omdat volgens de Algemene wet bestuursrecht subsidies alleen op grond van een wettelijk voorschrift mogen worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Aartsen en Van der Linde over de problemen die vuurwerk-ondernemers ondervinden bij het verkrijgen van voorfinanciering bij banken

MPs asked whether fireworks entrepreneurs face refusals of pre-financing by banks, whether state guarantees could help, and when compensation for storage and transport costs will be paid. The government answered that existing guarantee schemes are available, that only one concrete case of bank refusal is known, and that the fireworks subsidy (TSVC-19) will open for applications from 31 March to 3 May 2021 with payments after the window closes.
I am aware of one concrete case where this was directly related to (im)possibilities for pre-financing in relation to the design of the compensation scheme.
Ik ben bekend met één concrete casus waarbij dit direct samenhing met (on)mogelijkheden voor voorfinanciering in relatie tot de vormgeving van de compensatieregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over de steunmaatregelen voor schoonheidsspecialisten

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government will give extra COVID support to beauty specialists, many of whom face bankruptcy, and whether the partner test in the Tozo excludes self-employed beauticians from aid, and asked to meet their trade body Anbos. The government replied that the sector benefits from the TVL and NOW expansions, that self-employed beauticians may apply for Tozo, that the new TONK may help those excluded by the partner test, and that it is willing to talk with Anbos.
I am of course willing to talk with Anbos about the support and recovery package and the specific situation of beauty specialists within it.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid om met de Anbos in gesprek te gaan over het steun- en herstelpakket en de specifieke situatie van de schoonheidsspecialisten daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over ondernemers in Groningen en Fryslân die knel komen te zitten

MPs Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk and Moorlag asked whether start-up businesses hit by COVID-19 measures, such as hairdressers and hospitality firms without a reference turnover, are adequately compensated and whether the schemes could be changed. The State Secretary replied that a new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme will cover start-ups' fixed costs, that monthly turnover calculations are not feasible, and that fully closed sectors get up to 85% fixed-cost subsidy.
With the new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme, the cabinet wants to give these entrepreneurs a reasonable subsidy for their fixed costs.
Met de nieuwe regeling Tegemoetkoming Starters wil het kabinet deze ondernemers een redelijke subsidie bieden voor hun vaste lasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Aartsen over het bericht 'gemeente als huurbaas geen pretje'

MPs Koerhuis and Aartsen (VVD) asked whether it is true that businesses cannot negotiate lower rent with the municipality of Amsterdam, whether other large municipalities have similar policies, and whether municipalities should be urged to give tenants tailored relief during COVID. The state secretary replied that Amsterdam offers rent deferral, interest-free repayment and cancellation for bankrupt tenants, and announced a 10 million euro fund for rent discounts, but gave no overview of other municipalities and said municipalities must decide their own role.
No overview is available of the rent discount policy for businesses during the coronavirus period of all municipalities with more than 100,000 inhabitants.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van het beleid inzake huurkorting voor ondernemers in coronatijd van alle gemeenten met meer dan 100.000 inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Tielen en Nijkerken-De Haan over problemen die ondernemers ervaren bij het lopende steun- en herstelpakket

Three VVD MPs asked the government about business complaints over implementation problems in the COVID support packages (TVL, NOW, starters, TONK), including quarterly calculation, excluded starters, events and retail schemes, and capacity. The State Secretary answered that the government is aware of gaps, lists sector consultations and adjustments made, explains why monthly calculation and full starter support were not feasible, and promises further information and wider publicity on the TONK.
At present the cabinet has no insight into the size of this group or exactly which businesses fall under it.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen zicht op de grootte van deze groep en welke bedrijven hier precies onder vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net'

MPs asked why answers to earlier questions on the brown fleet (historic sailing charter vessels) aid of 15 million euro were delayed and when entrepreneurs would receive funds. The government answered that aid through the existing TVL scheme is being expanded, a separate subsidy scheme is being prepared, and a timeline will follow later, without a firm date.
I will inform the House about this.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht "Bruine vloot op de waakvlam – verdeling van 15 miljoen euro ingewikkeld en tijdrovend"

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers why the EUR 15 million support scheme for the historic 'bruine vloot' sailing charter fleet is complex and slow, and when shipowners will get clarity. The government answered that generic COVID support has been extended and that a separate subsidy for unique maintenance and operating costs of historic ships is being developed, with timing to be set with RVO.nl.
I will inform your House about this.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de evaluatie van de Gids proportionaliteit

An MP asks the state secretary about the external evaluation of the Gids Proportionaliteit amendment procedure, its scope, the stakeholders involved, and the role of the ministry as lead drafter compared with the period before 2017. The state secretary confirms the evaluation by KWINK groep covers the whole amendment procedure, will share findings and any policy plans with parliament, sends the commissioning brief, but declines to reconsider the advisory committee's statutory status for now.
The outcomes of this research will be shared with your House together with my possible policy intentions.
De uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zullen tezamen met mijn eventuele beleidsvoornemens met uw Kamer gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Harbers over het bericht dat bewoners in Transvaal al dagen in de kou zitten

MPs Koerhuis and Harbers asked about residents of Transvaal in The Hague left without heating for days, a shortfall on the Energiek 2 district heating network owned by housing corporation Staedion, and whether corporations may run heat networks and why they are exempt from the Warmtewet licensing requirement. The minister answered that outages affected about 50 then about 20 homes, that tenants' protection lies with tenancy law and courts or the Huurcommissie, that ACM may enforce for non-tenants, and that no revision of the exemption is planned.
For tenants, disputes can be brought before the court or the Huurcommissie.
Bij geschillen ligt voor huurders de weg naar de rechter of Huurcommissie open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over administratieve lastendruk exporterend mkb

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers how administrative burden on exporting SMEs has grown since the COVID crisis, including translation and customs paperwork, support channels, monitoring, fraud labelling, and EU and bilateral action. The government answered that it does not systematically track whether burden rises, points to existing helplines, life-events tools and the Exportwijzer, and says the EU is working on trade barriers and better regulation.
In general, the cabinet does not keep track of whether administrative burden rises or falls.
In het algemeen wordt door het kabinet niet bijgehouden of de administratieve lastendruk stijgt of daalt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de uitspraak van het College van Beroep voor Bedrijfsleven (CBB) die ondernemers die bezwaar hebben gemaakt tegen de afwijzing van coronasteun in het gelijk heeft gesteld

An MP asked the State Secretary about CBB rulings that entrepreneurs must be assessed on all SBI codes, not just the first, when denied TVL corona support, and about how many objections and cases are pending. The government confirmed RVO will re-assess the three cases and some objections, promised to inform affected entrepreneurs, but gave no firm timeline and said the CBB controls its own ruling schedule.
All entrepreneurs who have objected on this point will be informed of this.
Alle ondernemers die op dit punt bezwaar hebben gemaakt zullen hier over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over Maastricht Aachen Airport

An MP asks the government about Maastricht Aachen Airport growth, noise in Limburg quiet areas, and conflicting studies on tourism impacts, and asks whether the growth doctrine influenced commissioned research. The minister answers that the province of Limburg is responsible for quiet areas and for MAA's future, that the independent advice is pending, and that he does not take positions on the Breda and Ecorys studies, while also replying on the air-freight levy report and rejecting a growth doctrine.

Since I am not the commissioning party for either study and there is no formal application for an airport decision yet that I must consider, I do not think it is appropriate to make statements about either study.

Aangezien ik geen opdrachtgever ben van beide onderzoeken en er nog geen formele aanvraag voor een luchthavenbesluit ligt waarover ik mij moet buigen acht ik het niet opportuun om uitspraken te doen over beide onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de bezorging van braillepost

An SP MP asked whether braille post was seriously delayed, whether it should get priority over other mail like funeral cards, and whether PostNL must meet the 24-hour delivery norm for it. The state secretary said no formal complaints were lodged, delays of 4-5 days were seen in December's peak, and braille post falls under the universal postal service norm (95% within 24 hours, averaged annually) supervised by the ACM, which is not changing.
However, these parties do not keep track of how many cases this involves.
Er wordt door deze partijen echter niet bijgehouden om hoeveel gevallen het daarbij gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net'

Three VVD MPs asked why their earlier questions on the EUR 15 million aid scheme for the charter 'brown fleet' shipping operators remain unanswered, why the scheme is delayed, and when operators will receive funds. The item is a notice that the questions were answered during the 26 January 2021 model question hour, with the answers not reproduced in this text.

The written questions from MPs Aukje de Vries, Aartsen and El Yassini (all VVD) on the report 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net' were answered during the model question hour of 26 January 2021.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini (allen VVD) over het bericht «Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net' zijn beantwoord tijdens het modelinge vragenuur van 26 januari 2021
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht 'Bruine vloot op de waakvlam - verdeling van 15 miljoen euro ingewikkeld en tijdrovend'

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers about a news report that distributing the 15 million euro support scheme for the brown fleet (historic Dutch cargo vessels) is complicated and time-consuming, asking why, how it will be resolved, timing before 1 December, bank cooperation, the effect of the earlier inspection postponement, future options such as field labs, and whether money reaches entrepreneurs rather than administration. The answer, from the State Secretary, is a short referral noting the questions were answered in the 26 January 2021 model question hour and cited in a newspaper report, without substantive answers in this document.

Further answer: the written questions from MPs Aukje de Vries, Aartsen and El Yassini on the report on the brown fleet and the 15 million euro distribution were answered during the model question hour of 26 January 2021.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijk vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini (allen VVD) over het bericht «Bruine vloot op de waakvlam – verdeling van 15 miljoen euro ingewikkeld en tijdrovend» zijn beantwoord tijdens het modelinge vragenuur van 26 januari 2021
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Amsterdam op achterstand in opmars kunstmatige intelligentie'

MPs Van der Molen and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the ministers of Education and Economic Affairs about reports that Amsterdam lags in AI, the number of AI graduates, the need to retrain 800,000 workers, and progress on the AI action plan. The government answered that AI training is broad and hard to count, that Dutch AI leadership remains strong, and that it will keep informing parliament through the digitalisation strategy progress reports.
It is difficult to give a complete figure for the number of people being trained in artificial intelligence.
Het is lastig om een compleet cijfermatig beeld te geven van het aantal mensen dat wordt opgeleid op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Rabobank sluit helft filialen om winst op peil te houden'

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the decline in bank branches, including Rabobank's closures, is desirable and what the role of the state and DNB is in keeping banking accessible to vulnerable groups. The minister answered that digital banking explains most closures, that banks are primarily responsible with DNB chairing the MOB to monitor accessibility, and promised a mid-2021 interim evaluation and a DNB study on cash infrastructure.
I do not have information on how many full-time equivalents are involved in this.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over hoeveel fte hiermee gemoeid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van den Berg, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over het bericht 'Misstanden bij koeriers zijn eerder regel dan uitzondering'

MPs asked the Social Affairs minister about reports of widespread abuses at parcel and courier firms, including WW recipients working as couriers, workers without valid residence papers and sham constructions, and how these can persist. The minister acknowledged the serious findings from Inspectie SZW, described its sector programme and enforcement, and said the Inspectorate will confront major clients and evaluate in 2022 whether further measures are needed.
I attach great importance to fair, healthy and safe work for all employees.
Ik hecht groot belang aan eerlijk, gezond en veilig werk voor alle werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Aartsen over 'Spanje wil tweede instorting toerisme voorkomen'

MPs Dijkstra, Koopmans and Aartsen (VVD) asked whether safe travel corridors and rapid testing could revive tourism, following reports on Spain's Semana Santa operation, and how the EU and other parties could set criteria. The minister said the current COVID situation rules out reopening tourism now, promised to make necessary travel safer via negative test certificates and a possible shorter quarantine, and said a possible Schiphol–Atlanta corridor is being explored.
Therefore, at this moment there is no question of restarting tourism.
Daarom is op dit moment geen sprake van het weer op gang helpen van toerisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Brits Parlement overtuigd van samenwerking tussen Huawei en China'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Justice about a British parliamentary report on Huawei, China-state ties, subsidies and 5G security. The government said it makes its own assessment of 5G security, outlined existing telecom security measures and EU-level action, and acknowledged close state involvement in Chinese firms without commenting on the report's conclusions.
I closely follow developments in policy on the security and integrity of 5G networks in other countries, including the United Kingdom.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen in het beleid ten aanzien van de veiligheid en integriteit van 5G-netwerken in andere landen, waaronder het Verenigd Koninkrijk, op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over het bericht Providers gaan bedrijven waarschuwen voor beveiligingslekken'

MPs Yesilgoz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked whether the NBIP, designated as an OKTT, can receive threat information from the NCSC and why the Digital Trust Center cannot yet do so for non-vital businesses. The government answers that NCSC can already share threat information with NBIP within legal limits, that a DTC designation is being prepared with a target start early next year, and that a WODC study on the landelijk dekkend stelsel has been commissioned.
The Ministry of EZK is working on the preparatory work for this. The aim is for this new service to start early next year.
Het Ministerie van EZK is bezig met de voorbereidende werkzaamheden hiervoor. Het streven is dat deze nieuwe dienstverlening begin volgend jaar kan starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bieden van perspectief aan ondernemers na de gedeeltelijke lockdown en het onderzoek naar aanleiding van het OMT-advies over restaurants

An MP from the VVD asked the government how it would respond to the OMT advice on restaurants and the promised talks with hospitality and events sectors about prospects after the partial lockdown, including progress on FieldLab initiatives. The government answered that talks with sector representatives are ongoing, that segmented measures are being discussed, that FieldLab programmes for events are being developed with a possible start in January, and that the RIVM advice on the events FieldLab is pending.
The cabinet would like sectors to come forward with new initiatives if these can offer new prospects.
Het kabinet ziet graag dat sectoren zich melden met nieuwe initiatieven als die nieuwe perspectieven kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Van der Berg en Kuik over het bericht 'Termunten is slecht bereik zat: 'We moeten op de dijk staan om te kunnen bellen'’

MPs Van den Berg and Kuik asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile coverage in Termunten and Termunterzijl that reportedly leaves residents, businesses and emergency calls unreachable, and about the broader rollout of fast internet and mobile coverage. The State Secretary answered that no complaints are known to the regulator, that emergency-call success rates are high, that a new mast site is being sought with a provider, and that rollout targets are being monitored with updates promised for early 2021.
I am not aware of that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de berichten over een gebrekkig bereik van mobiele telefonie en internet in Termunten/Termunterzijl

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile and internet coverage in Termunten/Termunterzijl, including risks for emergency calls, and whether providers would be pushed to fix it. The State Secretary answered that emergency-call success is high, that a provider and the municipality are working toward a new site, and that the 700 MHz licence coverage conditions apply, while acknowledging some locations will always lack full coverage.
I therefore see no need to bring parties together at the table (unsolicited).
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak om partijen (ongevraagd) met elkaar aan tafel te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Van den Bosch en Veldman over het toestaan en mogelijk maken van winterterrassen als reddingsboei voor horecaondernemers

VVD MPs asked whether winter terraces with covers and heaters could serve as a lifeline for hospitality businesses, whether municipalities should be encouraged to allow them, and what rules apply to tents and canopies under Covid measures. The government agreed terraces help and that municipalities should weigh allowing them, said it is a local decision, and explained that open-sided terraces count as outdoor locations, though it keeps no overview of municipal decisions.
Such an overview is not kept.
Een dergelijk overzicht wordt niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van den Berg en Moorlag over pakketbezorging in de ‘last mile’

MPs Van den Berg and Moorlag asked the State Secretary about ACM and TNO findings on last-mile parcel delivery, its sustainability, the share of e-commerce in traffic, the expansion of pickup points, and further research. The government answered that the market functions well, that pickup points can reduce CO2 if consumers collect on foot or by bike, that the matter is largely left to market parties and municipalities, and that existing research and pilots are ongoing.
I am willing to initiate this research.
Bent u bereid dit onderzoek te initiëren?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Palland en Slootweg over de berichten 'Mkb'ers maar matig op de hoogte van financieringsmogelijkheden' en 'Kredietverzekeraar: Nederland wacht volgend jaar grote faillissementsgo

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about SMEs' limited awareness of financing options and about a predicted bankruptcy wave, including whether insolvency law could intervene earlier and whether a temporary protection for healthy firms should be introduced. The state secretary answered that many support schemes exist, that bankruptcies remain low due to support packages and court delays, that the WHOA restructuring law is the chosen tool, and that a general protection measure is rejected as too broad, while committing to a Kamer report on the annual SME action plan and a bank-data analysis.

I have not made a commitment that, in addition to the existing CBS monitoring commissioned by EZK, periodic reporting will be provided on the use of the guarantee schemes in general and specifically on rejections.

Ik heb geen toezegging gedaan dat er aanvullend op de bestaande monitoring door het CBS in opdracht van EZK (periodiek) gerapporteerd wordt over het gebruik van de garantieregelingen in het algemeen en specifiek over afwijzingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van der Linde over een tweede betaalpauze door banken

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether banks' refusal of a second generic payment holiday during the second lockdown, and the shift to case-by-case support, endangers viable firms, and how DNB's financial stability warnings and the Tax Authority's payment arrangements are handled. The minister answered that banks now assess clients individually, that the financial sector is resilient, and that the government is extending support schemes and debt-relief measures for entrepreneurs.

The cabinet will make efforts in the coming period to develop joint guidelines with large creditors, including banks, for a more flexible treatment of restructuring requests from entrepreneurs affected by the corona crisis.

Het kabinet spant zich de komende periode in om met grote schuldeisers, waaronder de banken, gezamenlijke richtlijnen te ontwikkelen voor een soepelere behandeling van saneringsverzoeken van ondernemers die door de coronacrisis zijn geraakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Weverling over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse universiteiten werken samen met omstreden techgigant Huawei’

MPs Wiersma and Weverling asked the ministers why Amsterdam universities are collaborating with Huawei on AI-related research despite security risks, and whether the government had warned the UvA about risks. The government answered that universities are autonomous and responsible for their own risk assessments, that the ministries gave advice on risks without formal approval, and that it is studying additional knowledge-security measures to report on this autumn.
Entering into a collaboration is therefore the responsibility of the institution itself.
Het aangaan van een samenwerking is dan ook de verantwoordelijkheid van een instelling zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Amsterdamse universiteiten gaan samenwerken met Huawei'

MPs Van der Molen and Van den Berg (CDA) asked ministers about reports that Amsterdam universities would collaborate with Huawei on AI research, including the role of security services, dual-use concerns, and the need for national-security frameworks. The government answered that universities are autonomous and responsible for their own partnership decisions, that AIVD and NCTV advised on risks without formal approval power, and that the government is developing additional knowledge-security measures.
The Dutch intelligence and security services have no role in approving or disapproving such collaborations.
De Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten hebben geen rol in het goed- of afkeuren van dergelijke samenwerkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over DDoS-aanvallen op internetproviders

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate, on behalf of the Minister of Justice and Security, about DDoS attacks on internet providers, their statistics, economic impact, the role of the Digital Trust Center and NCSC in helping SMEs, public-private cooperation, exercises, and user awareness. The answers give 2019 attack figures from NBIP's NaWas, state that economic damage cannot be estimated, describe existing public-private coalitions and advisory roles, and state that providers must take mitigation measures under the Telecommunications Act, with commitments limited to continuing existing exercises and sharing lessons learned.
An estimate of the economic damage caused by an internet disruption from a DDoS attack cannot be made because it depends on a large number of factors
Een inschatting van de economische schade als gevolg van een verstoring van het internet als gevolg van een DDoS-aanval is niet te maken omdat het afhangt van een groot aantal factoren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Westerveld over het sluiten van de NESO-kantoren

MPs Westerveld and Van den Hul asked why the Netherlands Education Support Offices (NESO) are being closed, whether an evaluation was done, what funds are freed, how many students use the offices, and how the closures and staff were handled. The minister answers that the offices are Nuffic branches without diplomatic status, that the decision reflects changed policy and financial governance rather than dissatisfaction, that student information services continue, and that freed funds are redirected to knowledge diplomacy, with a new strategy to be presented later.
It is therefore difficult to deploy the NESO offices for the more strategic purposes, which the changing geopolitical relations and heightened attention to knowledge security call for.
Het is daarom lastig om de NESO-kantoren voor de meer strategische doeleinden in te zetten, waar de veranderende geopolitieke verhoudingen en de verscherpte aandacht voor kennisveiligheid om vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht 'Start-ups vroegen massaal om steun, de overheid zei ook massaal 'nee''

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that most start-up applications for the Corona bridging loan (COL) were rejected, the reasons given, and whether the assessment process by the regional development companies (ROMs) would be reviewed. The State Secretary answered all eight questions, defending the ROM assessment criteria and procedure, saying the COL scheme has now ended, and committing only to discuss possible improvements with the ROMs.
I am willing to discuss the implementation of the COL with the ROMs, to put forward the reservations you raise about the ROMs, and to look together with the ROMs for possible improvements.

Ik ben bereid om met de ROM's in gesprek te gaan over de uitvoering van de COL en de kanttekeningen die u maakt bij de ROM's neer te leggen en samen met de ROM's te kijken naar mogelijke verbeteringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Von Martels over (vakantie)verhuurplatforms en toeristenbelasting

MPs Palland and Von Martels asked how Dutch tourist tax collection through holiday rental platforms differs from other European countries, why France can have platforms collect it while the Netherlands does not, and whether an agreement with platforms is feasible. The minister answered that no comparative overview exists, that platform collection is not necessary in the Netherlands given the registration obligation in the new short-stay rental law, and that no signal shows parties now consider a platform agreement feasible.
An overview of the manner of any local tourist tax levy in other European countries is not available, so no comparison with the Netherlands can be made.
Een overzicht van de (wijze van de) eventuele heffing van (lokale) toeristenbelasting in andere Europese landen is niet beschikbaar, dus er kan geen vergelijking met Nederland worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over het bericht 'Na corona komt het foute geld'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers how the government protects businesses weakened by COVID-19 against criminal 'foute helpers' and dirty money, and what has been done after a RIEC survey found about 10 percent of entrepreneurs had been approached by an unknown investor. Minister Grapperhaus replied that awareness campaigns, public-private platforms and the Actieprogramma Veilig Ondernemen are under way, that EU-level work is being pursued, and that the topic will be raised at the December JBZ Council, but the answer was late and gives no concrete new legislative or oversight measures.
I acknowledge that as a result of the coronavirus pandemic, the risks of abuse by criminals towards businesses are increasing.
Ik onderken dat als gevolg van de coronapandemie risico’s van misbruik door criminelen richting het bedrijfsleven toenemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Hack bij Apollo Vredestein toont zwakke cyberbeveiliging Nederlandse bedrijven' en het bericht 'Overheid wist wie kwetsbaar was, maar liet bedrij

Two MPs (Van den Berg and Amhaouch, CDA) asked the ministers about reports of a hack at Apollo Vredestein and claims that government knew which firms were vulnerable but did not warn them, raising questions on SME cyber-security, incident reporting duties and NCSC mandate limits. The government answered that cyber-security is a priority, that voluntary measures and the Digital Trust Center cover non-vital firms, and that the NCSC could not lawfully share certain threat data at the time, with a planned DTC expansion and a review of government powers in digital crises.

In addition, the NCSC has a statutory task, insofar as necessary to prevent adverse societal consequences, to pass on information about threats and incidents concerning network and information systems of other organisations, including personal data obtained from analyses for its primary task.

Daarnaast heeft het NCSC, voor zover noodzakelijk ter voorkoming van nadelige maatschappelijke gevolgen, krachtens de wet als taak om informatie over dreigingen en incidenten met betrekking tot netwerk- en informatiesystemen van andere organisaties (waaronder ook persoonsgegevens), die is verkregen bij analyses ten behoeve van de primaire taak, door te verstrekken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Van der Molen, Weverling en El Yassini ten behoeve van het VAO Telecommunicatie

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and Climate about the commercial radio advertising market during COVID-19, including revenue shares, job losses, support measures, litigation over frequency licences, the 2003 auction, and DAB+ penetration and FM switch-off timing. The State Secretary answered on substance in most points, citing SEO, ACM and Dialogic studies, and declined to disclose some figures as commercially confidential.
