An exact breakdown between large and smaller commercial stations on the one hand, and between commercial and public broadcasters on the other, is difficult to provide because this concerns commercially confidential information.

Een exacte verdeling tussen grote en kleinere commerciële stations enerzijds en tussen commerciële en publieke omroepen anderzijds is lastig te geven omdat het hier om bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht 'Amazon: wolf in wolfskleren voor start-ups.'

MP Wiersma asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that Amazon uses acquisition talks with start-ups to obtain their information and then launch competing products, and what the Netherlands will do about it. The State Secretary agreed this is undesirable, said she has no insight into Dutch start-ups affected, and pointed to competition enforcement, EU gatekeeper regulation and merger threshold changes as the response.
I have no insight into how many Dutch start-ups Amazon holds a stake in or a seat on the board of.
Ik heb geen zicht op in hoeveel Nederlandse startups Amazon een belang of plek in de directie heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over internationale drugshandel per post

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag ask about the growing international trade in hard drugs by post, foreign complaints about Dutch mail shipments, the scale of detections, enforcement gaps, and whether sender identification or opening powers should be introduced. Minister Grapperhaus answers that data are limited, customs pilots show positive results, public-private cooperation is being mapped, and a planned reform would let investigators open parcels without a rechter-commissaris.

After the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure, investigating officers will be authorised to independently seize postal parcels and then open them and examine the contents, without needing authorisation from the rechter-commissaris.

Na de modernisering van het wetboek van Strafvordering zullen opsporingsambtenaren bevoegd worden om zelfstandig postpakketten in beslag te nemen en om het postpakket vervolgens te openen en kennis te nemen van de inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over dat kermisexploitanten boos zijn over het annuleren van Park Hilaria

CDA MPs asked the minister why municipalities are not granting fair permits after COVID rules allowed small fairs from 1 July 2020, and whether the government will talk with the VNG and fix delayed SBI business-code changes for fairground operators. The state secretary answered that municipalities cite short notice, location safety, financial feasibility and enforcement, that the SBI-code reassessment process for TOGS/TVL has been handled, and that the VNG was already urged to support the sector, without committing to a new meeting.
It falls under the statutory authority of municipalities to grant permits for events, including fairs.
Het valt onder de wettelijke bevoegdheid van de gemeenten om vergunningen voor evenementen, waaronder kermissen, te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van den Bosch over de problemen in de kermisbranche en dat er ondanks de versoepelingen veel kermissen niet doorgaan

Two VVD MPs asked why many fairground events were not going ahead after the July 2020 easing of COVID rules, asking about economic damage, municipal reasoning, safe 'corona-proof' organisation and central support. The government answered that roughly half of fairs could proceed, that permitting is a municipal matter in consultation with safety regions, and that the national government and VNG provide handreikingen and platform support without taking over the decision.
Granting permits for a fair is a local matter, and the evaluation is that initially it is as well.
De vergunningverlening van een kermis is een lokale aangelegenheid en de evaluatie is dat in eerste instantie ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Veldman over de registratieplicht in de horeca en de mogelijkheid om mensen te weigeren die niet mee werken aan de registratieplicht

MPs Aartsen and Veldman asked whether hospitality operators may refuse guests who do not cooperate with the COVID-19 contact-registration obligation, and about how details of that obligation were communicated and whether operators were involved. The state secretary answered that guests cannot be refused for withholding contact data because consent must be voluntary under the GDPR, while refusal is allowed for breaches of safety rules such as the 1.5-metre distance, and that operators were not involved in drafting the obligation but were informed in advance.
It is very important that hospitality operators can ensure the measures to combat infections are properly implemented.
Het is heel belangrijk dat horecaondernemers ervoor kunnen zorgen dat de maatregelen om besmettingen tegen te gaan, goed uitgevoerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, De Groot en Verhoeven over verlengen certificaten voor de bruine vloot

D66 MPs asked the ministers whether the brown fleet of historic sailing ships, facing low revenue and costs from extended safety certificates during COVID-19, deserves more help and further postponement of certificate inspections. The government answered that EUR 15 million has been made available to secure the fleet, that existing schemes also apply, and that inspections need not be postponed further, while leaving room to reconsider extensions case by case.
With the additional EUR 15 million now made available, it is moreover not expected that entrepreneurs will still choose to postpone inspections.
Met de aanvullende € 15 miljoen die nu beschikbaar is gesteld, is het bovendien niet te verwachten dat ondernemers er nog voor zullen kiezen om keuringen uit te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het Manifest 'Toplocaties'

An MP asks the Education and Economic Affairs ministers about the 'Toplocaties' manifesto on campus development, its five recommendations, and the role of innovation ecosystems. The government answers that existing national instruments already support campuses, that it will engage with the manifesto authors, and that no separate physical-infrastructure policy is needed now.
There is currently no reason to form national policy specifically focused on the physical aspect of research and innovation ecosystems.
Er is op dit moment geen reden om op nationaal niveau beleid te vormen dat specifiek is gericht op het fysieke aspect van onderzoeks- en innovatie-ecosystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Gedeputeerde kaart oneerlijke concurrentie busaanbesteding aan in Brussel’

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a report that a Overijssel deputy wants to stop unfair competition from non-EU bus tenderers in regional procurement. The State Secretary answered that the government favours reciprocity and a level playing field via the International Procurement Instrument and a forthcoming EU white paper on foreign subsidies, but that national and regional procurement rules cannot discriminate on origin, so the room for steering toward local firms is limited.
I therefore see only limited possibilities to steer toward awarding contracts to local and regional companies.
Ik zie daarom slechts beperkte mogelijkheden om te sturen op het gunnen aan lokale en regionale bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht ‘Strandpaviljoens mogen deze winter blijven staan, maar geen omzet draaien’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the decision to let beach pavilions stay up over winter without trading, and whether beach operators fall under her responsibility and what savings and extended opening would mean. The government replied that responsibility is shared across ministries and provinces/municipalities, that staying up is a one-off measure with conditions, and that it cannot give specific figures or commit to extended winter opening, though other aspects are still being worked out.
I cannot give you specific information on how much savings this yields for the beach pavilion operator.
Ik kan u geen specifieke informatie geven hoeveel besparing dit voor de strandpaviljoenhouder oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het voorkomen van bill shocks bij mobiel datagebruik

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about how mobile operators prevent unexpected high data bills, whether notifications are mandatory, and whether legislation is needed beyond the voluntary 2012 Transparency Code. The State Secretary replied that complaints are few, that the three largest operators follow the code and send 80% and 100% usage notifications, and that legislation implementing the EU Telecom Code is planned to make such information mandatory for all providers.
For market-wide compliance, which can be enforced by the ACM where necessary, legislation is the most effective.
Voor marktbrede naleving, die zo nodig kan worden gehandhaafd door de ACM, is wetgeving het meest effectief.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Directeur Astron over zijn radiotelescoop versus de windmolens: ‘Lofar zou van beschermd nationaal belang moeten zijn’’

Three MPs (CDA and VVD) asked whether large national research infrastructure such as LOFAR deserves national protection, what the effects of 5G are on the Westerbork radio telescope, and whether ASTRON's measurements can be preserved. The minister replied that LOFAR is of national importance and is protected by regional permitting, that a 10 km protection zone with licence conditions shields Westerbork from 5G interference, and that talks with ASTRON and licensees will be arranged.
The Agentschap Telecom, based on internationally used and Dutch-specific calculation models, determined a 10-km protection zone around the radio telescopes at Westerbork.

Het Agentschap Telecom heeft op basis van internationaal gehanteerde en op de specifieke Nederlandse situatie toegespitste rekenmodellen een beschermingszone bepaald van 10 kilometer rond de radiotelescopen in Westerbork.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het bericht 'Gommers ziet geen verschil tussen Efteling en kermis: 'Virus niet verspreiden''

CDA MPs asked the health minister whether the NVIC chair's view that fairground visits should be possible under good plans is considered, whether fairground operators' continuity and field labs were addressed, and when clarity would be given. The minister replied that the relaxations announced on 24 June give perspective, that 1.5 metre distancing applies with no maximum headcount including fairs, that the sector will run a field lab and results will be reported to parliament, and that the June relaxations give clarity.
I will inform the House about this.
Ik zal de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Slootweg over de berichten 'Banken zijn 180.000 ondernemers en consumenten tegemoetgekomen’ en ‘Bedrijven bij nieuwe bank krijgen geen krediet’

CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that banks prioritise existing clients over new business customers, which may block new credit to firms during the coronavirus crisis, and about the lack of published rejection figures and the status of a Qredits loan. The government partly recognises the picture, says banks are now also serving new customers, promises to report on rejection data after the summer recess, and says the Qredits transaction should close at the end of July.
I am periodically in consultation with the banks regarding the corona monitoring they publish.
Ik ben periodiek in overleg met de banken ten aanzien van de coronamonitoring die zij uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Banken klagen over hoge kosten Geldmaat’

MPs Van der Linde and Aartsen asked why Geldmaat's ATM fee rates are confidential, whether smaller banks pay the same per-transaction fees, and how this fits competition law. The minister answered that the rates are kept confidential for commercial reasons, that smaller banks should keep open and non-discriminatory access, and that the government and ACM are monitoring the issue, with no firm new measure yet.
These mutually agreed rates were not published because of their commercially confidential nature.
Deze onderling overeengekomen tarieven werden niet gepubliceerd vanwege het bedrijfsvertrouwelijke karakter hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de aanleg van glasvezel in buitengebieden

An MP asks the state secretary whether KPN's partial fibre roll-outs in towns with existing full-network plans, and the market's fairness more broadly, hinder fibre reaching rural areas. The secretary agrees KPN's approach can cause delays, defers to the ACM on competition, rejects glass fibre as the only route to 100 Mbps, and promises an update in autumn 2020.
In autumn 2020 I will inform the House about the progress of these talks, as I committed to the House in the General Consultation of 11 June.
In het najaar van 2020 informeer ik uw Kamer over de voortgang van deze gesprekken, zoals ik uw Kamer in het Algemeen Overleg van 11 juni jl. heb toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Aartsen en Van der Linde over het bericht 'AFM waarschuwt voor schulden bij leasen van een auto of wasmachine’

MPs asked the government about AFM warnings on debt risks from private leasing of cars and appliances, including its size, contract terms, consumer information, BKR registration and whether it should fall under AFM supervision. The minister answered that private lease is unregulated and growing, outlined existing self-regulation and information, and committed to talks with market parties and the AFM on possible measures.
I will ask the AFM and other relevant parties to provide more insight into, among other things, the growth of private lease, the causes of this growth and the risks for consumers.
Ik zal de AFM en andere relevante partijen vragen om meer inzicht te geven in onder andere de groei van private lease, de oorzaken van deze groei en de risico's voor consumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Vervoersbedrijf Keolis nam initiatief tot ‘frauduleuze’ side letters'

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that Keolis proposed side letters with Chinese bus suppliers BYD and Ginaf outside the official tender contracts, and whether the Keolis concession for the IJssel-Vecht region was fairly awarded. The State Secretary said the matter must first be investigated, that the ministry has no side letters, and that if reports prove true the provinces could revoke or retender the concession, while leaving further investigation to the provinces and the prosecution service and promising only to consider lessons learned after current investigations finish.
This matter must first be investigated.
Deze zaak moet nu eerst worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Onderzoeksinstituut Wetsus in Leeuwarden gehackt, hacker betaald in bitcoins”

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about a ransomware attack on research institute Wetsus, whether minimum cybersecurity requirements apply to publicly funded institutes, and how the government will prevent recurrence, including ransom payment and Chinese knowledge theft. The state secretary answered that cybersecurity is primarily the institutes' own responsibility (defence-related research excepted), that the government is talking with TO2 institutes about improving resilience without new mandatory requirements, that the ransom was paid from own funds, and that Wetsus's funding after 2021 is being explored with an expert group.
Ensuring (cyber)security is primarily the responsibility of the research institutes themselves, subject to the relevant laws and regulations.
Het borgen van de (cyber)veiligheid is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van onderzoeksinstituten zelf, uiteraard met inachtneming van de relevante wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Özütok over het bericht van EenVandaag ‘Verbod streekmarkten drijft boeren tot wanhoop: Onbegrijpelijk, omdat weekmarkten wél open mogen'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why regional farmers' markets were banned under COVID-19 emergency rules while weekly markets stayed open, and whether municipalities could re-permit them. The minister explained that markets are excluded from the event ban only when they are ordinary markets, that whether a regional market counts as an event is decided case by case by the safety region chair, and that organising markets remains a municipal matter, while stating sympathy for short supply chains.
Whether a regional market falls within this definition depends on the concrete circumstances and organisation of that market and is for the chair of the safety region to assess.
Of een streekmarkt binnen deze definitie valt, zal afhankelijk zijn van de concrete omstandigheden en inrichting van die markt en is ter beoordeling van de voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aartsen over de berichten ‘VS van plan uit WTO-onderdeel te stappen‘ en ‘Chinese bussen kunnen bij aanbesteding niet worden geweerd‘

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Dutch and provincial authorities can exclude bidders from non-GPA countries such as China from public tenders, and about reports the US may leave the WTO procurement agreement. The government replied that exclusion of non-GPA bidders is legally possible under EU and WTO rules, that the Noord-Holland and Overijssel bus cases involved private purchases rather than tenders, and that it is pursuing an International Procurement Instrument while supporting the GPA.
It is possible for Dutch and other European contracting authorities to reject bids from third countries that are not party to the WTO Government Procurement Agreement.
Het is voor Nederlandse en andere Europese aanbestedende diensten mogelijk om inschrijvingen te weigeren uit derde landen die geen partij zijn bij de Overeenkomst inzake overheidsopdrachten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over vouchers voor geannuleerde vluchten voor Nederlandse klanten

An MP asked the government whether Dutch passengers with cancelled flights are entitled to refunds rather than vouchers, and how this compares with Israel, where refunds were paid, and whether vouchers are safeguarded if airlines go bankrupt. The Minister answered that passengers are entitled to refunds under EU Regulation 261/2004, that the government tolerated vouchers only temporarily, has withdrawn that tolerance, and is pushing for a European voucher guarantee, while stating that vouchers are an acceptable alternative in the crisis and that voucher holders rank as unsecured creditors.
On 14 May I informed the House that I had withdrawn the instruction to the ILT early.
Op 14 mei heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat ik de aanwijzing aan de ILT vroegtijdig heb ingetrokken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het openstellen van de TOZO-regeling voor studentondernemers

An SP MP asks why students who run their own business are excluded from the Tozo support scheme under the Participatiewet exclusion for those eligible for student finance, and whether the scheme will be adjusted to treat them equally. The State Secretary answers that the exclusion is a legal consequence of student finance being an adequate prior provision, that the scheme cannot deviate from the Participatiewet, and that he is not willing to change it, while noting the Minister of Social Affairs is exploring a broader safety net for flexible workers.
I am not willing to do so, because other students could then, on grounds of equal treatment, also become eligible for general assistance.
Ik ben daartoe niet bereid, omdat andere studenten dan, op grond van rechtsgelijkheid, ook voor algemene bijstand in aanmerking zouden kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Paternotte over het in gevaar brengen van Nederlanders door het in brand steken van zendmasten

MPs Verhoeven and Paternotte asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister of Justice and Security about arson attacks on mobile telecom masts linked to 5G conspiracy theories, including the number of incidents, impact on emergency services, protective measures and EU coordination. The government reported 29 registered arson incidents, no prior precedent in the Netherlands, that emergency number 1-1-2 was affected at least once, that the most critical C2000 masts will be secured within about three months, and that the matter was raised at an informal EU Telecom Council.
For security reasons I will not go into the specific protective measures.
Vanuit veiligheidsoogpunt ga ik niet in op de specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over het bericht 'Wéér twee gsm-masten in brand, terrorismebestrijder bezorgd'

MPs Van den Berg and Van Dam asked whether arson on phone masts threatens residents' safety and emergency number 112, and how the government will protect masts and 5G infrastructure. The state secretary answered that residents' safety was not known to be at risk, that 112 remains reachable, that 29 arson incidents are registered and the investigation is ongoing, and that ministries are consulting the sector on possible additional measures.
It is currently too early to go into specific security measures.
Het is op dit moment te vroeg om in te gaan op specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Ronnes en Palland over de website coronaverlies

MPs Van Dam, Ronnes and Palland (CDA) asked the government about the website coronaverlies.nl, which offered claim-recovery services to businesses hit by COVID-19, and whether it was a scam exploiting entrepreneurs. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the site is now offline, that it is not for the cabinet to judge whether such services are legitimate, and that victims can file a police report for the Public Prosecution Service to assess.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether services offered on websites such as coronaverlies.nl are legitimate.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of diensten die worden aangeboden op websites als coronaverlies.nl legitiem zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over het bericht 'Ondernemers in krediet-ellende'

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the ministers about reports that small business credit applications face long waits, heavy paperwork and high costs, and whether banks are committed to fast processing for small loans, whether 100% state guarantees or a role for Qredits would help. The state secretary replied that processing times are improving, points to the new small-loan guarantee scheme and optimisations to existing schemes, argues a 100% German-style guarantee is unsuitable for the Netherlands, and notes the reply came late.
The cabinet has also recently announced a separate guarantee scheme for small entrepreneurs with limited credit needs, where the credit assessment process can largely be carried out automatically.

Het kabinet heeft daarnaast recent een aparte garantieregeling aangekondigd voor kleine ondernemers met een beperkte kredietbehoefte, waarbij het kredietbeoordelingsproces grotendeels automatisch kan worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de werking van economische steunmaatregelen voor sectoren die worden geraakt door kabinetsbeleid rond het COVID-19 virus

Member Futselaar (SP) asked whether small firms and sole traders excluded from the TOGS COVID support scheme by fixed-cost thresholds, SBI codes or the separate-premises requirement, and community halls and training firms, could be helped. State Secretary Keijzer answered that the scheme targets firms with substantial fixed costs, pointed sole traders to the TOZO, extended TOGS to taxis and training firms from 15 April, and widened the premises requirement, while declining new financial support for local sales platforms.
The scheme is primarily aimed at compensating businesses with substantial fixed costs, because this group is relatively the hardest hit.
De regeling is primair gericht op compensatie van ondernemingen met substantiële vaste lasten, omdat deze groep relatief het hardst getroffen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Politie waarschuwt voor vals geld met carnaval, mogelijk via AliExpress gekocht'

MPs Aartsen and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked about police warnings on counterfeit 50-euro notes possibly bought via AliExpress, and what is being done about such platforms and fraud. The minister answers that counterfeit sales are illegal and monitored by customs, police and DNB, that DNB has asked several Dutch parties to stop offering unauthorised reproductions, that a meeting with Alibaba is pending, and that public information already exists so no extra campaign is planned.
I therefore cannot report (monthly) on the offer on an individual platform.
Ik kan daarom niet (maandelijks) rapporteren over het aanbod op een individueel platform.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'VDL Groep verliest busorder aan Chinees bedrijf'

MPs Amhaouch and Palland (CDA) asked how VDL Groep lost a bus order to Chinese BYD Auto, whether the tender was fair, and what the government will do about foreign subsidies and reciprocity in procurement. The Secretary of State answered that the buses were a private purchase by concessionaire Keolis rather than a tender, found no evidence of unfair competition, acknowledged that current powers to investigate foreign subsidies are limited, and pointed to a proposed EU level playing field instrument and reciprocity measures.

At the same time, I must note that the current possibilities for investigating companies that may receive discriminatory financial support, and for taking action against them if this proves to be the case, are limited.

Tegelijkertijd moet ik constateren dat de mogelijkheden op dit moment beperkt zijn om onderzoek te doen naar bedrijven die mogelijk discriminatoire financiële steun ontvangen, en op te treden tegen bedrijven indien dat het geval blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'PostNL verhoogt pakketprijs in kerstpiek'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about PostNL raising parcel prices in the Christmas peak, its link to the postage increase and the Sandd takeover, and whether cross-subsidisation between the universal postal service and parcels is prohibited and supervised. The State Secretary answered that the commercial parcel market is unregulated and the peak surcharge reflects extra costs, that the Sandd link is absent, that the Postal Act's maximum return on the universal service is respected, and that the ACM supervises cost allocation and an external study on strengthening cross-subsidy oversight is underway.
I have since commissioned an external study that also examines whether there is reason to strengthen the oversight of cross-subsidisation.
In dat verband heb ik inmiddels onderzoek extern uitbesteed waarin ook wordt gekeken of er aanleiding bestaat om het toezicht op kruissubsidiëring te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Snellere betaling kan spanning bij infraprojecten nu al verminderen’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that invoice payment in construction takes an average of 62 days, and whether faster payment could ease liquidity problems and bankruptcies in the sector. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat pays 97% of invoices on time, that faster payment depends on the earlier invoicing stage, and that the government intends to cut the statutory payment term for large companies from 60 to 30 days.
With this I will carry out the Wörsdörfer/Amhaouch motion on a 30-day payment term as the statutory norm.
Hiermee zal ik de motie-Wörsdörfer/Amhaouch over een betaaltermijn van 30 dagen als wettelijke norm uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Slootweg over het bericht 'Consumentenbond: Producten van webwinkels buiten de EU vaak onveilig'

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a Consumentenbond report finding many products from non-EU webshops unsafe, and about level-playing-field concerns, platform liability, the Amhaouch motion on EU liability officers, import controls and consumer awareness. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to EU platform pledges, a planned SER advice on platform liability, the market surveillance regulation requiring EU contact points from July 2021, and an awareness campaign, but declined generic import blocks as contrary to WTO rules.
I will discuss the latest state of affairs regarding the Product Safety Pledge with the European Commission.
Ik ga met de Europese Commissie in gesprek over de laatste stand van zaken met betrekking tot de Product Safety Pledge.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over regels voor campings en recreatieparken ten aanzien van de coronamaatregelen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister of Health how the 1.5-metre rule at campsites is enforced, how shared facilities should be handled, and whether people are moving to northern campsites and holiday homes during the COVID-19 crisis. The government answered that enforcement rests mainly on people themselves and operator communication, with municipal enforcement under regional emergency ordinances, that shared sanitary facilities were closed from 31 March, and that the sector has been informed of the rules.
If people do not comply with the rules, municipal enforcement officers can enforce them on the basis of the emergency ordinance each safety region has adopted.
Als mensen zich niet aan de voorschriften houden, kunnen gemeentelijke handhavers handhaven op basis van de noodverordening die elke veiligheidsregio heeft vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Ondernemers durven politie niet in te schakelen en zwijgen over afpersing‘

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked about reports that entrepreneurs do not report extortion to police, including how many reported cases and advice-line contacts exist and what will be done to raise reporting and protection. Minister Grapperhaus answered with registration figures, advice-line statistics, outreach efforts and a promise to inform the Chamber further on a public-private approach.
I am consulting with partners on how reports from entrepreneurs can be handled in an accessible and safe way.
Ik ga met partners in overleg over hoe meldingen van ondernemers op een toegankelijke en veilige manier kunnen worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Hoe de Facebook-CEO zichzelf zou inperken‘

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a report on Facebook's CEO resisting regulation, algorithm audits, tax reform for tech firms, unfair competition from big tech, innovation effects of acquisitions, and tech employment in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered each question, mostly stating existing policy, pointing to ongoing EU and OECD processes, and making a moral appeal to tech firms, without committing to new concrete measures.
For the latest state of affairs I refer you to the State Secretary of Finance.
Voor de laatste stand van zaken verwijs ik u graag naar de Staatssecretaris van Financiën
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Deventer sluit 'monsterdeal' voor bouw XXL-distributiecentrum'

MPs Bruins and Amhaouch asked about the planned XXL distribution centre in Deventer, covering jobs, housing for migrant workers, infrastructure, landscape impact, vacancy risk and the status of a motion on logistics sprawl. The state secretary answered that the buyer is also the user, that 300-350 jobs are expected, and that the national spatial vision will address warehouse sprawl, with the motion response to follow in spring.
The cabinet will return to this in the Spring Letter regarding the further choices in the National Environment and Planning Vision.
Het kabinet komt hier op terug in de Voorjaarsbrief met betrekking tot de nadere keuzes in de Nationale Omgevingsvisie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Franse treinfabrikant Alstom neemt treinentak Bombardier over'

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the planned takeover of Bombardier's rail unit by Alstom, its effect on European rail industry and competition, and European industrial and competition policy. The State Secretary answered that competition authorities must judge the merger case by case, that a strong independent competition regime is preferred over creating European champions, and that the government promotes a level playing field through trade instruments.
It is up to competition authorities to assess case by case whether a takeover leads to a significant restriction of competition.
Het is aan mededingingsautoriteiten om per casus te beoordelen of een overname leidt tot een significante beperking van de mededinging.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht dat banken het mkb leegmelken

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked whether banks may unilaterally raise interest margins on SME loans, including for sector-wide risk, and what has improved since the banking sector's self-regulation. The minister answered that such changes are allowed under contract terms and the 2018 Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering, that information duties are now set, that complaints to Kifid about such changes are absent, and that the code will be evaluated in 2021.
I have no figures on the extent to which banks do this.
Ik heb geen cijfers over in hoeverre banken dat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat banken het mkb leegmelken

SP MP Alkaya asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that banks are squeezing SMEs through interest margin increases, asking about justification, legitimacy, the scope of the Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering and AFM oversight. Minister Hoekstra answered that banks must communicate margin changes under the code, that margins can reflect generic or client-specific risk, and that the code will be evaluated in 2021 with possible tightening if information is inadequate.
I will ask the NVB to pay attention to including interest margins in the evaluation of the Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering in 2021 mentioned above.
Ik zal bij de NVB aandacht vragen voor het meenemen van renteopslagen in de hierboven genoemde evaluatie van de Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Sorry, alle IP-adressen zijn al vergeven’

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the exhaustion of IPv4 addresses, short-term fixes, whether government-held unused IPv4 addresses could be released, and whether a deadline could be imposed for the IPv6 transition. The state secretary answered that no good short-term solution exists, that selling unused government addresses is undesirable, and that the government will rely on stimulation and a commitment to make government websites and email reachable via IPv6 by end 2021 rather than enforce a deadline.
The government therefore has a stimulating role here, not an enforcing one.
De overheid heeft hierin dus een stimulerende rol, geen afdwingende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst heeft geen btw-id voor starters: 'Ik zit weken op zwart zaad'

Two VVD MPs asked why startup sole traders were waiting weeks for VAT identification numbers and what the government would do about backlogs, staffing and the Belastingtelefoon. The State Secretary answered that the two-week target is not being met for some, that backlogs have been cleared, that extra capacity was deployed, and that the new number system was introduced for privacy reasons with a fully new system timing still undetermined.
There is currently no exact date that can be given for when the entirely new system will be built and implemented.
Er is op dit moment nog geen exacte datum aan te geven wanneer het geheel nieuwe systeem gebouwd en geïmplementeerd gaat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de vindbaarheid van artikel 2.82 aanbestedingen op TenderNed

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether reserved public contracts under Article 2.82 of the Aanbestedingswet are hard to find on TenderNed and whether a search filter or notifications should be added. The government says search terms and notifications already work, that a dedicated filter is not useful because private platforms are not visible to TenderNed, and it will promote social procurement via PIANOo and other channels.
A search filter specific to reserved contracts would therefore only show reserved contracts created on TenderNed and would thus miss its purpose.
Een zoekfilter specifiek voor voorbehouden opdrachten zal daarom alleen de voorbehouden opdrachten die op TenderNed worden aangemaakt weergeven en daarom zijn doel missen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Strop webshops: buitenlandse brief mag van PostNL alleen nog papier bevatten'

An MP asks the state secretary for Economic Affairs about PostNL's price increase for international letter-post parcels from 1 January 2020, linked to Universal Postal Union barcode rules, its effects on businesses, comparisons with other countries, China, compensation for stamps, notification and EU free movement. The answers explain the UPU barcode obligation, PostNL's commercial reasons, that Deutsche Post made similar changes, that no distinction is made between business and private users, and that EU free movement is unaffected.
It is up to each national postal operator how these new requirements are implemented.
Het is aan elke nationale postvervoerder op welke wijze deze nieuwe eisen worden doorgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Futselaar  over medewerkers van Sandd die geen baan krijgen bij PostNL

Two SP MPs asked why most of Sandd's 16,000 staff lose their jobs when PostNL takes over, whether PostNL's job offers were adequate, and what is done for franchisee workers and those underpaid below minimum wage. The Secretary of State replies that PostNL made offers to all postal workers, that about 60% of interested postal workers accepted, that the civil courts handle franchisee contract disputes, and that the Inspectorate's fine concerned unverifiable hours.
It is not for me to intervene in individual contracts between Sandd and these franchisees.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in individuele contracten tussen Sandd en deze franchisenemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over de nieuwe Kleine Ondernemersregeling (KOR)

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked the State Secretary for Finance about the low uptake of the new small-business VAT scheme (KOR), the basis for the 200,000 estimate, the lack of VAT on invoices, the EUR 20,000 threshold and the three-year lock-in, and whether the scheme would be adjusted. The State Secretary answered that the scheme is an administrative simplification, that the threshold was chosen for budget neutrality, that uptake will only be assessed in an evaluation in 2021, and that no change is currently planned.

As indicated in the answer to question 6, it can only be determined after the announced evaluation to what extent the number of registered entrepreneurs (positively or negatively) deviates from the expected number and what the possible cause is.

Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 6 kan pas na afloop van de aangekondigde evaluatie vastgesteld worden in hoeverre het aantal aangemelde ondernemers (positief of negatief) afwijkt van het verwachte aantal en wat daar mogelijk de oorzaak van is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Kamer van Koophandel vertrekt uit Drenthe’

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the closure of the Chamber of Commerce office in Emmen, Drenthe, and whether startups can register without visiting a branch. The state secretary answered that closure is part of a planned national reorganisation toward five physical offices and more digital services, and declined to reverse the decision or introduce an alternative registration route soon.
It is not desirable that a different option for starting entrepreneurs to register with the KVK comes available in the short term.
Het is niet wenselijk dat er op korte termijn een andere mogelijkheid voor startende ondernemers komt om zich te kunnen inschrijven bij de KVK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Wiersma en Aartsen over de berichten ‘Alibaba zwemt in het geld na beursgang in Hongkong’ en ‘Tarieven voor pakjes uit China verhogen’

Three VVD MPs asked about Alibaba's Hong Kong listing and higher postal tariffs for China parcels, raising unfair competition, product safety and CE-marking enforcement. The state secretary replied that tariff harmonisation applies from 2020 with a phased self-declared rate system to 2021, that the EU should use its market power and possibly stricter oversight of platforms, and that the government is consulting the SER and the Commission on platform liability.
The cabinet believes the EU should better use its market power to enforce a level playing field in trade with third countries through new and existing instruments.
Het kabinet vindt dat de EU haar marktmacht beter moet inzetten om met nieuwe en bestaande instrumenten een gelijk speelveld in de handel met derde landen af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Middendorp en Aartsen over de eHerkenning en het artikel ‘MKB en VNO-NCW: gedupeerden nieuw aangiftesysteem compenseren’

MPs Lodders, Middendorp and Aartsen (VVD) asked the Finance, Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about internal resistance at the Tax Administration to eHerkenning, its costs, the fate of about 60,000 businesses lacking a suitable login, and whether small firms can keep filing free. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that concerns were addressed, that about 540 organisations cannot obtain eHerkenning, that proactive deadline extensions and an older portal for VAT remain, and that a further letter on support for small firms would follow.
The Tax Administration proactively grants extensions to employer-liable businesses that are legal entities and last filed via the old business portal.

De Belastingdienst verleent proactief uitstel voor ondernemers die aangifteplichtig zijn voor de loonheffingen, rechtspersoon zijn en hun laatst ingediende aangifte hebben gedaan via het oude ondernemersportaal van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over de veiligheid van het 5G netwerk

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about the security of 5G networks, including vendor screening, classification of high-risk network parts, human-rights principles and EU industrial capacity. The minister answered that vendors are assessed on intent and foreign legal obligations to share data, that the list of critical components is classified and cannot be shared, and that EU industrial policy is still under discussion.
The list of critical components has been classified as confidential and I therefore cannot share it with you.
De lijst met kritieke onderdelen is als vertrouwelijk geclassificeerd en kan ik daarom niet met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Weverling over het bericht 'KPN loopt voor de troepen uit en bouwt ondanks politieke strijd alvast Huawei-zendmasten in de Randstad'

MPs Van den Berg and Weverling asked whether KPN is installing Huawei antennas in its 4G and 5G network despite the parliamentary motions on 5G integrity, and whether this counts as an irreversible step. The State Secretary confirmed KPN began modernising its radio network with Huawei equipment, said several Dutch and EU operators use Huawei gear, and stated the critical components list is confidential while a structural approach with providers is being set up.
The list of critical components is confidential.
De lijst met kritieke onderdelen is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Verhoeven over het bericht dat DPG Media uitgeverij Sanoma overneemt

MPs Sneller and Verhoeven asked about DPG Media's takeover of publisher Sanoma and its effects on media plurality and competition. The minister replied that media concentration is not automatically a loss of plurality, that the ACM will assess competition effects in its merger review, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media monitors plurality annually.
Concentration of ownership within the media sector cannot simply be equated with a restriction of plurality.
Concentratie van eigenaarschap binnen de mediasector kan niet zonder meer gelijk gesteld worden aan inperking van pluriformiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: een op de drie vluchten vanaf Schiphol zou ook per trein kunnen’

Two D66 MPs asked about a report suggesting a third of flights from Schiphol could be replaced by train, about the role of tourism in flights, its economic value, and how to make rail more attractive. The minister says the report draws no conclusions, outlines an action plan with rail partners, cites tourism data and welfare estimates, and commits to talks with the travel industry and NS International.
I am aware of the study.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van den Hul over het bericht dat arbeidsmigranten slavenarbeid verrichten op Italiaanse tomatenplantages

MPs Alkaya and Van den Hul asked the government about reports of exploitative, near-slavery labour conditions for migrant workers on Italian tomato farms and whether such products reach Dutch shelves. The ministers answered that exploitation is condemned, that enforcement in Italy is for Italian authorities, that companies bear due diligence responsibility, and that sector parties under the food convenant will investigate and report back.
The steering group agreed that the sector parties that signed the convenant will investigate further the possible involvement of their members
In de stuurgroep is afgesproken dat de branchepartijen die het convenant hebben getekend nader onderzoek doen naar mogelijke betrokkenheid van hun leden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het dreigende verlies bij Postnned Stadskanaal

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about job losses among postal deliverers at franchisees of Sandd after the PostNL takeover, including whether deliverers of franchisees can be kept employed and whether the government will intervene. The State Secretary answered that PostNL offers Sandd deliverers employment and priority in applications, that franchisee staff fall outside the binding social arrangements, and that the government encourages PostNL and franchisees to talk about alternative work.
I am contacting the Association of Sandd Franchisees to see whether they can and will provide further data on the people working at the franchisees.
Ik treed met de Vereniging Franchisenemers Sandd in contact om te bezien of zij nadere gegevens kan en wil verschaffen over de mensen die bij de franchisenemers werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het dreigende verlies van banen bij Sandd

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about hundreds of job losses at Sandd franchisees after Sandd is absorbed into PostNL, and whether the merger conditions and franchisees' legal protection could be changed. The State Secretary answered that the merger licence contains conditions protecting workers, that efficiency gains will likely cost some jobs, that no specific legal protection for franchisees exists, and that PostNL will be urged to talk with franchisees about alternative work.
I therefore do not intend to amend the conditions and restrictions attached to the licence under Article 47.
Ik ben dan ook niet voornemens om de voorschriften en beperkingen die zijn verbonden aan de vergunning op basis van artikel 47 aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitrol van 5G

Van Raan (PvdD) asked the government about approval steps, rollout timelines, antenna numbers, tree removal, health and environmental research, cumulative exposure and EMF norms for 5G. The government answered that spectrum auctions run from 2020, that private operators decide rollout locations, that research has found no proven harm below exposure limits, and that Agentschap Telecom will monitor compliance.
The choices they make in this regard depend on business strategy, which is commercially confidential.
De keuzes die zij hierbij maken zijn afhankelijk van de bedrijfsstrategie, die bedrijfsvertrouwelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het niet meer kosteloos doen van loonaangifte voor ondernemers door de invoering van eHerkenning

Two VVD MPs asked why employers must now use eHerkenning, which costs roughly 40 to 45 euro, to file payroll returns for free-of-charge tax filing, and whether this conflicts with the goal of reducing administrative burden. The minister replied that the government chose mandatory eHerkenning for sensitive payroll data under the Wet digitale overheid, that costs are shared among users and providers, and that the scheme reduces burden with frequent use, but offered no reconsideration.

That is why, for payroll returns from 1 January 2020, the security level 'substantial' applies and a login means with a corresponding reliability level must therefore be used, in this case eHerkenning level 3.

Daarom geldt ter zake van loonaangiften per 1 januari 2020 beveiligingsniveau «substantieel» en moet dus gebruik worden gemaakt van een inlogmiddel met een overeenkomstig betrouwbaarheidsniveau, in dit geval eHerkenning niveau 3.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht 'Kleine winkeliers moeten gedwongen verhuizen voor uitbreiding Sterrenburg'

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that small shopkeepers in Sterrenburg must relocate for a shopping centre expansion, raising rent, contract and Sunday-opening rights. The State Secretary says the landlord must offer reasonable alternative premises, rent is subject to negotiation and courts decide disputes, and announces a bill giving shopkeepers consent rights over changed opening hours.
I am currently preparing a bill that protects shopkeepers against being confronted with changes to opening hours they have not explicitly agreed to.

Ik bereid op dit moment een wetsvoorstel voor dat winkeliers beschermt tegen situaties waarbij ze geconfronteerd worden met een wijziging van openingstijden waarmee ze niet nadrukkelijk hebben ingestemd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Bosman, Kerstens, Bruins, Voordewind en Stoffer over de berichtgeving ‘Nieuwe onderzeeboten: Nederlandse marine-industrie dreigt alleen kruimels te krijgen’

MPs from several parties asked the Defence, Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about press reports that the Dutch naval shipbuilding industry risks getting only scraps from the new submarine order, and about risks to knowledge retention, intellectual property, competition and the Defence Industry Strategy. The government answered at length, largely restating its procurement approach: competitive selection under Article 346 TFEU, IP and maintenance guarantees to be negotiated in the next phase, and no decision yet on a single preferred bidder.
As I stated in the B-letter, I will implement the Bruins Slot et al. motion.
Zoals ik in de B-brief heb vermeld zal ik uitvoering geven aan de motie Bruins Slot c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Taking Stock of App Stores’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about app store operators' dominance, commission fees and possible self-preferencing by Apple, and about ongoing competition investigations. The State Secretary answered that the open internet regulation does not cover app stores, that the ACM is conducting a follow-up investigation into Apple, that the European Commission is investigating a Spotify complaint, and that ex ante powers for gatekeeper platforms could be considered.
It is not for me to assess whether an undertaking abuses its dominant position.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of een onderneming haar machtspositie misbruikt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aartsen over de berichten ‘Hoe T-Mobile zichzelf in de voet schoot met omweg dataverkeer’ en ‘Klachten bij toezichthouder over traag internet bij T-Mobile‘

MPs Weverling and Aartsen asked the State Secretary about reports that T-Mobile routed Dutch data traffic via Germany, lowering response speed, and about net neutrality and the role of the ACM. The State Secretary answered that the rerouting was largely reversed, that the ACM is independent and may examine interconnection under net neutrality rules, and that no further investigation of other providers is planned.
The ACM is an independent regulator. For the sake of that independence, I do not consider it appropriate to comment on the desirability of any investigation.
De ACM is een onafhankelijk toezichthouder. Ten behoeve van die onafhankelijkheid acht ik het niet verstandig om mij uit te laten over de eventuele wenselijkheid van enig onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aartsen over het bericht dat een Chinees bedrijf een aanbesteding voor het aanleggen van een metrolijn in Stockholm heeft gewonnen

MPs Weverling and Aartsen asked whether Chinese state-owned firms bidding below cost on European public tenders, such as a Stockholm metro contract, distort competition and whether the government will act on reciprocity. The government answered that existing EU procurement rules allow abnormally low bids to be rejected, that it supports the EU International Procurement Instrument and a level playing field instrument, but gave only general commitments and referred to earlier letters.
The cabinet is currently pursuing a non-discriminatory instrument aimed at promoting a level playing field to address this problem.
Het kabinet zet momenteel in op een non-discriminatoir instrument gericht op het bevorderen van een gelijk speelveld om dit probleem wel te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het verbieden van deurverkoop

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about door-to-door energy sales, including misleading and aggressive sales tactics, the expected effects of a planned opt-in ban on unsolicited telemarketing, data on door sales, municipal powers to restrict them, and an ACM investigation into energy contract sales. The State Secretary acknowledges the signals, says misleading practices are unacceptable, rules out an opt-in ban for door sales for now in favour of talks with energy suppliers, and promises to ask the ACM to tighten supervision.
I will ask the ACM to tighten supervision of the sale of energy at the door, as the Beckerman et al. motion requests.
Ik zal de ACM vragen het toezicht op de verkoop van energie aan de deur te verscherpen, zoals de motie Beckerman c.s. verzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de bescherming van consumenten bij een faillissement van een energieleverancier

An MP asked the ministers whether consumers have enough insight into an energy supplier's financial health, whether the regulator ACM can intervene earlier and stricter entry rules should apply, and whether consumers should be compensated from a guarantee fund after a supplier's bankruptcy. The minister answered that supply security is already guaranteed, that stricter licensing and supervision are being examined for the new Energy Act, and that a compensation fund is not proportionate given its risks.
This may lead to tightening of the licensing requirements and of ACM's supervision of them.
Dit zal mogelijk tot een aanscherping van de vergunningseisen en het toezicht door ACM daarop leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de te lange betaaltermijnen van grote bedrijven aan kleine ondernemers

An MP asks the State Secretary about large companies paying small and medium businesses late, with payment terms rising to 41.4 days, and urges shortening the statutory term to 30 days, stronger enforcement and possible fines or reprimands. The government says the figures show no improvement, will tighten the rules once the evaluation of the Wet betalingstermijnen grote bedrijven is completed, and expects to report around the turn of the year.
I expect to be able to inform the House around the turn of the year about the outcomes of this.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer rond de jaarwisseling te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Donatiewebsite plotseling offline: tienduizenden euro’s verdwenen'

An MP asked the government about a donation website that went offline with tens of thousands of euros missing, and whether crowdfunding donation platforms should face the same registration and AFM oversight as investment crowdfunding. The government answered that existing consumer protection applies, that donation crowdfunding differs from investment crowdfunding and needs no AFM supervision, and that the sector and CBF are exploring a code of conduct rather than new government measures.
Crowdfunding through donation is therefore comparable to donating to more traditional charitable institutions, for example via a collection box.
Crowdfunding door middel van donatie is daarom vergelijkbaar met doneren aan meer traditionele charitatieve instellingen, bijvoorbeeld via een collectebus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over toezicht op crowdfundingplatforms zoals Dream or Donate

An SP MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether oversight of crowdfunding platforms like Dream or Donate was adequate after the site went offline with donations apparently lost. The government answered that donation-based crowdfunding falls outside AFM supervision, that the sector should self-regulate with CBF-related talks underway, and that fraud is for police and prosecutors.
Crowdfunding through donation is therefore comparable to donating to more traditional charitable institutions, for example via a collection box.
Crowdfunding door middel van donatie is daarom vergelijkbaar met doneren aan meer traditionele charitatieve instellingen, bijvoorbeeld via een collectebus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Veldman en Weverling over de berichten ‘Iedereen wil internet, niemand wil datacenters’ en 'Hoe Nederland zichzelf economisch in de voet schiet'

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary how the temporary building freeze on new data centres in Amsterdam and Haarlemmermeer fits with national digitalisation and spatial strategies, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary acknowledges the freeze is driven by energy demand and land shortages, points to a national data centre table and regional alternatives, and says the government is willing to play a facilitating role.
Yes, I am willing to play a facilitating role in this.
Ja ik ben bereid een faciliterende rol hierin te spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Bouwer staat 3:1 achter bij Tendergeschil: ‘Bizar dat politiek ingrijpen uit blijft''

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about industry complaints that the Commission of Procurement Experts' role is being weakened, the imbalance in court versus commission outcomes, and whether complaint handling and suspension rules should be strengthened. The State Secretary answered that the Commission will keep its complaint role for several years as a backstop, that a review of complaint handling and a possible mandatory suspension will be studied with a sounding-board group, and that the Commission's advisory role will be evaluated before any change.

As a first additional measure, I want to keep the current role of the CvAE in complaint handling for at least several more years and will examine how the CvAE can play a backstop role where complaint handling at contracting authorities is still insufficient.
Als eerste aanvullende maatregel wil ik de huidige rol van de CvAE in klachtafhandeling nog zeker enkele jaren behouden en zal ik bekijken hoe de CvAE een rol kan spelen als stok achter de deur.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘VVD wil één loket voor vergunningen van strandtenthouders’

An MP asked the state secretary about proposals for a single permit counter for beach tent operators and the burden of multiple permits, documents and differing processing times. The state secretary answered that the WABO already allows bundled applications, that the Omgevingswet will further consolidate permits in one application via a single municipal counter from 2021, and that digital tools are being developed, while not committing to new cross-government consultation.
The Omgevingswet goes further and provides for a more extensive bundling of activities into a single environmental permit.
De Omgevingswet gaat verder en voorziet in een verdergaande bundeling van activiteiten in één omgevingsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het duidelijk verslechterde economisch beeld van het midden- en kleinbedrijf (mkb)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the deteriorating SME business cycle shown by the CBS conjunctuurklok and how SME and large-firm conditions compare. The State Secretary answered that the business cycle has softened but remains good, that the clock covers all firms, that the MKB action plan provides specific SME support, and that domestic spending and wage policy are relevant but are for social partners to settle.
SMEs are the foundation of the Dutch economy.
Het mkb is het fundament van de Nederlandse economie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over jonge kinderen die worden blootgesteld aan gewelddadige beelden in gamehallen

An MP asked whether children as young as nine are exposed to violent games in gaming halls without supervision, and why these halls do not follow the age-classification rules that cinemas and shops follow. The minister answered that co-regulation applies, that article 240a of the Criminal Code makes it an offence to show harmful images to minors, and that inspections by Agentschap Telecom found gaming halls falling short, leading to industry talks, awareness work and tighter risk-based controls.
Second, I will work through the Nicam to raise awareness in the sector of the importance of protecting young people from harmful images.
Ten tweede zal ik via het Nicam bij de branche inzetten op bewustwording van het belang van bescherming van jongeren tegen schadelijk beeldmateriaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over de bereikbaarheid van 113 Zelfmoordpreventie

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked whether the 113 suicide prevention line could be made directly reachable via the 113 number, since the 0900 number is less known and costly, after a family tragedy where a caller dialled a non-existent 113 number. The State Secretary answered that a 0800 number now removes cost barriers, that the 1-1-3 number could potentially be made available subject to a number-plan change by the ACM, a process of at least three months with conditions and misdialling risks still being studied, and committed to further investigation with the Minister of Justice.
Together with the Minister of Justice we will investigate the possibilities, risks and appropriate conditions for making this number available.
Samen met de Minister van JenV zullen wij onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden, de risico’s en passende voorwaarden zijn bij het beschikbaar maken van dit nummer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het verdwijnen van XS4ALL

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the planned disappearance of XS4ALL, its customers' concerns about losing high-quality service, and whether the government can guarantee that service and ease switching providers. The state secretary replied that the government lacks legal instruments to force telecom providers to continue specific services, relying on market forces and ACM regulation, and that the sector has been asked to agree on longer email forwarding periods.
I lack the legal instruments to force telecom companies to continue specific services.
Mij ontbreekt het wettelijk instrumentarium om telecompartijen te dwingen specifieke dienstverlening te continueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de integratie van XS4ALL door KPN en de gevolgen voor de keuzevrijheid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about KPN's plan to dissolve the XS4ALL brand despite a negative works council advice, its effects on consumer choice, whether the regulator should analyse the market, and whether works councils have real influence. The State Secretary answered that market parties are free to offer services, that the regulator's wholesale access rules are being broadened, that the works council's weight is a matter for the boards, and that employment non-compete clauses are the responsibility of employer and employee.
I have no opinion on how the boards of XS4ALL and KPN weigh the advice of the Works Council; that is decision-making that lies within the respective boardrooms.
Ik heb geen mening over hoe de besturen van XS4ALL en KPN het advies van de Ondernemingsraad wegen; dat is besluitvorming die in de betreffende bestuurskamers ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Haga over de antwoorden op de vragen over het bericht 'Chinese webgigant AliExpress in strijd met Europese regels'

MPs Wörsdörfer and Van Haga asked how many imported products fail consumer and product safety rules, what ACM and NVWA have investigated and enforced against platforms like AliExpress, and how enforcement can be improved. The state secretary answered that no reliable percentage can be given because inspections are risk-based, described enforcement actions, new EU market surveillance rules, and planned consumer awareness campaigns, but declined to give exact counts of investigations or violations.
Because their investigations are targeted, it often turns out that there is a violation.
Omdat hun onderzoeken gericht worden uitgevoerd, blijkt daarom vaak dat er sprake is van een overtreding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht 'Nieuwbouwhuis? Grote kans dat 5G je geen sneller internet oplevert'

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about RTL Z reporting that 5G may not improve indoor mobile connectivity in new-build homes, and about who should ensure indoor coverage. The State Secretary answered that absolute indoor coverage guarantees are not feasible, that the 5G coverage requirement applies outdoors only, and that residents can use Wi-Fi and Voice over Wi-Fi, while the ministry's facilitating role applies only to business settings.
Absolute guarantees for mobile network coverage cannot be given.
Absolute garanties voor mobiele netwerkdekking zijn niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Apple deelde herleidbare, persoonlijke gegevens bij opnames Siri-gebruikers’

Two CDA MPs asked ministers whether Apple's sharing of identifiable Siri recordings violated privacy, what the Dutch privacy regulator AP had done, which law applies and where citizens should complain, and what the government would do about privacy risks in tech. The ministers answered that the AP is a concerned authority while the Irish regulator leads, that AVG complaint routes exist, that current law is largely adequate with the AVG evaluation to address data volume and profiling, and that a public campaign on privacy will start in spring 2020.
It is up to the competent privacy supervisors in the EU to start an investigation into Apple's conduct.
Het is aan de bevoegde privacytoezichthouders in de EU om een onderzoek te starten naar het handelen van Apple.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht 'En het Songfestival gaat naar ... Rotterdam!'

An MP from the CDA asked whether the government would act on adopted motions to promote the Netherlands at the Eurovision Song Contest 2020 in Rotterdam, and how regional and sector partners would be involved. The state secretary answered that the organising broadcasters and the municipality are developing the concept, that the ministry will offer knowledge and expertise via RVO.nl and NBTC, and that promotion will be aligned with the national branding effort, without committing to specific funding or a fixed step.
The Eurovision Song Contest 2020 offers an ideal opportunity to highlight the unique aspects of the Netherlands.
Het Eurovisie Songfestival 2020 biedt een uitgelezen kans om de unieke kanten van Nederland te belichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van Haga over het aanstaande Buitengewone Congres van de Wereldpostunie

MPs Weverling and Van Haga asked the state secretary about the extraordinary UPU congress, US threats to withdraw over postal terminal dues, Dutch and EU positions, and consequences of a US exit. The government confirmed attendance, said the Netherlands supports reform of the terminal dues system with gradual change, and answered most questions substantively while declining to endorse US proposals and disputing the Economic Report's characterization of Dutch positions.
I refer you for the answer to my extensive response of 20 September on questions 11 and 12 of the questions on the same subject of 27 June.
Ik verwijs u voor het antwoord naar mijn uitgebreide reactie van 20 september jl. op de vragen 11 en 12 van de vragen over hetzelfde onderwerp van 27 juni jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Veldman over het bericht ‘Banken weigeren bedrijven die met blockchain in de weer zijn’

MPs Wörsdörfer and Veldman asked whether banks refuse accounts to blockchain companies after a newspaper report. The minister says no structural refusal signals exist, notes crypto-service firms may face higher AML risk, and promises talks with banks.
Nevertheless, I will enter into discussion with the banks on whether there is indeed a refusal of parties that do something with blockchain.
Desalniettemin zal ik met de banken in gesprek gaan of er inderdaad sprake is van het weigeren van partijen die iets met blockchain doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de hernieuwde stijging van de postzegelprijs

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the postage stamp price rise after ACM allowed PostNL a 16.4% tariff increase, questioning liberalisation, dependence on post, and consolidation via PostNL's acquisition of Sandd. The State Secretary answered that rising tariffs follow from structural mail volume decline, defended liberalisation, committed to a Postal Act amendment later this year, and said a decision on PostNL's Sandd appeal would follow within 12 weeks.
I intend to submit an amendment proposal to the Postal Act to the House of Representatives later this year to secure this for the longer term.
Ik ben voornemens om later dit jaar een wijzigingsvoorstel voor de Postwet bij de Tweede Kamer in te dienen om dit ook voor de langere termijn te borgen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van Haga over de verkoop en distributie van pakketjes door Alibaba in Nederland

VVD MPs Weverling and Van Haga asked the government about Alibaba/AliExpress parcel distribution, unfair competition from China, Universal Postal Union tariffs and US proposals. The State Secretary answered at length, largely defending the 2016 tariff reform and EU/WTO tools, while withholding PostNL commercial figures as confidential.
Information about commercial agreements between parties is confidential, and making it public would harm PostNL's international competitive position.
Informatie over commerciële afspraken tussen partijen zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en het publiek maken daarvan zou de internationale concurrentiepositie van PostNL schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over de gevolgen van een harde Brexit voor de Nederlandse werkgelegenheid.

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government would take extra measures, such as short-time work, to cushion a hard Brexit's job losses, after a KU Leuven study estimated 73,200 Dutch jobs at risk. The ministers replied that existing contingency measures, support tools and social security are sufficient, that the study has important caveats, and that the government will not intervene in UK policy.
For these reasons, the cabinet currently sees no reason to deploy additional instruments to absorb the negative consequences of a no-deal Brexit.
Het kabinet ziet om die redenen op dit moment geen aanleiding voor de inzet van additionele instrumenten om de negatieve gevolgen van een no deal Brexit op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Laan-Geselschap en Worfsdorfer over het bericht ‘Deze nieuwe en gevaarlijke cyberaanval wordt gewoon met de post bezorgd’

Four VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about 'warshipping', a reported cyberattack using parcels to plant devices that breach local wifi networks, and how it could be detected, handled and countered. The government answered that it knows the technique but has no known cases in the Netherlands or abroad, that organisations can screen parcels, and that the NCTV and NCSC are aware of the risk and would advise if needed.
I am not aware of any cases in which warshipping has been detected in the Netherlands.
Er zijn mij geen gevallen bekend waarin «warshipping» is geconstateerd in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over de Wet modernisering kleineondernemersregeling (KOR)

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked about the implementation of the modernised small business scheme (KOR), its turnover threshold of €20,000, and the consequences of a CJEU ruling on margin-scheme dealers. The State Secretary answered that the scheme takes effect on 1 January 2020, outlined the communication campaign, defended the threshold as budget-neutral and comparable within the EU, and said the scheme will be evaluated and the threshold adjusted if warranted.
However, it is necessary that the new article 24 of the Implementing Decree VAT 1968, as it would enter into force on 1 January 2020, be withdrawn.
Wel is het noodzakelijk dat het nieuwe artikel 24 Uitvoeringsbeschikking OB 1968, zoals dat in werking zou treden per 1 januari 2020, wordt ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Bosman over het kabinetsbeleid ten aanzien van de defensie-industrie

MPs Van Haga and Bosman ask the government to reconcile its support for the domestic defence industry with its strict arms-export policy and with the FMO exclusion list that bars firms earning 10% or more from weapons from trade-promotion and financing instruments such as DTIF. The ministers confirm the policy tension, state that generic trade instruments are now open to defence firms, and say the government will review remaining aspects of defence trade support by Prinsjesdag 2019 while denying any intent to penalise the sector.
At present, however, the cabinet is considering whether trade support for the defence sector can be adjusted on this point in light of the DIS.
Op dit moment beziet het kabinet echter of de handelsinzet voor de defensiesector op dit punt in het licht van de DIS kan worden aangepast
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Bosman over de impact van het eenzijdig aangescherpte wapenexportbeleid voor de concurrentiepositie van de Nederlandse defensie-industrie

MPs Van Haga and Bosman asked about the impact of the Dutch tightened arms export policy toward the UAE, Egypt and Saudi Arabia on the competitiveness of the Dutch defence industry, including comparisons with German, French, Spanish and Czech practice, the Dutch military presence in the UAE, and whether defence firms can join trade missions. The government answered that the Netherlands is not acting alone since Germany and Finland also restricted exports, that the policy is justified by international obligations and humanitarian law, and that it regrets the negative effects on Dutch defence firms while pursuing harmonisation within the EU and opening trade missions to defence firms.
Arms export control is a national competence. EU member states are themselves responsible for assessing arms export applications against the eight criteria of the EU Common Position on arms exports.

Wapenexportcontrole is een nationale bevoegdheid. EU-lidstaten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de toetsing van wapenexportaanvragen aan de acht criteria van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de berichtgeving over dubbele petten van Verhagen

An MP asked whether former minister Verhagen was paid twice for overlapping work, as a Limburg province ambassador advising firms on JSF/F-35 contracts and as the state's special representative for F-35 industrial participation. The state secretary answered that the two mandates differ in nature, the Limburg role carries a fixed fee with no individual billing, and no double payment is evident, with coordination and reporting safeguards in place.
There is no question of individual advice.
Er is geen sprake van individuele adviezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het betalen van invoerrechten en btw voor pakketjes die aan de deur worden afgeleverd

MP Moorlag asked the State Secretary how PostNL may refuse universal postal service under the Postal Act and whether people with disabilities who must collect parcels at PostNL points, to pay import duties and VAT, are adequately served, and whether a home-delivery request option is possible.
