The State Secretary answered that PostNL is exploring home delivery via an online payment pilot, that the one-stop-shop portal will later help, that PostNL's general terms are checked by the Consumentenbond, and that the broad network of over 3,000 points is accessible to people with disabilities.
PostNL is investigating the possibilities to still deliver postal items to the home address of addressees.
PostNL onderzoekt de mogelijkheden om poststukken alsnog af te leveren op het huisadres van geadresseerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Ondernemers dupe van kwijtgeraakte pakketjes’

VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about entrepreneurs bearing costs of lost parcels and about data on lost-parcel volumes and complaints. The State Secretary answered that the government leaves the parcel market to competing carriers, does not hold the requested data, and that carriers are not legally required to record complaints.
I am addressing these questions together because the government does not have this information.
Ik behandel deze vragen tezamen omdat de overheid niet over deze informatie beschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘De mobiele lokdoos werkt niet met 5G’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that IMSI-catchers (mobile 'lokdoos' interception devices) do not work with 5G, and about Europol's concerns over identifying and locating suspects on 5G networks. The government answered that a working group is adapting investigative procedures and rules for 5G, that it is in contact with telecom providers and foreign counterparts, and that private possession of IMSI-catchers remains prohibited.

At present, the interdepartmental working group '5G and investigation', chaired by the police and including the Public Prosecution Service, Agentschap Telecom and the Ministries of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Justice and Security, is working out which changes in procedure are needed to enable identification and localisation of persons on the 5G network.

Op dit moment wordt in de ambtelijke werkgroep «5G en opsporing» onder voorzitterschap van de politie met daarin het Openbaar Ministerie, Agentschap Telecom en de Ministeries van Economische Zaken en Klimaat en van Justitie en Veiligheid uitgewerkt welke aanpassingen in werkwijze noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Verhoeven over hoge marktconcentratie onder dagbladuitgeverijen

MPs Sneller and Verhoeven asked about high market concentration among Dutch newspaper publishers, including De Persgroep's expansion, falling freelance rates, and whether the market remains competitive. The minister answered that concentration is high but the market is hybrid and digitalising, that the ACM reviewed and approved the Independer takeover on competition grounds, and that the government is pursuing collective bargaining options for freelancers while having no comparative EU data.
The takeover of Independer by De Persgroep was notified to the ACM at the end of October 2018.
De overname van Independer door De Persgroep is eind oktober 2018 bij de ACM gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het verdwijnen van 3G

An MP asked the state secretary about Vodafone's early 3G shutdown, its refusal to make phones 4G-compatible, and whether affected low-income customers should be compensated as with cable TV decoders. The state secretary answered that customers can still call and use 2G, that operators communicate the shutdown well in advance, and that no arrangement with Vodafone is needed because phones are personal property unlike decoders.
I therefore see no need to enter into consultation about arranging such a scheme.
Ik zie zodoende geen noodzaak om in overleg te treden over het treffen van een dergelijke regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Moorlag over de gevolgen van lachgasgebruik voor het Klimaat

PvdA MPs asked whether recreational nitrous oxide use and its climate impact are known to users and how much it adds to emissions. The government answered that users are not aware of the climate effects, estimated the emissions as small relative to national totals, and said a risk assessment due in November will guide any health measures, while no specific climate policy is planned.
Pending the advice, the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport is examining various policy options so that appropriate national measures can be taken quickly once the assessment is final.

In afwachting van het advies worden door het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport diverse beleidsopties bekeken zodat wanneer de beoordeling definitief is, snel passende landelijke maatregelen kunnen worden getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Wörsdörfer over de policy brief van het CPB over MKB-bankfinanciering

MPs Amhaouch and Wörsdörfer asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a CPB report finding that Dutch SMEs receive fewer bank loans and face higher rates than in other eurozone countries, and what the government will do. The State Secretary acknowledges the report, stresses that the causes are diverse and not firmly established, notes that many rejections are justified, points to existing guarantee and risk-capital instruments, and promises a policy letter in autumn 2019 rather than before the summer recess.
In autumn 2019 I will elaborate on my policy vision in a letter to the House.
In het najaar 2019 zal ik in een Kamerbrief mijn beleidsvisie nader toelichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over de International Association for Trusted Blockchain Applications

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the International Association for Trusted Blockchain Applications (INATBA), its expected role, Dutch membership, support for Dutch firms, regulatory sandboxes and blockchain in the digitalisation strategy. The State Secretary answered that the INATBA is still being set up, promised to support it where possible, described existing DNB/AFM sandbox programmes, and confirmed the digitalisation report contains no separate blockchain chapter.
Due to the confidentiality of supervision, the precise nature of the questions and experiments cannot be elaborated on.
Over de precieze aard van de vragen en experimenten kan in verband met vertrouwelijkheid van het toezicht niet uitgeweid worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'ACM: pas eind zomer besluit over overname Apeldoornse Sandd door PostNL'

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports that the competition regulator ACM would only decide in late summer on PostNL's takeover of Sandd, and whether ACM's public timeline communication was appropriate. The state secretary replied that the report contains no new information, that ACM's independent process is governed by statutory deadlines that can be paused by requests for information, and that no hard end date is desirable.
The ACM may request further information from parties in order to reach a proper assessment.
De ACM kan van partijen nadere informatie verlangen om tot een goede beoordeling te kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over hoe de sterke zekerheidsrechtelijke positie van banken alternatieve financiers belemmert

MPs Sneller, Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked whether banks' strong security positions in bankruptcy and the ban on pledging assets hinder alternative lenders, and whether the government will investigate, legislate or address this in the bankruptcy law revision. The minister answered that a study of Dutch financing practice will be commissioned, that the bankruptcy law revision is examining secured creditors' position, and that the bill to lift pledging bans will go to the Council of State shortly after the summer recess.
We are willing to commission a study into this, which will also address collateral provision in SME financing, in view of the motion adopted by your House on 18 June.

Wij zijn bereid om een opdracht tot een onderzoek daarnaar te geven, waarbij tevens, mede gelet op de op 18 juni door Uw Kamer aangenomen motie, 2 de zekerheidsstelling bij MKB-financiering aan de orde zal komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Remco Dijkstra en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Transporteurs boos over dure Nederlandse tachokaart: ‘In buitenland veel goedkoper’

MPs asked why Dutch hauliers pay substantially higher prices for tachograph cards than in neighbouring countries and whether this disadvantages Dutch SMEs. The minister acknowledged price differences, said a benchmark study will be sent to parliament after the summer, and promised a revised, more transparent tariff scheme that may lower prices.
This study will be sent to your House after the summer.
Dit onderzoek zal na de zomer naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat er woede is over de woekerhandel in kaartjes voor een voetbalwedstrijd

An SP MP asked the government about ticket scalping for the Feyenoord-Ajax match, including enforcement, a national ban, ACM action, EU initiatives, and transparency obligations for ticket resellers. The Staatssecretaris answered that a national ban would be ineffective and unenforceable, that clubs block scalped tickets under KNVB conditions, and that the government will not pursue further national rules given the cross-border nature of the problem.
I do not have the means at my disposal to map the total extent of this problem, since it is a cross-border matter.
Ik heb niet de middelen tot mijn beschikking om de totale omvang van deze problematiek in kaart te brengen, aangezien het hier gaat om een grensoverschrijdende aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Dieven teisteren Nederlandse winkeliers: 1,8 miljard verlies'

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the government was aware of reports of 1.8 billion euro in losses from shoplifting, what measures it was considering for small businesses, and for an appraisal of the VVD's earlier recommendations on shoplifting. The government confirmed the figures are broadly in line with earlier data, described existing public-private platforms and a new intelligence register on mobile gangs, and promised an appraisal of the recommendations from the Minister of Justice and Security by the end of summer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Tientallen kleine bedrijven failliet door hoge kosten crowdfunding'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Finance and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that small firms went bankrupt due to high crowdfunding costs, and whether existing rules protect SMEs from excessive interest rates. The minister answered that crowdfunding is a valuable financing option, that the government relies on self-regulation codes for business clients, and that the AFM oversees certain crowdfunding forms, with a possible national framework deferred to the pending EU regulation.
As indicated in the answer to question 3, the cabinet is relying on self-regulation to improve protection for small business clients.
Zoals in de beantwoording op vraag 3 is aangegeven, zet het kabinet wat betreft de verbetering van de bescherming voor kleinzakelijke klanten in op zelfregulering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het betalen van invoerrechten en btw aan de deur

An MP asked why PostNL only lets recipients collect parcels with import duties or VAT at a PostNL location rather than paying at the door, and whether this conflicts with universal postal access rules. The state secretary confirmed the policy, citing efficiency and courier safety, and maintained that PostNL's conditions comply with the Postal Act 2009 and universal service remains accessible.
PostNL is therefore not acting in breach of laws and regulations.
PostNL handelt hiermee niet in strijd met wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Sjoerdsma over een gelijk speelveld voor alternatieve kredietverleners en banken bij de financiering van het midden- en kleinbedrijf

MPs Sneller and Sjoerdsma asked about the level playing field between banks and alternative lenders in financing SMEs, including differing SME definitions, the professionalisation of alternative lenders, implementation of a motion, and why certain subsidy schemes channel funds only through banks. The government replied that bank financing remains dominant but non-bank finance is growing, that a study on SME financing is underway with a report expected in the second half of the year, and that schemes will be reviewed for level-playing-field effects.
What matters is that SMEs have a sufficiently diverse financing landscape available that meets their legitimate credit needs.
Van belang is dat mkb'ers een voldoende divers financieringslandschap ter beschikking staat dat voorziet in hun legitieme kredietbehoeften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Veldman en Wiersma over het aantrekken van personeel door startups

MPs Wörsdörfer, Veldman and Wiersma asked whether startups face barriers in recruiting foreign talent, including income requirements, the partner labour market access and BTW registration for foreign entrepreneurs. The government answered that a pilot residence scheme for essential startup staff with a lower salary threshold will be created, that partner labour market access is being arranged, and that foreign entrepreneurs do not need to register physically at the tax office.
It was chosen to create a separate residence scheme in the form of a pilot rather than to adjust the knowledge migrant scheme.
Er is gekozen voor een aparte verblijfsregeling in de vorm van een pilot en niet voor aanpassing van de kennismigrantenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat Google de Android-licentie voor Huawei intrekt

MP Moorlag asked the State Secretary whether Google's revocation of Huawei's Android licence would degrade or stop updates on existing Huawei phones, whether this breaches consumer contracts, what the ACM could do, and how consumers can be informed. The State Secretary answered that Huawei expects no loss of functionality or security updates for existing devices, that any non-conformity would be a matter for the seller and ultimately the courts, that the ACM sees no consumer-law violation, and that sellers must inform buyers.
From this it appears that no consequences are foreseen for the functionality for current owners of Huawei phones.
Hieruit blijkt dat er geen gevolgen worden voorzien ten aanzien van de functionaliteit voor huidige bezitters van Huawei-telefoons.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Alkaya over het ontnemen van toegang van Huawei tot Google-software door de Verenigde Staten

MPs Futselaar and Alkaya asked the government about the US decision to restrict Huawei's access to Google Android, its effects on Dutch users, the justification for it, and whether Dutch policy should shift. The government answered that the effects are not yet clear, that current Huawei phones keep working, that Dutch risks are assessed case by case, and that it rejects the need for a US strategy while pursuing multilateral trade reform.
The cabinet does not share this view and therefore sees no reason to draw up an American strategy.
Het kabinet deelt deze mening niet en ziet hierin derhalve geen aanleiding een Amerikastrategie op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Haga over het bericht 'Chinese webgigant AliExpress in strijd met Europese regels'

Two MPs asked whether AliExpress's terms breach Dutch and EU consumer rules, what the government will do to protect Dutch consumers buying from non-EU sellers, and why China strategy omitted this. The Secretary of State said enforcement lies with the ACM and courts, outlined EU cooperation, WTO e-commerce talks, product safety pledges, and an awareness campaign, and argued the share of purchases from Chinese webshops is still small.

It is up to the supervisory authority Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) and the courts to assess whether a company complies with the consumer rules in force in Europe and the Netherlands and, if not, which rules have been breached.

Het is aan de toezichthouder Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) en de rechter om te beoordelen of een bedrijf zich aan de in Europa en Nederland geldende consumentenregels houdt en zo nee, welke regels zijn overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Van den Hul over problemen door het krimpend frequentiespectrum

MPs Moorlag and Van den Hul asked whether the government knows that shrinking radio spectrum, from 4G/5G expansion and the loss of the 700 MHz band for PMSE users from 2020, will harm media production, events and public broadcasting, and whether promised support for PMSE was delivered. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, described coordination measures, a joint action plan with the sector, alternative frequency bands and a licensed shared access pilot, while stating that the consequences are being managed in ongoing consultation.
On possible consequences and solutions, my ministry and Agentschap Telecom are in ongoing consultation with the sector.
Over mogelijke gevolgen en oplossingen zijn mijn ministerie en Agentschap Telecom in voortdurend overleg met de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de berichten ‘Deurne krijgt echt twee keer glasvezel’, ‘Aanleg glasvezel vertraagd’ en ‘E-Fiber en KPN samen in één sleuf’

An MP asks the State Secretary about reports on fibre roll-out delays and dual fibre networks in rural Brabant, and whether the government backs the goal of broadband for all. The State Secretary says the market leads, the government sets conditions, the ambition of 100 Mbps by 2023 stands, and the ACM market study is expected after the summer.
I will therefore send the outcomes to your House.
Ik zal de uitkomsten dan ook aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Ronnes over het bericht 'KPN legt initiatief voor glasvezel in Beemster lam'

MPs Van den Berg and Ronnes asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about KPN's plan to fiber-connect only the village cores in Beemster, which may undermine the citizen-led Breedband Beemster project. The State Secretary said competition is for the ACM to supervise, that the ACM is running a market study to be published after summer, and that he will invite the initiative to a meeting, but declined to pre-empt the ACM's findings.
I cannot anticipate the outcomes of the ACM's investigation into competition in the fiber market.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de ACM naar de concurrentie in de glasvezelmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘De weerman wordt gestoord door 5G’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that 5G rollout in the 26 GHz band could disrupt weather and climate measurements, including whether meteorological bodies had raised concerns and whether the rollout risks degrading forecast quality. The State Secretary answered that European protections are adequate, that technical limits do not hinder 5G rollout, and that the Netherlands will push for equivalent protections at the ITU World Radiocommunication Conference, while acknowledging that international negotiations are expected to be intensive.
For weather measurements in Europe, I therefore currently have no concerns.
Voor de weermetingen in Europa heb ik dan ook op dit moment geen zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Huawei kan bij vertrouwelijke klantdata KPN’

An MP asked whether the interdepartmental Taskforce assessing risks from Huawei access to KPN customer data covers software supply and IT development by tech vendors, and whether government reviews telecom suppliers' access arrangements and security policy. The government answered yes on scope, pointed to the Telecommunications Act duty and Agentschap Telecom oversight, and said the Taskforce has delivered its findings with the cabinet still deliberating and the Chamber to be informed.
The Taskforce has now delivered its findings. The cabinet is currently deliberating on these findings. The Chamber will be informed about this.
De Taskforce heeft inmiddels haar uitkomsten opgeleverd. Op dit moment beraadt het kabinet zich op deze uitkomsten. De Kamer wordt hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ongewenste post

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about unwanted unaddressed advertising mail, including whether an opt-in system should be introduced and whether 'aan de bewoners van' mail should be treated as unaddressed. The State Secretary defended the current opt-out system, rejected opt-in and the stricter treatment of such mail, and said talks with the Consumentenbond and Postfilter.nl are ongoing.
I am confident these talks will produce results and at this moment see no reason to reconsider my position.
Ik heb er vertrouwen in dat deze gesprekken resultaat zullen opleveren en zie op dit moment dan ook geen reden om mijn standpunt te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Tien jaar Bel-me-niet Register, het werkt voor geen meter.’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the failure of the Bel-me-niet register, the ACM's enforcement against telemarketers, and protection of self-employed people, and asks whether an opt-in register should be introduced. The State Secretary responds that register numbers are high, that the system will move to opt-in with the register disappearing, that enforcement difficulties are acknowledged with new rules planned, and that an opt-in regime makes a separate Bel-me-wel register unnecessary.
I intend to ensure better enforcement possibilities in the new regulations, which are now being prepared.
Ik ben voornemens om in de nieuwe regelgeving, die nu in voorbereiding is te zorgen voor betere handhavingsmogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ’10 academische startups winnen deelname aan GES en een reis naar Silicon Valley’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the academic startup competition, the share of academic startups in the Netherlands, additional support measures, a possible valorisation pact with universities, the use of extra education and research funds, and whether the competition will recur. The State Secretary answers that no unambiguous figures exist (estimated 13% of startups are academic), lists existing and planned measures such as the TTT scheme and extra startup funding, says a valorisation meeting is aimed for 2020, and supports a recurring competition led by VSNU, TechLeap.NL and AcTI.
There are no unambiguous figures available on the number of academic startups and spin-offs in the Netherlands.
2 Er zijn geen eenduidige cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal van academische startups 3 en spin-offs 4 in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van Haga over de verkoop en distributie van pakketjes door Alibaba in Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister for Foreign Trade about cheap Alibaba parcels shipped to the Netherlands, counterfeit goods, postal delivery fee rules under the Universal Postal Union, and the risk of unfair competition from China. The government answered at length, stating that many details are commercially confidential, that the postal fee system is being phased toward parity, that the US threat to leave the UPU is being addressed multilaterally, and that China trade issues will be pursued via the WTO and the new China strategy.
This concerns commercially sensitive and confidential business information.
Dit betreft commercieel gevoelige en bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ellemeet over het rapport ‘Overpriced: Drugs developed with Dutch Public Funding’

MPs Van Gerven (SP) and Ellemeet (GroenLinks) asked the ministers whether taxpayers pay twice for drugs developed with public funding, given the SOMO report 'Overpriced', and asked about ROM investments, transparency, conditions on public funding, and alternative models such as a national drug research fund. The government acknowledged the report, said R&D is only one element of drug prices, argued that its own funding overview cannot be meaningfully summed, and said it will review conditions on revolving funds while ruling out a national drug research fund.
The report 'Overpriced: Drugs developed with Dutch Public Funding' focuses in particular on revolving funds that impose no concrete conditions.
Het rapport «Overpriced: Drugs developed with Dutch Public Funding» zoomt met name in op revolverende fondsen die geen concrete voorwaarden stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Moorlag over een breed plan voor technisch onderwijs dat volgens ondernemersorganisatie Techniek Nederland nu nodig is

Two PvdA MPs asked the education and economic affairs ministers how they view Techniek Nederland's call for a broad technical education plan, including hybrid teachers and hybrid programmes. The minister acknowledged the need for technical skills, said youth unemployment is low, welcomed hybrid teaching in principle, referred to existing measures and the Techniekpact, and said the ministry would keep talking with industry without committing to adopt the proposals.
This cabinet therefore considers it important to support schools by improving the transitions between primary education, secondary education, secondary vocational education and higher education.

Dit kabinet vindt het dan ook van belang om scholen te ondersteunen door het verbeteren van de overgangen tussen primair onderwijs, voortgezet onderwijs, middelbaar beroepsonderwijs en hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Schimmigheid klimaattafels baart MKB zorgen’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the climate roundtables raise concerns among SMEs, and whether the energy transition is affordable, whether the government will consult SMEs about shifting the sustainable energy surcharge (ODE) to large industry, and whether SMEs can be supported in energy-saving measures. The minister answered that the government aims for an affordable transition, will show the effects of the ODE shift on SMEs before the bill this summer, and will assess the broader impact of the Klimaatakkoord on SMEs and inform the House in the second half of 2019.
Once this overview is ready it will be shared with MKB-Nederland and the House of Representatives.
Zodra dit overzicht gereed is zal het worden gedeeld met MKB-Nederland en de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Onze veiligheid in eigen hand houden’

MPs Weverling and Laan-Geselschap asked the government about a proposed national secure communications network (NVC) and whether it is needed for critical infrastructure, emergency services and C2000 back-up, and about security audits of C2000 technology. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government does not see the need for an NVC, that vital providers bear primary responsibility, and that a study into a C2000 solution independent of states with offensive cyber programmes will be reported after the summer.
In this letter I committed to carry out an exploration of a solution that does not depend on countries that have been established to run offensive cyber programmes against Dutch interests.

In deze brief heb ik toegezegd een verkenning uit te voeren naar een oplossing die niet afhankelijk is van landen waarvan is vastgesteld dat ze een offensief cyberprogramma voeren tegen Nederlandse belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het artikel 'MKB-Nederland: Grote bedrijven betalen facturen nog steeds te laat'

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about large companies paying SME invoices late, the effects on small firms, and whether the statutory payment term should be cut to 30 days. The state secretary called the trend worrying, said the reasons are unknown, and promised an evaluation of the late-payment law with results in September and possible tightening afterwards.
This will also make clear whether the statutory payment term should be tightened to 30 days.
Daarmee wordt ook duidelijk of de wettelijke betaaltermijn moet worden aangescherpt naar 30 dagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘MKB-Nederland wil wettelijke betaaltermijn voor 'groot aan klein' naar 30 dagen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that SMEs wait up to 60 days for payment and whether the statutory maximum payment term should be cut to 30 days. The State Secretary said the evaluation of the payment-terms law will report by September and may lead to tighter rules, but declined to commit to amending the law now, citing average payment terms of about 40 days showing no clear trend.
I acknowledge there is a risk that emphasis on the 60-day outer limit causes attention to slacken on applying the desirable 30-day payment term.
Ik onderschrijf dat er een risico is dat nadruk op de uiterste grens van 60 dagen de aandacht laat verslappen voor het hanteren van de wenselijke betaaltermijn van 30 dagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de uitzending van Tegenlicht omtrent Ruimtepuinruimer

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about space debris, international law on removing it, Luxembourg's commercial space law, liability for satellites, and Dutch positions in UN space programmes. The State Secretary answered that no UN treaty requires debris removal, that the Netherlands prioritises debris reduction within the UN and ESA frameworks, and that no new legal regime is currently planned.
The Netherlands endorses the importance of the guidelines developed within the UN, and has designated reducing and preventing space debris as one of its priorities.
Nederland onderschrijft het belang van de binnen de VN ontwikkelde richtlijnen, en heeft het verminderen en voorkomen van ruimtepuin als een van zijn prioriteiten aangemerkt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ongewenste post

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about unaddressed advertising mail, whether consumers should be able to refuse it, and whether an opt-in system like the one planned for telemarketing should be introduced. The State Secretary replied that existing sticker, register and right-of-objection options are adequate and that no opt-in regime is planned for advertising mail.
As I explained in the answer to question 5, I currently see no reason to introduce an opt-in system for advertising mail or to take other measures.
Zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 5 heb toegelicht, zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om voor reclamepost een opt-in systeem te introduceren, of andere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht ‘Keurmerktrammelant’

An MP asked the ministers about the proliferation of food labels and certification marks in supermarkets, whether they are trustworthy, and whether government regulation or a single state-set health logo is needed. The government answered that existing rules suffice, pointed to a Milieu Centraal benchmark and campaign, and said a government-backed food-choice logo is planned by 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over een keurmerk voor voedsel

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether the government would adopt the Nutriscore food labelling system, citing a Consumentenbond survey of snacks. The Secretary of State said the government is still comparing European logos and running consumer research, will decide after summer and no later than end 2019, and gave no commitment to Nutriscore.
I expect to inform you after the summer, but no later than the end of 2019, about the outcomes of the studies and my decision on the new food choice logo.
Ik verwacht u na de zomer, maar uiterlijk eind 2019 te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken en mijn beslissing over het nieuwe voedselkeuzelogo.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Kwint over de fusie van Partou en KidsFoundation

MPs Bruins and Kwint asked about the merger of childcare providers Partou and KidsFoundation, their takeover by investment firms Onex and Waterland, and whether private equity harms public interests in childcare. The State Secretary answered that all providers must meet the Childcare Act, that the competition authority ACM reviews such mergers, that sector margins are modest, and that studies show no quality decline.
In 2017 parents reported €3.5 billion in gross childcare costs to the Tax Administration.
In 2017 hebben ouders voor € 3,5 mld aan bruto kosten voor hun kinderopvang doorgegeven aan de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Verkopers van Eneco toch niet zo braaf’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about reports of aggressive door-to-door energy sales, whether a licensing requirement for sellers is warranted, and whether the ACM is adequately active. The State Secretary condemned the conduct, said existing municipal licensing and ACM enforcement powers are sufficient, and announced planned telemarketing opt-in rules and talks on business contracts sold to sole traders.
I am of the view that this system offers sufficient possibilities to impose requirements on selling parties and to enforce action when the rules are not complied with.
Ik ben van mening dat dit stelsel voldoende mogelijkheden biedt om eisen op te leggen aan verkopende partijen en om handhavend op te treden als de regels niet worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert over het bericht dat de VS Turkije uit F-35 programma dreigen te gooien om Russische raketten

CDA MPs Bruins Slot and Van Helvert asked whether the US halting F-35 equipment deliveries to Turkey over its planned purchase of Russian S-400 air defence systems is accurate, whether Nederland agrees with the US reasoning, and whether Dutch industry could take over Turkish F-35 work. The government confirmed the US decision, shared US concerns, said it has raised them bilaterally and in NATO, and declined to speculate on further steps while Turkey remains a partner.
At this stage it is undesirable to speculate openly about possible follow-up steps in the programme.
Het is onwenselijk om in dit stadium openlijk te speculeren over mogelijke vervolgstappen in het programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het voornemen van Italië om zich aan te sluiten bij het Chinese Belt and Road investeringsprogramma

CDA MPs asked the government about Italy's planned accession to China's Belt and Road Initiative, its effect on EU unity, Dutch firms and EU screening of Chinese investment. The minister answered that Italy's MoU is a non-binding intention, that EU rules remain fully applicable, that the EU investment screening regulation was being finalised, and that the government would address China in a forthcoming note.
At this moment it is not possible to make an estimate of this.
Op dit moment is het niet mogelijk hiervan een inschatting te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over de gevolgen van het faillissement van Intertoys

MPs Moorlag, Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked about reports that the owner of bankrupt Intertoys, as a pledge-holding creditor, would be paid ahead of other creditors, whether this shifts business risk onto the tax authority, UWV and staff, and how workers would be helped. The minister said the specific case is for the curator and courts, explained generally how pledges give priority, said the matter is being examined in the bankruptcy law review, and described UWV information sessions and support for workers.
It is not for me to comment on a specific practical situation.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op een specifieke praktijksituatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma en Van Weyenberg over vrouwelijke ondernemers

D66 MPs asked why so few start-ups led by women receive investment, whether women face harder access to credit, and what government will do about it. The ministers answered that the gap is a real underuse of talent, that causes include bias and stereotypes, that no data yet exist on credit applications by women, and that they will commission research, host a roundtable follow-up and seek SER advice on diversity.
We will consider how and within what timeframe such research will take place.
We zullen bezien op welke wijze en welke termijn een dergelijk onderzoek plaats zal vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over het bericht over legitimatieplicht voor verzenders van postpakketten

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked about a proposed identification requirement for senders of parcels, following a Taskforce Brabant-Zeeland call, and whether existing measures against drug trafficking via post are adequate. The Minister answers that existing measures (drug-dog checks, sensing, public-private cooperation with PostNL and other carriers) are part of an integrated approach, and that an ID requirement is not proportionate given parcel volumes, privacy and administrative burden.
Given the total volume of parcel post, the intrusion on privacy and the increase in administrative burden, we consider an identification requirement not proportionate to combat drug crime.

Een legitimatieplicht achten wij gelet op het totale volume aan pakketpost, de inbreuk op de privacy en de verzwaring van de administratieve lasten niet proportioneel om drugscriminaliteit tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over de verzending van drugs via brievenpost

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked whether the government knows how much drugs are mailed from the Netherlands by letter post, whether Dutch businesses and individuals are being misused as senders, whether the Postinterventieteam acts on letter post, and how innocent recipients can avoid being treated as suspects. The Minister answered that volumes are unknown and being studied with partners, that letter post is not structurally checked, that interventions such as taking down darknet sites are desirable, and that people receiving unsolicited drugs should report them to police.
The cabinet is considering with its partners whether the nature and scale can be mapped.
Het kabinet bekijkt met de partners of de aard en omvang in kaart is te brengen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Moorlag over de gevolgen van faillissementen van energiebedrijven voor consumenten

An MP asked the minister about consumer losses from energy supplier bankruptcies (Robin Energie, EnergieFlex), whether a guarantee fund should be created, and whether consumer protection should be strengthened. The minister said supply continuity and licensing with financial checks already protect consumers, and rejected a guarantee fund for risk-shifting and cost reasons while promising to examine extra licensing requirements and monitoring in the Energiewet 1.0.

I have no information about the average amount customers of the bankrupt energy companies Robin Energie and Energieflex may have lost, and I have no insight into how the estates of both bankrupt companies are distributed.

Ik heb geen informatie over het gemiddelde bedrag dat de klanten van de inmiddels failliete energiebedrijven Robin Energie en Energieflex mogelijk zijn misgelopen en ik heb geen inzicht in de boedelverdeling van de beide failliete bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de aanleg van glasvezel en een eventuele opsplitsing van KPN

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about KPN's fibre rollout, alleged strategic building to deter smaller competitors, the pace of reaching universal 100 Mbps broadband, and whether KPN should be split or the infrastructure returned to public ownership. The State Secretary answered that competition among networks is welcome, that the 2023 100 Mbps target is expected to be met given private investment, that targeted state aid remains available for unprofitable addresses, and that she rejects public ownership of the infrastructure.
I will keep following this closely and, as promised in the Telecommunications General Consultation of 17 October 2018, will report to the House on progress annually.
Ik blijf dit nauwlettend volgen en zal de Kamer zoals toegezegd in het Algemeen Overleg Telecommunicatie op 17 oktober 2018 3 jaarlijks over de voortgang rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de aanleg van glasvezel op het platteland

An MP asked the state secretary about fibre roll-out in rural areas, competition concerns with KPN, whether law should favour whole-municipality plans, and whether competition rules should be relaxed for local initiatives. The state secretary answered that the market decides where fibre is laid, that no change to competition law is needed, that EU state-aid rules will be eased for local authorities, and pointed to an action plan with an annual progress report to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Wörsdörfer over het bericht dat Europarlementariërs de Europese Commissie waarschuwen niet de plannen voor een nieuw ruimtevaartprogramma te blokkeren

MPs Veldman and Wörsdörfer asked whether the European Commission intended to withdraw the new EU space programme after a provisional deal had been reached, and what the consequences would be for the Dutch space sector and EU competitiveness. The State Secretary replied that the Commission has not withdrawn the programme, that Council, Parliament and Commission reached a partial agreement at first reading, and that open points such as budgets will be settled later in the MFF negotiations.
It is now clear that the European Commission has not withdrawn the space programme.
Inmiddels is duidelijk dat de Europese Commissie het ruimtevaartprogramma niet heeft teruggetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Wörsdörfer over ‘orange carpet’ initiatieven en barrières bij het aantrekken van startups en scale-ups naar Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about barriers to attracting foreign startups and scale-ups to the Netherlands and about 'orange carpet' initiatives. The state secretary answered that Dutch rankings are good, that some barriers exist (bank accounts, partner labour market access, waiting times), and listed existing and planned measures with commitments to inform parliament later in 2019.
Parliament will be informed further about this in the second half of 2019.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer in de tweede helft van 2019 nader geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over de bescherming van ondernemers uit het midden- kleinbedrijf (mkb) tegen onredelijke energiecontracten en de oproep van de Consumentenbond voor e

MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about protections for small and medium-sized businesses against onerous energy contracts and the Consumentenbond's call for a total ban on telephone sales. The State Secretary answered that small business customers with small connections get consumer protections under energy law, that exit fees are being investigated by the ACM, and that an opt-in regime for telemarketing and an incasso register are being prepared.

Therefore the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, together with the ACM, will consider after this investigation concludes whether further measures are necessary to better protect small business customers.
Daarom beziet de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat samen met de ACM na afronding van dit onderzoek of verdere maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn om kleinzakelijke afnemers beter te beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de consumentenbescherming ingeval van faillissement van een bedrijf dat cadeaukaarten uitgeeft

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about consumer protection when a gift card issuer goes bankrupt, following the Intertoys case where customers redeemed vouchers during a computer outage. The State Secretary said gift card holders are ordinary creditors, rejected giving them priority or mandatory separate accounts, noting that electronic money institutions must safeguard balances while smaller non-EGI issuers fall outside the Wft and voluntary measures are preferred.
A statutory obligation is not necessary in my view at this time, because the current situation provides sufficient consumer protection.
Een wettelijke verplichting vind ik op dit moment niet nodig, omdat de huidige situatie voorziet in voldoende bescherming van de consument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Notarissen staken jarenlang kadastergeld in eigen zak’

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked about reports that notaries charged clients for cadastral fees and levies never actually incurred, and whether this is widespread, unlawful, and whether clients should be refunded. The Minister replied that the disciplinary judge has ruled on the conduct without imposing a sanction, that no structural problem is known so no estimate can be made, that the matter is for the civil court on undue payment, and that the bar association has urged notaries to compensate clients, which the Minister supports.
It is for the disciplinary judge to assess the conduct of a (candidate) notary and to impose measures where appropriate.
Het is aan de tuchtrechter om te oordelen over het handelen van een (kandidaat-)notaris en eventueel maatregelen op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Lodders over het bericht ‘Klokkenluiders kunnen bij misstanden aanbestedingen nergens terecht’

Two VVD MPs asked whether whistleblowers can report misconduct in public procurement, since the competition authority ACM can only act against firms under the cartel ban and not against government bodies or state companies. The state secretary answered that ACM can act against state companies acting as undertakings, that internal checks, the Huis voor Klokkenluiders and the FIOD/OM are the available routes, that no change to the rules is needed, and that research on legal protection in procurement is ongoing with results to parliament before summer.
I am of the view that it is not necessary to expand the current possibilities.
Ik ben van mening dat het niet nodig is om de huidige mogelijkheden uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Moorlag over het bericht ‘Kritiek op Booking.com om aanbieden van bedden in Israëlische nederzettingen’

MPs Van den Hul and Moorlag asked the government whether Booking.com's listing of accommodations in Israeli settlements contributes to rights violations, whether the company meets the UN Guiding Principles, and what sanctions apply to misleading information. The government answered that businesses bear their own responsibility under OECD guidelines, that the ACM supervises misleading-practice rules, and that Booking.com has committed to labelling settlement accommodations as 'Israeli settlement'.
It is up to companies themselves to decide which activities they undertake and to account for them.
Het is aan bedrijven zelf om te bepalen welke activiteiten zij ontplooien en daar verantwoording over af te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Wörsdörfer over de financieringsmogelijkheden van het midden- en kleinbedrijf en de financieringsmonitor van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about SME financing difficulties, the CBS Financing Monitor, and possible policy responses. The State Secretary answered that SME financing is riskier, that Dutch figures are broadly in line with European surveys, and that the government is supporting schemes such as BMKB, Qredits and financing tables, with a CPB study and a Kamerbrief promised.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de Big Brother Award voor de Kamer van Koophandel

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Chamber of Commerce may be required by law to supply business data, including bulk lists sold to third parties, and whether sole traders and legal entities should be shielded from unwanted telemarketing. The secretary answered that the law obliges public register data to be supplied on request, that he will restrict disclosure of home addresses for unincorporated sole traders per a motion, and that legal-entity businesses need no special telemarketing protection.
I consider it desirable to restrict the statutory obligation to supply certain data.
Ik acht het wenselijk om de wettelijke verplichting voor de levering van bepaalde gegevens te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Agnes Mulder, Sienot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Ministerie erkent blunder met energierekening: Tweede Kamer boos’

MPs from VVD, D66, ChristenUnie and CDA asked why the government had used outdated 2017 PBL projections of household energy bills, which underestimated rising prices, and what the consequences are for the 2019 budget, koopkracht and the Klimaatakkoord analysis. Minister Wiebes acknowledges the government should have been less categorical and that the PBL did not update its outlook in 2018, attributes the price rise to market developments and existing policy, and promises a new PBL estimate within weeks.
The cabinet should have been less categorical at the end of last year and should have stressed more that this was a 2017 estimate.
Het kabinet had zich eind vorig jaar minder stellig moeten uitlaten en meer moeten benadrukken dat het hier ging om een raming uit 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht in de Staatscourant dat het budget voor het Innovatiekrediet voor 2019 op 60 miljoen euro is vastgesteld

An MP asked why the 2019 Innovatiekrediet budget was set at 60 million euros when the budget was 70 million structurally, and where the remaining 10 million goes. The state secretary explained that 30 million is set aside for each of the clinical and technical categories, with an additional 10 million expected later in the year, and that the government will examine options for the oversubscribed clinical budget and report in the second half of 2019.
A recent letter on the financing monitor and evaluation of financing instruments has been published.
Recent is de brief Financieringsmonitor en evaluatie financieringsinstrumenten verschenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Four Trends that Blockchain will Dominate in Emerging Tech in 2019’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister of Finance about blockchain developments, government funding, legal frameworks, regulatory sandboxes, bank account access for blockchain firms, a business complaints desk, and regulation abroad. The government answers that blockchain is still maturing, about 2.8 million euros is spent on blockchain research, several legal studies are underway, and it will examine EU financial rules and crypto regulation without finding clear domestic barriers so far.
A cabinet response to the report is expected before the summer recess.
Naar verwachting zal vóór het zomerreces een kabinetsreactie op het rapport volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de kosten van crowdfunding bij Dream or Donate

MP Alkaya (SP) asked whether the fees charged by crowdfunding platform Dream or Donate for medical fundraising are proportionate, whether consumer and financial oversight should be tightened, and whether new rules on platform fees are planned. Staatssecretaris Keijzer replied that existing consumer protection rules and ACM oversight are adequate, the matter is for ACM and the courts, and no new regulation is needed.
The assessment of Dream or Donate's conduct is for the competent supervisor, the ACM, and ultimately for the courts.
De beoordeling van de handelwijze van Dream or Donate is aan de betrokken toezichthouder ACM en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de mogelijk negatieve effecten van de e-privacyrichtlijn op het werk van het Expertise Centrum Online Kindermisbruik

MP Van Nispen asked whether the ePrivacy Directive would prevent the EOKM and private parties from scanning uploads for child sexual abuse material without user consent, and whether the EOKM could keep using its hash database. The State Secretary answered that uploads are not preventively scanned, that ePrivacy rules stop applying once content reaches the host's server so hash-based removal remains possible, and that national exceptions for crime prevention may be explored.
Regarding the approach to child pornographic content, I am considering together with the Minister of Justice and Security to explore this option if the number of reports does not decline.
Voor wat betreft de aanpak van kinderpornografische inhoud overweeg ik samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid deze optie te verkennen wanneer het aantal meldingen niet daalt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Europa op grote achterstand in strijd om digitale hegemonie’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about a report claiming Europe lags behind in the platform economy, whether foreign platforms face weaker regulation, and what policy steps could help. The State Secretary largely reassured that the Netherlands performs well, pointed to existing EU and national enforcement, startup support and a consultation on competition policy, and gave other questions only general answers or referred to later letters.
However, I have no direct indications that the Dutch competitive position is under pressure from foreign platforms.
Ik heb echter nog geen directe aanwijzingen dat de Nederlandse concurrentiepositie onder druk staat door buitenlandse platforms.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over het bericht dat criminelen misbruik maken van pakketbezorgers PostNL

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked about reports that criminals exploit PostNL parcel delivery, the cooperation with police, prosecutors and tax authorities, intimidation of couriers, unlicensed courier firms, and whether subcontractor pay drives violations. The government describes the PIT team and seizures, notes the RIEC pilot, says licensing thresholds stay unchanged and that PostNL and subcontractors set their own terms, while liability for wage violations exists under existing law.
No information is given about further outcomes of this approach or follow-up in individual cases.
Over verdere uitkomsten van deze werkwijze en opvolging daarvan in individuele gevallen worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht dat ondernemers schrikken van de Brexit

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that entrepreneurs are alarmed by Brexit, the number of Brexit information-point users, the share of unprepared firms, EORI registrations and additional outreach. The government answered that demand for Brexit information is rising, that a broad instrument mix exists, and that the campaign and stakeholder cooperation will be intensified.
Preparing for Brexit is ultimately the responsibility of the entrepreneur themselves; failing to start preparations in time is worrying.
Het voorbereiden op de Brexit is uiteindelijk de verantwoordelijkheid van de ondernemer zelf; het niet tijdig starten met de voorbereidingen is zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het feit dat er in Frankrijk een verbod is op reclame voor apotheken

An MP asked the government about France's ban on advertising by pharmacies and whether it creates a barrier to the EU internal market, and whether the Netherlands will submit input to a pending Court of Justice case and examine other internal-market barriers. The government said it will submit written observations to the Court because of the broader interest in a complete digital internal market, and committed to pursuing better enforcement of internal-market rules.
Because of the broader interest in ensuring a complete internal (digital) market, the Dutch government will submit written observations.
Vanwege het bredere belang van het verzekeren van een volledige interne (digitale) markt zal de Nederlandse regering schriftelijke opmerkingen indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Weverling over het bericht ‘112 onbereikbaar door accudieven’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that battery theft from telecom masts threatens 112 availability, and whether it is being tackled. The minister answered that emergency calls are largely protected by roaming and call priority, that police registered 136 theft reports in 2018 with few arrests, that no data exists on outages caused by theft, and that police prioritise theft by seriousness and indicators, with regional consultations possible.
Theft of emergency power batteries therefore does not directly lead to reduced availability.
Diefstal van noodstroomaccu’s leidt dan ook niet direct tot een verminderde bereikbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de productconformiteit van PC’s, laptops, tablets, smart TV’s, slimme thermostaten en andere slimme apparatuur thuis

An MP asked the State Secretary whether consumer electronics with components that cannot be replaced cheaply conform to Dutch consumer sales law, and whether the manufacturers could be pressed to make parts replaceable at reasonable cost. The State Secretary answered that non-conformity requires free repair or replacement regardless of cost, that the burden of proof shifts after six months, and that manufacturers decide their own production choices, so no further action was committed.
It is up to manufacturers to make choices about how they organise their production process.
Het is aan fabrikanten om keuzes te maken over de inrichting van hun productieproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een boekhoudkundige truc om aan openbaarmaking van de jaarrekening te ontkomen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Blokker family evades annual accounts disclosure by periodically inserting a new parent company above HB Capital, and whether this should be closed off. The government answered that a subsidiary's publication duty only lapses if the parent publishes consolidated accounts and files a 403 declaration, that the transparency rules still apply, and that it sees no loophole requiring legislative change.
As appears from the answers above, I see no loophole in the law.
Zoals blijkt uit de bovenstaande antwoorden, zie ik geen maas in de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over kansen voor Nederlandse batterij-industrie

MPs from the CDA asked the government whether a German one-billion-euro battery investment, possible Dutch battery opportunities, EU state aid rules and related Dutch initiatives could be supported. The State Secretary answered that Germany's plan is national but aligned with the EU initiative, that the Netherlands is exploring battery opportunities via RVO.nl, and that talks with the Commission and a Twente R&D initiative are ongoing, without firm commitments yet.
The German initiative is not yet sufficiently developed to establish whether, and if so how, it will use European funds, and whether it will conflict with European competition rules.

Het Duitse initiatief is nog onvoldoende uitgewerkt om te kunnen vaststellen of, en zo ja, hoe het gebruik zal maken van Europese middelen, en of het ook tegen Europese mededingingsregels zal aanlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het 'uitrusten' van werknemers met microchips

An SP MP asked ministers whether employers may require or request workers to have microchips implanted, citing a UK case, and how such practices relate to GDPR, bodily integrity and the role of supervisors. The minister said such practices must respect privacy and bodily integrity, that the case is hypothetical for the Netherlands, that implanting microchips would likely be unlawful given the employer-employee relationship and biometric data rules, and that workers can complain to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and Inspectie SZW.
Privacy, human dignity and protection of bodily integrity are fundamental rights that must also be protected in a rapidly digitalising work environment.
Privacy, menselijke waardigheid en de bescherming van de lichamelijke integriteit zijn fundamentele rechten die ook in een snel digitaliserende werkomgeving beschermd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de gevolgen van een faillissement van een energieleverancier voor consumenten

An MP asked the minister about consumer consequences when energy supplier EnergieFlex went bankrupt, including whether prepaid advances are privileged, the Consumentenbond's role and liability, the licence withdrawal timing, and whether solvency requirements or a guarantee fund should apply. The minister answered that consumers have no preferential creditor status, that customers were transferred to another supplier under the security-of-supply decrees, that Consumentenbond liability is a matter for contract law, and that solvency is checked only at licensing.
The handling of the EnergieFlex bankruptcy is still ongoing.
De afhandeling van het faillissement van EnergieFlex loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het gebruik van gegevens uit registers van de Kamer van Koophandel voor telemarketing

An MP asked the State Secretary whether unwanted telemarketing using Chamber of Commerce register data should be curbed, including refusal of data release, opt-out options and enforcement cooperation. The State Secretary said the register is public by law, pointed to privacy regulators and the Bel-me-niet register, announced a forthcoming opt-in proposal and more coordination with the Chamber and regulators.
I am considering balanced measures that limit unwanted direct marketing using commercial register data, while safeguarding the openness of the register for its statutory purposes.

Ik beraad mij op evenwichtige maatregelen die ongewenste direct marketing met handelsregistergegevens beperken, en tegelijk de openbaarheid van het handelsregister ten behoeve van haar wettelijke doelen borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de uitzending van Radar over zzp’ers en acquisitiefraude

An MP asks the State Secretary about a Radar broadcast on aggressive energy-contract sales to self-employed entrepreneurs, including whether the Chamber of Commerce facilitates unsolicited telemarketing by openly distributing business contact data, how privacy will be better protected, and whether the ACM should get more powers. The State Secretary says the register's openness serves legal certainty, that a balanced set of measures on direct marketing is being prepared, and that expanding ACM powers is not the solution; he declines to answer question 8 on timing.
I am considering balanced measures that limit unwanted direct marketing using trade register data while still safeguarding the openness of the trade register for its legal purposes.

Ik beraad mij op evenwichtige maatregelen die ongewenste direct marketing met handelsregistergegevens beperkt, en tegelijk de openbaarheid van het handelsregister ten behoeve van haar wettelijke doelen borgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Von Martels over het feit dat ASML in België medische isotopen gaat ontwikkelen

MPs from the CDA asked why the Lighthouse medical isotope project, named a Dutch National Icon, is being developed in Belgium instead of the Netherlands, and what financing was tried. The government answered that Lighthouse keeps its icon status, that Dutch private investors judged the risk too high, and that the Belgian IRE is now the partner, with the state-aid compliance left to Belgium.
It is up to the Belgian government to ensure that the agreements comply with the European state aid rules.
Het is aan de Belgische overheid om te zorgen dat de afspraken voldoen aan de Europese staatssteunregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Lodders over de wachttijden voor ondernemers om zich in te schrijven in het handelsregister van de Kamer van Koophandel

Two MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretaries about waiting times of about three weeks for entrepreneurs to register at the Chamber of Commerce, including regional differences, the causes and VAT number delays. The government answered with regional waiting times of 4 to 14 days, measures taken to reduce them, and an explanation of VAT number timing, while stating it does not yet meet its 7-day target everywhere.
The KvK does not meet the target of a maximum waiting time of seven calendar days in all regions.
De KvK voldoet niet in alle regio’s aan de doelstelling van een maximale wachttijd van zeven kalenderdagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het verstrekken van Staatsgaranties bij financiering van franchiseondernemingen

MP Moorlag asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about state-guaranteed loans (BMKB) for franchise businesses, including whether banks supply overly rosy or incorrect information, whether RVO acts against applicants who withhold information, and what remedies franchisees have if misled by a bank. The State Secretary answered that banks act as the loan gateway and bear responsibility for the assessment, that RVO checks loss claims and can reject them, and that RVO knows of no cases of deliberate misinformation in franchise guarantees.
The special feature of the BMKB scheme is, however, that it is not RVO but the credit provider that fulfils the gateway role.
Het bijzondere van de BMKB-regeling is echter dat niet RVO, maar de kredietverlener de rol van loketfunctie vervult.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het gebruik van ruimtevaart voor het verkrijgen van data over onder andere ammoniak

An MP asked the government about the role of space-based data in refining the nitrogen and ammonia measurement network and whether this should be included in a forthcoming ammonia policy letter. The minister replied that satellite data is not yet suitable for near-surface concentration measurement and referred the technical detail to a RIVM briefing.

Satellite observations are currently not yet suitable for measuring concentrations close to the earth's surface (in a distinguishing way), so they cannot contribute to refining the current measurement networks.

Satellietwaarnemingen zijn momenteel echter nog niet geschikt om concentraties dicht bij het aardoppervlak (onderscheidend) te meten, om zo een bijdrage te kunnen leveren aan verfijning van de huidige meetnetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de stakingen van postbezorgers bij PostNL

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about PostNL strikes by postal workers over the introduction of the combibundel and reorganisations, and whether PostNL should be asked to postpone them. The State Secretary said workers may express their views through strikes, that employers must consult works councils and workers on work risks and changes, and that she will not interfere in PostNL's internal business decisions, citing the need for structural changes to finance the universal postal service.
It is not for me to interfere in the internal business processes of a market party and the choices it makes in doing so.
Het is niet aan mij om me te bemoeien met het interne bedrijfsproces van een marktpartij en de keuzes die deze daarbij maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Spanish cities grapple with invasion of electric scooters’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about Spanish cities struggling with electric scooters and whether similar initiatives, safety rules and experimentation room exist in the Netherlands. The minister replied that electric steps are currently classed as special mopeds with rules being reviewed by SWOV, RDW and the Safety Board, that municipalities cannot themselves admit vehicles to public roads, and that the Strategic Road Safety Plan will take these developments into account.
Municipalities cannot independently decide to admit vehicles to the public road.
Gemeenten kunnen niet zelfstandig besluiten om voertuigen toe te laten tot de openbare weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het Bel-me-niet-Register

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about why people on the Bel-me-niet register still receive unsolicited sales calls, whether former customers should be exempt from calls, whether small businesses can register, and how consumers can exercise their right of objection more easily. The state secretary acknowledged the confusion, announced a shift to a statutory opt-in system and a review of telemarketing, said self-regulation talks will come first, and explained the register and objection rights are available to individuals and can be invoked during a call.
I am therefore considering measures to address this, but I think it is important to first hold talks with the telemarketing sector.
Ik overweeg dan ook maatregelen om dit aan te pakken maar ik vind het belangrijk om hierover eerst gesprekken te voeren met de telemarketing sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het onderzoek van de Consumentenbond dat veel winkels zich schuldig maken aan nepaanbiedingen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a Consumentenbond study finding fake discounts in many shops, whether earlier findings were not addressed, and whether shops are unaware of the Unfair Commercial Practices Act. The State Secretary said there is no data on how often fake discounts occur, cannot confirm that shops failed to improve, and that the study cannot support general conclusions, while welcoming such research alongside ACM oversight.
I have no data on how often such fake discounts occur.
Ik heb geen gegevens over hoe vaak dergelijke nepaanbiedingen voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Australische overheid verbiedt Huawei en ZTE apparatuur te leveren voor 5g’

MP Verhoeven asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers whether they know of Australia's ban on Huawei and ZTE 5G equipment, whether the Netherlands will follow, and how such national-security decisions are made, including at EU level. The government answered that it assesses risks case by case on the basis of state-actor threats and legal duties to cooperate, declined to speculate on future measures, and said the existing framework is flexible enough and that national security remains a member-state responsibility.

Given the national security interests and the interests of business, there is no anticipating or speculating on which products, services or companies may or may not pose a risk to national security, or on possible future measures.

Gezien de nationale veiligheidsbelangen en de belangen van het bedrijfsleven wordt niet vooruitgelopen op of gespeculeerd over welke producten, diensten of bedrijven al dan niet een risico zouden kunnen vormen voor de nationale veiligheid en over al dan niet mogelijke toekomstige maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over winkels die nep-aanbiedingen doen

An MP asked the state secretary whether misleading 'original price' claims by webshops violate the Dutch unfair trading practices law and what would be done about them, including stronger ACM enforcement and talks with the Consumentenbond. The state secretary agreed such claims are prohibited, said the ACM is responsible for enforcement under its independent priority-setting, and committed only to existing regular consultation with the consumer organisation.
However, it is up to the ACM to decide, based on its own priority-setting policy, whether or not to take enforcement action.
Het is echter aan de ACM om op basis van het eigen prioriteringsbeleid te besluiten al dan niet handhavend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de geloofwaardigheid van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM)

An MP asked the state secretary whether the competition regulator ACM is less willing than European peers to use formal sanctions, and whether its informal enforcement should be more transparent. The state secretary replied that ACM uses both informal and formal tools, that three formal enforcement decisions were taken since October 2017, and that transparency is sufficient, while promising a broader evaluation of ACM in the future.
I consider it important that infringements of the competition rules can also lead to fines, as they have a deterrent and preventive effect.
Ik vind het van belang dat overtredingen van de mededingingsregels ook tot boetes kunnen leiden, omdat daar een afschrikwekkend en preventief effect van uitgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘430.000 gulden voor onderzeeër’

An MP asked the Defence and Economic Affairs state secretaries about reports on the submarine replacement project and the new Defence Industry Strategy, including timing and industrial participation. The government answered that the strategy will be published in Q4 2018, that market consultation with potential suppliers was held, and that the B-brief on submarines is delayed to early 2019 but the strategy will be sent to parliament before it.
The DIS will be sent to the House earlier than the B-letter on replacing submarine capacity.
De DIS zal eerder aan de Kamer worden aangeboden dan de B-brief voor de vervanging van onderzeebootcapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de partijdigheid van de evaluatie van de netneutraliteitsverordening

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the consultancy Bird & Bird, which previously challenged Dutch net neutrality law, can impartially evaluate the net neutrality regulation, and how zero-rating concerns will be addressed. The State Secretary answered that the European Commission selects contractors under procurement rules, that conflicts of interest are contractually covered, that zero-rating is governed by BEREC guidelines, and that no action in Brussels is planned.
If the Commission considers that there is nevertheless a conflict of interests, it may terminate the contract.
Als de Commissie van oordeel is dat er desalniettemin sprake is van conflicterende belangen kan zij de overeenkomst beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het benutten van sociale ondernemingen via de Aanbestedingswet voor het creëren van banenkansen voor mensen met achterstand op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked the State Secretaries whether Article 2.82 of the Public Procurement Act is meant to increase employment for people far from the labour market, whether reserved contracts should be attractive to authorities, and whether seconded workers count toward the 30% threshold for reserved tenders. The government answered that Article 2.82 does aim to increase such employment, that reserved contracts are supported, and that whether seconded workers count depends on interpreting 'werknemer' and is ultimately for the courts to decide.
Whether seconded workers can be classed as employees under this article is a question of interpreting the law.
Of gedetacheerde werknemers aangemerkt kunnen worden als werknemers binnen dit artikel is een vraag naar de interpretatie van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Oosten over het tegengaan van winkeldiefstal

MPs Wörsdörfer and Van Oosten asked about the scale of shop theft, use of collective shop bans, and whether filing a police report is required for civil settlements and information sharing. The minister said reliable damage figures cannot yet be given and a follow-up study is underway, that bans are used with few obstacles, that police are improving the reporting process, and that a report is needed for the standard civil charge but not for sharing information within the ban system.
A follow-up study is currently being carried out to answer whether it is possible to achieve proper registration and reliable data.
Op dit moment wordt een vervolgonderzoek uitgevoerd dat antwoord moet geven op de vraag of het mogelijk is tot een goede registratie en betrouwbare gegevens te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over betaaltermijnen aan mkb’ers

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about longer payment terms for SMEs, whether the 2018 payment-term law is working, and whether an earlier evaluation, supplier-imposed conditions, EU comparisons and long-term risks will be examined. The State Secretary largely defended the current policy, declined to bring the evaluation forward, and said further investigation of contract conditions is uncertain.
No, I do not consider it useful to start an evaluation earlier than the planned date of mid-2019.
Nee, het starten van een evaluatie eerder dan het geplande tijdstip van medio 2019 acht ik niet zinvol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Kostenbesparende operatie 'brievenbus weghalen' is in volle gang’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about PostNL's plan to remove nearly half of Dutch letter boxes, its legal basis, consultation with the ACM and vulnerable groups, and whether removals should be reversed. The State Secretary answered that the 2016 loosened spreading rules allow about 8,700 boxes, that the legal consultation process with consumer organisations is in place, that the ACM sees no current breaches, and that the government will keep the minimum number without reversing removals.
I have understood from the ACM that there are currently no indications that PostNL is not complying with the rules on the availability of letter boxes.
Ik heb van de ACM begrepen dat er op dit moment geen indicaties zijn dat PostNL zich niet houdt aan de regels ten aanzien van de beschikbaarheid van brievenbussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de verhoging van de postzegelprijs

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the ACM allowed PostNL to raise stamp prices by 14.2%, and whether affordability, accessibility and shareholder payouts were considered. The State Secretary answered that the ACM applies statutory tariff rules, that the price is PostNL's decision, that accessibility and affordability are under pressure but guaranteed, and that the ACM should keep supervising prices.
I value this division of roles and am of the opinion that supervision by the ACM contributes to safeguarding the public interest of affordable universal postal service.
Ik hecht aan deze rolverdeling en ben van mening dat toezicht door de ACM bijdraagt aan het borgen van het publieke belang van een betaalbare UPD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het niet aansluiten Standaard Bedrijfsindeling (SBI) op economische activiteiten in de digitale economie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the Standard Industrial Classification (SBI) adequately captures the digital economy and whether it should be adapted, and whether other classifications have the same gap.
