The State Secretary agreed that a single SBI-based delineation of the internet economy is not possible, said he would consult Statistics Netherlands on international adjustment while noting this needs European consensus, and pointed to CBS monitoring and a digital transformation monitor.
Nevertheless, I will consult with CBS to explore the possibilities for internationally adapting the SBI so that it better reflects new developments in the digital economy.
Niettemin zal ik in overleg gaan met CBS om na te gaan wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de SBI internationaal aan te passen om nieuwe ontwikkelingen in de digitale economie beter te reflecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Weverling over het bericht ‘Multibandveiling zou ook 2021 kunnen worden’

MPs Paternotte and Weverling asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the multiband spectrum auction might slip to 2021, and about the timing dependence on the European Commission's decision on the T-Mobile/Tele2 merger. The State Secretary answered that the auction still aims for late 2019 but may slip a few months, depending mainly on the Commission's merger decision and the ACM advice, and declined to speculate on scenarios.
In this matter I must be cautious and restrained toward the European Commission, given its independent position as regulator.
Ik dien me in deze zaak overigens behoedzaam en terughoudend op te stellen richting de Europese Commissie gegeven diens onafhankelijke positie als toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Koopmans over het bericht ‘Mkb kan uitzondering op nieuwe strenge privacywet wel vergeten’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about SME compliance costs and vague AVG rules, including the register obligation and data storage scope, and about the Data Protection Authority's enforcement approach. The government estimated compliance costs, pointed to existing guidance and brochures, said the register duty largely replaces the earlier notification duty, and described the AP's independent focus on education and proportionate enforcement.
The AP is an independent supervisor that makes its own supervisory choices.
De AP is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die zelf haar toezichtskeuzes maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het plan om brievenbussen weg te halen in Gorinchem

An MP asked the state secretary why PostNL plans to remove eight letterboxes in Gorinchem, including ones that disability advocates consider essential, and whether PostNL will re-engage local organisations. The secretary answered that PostNL follows a legally based locatiebeleid with a consultation process, that the regulator ACM supervises it, and declined to ask PostNL to re-engage, saying existing rules are sufficient.

In my firm conviction, PostNL carries out this process with great care, provides timely communication to the local representatives and administrators concerned, and already tries to deliver as much tailored service as possible.

Naar mijn stellige overtuiging doorloopt PostNL dit proces uitermate zorgvuldig, verzorgt zij tijdige communicatie met betrokken lokale vertegenwoordigers en bestuurders en tracht zij reeds zoveel mogelijk maatwerk te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Arno Rutte, Middendorp en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Agentschap Telecom slaat alarm over hackbare apparaten’

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government shares the Agentschap Telecom's call to hurry a security mark for 'smart' connected devices, how it is progressing, and related questions on consumer visibility, ISP involvement, company-led certification and innovation. The government answers that it supports a European CE-type mark with mandatory minimum digital security requirements under the Radio Equipment Directive, that it has proposed this in Europe, and that it is working with ISPs and on EU cybersecurity certification.

Together with the European Commission, the cabinet is examining how to give effect to the aforementioned possibility of extending the current CE mark of the RED with minimum digital security requirements for wireless devices.

Met de Europese Commissie onderzoekt het kabinet hoe invulling te gegeven aan voornoemde mogelijkheid om het huidige CE-keurmerk van de RED uit te breiden met minimale eisen aan de digitale veiligheid van draadloze apparaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over onveilige telefoons van Samsung

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about Samsung's refusal to provide security updates for phones older than two years, asking about scale, product safety under consumer law, and new legislation. The State Secretary said there is no data on how many citizens are affected, that product safety must be judged case by case, and pointed to the Roadmap Digitaal Veilige Hard- en Software, EU radio equipment and cybersecurity measures, and an EU digital content directive that would oblige sellers to provide security updates.
I will go into this further when answering the other questions.
Ik ga hier nader op in bij de beantwoording van de overige vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Koopmans over gebruik informatie uit het Handelsregister voor facebook-targeting

Two VVD MPs asked how Chamber of Commerce register data could be used for Facebook targeting, whether that is permitted, and whether the privacy of sole traders is affected. The Secretary of State said the register is public under the Handelsregisterwet, the KvK does not offer data for advertising purposes, privacy may be at stake, and talks with the Data Protection Authority are ongoing and confidential.
The talks between the KvK, the Data Protection Authority and EZK are still ongoing and take place in a confidential atmosphere.
De gesprekken tussen de KvK, de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens en EZK zijn nog gaande en vinden plaats in een vertrouwelijke sfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het gebruik van gegevens uit het handelsregister voor direct marketing aan ZZP’ers en kleine ondernemers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about KvK selling Trade Register data for direct marketing to self-employed persons, the share of KvK revenue from data sales, how many registrants have private addresses exposed, and whether the KvK should depend on data sales and how intrusion can be limited. The State Secretary answered that data sales have stayed around 25-30% of KvK income, that the register is public by law, that the Non Mailing Indicator exists and KvK is studying extending it to e-mail and phone, and that the questions would be addressed in the upcoming amendment of the Trade Register Act.
The KvK is currently examining the possibilities to extend the NMI to e-mail and telephone.
De KvK onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden om de NMI uit te breiden naar e-mail en telefoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over het bericht dat informatie van de Kamer van Koophandel gebruikt wordt voor reclamedoeleinden

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked why the Chamber of Commerce (KvK) sells business register data that companies are obliged to provide, which is then used for targeted advertising, and what protections businesses have. The State Secretary answered that the register's public nature requires disclosure, that recipients bear their own privacy-law responsibility, and pointed to the Non Mailing Indicator, the Bel-me-niet register and ongoing exploration of extending protections, but committed only to continued contact with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
The KvK is currently investigating the possibilities to extend the NMI to email and telephone.
De KvK onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden om de NMI uit te breiden naar e-mail en telefoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het kunnen bijhouden van de innovatierace door mkb’ers

Mr Amhaouch (CDA) asked whether SMEs in the metal sector can keep up with rapid digitalisation and robotisation, and whether innovation subsidy criteria should be broadened to cover process innovation. State Secretary Keijzer answered that government supports innovation broadly, that process innovation is already supported via MIT, WBSO and Invest-NL, and that the WBSO evaluation this year will examine process innovation.
This will be taken into account in the evaluation of the WBSO, which takes place this year.
Dit wordt in de evaluatie van de WBSO, die dit jaar plaatsvindt, meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het voorkomen van wangiri-fraude

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg asked how wangiri phone fraud via Dutch and foreign numbers can be prevented and whether operators can block high-tariff numbers. The government answered that no reliable figures exist, that operators and the ACM have some blocking and anti-fraud options, and that enforcement is difficult because it is international, while promising to inform the House if relevant developments arise.
I am willing to inform the House further if relevant developments occur in the consultations with the telecom sector.
Ik ben bereid de Kamer nader te informeren als zich relevante ontwikkelingen voordoen in het overleg met de telecomsector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Kent over het ontduiken van het minimumloon door Sandd

MPs Alkaya and Van Kent asked whether postal company Sandd is evading the minimum wage by paying couriers on fixed norm hours rather than actual hours worked, and how the 80% employment norm was met. The minister answers that the minimum wage applies per hour worked, that the Inspectorate SZW is aware of the FNV complaint, that ACM found postal firms compliant with the 80% norm, and that a sector-wide collective agreement is for social partners to decide.
I cannot make statements about the specific situation at Sandd.
Over de specifieke situatie bij Sandd kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Yesilgöz-Zegerius inzake het bericht 'Haven wil CO2 duurder maken'

MPs Dijkstra and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether a Northwest-European minimum CO2 price proposed by the Port of Rotterdam is realistic, how to avoid a Dutch go-it-alone, what investments a €50-70 price would bring, and how to keep chemical industry and the port competitive in the energy transition. The minister answered that the government seeks Northwest-European cooperation and flanking policy, is still studying a minimum CO2 price within the national Klimaatakkoord process, and has sector tables examining industrial investment projects.
The cabinet explicitly seeks cooperation with like-minded Northwest European countries.
Het kabinet zoekt nadrukkelijk samenwerking met gelijkgezinde Noordwest-Europese landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de tegenstelling tussen de woorden en daden in het innovatiebeleid van het departement

MP Van der Lee asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the ministry's innovation spending contradicts its stated focus on specific, thematic innovation, citing a press analysis showing generic spending rising while specific spending fell. The State Secretary disputes that analysis, presenting figures showing specific innovation spending rose 56% (EZK) since 2012 and generic spending 8%, and says generic and specific policy complement each other and will both be kept.
Before the summer I will send your House a letter elaborating this policy adjustment in connection with the intensification of funds for applied research in the coalition agreement.
Voor de zomer stuur ik uw Kamer een brief waarin deze beleidsaanpassing wordt uitgewerkt in samenhang met de in het Regeerakkoord opgenomen intensivering van middelen voor toegepast onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Veldman over de langere betalingstermijn aan Mkb'ers

MPs Wörsdörfer and Veldman asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about supermarkets paying suppliers later and whether SMEs are harmed by late payment, including government payment times. The state secretary answered that payment behaviour is improving, that no cases of SMEs in financial trouble from this trend are known, and that the government is monitoring payment times and has the 60-day payment law and the Betaalme.nu initiative in place.
The number of cases in which payment deviated from the 30 or 60 days is not available; these data are not on hand.
Het aantal gevallen waarbij er werd afgeweken van de 30 of 60 dagen is niet inzichtelijk, deze gegevens zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over late betalingen door en marktmacht van Nederlandse supermarkten

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked the government about late payments by Dutch supermarkets to suppliers, bank-financed payment schemes, and whether rising market power and concentration threaten competition. The State Secretary answered that existing payment-term rules apply to supermarkets, a Commission proposal on unfair trading practices is being assessed, a ban on assignment clauses is planned, and that the ACM already polices abuse of dominance case by case, while declining to speculate on causes or commission a broad market-power study.
It is not for me to speculate on the underlying reason for supermarkets' conduct.
Het is niet aan mij om te speculeren over wat de achterliggende reden van het handelen van supermarkten is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over een vorm van slavernij bij PostNL

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked whether working conditions for agency sorters at PostNL amount to a form of slavery, including pace of work, heavy lifting, breaks, standby pay, underpayment and bypassing the collective agreement. The ministers answered that employers bear primary responsibility under the Working Conditions Act and that the Labour Inspectorate enforces the rules, that the underpayment matter is before the civil court, and that they saw no reason to meet PostNL's management.
Following the findings of the investigation, the FNV summoned PostNL and agency InPerson before the civil court on 22 February 2018.
Naar aanleiding van de uitkomsten uit het onderzoek heeft de FNV op 22 februari 2018 PostNL en uitzendbureau InPerson voor de civiele rechter gedaagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Von Martels over het omgaan met de mogelijkheden om deelplatforms te kunnen onderwerpen aan nationale regels

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers whether a 2018 EU Court ruling allowing member states to regulate taxi platforms changes Dutch policy on regulating sharing-economy platforms and their enforcement. The government replied that the ruling does not extend member-state freedom beyond existing taxi rules, that platform regulation requires case-by-case assessment, and that it pursues dialogue with platforms, a regulatory review by the ATR due in Q3 2018, and improved fiscal enforcement.
There is no reason to impose new rules on taxi platforms in the Netherlands.
Voor het opleggen van nieuwe regels aan taxiplatforms in Nederland is geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Betalen om op te zeggen’

An MP asked the government whether insurers charging cancellation fees after one year or more deter consumers from switching, and whether insurers should fall under the Van Dam Act if the Insurers' Association keeps charging them. The minister replied that such fees must be disclosed pre-contractually, that the Association will review its code of conduct with insurers, and that no extension of the Van Dam Act is currently planned.
I am keeping an eye on developments.
Ik houd de ontwikkelingen in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat consumenten opzegkosten moeten betalen voor het opzeggen van een schadeverzekering

An MP asked whether insurers charging exit fees for cancelling damage insurance deter consumers from switching, and whether the industry code and the Van Dam Act should be tightened. The minister answered that exit fees must be disclosed upfront, that the industry says most insurers no longer charge them, and that the code will be tightened, but saw no reason to bring insurers under the Van Dam Act.
I think it is a good thing that insurers are getting to work on this.
Ik vind het een goede zaak dat verzekeraars hiermee aan de slag gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht ‘Kleine ondernemers in actie voor lagere pinkosten’

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers whether small businesses and SMEs are being used as cash cows through higher card-payment fees and what will be done to lower them. The minister answered that fee differences reflect volume-based pricing in a competitive market, that existing convenant arrangements freeze tariffs, and that no intervention is needed for now, though the parties will be asked to pay attention to small merchants in the 2018 evaluation.
I do not currently know which providers charge which costs to which customer segments.
Het is mij op dit moment niet bekend welke aanbieders precies welke kosten rekenen voor welke klantsegmenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de telefonische verkoop van ongevraagde producten

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a company selling a 'free' puzzle book that turns out to be a subscription, asking whether this practice is permissible, whether the ACM has fined a related firm, whether it is investigating, how often it receives complaints, and whether the written-consent requirement should extend to telephone sales. The State Secretary says the ACM is responsible for enforcement, confirms a 2015 EUR 200,000 fine against a related company, declines to comment on ongoing investigations, notes the written-consent rule already applies to certain telephone sales, and says the ACM discussions and an EU study will inform whether legislation should change.

I am in discussion with the ACM about the conclusions of this study. The outcomes of these discussions, which also cover the written-consent requirement, I will take into account in considering whether there is sufficient reason to amend legislation.

Ik ben met de ACM in gesprek over de conclusies van dit onderzoek. De uitkomsten van deze gesprekken, waar ook het schriftelijkheidsvereiste aan bod komt, neem ik mee in mijn overweging of er voldoende aanleiding is voor het aanpassen van wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de risico's die de overbelasting van de elektriciteitsvoorziening brengt voor de digitale koppositie van Nederland

An MP asks the minister about grid capacity shortages threatening datacenter growth in the Netherlands, including a Schiphol outage, the causes of delays, and industry proposals. The minister answers that no current shortage is shown, that a new substation site is needed in Haarlemmermeer, that investment-planning rules were tightened in the Wet Voortgang Energietransitie, and that the issue will be addressed in the climate accord talks, without committing to a dedicated working group.
The cause of the outage that occurred at Schiphol on 29 April is not yet known.
De oorzaak van de storing die zich 29 april jl. op Schiphol heeft voorgedaan is nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Wörsdörfer en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Kabinet zet koppositie ICT op het spel, waarschuwt Eelco Blok’

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether they agreed with Eelco Blok's claim that the cabinet lacks a long-term ICT vision and risks Dutch digital leadership, and asked about spectrum auction timing and the national digitalisation strategy. The government disputed the claim, pointed to Dutch strengths and the coming Digitaliseringsstrategie, and confirmed that auction dates and the 3.5 GHz options would be sent to parliament before the relevant recesses.
To be able to lead in the coming years, the coalition agreement contains the necessary ambitions and actions regarding digitalisation.
Om de komende jaren voorop te kunnen lopen, bevat het regeerakkoord de nodige ambities en acties bevat als het gaat om digitalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel 'Bij revolverende fondsen fungeert de overheid als bank'

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about an article claiming that public revolving funds (FMO's catalysed capital, DVI investment leverage, market distortion) are misreported and that parliament lacks information on their results. The State Secretary rejects the criticism, says the calculation differences do not apply to ministry funds, and promises to share the Court of Audit's forthcoming study on revolving funds with parliament.

The information on the revolving funds and the cabinet's response to the study and any recommendations of the Court of Audit will be shared with parliament as soon as possible upon completion of the study.

De informatie over de revolverende fondsen en de reactie van het kabinet op het onderzoek en eventuele aanbevelingen van de Algemene Rekenkamer, worden met de afronding van het onderzoek zo snel mogelijk gedeeld met het parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de onduidelijke kosten van uitvaartverzorgers

MP Moorlag asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate whether funeral costs are clear in advance, whether bereaved can compare prices, and whether undertakers should be made more transparent. The State Secretary says existing consumer law already requires costs to be clear before contracting, that comparison is possible via offers and websites, and that no additional measures are needed now, leaving improvement to the sector and ACM enforcement.
At this moment I do not consider additional measures necessary.
Op dit moment acht ik aanvullende maatregelen niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Wörsdörfer over het btw-nummer van zzp’ers

VVD MPs Lodders and Wörsdörfer asked whether self-employed people working from home must publish their home address in the Chamber of Commerce register, how they are protected against identity fraud, and whether the VAT number containing the BSN can be avoided. The government answered that the register publicly shows home and business addresses for sole traders for traceability and legal certainty, that home addresses can be shielded on request, and that it is investigating options for VAT numbers without the BSN.
I have no indications that the public disclosure of this information in the trade register creates an increased risk of identity fraud.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de openbaarheid van deze gegevens in het handelsregister een vergroot risico op identiteitsfraude oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over de gevolgen van Kaderprogramma 9 voor het Meerjarig Financieel Kader

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate whether Council conclusions on industrial policy amount to a call to raise the EU budget (MFK), and why the minister said the MFK was not on the agenda. The State Secretary answered that the conclusions are not a call for a higher MFK, that the MFK was not discussed at the Competitiveness Council, and that the government will improve referencing of agenda documents in future.
As discussed in the General Committee on Information Provision of 12 April, the cabinet will give extra attention to proper referencing in the annotated agenda and cabinet letters.
Zoals besproken in het Algemeen Overleg Informatievoorziening van 12 april jl. zal er vanuit het kabinet extra aandacht zijn voor goede verwijzing in de geannoteerde agenda en kabinetsbrieven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over validatie van 80%-norm arbeidsovereenkomst postsector

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how the ACM verified that postal carriers employ at least 80% of their couriers under employment contracts and whether external validation was required. The government answered that the ACM checked contracts directly without requiring external validation, but committed to re-checking compliance this year and to examining complaints at any time.
The ACM has however committed to me that it will still examine this year whether the postal carriers still comply with the 80% norm.
Wel heeft de ACM mij toegezegd dat ze dit jaar nog zal onderzoeken of de postvervoerbedrijven nog steeds voldoen aan de 80% norm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Pand Groningse fietsenmaker in beslag genomen om koopzondagenruzie’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about the seizure of a Groningen bicycle shop's premises by a homeowners' association over a shop-opening dispute, questioning proportionality and the shopkeeper's legal protection. The state secretary answered that the courts decide, that the Civil Code provides enforcement tools and appeal/suspension routes, and that the planned Winkeltijdenwet amendment will strengthen the shopkeeper's position.
Our legal system contains sufficient safeguards for both parties and therefore also for the small shopkeeper.
Ons rechtssysteem bevat voldoende waarborgen voor beide partijen en dus ook voor de kleine winkelier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Wörsdorfer over het bericht  ‘Wirwar van gemeentelijke milieuzones groeit: automobilist kan Maastricht straks alleen nog met milieusticker in’

MPs Ziengs and Wörsdorfer asked about the growing patchwork of municipal environmental zones, including Maastricht's sticker system that affects motorists and entrepreneurs. The State Secretary agreed a uniform system is undesirable, deferred the balancing of interests to municipalities, and committed to a meeting with municipalities and the VNG and to uniform signage by 1 January 2020.
I have invited the new municipal executives and the VNG to sit down together on this matter.
Ik heb de nieuwe gemeentebestuurders en de VNG uitgenodigd om hierover om tafel te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het weigeren van de VVV-cadeaukaart, de positie van het lokale mkb en de geldigheidsdatum bij cadeaukaarten

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about shops refusing the new VVV gift card, the position of local SMEs, and unclear expiry dates on gift cards. The State Secretary answered that retailers and issuers set acceptance and validity terms themselves, that the consumer law framework applies with ACM oversight, and that no further rules are planned.
I am aware of reports like the above about the refusal of the VVV gift card in its new form, but I do not have precise data on its extent.
Mij is berichtgeving zoals bovenstaande over de weigering van de VVV-cadeaukaart in zijn nieuwe vorm bekend, maar precieze gegevens over de omvang hiervan heb ik niet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het stopzetten van de service van Octrooicentrum Nederland om oriënterende octrooiliteratuuronderzoeken uit te voeren voor de Nederlandse universiteiten en hogescholen

An MP asked why Octrooicentrum Nederland stopped offering preliminary patent literature searches to universities and universities of applied sciences, and whether this forces them to hire costly external bureaus. The minister confirmed the service was scaled back under earlier budget cuts, said institutions should build the expertise in-house, and only offered to consider whether the agency could help in the upcoming policy evaluation.

No. As part of the further professionalisation of the TTOs of universities and universities of applied sciences, I consider it important that the expertise required to carry out preliminary searches is available within the TTOs themselves.

Nee. In het kader van de verdere professionalisering van TTO's van universiteiten en hogescholen vind ik het belangrijk dat de voor het uitvoeren van oriënterende onderzoeken vereiste expertise binnen de TTO's zelf beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Veldman over het omzeilen van de Wet markt en overheid

VVD MPs Wörsdörfer and Veldman asked whether a municipal loan to Focus Filmtheater, and the 'Horeca BV' structure that may let commercial hospitality bypass the Wet markt en overheid, creates unfair competition and what rules apply. The state secretary answered that state-aid and WMO rules apply, that enforcement lies primarily with the municipality, the Commission, courts and the ACM, and that subsidy conditions can address unfair competition, without committing to a new investigation or legislative change.
Whether there is state aid in the present situation is primarily for the municipality to assess.
Of er in onderhavige situatie sprake is van staatssteun, is in de eerste plaats aan de gemeente om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en  Van der Lee over het definiëren van de markt met betrekking tot marktmacht

MPs Van den Berg and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary how market definition by the ACM affects findings of market power, whether new or existing law is more effective against dominant tech firms, and whether the ACM can use consent agreements like the US FTC. The State Secretary answered that existing competition law should be used first with new EU rules where needed, that market definition is an important but not decisive step, that the ACM already has binding commitment decisions, and that an EU proposal on platform-business relations is expected in April.
I will inform the House after publication via a BNC fiche about the proposal and my position in Europe.
Ik zal uw Kamer na publicatie per BNC-fiche informeren over het voorstel en mijn inzet in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de gevolgen van dalende postvolumes voor de postbezorging

MP Alkaya (SP) asked whether consolidation of postal companies is needed to guarantee postal continuity, employment and better jobs for postal workers, and asked about the number of postal operators, overlap, and weekly working hours. The Staatssecretaris answered that a Postdialoog will inform policy and that consolidation's pros and cons will be judged only after its results, while providing figures on operators (118) and average postal working hours (about 16 per week).

I attach importance to providing this space and to awaiting the results of the Postdialoog before drawing conclusions on the pros and cons of consolidation for the continuity of postal delivery and employment.

Ik hecht eraan om deze ruimte te bieden en de resultaten van de Postdialoog af te wachten alvorens ik conclusies trek over de voor- en nadelen van consolidatie voor de continuïteit van de postbezorging en de werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Wörsdörfer over de verhaalspositie van het MKB bij onbetwiste geldvorderingen

MPs Van Oosten and Wörsdörfer asked whether Belgium's 2016 out-of-court debt collection procedure for undisputed claims between businesses should be introduced in the Netherlands to strengthen small and medium-sized firms' position. The minister answered that its added value is unclear, that rule-of-law safeguards and cost questions need study, and that a further exploration will follow once the Belgian law's effects are clearer.

The rule-of-law safeguard of out-of-court dispute resolution methods such as arbitration and binding advice lies, as a recently published report on this subject also showed, among other things in the fact that one must go to the judge for an enforceable title.

De rechtsstatelijke waarborging van buitengerechtelijke geschiloplossingsmethoden zoals arbitrage en bindend advies, is – zo bleek ook in een recentelijk gepubliceerd rapport over dit onderwerp – onder meer gelegen in het gegeven dat men voor een titel voor tenuitvoerlegging naar de rechter moet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Molen over het verdwijnen van de brievenbus in Tichelwurk

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the removal of the letterbox in Tichelwurk, which would leave residents six kilometres from the nearest box in winter, and whether ACM and PostNL could reconsider. The State Secretary said the rules allow removal but PostNL has decided to keep the box given the geographic circumstances, and that ACM has signalled no gaps in the supervisory framework.
The advisory process preceding a change, as PostNL applies it, ensures that account is taken of vulnerable groups and any special geographic circumstances.
Het adviesproces voorafgaand aan een wijziging zoals PostNL dat hanteert borgt dat er rekening wordt gehouden met kwetsbare groepen en eventuele bijzondere geografische omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van den Hul over piratenzenders

MPs Nijboer and Van den Hul asked about unlicensed pirate radio stations, rising fines, and whether the hobby could be tolerated or recognised as cultural heritage. The government defended enforcement by Agentschap Telecom on grounds of spectrum scarcity, safety and environmental harm, pointed to legal alternatives, and declined to endorse the heritage call.
The fining policy is aimed at stopping illegal activities or sharply reducing them.
Het boetebeleid is erop gericht om illegale activiteiten te doen stoppen dan wel sterk te doen verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of Brexit for the Netherlands, focusing on a customs impact memo, customs staffing needs (500-800 extra staff), IT readiness and the timing of recruitment. The government answered that the Douane and NVWA are recruiting within existing frameworks, that analyses for internal deliberation will not be shared, and that preparations continue ahead of March 2019.
The analyses requested by your House were, however, prepared for internal deliberation and it is undesirable that they become the subject of political debate.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde analyses zijn echter opgesteld voor intern beraad en het is onwenselijk dat zij onderwerp zijn van politiek debat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de belemmering van de uitrol van 5G

The MP Moorlag asks whether the intelligence services' use of the 3.5 GHz band near the Burum satellite station blocks 5G rollout in the north, and what alternatives exist. The government answers that the 2011 restriction above the Amsterdam-Zwolle line remains until 2023, that a shielding screen proved infeasible, that alternative solutions are being studied with a decision and information to parliament expected mid-year, and that it is too early to say who bears any extra cost.
Your House is expected to be informed about the possible solution directions around mid-year.
Uw Kamer zal naar verwachting medio dit jaar over de mogelijke oplossingsrichtingen worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Molen over het klaar maken van Nederland voor de uitrol van 5G

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate how the Netherlands can prepare for 5G, including the 3.5 GHz band, the 700 MHz alternative, trials such as the Leidseplein antenna, and whether Amsterdam can host the first 5G stadium for Euro 2020. The government answered that 700 MHz will be available nationally from 2020, the 26 GHz band is being prepared pending EU decisions, other European states are further along on 3.5 GHz, and it will facilitate experiments in Amsterdam without committing to a result.
I am already working on making the 700 MHz band available nationwide from 2020.
Ik werk reeds aan het landelijk beschikbaar stellen van de 700 MHz-band per 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Belhaj en Weverling over de berichten 'Spionnenjacht blokt 5G' en 'Arena geen proeftuin voor nieuwste generatie mobiel internet'

MPs Paternotte, Belhaj and Weverling asked about press reports that intelligence services are blocking 5G rollout in the 3.5 GHz band and that the Amsterdam Arena cannot serve as a 5G testbed. The State Secretary says the rollout is important, that talks with intelligence services and neighbouring countries are ongoing, and that a solution and options will be sent to parliament around mid-2018.

Both the ministers of Defence and of the Interior and the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and Climate are working to find, on the basis of technical research, solution options for making the 3.5 GHz band available.

Zowel de ministers van Defensie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijkrelaties als de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en Klimaat zetten zich in om op basis van technisch onderzoek tot oplossingsmogelijkheden te komen voor de beschikbaarstelling van de 3,5 GHz-band.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over het uitstel van de Nota Mobiele Communicatie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the delay of the Mobile Communications Note, the timing of the 5G rollout and frequency auctions given the T-Mobile/Tele2 merger, and the Burum satellite ground station. The State Secretary said he is in contact with the regulator and considers the rollout timing, committed to informing parliament on the Burum options before the Spring Memorandum, but declined to give a firm deadline or two-scenario publication because that would frustrate the regulator's decision-making.
It is undesirable to elaborate and publish the auction design for all possible (sub)scenarios.
Het is onwenselijk om voor alle mogelijke (sub)scenario's de opzet van de veiling uit te werken en te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Paternotte over het bericht ‘PostNL nog steeds bezig met bezorgen kerstpost’

MPs Weverling and Paternotte asked the State Secretary about reports that PostNL was still delivering Christmas mail in January 2018, including delivery standards, oversight of peak periods, causes of the delays, and whether additional requirements would be set. The State Secretary answered that the existing delivery norms and ACM oversight are adequate, attributed the delays to weather, staffing shortages and a new sorting code rule, declined to impose extra requirements for now, and said ACM is investigating.
Imposing additional requirements now therefore seems premature to me.
Het nu stellen van aanvullende eisen vind ik daarom prematuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de eenzijdige opgelegde commissieverhoging door Thuisbezorgd.nl

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about Thuisbezorgd.nl's unilateral commission increase, its market share, and whether its parity clause and alleged abuse of market power should be banned or investigated by the ACM. The State Secretary answered that the commission is a private contractual matter, that the ACM found no reason for further action on the parity clause, that a ban is not warranted for now, and that platforms' abuse of power is for the ACM to judge case by case.
It is for the ACM, as the independent supervisor of the Competition Act, to judge whether in an individual case there is abuse of a dominant position or another infringement of the Competition Act.

Het is aan de ACM om als onafhankelijke toezichthouder op de Mededingingswet te oordelen of in een individuele casus sprake is van misbruik van een machtspositie of een andere overtreding van de Mededingingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het afzien van verdere deelname van IVBN aan de Retailagenda

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the consequences of the institutional investors' association IVBN and the private investors Vastgoed Belang no longer taking part in the next phase of the Retail Agenda, how transparency in the retail market will be improved, and how support for retail deals among local SMEs is secured. The State Secretary replies that talks with IVBN are underway, that Vastgoed Belang has signalled willingness to contribute again, that local retail deals are the responsibility of municipal councils and that a toolkit with support for stakeholder cooperation is provided.
Following IVBN's letter, the Director-General for Business and Innovation of my ministry and the chair of the Retail Agenda will talk with IVBN's board.
Naar aanleiding van de brief van IVBN gaan de Directeur-Generaal Bedrijfsleven en Innovatie van mijn ministerie en de voorzitter van de Retailagenda in gesprek met bestuurders van IVBN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de woekerhandel in concertkaarten kan voortduren

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked whether the government would tackle large-scale secondary resale of concert tickets, including by Live Nation's platforms, and whether it would act against professional resale. The Staatssecretaris answered that resale is nuanced, that the ACM already has tools and has acted in specific cases, that talks with the sector will follow, and that any EU-level measures are preferable, without committing to new legislation yet.
As indicated in the answers to questions 3, 5 and 7, I first want to enter into discussion with the sector and then consider what may need to be done.
Zoals aangegeven in de antwoorden op de vragen 3, 5 en 7 wil ik nu eerst het gesprek met de sector aangaan en daarna bezien wat er eventueel moet gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Ouderen dupe van opdoeken brievenbussen'

MPs Weverling and Van den Berg asked about reports that letterboxes were removed in Leidschendam-Voorburg, harming elderly residents, and how accessibility rules protect vulnerable users. The State Secretary answered that complaints are few, that PostNL's consultation process with advocacy groups and local representatives governs changes, that legal rules require considering vulnerable groups, and that PostNL already agreed not to remove letterboxes at care institutions.
Before a planned change in the number of letterboxes, this is announced in writing and meetings are organised for interest groups about the relocation plans.

The Minister acknowledged communication failures, said the sector will tighten working agreements and transparency, and pointed bereaved families to the funeral provider and the Stichting Klachteninstituut Uitvaartwezen for complaints.
Once bereaved families have been informed by the funeral undertaker, they must receive full openness and have freedom of choice regarding the further care of the deceased.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het besluit over de toekomst van de postmarkt

An MP asks why the state secretary announced to the press that a decision on the future of the postal market would be delayed by a year, and why the coalition agreement's description of the current compensation model is incorrect. This is of course something I want to discuss with the House first.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over een advies door een kinderverpleegkundige aan het SKGZ

An MP asked the state secretary about Dutch growers using USDA organic methods (including substrate growing) following the EU-US organic equivalence agreement, and whether those methods could continue for the North American market. The government answered that the rules remain distinct, that a study of growing methods is planned with results expected in autumn, that the topic may return to the EU organic committee in 2013, and that continued US-market production is possible as long as the rules are unchanged, though no guarantee is given.
I intend to have a number of cultivation methods investigated.
Ik heb het voornemen een aantal teeltwijzen te laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen De Mos over het bericht dat 49 voormalige NASA-wetenschappers afstand genomen hebben van het standpunt dat CO2-uitstoot een belangrijke oorzaak is van het broeikaseffect

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary whether the government will respond to a letter from 49 former NASA scientists disputing that CO2 emissions are a major cause of climate change, and whether scientific debate is unsettled and CO2 reduction spending should stop. The state secretary replies that open debate is needed and that there is no risk to scientists, but rejects halting CO2 reduction spending, citing the need to weigh present costs against future risks.
No, I explicitly do not share that view.
Nee, die mening deel ik uitdrukkelijk niet.
Antwoord vragen de Mos, van Vliet en van Bemmel over het bericht “Hedwige mogelijk deels onder water”

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether the risks of flooding caused by the Hedwige polder de-embankment, including for the Doel nuclear plant across the border, warranted independent research or invoking treaty clausula rebus sic stantibus. The secretary answered that flood safety was already a key condition in planning, so the de-embankment does not compromise safety and further independent research is not needed.
No, in the planning for the de-embankment of the Hedwige polder flood safety has been taken into account as an important condition.
Nee, in de planvorming voor de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder is de veiligheid tegen overstroming als een belangrijke voorwaarde meegenomen.
Antwoord vragen De Mos over het artikel ‘Saoedi-Arabië verbiedt vrouwen deel te nemen aan Olympische Spelen’

An MP from the PVV asks the health minister whether it is unacceptable that Saudi Arabia bars women from the Olympics, whether the IOC should exclude such countries, and whether the minister will press colleagues for this. The minister answers that the Dutch government finds exclusion unacceptable, that national Olympic committees choose their own delegations, that talks with the Saudi committee are ongoing, and that the minister will not direct the autonomous IOC but will keep raising equal rights internationally.
No, the IOC follows its own policy in this matter as an autonomous organisation.
Neen, het IOC hanteert als autonome organisatie zijn eigen beleid in deze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Mos over kernafvalopslag COVRA in Zeeland

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about COVRA's radioactive waste processing and storage facilities in Zeeland, including whether Dutch facilities could be shared with other countries to reduce costs. The minister confirmed the facts, explained that Dutch policy requires all domestic radioactive waste to go to COVRA, and said that cross-border cooperation under the EU directive is possible but not currently on the agenda.
Possible cooperation is, however, not currently on the agenda.
Eventuele samenwerking is nu echter niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen De Mos en Graus over het treffen van CO2-maatregelen op Europees niveau

PVV MPs De Mos and Graus asked the state secretary about Dutch efforts on the EU aviation ETS, the Chinese retaliation against it, and calls to suspend it. The state secretary answered that he pressed for EU-wide study of retaliation risks and a global ICAO system, but that the EU should keep a coordinated front and not withdraw the ETS unilaterally.
I urged the European Commission to 'pull out all the stops' to prevent countries such as the US, Russia and China from taking countermeasures to the detriment of the EU or its member states.
Ik heb erop aangedrongen dat de Europese Commissie «alles op alles zet» om te voorkomen, dat landen als de VS, Rusland en China tegenmaatregelen nemen ten nadele van de EU of haar lidstaten.
Antwoord vragen De Mos over het bericht ‘Vergaande acties tegen opwarming zijn onnodig’

MP De Mos (PVV) asked the state secretary about a newspaper report claiming climate action is unnecessary, questioning climate science, IPCC models, the claimed absence of warming over ten years, and cost-benefit findings. The state secretary answered that the IPCC Fifth Assessment Report will set out the latest science, that a cost-benefit study through 2050 will follow a parliamentary motion, and rejected the other claims as not recognised or as misreadings.
Antwoord vragen De Mos en Van Vliet over de metallurgische industrie

PVV MPs De Mos and Van Vliet asked the ministers whether the government will act to protect the metallurgical industry's level playing field against the EU emissions trading system and the German nuclear phase-out, and urge that the system be scrapped. The minister answers that the Dutch government supports the ETS and only seeks compensation for genuine carbon leakage risk, while the Commission's state-aid guidelines are still pending.
The aim is to maintain a level playing field in Europe and to prevent member states from using state aid to distort European competitive conditions.
Het doel is handhaving van het gelijke speelveld in Europa en daartoe voorkomen dat lidstaten door middel van staatssteun de Europese concurrentieverhoudingen kunnen verstoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Mos en De Jong over de artikelen ‘Regeringsstad zonder internationale trein’ en ‘Hedwige-conflict kwelt Loodswezen’

PVV MPs De Mos and De Jong asked about a Telegraaf report that Belgium had not ordered the rolling stock needed for the Den Haag-Brussel HSL-Zuid agreement, about a Hedwige polder alternative, and about roughly EUR 9 million in unpaid pilotage deficits owed by Flemish authorities to the Dutch pilotage service. The minister said Belgium had pledged to implement the agreements but NMBS had not ordered the trains, that the Hedwige polder de-polderisation is no longer on the table under the June 2011 decision, and that the pilotage dispute is under binding arbitration, which she will raise with her Flemish counterpart.
In the short term I have a meeting with my Belgian colleague minister Magnette in which the implementation of these agreements will be discussed.
Op korte termijn heb ik een overleg met mijn Belgische collega minister Magnette, waarin de uitvoering van deze afspraken zal worden besproken.
Antwoord vragen Hernandez en De Mos over het bericht dat het ministerie van Defensie zonnepanelen op scholen en gemeentegebouwen medefinanciert

Two PVV MPs asked Defence Minister Hillen whether Defence co-financed solar panels on schools and municipal buildings in Coevorden, what its interest was, whether this was a wrong signal given cuts to units and barracks, and for overviews of its energy spending and energy-policy staff. The minister confirmed a EUR 121,000 contribution tied to the Coevorden wind park agreement to build local support, said it saves Defence EUR 600,000 a year, and provided figures of about EUR 80 million a year on energy purchases and EUR 65 million for 2009-2017 on efficiency measures, plus roughly nine policy staff partly on energy.
Asked why not if not: answer 4 - at current energy prices Defence spends about EUR 80 million a year on purchasing energy.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 4 Bij de huidige energieprijzen besteedt Defensie jaarlijks ongeveer € 80 miljoen aan de inkoop van energie.
Vragen van het lid de Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Atsma; Nederland komt niet onder CO2-taks uit» (ingezonden 19 december 2011).

The MP asked the state secretary whether he would lobby all 27 EU member states against the EU ETS in its current form, what sanctions Europe would impose if the Netherlands refused to implement aviation ETS, and whether he would reject ETS for shipping if it is not global. The state secretary confirmed the statement, said the Netherlands is bound by the implemented directive, promised to keep talking with third countries and press the Commission for concrete steps, and gave no commitment to refuse ETS or lobby all member states.
To prevent any negative consequences for the Netherlands, it is of great importance to remain in dialogue with third countries.
Om eventuele negatieve consequenties voor Nederland te voorkomen is het van groot belang met derde landen in gesprek te blijven.
Antwoord vragen De Mos over de verhoging van de prijs van vliegtickets door het ETS

An MP asks the state secretary about the rise in airfares caused by the EU Emissions Trading System, the risk of foreign countries retaliating (such as cancelled Airbus orders), and whether the ETS charge should be suspended pending a KiM study. The state secretary replies that airlines may pass on costs under the polluter-pays principle, that retaliation is being discussed diplomatically without knowing its form, and promises the KiM study results around 1 March, while pursuing a global ICAO solution.
I expect to be able to share those results with the House around 1 March.
Ik verwacht die resultaten rond 1 maart met de Kamer te kunnen delen.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Olietanks slecht beveiligd» (ingezonden 12 december 2011).

MPs De Mos and Elissen asked the state secretary about a report that oil tanks were poorly secured and whether unauthorised people could approach them, and about security at other oil storage sites such as Rotterdam. The state secretary agreed access by unauthorised persons is unacceptable, described the permit, safety report and port security regime and inspection, but said no guarantee can be given that such an incident will never recur.
I share your view that it is unacceptable that unauthorised persons can get close to oil storage tanks.
Ik deel uw mening dat het onaanvaardbaar is, dat niet-bevoegde mensen dicht bij olieopslagtanks kunnen komen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel «Te hoge waterschapslasten nog hoger» (ingezonden 13 december 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a newspaper report that water board levies for homeowners would rise despite a Vereniging Eigen Huis claim that they could fall. The state secretary replied that the report misreads the efficiency study: savings of 550 million euro are offset by about 600 million in investment, so tariffs rise only modestly, and he sees no reason to meet individual water boards but will report the final tariffs.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, De Mos en De Jong (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over giftreinen met onbekende ladingen (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

MPs Elissen, De Mos and De Jong asked ministers whether freight trains carrying hazardous substances are reliably documented, whether inspection covers this, and whether the Wob-request by De Pers was fully answered. The minister answered that inspections found 24 violations since February 2011, sanctions were imposed, documentation gaps persist, and inspection will continue closely.
Since February 2011, 24 violations have been identified to date.
Er zijn vanaf februari 2011 tot op heden 24 overtredingen geconstateerd.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Dure regiotaxi drukt oudere in isolement» (ingezonden 23 decembe

An MP asked the government whether municipalities breach the Wmo by sharply raising regiotaxi fares, whether national frameworks should limit this, and for an answer before 1 January 2012. The state secretary rejected that municipalities breach the Wmo, said the Wmo gives municipalities discretion and appeal rights, saw no reason for national rules, and said answers before 1 January were not possible.
I see no reason at present to assume that municipalities make access to Wmo provisions unnecessarily expensive and thereby impossible.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat gemeenten de toegang tot Wmo-voorzieningen onnodig duur en daarmee onmogelijk maken.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over dat ’t Hofnarretje voor de derde keer niet voldoet aan de inspectie-eisen van de GGD (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the minister why the daycare centre 't Hofnarretje has failed GGD inspection for the third time, whether it is unacceptable, and whether it will be closed immediately and other failing daycare centres investigated. The minister says the municipality of Amsterdam is responsible for supervising and deciding on closure, expresses concern, and promises to report on municipal compliance in the Inspectorate's annual report in spring 2012.
Responsibility for supervising the quality of childcare rests with the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het toezicht op de kwaliteit van de kinderopvang berust bij de gemeenten.
Vragen van het lid de Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Taxirijdersbond: Honderden illegale taxi’s in Nederland» (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether enforcement against illegal taxi drivers is adequate, including how many mystery guest operations are active and whether the Inspectorate should expand them. The minister replied that illegal taxis are hard to detect, that mystery guest checks are risk-based and not counted per municipality, and that the current deployment is sufficient.
It is therefore not possible to state per municipality how many Mystery Guests are active.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk per gemeente aan te geven hoeveel Mystery Guests actief zijn.
Vragen van de leden Elissen en De Mos (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over inbraak in een kerncentrale door terreurcommando’s van Greenpeace (ingezonden 7 december 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Dutch nuclear plants will get extra protection after a Greenpeace intrusion into a French nuclear plant, whether Greenpeace should be excluded as a dialogue partner, and whether Dutch authorities will cooperate proactively with France. The minister replied that Dutch installations are adequately secured and tested through exercises, that Greenpeace is not listed as a terrorist organisation so there is no ground to exclude it, and that Dutch services will cooperate fully on request.
The Dutch nuclear installations are adequately secured, including against intrusion.
De Nederlandse nucleaire installaties zijn adequaat beveiligd, ook tegen binnendringing.
Vragen van de leden Helder en de Mos (beiden PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht: «werkstraffen voor hooligans» (ingezonden 16 november 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice whether the community sentence (taakstraf) should be removed as a main penalty for lack of public support, and whether group liability in article 141 of the Penal Code should be strengthened for public violence by rioters. The government answered that research shows public support for community service and lower recidivism than prison, so it will keep it, and that a consultation on article 141 is ongoing with a report promised for January 2012.
The cabinet considers it important to retain the community sentence in the sanctions system.
Het kabinet acht het behoud van de taakstraf in het sanctiestelsel van belang.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Sabotage rails kerntransport» (ingezonden 14 oktobe

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about reports of sabotage on nuclear fuel transport rails and why police initially described the transport as unremarkable. The minister replied that police never used that wording, that a suspect was arrested the same day, and that whether the law was broken is for the courts to decide.
It is for the court to judge whether there has been a violation of the law.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen of er sprake is van het overtreden van de wet.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de watersnoodramp (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

MP De Mos (PVV) asked the state secretary whether he knows of reports on quicksand as a major cause of the 1953 flood disaster, and whether he agrees that dike policy should address dangers beneath dikes, including a deep study of how Zeeland dikes can collapse. The state secretary answered that all parties aim to prevent such disasters and that design and assessment rules already cover all relevant failure mechanisms, including dangers under dikes, so no new study was announced.
The design and assessment rules we apply in the Netherlands already take into account all relevant failure mechanisms.
In de ontwerp- en toetsregels die wij in Nederland hanteren wordt reeds rekening gehouden met alle relevante faalmechanismen

Vragen van de leden De Mos, Graus en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «VS laten zich de les niet lezen in de luchtvaart»

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether the EU Emissions Trading System for aviation threatens Schiphol's hub role by pushing non-European airlines to route around Europe, and whether an independent study and joint EU action should follow. The state secretary answered that ETS is a market-based instrument rather than a tax, that a KiM study on Dutch aviation effects is underway, and that the Commission has been asked to assess EU-wide consequences.
The Knowledge Institute for Mobility Policy has currently commissioned a study into the effects of the EU ETS on Dutch aviation.
Bij het Kennisinstituut Mobiliteitsbeleid is op dit moment een onderzoek uitgezet naar de effecten van EU-ETS op de Nederlandse luchtvaart.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel «DCMR: Odfjell lekte regelmatig benzeen» (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that Odfjell repeatedly leaked benzene in the Rotterdam port, whether a deep investigation is needed, and whether all Dutch ports should use VentoClean-type vapour recovery. The state secretary says benzene is a minimisation-obliged substance, that the regional authority (DCMR) and inspectorate monitor Odfjell, a criminal investigation is underway, no new deep study is needed, and vapour recovery is required where economically feasible.
Because of this incidental peak emission and earlier emissions in which benzene was released, a criminal investigation has been started against Odfjell.
Wegens deze incidentele piekemissie en eerdere emissies waarbij benzeen vrijgekomen is, is er een strafrechtelijk onderzoek gestart tegen Odfjell.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de uitgegeven Bosatlas van het klimaat (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about the cost of the Bosatlas van het klimaat, whether the KNMI's involvement makes it partisan unsuited to objective public information, and whether the WMO-based ten-yearly climate atlas duty can be dropped. The state secretary answered that no subsidy was given, the KNMI supplied only factual information, and that the ten-yearly assessment is useful for sectors needing to adapt.
The KNMI contributed exclusively factually and objectively established information for the atlas.
Het KNMI heeft voor de atlas uitsluitend feitelijk en objectief vastgestelde informatie aangedragen.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de Staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «Mestbeleid op de schop» (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretaries about a newspaper article on manure policy, including how processing manure fits with sustainability and family farms, the Run2You manure-pellet method, the economic effects if manure exports to Germany stopped, and whether biogas co-digestion innovation would be examined. The government answered that its future manure policy leaves room for sustainability and family farms, that it welcomes methods contributing to policy goals while leaving market introduction to business, that it sees no reason for an export stop, and that it has added substances to the co-digestion positive list and is developing an alternative system.
I see no reason for such a situation.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een dergelijke situatie.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over kosten van het klimaatbeleid (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary to account for total climate policy costs, including renewable energy subsidies flagged by the Audit Office, and for spending on external consultants and climate foundations. The state secretary says renewable energy costs fall under a different minister and that the requested detail cannot be provided after the fact.
No. The answers given address the requested information as well as possible and provide the information that is directly available.
In de gegeven antwoorden is zo goed als mogelijk ingegaan op de gevraagde informatie en is de informatie verstrekt die direct beschikbaar is.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beide PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over ecologische braaklegging (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether a 5% ecological fallow requirement is unrealistic and whether private management should be expanded. The state secretary said the EU greening proposals for the 2014-2020 CAP are still under review with a cabinet response due by month-end, and that private parties and farmers should be involved more in nature management, citing an approved subsidy scheme for land purchase.
I intend to send the cabinet response to the Commission proposals to your House before the end of the month.
Ik ben voornemens om uw Kamer voor het einde van de maand de kabinetsreactie op de Commissievoorstellen aan te bieden.

Vragen van het lid de Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat Al Gore een lezing komt geven aan de Rijksuniversiteit van Groningen (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary of Infrastructure and Environment about Al Gore's lecture at the University of Groningen, alleging that the CBS, tax authority, municipality and university sponsored it, and asking whether taxpayers are funding it and whether the university's climate message is one-sided. The state secretary answers that the tax authority and CBS only ran unrelated workshops, that the organising student association financed the lecture from business contributions, and that the university is responsible for such spending, so no recovery from subsidies is planned.
The University of Groningen is itself responsible for this expenditure.
De Rijksuniversiteit Groningen is zelf verantwoordelijk voor deze uitgaven.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Van Vliet en De Mos (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over verouderde gasleidingen die tikkende tijdbommen in de Nederlan

PVV MPs asked whether outdated brittle gas pipes in the Dutch subsoil are ticking time bombs, whether risk assessments and replacement timelines of about thirty years are acceptable, and who is responsible for replacing about 10,000 km of cast iron. The minister answers that responsibility lies with regional grid operators supervised by SodM, that the most vulnerable pipes will be replaced within five years, that new safety rules took effect in 2011, and that most cast iron pipes will be replaced by 2041.
SodM supervises the implementation of the plans.
SodM houdt toezicht op de uitvoering van de plannen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de vraag of klimaatregels überhaupt effect hebben (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

An MP from PVV asked the state secretary whether the light bulb ban and other climate measures actually reduce CO2, and whether they should be reviewed. The state secretary answered that energy saving is important, that the ban was adopted at EU level, and that the emissions trading system will be kept as it is.
The decision for a ban on incandescent light bulbs was taken at European level.
Het besluit voor een verbod op gloeilampen is op Europees niveau genomen.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Miljarden euro's klimaatgeld onderhevig aan corruptie» (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary about reports that billions in climate finance are vulnerable to corruption, how much goes to highly corrupt countries, whether climate sceptics sit on the climate bank, and about fraud in CO2 trading. The government answered that all funds are accounted for and corruption is investigated and recovered, that the World Bank will act as trustee with fiduciary standards, and that anti-fraud measures for emissions trading are being strengthened.
Afterwards, all organisations that have received the money must always account for the expenditure.
Achteraf dienen alle organisaties die het geld hebben ontvangen zich altijd te verantwoorden voor de uitgaven.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Al Gore start nieuwe klimaatcampagne» (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment for a detailed accounting of climate policy costs per department since 1988, departmental staffing, and the costs for business of meeting the EU 20% CO2 target, and whether the climate spending has made a measurable difference to temperature or sea level. The state secretary gave partial figures for some years, said several datasets are unavailable or will be published later, and said climate costs were not aimed at making the Netherlands climate neutral by 2012 or 2020.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «Hongersnood dreigt in Nederland» (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

PVV MPs De Mos and Gerbrands asked the state secretary whether drought endangering Dutch harvests and natural projects converting farmland to marsh or causing salinisation are acceptable, and whether this shows the need to preserve freshwater and farmland. The state secretary agreed that water must be managed carefully, pointed to the water allocation priority list and the Delta Programme's freshwater sub-programme, and said nature projects may be needed to meet international obligations while negotiations with provinces continue.
To meet international obligations on nature conservation and/or restoration, it may be among the possibilities to proceed with the measures mentioned in this question.
Om te voldoen aan de internationale verplichtingen omtrent natuurbehoud en/of natuurherstel kan het tot de mogelijkheden behoren om over te gaan tot de in deze vraag genoemde maatregelen.
Vragen van leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over waterschapslasten (ingezonden 2 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether it is undesirable that farmers pay disproportionate water board levies because of infrastructure value in their water board areas, and whether the Taxatiewijzer for infrastructure should be made optional in 2012. The state secretary said infrastructure value is legally part of the valuation, that Delfland's tariffs rose after the new tax system, that research on tariff relief within the current law has not yet produced a solution, and that the results will be reported to parliament.
I will report the results to the House of Representatives.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer over de resultaten berichten.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over taxibedrijven (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

An MP asks the minister to reassess the need for the mandatory taxi on-board computer (BCT), citing modern in-house systems, its cost of about €4,500 per car, fraud sensitivity, and the uniqueness of the Dutch rest-time rules. The minister refuses to reconsider, arguing the BCT reduces administrative burden and improves oversight, that the cost is about €1,000–1,200 with a €600 subsidy, and that its design limits fraud and driver dependence.
I do not wish to abandon the introduction of the on-board computer.
Ik wil niet afzien van de komst van de boordcomputer.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Minister Cramer investeerde 50 miljoen in zichzelf» (ingezonden 28 juni 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a press report that minister Cramer invested 50 million euro in herself, and whether the funds for the University of Utrecht would go to climate research. The state secretary said no such transaction is known, explaining the figure refers to a 2007 cabinet decision creating a 50 million euro FES-funded climate programme requiring matching contributions from many organisations, with Utrecht's share about 1.2 million euro.
Such a transaction is unknown to me.
Een dergelijke transactie is mij onbekend.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het dreigende faillissement van de Nederlandse vissersvloo

PVV MPs asked the state secretaries about the threatened bankruptcy of the Dutch fishing fleet, including whether strict EU environmental rules are to blame, whether climate funds could pay fishers to collect plastic, and for an overview of climate spending. The government answered that the fleet's viability is primarily the fishers' responsibility, that environmental rules are set at EU and international level with no national room to deviate, that climate funds are not earmarked for plastic fishing, and that it will discuss a possible pilot with the Commission.
There are no possibilities to deviate from that nationally.
Er zijn geen mogelijkheden om daar nationaal van af te wijken.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Helder (PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Minister Opstelten wil per korps top 10 van hooligans» (ingezonden 26 mei

MPs De Mos and Helder asked the Justice and Health ministers whether tightening the Dutch football law, such as nationwide stadium bans, makes a 'top 10 hooligans' list per police unit unnecessary, and about its costs and possibility of an English-style law. Minister Opstelten rejected that view, explained existing stadium-ban tools, said the list supports better targeting of those measures, could not give exact costs, and said the English model will be considered in the evaluation of the football law.
Gathering information, identifying subjects and developing a targeted tailored approach is part of the daily work of the police and various security partners.
Het verzamelen van informatie, het in beeld brengen van subjecten en het ontwikkelen van een gerichte aanpak op maat, is onderdeel van het dagelijkse werk van politie en diverse veiligheidspartners.
Kamervragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Milieunorm te streng» (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

The PVV MP De Mos asks the state secretary about reports that EU aviation emissions rules could cost jobs, and about the ETS, Chinese non-participation, passenger compensation and reciprocity for foreign airlines. The state secretary rejects the premise, defends free allocation and the polluter-pays principle, promises to press the Commission on third-country issues and passenger-rights revision, and says reciprocity already applies.
I will ask the European Commission to take action on this and seek a solution
zal ik de Europese Commissie verzoeken om hierop actie te ondernemen en te zoeken naar een oplossing
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Hedwigepolder (ingezonden 25 maart 2011).

An MP asks whether former minister Nijpels's public stance against alternatives to flooding the Hedwige polder hampers finding alternatives, and whether the government will go to great lengths to avoid flooding it. The state secretary says the former minister's view did not disrupt the decision preparation, refers to a letter, and declines to assess statements by former office holders.
The view of former minister Nijpels has not disrupted the preparation of the cabinet decision.
De opvatting van voormalig-minister Nijpels heeft de voorbereiding van het kabinetsbesluit niet verstoord.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Klimaatdoelen kosten Rotterdam miljarden» (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked whether a reported 11.3 billion euro cost to meet climate targets in the Rotterdam port is accurate, whether it is megalomaniac, and for a cost-benefit analysis and economic consequences. The state secretary replied that the figure concerns the municipality's Duurzaam programme and a direct economic impact estimate by a public-private initiative, not national policy, that no Rotterdam-specific cost-benefit analysis exists, and that the national climate aim is a global warming limit of 2 degrees.
Your question refers to policy formulated in the Rotterdam municipality's Sustainability Programme. This concerns no national government policy.
Uw vraagstelling refereert aan beleid geformuleerd in het Duurzaamheids Programma van de gemeente Rotterdam. Dit betreft geen beleid van het Rijk.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Blatter en de FIFA (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

MP De Mos asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether FIFA should investigate president Blatter over World Cup awards and a one-million-dollar payment to Concacaf, and whether Blatter should resign. The minister replied that FIFA is an autonomous private body whose members must reform it, that the Netherlands has raised transparent governance in EU sport councils, and that the Dutch World Cup bid support of 4.5 million euro will be accounted for to parliament.
Because FIFA is an autonomous and private membership organisation, I can and will not interfere in its internal affairs.
Omdat de FIFA een autonome en private ledenorganisatie is kan en wil ik mij niet met de interne gang van zaken bemoeien.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over rioolwater in de Westerschelde (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about millions of litres of sewage entering the Westerschelde after a pipe break, questioning its environmental and economic impact, whether maintenance backlog was involved, and whether the whole sewerage system should be examined and alternative temporary storage promoted. The state secretary answered that the impact was local and temporary, that the water board is investigating the cause, that the national sewerage system is in order per the 2010 benchmark, and that further national research and promotion of alternative storage are not needed.
The Brabantse Delta Water Board is investigating the cause of the pipe break on its territory.
Het Waterschap Brabantse Delta onderzoekt de oorzaak van de breuk in de persleiding op zijn terrein.
