Vragen het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Waterschap verkwist zelf veel water in droge tijd» (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that water boards waste considerable fresh water during drought, and whether the reuse of treated wastewater, as suggested by a consultancy, should be pursued. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said reuse of treated wastewater is being studied within the Delta Programme with cost-benefit analysis, and promised to inform the House in the annual Delta Programme update.
Yes, I take the DHV advice seriously.
Ja, ik neem het advies van DHV serieus.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over gaten in de Voetbalwet (ingezonden 16 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about gaps in the football hooliganism law after a court let three Ajax fans subject to reporting obligations attend the cup final, and whether area bans should apply to all Dutch stadiums. The minister denied a legal gap, explaining the court ruling turned on factual basis and preparation of decisions, and said the English model would be considered in the pending evaluation of the Dutch law.
I want to await this evaluation before making statements about the English football law.
Ik wil deze evaluatie afwachten voordat ik uitspraken doe over de Engelse voetbalwet.

Vragen van de leden De Mos, Gerbrands en Bontes (allen PVV) aan staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «Limburgs grondwater nog decennia vuil» (i

Three PVV MPs asked whether the Netherlands should tighten manure rules to meet the 2015 Water Framework Directive nitrate target, and whether further study or postponement to 2027 was wise. The state secretary replied that nitrate concentrations are falling, that policy changes will follow careful study, that no extra research is needed now, and that extending the deadline to 2021 or 2027 may be considered.

That does not necessarily mean that on the basis of this recent research the manure rules will be tightened in the short term merely to meet the 2015 target date of the European Water Framework Directive.

Dat betekent niet per definitie dat op basis van dat recente onderzoek op korte termijn de mestregels zullen worden aangescherpt, om maar de streefdatum van 2015 uit de Europese Kaderrichtlijn Water te halen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de afvaloven Omrin (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

An MP asked whether the Omrin waste incinerator in Harlingen had been idle, whether it sought relaxed environmental norms, whether workers fell ill during a chimney incident, and whether 4.4 million euro of subsidy was paid without checking conditions and should be stopped. The state secretary answered that the plant had a planned five-day maintenance stop, that Omrin made no request to relax norms, that a start-up incident caused brief airway irritation to two workers 300 metres away, that the subsidy payment was made, and that the subsidy falls under another ministry so it cannot be stopped or reclaimed.
The subsidy falls under the responsibility of the Ministry of EL&I and I therefore cannot stop or reclaim that subsidy.
Antwoord 5 De subsidie valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het ministerie van EL&I en ik kan die subsidie dan ook niet stopzetten of terug vorderen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over zwakke veendijken (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is outrageous that no major investment in weak peat dike maintenance followed the 2003 Wilnis breach, and whether the six-year dike testing cycle should be extended to twelve years. The state secretary answered that about 300 km of peat dikes have been improved, that a guideline for drought-sensitive dikes exists, that regional dikes already have a twelve-year testing cycle under provincial rules, and that the change for primary dikes does not affect water safety.
Moreover, the change in testing frequency for primary flood defences has no consequences for the water manager's responsibility to continuously monitor the safety of the flood defences.

Overigens heeft de verandering in de toetsfrequentie voor primaire waterkeringen geen consequenties voor de verantwoordelijkheid van de waterbeheerder om doorlopend de veiligheid van de waterkeringen te bewaken.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over met dioxine vervuilde wateren (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

PVV MPs De Mos and Gerbrands asked the state secretary about dioxin-contaminated waters and polluted river eel, asking whether the waters will be cleaned up quickly, how long they have been contaminated, and whether fines for illegal industrial discharges should be raised by 500%. The state secretary answered that historical sediment contamination cannot feasibly be fully removed, that targeted measures are planned, and that a sharp fine increase is disproportionate and would overshoot its goal.
Raising fines for illegal water discharges significantly is, in that light, not proportionate to me and would moreover overshoot its goal.
Het fors verhogen van de boetes voor illegale waterlozingen acht ik in dat licht niet proportioneel en zal bovendien zijn doel voorbij schieten.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Taxi’s Schiphol weigeren ritten» (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether taxi drivers refusing fares at Schiphol harm the economy and tourism, what will stop refusals, whether the Schiphol coordinator can be upgraded to a service role, and whether Haarlemmermeer rules on group operation will be revised. The minister says refusals are undesirable but that Schiphol and its private Taxi Controle foundation are responsible, reports few recorded refusals, declines to change the coordinator role, and says the taxi-law rules are being discussed with the seven municipalities.
The central government cannot and will not intervene in this purely private-law arrangement.
Het Rijk kan en wil niet treden in deze louter privaatrechtelijke constellatie.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over plastic afvalbergen in zee (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about plastic waste accumulating in the sea, its ecosystem impact, and shipping's role, and whether the issue would be placed high on the international agenda. The state secretary answered that Nederland has raised marine litter in EU and UNEP forums, cites EU and IMO measures and national clean-up programmes, and announced a study of microplastics in the North Sea.
In addition, I am currently having an initial study carried out into the scale and possible consequences of microplastics in the North Sea.
Daarnaast laat ik momenteel een eerste onderzoek uitvoeren naar de omvang en mogelijke gevolgen van microplastics in de Noordzee.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het Europees verzuringsbeleid (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether the government accepts that the PBL report on 30 years of acidification undermined the scientific basis of European acidification policy, whether the Gothenburg-based nitrogen rules should be relaxed, and whether PBL's quality control should be scrapped. The government rejected these claims, defended the policy as necessary for biodiversity, and kept PBL's internal quality control while announcing a 2012 international audit.
I consider the quality control by the PBL itself sufficient, given the internal scientific quality assurance and certification procedures the PBL applies.
De kwaliteitscontrole door het PBL zelf acht ik voldoende, mede gelet op de door het PBL gehanteerde interne wetenschappelijke kwaliteitsborging en certificeringsprocedures.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel «Atsma zet in op minder keuringen van dijken» (ingezonden 19 april 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether reducing dike inspections from every six to every twelve years is wise given rising sea levels and flood risk, and what savings and data justify it. The secretary confirms the change follows a taskforce recommendation to spread assessment and reinforcement work more evenly over time, with a six-yearly overview report and no change to the water manager's ongoing safety duty.
The assessment, design and improvement of water defences can therefore be carried out more evenly over time.
Het toetsen, ontwerpen en verbeteren van waterkeringen kan daardoor gelijkmatiger in de tijd uitgevoerd worden.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over kankerverwekkende stoffen in spaarlampen (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An MP asked whether energy-saving lamps emitting carcinogenic substances are acceptable on shop shelves and whether the Postbus 51 campaign promoting them should stop. The state secretary replied that the emissions are very small, lower than incandescent and halogen lamps, that German research is ongoing, and that the campaign has ended.
Of course we will keep an eye on the results of this research.
Uiteraard zullen wij de resultaten van dit onderzoek in de gaten houden.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Mos (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat ADO-spelers het lied «We gaan op jodenj

Two PVV MPs asked ministers whether they know of reports that ADO Den Haag players sang an antisemitic chant after beating Ajax, whether such calls are condemned, and what measures will be taken with the KNVB. The minister confirmed awareness, called incitement unacceptable, said the club suspended the players and the prosecutor saw no role, and promised a letter on tightening anti-discrimination policy before summer.
Before the summer, the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and I will send a letter on tightening anti-discrimination policy.
Nog voor de zomer zullen de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en ik met een brief komen over de aanscherping van het antidiscriminatiebeleid.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over kwetsende spreekkoren (ingezonden 4 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether football clubs and the KNVB should be called on to stop offensive chants, define offensive terms, and join the FARE programme. The minister answered that offensive chants are unacceptable, supports the KNVB's own disciplinary instruments and a joint action plan with police and prosecutors, but considers compiling a list of offensive terms unhelpful and says FARE membership is voluntary.
However, drawing up a list of offensive terms does not seem useful to me.
Het opstellen van een lijst met kwetsende termen lijkt mij echter niet zinvol.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over klimaatverandering door menselijk handelen (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about the claimed 97% scientific consensus on human-caused climate change, a sample of 75 scientists, the 'hide the decline' tree-ring affair, a European Commission cost estimate of EU climate policy, and whether environmental policy should be assessed by cost-benefit analysis. The state secretary answered that the IPCC reflects the consensus, that the sample was not representative and the 97% figure rests on a subgroup, that tree-ring data have limited reliability, that climate policy is expected to be effective, and that cost-benefit analysis is already used where meaningful.
For this cabinet, as for the previous one, the IPCC reports reflect the consensus in climate science.
Voor dit kabinet, evenals voor het vorige, geven de rapporten van het IPCC de consensus in de klimaatwetenschap weer.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over problemen in het gehandicaptenvervoer (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

An MP asked ministers about refusals of disabled passengers in special transport because of stricter rules, about wheelchair standards, seatbelts, and scooter lifts. The minister said safety rules bar concessions, cost estimates make mandatory wheelchair anchor points unjustified, and only a small adjustment to rules will be examined.
I am therefore willing to have it examined whether it is possible to resolve possible problems regarding the seating posture with a minor adjustment of the existing rules.
Ik ben daarom bereid om te laten nagaan of het mogelijk is om met een geringe aanpassing van de bestaande regels eventuele problemen rond de zit-lighouding op te lossen.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Graus (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over milieuzones (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether environmental zones (milieuzones) unfairly burden entrepreneurs and fairground/circus vehicles, and whether the fine dust effects justify them. The state secretary rejected the claim of significant economic harm, pointed to hardship exemptions and the 13-year age exception for fairground vehicles, and cited a study showing environmental zones reduce NO2 and PM10 concentrations.
No, I do not share this view.
Nee, deze mening deel ik niet.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over schulden en Europese topclubs (ingezonden 29 maart 2011).

An MP asks the sports minister whether the government will press UEFA and the KNVB to enforce the Financial Fair Play debt rules against European top clubs and to curb transfer spending, citing club debts and bankruptcy risk for grassroots football. The minister answers that UEFA must enforce its own rules and no action is needed now, declines to call for ending free movement of workers, and says a club bankruptcy need not directly harm grassroots sport or youth training.
I share the view that the European football federation must enforce its own rules and I have full confidence that this federation will do so.
Ik deel de mening dat de Europese Voetbalbond haar eigen regels moet handhaven en ik heb er alle vertrouwen in dat deze bond dat ook zal doen.

Vragen van de leden Lucassen en De Mos (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Utrecht wil bewoners dwingen hun hui

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they support Utrecht's plan to force residents to insulate their homes, and whether aerial thermal scans identifying individual homes go too far. The minister opposed compulsory insulation, said it would not become national policy, left the choice to owners, and said thermal scans give only global information and detailed assessment requires owners' consent.
However, it always remains up to building owners themselves to decide whether and which measures they take.
Het blijft echter te allen tijde aan gebouweigenaren zelf om te bepalen of en zoja welke maatregelen zij nemen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Gaat de zon de broeikas stoppen» (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether he would revise climate policy if reduced solar activity cools the Earth, and whether he would investigate that claim further and invite sceptical scientists. The state secretary replied that Dutch climate policy follows current science, that solar variation is already accounted for, that a 2006 report on the sun's influence already covered the topic, and that he is open to talks with climate experts.
I see no reason to adjust the current policy because variations in solar activity are already taken into account.
Ik zie geen reden tot aanpassing van het huidige beleid omdat variaties in zonneactiviteit daarin al worden meegenomen.

Vragen van het lid Dille en De Mos (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het onderzoek van FNV Bondgenoten over de kwaliteit van het taxivervoer voor ouderen en gehandicapten(ingezonden

MPs Dille and De Mos asked the minister about an FNV Bondgenoten survey showing poor quality in taxi transport for elderly and disabled people, and whether marketisation worsened it and whether legal quality requirements for tenders are needed. The state secretary rejected the causal claim, said the union survey is not representative and not comparable to the government's own baseline measurement, and stated that cost is not the only criterion in tenders but gave no commitment to new legal quality requirements.
I do not recognise the picture the question suggests. This general conclusion cannot be drawn (on the basis of this research).
Ik herken mij niet in het beeld dat de vraag oproept. Deze algemene conclusie kan men (op basis van dit onderzoek) niet trekken.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over plannen voor een nieuwe afvaloven (ingezonden 21 fe

Two PVV MPs asked whether the €6 million state subsidy for the Omrin waste incineration plant in Harlingen should be withheld while court proceedings and the annulled permit are pending, and whether there is overcapacity in waste incineration. The state secretary answered that the subsidy is tied to commissioning by 1 May 2011 and would be reduced to zero if the plant cannot operate, that the permit is in force after the Council of State rejected the injunction, and that waste supply is currently below forecasts.
If the REC cannot be put into use due to the lack of an environmental permit, the subsidy will be set at zero.
Als de REC niet in gebruik kan worden genomen als gevolg van het ontbreken van een milieuvergunning, zal de subsidie op nihil worden vastgesteld.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het project in het gebied Nieuweschans/Hamdijk (ingezonden 1 maart 2011).

PVV MP De Mos asked the State Secretary about the Hamdijk/Nieuweschans water storage and nature project, arguing it damages farmland and that the regional government ignored stakeholders' alternatives. The State Secretary defended the project as part of flood safety and nature restoration, said the courts found the authorities had acted carefully, and deferred the nature decisions to the province.
It is up to the province of Groningen to assess whether it includes these nature areas in its proposal for a revised EHS.
Het is aan de provincie Groningen om te beoordelen of ze deze natuurgebieden meenemen in hun voorstel voor een herijkte EHS.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de financiering van het Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether the government would investigate stopping Dutch funding to the IPCC, given that the Dutch House of Representatives had supported halting IPCC funding. The state secretary said IPCC reflects the science well but needs reform, that Dutch funding is modest and better spent influencing reforms than stopping, and disclosed an annual contribution of about 39,000 euro.
Stopping the (modest) contribution is neither opportune nor effective.
Stoppen met de (bescheiden) bijdrage is opportuun noch effectief.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over «oermoeras» (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether converting 600 hectares of farmland into a wetland (Dannemeer, Groningen) is absurd, and whether the money would be better spent on the business climate. The state secretary answered that the project stems from 1990 agreements, is financed under the ILG arrangements, and is being reviewed in a broader herijking of the EHS, with the province of Groningen responsible for prioritising within national frameworks.
It is up to the province of Groningen to determine, on the basis of the criteria provided, whether completing the Dannemeer project forms part of the revised EHS.
Het is aan de provincie Groningen om op basis van de aangereikte criteria te bepalen of de afronding van het project Dannemeer deel uitmaakt van de herijkte EHS.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Ajaxfan hoeft zich niet te melden» (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

An MP asks whether the Amsterdam mayor's football-hooligan reporting obligation, suspended by a court, can be fixed, whether the Voetbalwet can be strengthened, and whether it can be made as strict as the English Hooligan Act. The minister answers that the court suspended the order for insufficient justification, that the mayor will reconsider, that the law is being monitored and supported, and that the English experience will be considered in the evaluation.
Pending the evaluation of the law's operation, its application by administration and the Public Prosecution Service is being monitored in the interim by the Inspectorate for Public Order and Safety.
In afwachting van de evaluatie van de werking van de wet wordt de toepassing van de wet door bestuur en Openbaar Ministerie tussentijds gemonitord door de Inspectie Openbare Orde en Veiligheid.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het aan kinderen opdringen van een eenzijdige klimaattheor

PVV MPs asked the education minister whether schools are being pressed to teach a one-sided climate theory to children, citing the 'Warme Truiendag' campaign and a Youth News broadcast, and asked about related subsidies. The minister said schools choose their own teaching materials, declined to give a substantive view on indoctrination, and stated that the 'Warme Truiendag' campaign received no 2011 state subsidy while a related European youth project is partly funded by the Foreign Ministry.
It is up to the schools themselves which teaching materials they use.
Het is aan scholen zelf van welke leermiddelen zij gebruik maken.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over kunstgras (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

MP De Mos asks the minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about a remark by ADO trainer John van den Brom that home teams with artificial turf have an absolute advantage, raising concerns about competitive distortion, a possible survey of professional clubs, and whether artificial turf should be banned in competitions. The minister acknowledges the report and answers that the KNVB and clubs decide on playing surfaces, so the ministry has no responsibility.
It is up to the KNVB and the clubs to decide how, where and on what surface football is played.
Het is aan de KNVB en de clubs om te bepalen hoe, waar en op welke ondergrond het voetbal wordt gespeeld.

Vragen van de leden De Mos, Hernandez en Graus (allen PVV) aan de minister van Defensie en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over verkregen informatie dat er naar alle waarschijnlijkheid op verschillende p

PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister whether a map shows 18 locations in the Haarlemmermeer polder with live WWII German explosives near dikes, roads and Schiphol, and why this was not disclosed, and whether the explosives will be cleared and the map shared. The minister denied live explosives, said the sites were cleared in 1945–1947, and provided a copy of the map after it was posted online.
A copy of the map is hereby sent to you.
Een kopie van de kaart zend ik u hierbij.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over voetbalwedstrijden en collectief vervoer (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the combi-regulation (forced collective travel for away supporters) should be abolished in favour of the Football Act, and whether clubs' losses and English practice warrant change. The Minister says the two measures are different and both have a role, that the government will agree with partners to reduce combi-regulations under a new framework due this spring, that an audit of away supporters is underway, and that the combi-regulation is still needed while incidents continue.
The policy framework will be published this spring.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het onderhoud aan dijken (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary why the Netherlands is protected by poorly maintained dikes, which dikes are affected, by when all dikes will meet the norms, and whether dike reinforcement should take priority over new nature creation. The state secretary acknowledged the report, explained that standards are checked every six years and failures have many causes, promised an overview report by mid-year, and said safety is his core priority while nature work may be combined with it but not at the expense of flood-safety budgets.
Yes, I intend to send you a report by mid-year containing an overview of the condition of all primary flood defences.
Ja, ik ben voornemens om u medio dit jaar een rapportage met daarin een overzicht van de toestand van alle primaire waterkeringen toe te sturen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uitspraken van FIFA-baas Blatter over homo’s in Qatar (ingezonden 20 december 2010).

The PVV MP De Mos asks the health minister whether she knows of FIFA president Blatter's remarks that gay people in Qatar should abstain from sex, whether she agrees this harms gay rights, and whether she will ask Blatter or the KNVB for clarification. The minister confirms awareness of the report and refers to earlier answers given to MP Dijkstra, without restating substance.
See my answer to question 2 from MP Dijkstra.
Zie mijn antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Dijkstra.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel «Nederlanders betalen hoogste milieubelasting ter wereld» (ingezonden 18 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether Dutch environmental taxes, reported as the highest in the world, harm business competitiveness and whether they should be aligned with neighbouring countries. The government corrected an OECD double-counting error, argued that total tax burden and administrative costs matter more than environmental taxes alone, and declined to reduce environmental taxes because revenue funds general spending.
Lowering environmental taxes would have to lead to higher other taxes.
Verlaging van de milieubelastingen zou moeten leiden tot verhoging van andere belastingen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Defensie over de Zandmotor (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about groundwater risks from the Loswal Noord dump near the Zandmotor, and about ordnance risks, asking that the project be halted pending independent research. The state secretary answered that the dump cannot affect drinking water sources because groundwater flows seaward, that sonar surveys found no ordnance at the sand extraction site, and that the explosives disposal service would be called if ordnance were found; he did not agree to halt the project.
Therefore I do not share your view that the Zandmotor pilot should be abandoned and that independent research should be conducted into possible influences of Loswal Noord.
Daarom deel ik uw mening niet dat moet worden afgezien van de Pilot Zandmotor en er onafhankelijk onderzoek moet worden verricht naar mogelijke invloeden van Loswal Noord.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de presentatie van het boek «De staat van het klimaat» (ingezonden 17 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether he shares the claim that favouritism, pressure and deception undermine international climate research, and whether the IPCC should consider sceptical publications. The state secretary rejected the conclusion, said Netherlands supports the IPCC review process, and stated that publications on solar activity, air pollution and land use were included in the Fourth Assessment Report.
I intend to discuss in a follow-up conversation the ideas of Mr Crok regarding the sound and proper functioning of climate science in general and of the IPCC in particular.

Ik ben voornemens in een vervolggesprek door te praten over de ideeën van de heer Crok met betrekking tot het goed en integer functioneren van de klimaatwetenschap in het algemeen en van het IPCC in het bijzonder.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over overvallen op taxichauffeurs in Arnhem (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about robberies of taxi drivers in Arnhem and whether the rise in violence was national, and what could be done, including installing alarm buttons in every taxi. The minister replied that police LORS data show taxi robberies fell 30% in 2010, that overvallen remain a priority with a Taskforce, that industry measures are available, and that alarm buttons are already present in many taxis.
According to the LORS, the number of robberies of taxis in the first ten months of 2010 fell by 30%, from 74 in 2009 to 52 in 2010.
Uit het LORS blijkt dat het aantal overvallen op taxi's in de eerste tien maanden van 2010 met 30% afgenomen is, van 74 in 2009 naar 52 in 2010.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Juristen: «Overheid loopt aanzienlijke risico’s voor aansprakelijkheid klimaatverandering» (ingezonden 8 november 201

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment whether a book by lawyers warning of state liability for climate change inflames fear, whether the government should create more legal frameworks, whether it disavows the book's conclusions, and whether public money funded it. The state secretary answered that the book reflects the views of lawyers from the Landsadvocaat's firm, that the government was not involved and no public money was spent, that current regulation complies with European and treaty obligations, and that the government anticipates legal problems as they arise.
The Rijk was in no way involved in this, and the conclusions are therefore for the account of the law firm.
Het Rijk is hier op geen enkele manier bij betrokken geweest, en de conclusies komen dan ook voor rekening van het advocatenkantoor.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether the Flemish prime minister had reversed his position on the Hedwigepolder de-poldering, whether Flanders was using the project as a bargaining chip for Antwerp port growth, and whether the Zeeland population could be assured that de-poldering would not go ahead. The state secretary denied any reversal, said no such linkage had been raised with Flanders, and said a realistic alternative would be clear within six months.
I have informed Flemish Minister-President Peeters that within half a year there will be clarity on whether a realistic alternative to the Hedwigepolder can be found.
Ik heb de Vlaamse minister-president Peeters gemeld dat er over een half jaar duidelijkheid zal zijn of een reëel alternatief voor de Hedwigepolder te vinden is.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het onttrekken van rechten aan het Europese emissiehandelssysteem met als doel deze te vernietigen (ingezonden 3 november 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary about a website, co2markt.eu, through which citizens can voluntarily cancel EU ETS emission allowances, and whether the government funds it. The government defends voluntary cancellation as built into the EU ETS, notes the NEa verifies cancellations, and says SNM received a SMOM subsidy of about 236,690 euro for start-up costs.
SNM has received SMOM subsidy from the government for this project.
SNM heeft van de overheid SMOM-subsidie ontvangen voor dit project.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu, de minister Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie o

PVV MPs asked why ministries co-funded a free Bosatlas set for all secondary schools, whether climate sceptics were involved, and whether children are being informed one-sidedly about climate change. The state secretary answered that schools choose their own teaching materials, that the atlas omits future temperature and sea-level scenarios due to uncertainty, and gave no commitment to change anything.
It is up to the schools themselves which teaching materials they use.
Het is aan de scholen zelf van welke leermiddelen zij gebruik maken.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over verdubbeling in het aantal legionellagevallen

The MPs asked whether the government will investigate weather effects, water quality and prevention measures after a doubling in Legionnaires' disease cases. The state secretary answered that research points to warm, wet weather, that sources remain unclear, that monitoring duties exist for some installations, and that information campaigns and a separate letter will follow.
You will be informed separately by letter about this issue and the measures to be taken.
Over deze problematiek en de te treffen maatregelen wordt u separaat bij brief geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel waarin een grote gifzaak in de haven van Rotterdam wordt beschreven (ingezonden 19 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether the government considers it a scandal that highly toxic zinc waste has lain for decades in the port of Rotterdam, whether it should be returned to Germany, and whether the ministry failed to protect the environment and help the company. The state secretary replies that the operator EBS is responsible, that a temporary permit allows storage until July 2011, that the EU cannot force Germany to take the waste back, and that the silos pose no danger.
The provincial executive of South Holland decided to cooperate with EBS by issuing a temporary permit for the storage of these waste materials.
Het college van Gedeputeerde Staten van Zuid-Holland heeft besloten mee te werken met EBS door het afgeven van een tijdelijke vergunning voor de opslag van deze afvalstoffen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Ophef over gloeilampenafspraken: Cramer in de fout» (ingezonden 19 oktober 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether the incandescent light bulb phase-out, which the MP said had caused darkness for households and businesses and that the alternatives were immature, should be reversed or fought in Brussels. The state secretary rejected these views, pointed to the EU Ecodesign rules, the conversion list and public campaign, and stated support for the phase-out.
I do not share this view. The incandescent bulb is a very inefficient light source and I support the European decision to phase out inefficient lamps.
Deze mening deel ik niet. De gloeilamp is een zeer onzuinige lichtbron en ik sta achter het Europese besluit om onzuinige lampen uit te faseren.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over bewindspersonen die naar de klimaattop in Cancún (Mexico) gaan (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

MP De Mos (PVV) asked whether ministers should travel to the Cancún climate summit, given stalled negotiations, doubts about human impact on climate, the expiry of Kyoto, and taxpayer costs. State Secretary Atsma defended attending with a small delegation, reaffirmed the climate science and international agreements' necessity, and offered video links for MPs who do not travel.
I choose a small, effective delegation.
Ik kies voor een kleine, effectieve delegatie.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht dat grondwater een belangrijke rol speelt bij de stijging van de zeespiegel (ingezonden 29 septe

An MP asks the minister about a study finding that groundwater extraction contributes substantially to sea-level rise, and whether measurements should be corrected for it. The state secretary answers that the study adds a reason for sustainable water management and that groundwater extraction would be noted as a third major cause if confirmed, while measured values stay unchanged.
I will of course take the outcomes of this research into account when naming the causes of sea-level rise.
Wel zal ik de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek uiteraard meenemen in het benoemen van de oorzaken van de stijging van de zeespiegel

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het falen omtrent asbestverwijdering in woningen in de Nieuwegeinse wijk Jutphaas/Wijkersloot (ingezonden 4

An MP asks the housing minister whether asbestos removal and renovation works in Nieuwegein's Jutphaas/Wijkersloot neighbourhood endangered residents and workers, and whether ministry supervision failed. The state secretary replies that municipal and labour inspection supervision is adequate, that the VROM Inspectorate found permits and asbestos removal compliant after two site visits, and that the Ombudsman found the municipality should have acted faster, which it accepts.
The municipality accepts the ruling and will adjust its working method.
De gemeente accepteert het oordeel en zal haar werkwijze aanpassen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht «Bevriende taxichauffeurs krijgen lucratieve ritjes» (ingezonden 8 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether she knew of reports that hotels steer guests to favoured taxi drivers, and whether she would have the Inspectorate investigate. The minister replied that the choice of taxi company is the customer's, that no monitored rule appears violated, and that she will not ask the Inspectorate to investigate absent indications of violations.
In the situation you describe, no rule is violated that the IVW supervises.
In de door u geschetste situatie wordt geen regel overtreden waarop door IVW toezicht wordt gehouden.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over invloed van CO2 in de atmosfeer op temperatuurstijging (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether a lecture by a former AKZO director, claiming a doubling of CO2 yields only 0.27 degrees warming, reopens the debate on human-caused warming, and whether climate policy should be halted until the IPCC conclusions are better substantiated. The minister answers that the lecturer's trends stem from changes in measurement systems rather than atmospheric change, and that there is no reason to doubt the IPCC's main conclusions, so no investigation or policy halt is planned.
The lecture by Mr Van Andel gives no reason to doubt the main conclusions of the IPCC.
De lezing van de heer Van Andel geeft geen aanleiding te twijfelen aan de hoofdconclusies van het IPCC.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Sharpe (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over gevolgen van de zandmotor voor de Delflandse kust (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

PVV MPs De Mos and Sharpe asked the minister of Transport and Water Management whether the Zandmotor pilot should be halted over uncertain effects on currents, rip formation, drowning risk, munitions and sea-level rise. The minister rejected halting the project, citing active monitoring, safety measures and the need for innovative, cost-efficient coastal defence.
Also during and after the construction of the Zandmotor, effects are monitored daily.
Ook tijdens en na de aanleg van de Zandmotor worden effecten dagelijks gemonitord.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht dat de ijskappen minder hard smelten (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

An MP asked the minister about a TU Delft study finding ice caps melt less than thought, whether the study's inclusion of crustal measurements was justified, and whether such measurements would be adopted in future research. The minister answered that the method is new, not yet very accurate, and that the authors themselves call for further research.
This new method is still in its infancy and is not yet very accurate.
Deze nieuwe methode staat nog in de kinderschoenen en is nog niet heel nauwkeurig.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Miljoenenfraude met bureaus voor gastouders» (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

An MP asked the minister about reports of multimillion-euro fraud involving childcare agencies, whether a national blacklist of dubious agencies should be created, and what action will be taken against agencies falsely claiming registration. The minister confirmed a criminal investigation with convictions, rejected a government blacklist in favour of a quality-register and new controls, and said registration checks will be possible for parents from 2011.
A blacklist of dubious childminding agencies does not automatically achieve the intended goal of keeping fraudsters out of the childcare market.
Een zwarte lijst van dubieuze gastouderbureaus leidt niet zonder meer tot het beoogde doel om fraudeurs te weren uit de kinderopvangmarkt.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de voormalig hoogleraar milieukunde en onderzoeker aan de Universiteit van Ottawa (ingezonden 30 juli 2010).

MP De Mos (PVV) asks the minister about a former Ottawa environmental scientist's claim that man-made global warming is a corrupt social phenomenon, whether IPCC scientists serve governments, and whether CO2 emissions trading is fraudulent. The minister answers that the 'corrupt' wording is not in the cited essay, that IPCC authors are selected on expertise and unpaid, and refers to earlier answers on emissions-trading fraud.
The authors of the IPCC reports are selected by the IPCC Bureau primarily on the basis of scientific expertise.
Antwoord 3 De auteurs van de IPCC rapporten worden geselecteerd door het Bureau van IPCC primair op basis van wetenschappelijke expertise.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over ophef over anti-glasnost brief Pachauri aan auteurs (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether the IPCC chair's letter to report authors urging careful, coordinated media statements undermines open climate debate, and whether the minister would ask him to stop such letters. The minister answered that the letter was a call for care, that the chair clarified it in a follow-up stressing transparency and media contact, and that no request to the IPCC chair was made.
The letter primarily asks for care.
De brief vraagt primair om zorgvuldigheid.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht «Zelfde catastrofedenkers bij nieuw IPCC» (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the environment minister whether activist climate scientists dominating the IPCC's author selection undermine trust, and whether a Greenpeace-linked coordinating lead author should be appointed to Working Group 2. The minister replied that author selection is based on scientific expertise via national nominations, that the appointed author's team is balanced, and that the PBL and an InterAcademy Council review will inform the IPCC process.
The IPCC secretariat selects authors based on nominations from countries and international organisations, and may also approach experts itself.
Het bureau van het IPCC doet de selectie van de auteurs op basis van de nominaties van landen en internationale organisaties en eventueel kan het bureau ook zelf experts benaderen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over biobrandstof (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether the EU should drop mandatory biofuel blending given CE Delft findings on deforestation and climate impact, and whether all biofuel targets competing with food land should be scrapped. The minister replies that sustainability criteria already apply, that Netherlands supports an indirect land-use change factor, and that food-competition risks are being monitored, without committing to abolish the blending target.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht «Taxi’s speciaal vervoer sjoemelen» (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

The MP asks the minister about reports that special-transport taxi firms evade the collective agreement and whether their operating licences should be withdrawn, and about claims that tenders for special transport focus only on price. The minister answers that compliance with the CAO is primarily the responsibility of social partners and the Sociaal Fonds Taxi, that the IVW can suspend or revoke licences only after a civil court judgment finding serious and repeated breaches, and that quality criteria are being promoted in tenders with an annual evaluation to Parliament.
The Inspectorate of Transport and Water Management (IVW) can suspend or withdraw the operating licence. For that a judgment from the civil court is required.
De Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat (IVW) kan de ondernemersvergunning schorsen of intrekken. Daarvoor is een vonnis van de burgerlijke rechter nodig
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht dat taxichauffeurs jarenlang zijn opgelicht (ingezonden 29 juni 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether taxi drivers were defrauded by paying around 37 euros for a taxi logbook when comparable versions cost about 3 euros, whether the minister would investigate or order repayment, and whether the annual taximeter inspection could be abolished. The minister answered that Sdu's pricing fell within permitted tariff freedom, that no investigation had been announced, that all approved logbooks meet the requirements, and that the annual taximeter inspection will be kept because consumers cannot verify it themselves.
No investigation into Sdu has been announced by me.
Door mij is geen onderzoek naar Sdu aangekondigd.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over streep door rekening strandfestival (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MP De Mos (PVV) asks why a Radio 538 beach festival is subject to an ecological quickscan and whether environmental groups' influence should be curbed, and asks for the quickscan to be declared unnecessary. The minister replies that Natura 2000 rules require testing where effects cannot be ruled out, that the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority, that the organiser cancelled the event, and that she will not declare the assessment unnecessary.
Under the Nature Conservation Act 1998, the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority in this matter.
Op grond van de Natuurbeschermingswet 1998 is de provincie Noord-Holland in dezen bevoegd gezag.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht «Maleisië dreigt met conflict over hout» (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP from the PVV asks the minister why the Dutch taxpayer must bear costs of objection procedures brought by environmental groups against the Malaysian timber certificate, which the TPAC found compliant, why no decision on admission has been taken while neighbouring countries approved it, and whether the government applies double standards on forest felling at home. The minister replies only that the questions cannot be answered within the statutory deadline and that answers will follow as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that these questions cannot be answered within the time limit set for them.
Hierbij deel ik u mee dat deze vragen niet binnen de daarvoor gestelde termijn beantwoord kunnen worden.

m: Motie van het lid Çelik over maatwerk via gemeenten
Asks the government to keep ensuring tailored support via municipalities for people who cannot immediately enter the labour market after language courses.
requests the government to continue guaranteeing tailored help via the municipalities for this group
verzoekt de regering, via de gemeenten voor deze groep mensen maatwerk te blijven waarborgen
Amendement van het lid Çelik over het opnemen van een evaluatiebepaling in het wetsvoorstel
Adds an evaluation clause requiring the education minister to report to the Staten-Generaal within five years on the law's effectiveness and effects.
Within five years of this law taking effect, the Minister of Education, Culture and Science sends the Staten-Generaal a report on the law's effectiveness and effects in practice.

Onze Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap zendt binnen vijf jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Motie van het lid Çelik over de toezichthoudende taak van raden van toezicht
Asks the government to direct school supervisory boards to oversee how schools involve parents, not only finances and operations.
requests the government to point the supervisory boards to their supervisory task regarding how the board and school give shape to parental involvement
verzoekt de regering, om de raden van toezicht te wijzen op hun toezichthoudende taak bij de wijze waarop het bestuur en de school gestalte geven aan ouderbetrokkenheid
Motie van het lid Çelik over ruimte voor kwaliteitsambities
Asks the minister to specify how the WMS information rights can be read to allow quality discussions in works councils without changing the law.
requests the minister to specify how the provisions of the WMS, in particular the information rights provisions, can be read
verzoekt de minister, te specificeren hoe de bepalingen van de WMS, met name de bepalingen met betrekking tot de informatierechten, gelezen kunnen worden
Motie van het lid Çelik over indicatoren voor medezeggenschap
Motion asks the minister to have sector organisations include indicators on works council participation in accountability frameworks and report to the House on actions taken.
include indicators on participation in Vensters voor verantwoording and Vensters PO and report to the House
indicatoren over medezeggenschap op te nemen in Vensters voor verantwoording en Vensters PO en aan de Kamer te rapporteren
Motie van het lid Çelik over verplicht toestemming aan de minister vragen voor investeringen vanaf 30 mln.
Motion asks the government to require regional training centres to obtain ministerial permission for investments of 30 million euros or more.
requests the government to oblige regional training centres to ask the minister for permission for investments of 30 million or more
verzoekt de regering, voortaan de regionale opleidingscentra te verplichten om voor investeringen ten bedrage van bijvoorbeeld 30 mln. of hoger de minister om toestemming te vragen
Motie van het lid Çelik over aandachtspunten bij het toezicht op regionale opleidingscentra
Asks the government to pay attention to investment mismanagement and outdated equipment when supervising regional vocational training centres.
requests the government to explicitly keep an eye on these kinds of aspects going forward when supervising the regional training centres
verzoekt de regering, voortaan dit soort aspecten uitdrukkelijk in de gaten te laten houden bij het toezicht op de regionale opleidingscentra
Amendement van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Çelik ter vervanging van nr. 7 over het geven van instemmingsrecht aan de MR bij verzelfstandiging
Gives the school participation council a right of consent (instemmingsrecht), not only advice, over the spin-off of a branch or part of a school.
the participation council has not only advisory rights on spin-offs but also consent rights
de medezeggenschapsraad niet slechts adviesrecht heeft bij verzelfstandiging maar instemmingsrecht
Motie Jasper van Dijk en Çelik over maximumaantal leerlingen per school
Motion asks the government to investigate options for a maximum number of pupils per school and present them to the House.
requests the government to investigate the various options for this and present them to the House of Representatives
verzoekt de regering de verschillende mogelijkheden hiertoe te onderzoeken en voor te leggen aan de Tweede Kamer
Motie Jasper van Dijk / Çelik over vrijstelling van de leerplicht
Asks the government to abolish exemptions from compulsory schooling granted on religious or philosophical grounds.
requests the government to remove the exemption from compulsory schooling on grounds of philosophical objections.
verzoekt de regering de vrijstelling van de leerplicht op grond van richtingsbedenkingen te schrappen
Motie Çelik over een specificatie van de ontwikkeling in het aantal vrijstellingen
Asks the government to report annually on the development of numbers of compulsory-education exemptions under several legal articles, to monitor ministerial policy.
requests the government to provide from now on an annual specification of the development
verzoekt de regering om voortaan jaarlijks een specificatie te leveren van de ontwikkeling
Motie Çelik over de ombuiging bij passend onderwijs
Asks the government to use the full performance-pay budget to reduce the cut to special needs education funding.
the government implements a cut of €300 million when introducing inclusive education
de regering bij de invoering van het passend onderwijs een ombuiging doorvoert van € 300 mln.
Asks the government to commission supplementary research tracing primary-school advice against later secondary-school performance to measure under-advising of pupils.
requests the government to have the existing studies on under-advising supplemented and expanded
verzoekt de regering om de bestaande onderzoeken naar onderadvisering te laten aanvullen en uitbreiden
Motie Çelik en Biskop over de keuze voor techniek
Asks the government to have the ministers of education and economic affairs draw up, with employers, a plan with result obligations to promote choosing technical careers.
requests the government to give the education minister an important task and have her, with the economic affairs minister and employers, produce a plan to promote choosing technical careers
verzoekt de regering om ook de minister van OCW hierbij een belangrijke taak te geven en haar samen met de minister van ELI in overleg met werkgevers tot een plan te laten komen
Motie Çelik over een differentiatie in de materiële lumpsum
Asks the government to differentiate the material lump-sum funding for vmbo education so that technical programmes receive funding matching their higher material costs.
requests the government to move towards a differentiation in the material lump sum
verzoekt de regering om te komen tot een differentiatie in de materiële lumpsum
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over maatwerk in het mbo
Asks the cabinet to offer tailored support in mbo programmes shortening, with an extra year of margin where needed.
requests the cabinet, in consultation with mbo programmes, to offer tailored solutions when shortening the programmes
verzoekt het kabinet in overleg met de mbo-opleidingen maatwerk te bieden bij het verkorten van de opleidingen
Motie Biskop en Çelik over beroepsopleidingen in regiogemeenten
Asks the government to promote retention of vocational education in regional municipalities, with regional business interests guiding policy.
requests the government to promote the retention of vocational education in regional municipalities
verzoekt de regering het behoud van het beroepsonderwijs in regiogemeenten te bevorderen
Motie Çelik over de bekostiging van technische (vmbo-)opleidingen
Asks the government to earmark funding for technical vmbo education instead of leaving it within the lump-sum budget for schools.
requests the government no longer to let funding for technical vmbo training simply merge into the lump sum but to earmark it from now on
verzoekt de regering om niet langer de bekostiging van technische (vmbo-)opleidingen zonder meer te laten opgaan in de lumpsum maar deze voortaan te oormerken
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over klassengrootte
Motion asks the cabinet to commission research into class sizes in primary and secondary education and their relation to education quality.
requests the cabinet to commission research into class size in primary and secondary education.
verzoekt het kabinet een onderzoek in te stellen naar de klassengrootte in het primair en voortgezet onderwijs
Motie Klaver c.s. over investeren in het onderwijs
Asks the government to raise corporate tax by a quarter percentage point and use the revenue for education investment.
requests the government to raise corporation tax by a quarter percent and use the proceeds directly to invest in education.
verzoekt de regering de vennootschapsbelasting met een kwart procent te verhogen en de opbrengsten direct te gebruiken om te investeren in het onderwijs
Motie Beertema c.s. over criteria voor het contactuur

Asks the government to pursue a national definition of the teaching contact hour with clear criteria, aiming for an 80/20 split between primary process and overhead in education institutions by end 2014.
based on a unambiguous national definition including clear criteria for the contact hour
op basis van een eenduidige, landelijke definiëring waarin heldere criteria voor het contactuur zijn opgenomen
Motie Çelik en Biskop over de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage
Asks the government to remind schools that voluntary parental contributions are optional and to have the inspectorate act on any sign of compulsion.
have the inspectorate respond alertly to any signal that a school has given the voluntary contribution a compulsory character
de inspectie alert te laten reageren op elk signaal dat een school de vrijwillige bijdrage een verplicht karakter heeft gegeven
Amendement van de leden Çelik en Dijksma over het verstrekken van een OV-trajectkaart aan MBO-leerlingen die jonger zijn dan achttien jaar
Adds 70 thousand euros to the education budget so that MBO students under 18 can receive an OV annual pass, funded by cutting road construction.
With this amendment the submitters ensure that MBO students under 18 also receive an OV annual pass.
Met dit amendement bewerkstelligen de indieners dat ook MBO-leerlingen die jonger zijn dan 18 jaar een OV-jaarkaart krijgen.
Amendement van de leden Çelik en Jasper van Dijk over het actief begeleiden van de leerling tijdens de onderwijstijd
Amendment defining school time as only hours in which a pupil is actively guided by a teacher, excluding unsupervised 'ophokuren'.
Only the hours in which a pupil is actively guided by a teacher are counted towards the hours referred to in the previous sentence.
Tot de uren, bedoeld in de vorige volzin, worden slechts de uren gerekend waarin een leerling actief door een leraar wordt begeleid.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Çelik ter vervanging van nr. 12 dat de plicht introduceert voor de minsiter om zorg te dragen voor een goede bekostiging van scholen indien docenten verzuimen en dient
Obliges the minister to ensure adequate funding for schools that must hire replacement teachers for absent staff, so that the hours norm can be met.
