Ik heb kennisgenomen van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.

Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een scholengemeenschap die het onderwijs meent te verbeteren door voortaan leerlingen met een havo-advies af te wijzen (ingezonden

An MP asked the education minister how she assesses a Amsterdam school's decision to stop admitting pupils with a havo advice, whether it breaches the Amsterdam transition convention, and how the inspectorate will treat this 'cherry-picking' in its ratings. The minister answered that admission decisions are the competent authority's responsibility, that she cannot judge the convention question, and that the inspectorate measures results against the primary school advice, while she will monitor the po-vo transition.
It is not for me to judge admission decisions of schools.
Het is dus niet aan mij om over toelatingsbeslissingen van scholen te oordelen.
Antwoord vragen Çelik over examinering op de Antillen en de positie van het Vespucci College in het bijzonder

An MP asked whether mandatory state examinations on Bonaire threaten the Vespucci College on Curaçao, and whether examinations should be allowed on Curaçao. The minister replied that the school is privately funded, that exams on Bonaire are an accessible option, and that a Council of State advice indicates only a national law could allow exams on Curaçao, which it considers a heavy route for a small group.
Using the option to sit the state examination on Bonaire is then the most practical solution.
Gebruik maken van de mogelijkheid staatsexamen te doen op Bonaire is dan de meest praktische oplossing.

Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de consequenties van de feitelijke fusie van ROC Flevoland en het ROC van Amsterdam (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether the de facto merger of ROC Flevoland and ROC van Amsterdam, which lifted all four ROC Flevoland board members into the top ten of best-paid ROC heads, changes her earlier stance, and whether the extra work justifies such pay. The Minister says she found no formal merger after an Inspectorate study, rejects the pay rise, has asked the Inspectorate for further research, and notes the WNT pay-norming bill; she reports no complaints received.
I have also asked the Inspectorate of Education to now carry out additional research into the cooperation construction used by the ROC van Amsterdam and ROC Flevoland.
Tevens heb ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gevraagd om nu aanvullend onderzoek te doen naar de door het ROC van Amsterdam en het ROC Flevoland toegepaste constructie van samenwerking.

Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de aanvraag die de Stichting Voortgezet Onderwijs Kerkrade bij de minister heeft ingediend om toestemming te krijgen om in Kerkrad

An MP asked the education minister whether she had considered the application to found College Nova Rolduc in Kerkrade, why a Parkstad school closed, and whether citizen initiatives and school-choice motives related to quality could be weighed in new school applications. The minister answered that the application was rejected, that closing a branch is the board's decision and the minister will talk with the board, that new schools are bound by law, and that existing law already allows funding to be stopped for very poor-performing schools.
Soon, at my request, a meeting will take place with SVO|PL in which they will among other things explain the motives for their decision.
Binnenkort vindt er op mijn verzoek een gesprek met SVO|PL plaats waarin zij onder meer de motieven voor hun beslissing komen toelichten.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de Toelatingscode vmbo-t / havo van de VO-Raad (ingezonden 8 december 2011).

MP Çelik asks the minister whether the VO-Raad's admission code for vmbo-t to havo transfer, with a 6.8 average exam grade cap and an interview, honours the Chamber's motion, and why the code takes effect only on 1 August 2012. The minister replies that the code combines grades with an interview and school advice, that a klachtenloket and an Inspectie study in 2012 will monitor compliance, and that schools will already apply the code in spring 2012.
To support this, I have agreed with the VO-Raad that a complaints desk will be operational, where parents and pupils can report if schools do not comply with the code.
Ter ondersteuning hiervan heb ik met de VO-raad afgesproken dat er dan ook een klachtenloket operationeel is, waar ouders en leerlingen het kunnen melden als scholen zich niet aan de code houden.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over tussentijdse verzwaring van opleidingen voor MBO-deeltijdleerlingen (ingezonden 9 november 2011).

MPs Çelik and Kuiken asked the education minister whether MBO part-time courses were being made harder mid-course by adding mandatory subjects like mathematics ahead of centrally set exams. The minister called such mid-course additions undesirable, denied that the change stems from the 2013–2014 central exams, and pointed students to the institution's complaints procedure and the Ombudslijn mbo.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over gediplomeerde overblijfkrachten in de tussenschoolse opvang (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP asked the education minister about the 11 citizen letters received on school lunch supervision, whether the statutory requirement that half of lunch supervisors be trained still stands, and how that squares with ending the training subsidy from the new year. The minister confirmed the statutory requirement, said the subsidy was explicitly temporary and that schools are now responsible, and declined to take new action.
I have no indications that schools are being placed in an impossible task and will not take any new action.
Ik heb geen indicaties dat scholen voor een onmogelijke opgave worden geplaatst en ga geen nieuwe acties ondernemen.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over 12 000 leerwerkbanen die in de uitzendbranche op de tocht worden gezet (

MPs Çelik and Hamer asked whether changing the education wage-tax reduction (Wet vermindering afdracht onderwijs) so that staffing agencies no longer qualify would put 12,000 apprenticeship places in the temp sector at risk, and why the government would undermine agencies' training role. The minister denied the change harms apprenticeships, said the reduction must reach the recognised training employer, and announced eased conditions allowing the reduction to be split with intermediary employers.

The clarification means that when an intermediary employer is engaged, the wage-tax reduction must go partly or fully to the recognised training company, depending on the division of tasks agreed between them.

De verduidelijking houdt in dat de afdrachtvermindering bij inschakeling van een intermediaire werkgever deels of volledig moet toekomen aan het erkende leerbedrijf, afhankelijk van de onderling overeengekomen taakverdeling.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over ondermaats onderwijs op particuliere vwo-scholen (ingezonden 30 september 2011).

An MP asked the education minister whether private vwo schools with simpler school exams inflate grades, making diplomas effectively purchasable, and whether the licensing colleges have adequately addressed the gap. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has intensified supervision, a gap limit of 0.5 applies over three years, sanctions (licence withdrawal) are being prepared, and the school-exam gap is improving but more slowly for vwo.
I also announced that the average difference between school exam grades and central exam grades over three exam years may not exceed 0.5.
Tevens heb ik aangekondigd dat het gemiddeld verschil tussen de schoolexamencijfers en de cijfers van het centrale examen over drie examenjaren niet groter mag zijn dan 0,5.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over de zinloosheid van zittenblijven (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

An MP asks the Education Minister whether repeating a school year is pointless, why retention rates differ little between average strong and weak schools, what alternatives she prefers and what retention costs. The minister says the evidence is mixed, leaves the judgement on retention to schools, points to outcome-oriented teaching and action plans, and declines to quantify costs because she rejects equating retention with waste.
I distance myself from the suggestion in the question that repeating a year is the same as waste.
Ik distantieer mij van de suggestie in de vraag dat zittenblijven hetzelfde is als verspilling.
Vragen van de leden Van Dekken , Çelik en Jadnanansing (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een diplomatruc voor gezakte leerlingen (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

MPs asked the education minister why the Inspectorate's investigation into a school's diploma trick for failing pupils was not finished and why she would not announce a law change now. The minister replied that the Inspectorate needed time after the holidays for hearing and counter-hearing, and that she can only judge whether to amend rules once the findings are known.

As I indicated in answer 4 to the previously mentioned parliamentary questions, I can only assess whether and how laws and regulations should be amended on the basis of the outcome of the Inspectorate's investigation.

Zoals ik in antwoord 4 van de reeds eerder genoemde Kamervragen heb aangegeven kan ik pas op basis van de uitkomst van het onderzoek van de Inspectie beoordelen of en op welke wijze wet- en regelgeving moet worden aangepast.

Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het groeiend aantal meldingen over de «vrijwillige» bijdrage die ROC’s vragen aan scholieren die volwassenonderwijs volgen (ingezo

MP Çelik asked the education minister whether ROCs were unlawfully pressing adult-education students for 'voluntary' contributions of up to over 200 euro, payable on the spot and tied to enrolment. The minister said such contributions are allowed only if voluntary and not linked to enrolment, that the inspectorate is requesting information from LAKS and will act if the law is broken, and that a guideline on school costs is being prepared for March 2012.
The inspectorate has requested further information from LAKS and will, once it has received the information, assess whether there is non-compliance with the law.
De inspectie heeft bij LAKS nadere informatie opgevraagd en zal na het verkrijgen van de informatie beoordelen of hier sprake is van niet-naleving van de wet.
Vragen van de leden Çelik en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over gevolgen wijziging beleid achterstandsleerlingen (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

Two MPs asked the education minister why rural schools gained little from the 2006 change in the weighted funding scheme for disadvantaged pupils and whether pupil disadvantage has fallen or risen in rural areas. The minister attributed the limited gains to rising parental education levels and a higher funding threshold chosen to avoid spreading money too thinly, and said the plan 'Basis voor presteren' and targeted extra funding for the big cities address the wider problem.
The simplification succeeded and the shift of funds was limited.
De vereenvoudiging is gelukt en de verschuiving van middelen was beperkt.
Vragen van de leden Çelik en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over verbeterde aandacht voor kinderrechten via het onderwijs (ingezonden 1 september 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister how children's knowledge of their rights could be improved through schooling, citing EU and NGO reports. The minister answered that schools already address human and children's rights under citizenship requirements, that the inspectorate supervises this, and that further improvement is not excluded, with a Onderwijsraad advisory request pending.
I do not rule out that it could still be better.
Ik sluit niet uit dat het nog beter kan.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het succes van de inzet van vliegende brigades bij zeer zwakke scholen (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

MP Çelik asked the education minister about the success of the Vliegende Brigade programme for very weak schools, the role of the CED-groep, whether past expertise should be built on, and whether the winning formula should be kept. Minister Rouvoet called the results good, said an interim evaluation would come this autumn, and explained that responsibility has moved to the PO-Raad's 'Goed Worden, Goed Blijven' programme, which now houses the Vliegende Brigade.
Incidentally, on 8 September I received the request from the standing committee for Education, Culture and Science to send the House a quick scan/evaluation of the Vliegende Brigade.

Overigens heb ik op 8 september het verzoek ontvangen van de vaste commissie voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap om de Tweede Kamer een quick scan/evaluatie te doen toekomen voor de Vliegende Brigade.

Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschappen over de toename van de groepsgrootte in het basisonderwijs (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister about reported rises in class sizes in primary schools, the PO-raad's claim of a 12% increase, material maintenance funding shortfalls, quality concerns and Passend Onderwijs cuts. The minister said she holds no class-size data, that schools set staffing themselves, that the cuts amount to about 2% of funding, and that she sees no reason to adjust funding or intervene.
I have no data on class size and therefore cannot track the development of class size.
Ik heb geen gegevens over de groepsgrootte en kan daarom ook niet de ontwikkeling van de groepsgrootte volgen.
Vragen van de leden Smits (SP) en Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over verouderde cijfers over de bekostiging van het basisonderwijs (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

MPs Smits and Çelik asked the education minister why data on primary school finances sent to parliament were outdated, and whether she would update the picture given cuts since 2009. The minister defended using the latest available data, said full 2010 accounts were only just in and 2011 data comes in 2012, and promised a report on the annual figures in December.
Are you willing to inform the House, before the committee debate on primary education finances, about the current financial situation in primary education?
Bent u bereid om de Kamer voorafgaand aan het algemeen overleg over de financiën in het primair onderwijs te informeren over de actuele financiële situatie in het primair onderwijs?
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over extra bijdragen die ROC’s vragen in verband met opleidingsgebonden kosten (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

An MP (PvdA) asked the education minister about schools charging extra optional contributions for training costs, including software and ingredients, and threatening students or parents over unpaid amounts. The minister answered that such contributions are voluntary, cannot be a condition of enrolment, must be transparent, and that the inspectorate and JOB guidance will be used, with a possible sanction and a review of the law.
Access to education may not be refused on the basis of not paying a voluntary contribution.
Toegang tot onderwijs mag niet geweigerd worden op grond van het niet betalen van een vrijwillige bijdrage.

Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over mogelijke manipulatie van de scores voor de centrale examens bij de basisvakken Engels, Nederlands en wiskunde (ingezonden 23 mei

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the College voor Examens politically manipulates the N-term used to convert exam scores for Dutch, English and mathematics, and why pupils underperform in these basic subjects. The Minister denied manipulation, explained the N-term as a tool to keep standards equal across years, and listed measures to improve results and safeguard school exams.
The College voor Examens has the task of keeping the requirements for candidates equal from year to year for all central examinations.
Het College voor Examens heeft de taak, bij alle centrale examens de eisen voor kandidaten van jaar tot jaar gelijk te houden.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de Rotterdamse aanpak van spijbelaars tussen 18 en 23 jaar (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

An MP asks the Education Minister about Rotterdam's agreements with regional aldermen to involve parents of adult (18+) truant students, and why the minister advised against a motion urging the same. The minister says adults are legally competent so such a practice cannot be mandated nationally, suggests schools use enrolment agreements with parents, and says she will inform schools about this option.

I will take the initiative to actively inform schools, primarily vocational education institutions, about the option to include in the education agreement with the minor student that, while the young person is enrolled, parents are informed about, among other things, truancy.

Ik neem het initiatief om scholen, en dan primair mbo-instellingen, actief te informeren over de mogelijkheid om in de, met de minderjarige leerling af te sluiten, onderwijsovereenkomst op te nemen dat gedurende de tijd dat de jongere op school staat ingeschreven, de ouders worden geïnformeerd over onder andere het spijbelgedrag.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over onvrede over het onderwijs bij de twee Amsterdamse ROC’s (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

An MP asks the education minister about student dissatisfaction at two Amsterdam vocational colleges (ROC Amsterdam and ROC ASA), including structural lesson loss, poor internship supervision, and whether the minister will act and impose fines under a motion. The minister answers that the inspectorate found no grounds for extra investigation, that complaints are handled through the Ombudslijn MBO and the inspectorate, and that a funding measure can be imposed when instruction time is insufficient, with an evaluation of the Ombudslijn to follow.
In addition, I have submitted the twelve concrete complaints, which were ultimately sent to me following Mr. Marcouch's signal, to the Inspectorate of Education.
Daarnaast heb ik de twaalf concrete klachten, die naar aanleiding van het signaal van dhr. Marcouch mij uiteindelijk zijn toegestuurd, aan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs voorgelegd.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de hoge ouderbijdrage voor het Leonardo-onderwijs (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

An MP asks the education minister how her earlier answers on high parental contributions for Leonardo education square with an inspectorate email stating such contributions are mandatory, and whether Leonardo classes in regular schools amount to private education. The minister answers that the contributions are voluntary, the Leonardo departments are part of regular schools with no separate legal status, and the inspectorate's view does not change her position.
As already explained in the answer to question 1, this is not private education but extra educational activities offered by a publicly funded school.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 1 al is uiteengezet, betreft het hier geen particulier onderwijs maar extra onderwijsactiviteiten die door een rijksbekostigde school wordt aangeboden.
Vragen van de leden Arib en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over seks met de leraar (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

MPs Arib and Çelik asked the ministers of Justice and of Education about a Brandpunt survey showing sexual relations between teachers and pupils at nearly half of secondary schools, and whether such cases are more common than earlier research showed. The minister answered that the Inspectorate figures and the survey are not comparable, that action must always be taken on suspicion of such relations, and that schools and teachers will be reminded of the statutory reporting duty.
I therefore consider it important that schools and teachers are aware of the statutory reporting duty.
Ik vind het daarom van belang dat scholen en docenten zich bewust zijn van de wettelijke meldplicht.

Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem, Çelik en Jacobi (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat Jeugdproject Wyldemerk gedwongen de deuren moet sluiten (ingezonden 4 apri

MPs Dijsselbloem, Çelik and Jacobi asked the state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about the closure of the Wyldemerk youth project, including whether 24-hour support for 43 youths stops, whether pupils can finish the school year, and whether a school inspectorate report caused the closure. The state secretary confirmed the support ends after the 2010-2011 school year, said the foundation itself decided to close and the inspectorate report was not the cause, and placed responsibility for finding alternative places and for youth care on the foundation and the provinces.
That guarantee I cannot give you; that is the responsibility of Wyldemerk.
Die garantie kan ik u niet geven, dat is de verantwoordelijkheid van Wyldemerk.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over verlaging van de administratieve lasten bij de inschrijving v

MPs Heijnen and Çelik asked whether schools must require a GBA extract (municipal population register extract) when enrolling pupils, and how administrative burdens can be cut. The minister answered that schools are only required to hold such extracts for one subsidy scheme, that other documents can be used, that information campaigns will be used to correct misinterpretation, and that the government is working to remove the GBA-extract requirement from other procedures.
I will use the communication channels between DUO and the schools for this.
Ik zal daarvoor de communicatiekanalen tussen DUO en de scholen gebruiken.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de bekostiging van het onderwijsaanbod op Texel (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

An MP asked the education minister why Texel's only secondary school, De Hogeberg, lost its compensation funding while other Wadden islands kept theirs, and whether students losing vmbo sectors would get transport support. The minister replied that the school's enrolment falls outside the exception rule, that the school board must choose its offer within regular funding, and that students are expected to travel, with Den Helder reachable in twenty minutes.
The starting point is that regular funding is sufficient for secondary schools with enrolment above the foundation norm.
Uitgangspunt is dat reguliere bekostiging toereikend is voor VO-scholen met een leerlingaantal boven de stichtingsnorm.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het ontslag van conciërges op basisscholen (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Education about possible mass dismissals of school caretakers (conciërges) in primary schools as municipal and national subsidies end, and about workload and administrative burden. The state secretary says municipalities are reconsidering funding, the national caretaker scheme ends in August 2012 with a subsidy policy letter forthcoming, and schools set their own personnel policy, so he declines to collect further detail and does not commit to halting the dismissals.
Het gaat hier om gemeentelijk beleid.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Jadnanansing (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de afkeuring door de rechter van de lagere plaatsing van een studente door de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs

MPs Çelik and Jadnanansing asked the education minister about a court ruling that rejected DUO's lower placement of a student in a lottery class due to varied mbo diploma formats. The minister answered that the problem was known, that DUO applies the lottery rules without assessing programme value, and that the RAS regulation and a future diploma and transcript model will clarify procedures.
The above-mentioned regulation will be amended in parts.
Bovengenoemde regeling wordt op onderdelen gewijzigd.

Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat thuisonderwijs een grote vlucht dreigt te nemen door kledingvoorschriften in het reguliere onderwijs (ingezonden 1

An MP asked the education minister about reports that nearly 100 Amsterdam pupils from the Islamic College may be homeschooled after closure and strict dress rules at nearby schools, and about the legal basis, numbers, and oversight of homeschooling. The minister answered that homeschooling is not a legal right, only a possible consequence of a leerplicht exemption under article 5, that oversight of its quality is not required, that she will reconsider the exemption grounds, and that municipal authorities are responsible for enforcement.
I will therefore consider the desirability of this exemption ground and will inform you of the outcome this autumn.
Ik ga mij dan ook beraden op de opportuniteit van deze vrijstellingsgrond en zal u dit najaar over de uitkomst informeren.
Vragen van de leden Çelik en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over de kaalslag op de scholen in Noord Nederland (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

MPs Çelik and Van Dekken asked the education minister about the consequences of school shrinkage in northern Netherlands, including projected job losses, higher costs of small schools, funding, teacher workload and inspection assessment. The minister answered that shrinkage requires timely regional measures, that job losses are expected but not necessarily forced dismissals, that small schools are compensated through funding instruments, and that the inspectorate judges schools only on quality.
The research will be concluded shortly.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de gebrekkige aansluiting tussen MBO-opleidingen en het werken in de hav

MPs Hamer and Çelik asked ministers whether vocational colleges (ROCs) and port employers are to blame for the mismatch between MBO training and port jobs, and whether a sector-wide overview and joint table talks were planned. Minister Kamp answered that employers are primarily responsible for their own staffing, that ROC cooperation with employers already exists, and that no separate overview or new table talks were needed.
No, given legal responsibilities this is a matter for the ROCs and port employers themselves.
Neen, gelet op wettelijke verantwoordelijkheden is dit een zaak van roc's en havenondernemers zelf.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het mengen van zwarte en witte scholen in Rotterdam (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

An MP asks the education minister whether she supports Rotterdam's alderman dropping active promotion of mixed black and white schools in favour of raising quality, and whether she has discussed this with him. The minister answers yes to supporting the alderman's view, states that there is no clear evidence mixing schools improves results, and says quality improvements (more learning time, good teachers, involved parents) are the priority.
There is no unambiguous evidence that mixing schools leads to better results.
Er is geen eenduidig bewijs voor dat het mengen van scholen leidt tot betere resultaten.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over drugsbeleid in Rotterdam (ingezonden 16 december 2010).

MPs Bouwmeester and Çelik asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Rotterdam's drug policy, including school-based prevention at ROCs, closing coffeeshops, and drug runners. The minister answered that the Rotterdam approach is a good example but nationwide rollout is not appropriate, that closing coffeeshops near schools is effective in the longer term, and that drug runners are tackled jointly by the Public Prosecution Service, police and municipalities.

Nationwide introduction of the Rotterdam approach is not, however, an obvious choice, because I do not want to encroach on the scope of both municipalities and schools to tailor their drug and alcohol policy to local circumstances.

Landelijke invoering van de Rotterdamse aanpak ligt echter niet voor de hand, omdat ik niet wil treden in de ruimte van zowel gemeenten als scholen om hun drugs- en alcoholbeleid af te stemmen op de lokale situatie.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de groeiende afstand tussen de schoolbesturen en de werkvloer in het onderwijs (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

MP Çelik asked the Minister of Education about reports that mandatory central school-board levies vary widely and sometimes reach 30% of funding, about board-level lawyers, about boards filtering staff concerns through cluster managers, and about a gag-like culture discouraging contact with MPs. The Minister answered that boards are responsible for their own spending, that no data on levy rates is held and collecting it would add burden, that existing oversight by the Inspectorate, works councils and supervisory boards is adequate, and that she sees no need for further regulation.
Primary and secondary education have no rules requiring boards to record which part of their funding is used for central (board-level) activities.
Het primair en voortgezet onderwijs kennen geen voorschriften voor besturen om te (laten) registreren welk deel van de bekostiging wordt aangewend voor bovenschoolse activiteiten.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over dreigende sluiting van school voor voortgezet onderwijs in de Haagse Schilderswijk (ingezonden 9 december 2010)

MPs Çelik and Heijnen asked whether closing a havo/vwo school in The Hague's Schilderswijk, part of the Johan de Wittcollege, would harm opportunities in a disadvantaged neighbourhood, and whether the ministry would intervene. The minister replied that the school board is only relocating the vwo branch elsewhere in The Hague due to new building, that the decision belongs to the school board and the works council, and declined to request a municipal report or to investigate keeping the programme.
Whether or not to close (branch) locations are decisions taken primarily by the school board, which is entitled to make them.
Het al dan niet sluiten van (neven)vestigingen zijn beslissingen die primair door het schoolbestuur worden genomen, het schoolbestuur is hiertoe gerechtigd.
