Het voornemen om de fabriek in Moerdijk eind 2014 te sluiten is gebaseerd op bedrijfsmatige- en strategische keuzes. Daar kan de overheid niet in treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Hamer over het bericht dat er weer veel banen verdwijnen bij MSD in Oss

MPs Jan Vos and Hamer asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about the loss of around 440 jobs at MSD in Oss, including how affected workers will be helped and what is being done with the municipality. Minister Kamp answered that a social plan with retraining support and an external job-placement firm is in place, that he is already in talks with MSD, Oss and the province, and that the Pivot Park offers opportunities for starters.
In cooperation with the municipality, province, Brabant Development Agency and MSD, I will examine what the possibilities are.
In samenwerking met de gemeente, provincie, Brabantse Ontwikkelingsmaatschappij en MSD zal ik bekijken wat de mogelijkheden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Hamer en Yücel over het voornemen van het concern AKZO om de productieafdeling van de vestiging Deventer naar het buitenland te verplaatsen

MPs Kerstens, Hamer and Yücel asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about AkzoNobel's plan to move production from Deventer abroad, costing about 215 jobs, and what the government could do. The minister replied that the decision is a business-economic one the government cannot interfere with, pointed to general business-climate policy and R&D retention in Deventer, and said the ministry had discussed the decision with the company's management.
However, the cabinet cannot interfere in the business-economic decisions of companies.
Het kabinet kan zich echter niet mengen in bedrijfseconomische beslissingen van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Hamer en Ojik over verslechterde arbeidsomstandigheden van schoonmakers bij de Belastingdienst

MPs asked whether the government would intervene after cleaners at several Belastingdienst sites complained of worsened working conditions, including higher workload, refused sick notices, and alleged intimidation, and whether the Inspectie SZW would investigate. The State Secretary answered that a yearly workload monitor and talks with contractors and cleaners will address the complaints, that Apeldoorn capacity was increased, and that no Inspectie SZW investigation is warranted.
Given the aforementioned measures, I see no reason to ask the Minister of SZW to involve the Inspectie SZW.
Ik zie, gezien de voornoemde maatregelen, geen aanleiding om de Minister van SZW te vragen de Inspectie SZW in te schakelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hamer over het bericht “Kabinet dwingt werklozen WW in”

An MP asked the minister whether abolishing the dagloongarantie (daily wage guarantee) for unemployment benefit when switching jobs forces workers to claim WW first, and whether this hinders work-to-work transitions. The minister says such switches involve other factors, acknowledges a dilemma, and commits to reintroducing a revised daily wage guarantee via a Dagloonbesluit amendment after the Wet werk en zekerheid.
Yes. The Wet werk en zekerheid amends the Unemployment Insurance Act.
Ja. Met het wetsvoorstel Wet werk en zekerheid wordt de Werkloosheidswet gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Yücel over het bericht dat werkloze allochtone jongeren niet worden bereikt

MPs Hamer and Yücel asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether reports that unemployed migrant youths are not being reached are accurate, how large that group is, and what measures will ensure they find training or work. The minister said the nationally small group of youths without work, school or benefits is about 1.2%, but is markedly higher among migrant youths in the G4, and listed existing programmes and the implementation of a related motion, while declining to answer the questions before the 2014 budget debate.
No, more time was needed to answer.
Nee, voor beantwoording was langer de tijd nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Hamer over het bericht dat er 280.000 potentiële stageplaatsen onbenut blijven

MPs Jadnanansing and Hamer asked the Minister of Education about a report that 280,000 potential internship places remain unused, the risk of an internship shortage raised by SBB, and why small firms and self-employed people rarely take interns. The minister answered that the stage and apprenticeship offensive is working, that self-employed people face no legal barriers but must meet quality criteria, that a practice-learning subsidy starts in January 2014, and that she opposes loosening quality requirements for training firms.
I am willing to examine whether such collaborations can make it easier for self-employed people to offer an internship or work-placement.
Ik ben bereid om te onderzoeken of dergelijke samenwerkingsverbanden ervoor kunnen zorgen dat het eenvoudiger wordt voor zzp'ers om een stage of leerwerkbaan aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hamer over onbetaalde stages

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether unpaid internships are being misused as disguised employment and what the legal criteria for a stage are. The minister set out criteria distinguishing a learning internship from regular work, said the Inspectie SZW enforces the minimum wage and fines firms that wrongly claim stagiair status, and stated that work without a learning focus requires at least the minimum wage.
The Inspectorate SZW imposes a fine on companies that claim the workers are interns while the facts and circumstances show it is work and legally an employment contract exists.

De Inspectie SZW legt een boete op aan bedrijven als zij claimen dat het om stagiairs gaat, terwijl uit de feiten en omstandigheden blijkt dat het gaat om werk en juridisch gezien sprake is van een arbeidsovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Hamer en Jan Vos over de situatie bij Aldel

MPs Van Dekken, Hamer and Jan Vos asked ministers whether they were aware of the precarious situation at chemical company Aldel in Delfzijl, its importance for regional employment, and what the government would do to keep it afloat and assist workers if jobs were lost. The government referred to an earlier letter for the first four questions and said that, if mass dismissals threatened, the social affairs minister would work with UWV on measures to preserve employment, which is not currently the case.
See my letter of 4 October 2013 with reference DGBI-TOP/13168246, which is attached.
Zie mijn brief van 4 oktober 2013 met kenmerk DGBI-TOP/13168246, welke is bijgevoegd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over ‘een uitspraak van de Raad van State over schijnconstructies met zogeheten MOE-landers’

The MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked the minister how the Inspectorate SZW will respond to a Council of State ruling on sham constructions using Polish workers, and whether the ruling makes such constructions unacceptable. The minister answered that the ruling clarified the distinction between genuine cross-border services and posting of workers, that the Inspectorate has incorporated its criteria into its working method, and that the action plan on sham constructions addresses service-based constructions.
The Inspectorate SZW has incorporated the criteria from this ruling into its existing working method.
De Inspectie SZW heeft de criteria uit deze uitspraak verwerkt in de bestaande werkwijze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over het stimuleren van «reshoring» en de mogelijkheden daarbij in het kader van de Participatiewet

PvdA MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked whether reshoring of production to the Netherlands creates jobs for people with a distance to the labour market under the Participatiewet and what measures could stimulate it. The ministers replied that reshoring complements the Participatiewet, pointed to wage-cost subsidies and sector plans, and said the government will promote reshoring's job potential during implementation.

In implementing the Participatiewet, the State Secretary for Social Affairs will explicitly promote the opportunities reshoring offers for creating employment, particularly for people with a distance to the labour market.

Bij de implementatie van de participatiewet gaat de Staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken expliciet uitdragen welke kansen «reshoring» biedt voor het creëren van werkgelegenheid, met name voor mensen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Otwin vanDijk (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over nulurencontracten in de zorg (ingezonden 27

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Health about zero-hour contracts in care, including variants, whether workers should get contracts reflecting average hours, and how the government will hold care employers to the care accord. The minister answered that he is in talks with social partners on implementing the Social Accord and expects parties to honour the Care Accord, without committing to a specific step.
I assume that the parties will abide by the agreements in the care accord.
Ik ga er van uit dat partijen zich aan de afspraken uit het zorgakkoord houden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht dat het UWV een ontslagvergunning heeft verleend aan thuiszorgorganisatie Sensire om 1.100 thuiszorgmedewerkers te ontslaan

PvdA MPs asked the government about UWV granting a dismissal permit to home-care organisation Sensire to lay off 1,100 workers, including whether more care providers would seek preventive dismissals and whether a convenant with the sector was planned. The state secretary replied that talks with municipalities and stakeholders took place, that UWV does not grant preventive dismissal permits while tendering is uncertain, and that a convenant has little added value; instead municipalities will be informed about timely tendering.
In that case the policy line, under current regulations, is that UWV does not grant a dismissal permit because there is no certainty about the structural loss of jobs.
In dat geval is de beleidslijn, op basis van de huidige regelgeving, dat UWV geen ontslagvergunning verleent omdat er geen zekerheid bestaat over het structureel vervallen van arbeidsplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Groot over de verkoop van vakantiedagen

MPs Hamer and Groot asked the ministers about a report that businesses hold about 16 billion euro in unused leave and whether a lower tax rate on buying out leave days would boost the economy. The government answered that the 16 billion figure rests on a small, uncertain survey, that only above-statutory leave can be bought out, and that a reduced tax rate is undesirable because of unequal treatment, revenue loss and tax arbitrage.
For tax purposes, the buyout of holiday days is treated as wages taxed at the rate applying to the employee who buys out.
Fiscaal wordt de afkoop van vakantiedagen beschouwd als loon dat belast wordt naar het tarief zoals dat geldt voor de werknemer die afkoopt.
Antwoord vragen Hamer en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht dat het UWV een ontslagvergunning heeft verleend aan thuiszorgorganisatie Sensire om 1.100 thuiszorgmedewerkers te ontslaan

Two PvdA MPs asked why UWV granted Sensire permission to dismiss 1,100 home-care workers despite the care accord and whether the works council and unions were overruled. The minister said UWV applied the dismissal rules on business-economic grounds, that the decision is for UWV and the municipalities, and that the state secretary will contact the parties shortly.
UWV acted in application of the dismissal and policy rules.
UWV heeft gehandeld met toepassing van de ontslag- en beleidsregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over het artikel ‘meer kans op een baan met een Nederlandse naam’

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about a report that job applicants with non-Dutch names are less likely to be invited to interviews, and whether anonymous application should be promoted, with government as a leader. The state secretary found the finding disappointing, noted discrimination must be fought where proven, pointed to a pending SER advisory report, and declined to promote anonymous applications, saying employers bear primary responsibility.
Following this advice, I want to examine whether and what follow-up actions on labour market discrimination are needed.
Naar aanleiding van dit advies wil ik bezien of en zo ja welke vervolgacties op het gebied van arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Hamer over het bericht ‘NOM wil bemiddelaar om PPG te redden’

Two Labour MPs asked the Social Affairs and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that the Northern Development Company (NOM) wanted a mediator to save fibre-optic firm PPG, which faced closure threats amid union action. Minister Asscher answered that PPG management and union FNV Bondgenoten reached a deal through mediation by the Drenthe Commissioner of the King, that the closure threat is lifted, and that the dispute is a private matter so no further government action is needed.
The negotiations between PPG's management and FNV Bondgenoten are primarily a private matter and have since led to a good outcome.
De onderhandelingen tussen de directie van PPG en FNV Bondgenoten betreffen in eerste aanleg een private aangelegenheid en hebben intussen tot een goede uitkomst geleid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Hamer over rijopleidingen en het opleiden van rijinstructeurs door het UWV

MPs Kuiken and Hamer asked about high dropout from UWV-funded driving instructor training, selection of trainees, recovery of training costs, a bankruptcy that disrupted 255 trainees, and how many have been trained. The government answered that dropout is in line with average re-integration training, selection followed protocol, cost recovery occurs in some cases via sanctions, affected trainees were placed in other training, and only 144 of 391 tracks ended in placement.
The number of dropouts from the driving instructor training does not differ from the average dropout rate for training within the re-integration of benefit recipients.
Het aantal uitvallers bij de opleiding rijinstructeur wijkt niet af van de gemiddelde uitval bij de opleidingen in het kader van de re-integratie van uitkeringsgerechtigden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over aan het werk gaan vanuit de bijstand

MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked whether bureaucratic obstacles deter benefit recipients from accepting temporary agency work and whether temporary work is a good stepping stone to a permanent job. The state secretary acknowledged knowledge bottlenecks in rules and municipal practice, said the government is working with municipalities and agencies to reduce them, and said measures on flexible work and payrolling will be pursued.
We are currently working with municipalities, as announced in the cover letter to this study, to examine the bottlenecks they experience in this area, with temp agencies also involved.

Momenteel zijn wij, zoals aangekondigd in de aanbiedingsbrief bij dit onderzoek, samen met gemeenten bezig de door hen ervaren knelpunten op dit terrein te bezien, waarbij ook uitzendorganisaties zijn betrokken.
Antwoord vragen Kerstens en Hamer over fraude bij de inzet van buitenlandse arbeidskrachten

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about press reports of wage fraud through cross-border posting of foreign workers, including whether a single lead enforcement body should be created. The minister answered that whether such arrangements are unlawful depends on the facts, that enforcement bodies cooperate where needed, and that a broader integrated approach will consider prevention and responsibility allocation among agencies.
Part of the integrated approach is first to examine how illegal or undesirable constructions can be prevented.
Onderdeel van de geïntegreerde aanpak is ten eerste dat wordt bezien op welke wijze illegale of ongewenste constructies kunnen worden voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Hamer over het bericht “Vraag geen verlof aan voor staking DJI!

MPs Marcouch and Hamer asked whether the Ministry of Justice and Security's circular on union actions wrongly required staff to request leave for strike participation, and whether those staff should have leave reversed. The state secretary acknowledged the wording wrongly suggested leave was required, clarified that pay is withheld only when working time is used without leave, and issued a corrected letter with a special arrangement for the 25 April action.
With this wording, the suggestion was unintentionally created that action may only be taken if leave has been taken.
Met deze formulering is onbedoeld de suggestie gewekt dat alleen actie mag worden gevoerd als verlof is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Hamer over misbruik van ziekte door werkgevers

Two MPs asked the minister about reports that employers misuse sick leave to cut wage costs or push out staff, including keeping recovered workers registered as partially sick, limited access to occupational doctors, and oversight of medical information. The minister disapproves of registering fully recovered workers as sick, points to occupational doctors' advice and UWV or court routes for disputes, and says no cases are known of UWV dismissals of workers already back at work.
I do not approve of a worker who has fully resumed the agreed work after a period of sickness remaining administratively registered as partially incapacitated for one or a few percent.

Ik keur het niet goed dat een werknemer die na een ziekteperiode de bedongen arbeid volledig heeft hervat, administratief voor één of enkele procenten als arbeidsongeschikt geregistreerd blijft staan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Jacobi over het dreigende collectieve ontslag bij Prins Dokkum en een reactie op de situatie bij het bedrijf Prins Dokkum waar gestaakt wordt tegen overplaatsing naar het buitenla

MPs Hamer and Jacobi asked the minister of Social Affairs about the threatened collective dismissal at Prins Dokkum after parent company Saferoad changed policy, including the legal force of employment guarantees given at the 2010 takeover and how such guarantees are weighed by UWV. The minister answered that the legal value depends on the guarantee's wording, that the UWV procedure is at an early stage, that guarantees are considered in the economic-necessity assessment, and that group-level profitability does not automatically defeat the subsidiary's dismissal case.
It is not for me to make further statements about the legal value of the employment guarantee in this individual case.
Het is niet aan mij om verdere uitspraken te doen over de juridische waarde van de werkgarantie in dit individuele geval.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Kerstens en Hamer over ‘het onderzoek naar de arbeidsomstandigheden in de Nederlandse pakketdienstensector’.

MPs Mei Li Vos, Hamer and Kerstens asked ministers about working conditions and bogus self-employment among parcel couriers, including PostNL subcontracting, VAR certificates, and whether the Inspectorates and competition authority should intervene. The government acknowledged the problems are undesirable, said bogus self-employment should be prevented and an action plan would follow, announced inspections and an exploratory study, and declined to disclose details of agreements with specific taxpayers.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over ongelijke beloning tussen mannen en vrouwen

MPs Yücel and Hamer asked whether unequal pay between men and women is acceptable, what the statistics show for the Netherlands versus the EU and OECD, and which countries have low gaps. The government answered that unequal pay for equal work is unacceptable, referred the question of additional measures to the SER, and cited CBS and Eurostat figures showing a gap of about 13-20 percent depending on sector, with unexplained parts that do not necessarily indicate discrimination.
On 18 February 2013 I asked the SER in an advisory request on discrimination in the labour market which additional actions could help prevent and combat unequal pay.

Ik heb op 18 februari 2013 in een adviesaanvraag over discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt aan de SER gevraagd welke aanvullende acties kunnen bijdragen aan het voorkómen en bestrijden van ongelijke beloning.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hoogland en Hamer over ‘het algemeen verbindend verklaren van de cao Railinfra’

MPs Hoogland and Hamer asked whether the Railinfra collective labour agreement should be declared generally binding quickly, whether staff should transfer with concessions, and whether Dutch language skills of rail workers are ensured for safety. The minister replied that the new CAO is for social partners to request, that the government will not intervene in the rail contracting market, and that the Inspectorate found no evidence language problems caused unsafe situations, while noting existing working conditions rules.
However, the State Secretary for Infrastructure and the Environment and I do not wish to intervene in the market of rail contractors.
De Staatsecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en ik willen echter niet interveniëren in de markt van spooraannemers.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer en Van Dekken over het verdwijnen van banen bij Menzis in Groningen

MPs Hamer and Van Dekken asked the minister whether he would act on the dismissal of 175 Menzis staff in Groningen, a region with high unemployment, and why the company targets that region disproportionately. The minister replied that corporate location and staffing decisions are private, that unions and works councils represent employees, and that municipalities and UWV handle local job support, with a social plan already agreed.
The location and personnel policy of individual companies is a private consideration that the cabinet does not get involved in.
Het vestigingsplaats- en personeelsbeleid van individuele bedrijven is een private overweging waar het kabinet niet in stapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over oneigenlijk gebruik van de kinderopvangtoeslag

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about reported multi-million euro fraud with childcare allowances in 2009-2010 and why measures announced in 2011 did not prevent it. The minister answered that the measures took effect in 2012, that roughly 40 million euro of fraud had been established with a further 40 million under prosecution, that the effectiveness of the measures cannot be precisely demonstrated, and that no additional measures are planned for now.
I do not intend to take additional measures at this stage. When I see reason to do so, the House will be informed.
Ik ben niet voornemens om nu al aanvullende maatregelen te nemen. Wanneer ik daar aanleiding toe zie, zal de Kamer daar over informeren.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over het bericht ‘twee miljard euro helpt ouderen niet aan het werk’

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether about two billion euros of subsidies for keeping older workers employed are pointless, as a news report claimed, and what would be done about low employer awareness of the schemes. The minister says the budget is now under one billion, defends the remaining schemes as effective for some groups, and promises to raise employer awareness and consider co-financing sector plans.
The SEO Economic Research study indeed shows that 40% of the employers surveyed are not aware of schemes that make it financially attractive to hire older workers.
Het onderzoek van SEO Economisch Onderzoek laat inderdaad zien dat 40% van de ondervraagde werkgevers niet bekend is met regelingen die het financieel aantrekkelijk maken om ouderen aan te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Hamer, Van Dekken, Albert de Vries en Wolbert over het bericht dat er gevangenissen in Groningen, Drenthe Zeeland worden gesloten

PvdA MPs asked whether plans to close prisons in Groningen, Drenthe and Zeeland exist, and about the employment, visitor travel and cultural-heritage effects of such closures. The State Secretary replied that no decision has been taken, closures cannot be avoided given budget cuts, a Masterplan on detention capacity will be presented in April 2013, and regional employment and visits will be weighed.

With a view to a careful decision-making process, I have asked the Director-General of DJI to draw up a Masterplan on DJI detention capacity, which will show the consequences of the cuts for cell capacity and staff.

Met het oog op een zorgvuldig besluitvormingsproces heb ik de hoofddirecteur van DJI verzocht om een Masterplan detentiecapaciteit DJI op te stellen, waarin de gevolgen van de ombuigingen voor de celcapaciteit van DJI en het personeel in beeld worden gebracht.
Antwoord vragen Hamer en Van Dekken over het verdwijnen van banen bij Menzis in Groningen

Two MPs (PvdA) asked the minister whether the loss of 165 jobs at Menzis in Groningen, and the concentration of insurer work, is disproportionate for the northern labour market and whether the government will act. The minister acknowledges the impact on affected workers, states that regional labour market policy lies with municipalities and UWV, that location and staffing decisions are a private matter, and that the government sees no evidence the north performs worse, promising only to consult social partners.
The location and staffing policy of individual companies is ultimately a private matter.
Het vestigings- en personeelsbeleid van individuele bedrijven is uiteindelijk een private aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer, Kerstens en Monasch over "Bouwbedrijven rommelen met faillissementen"

MPs Hamer, Kerstens and Monasch asked minister Kamp whether he would act on reports of construction firms abusing bankruptcies, dismissals of workers rehired as self-employed, and threats to collective sector agreements. The minister answered that government has no active role in preventing bankruptcy fraud beyond criminal enforcement, that dismissal permits are granted only for genuine self-employed workers, and that no signals of endangered sector arrangements exist, with an SER advice pending.
As already indicated in answering earlier parliamentary questions on bankruptcy fraud, the government has no role in preventing and combating bankruptcy fraud.
Zoals bij de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen over het onderwerp faillissementsfraude al is aangegeven heeft de overheid geen rol bij het voorkomen en bestrijden van faillissementsfraude.
Antwoord vragen Klijnsma en Hamer over de vermogenstoetsen bij de zorgtoeslag en het kindgebonden budget in geval van een letselschade-uitkering

MPs Klijnsma and Hamer asked whether the new asset tests for healthcare allowance and child-related budget would penalise people receiving personal injury compensation, and whether the rules should be changed. The state secretary answered that affected cases are mainly settlements paid as lump sums, that private-law solutions should be sought first, and that a limited, temporary compensation scheme will be considered for cases where the impact is disproportionate.
I am willing to introduce a compensatory scheme for cases where this turns out disproportionately hard.
Ik ben bereid voor gevallen waar dit onevenredig hard uitpakt een tegemoetkomende regeling te treffen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens, Hamer en Timmermans over de aanvraag van uitstel van betaling door SW-bedrijf Licom

MPs asked the state secretary about Licom, a sheltered-employment (Wsw) company seeking suspension of payments after its municipal shareholders withdrew funding, and about its impact on staff, sector-wide deficits, and the ministry's role. The state secretary answered that responsibility for Wsw implementation and oversight lies with municipalities and their councils, so the ministry cannot provide a sector-wide overview and sees no direct role, while noting municipalities pledged to guarantee jobs and wages and that the ministry will monitor developments.
Municipalities are responsible for implementing the Wsw and for sound financial management.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de Wsw en een verantwoord financieel beheer.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over "administratieve rompslomp voor parttime zzp'ers"

MP Hamer asked whether part-time self-employed workers struggle to obtain a VAR WUO declaration from the Tax Authority, causing them to lose assignments, and whether government will help solve this and send a letter by 1 October 2012. The state secretary answered that the VAR assessment applies uniform criteria to all applicants, that part-timers less often qualify as entrepreneurs under existing case law, and that a web module will be introduced to make the qualification process more transparent, with no change to the legal definition planned.

I am of the view that a web module can provide clarity to the client and contractor about the classification of their working relationship and the associated rights and obligations, so that both parties know where they stand.

Ik ben van mening dat een webmodule duidelijkheid kan bieden aan opdrachtgever en opdrachtnemer over de kwalificatie van hun arbeidsrelatie en de bijbehorende rechten en plichten zodat beide partijen weten waar ze aan toe zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer en Van Dekken over "de oneerlijke concurrentie op arbeidsvoorwaarden op de bouwplaatsen in de Eemshaven"

MPs Hamer and Van Dekken asked the minister about alleged underpayment of Romanian workers below the CAO construction wage at Eemshaven construction sites and the limits of inspection and enforcement. The state secretary replied that the Inspectorate SZW found Minimum Wage Act violations at Forklift, that CAO enforcement is primarily the responsibility of the social partners, and pointed to the EU enforcement directive proposal on chain liability while avoiding commitments on new measures.
Enforcement of collective agreements, like their creation, content and compliance, primarily falls under the responsibility of the social partners.
De handhaving van cao's valt – net als de totstandkoming, de inhoud en naleving van cao's – primair onder de verantwoordelijkheid van cao-partijen.
Antwoord vragen Dijsselbloem, Hamer en Jadnanansing inzake ‘gebrek aan steun voor scholen bij het opzetten van burgerschapslessen’

Three Labour MPs asked the Minister of Education whether she would act on the Education Council's finding that schools lack clarity and support for citizenship lessons, and whether she would produce a plan to improve support and materials. The Minister acknowledged the advice, said citizenship is a shared school and parental task rather than a subject, and deferred a full policy response to the next cabinet.
I will leave a comprehensive policy response to this advice to the next cabinet.
laat ik een uitgebreide beleidsreactie op dit advies aan het volgende kabinet
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer over ruim half miljoen werklozen in Nederland

An MP asks the Social Affairs minister whether the government's deficit-reduction course is failing to tackle the rise above half a million unemployed, and whether it will adopt a youth unemployment action plan and sector support for construction. The minister replies that fiscal repair is a precondition for recovery, that rising unemployment is not reason to revise the budget package, that a youth action plan already ran in 2009 and regional follow-up continues, that construction support is rejected as costly and obstructive, and that the WW budget effect is already within forecasts.
A precondition for economic recovery is the restoration of public finances.
Randvoorwaarde voor economisch herstel is het herstel van de overheidsfinanciën.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van het lid Hamer over het weigeren van uitkeringsgerechtigden voor een baan

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is acceptable that employers may refuse jobseekers simply because they receive benefits, and whether this could breach the equal-treatment clause of the Constitution. The state secretary called exclusion on the basis of benefit receipt unacceptable, explained that such discrimination is for the courts or the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling to judge, and declined to take up the matter himself, since neither the municipality nor the ministry is entitled to file a complaint.
Receiving a benefit is not a discrimination ground specifically named in equal treatment legislation.
Het hebben van een uitkering is geen discriminatiegrond die specifiek in de gelijke behandelingswetgeving wordt genoemd
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer inzake het verlies van 400 arbeidsplaatsen bij DSM

An MP asked ministers whether DSM's planned loss of 400 Dutch jobs, after receiving part-time unemployment support, was justified and whether EU globalisation funds would be used if forced dismissals occur. The minister answered that the decision is DSM's responsibility, that no collective dismissal notice has been filed, and that the EGF could be considered only if the 500-dismissal threshold is met.
This decision is the responsibility of DSM.
Deze beslissing is de verantwoordelijkheid van DSM.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer over een stijgend aantal loonbeslagleggingen

An MP asked the state secretary about the rising number of wage garnishments, especially among young people, and about multiple creditors seizing wages without knowing of each other, the adequacy of the minimum protection for debtors, and a response to the Paritas Passé report. The government acknowledges the rise but notes no national registration exists, says the question of creditor ranking is deferred to the next cabinet, and promises that the questions will be included in a later policy position.
Your questions will be taken into account in the aforementioned policy position.
Uw vragen zullen worden meegenomen in genoemde standpuntbepaling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer over “het terugdraaien van bezuinigingen op de kinderopvang”

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a broad parliamentary majority now favours reversing childcare cuts, and whether the cuts will be reversed quickly. The minister replied that no majority plans to fully reverse the 2013 childcare allowance cuts, that the 2013 scheme will be published by 15 October as agreed, and that he will implement measures already approved by cabinet and both chambers.
I intend to implement the measures that the cabinet and both chambers have already agreed to.
Ik ben voornemens uitvoering te geven aan de maatregelen waar kabinet en beide Kamers reeds mee hebben ingestemd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer over “de overvolle peuterspeelzalen”

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether cuts to childcare are causing overcrowding and waiting lists in playgroups, pushing toddlers with language delays out, and what action will be taken. The minister replied that he has no figures on waiting lists, that playgroups are a municipal responsibility, that municipalities can respond locally, and that he sees no displacement effect or need for new proposals.
I have no figures on waiting lists or an increasing number of children in playgroup care.
Ik heb geen cijfers over wachtlijsten of een toenemend aantal kinderen in het peuterspeelzaalwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hamer over de slechte positie van werksters in Nederland

An MP asked the minister why domestic cleaners (werksters) in the Netherlands lack the same rights as other employees, and about the size of the undeclared cleaning sector. The minister rejected extending full employee protections, arguing the Regeling Dienstverlening aan huis gives adequate protection and that abolishing it would revive old problems, and said he had no figures on the undeclared sector or measures planned.
I have no insight into what kinds of workers are employed in the undeclared cleaning circuit.
Antwoord 5 Ik heb geen inzicht in wat voor arbeidskrachten werkzaam zijn in het «zwarte schoonmaakcircuit».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Çelik over het uitblijven van 'exitgesprekken' met voortijdig schoolverlaters

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the absence of exit interviews with early school leavers, who face higher unemployment and crime risk, is acceptable and whether such interviews should be mandatory, and whether the halving target should be adopted. The minister agreed interviews are sensible and promotes them through schools and parent involvement, but declined to make them mandatory, said the 2016 target of 25,000 is ambitious and that an even sharper target is not feasible, and linked youth unemployment to temporary contracts and lack of qualifications.
It is up to the educational institution to make conducting exit interviews a regular part of the deregistration procedure.
Het is aan de onderwijsinstelling om het voeren van exitgesprekken een regulier onderdeel te maken van de uitschrijfprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Hamer over het bericht ‘Minder kinderbijslag militairen buitenland’

MPs Eijsink and Hamer asked whether Dutch soldiers stationed abroad with their families are harmed by the new country-of-residence principle reducing child benefit, and whether they should be compensated. The minister replied that child benefit is now set at the cost level of the child's country of residence, that the law was not intended to target soldiers, and that no increase in the foreign allowance is planned.
The purpose is to prevent benefits paid outside the Netherlands from diverging from local standards.
Doel hiervan is te voorkomen dat uitkeringen die buiten Nederland worden verstrekt, met lokale maatstaven uit de pas lopen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer over een actieplan om de sterk stijgende jeugdwerkloosheid terug te dringen

An MP asked the minister about rising youth unemployment, the gap between migrant and native youth, and whether the Netherlands should adopt a Finnish/Swedish-style youth guarantee action plan. The state secretary answered that the rise reflects the economic downturn, that the government relies on generic measures emphasizing youth's own responsibility, and pointed to earlier action plans and regional cooperation.
The cabinet is strongly committed to preventing and combating youth unemployment.
Het kabinet zet stevig in op het voorkomen en bestrijden van de jeugdwerkloosheid.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over de aanbesteding van de postbezorging van de overheid

An MP asks why the State's postal delivery tenders for the Tax Authority set per-item rates below the range SEO advised, which would prevent 80% of postal workers from having sector-CAO employment contracts by 2014, and whether the government will set decent prices. The state secretary replies that the tendered rates are substantially higher than before, leave room for the planned phase-in, were not fixed in advance, and were protected by quality weighting and conditions requiring realistic prices.
The final rates are not public.
De uiteindelijke tarieven zijn niet openbaar.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over de werkwijze van de gemeente Montfoort om goed bemiddelbare uitkeringsgerechtigden te detacheren met behoud van uitkering

An MP asks the state secretary whether Montfoort's practice of placing well-employable benefit recipients with regular employers while keeping their benefit, with the fee used to cover costs and Wsw budget shortfalls, is acceptable, and whether action will be taken. The secretary answers that these are municipal responsibilities under the WWB, that work with benefit should be temporary and avoid displacement, that no information exists on how widespread the practice is, and that no action is planned.
No information is available on this. Shaping municipal reintegration policy is a responsibility of the college of mayor and aldermen.
Hierover is geen informatie beschikbaar. De invulling van het gemeentelijk re-integratiebeleid is een verantwoordelijkheid van het college van B&W.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer over het teruglopende aantal vacatures en opdrachten voor zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp’ers)

An MP asked the minister about falling vacancies, the number of new labour market entrants left unemployed, and changes in assignments for self-employed workers without staff (zzp'ers), and whether the CBS should report on them. The minister said vacancy decisions lie with employers, that the government supports a good business climate, that CBS already reports zzp data, and that a package of WW and dismissal law reforms is being prepared for 2013.
The number of assignments for zzp'ers does not constitute usable policy information, because it is a diffuse unit
Het aantal opdrachten van zzp'ers vormt geen bruikbare beleidsinformatie, omdat dit een diffuse eenheid betreft
Antwoord vragen Hamer over het opschorten van de huishoudinkomenstoets

An MP asked whether the household income test in social assistance, in force since 1 January 2012, would be withdrawn retroactively and what that means for people refused or partly refused benefit. The state secretary answered yes: a bill with retroactive effect from 1 January 2012 was submitted, and municipalities must reassess entitlement and benefit levels for those affected.

Municipalities must reassess the right to assistance for persons whose application for assistance was rejected in connection with the household income test between 1 January 2012 and the date this bill takes effect.

Gemeenten dienen het recht op bijstand herbeoordelen voor personen wier aanvraag om bijstand in de periode van 1 januari 2012 tot de datum van inwerkingtreding van dit wetsvoorstel is afgewezen in verband met de huishoudinkomenstoets.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer over het opschorten van de huishoudinkomenstoets

MP Hamer asked the state secretary how people who registered for social assistance at UWV after 1 January 2012, and were turned away by the household income test, will be treated, and whether unregistered applicants can still claim benefits. The state secretary answered that a bill abolishing the test retroactively from 1 January 2012 is being introduced, that affected applicants will be reassessed and may apply within two months of publication, and that the ministry will support municipalities in informing citizens.
For persons whose application for assistance was rejected between 1 January 2012 and the date this bill takes effect, municipalities must reassess the right to assistance with retroactive effect.

Voor personen van wie de aanvraag om bijstand in de periode van 1 januari 2012 tot de datum van inwerkingtreding van dit wetsvoorstel is afgewezen, dienen gemeenten het recht op bijstand met terugwerkende kracht te herbeoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Hamer over de onduidelijkheid tussen de vitaliteitsparagraaf in het Nationale Hervormingsprogramma en die paragraaf in het Stabiliteitsprogramma

MPs Vermeij and Hamer asked why the vitality package's mobility bonuses appear in the National Reform Programme but are cut back in the Stability Programme, and which work bonuses are ended. Minister Kamp answered that the programmes were aligned as far as possible, that the mobility budget is frozen rather than abolished, and that the work bonuses for workers and employers are ended as part of the budget agreement.
The final version of the National Reform Programme submitted to your House on 27 April was aligned as far as possible with the commitments in the Stability Programme.
De definitieve versie van het Nationale Hervormingsprogramma dat op 27 april aan uw Kamer is aangeboden, is zo veel mogelijk afgestemd op de afspraken uit het Stabiliteitsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hamer over bezuinigingen op de sociale werkplaats in 2013

An MP asked the state secretary about cuts to sheltered workplaces (sociale werkplaats) in 2013, the basis for reversing them, and the fate of the Wet werken naar vermogen after loss of majority support. The state secretary largely referred questions to the coalition-agreement parties and to the bill's memorandum, said gemeenten would be informed after parliamentary decisions, and gave no firm commitments.
It is up to the parties mentioned to make further announcements about this.
Het is aan genoemde partijen om hier verder mededelingen over te doen.
Antwoord vragen  Hamer en Van Dam over kleine ondernemers die de volledige ketenboete voor illegale arbeidskrachten in hun maag gesplitst krijgen

MPs Hamer and Van Dam asked whether clients shift the full fine for illegal foreign labour onto small contractors through contract clauses or set-off, and whether this should be stopped. The minister says the broad employer definition makes all chain parties fineable, that fines can be reduced for clients who supervise compliance, and that civil courts can prohibit or moderate such recharging, but he sees no need for statutory measures given contractual freedom.
Statutory measures to prevent recharging I do not consider necessary at this time, partly because this would infringe the contractual freedom of parties.
Wettelijke maatregelen om doorbelasting te voorkomen acht ik nu niet nodig, mede ook omdat dit de contractvrijheid van partijen aantast.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over het ontduiken van vaste contracten en cao’s door payrolling

An MP asked the minister whether employers evade the Flexwet chain rule and collective labour agreements by using payroll firms, and whether the legal employer identity, a six-month cap on temporary agency work, and equal pay rules should be clarified. The minister said he had no signals of such practices, pointed to workers' right to go to court, deferred answers on legal employer and caps pending Stichting van de Arbeid advice, and noted existing and forthcoming equal treatment rules under WAADI and the Uitzendrichtlijn.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de inspanningen van de rijksoverheid om re

MPs Heijnen and Hamer asked the ministers how central government will directly strengthen the labour market position of Wajong and WSW beneficiaries, including targets, quotas and social return in procurement. The minister answered that a 1% reserved-places quota applies, that a range of support measures and a 2012 study on bonus-malus incentives are underway, that no separate target exists for these groups, and that social return will be evaluated in 2013.
From 1 July 2011, social return is part of the central government procurement policy.
Vanaf 1 juli 2011 is social return onderdeel van het Rijksinkoopbeleid.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over de sterke stijging van het aantal schuldhulpvragen

An MP asked the state secretary about a sharp rise in debt-assistance requests, rising waiting lists, unemployment-driven demand, and whether capacity will be increased. The state secretary answered that waiting-time data for referrals via social work is not held, that municipalities are responsible for capacity, and that the Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening will cap waiting times.
I do not have data on waiting times for clients who approach municipal debt assistance via social work.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over wachttijden van cliënten die via het maatschappelijk werk beroep doen op de gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord vragen Heijnen en Hamer over de effecten van het social return beleid

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the government would follow the long-term effects of social return policy independently, like Rotterdam, and how it applies case-specific tailoring and possible Rotterdam-style methods. The minister replied that central government reports annually and will evaluate social return in 2013, sees no added value in an extra independent monitor for now, and points to existing knowledge-sharing and case-by-case design of social return clauses.
In addition, the social return policy at central government will be evaluated in 2013 on its effects as well as the implementation costs for both the contracting authority and the contractor.
Daarnaast wordt het social return beleid bij het Rijk in 2013 geëvalueerd op de effecten alsmede de uitvoeringslasten voor zowel de opdrachtgever als de opdrachtnemer.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over de dramatische daling van het aantal vaste contracten en de gevolgen voor Nederland

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a reported sharp fall in permanent contracts, whether flexible employment has become excessive, insecurity for workers, age effects, and training investment. The minister answers that temporary contracts rose modestly due to the recession, that about a quarter of flex workers moved to permanent jobs after a year, that older workers have mostly permanent contracts, and that training gaps between flex and permanent workers are small.
The CBS has started collecting data on the transition of this group.
Het CBS is gestart met het verzamelen van gegevens over de doorstroom van deze groep.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam en Hamer over "het ontduiken van de werkvergunningplicht voor Roemeense en Bulgaarse werknemers door Nederlandse bedrijven"

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs whether companies are abusing posting and self-employed constructions to evade work permit requirements for Romanian and Bulgarian workers, and about illegal employment and wage competition. The minister acknowledged rising notifications, announced higher fines, stricter data sharing between UWV and the Inspectorate, and a requirement for employers to show documentary proof, but said illegal employment figures are unknown and wage rules apply to posted workers.
Figures on Romanians and Bulgarians working illegally in the Netherlands are not known.
Cijfers over Roemenen en Bulgaren die illegaal in Nederland werken, zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over een aanhouding voor ontucht op een kinderdagverblijf in Vlissingen

MP Hamer asked the ministers about the arrest of a childcare worker in Vlissingen for suspected sexual abuse of a 3-year-old, the information given to parents, the investigation, and progress on childcare quality measures. Minister Kamp answered that details are withheld for the investigation, parents were informed through meetings, a helpline and letters, and the 'four-eyes principle' will be anchored in law.
In the interest of the investigation, it is not possible to make any statements about the content of the investigation that has since continued.
Het is in het belang van het onderzoek niet mogelijk om over de inhoud van het onderzoek dat sindsdien is voortgezet, mededelingen te doen.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over het bericht in Spitsnieuws van 1 februari jl. dat mannen massaal de kinderopvang verlaten

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether men are massively leaving childcare after the Amsterdam abuse case, and what reasons and consultations exist. The minister answered that only 4 percent of childcare staff are men, no comparable before-and-after data exist, the negative attention may have contributed to some departures, and he regrets their leaving but sees no direct role for the ministry in increasing male staff.
Given the division of responsibilities, I see no possibility to actively promote the number of men in childcare myself.
Gezien de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling, zie ik geen mogelijkheid om zelf actief het aantal mannen in de kinderopvang te bevorderen.

Vragen de leden Hamer en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het verzoeken van Europese steun om ontslagen medewerkers van Zalco weer aan het werk te helpen (ingezonden 23

MPs Hamer and Van der Veen asked the minister whether he would submit an urgent application to the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund to help workers dismissed by Zalco, and why not if he would not. The state secretary answered yes, he is willing to apply, subject to the application meeting the conditions, with Zeeland province and Zalco preparing the draft in close cooperation with his ministry.
Yes, I am willing to submit an application to the European Commission for support from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund.
Ja, ik ben bereid een aanvraag in te dienen bij de Europese Commissie voor steun uit het Europese Globaliseringsfonds.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Braakhuis (GroenLinks), Hamer (PvdA) en Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de falende postbezorging van Post.nl (ingezonden 25

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and PVV asked the state secretary about widespread failed and late mail delivery by PostNL shown in a TV broadcast, whether the claimed 96.5% next-day delivery rate is credible, and whether staffing policy is to blame. The state secretary replied that PostNL is responsible for quality, that the 95% overkomstduur norm is measured by an independent bureau and supervised by OPTA, that he sees no reason to revisit the norm, and that staffing is PostNL's own responsibility.
If PostNL does not meet the stated requirements, OPTA can act under the Postal Act.
In het geval PostNL niet aan de gestelde eisen voldoet, kan OPTA op grond van de Postwet optreden.
Vragen van het leden Hamer en Dijsselbloem (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over payrollen bij een ROC (ingezonden 31 oktober 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether using a payroll construction to let a ROC (Eindhoven) avoid its unemployment-insurance (WW) own-risk obligation is undesirable and whether it shifts costs onto the collective. The minister said public employers should bear WW risk for their own staff and that shifting it to market-sector funds is undesirable, but argued that the price of the risk is priced into payroll fees, and promised advice from the Stichting van de Arbeid before a government response.
The cabinet has asked the Stichting van de Arbeid for advice on payrolling.
Het kabinet heeft de Stichting van de Arbeid om advies gevraagd over payrolling.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over 12 000 leerwerkbanen die in de uitzendbranche op de tocht worden gezet (

MPs Çelik and Hamer asked whether changing the education wage-tax reduction (Wet vermindering afdracht onderwijs) so that staffing agencies no longer qualify would put 12,000 apprenticeship places in the temp sector at risk, and why the government would undermine agencies' training role. The minister denied the change harms apprenticeships, said the reduction must reach the recognised training employer, and announced eased conditions allowing the reduction to be split with intermediary employers.

The clarification means that when an intermediary employer is engaged, the wage-tax reduction must go partly or fully to the recognised training company, depending on the division of tasks agreed between them.

De verduidelijking houdt in dat de afdrachtvermindering bij inschakeling van een intermediaire werkgever deels of volledig moet toekomen aan het erkende leerbedrijf, afhankelijk van de onderling overeengekomen taakverdeling.
Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de postzegelprijs (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

MPs Dijksma and Hamer asked the state secretary about a planned stamp price increase by PostNL and whether it complies with postal regulation, and about tariff fairness versus business post and staff conditions. The state secretary answered that OPTA set the Universal Postal Service tariffs under the Postwet and Postregeling without needing ministerial ratification, that business tariffs are not comparable, and that employment conditions are for social partners.
An increase in the UPD tariffs does not need to be ratified by ministerial regulation.
Een verhoging van de UPD tarieven hoeft niet te worden bekrachtigd bij ministeriële regeling.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de luchtkwaliteit in kinderdagverblijven (ingezonden 8 sept

MPs Hamer and Monasch asked about indoor air quality in daycare centres, including whether all daycare should be required to use an objective ventilation assessment method and whether remaining crisis funds are available. The minister answered that ventilation assessment should remain a private quality matter, that funds were passed via municipalities to schools, and that a phased voluntary improvement programme plus new Bouwbesluit rules from 2012 are in place.
No, I do not intend to make the objective assessment method mandatory for all daycare centres.
Nee, ik ben niet van plan om de objectieve beoordelingsmethode verplicht te stellen voor alle kinderdagverblijven.

Vragen van de leden Albayrak en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de kritiek in het Europees parlement op Nederland (ingezonden 15

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about European Parliament criticism of Netherlands over blocking extension of the Globalisation Adjustment Fund and how much Dutch workers benefited. The minister answered that the Netherlands does not block the fund but opposes extending the eased eligibility rules, and gave figures on Dutch applications (13 applications, EUR 21.1 million, 6,382 workers).
I therefore advocate a prompt and thorough external evaluation of the use and effects of the EGF as an instrument to counter the effects of globalisation and the crisis.
Ik pleit dan ook voor een spoedige en gedegen externe evaluatie over het gebruik en de effecten van het EGF als instrument om de effecten van globalisering en de crisis tegen te gaan.

Vragen van het lid Hamer (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de postbezorging op maandag (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about PostNL's statements that Monday mail delivery should be abolished and whether the government would guarantee it and talk with PostNL. The state secretary answered that the Postwet 2009 obliges weekly six-day delivery including Monday, that an evaluation of universal postal service is underway, and that a vision on the postal market will follow this autumn.
Under Article 16(5) of the Postwet 2009, the universal postal service provider is obliged to collect mail and deliver to every address in the Netherlands at least six days a week.

Op basis van artikel 16, lid 5 van de Postwet 2009 is de uitvoerder van de universele postdienst verplicht ten minste zes dagen per week poststukken op te halen en voert hij tenminste zes dagen per week overal in Nederland een bestelling uit.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Hamer (PvdA) en Braakhuis (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het UWV dat weiger

MPs from SP, PvdA and GroenLinks asked why UWV refused PostNL dismissal permits for sorting staff and how the dismissal rules were applied, including the shift from permanent to flexible work and a motion on UWV's work instruction. The minister answered that permits were refused because the selection did not follow the afspiegelingsbeginsel and because it was unclear whether temporary and agency staff would continue, and that the work instruction did not play a role in this assessment.
In this case the permits were refused because the dismissal selection was not in line with the afspiegelingsbeginsel.
In dit geval zijn de vergunningen geweigerd omdat de ontslagkeuze niet in overeenstemming was met het afspiegelingsbeginsel.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Smeets (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het gebruik van een sterfhuisconstructie bij een onwelgevallig gerechtelijk oordeel over te betalen ontslagvergo

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the use of a bankruptcy ('sterfhuis') construction by Doorwin to avoid paying dismissal compensation to Limburg Kozijnen staff, after an unfavourable court ruling, is acceptable and whether instruments exist to prevent it. The minister answered that withdrawing a dissolution request is a lawful option, that the motives are for the judge to assess, that bankruptcy filings can amount to abuse of rights under case law and Article 13a of the Bankruptcy Act, and that existing law gives workers sufficient protection, so no new measures are planned.
I see no reason to counter the use of 'sterfhuis' constructions, as is claimed.
Antwoord 4 Ik zie geen reden om – zoals wordt gesteld – het gebruik van «sterfhuisconstructies» tegen te gaan.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financiën over de kwaliteit van arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen voor zelfstandige ondernemers (ingezonden

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about the quality of disability insurance for self-employed workers after the AFM found weak budget products. The Minister of Social Affairs said the AFM found no structural misconduct, that Finance is preparing measures on product development and advice, and that he sees no need for further action on specific products.
The Minister of Finance is currently preparing a package of measures addressing the various identified shortcomings.
De minister van Financiën bereidt op dit moment een pakket maatregelen voor die verschillende onderdelen van de geconstateerde tekortkomingen adresseren.
Vragen van het lid Hamer (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de groei van payrolling (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

An MP asks the minister about the growth of payrolling, including whether dismissal rules, exclusivity clauses, contract extensions and the comparison with temp agencies create disadvantages for workers. The minister says payrolling uses lawful options, that dismissal for payroll workers requires proof of attempts at redeployment, and that the Stichting van de Arbeid will be asked for its view.
I will ask the Stichting van de Arbeid how it views the development of payrolling, including in light of the consequences for workers regarding dismissal.
Ik zal de Stichting van de Arbeid vragen hoe wordt aangekeken tegen de ontwikkeling van payrolling, mede in het licht van de gevolgen voor werknemers als het gaat om ontslag.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de rechtsbesche

MPs Heijnen and Hamer asked ministers about legal protection of civil servants at AgentschapNL, who work via a payroll company and may be dismissed without a social plan due to budget cuts. The government answered that payroll workers are employees of the payroll firm, not civil servants, that the VPO-CAO applies, and that the firm bears employer responsibility, while AgentschapNL will act within the Rijk social flanking policy.
These are not civil servants but employees of a payroll company.
Het betreft hier geen ambtenaren maar werknemers in dienst van een payrollbedrijf.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het tekort aan technici met een lagere en middelbare opleiding

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about a predicted shortage of lower and intermediate-level technicians and the cuts to MBO training for over-30s. The ministers defended the €23 million technology investments, said the 30+ cut reflects private responsibility, and described an alternative financing arrangement with a €130 million box.
Vragen van de leden Hamer en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over werkzoekende ouderen (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about the difficulty older jobseekers face finding work, the stigma they encounter, the future of funding for their network groups, and whether a training right and duty would help. The minister acknowledged the problem, said agreements with social partners on sustainable employability are under negotiation, noted UWV has no separate budget for older jobseekers, and said training is mainly a matter for employers and employees.
UWV has no separate budget for older unemployed people.
UWV heeft geen apart budget voor oudere werklozen.

Vragen van de leden Ulenbelt (SP), Ortega Martijn (ChristenUnie), Klaver (GroenLinks) en Hamer (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over machtsmisbruik, intimidatie en falende leiding bij d

Four MPs asked the state secretary for Social Affairs about alleged abuse of power, intimidation and failed leadership at the sheltered workplace Pauw Bedrijven, including what workers can do and what measures will prevent such abuses. The state secretary answered that this is a matter for the employer, works council, union and local authorities, that an independent investigation has been commissioned, and that no further measures or known signals elsewhere exist.
This concerns a matter for the implementing organisation and the administrators involved.
Dit betreft een kwestie van de uitvoeringsorganisatie en de betrokken bestuurders.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de gebrekkige aansluiting tussen MBO-opleidingen en het werken in de hav

MPs Hamer and Çelik asked ministers whether vocational colleges (ROCs) and port employers are to blame for the mismatch between MBO training and port jobs, and whether a sector-wide overview and joint table talks were planned. Minister Kamp answered that employers are primarily responsible for their own staffing, that ROC cooperation with employers already exists, and that no separate overview or new table talks were needed.
No, given legal responsibilities this is a matter for the ROCs and port employers themselves.
Neen, gelet op wettelijke verantwoordelijkheden is dit een zaak van roc's en havenondernemers zelf.
Vragen van de leden Hamer (PvdA) en Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de terugvordering van Wsw-gelden van gemeenten (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

MPs Hamer and Koşer Kaya asked the state secretary why some municipalities were warned about discrepancies in their Wsw (sheltered employment) accounts and others not, whether the 20% threshold was used, and how the Breda court ruling on the clawback affects recoveries. The state secretary said all accounts were checked, flagged municipalities were given a chance to correct them, clawback applies even when funds were spent as intended, and the ruling does not affect the recovery decisions because the legal basis stands.
I therefore do not know whether Wsw-registered persons working at a sheltered workshop elsewhere are the cause of a common error.
Het is mij derhalve niet bekend of Wsw-geïndiceerden, die bij een werkvoorzieningschap elders werkzaam waren, de oorzaak zijn van een veelvoorkomende fout.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de voorgenomen ontslagen bij De Vries Kozijnen in Gorredijk. (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether planned dismissals at De Vries Kozijnen in Gorredijk, and the reorganisation process, violated the Collective Redundancy Notification Act (WMCO) and whether intervention was planned. The minister answered that a court ruled the notification met WMCO requirements, that the late involvement of unions and the works council was cured by later consultation, and that no fraud occurred, so the interests of employees were adequately protected.
I do not share that view.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya (D66) en Hamer (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over terugvordering van Wet Sociale Werkvoorziening (Wsw)-budgetten (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

MPs asked whether municipalities were recovered funds for Wsw sheltered-employment budgets after failing to report Wsw workers employed by other providers, and whether warnings were given and whether administrative errors justify recovery. The state secretary confirmed recoveries from several municipalities for incomplete reporting, said warnings and an extra internal check were applied, and stated that only reporting failures not shown to be non-culpable led to recovery, while clerical errors were not charged.
Recovery only took place in cases where there were errors in the accountability, where the municipalities had not shown that the handling was not culpable.
Terugvordering heeft alleen plaatsgevonden in de gevallen waarbij sprake is van fouten in de verantwoording
Vragen van het lid Hamer (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het artikel «De crèche wordt steeds duurder en slechter» (ingezonden 5 november 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a press report claiming childcare is becoming more expensive and worse, including foreign ownership, weak financial oversight, understaffing in Leiden and lack of parental cost information. The minister said nationality of owners is not registered, enforcement in Leiden has improved under agreements with the Inspectorate, and parents' position will be strengthened via a promised letter and a comparison website.
Enforcement of violations of the quality criteria, including the staff-child ratio, must be tackled by municipalities.
Handhaving op overtredingen van de kwaliteitscriteria, dus ook zeker de beroepskracht-kind-ratio, moet door gemeenten worden aangepakt.
Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bezuinigingen op de thuiszorg (ingezonden 3 juni 2010).

MPs Wolbert and Hamer asked the health minister about reported cuts of 200 million euros to municipal Wmo home-care budgets, alleged use of that money for medical specialist overruns, and a delayed or reduced reimbursement of Wmo implementation costs. The minister confirmed a structural downward adjustment of 200 million linked to expected efficiency gains and lower personal budgets, said specialist overruns play no role, and stated that no agreement with the VNG has yet been reached and talks continue in September.
After final conclusion of the administrative consultation, I will inform your House and the municipalities of the outcomes.
Na definitieve afronding van het bestuurlijk overleg zal ik uw Kamer en de gemeenten informeren over de uitkomsten.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische en van Zaken en Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de grootschalige ontslagen bij MSD/Organon te Oss (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

MPs Hamer and Spekman asked ministers about the mass layoffs at MSD/Organon in Oss, including urgent action to limit damage, short-term help for those losing jobs, UWV anticipation of job seekers, and contact with the municipality of Oss. The government answered that it agrees the job losses are serious, that consultations involving the government and other parties are underway to preserve jobs and knowledge via two working groups, that UWV is closely involved, and that it is not yet clear which employees become redundant.
At this moment it is not yet clear for which employees redundancy will arise.
Op dit moment is nog niet duidelijk voor welke medewerkers boventalligheid ontstaat.
