qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul  en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht 'Coöperatie Laatste Wil komt met nieuwe  levenseindemethode'

MPs Bikker, Krul and Diederik van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about the Coöperatie Laatste Wil's new assisted-dying method, its risks for vulnerable people, and possible legal action. The government called the dissemination of suicide methods undesirable, said it is checking whether the activities are criminal under article 294 Sr, declined to confirm any ongoing investigations, and said the prosecutor would act if criminal limits are crossed while the minister sees no reason to use a special instruction power.
In general, the Minister of Justice and Security can neither confirm nor deny whether criminal investigations are ongoing against certain natural or legal persons.
In zijn algemeenheid geldt dat de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan bevestigen noch ontkennen of tegen bepaalde natuurlijke of rechtspersonen strafrechtelijke onderzoeken lopen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Straatman over het bericht 'Tabakssmokkel en nepsigaretten schaden Nederlandse verkopers'

MPs Krul and Straatman (CDA) asked about reports of rising illegal cigarette trade, smuggling, illegal production, online sales and excise policy. The government answered with survey data, enforcement measures and EU excise harmonisation plans, but made no firm commitments on new accijns increases.
It is up to the next cabinet to decide on changes to the excise duty.
Het is aan het volgende kabinet om te besluiten over te gaan tot wijzigingen ten aanzien van de accijns.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over het artikel ‘Jongerengeweld zoals in Beverwijk speelt in het hele land: Vechtpartijen zijn van alle tijden maar er is een nieuwe dimensie bij gekomen’

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked the Minister of Justice and Security about rivalry between youth groups in the IJmond, the role of social media, cooperation between police, municipalities and prosecutors, and whether pilots, information to the House, and a criminal ban on posting victim images are warranted. The minister answered that online factors act as catalysts, described existing multi-party youth-group approaches and digital neighbourhood officers, declined a pilot for smaller municipalities but pointed to ongoing programmes, promised to inform the House on the approach, and noted a pending research report and an initiative bill that the cabinet will assess later.
It is explicitly the intention to inform other municipalities with comparable problems about the approach and results achieved.
Het is uitdrukkelijk het voornemen om andere gemeenten met vergelijkbare problemen te informeren over de werkwijze en resultaten die hierin bereikt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over de gevolgen van het gebruik van lachgas en de handhaving van het lachgasverbod

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice and Security and Health ministers how they will respond to a Radar broadcast on nitrous oxide harms, including care pressure, enforcement of the ban, online sales and European coordination. The minister answered that there are no signals of rising pressure on care, that enforcement appears adequate, and committed to raising a European ban in EU drug working groups.
There are no signals that the enforceability of the ban is in question.
Er zijn geen signalen dat de handhaafbaarheid van het verbod in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul, Vedder en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Geen demonstratie voor veilige kruising’

CDA MPs asked the ministers about traffic safety on the N9 near the vlotbruggen (floating bridges) in North Holland, including structural fixes, Defence-related traffic from Den Helder, and how residents are involved. The minister replied that small targeted measures were carried out in 2023/2024 at the Burgervlotbrug and Sint Maartensvlotbrug, that a review of a fixed crossing is the province's responsibility with results expected in 2027, and that no concrete further improvements are yet planned.
The previous cabinet invested roughly €4 million in traffic safety at the Sint Maartensvlotbrug and Burgervlotbrug.
Het voorgaande kabinet heeft voor ongeveer € 4 miljoen geïnvesteerd in de verkeersveiligheid in Sint Maartensvlotbrug en Burgervlotbrug.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Krul over de uitvoering van de motie Dobbe/Krul over zich ervoor inzetten om de onlineverkoop van vapes te stoppen

Two MPs asked the state secretary why the July 2025 letter on the Dobbe/Krul motion against online vape sales did not address restricting payment and delivery options, and what will be done to stop companies offering them. The state secretary admitted payment and delivery restrictions were not specifically named, pointed to an NVWA arrangement with a delivery firm and a forthcoming action plan with an update due mid-2026, and said answers could not be ready in time for the debate.
Restricting payment and delivery options was indeed not specifically mentioned, but this will be taken into account.
Het beperken van betalings- en bezorgingsmogelijkheden is inderdaad niet specifiek genoemd, maar dit wordt meegenomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Waarom goedkope, gebruiksvriendelijke hulpmiddelen de patiënt maar moeizaam bereiken’

The MP Krul asks the Minister of Health about a newspaper report that cheap, user-friendly medical aids struggle to reach patients, asking whether the problem is recognised, why such aids are not reaching patients, the size of the problem, the role of Zvw financing, possible savings and solutions. The Minister acknowledges signals, points to EU regulation (MDR/IVDR), existing innovation support and AZWA agreements, but says she does not have insight into the scale, does not steer on specific aids or prices, and refers responsibility for procurement and purchasing to care providers and insurers.
I cannot respond specifically to these examples because as Minister I do not concern myself with how aids in care are purchased and deployed.
Ik kan niet specifiek op deze voorbeelden ingaan omdat ik als Minister niet ga over hoe de hulpmiddelen in de zorg ingekocht en ingezet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse universiteiten houden politiek buiten de deur tijdens de introductieweken’

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that Amsterdam universities exclude political youth organisations from introduction weeks, and whether dialogue on campus should be promoted. The Minister answers that the design of introduction weeks is for institutions to decide, notes existing access rules, and declines to engage with universities or youth organisations.
The design of the introduction weeks is entirely up to the institution itself.
De vormgeving van de introductieweken is volledig aan de instelling zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Six Dijkstra over de nieuwe cijfers van het Landelijk Alcohol en Drugs Informatie Systeem (LADIS)

MPs asked the government about the rising number of people seeking treatment for gambling addiction (many young, mostly online), the lack of a ban on online gambling advertising, the minimum gambling age, drug addiction trends including cannabis and new substances, and the cost of cannabis-related addiction care. The minister acknowledged the trends as worrying, pointed to planned gambling law revision with consultation in 2026 and a planned raise of the minimum age to 21, and listed prevention measures while declining to ban gambling outright and giving no cost breakdown for cannabis treatment.
The aim is to put the relevant bill out for consultation in 2026.
Het streven is om het betreffende wetsvoorstel in 2026 in consultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Krul en Boswijk over het bericht “Wake-up call: Microsoft sluit e-mail ICC zonder pardon af”

Three CDA MPs asked whether Microsoft cut off the ICC prosecutor's email on US orders, what the government is doing to restore access and protect the court, and whether dependence on US digital services undermines democratic institutions. The minister declined to confirm the reported cut-off, condemned the sanctions, said talks with the US and business are ongoing, and stated that digital dependence is a policy issue being addressed through a planned digital autonomy vision rather than an acute threat to democracy.
It is not for the cabinet to confirm or deny reporting on the implementation of sanctions imposed by other states.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om berichtgeving over de implementatie van sancties die door andere staten zijn opgelegd te bevestigen of te ontkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Krul over het bericht 'Werkgevers lokken jonge werknemer met studieschuldregeling' in het FD van 11 mei 2025

MPs Inge van Dijk and Krul asked whether tax-advantaged employer repayment of student debt should be broadened, given high debts and write-offs of residual debt. The Staatssecretaris answered that the existing workplace expenses scheme and free allowance already allow it, that a specific exemption does not fit the scheme's purpose, and that budgetary effects of broadening it would need to be financed and are being evaluated.
The ongoing evaluation of the workplace expenses scheme will also consider whether employers should be fiscally incentivised to let employees repay student debt at favourable terms.

Bij de op dit moment lopende evaluatie van de werkkostenregeling wordt ook meegenomen of werkgevers fiscaal gestimuleerd moeten worden voor het voordelig laten aflossen van studieschulden door werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Paulusma, Bikker en Krul over het beëindigen van de VWS-subsidie aan het IKNL Trialbureau

MPs asked why the minister is ending the VWS subsidy for the IKNL trial bureau, its amount, timing, alternatives and impact. The minister confirmed the subsidy for trial activities ends on 1 January 2026 on state aid grounds, stated the 2025 amount, and declined substantive answers on alternatives and timing because an objection by IKNL is pending.
Because of this ongoing objection procedure, I cannot make any further substantive statements.
Vanwege deze lopende bezwaarprocedure kan ik daarom verder geen inhoudelijke uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Krul over de oplossing van natuurcompensatie voor de aanleg van de Tweede Maasvlakte en de gevolgen daarvan voor vissers in Noord-Holland

MPs Vedder and Krul asked the State Secretary about an alternative nature compensation plan for the Second Maasvlakte, its possible displacement effects on Noord-Holland fishers, the basis for a new Natura 2000 area, and compensation. The State Secretary confirmed the proposal is still under consultation with a final chance for stakeholders until mid-May, will avoid a final decision before Commission agreement, and states compensation is only possible after an irrevocable decision.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Zorgen bij ziekenhuizen over tekorten aan middelen voor chemokuren' en de WNL-aflevering Stand van Nederland van 21 maart

An MP asked the health minister about reports of shortages of cancer drugs (chemokuren) and supply chain vulnerabilities, including dependence on China and whether Dutch and EU production should be increased. The minister said shortages in 2024 fell by 30%, described monitoring and measures for oncolytics, and outlined EU and national plans such as the Critical Medicines Act, stockpiling and IPCEI support, while not quantifying affected patients.
It is not possible to state how many patients are affected, but through close monitoring the effect on patients is limited as much as possible.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel patiënten geraakt worden, maar door de nauwkeurige monitoring wordt het effect op de patiënt zo goed als mogelijk beperkt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Krul en Vedder over het bericht 'Zie de mens, niet het getal'; Senioren lopen aan tegen 'discriminatie op basis van leeftijd', ouderenorganisatie luidt noodklok'

MPs Inge van Dijk, Krul and Vedder (CDA) asked the government to respond to reports and a survey by ANBO-PCOB showing widespread age discrimination against seniors, and to set out measures across finance, labour, vehicle rental and volunteering. The minister answered that age discrimination is serious, that the government will discuss the survey with ANBO-PCOB, and that existing policies such as the Offensief Gelijke Kansen apply, but that no specific action plans exist for finance and no concrete new measures were announced beyond a planned study on vehicle rental insurance.
The fact that so many older people experience age discrimination is a reason for me to discuss the results of this research further with ANBO-PCOB.
Het gegeven dat zoveel ouderen leeftijdsdiscriminatie ervaren is voor mij aanleiding om met ANBO-PCOB verder te spreken over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Inge van Dijk over het artikel 'Scherpe kritiek op onderzoek Jeugdbescherming naar eigen rol bij gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire'

MPs Krul and Inge van Dijk asked why the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming's self-reflection on child removals of childcare-benefit scandal victims relied only on file review and professional interviews, without speaking to parents and children. The State Secretary defends the self-initiated reflection, acknowledges the missing parent and child perspective, notes other studies did include them, and promises a policy response and possible further research by June 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Fysio om de hoek redt het vaak niet meer'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that many physiotherapy practices are struggling or closing due to administrative burden and low pay, and about shortages, student enrolment, wait lists and market studies. The state secretary acknowledged concern, said no concrete NZa signals of shortages exist, and pointed to ongoing NZa market research and policy programmes with results expected later in 2025.
Before the committee debate on the health insurance system on 19 June, the House will be informed of a first NZa analysis of market functioning and accessibility in physiotherapy.

Voor het Commissiedebat over het zorgverzekeringsstelsel op 19 juni a.s. wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over een eerste analyse van de NZa met inzichten rondom het functioneren van de markt en de toegankelijkheid binnen de fysiotherapie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Bikker, Krul en Van der Plas over abortus vanwege geslacht

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie, CDA and BBB asked whether sex-based abortion after prenatal sex disappointment is discriminatory, whether it conflicts with the Embryowet ban on sex selection, and whether verification or regulation of pre-technical sex-determination ultrasounds is possible. The state secretary answered that such abortions are rare and multi-motivated, that a study of reasons would be unreliable and undesirable, and that private ultrasounds fall outside state regulation and cannot be influenced by law.
I have made inquiries with the professional groups of midwives (KNOV), sonographers (BEN) and abortion doctors (NGvA) on this.
Ik heb hierop navraag gedaan bij de beroepsgroepen van verloskundigen (KNOV), echoscopisten (BEN) en abortusartsen (NGvA).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Zorgverzekeraars vinden thuis sterven vaak te duur'

An MP asks the health minister about a report that health insurers consider dying at home too costly, including a utilisation test for terminal home care and a reported 12-hour monthly limit. The state secretary disputes the specific case, states no insurer has refused such requests in 2024 or earlier, says no hour limits are applied, and commits to agreements in the Aanvullend Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord and the palliative care transformation programme.
I am working towards making additional agreements on this in the Aanvullend Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord (AZWA).
3 , erop in om hierover in het Aanvullend Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord (AZWA) aanvullende afspraken te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over de onrust na het dodelijke steekincident op 2 januari in Den Dolder

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked whether the 2017 promise that the Fivoor clinic would leave Den Dolder by 2025 would be honoured, and what options exist to relocate Fivoor or restore residents' sense of safety. The state secretaries answered that no formal promise on a departure date was made, that they lack the competence to order a relocation or an admission stop, and that they will explore use of Rijksvastgoed and continue talks with the municipality.
No formal commitment was made by the Minister for Legal Protection regarding the departure date of the Fivoor clinics from Den Dolder.
Er is door de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming geen formele toezegging gedaan over de vertrekdatum voor de klinieken voor de klinieken van Fivoor uit Den Dolder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Shit, kan ik nog terug?' Chemiestudent Marieke werd twee keer geronseld voor drugslab'

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Education about reports of chemistry students being recruited by drug criminals, including signals known to universities and police, protection measures, criminal liability and prevention campaigns. The government answered that recruitment of people with specific skills occurs but its frequency is unknown, pointed to existing prevention programmes, anonymous reporting channels and the criminal law provision, and declined to set up a dedicated information point for students.
How often this exactly occurs is not known.
Hoe vaak dit precies is, is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Als er niet meer geld komt, verdwijnen onze molens'

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that windmill preservation needs more funding and about volunteer support, subsidies and encroaching buildings threatening windmills. The Minister acknowledges the funding pressure, notes that around 80 to 120 mills need major maintenance each year, reports a provincial matching arrangement of 20 million euros, and says he will raise the wind-shadow issue with IPO and VNG.
I have committed to inform the House before the summer about the further steps I intend to take regarding the funding problems of (large) monuments.
Ik heb toegezegd uw Kamer voor de zomer te informeren over de verdere stappen die ik wil zetten met betrekking tot de financieringsproblematiek van (grote) monumenten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Diederik van Dijk, Van den Hil, Krul, Ceder, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Slagt-Tichelman, Kostić en Eerdmans over een solide toekomstplan voor Kamp Westerbork naar aanleiding van 80 jaar

MPs asked the government to respond to Kamp Westerbork memorial's financial shortfalls, deferred maintenance and the need for a sustainable future plan, and to say what it will do about the memorial's proposed plan and the Moluccan history. The state secretary answers that a solid future plan will be developed with the memorial centres, one-off 2025 funds have been reserved, the memorial's financing plan is under study, and an OHW letter on progress is expected around summer 2025.
I am studying this plan and looking at what role the central government can play in it.
Ik ben dit plan aan het bestuderen en bekijken welke rol de Rijksoverheid daarin kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Krul over de uitzending van Radar 'De gevolgen van het verdwijnen van de restitutiepolis' van 16 december 2024

An MP asks the Minister of Health about the loss of restitution policies for community nursing and mental health care, the NZa's alleged orders against nine insurers over free choice of doctor, the insurers' duty of care and the 75% reimbursement threshold, and complaint numbers and handling times. The Minister says the NZa issued no order after insurers fixed their problems, insurers must meet their duty of care, the hardship criterion applies, and complaints fell in 2024 though mental health complaints rose.
After investigation the NZa found that eight health insurers must better inform their insured when they have to pay a high own contribution for uncontracted care.
Na onderzoek heeft de NZa vastgesteld dat acht zorgverzekeraars hun verzekerden beter moeten informeren als zij een hoge eigen bijdrage moeten betalen voor onverzekerde zorg

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Krul en Bikker over het bericht ‘Deze zes mensen zien het vuilste van wat op internet rondgaat’ en ‘Politie waarschuwt honderdvijftig bezitters van kinderporno

MPs Van Dijk, Krul and Bikker asked why Dutch hosting providers are slow to remove child sexual abuse material, why police only warn downloaders rather than arrest them, and what legal tools exist. The minister acknowledges that only about 26% of Offlimits reports were handled within 24 hours in 2023, points to the new ATKM powers since July 2024, and explains that police prioritise producers and networks, using warning campaigns for downloaders.
In 74% of cases no or insufficient follow-up was given to a report, and the child pornography material remained visible for at least 24 hours.
In 74% van de gevallen werd geen of onvoldoende opvolging gegeven aan een melding en blijft het kinderpornografisch materiaal op zijn minst langer dan 24 uur zichtbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Ceder over het bericht ‘veel kinderen hebben spijt van aankopen in games’

MPs Krul (CDA) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government will respond to Unicef research showing many children regret in-game purchases such as loot boxes, whether a ban is needed, and why Belgium could ban them nationally but the Netherlands cannot. The minister answers that the findings are worrying, that the Netherlands is pushing for a loot box ban in the EU Digital Fairness Act (proposal expected late 2025 or early 2026) since EU maximum harmonisation blocks stricter national rules, that Dutch gambling law does not fit loot boxes, and that a national ban is not pursued in favour of EU action.
I do not want to anticipate national legislation, because I expect action to be taken at the European level.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op nationale wetgeving, omdat ik verwacht dat er op Europees niveau actie wordt ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over het bericht ‘Tientallen kanalen met sportwedtips op Telegram, kansspelautoriteit stelt onderzoek in’

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked about reports of dozens of Telegram channels selling sports betting tips aimed at young people, including whether influencer promotion falls under the gambling advertising ban and whether the Kansspelautoriteit investigation has concluded. The Secretary of State says the tips appear to be fraud rather than matchfixing or licensed gambling advertising, points to existing prevention and enforcement tools, says the regulator monitors these channels, and promises to inform parliament once the investigation results are known.
Once the results of the investigation are known, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Op het moment dat de resultaten bekend zijn, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Krul en Stoffer over het onderzoek ‘De herstelopdracht doorgelicht: Een verkenning naar de rechtmatigheid van herstelopdrachten in het funderend onderwijs’

MPs Ceder, Krul and Stoffer asked the Minister of Education about Professor Van Schoonhoven's study questioning whether Inspectorate remediation orders (herstelopdrachten) rest on legal grounds, and how the Inspectorate avoids overreach, distinguishes its supervisory from its stimulating role, justifies orders, and informs school boards of their rights. The Minister replies that the Inspectorate found its orders lawful, tied to statutory adequacy standards, will refine justification and frameworks, and will not withdraw any orders, while describing existing safeguards such as complaint procedures and board responses.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Boomsma, Tseggai en Diederik van Dijk over de aanpak van klanten die betaalde seks hebben met minderjarige slachtoffers van seksuele uitbuiting

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police and prosecution capacity for pursuing clients who buy sex from minors, after the OM Limburg reportedly declined to target them, and about sentencing, online age verification on sex-advertisement sites, and effective enforcement. The Minister denied any national policy of not pursuing clients, cited the higher statutory maxima and capacity investments, and committed to talks with police, the OM and advertising platforms, plus a policy response to the CKM report before the Christmas recess.
There is no decision that no capacity will be deployed in any case for the investigation of customers of human trafficking.
Er is geen besluit dat er sowieso geen capaciteit wordt ingezet voor de opsporing van klanten van mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer en Krul over het schrappen van de subsidie op het godsdienstig onderwijs of levensbeschouwelijk vormingsonderwijs

MPs Ceder, Stoffer and Krul asked why the government plans to end the subsidy for religious and life-stance formation education and whether this conflicts with the statutory basis and with pupils' access to such education. The State Secretary answered that about 50,000 pupils receive it, that the subsidy ends from 2027 via a legislative proposal, and that schools' civic and worldview curriculum will cover the needs, but did not expect equal access and gave only partial answers on consultation with parents.
For the termination of the subsidy, a proposal for a legislative amendment will be made.
Voor de beëindiging van de subsidie wordt een voorstel tot wetswijziging gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht «Einde aan diensttijd voor de maatschappij»

MP Krul (CDA) asked the government to confirm reports that the Maatschappelijke Diensttijd programme is being ended, contesting its cost versus its value to youth, and asked about consultation, budget phasing, and participation figures. The state secretary confirmed the OCW subsidy of 200 million euros is being cut as part of budget savings, said a careful phase-out with partners is planned, and supplied participation numbers for 2024 and 2025.
In the run-up to the OCW budget debate, I will inform your House further on how we are organising the process for safeguarding and sustaining MDT.
In aanloop naar de begrotingsbehandeling van OCW zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren over hoe we het proces rondom de borging en verduurzaming van MDT inrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Krul, Stultiens, Kostić en Beckerman over het bericht 'Juristen: regeerprogramma op meerdere punten niet rechtsstatelijk'

Five MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how he views a legal commission's finding that cutting higher-education funding agreements unilaterally breaches the rule-of-law principle of a reliable government, and whether he would share the internal advice and memos behind the coalition programme before a committee debate. The minister rejects the commission's view, says the budget legislature sets annual funding and the agreement is not the legal basis, and refuses to share internal advice and memos under the principle of cabinet unity.
I am not, because the cabinet does not share internal advice and memos relating to the drafting of the coalition programme, on the basis of cabinet unity.
Dat ben ik niet, omdat het kabinet geen ambtelijke adviezen en nota’s deelt die zien op het opstellen van het Regeerprogramma, op grond van eenheid kabinetsbeleid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Als model gelokt, voor de camera misbruikt’

The CDA MP Krul asked the Justice Minister about a Volkskrant report that a recruiter brought hundreds of Eastern European women into illegal porn and prostitution over 20 years without prosecution, and why an earlier government exploration found no signs of abuse in the Dutch porn industry. The minister said signals of trafficking are always followed up by police and prosecutors, declined to comment on individual cases, explained the limits of the earlier exploration, and committed to a WODC study into abuses in the Dutch porn industry.
However, it is not possible for me as Minister to respond to specific questions concerning information about individual criminal cases.
Het is voor mij als Minister echter niet mogelijk om in te gaan op specifieke vragen die zien op informatie over individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Krul over het toezicht op webwinkels als Temu, AliExpres en Shein

MPs Inge van Dijk and Krul asked the ministers about oversight of Temu, Shein and AliExpress, covering unfair trade practices, dark patterns, product safety, privacy, Chinese ties and BNPL promotion. The minister answered that existing EU and Dutch rules and the ACM, NVWA and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are responsible, pointed to pending EU initiatives such as the fitness check, DSA and product safety regulation, and declined to order investigations or disclose details of internal app measures.
Because of this confidentiality, I cannot go further into these measures.
Door deze vertrouwelijkheid kan ik dan ook niet verder ingaan op deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Groeiende groep mensen kijkt naar seksueel misbruik van minderjarigen, ook jongeren ‘voor de kick’

An MP asked the Justice Minister and the Education State Secretary about reports that minors share child sexual abuse material casually, asking about encryption, prevention, awareness, support for investigators and trends. The government answered by pointing to its enforcement and prevention measures, the EU CSAM regulation and HLG work, education efforts, and existing psychological support, while noting that end-to-end encryption limits investigators' access to message content.

The cabinet is committed to effectively combating child sexual abuse imagery, but restrictions on fundamental rights will only take place when strictly necessary and proportionate, and surrounded by adequate safeguards.

Het kabinet zet zich ervoor in dat beeldmateriaal van seksueel kindermisbruik effectief kan worden bestreden, maar dat inperking van grondrechten alleen plaatsvindt wanneer dit strikt noodzakelijk en proportioneel is, en omkleed met passende waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het item in Nieuwsuur "Hoe schoolbestuurders zakendoen met bekenden en zichzelf"

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Education about a Nieuwsuur report on school board members doing business with acquaintances and themselves, including the growth of education consultancy firms financed from public funds, the lack of transparency on spending, and whether intern toezicht and the Inspectorate should get more powers. The State Secretary acknowledged that conflicts of interest are unacceptable, pointed to existing rules and the Inspectorate's role, said spending is not separately reported, and announced a bill with stricter integrity requirements and expanded Inspectorate oversight, with an internet consultation planned for end of December.

With this bill I intend, among other things, to give a further and non-voluntary impulse to the professionalisation of education boards, and more direction will be given to internal supervision about what is expected.

Met dit wetsvoorstel wil ik onder meer de professionalisering van onderwijsbesturen een nadere en niet-vrijblijvende impuls geven en wordt er meer richting gegeven aan het intern toezicht over wat er wordt verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Als de politie alle Amsterdamse taxi’s aan de kant zet, dan heb je de grootste drugsvangst ooit’

MPs Krul and Boswijk asked the ministers about a report that police could seize large drug shipments if they stopped Amsterdam taxis, and about criminality in the taxi sector, vetting, enforcement and possible law changes. The minister answered that police do monitor taxi-linked crime through checks and investigations, that vetting and licensing rules apply, and that the sector's criminality will be addressed through partner-based measures and a review of the Wp2000 without committing to a specific legal change.
The Wp2000 is intended to safeguard the quality of taxi transport in the Netherlands.
De Wp2000 is bedoeld om de kwaliteit van het taxivervoer in Nederland te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Jonge huisartsen springen in gat dat Co-Med achterlaat, maar worden tegengewerkt door curator’

An MP asked the Minister of Health why the bankruptcy curator of Co-Med allegedly blocks young GPs from taking over practices by charging for patient files and withholding access. The Minister answers that IGJ has imposed enforcement to secure file access, that the curator must follow the KNMG handover guideline, that goodwill payments for practice takeovers are a matter between curator and buyer, and that the ministry will act if the supervisors identify a role for VWS.
I am kept informed by the supervisory authorities NZa and IGJ of all developments regarding the handling of the bankruptcy.
Ik word door de toezichthouders NZa en IGJ op de hoogte gehouden van alle ontwikkelingen rondom de afwikkeling van het faillissement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Eén op twintig ouderen wordt mishandeld: We zien het topje van de ijsberg’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that one in twenty elderly people are abused, the taboo and low reporting to Veilig Thuis, campaigns, the information box on financial abuse, police and prosecution data, and bank and notary cooperation. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging the problem and taboo, citing the 2018 prevalence study, describing campaigns and alliances, and committing to explore a new prevalence study and an updated information box, while saying some data (police, prosecution, professional misconduct) is not registered.
At national level, Veilig Thuis has no insight into who reports which form of domestic violence.
Op landelijk niveau is er bij Veilig Thuis geen zicht op wie welke vorm van huiselijk geweld meldt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over de Nieuwsuur-uitzending over de zorgen van plastische chirurgen betreffendebekwaamheid van cosmetische artsen

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about surgeons' concerns over the competence of cosmetic doctors and why the sector has not agreed competence requirements after three years. The minister answered that the sector is responsible, pointed to the Zorginstituut's quality framework and possible future intervention, and said she will consider asking the Zorginstituut to act if the sector fails to resolve the impasse within a year.

Should the sector fail to break the impasse over competence requirements within a year, and if intervention based on IGJ reports appears proportionate, I will consider asking the Zorginstituut to place the subject of competence requirements for cosmetic care on its multi-year agenda.

Mocht de sector er niet in slagen om binnen een jaar de impasse rond de bekwaamheidseisen in de cosmetische sector te doorbreken, en mocht op basis van de meldingen bij de IGJ ingrijpen proportioneel lijken, dan zal ik overwegen om het Zorginstituut te verzoeken het onderwerp bekwaamheidseisen cosmetische zorg op de Meerjarenagenda te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Krul en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Minstens 172 mensen overleden door het innemen van zelfdodingspoeder middel X’

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and BBB asked the government how it will protect vulnerable people from suicide powder Middel X, given a study finding at least 172 deaths and 70% with a psychiatric history, and why the substance is not banned. The minister says access is limited via an industry code, that a ban is legally complicated and of limited effect, and that additional forensic powers and follow-up research are planned.
A change to the Burial and Cremation Act is currently being prepared, giving forensic physicians more powers to conduct further investigation.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een wijziging van de Wet op de lijkbezorging (Wlb), waarbij de forensisch arts meer bevoegdheden krijgt om nader onderzoek te doen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over het bericht 'Zijn rechtszaken over misbruik straks niet meer openbaar?'

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked whether victims of sexual offences, including minors, can have criminal hearings held behind closed doors, and whether the rules should be extended in light of a Belgian proposal. The minister confirmed judges may order closed-door hearings on request, that no figures exist on how often this is granted, and that existing rules suffice, so no change is planned.
Neither the Public Prosecution Service nor the judiciary has figures available on the number of granted requests.
Zowel bij het Openbaar Ministerie als bij de rechterlijke macht zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal toegewezen verzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Huisartsenpraktijk in Anna Paulowna al drie weken dicht: 45 meldingen bij inspectie’

An MP asked the minister about the sudden, prolonged closure of a GP practice in Anna Paulowna, the duties of practices toward patients, the insurer's role, and the inspectorate's order to Co-Med, including whether Co-Med should keep taking over practices. The minister answered that continuity of care is paramount, that patients were informed and can use another location, that the NZa and insurer VGZ are monitoring and seeking alternatives, and that a power to temporarily block takeovers will be detailed and sent to parliament soon.
For that reason the IGJ has issued Co-Med a directive.
Om die reden heeft de IGJ Co-Med een aanwijzing gegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Boon over de berichten 'Staatssecretaris: begrip voor uitstel concerten Israëlische groep' en 'Driehoek wist niets van het besluit over afgelastin

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary for culture how the government will ensure artists can perform safely regardless of origin, and why she showed understanding for Het Concertgebouw cancelling Jerusalem Quartet concerts without consulting the local security triangle. The answers say the cancellation was a security-based decision by the venue, that the state secretary understood it as an exception, that a general guidance document is being prepared with the sector, and that a concert date is being sought.
However, Het Concertgebouw itself made the decision to cancel this concert before advice had been given by the security triangle.
Het Concertgebouw heeft echter zelf de beslissing genomen om dit concert af te gelasten voordat er een advies vanuit de driehoek was gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Inge van Dijk en Krul over dat in New Towns als Almere “het sociale cement het stenen cement nauwelijks kan bijbenen”

CDA MPs asked the government to respond to a report on social resilience in Almere and to reflect on how New Town problems such as debt, loneliness, teacher shortages and youth crime relate to rapid growth and national financing, and what action is needed. The minister replied that the report was commissioned by Almere and that the government points to existing programmes (NPLV, GALA, IZA, regional deals) and will await a broader WijkWijzer study before reflecting further.
For a reflection on the problems in the New Towns, the results of that study will be awaited.
Voor een reflectie op de problematiek in de New Towns, worden de resultaten van dat onderzoek afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Daniëlle Jansen en Krul over het evenement ‘Navigating Nicotine Regulation: Insights from Sweden’

Two MPs asked the ministers about a Business Sweden event in Parliament on nicotine regulation, with speakers linked to the tobacco and nicotine industry, and whether it breaches FCTC Article 5.3. The State Secretary opposed the event, said Dutch snus and nicotine pouch policy will be maintained, but stated that the House itself is responsible for its contacts with the tobacco industry.
I trust that members of the House will hold each other to account when there is contact with the tobacco industry.
Ik vertrouw erop dat Kamerleden elkaar aanspreken wanneer sprake is van contact met de tabaksindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Jansen over het bericht 'Coffeeshops Tilburg en Breda mogen meer legale cannabisvoorraad in huis hebben: ‘genoeg voor een week’'

Four MPs asked whether the government had decided to raise the legal cannabis stock limit for coffeeshops in Tilburg and Breda beyond one week's supply, and why parliament learned of it only through the media. The minister replied that the 500-gram local limit was dropped after burgemeesters found it unworkable, that the change was previously announced in parliament, and that police and prosecutors raised no objections though they suggested a fixed weight.
Question 3: Why must the House learn from the media that the government is dropping a uniform norm altogether
Vraag 3 Waarom moet de Kamer in de media vernemen dat de regering een uniforme norm in het geheel loslaat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Adrz verrast vriend en vijand met sluiting poliklinieken in Zierikzee; college stuurt brief op poten’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the planned closure of the Admiraal de Ruyter hospital's outpatient clinics in Zierikzee, its effects on access to care on Schouwen-Duiveland, and what the government would do. The Minister answered that the hospital decides on its own services within legal frameworks, that care will be relocated to Goes and Vlissingen over six months, and that regional integrated care plans and talks with the municipality continue.
The Adrz is responsible for providing good-quality care.
Het Adrz is verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van zorg van goede kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over de dalende vaccinatiegraad onder jonge kinderen

An MP asked the state secretary about the falling childhood vaccination rate, its risks, and whether government information and campaigns can reverse it. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to ten planned actions and a promised update before the summer recess, and stressed the role of doctors and local tailoring.
I will inform the House before the summer about progress on the ten actions initiated.
Ik informeer uw Kamer voor de zomer over de voortgang op de tien ingezette acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over de uitzending van Radar d.d. 11 maart 2024 over te dure gehoorapparaten

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Medical Care how she views a Radar broadcast on overpriced hearing aids sold by commercial hearing shops, the failure of parties to honour the 2017 consensus on hearing care, what can be done to ensure correct advice, and whether the lack of quality supervision of audiologists will be addressed. The Minister said the situation is undesirable, pointed to the Zorginstituut's improvement signal and self-regulation in the sector, said the IGJ does not supervise audiology care, and said further supervision will be examined together with the Zorginstituut and IGJ, without a separate meeting with insurers.
I therefore think it is important that the parties involved actively get to work on these actions.
Ik vind het daarom belangrijk dat de betrokken partijen actief met deze acties aan de slag gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het artikel 'Toename commerciële verpleeghuizen zorgelijk'

An MP asked the health minister about the growth of commercial nursing homes and whether medical care there is adequately regulated, including GP access, hospital admissions and inspection oversight. The minister saw the growth as meeting demand, said the care is generally delivered by GPs, pointed to coordination agreements and programmes, and said the inspectorate applies no distinction between commercial and other homes.
Within the Wlz it is registered which form of care clients use, but it is not registered what legal form the providing institution has, and it is not known whether these are commercial institutions.
Binnen de Wlz wordt geregistreerd van welke leveringsvorm cliënten gebruik maken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het tekort aan medische hulpmiddelen in de thuiszorg

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about shortages and administrative burdens in obtaining medical aids in home care, and about the implementation of a parliamentary motion and the NZa's deadlines. The minister acknowledged the problems, described steps taken with insurers and the Kwaliteitsraad, and said he would explore legal measures if parties fail to find a solution.
If parties fail to find a satisfactory solution for patients and care providers, I am willing to explore legal measures.
Mochten partijen er niet in slagen een voor patiënten en zorgverleners bevredigende oplossing te vinden, dan ben ik bereid wettelijke maatregelen te verkennen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Miljoenen drugsadvertenties op Telegram, platform laat handel ongemoeid’ en het bericht ‘Telegramdealers: 'De straten hebben rust, zoals jullie wilden'

MP Krul (CDA) asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that drug dealers openly advertise and operate on Telegram, and about Telegram's failure to cooperate with police and prosecutors and whether it can be compelled or blocked. The minister answered that Telegram's cooperation is lacking, that Telegram has no Dutch or EU establishment (it has a legal representative in Belgium under the DSA), that blocking channels is only possible in limited cases and depends on Telegram's cooperation, and that enforcement options and DSA oversight are being developed, with the DSA implementing law to follow later.
I will inform the House in a subsequent progress letter about the concrete proposals to better enforce the sale of drugs via online channels.
Ik zal uw Kamer in een volgende voortgangsbrief nader informeren over de concrete voorstellen om beter te kunnen handhaven op de verkoop van drugs via online kanalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Gemeenteraad Baarn wil spoedberaad over Paleis Soestdijk nadat Raad van State het bestemmingsplan voor het landgoed vernietigde’

An MP (Krul, CDA) asked the Interior Minister, after the Council of State annulled the zoning plan for the Paleis Soestdijk estate, about the consequences, the burden on Baarn municipality and whether the national government would provide financial or staff support. The minister answered that the plan reverts to the 2009 rural-area plan, that the owner and Baarn must decide next steps, and that additional funding or staff support is not appropriate because municipalities are expected to handle such files.
Additional funding and/or staff support is not an option.
Aanvullende bekostiging en/of personele ondersteuning is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Toekomst studie Fries zorgelijk: 'Zo snel mogelijk fulltime professor nodig'’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a report that academic Frisian studies need a full-time professor, the KNAW advice, the restructuring into a track, and the Council of Europe charter obligations. The minister agreed to structurally fund EUR 340,000 for academic Frisian, will explore a bachelor programme with the RUG, and plans a covenant with the institution to meet the parliamentary motion.
As regards Frisian at university level, which the KNAW report's recommendations target, I am willing to structurally make EUR 340,000 available in line with the amendment.

Voor wat betreft het Fries op universitair niveau, waar de aanbevelingen in het KNAW-rapport op gericht zijn, ben ik bereid om hiervoor conform het amendement € 340.000 structureel beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Brink, Krul en Inge van Dijk over het niet doorgaan van amateur wielrenwedstrijden

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers why amateur cycling races are being cancelled because police motorcycle escorts are unavailable, and whether volunteer civilian motorcyclists could be deployed, including via a pilot and changes to traffic rules. The minister answered that a study by Antea Group is underway with results expected in summer 2024, that a temporary experiment would need a legal amendment and AMvB taking about a year, and that changing traffic rules awaits the study's outcome.
I expect the results of the above-mentioned study in the summer of 2024.
De uitkomsten van het bovengenoemde onderzoek verwacht ik in de zomer van 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Peters over de dreigende financiële dreun aan het openbaar vervoer in de regio

MPs Krul and Peters asked about a projected cut of about 260 million euros to student public transport budgets, arguing the 2021-2022 base year was unrepresentative due to COVID. The minister answered that the recalibration uses the 2022-2023 measurement period, that the freed-up funds (about 207.5 million) will be used once in 2024 to support public transport, and that a 2025 recalibration is proposed.
I therefore do not share the view that this recalibration study is not representative.
Ik deel daarom niet het standpunt dat dit herijkingsonderzoek niet representatief zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Boswijk over de brief van Eurocommissaris Thierry Breton aan Elon Musk over de desinformatie op X (voormalig Twitter)

MPs Krul and Boswijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about EU Commissioner Breton's letter to Elon Musk on disinformation and illegal content on X after the Hamas attacks, and what the government would do. The government answered that DSA enforcement over X rests with the European Commission, that it supports the Commission, and that X's content policy and transparency are unclear, with X having withdrawn from the EU disinformation Code of Practice.
Primary responsibility for DSA supervision of X lies with the European Commission.
Het primaat van het DSA-toezicht op X ligt bij de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het artikel 'Russische familie? Dan wordt een baan bij defensie heel lastig'

MP Krul (CDA) asked the Defence Minister whether security clearances (VGB) were refused or withdrawn for Defence staff because of Russian family ties, and whether this is consistent with earlier answers and external risk assessments. The minister answered that no specific policy targets staff with Russian ties, that each clearance is case-by-case under the Security Screening Act, declined to comment on individual cases, and rejected compensation or review, pointing to the objection and appeal procedure.
I cannot make any statements about individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek kan ik geen uitspraken doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over de berichten 'Acht maanden' totale ellende' op A7' en 'Zo'n verkeersinfarct kun je gebied echt niet aandoen'' en 'Je kunt brug ook aan onderzijde verstevigen'; verkeer Transportbe

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about newspaper reports on months of traffic disruption from renovating the A7 viaduct near Purmerend, including the weight restriction, alternative repair from below, and mitigation plans. The Minister answered at length, describing mitigation measures, consultations with stakeholders, and why the below-deck repair option was rejected on technical and lifespan grounds.
Rijkswaterstaat will carry out the following actions in the coming period: theoretical modelling of traffic disruption and impact analysis for the entire Noord-Holland traffic network.
Rijkswaterstaat voert de komende periode de volgende acties uit: – Theoretische modellering verkeershinder/impactanalyse voor het volledige verkeersnetwerk van Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Ondernemers desnoods naar rechter om Kooybrug open te houden. 'We voelen ons in de kou staan''

MPs Krul and Koerhuis asked the minister about the planned closure of the Kooybrug, traffic safety, the absence of a temporary bridge, compensation for affected businesses, and coordination with ProRail. The minister answered that the renovation is postponed and will be rescheduled, that detour routes and incident scenarios exist, that compensation under the general regulation applies, and that Rijkswaterstaat will stay in close contact with the region, though many answers give no concrete timeline.
At this moment nothing can yet be said about the expected duration of the closure.
Op dit moment kan er nog niets gezegd worden over de verwachte duur van de afsluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Kuik over begeleiding van probleemjongeren door de krijgsmacht

CDA MPs Krul and Kuik asked whether the Landmacht's BBJ-KL programme for at-risk youth, with 240 participants and 28 becoming soldiers, is successful, and whether it should be improved, expanded, linked to Justice's Preventie met Gezag, or combined with work and education. The State Secretary for Defence answered that the programme is not a core Defence task but is partly successful (136 returned to school or work), that expansion is capped at 200 youths a year with no added staff, that municipalities can refer youths, and that cooperation with Justice is being considered while broader goals are rejected.
Municipalities can refer youths to this guidance programme.
Gemeenten kunnen jongeren voordragen voor dit begeleidingstraject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Treinen rijden weer na ochtend vol chaos en onduidelijkheid: 'We hebben drie uur moeten wachten''

MP Krul (CDA) asked the state secretary about chaos and poor information for rail passengers in Zeeland on 18 September 2023, when delayed engineering work and too few replacement buses left travellers waiting for hours. The state secretary acknowledged the hindrance, said NS and ProRail were asked to reflect and report and that an evaluation of the earlier Amsterdam Centraal incident would be shared with parliament, but did not commit to new structural measures.
After the external validation of the evaluation, I will share it with your House.
Na de externe validatie van de evaluatie zal ik deze met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Lobby voor veilige N35 bij Enschede strandt: Minister pakt weg voorlopig niet aan’

Mr Krul (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the lack of planned safety upgrades on a stretch of the N35 near Enschede with frequent accidents, and about the consistency of prioritising traffic safety against nitrogen and budget constraints. The minister replied that the stretch was not prioritised within the 200 million euro traffic safety budget, that no new investment is possible under the demissionary cabinet, and that the nitrogen-linked Mariënheem bypass and a motion on restoring trust are still being explored with the province.
At this moment new investments are not on the agenda and therefore this bottleneck cannot be addressed.
Op dit moment zijn nieuwe investeringen niet aan de orde en daarom kan dit knelpunt niet worden aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Bontenbal over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de regels rond verlichting van windmolens

Two CDA MPs asked about the status of ILT approval for proximity detection to switch wind turbine obstacle lighting, notably for the Wieringermeer park, and about funding and provincial frameworks for retrofitting existing turbines. The minister replied that the ILT assessment is ongoing without a date, that new parks' costs are built into SDE++ rates, that a one-off 60/20/20 cost split with provinces is being prepared for a specific grant expected in autumn 2023, and that provinces are developing their own frameworks on individual timelines.
It is not possible during the assessment process of the application to state when the ILT will decide on its approval.
Het is niet mogelijk om gedurende het beoordelingsproces van de aanvraag een uitspraak te doen over het moment waarop besloten wordt over de instemming door de ILT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘'165.000 vrachtwagens niet toegestaan in zero-emissiezone; RDW stuurt brief

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary why RDW letters to truck operators on zero-emission zones omitted any reference to exemptions, causing unrest, and asked about the status of a national exemption desk. The state secretary acknowledged the omission, said national exemptions were published in the Staatscourant, and committed to including exemption information in future letters and sharing final decisions with the sector.
This could have removed unrest among the recipients of the letter.
Dit had onrust bij de ontvangers van de brief kunnen wegnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Krul over de openstelling van de Afsluitdijk voor fietsers en wandelaars

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the temporary opening of the Afsluitdijk to cyclists and walkers in July 2023, its success, and the possibility of another opening. The government confirmed the high usage and described preparations, and said that from 2024 cycling and walking will be possible over most of the dike but refused a full reopening.
However, the Afsluitdijk will be largely accessible from 2024 as I described in my answer to question 4.
Wel zal de afsluitdijk grotendeels toegankelijk zijn vanaf 2024 zoals ik heb beschreven in mijn antwoord op vraag 4.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het artikel “Overleden bestuurder uit Zwaag zoveelste slachtoffer op de N247, automobilisten rijden te hard en halen in waar het niet mag: ’Hoeveel doden moeten er nog vallen?’”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about fatal crashes on provincial road N247 and proposed local safety measures. The minister answered that the road is provincial and primarily the responsibility of the road manager, while pointing to national support programmes for road safety.
The N247 is a provincial N-road. It is therefore not under the management of the national government.
De N247 is een provinciale N-weg. Daarmee is deze niet in het beheer van het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Provincie: 'Wijzig wet om nieuw Zeeuws OV-systeem mogelijk te maken''

MPs Krul and Van den Berg asked the state secretary about a provincial call to amend the Wet personenvervoer 2000 to allow an innovative Zeeland public transport system, and about financial support, further legal changes, and a right to tailored exemptions. The state secretary supports the initiative, says a review of whether the transport law needs amending will be completed by year-end, and states that no legal changes or funding have yet been decided.
By the end of this year I will complete an exploration of the need to amend the Wet personenvervoer 2000 or lower regulations.
Eind dit jaar rond ik een verkenning af naar de noodzaak om de Wet personenvervoer 2000 of lagere regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Krul en Boswijk over de beveiliging van luchthaven Schiphol

Three CDA MPs asked ministers how Schiphol's access controls fail when former staff keep passes, uniforms and radios, and who is responsible for fixing this. The government calls the situation unacceptable, says Royal Schiphol Group and employers hold responsibility, and lists audits, sanctions and an automatic alarm as steps taken.
Royal Schiphol Group further intensifies supervision of correct implementation by carrying out random audits of employers.
Royal Schiphol Group intensiveert verder het toezicht op de correcte uitvoering door steekproefsgewijs audits uit te voeren op werkgevers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over de wervingscampagne van Defensie

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked the Defence Minister about a recruitment campaign for Ukrainian- and Russian-speaking staff and about security clearance (VGB) policy for personnel with Russian ties. The minister confirmed the operational need for language skills, said there is no policy excluding people with Russian ties, and explained the general criteria and reporting duties for security clearances.
No, Defence does not pursue such a policy.
Nee, Defensie voert een dergelijk beleid niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Kuik over het bericht 'Nieuwe Gerrit Krolbrug minimaal een jaar vertraagd, gemeente stuurt brandbrief naar minister'

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the reported one-year-plus delay to the new Gerrit Krol bridge in Groningen, the lack of a temporary crossing over the Van Starkenborgh canal, and related public trust, traffic and stikstof risks. The minister acknowledged the delay (opening pushed to 2029 at the latest), said a temporary crossing is expected by end 2023 after technical setbacks, and committed to a joint working group with residents and the municipality.
The expected opening of the new bridge now shifts unfortunately from 2026 to 2029 at the latest.
De verwachte openstelling van de nieuwe brug verschuift nu helaas van 2026 naar uiterlijk 2029.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Boswijk en Krul over het bericht 'Nieuw probleem bij zoeken opvangplekken: ‘Dassen blokkeren opvang 800 asielzoekers’'

CDA MPs asked whether the government will act urgently to grant general exemptions under the Nature Protection Act so badgers blocking reception locations for 800 asylum seekers can be removed. The minister answered that exemptions are case-specific, the province is the competent authority, a general exemption is being explored with care, and ProRail has a code since January 2023.
As indicated, the province is the competent authority under the Nature Protection Act and it is up to the province to make that assessment.
Zoals aangegeven is de provincie bevoegd gezag op grond van de Wnb en is het het aan de provincie om die afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Krul over het bericht ‘Laat KLM zich aan de afspraken over miljarden aan coronasteun houden’

MPs Slootweg and Krul asked whether the government will enforce KLM's compliance with corona aid conditions, including legal action, use of the 2 billion NOW aid and tax deferral, and pressure via the shareholder Air France-KLM. Minister Kaag answered that the contract could not be terminated for partial non-compliance, litigation was judged uncertain, generic measures cannot be used as leverage, and the government will assess compliance and consider further steps.
The cabinet will use its shareholder powers to keep questioning and assessing KLM's board and supervisory board on this matter.
Het kabinet zal zijn aandeelhoudersbevoegdheden inzetten om het bestuur van KLM en de raad van commissarissen hierover te blijven bevragen en te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Transportsector vreest verkeersinfarct nu ook stuk N9 wordt afgesloten voor zwaar verkeer: ’Waarom zoveel wegen tegelijk dicht?’'

MP Krul (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why many roads are closed at once, including an axle-load restriction on the N9 after cracks were found in a culvert, and about duration, mitigation, traffic safety and cyclist safety. The minister answered that this is an emergency, not planned works, that the duration is not yet known, and that Rijkswaterstaat is monitoring traffic with the municipality of Alkmaar and will take extra measures if needed.
Currently it is still being investigated what is needed to repair the culvert under the N9 and how long the work will take, so unfortunately the answer to the question is not yet available.
Momenteel wordt nog onderzocht wat er voor nodig is om de duiker onder de N9 te herstellen en hoe lang de werkzaamheden gaan duren, dus het antwoord op de vraag is helaas nog niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Hollands Kroon roept Minister op regels rond verlichting windmolens per 2024 aan te passen'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about aviation obstacle lighting on wind turbines, its nuisance, and why the needed regulation is tied to the Environment and Planning Act. The Minister answered that new rules will be set in the wind turbine provisions, that approval-based proximity detection is already possible, and that a stepwise action plan and coordination with the municipality will follow.
Work is being done to anchor this process in formal regulation under the Environment and Planning Act and its implementing decrees as quickly as possible.
Er wordt aan gewerkt om dit proces zo snel als mogelijk in formele regelgeving te verankeren onder de Omgevingswet en de bijbehorende uitvoeringsbesluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Krul over het bericht 'Gratis reizen met ov heel eenvoudig: betaling met OVpay te omzeilen'

MPs Minhas and Krul asked the state secretary about a report that OVpay contactless payment on public transport can be circumvented by fraudulently using disposable digital cards. The state secretary acknowledged the fraud scenario was known, described monitoring and bank sanctions, and stated no significant increase had been detected, with no new structural measures planned.
Following the RTL publication, no worrying increase in this type of fraud cases has been observed.
Er is, naar aanleiding van de RTL-publicatie, geen zorgwekkende toename geconstateerd van dit soort fraudegevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over PFAS-besmetting op verschillende kusten in Jutland en Zeeland

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of PFAS contamination on Danish and Zeeland coasts, including whether grass sampling, monitoring of grazing animals and consultation with farmers should be part of the Dutch approach. The State Secretary answered that PFAS monitoring already occurs where there are signs of high concentrations, that further grass sampling adds little value now, and that consultation with farmers will take place when further investigation is needed.
Given the many measurements in soil, water and biota that already take place and are analysed, there is little added value in now adding a specific analysis of grass samples to the work programme.

Gegeven de veelheid aan metingen in bodem, water en biota die nu al plaatsvinden en geanalyseerd worden, is er weinig meerwaarde om nu een specifieke analyse van grasmonsters toe te voegen aan het werkprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het artikel ‘Het geld is op, en dus verliest dit dorp twee derde van zijn bruggen: ‘Alsof we er hier niet toe doen’’

MP Krul (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the loss of bridges in Pekela due to municipal budget shortfalls, asking whether the Rijk can help finance maintenance, whether it has a moral duty, and how cost-benefit analysis should be treated. The minister answered that the canal falls under municipal responsibility with no Rijk financing option, pointed to the Gemeentefonds distribution model, and said a parliamentary motion on MKBA will be taken into account in revising the guidance.
The Pekelerhoofddiep falls under the municipality and Rijkswaterstaat or the Ministry of IenW has no role there.
Het Pekelerhoofddiep valt onder de gemeente en daar heeft Rijkswaterstaat of het Ministerie van IenW geen rol bij.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Amhaouch over de berichten 'Wat moet je met dassen onder het spoor? 'Uitgraven en weghalen'' en het bericht 'Dassen verlammen Brabants treinverkeer nog zeker drie weken'

CDA MPs Krul and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about news reports on badger burrows disrupting rail traffic between Den Bosch and Boxtel, and asked whether ProRail should get a generic exemption to remove badger setts and whether burrow removal should be the policy. The State Secretary answered that ProRail needs a per-location exemption from the competent authority (RVO), that a generic exemption and an evaluation with the ministries are being explored, and that ProRail now has a code of conduct for monitoring and early action.
Following the problems in Molkwerum and Esch, the Ministry of IenW, ProRail, the Ministry of LNV and RVO will evaluate how it came to the point that no trains could run.

Het Ministerie van IenW, ProRail, het Ministerie van LNV en RVO gaan naar aanleiding van de problemen in Molkwerum en Esch evalueren hoe het zo ver heeft kunnen komen dat er geen treinen meer konden rijden.
Antwoorden op vragen die de leden Krul en Amhaouch over het helpen van ons MKB bij de omschakeling naar onderhoudsprojecten.

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the government will halt road and rail construction due to nitrogen, inflation and labour shortages, and what this means for infrastructure SMEs and public transport and road safety. The minister confirmed a shift from new construction to maintenance on the national road and waterway networks, said affected projects are not yet identified, and promised updates before the July MIRT debate.
Since it is currently not known which projects are involved, it is also not possible at this time to reflect on the impact per project.
Gezien het momenteel niet bekend is om welke projecten het gaat, is het op dit moment ook niet mogelijk te reflecteren op de impact per project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Peters over het bericht 'MBO-scholen helemaal klaar met stakingen in streekvervoer: 'Sommige klassen zitten maar halfvol'

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers how MBO students were affected by regional transport strikes, what steps schools and the government would take, and whether the social partners should be urged to resume talks. The minister acknowledged the impact, noted that a collective agreement was reached on 7 April ending the strikes, and said further measures are no longer needed.
I therefore cannot state in general terms what the impact of regional transport strikes on education is.
Ik kan daarom niet in algemene zin aangeven wat de invloed is van stakingen in het streekvervoer op het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Zorgen en ergernis na wéér een afsluiting van Vlaketunnel'

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the repeated closure of the Vlaketunnel after an intercom fault, the options Rijkswaterstaat has, why the tunnel was not kept open at reduced speed, and how Zeeland's accessibility will be protected during planned maintenance. The minister answers that closure was necessary for safety during testing, that a speed limit and inspection were used until then, and that mitigation measures and regional coordination are planned for autumn maintenance.
Given the circumstances and for the safety of road users and workers, closing the tunnel was however necessary.
Gezien de omstandigheden en omwille van de veiligheid van weggebruikers en werknemers was afsluiting van de tunnel echter noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Krul en Grinwis over het bericht 'Ministerie betaalde al 15.000 euro aan actiegroep Lelystad Airport: ‘Dit is van de zotte’

Three MPs (Boswijk, Krul, Grinwis) asked why the government pays penalty payments rather than fulfilling a Woo freedom-of-information request from Stichting Laagvliegen, whether aviation emissions above 3,000 feet must be reported under the NEC directive, what sanctions apply for incomplete reporting, and how that affects the nitrogen approach. The minister acknowledges delay and agrees phased publication, says the NEC reporting is not legally binding but commits to including above-3,000-foot emissions from 2024, and maintains that the nitrogen contribution of aviation is about 0.01%.
I regret that it took longer than the applicable statutory deadlines, as a result of which a penalty payment was imposed.
Ik betreur het dat het langer heeft geduurd dan de daarvoor geldende wettelijke termijnen, waardoor er een dwangsom is opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Van den Berg over de afsluiting van de Heinenoordtunnel en de Haringvlietbrug

MPs Krul and Van den Berg asked the minister how a motion on a traffic-overflow plan and emergency-service access for the Heinenoordtunnel and Haringvlietbrug closures would be carried out, and what is planned for acute care access. The minister answered that a plan with traffic diversions, extra ambulances and fire services, a temporary ferry and possible helicopter use has been drawn up, and committed to further consultation and to informing parliament by June.
Consultation on implementing the motion in general terms is ongoing with the Ministry of VWS, and your House will be informed by June of this year at the latest.
Over de uitvoering van de motie in algemene zin is overleg gaande met het Ministerie van VWS en uw Kamer zal uiterlijk in juni van dit jaar worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en De Hoop over het bericht 'Krakkemikkige boogbrug over het Julianakanaal wordt ineens niet meer vervangen: Itteren houdt zijn hart vast'

MPs Krul and De Hoop asked the minister why the Itteren bridge over the Julianakanaal will be renovated instead of replaced, the timeline, consultation with the Itteren village council, traffic and noise effects, shipping implications, and the stance on the Maastricht council's letter. The minister answered that replacement costs had more than doubled so renovation was chosen within budget, outlined a consultation process with a target decision in 2024, and said inspections show no short-term safety problem.

In the second quarter of 2023 Rijkswaterstaat will consult the municipality of Maastricht, the Itteren village council and other local parties on the precise scope of the renovation of the Itteren bridge.

In het tweede kwartaal van 2023 zal Rijkswaterstaat in gesprek gaan met gemeente Maastricht, de dorpsraad Itteren en andere omgevingspartijen over de precieze invulling van de renovatie van brug Itteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over duidelijkheid over de toekomst van vuurtoren Lange Jaap

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management for a timeline of the investigations into the Lange Jaap lighthouse and whether the findings would be shared with parliament, and asked for a decision before year-end. The minister promised to send three reports (foundation, access route, crack inspection) by end of Q1 2023 and expects clarity on future scenarios by end of 2023, while committing to speed without compromising care.
Yes, the above three reports will be sent separately to the House as soon as they are final.
Ja, bovenstaande drie rapporten zullen separaat aan de Kamer worden toegezonden zodra deze definitief zijn.

m: Motie van het lid Beckerman c.s. over een jaar na inwerkingtreding van de Wet onderwijsondersteuning zieke leerlingen komen met een monitoringsrapportage en een tevredenheidsonderzoek
Asks the government to deliver a monitoring report one year after the Wet onderwijsondersteuning zieke leerlingen takes effect, with a satisfaction survey of pupils, parents and staff.
requests the government to come with a monitoring report one year after entry into force
verzoekt de regering om een jaar na de inwerkingtreding met een monitoringsrapportage te komen

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Bushoff en Armut over de gezondheid van scholieren na één van de zwaarste aardbevingen in Groningen

MPs Beckerman, Bushoff and Armut asked the State Secretary for the Interior about a report on the effects of gas-extraction earthquakes on Groningen schoolchildren's health, the pace of reinforcement and damage repair, restoring trust in government, mental health support, youth participation, and long-term monitoring. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to the school reinforcement programme, the Social Agenda, the equalisation of immaterial damage compensation for children, participatory youth projects and longitudinal research, while committing to further information in January 2026.
That is why I consider projects such as 'Lang verhaal kort' by the IMG important.
Daarom vind ik projecten zoals « Lang verhaal kort » van het IMG belangrijk.

m: Motie van de leden Van Weerdenburg en Van Haga over aan Nederlandse ondernemingen in financieel zwaar weer de mogelijkheid bieden om van klimaatgerelateerde investeringen in ontwikkelingslanden af te
Asks the government to give Dutch companies in financial difficulty a quick and simple way to exit their climate-related investments in developing countries.
to offer a quick and simple way to exit their climate-related investments in developing countries
een snelle en eenvoudige manier te bieden om van hun klimaatgerelateerde investeringen in ontwikkelingslanden af te komen

requests the government to spend not one cent more on development aid
verzoekt de regering om geen cent meer uit te geven aan ontwikkelingshulp
