to suspend or freeze all intensifications and new expenditure on development cooperation
alle intensiveringen en nieuwe uitgaven voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking op te schorten dan wel te bevriezen

requests the government to include in the future approval law for the Mercosur treaty that approval is granted in accordance with Article 91(3) of the Constitution

Asks the government to spend no more money on development aid.
requests the government to spend not one cent more on development aid

Motie van de leden Van Weerdenburg en Van Haga over geen cent meer uitgeven aan ontwikkelingshulp
Asks the government to spend no more money on development aid.
requests the government to spend no more money on development aid
verzoekt de regering, om geen cent meer uit te geven aan ontwikkelingshulp
Motie van de leden Van Weerdenburg en Van Haga over gedurende de coronacrisis geen nieuwe verplichtingen aangaan op het gebied van ontwikkelingssamenwerking
Asks the government not to enter new commitments or optional spending on development cooperation during the corona crisis.
not to enter into new commitments nor make additional expenditure in the field of development cooperation

Asks the government to stop subsidies to institutions that actively litigate against the government or otherwise work against government policy.
requests the government to stop subsidies to institutions that actively litigate against the government or otherwise work against government policy
verzoekt de regering, om de subsidies aan instellingen die actief procederen tegen de overheid of het regeringsbeleid anderszins tegenwerken, stop te zetten
Amendement van de leden Weerdenburg en Bisschop t.v.v. nr. 7 over goedkeuring met tweederde meerderheid

Amendment requiring the CETA approval law to follow the two-thirds majority procedure of Article 91(3) of the Constitution, because CETA joint committees make binding decisions without effective parliamentary control.
The CETA approval law wrongly contains no provision requiring, by reference to Article 91(3) of the Constitution, such a majority for approval of the treaty

De goedkeuringswet van CETA bevat naar de mening van de indiener ten onrechte geen bepaling waarin onder verwijzing naar artikel 91, derde lid, van de Grondwet een dergelijke meerderheid voor goedkeuring van het verdrag vereist is.
Amendement van het lid Van Weerdenburg over goedkeuring met tweederde meerderheid
Requires approval of the CETA implementing act by a two-thirds majority in both chambers, as Article 91(3) of the Constitution demands for treaties departing from the Constitution.
If a treaty deviates from the Constitution, a qualified majority in both chambers is required for its approval
Als een verdrag afwijkt van de Grondwet is voor de goedkeuring daarvan een gekwalificeerde meerderheid nodig in beide Kamers
Motie van de leden Van Weerdenburg en Van Haga over informatievoorziening bij mogelijke malversaties
Asks the government, when informing about possible misappropriation of funds, to limit itself to facts and figures and refrain from drawing conclusions or calculating Dutch risk shares.
to limit itself to stating facts and figures and to refrain from drawing conclusions
zich te beperken tot het noemen van feiten en cijfers en zich te onthouden van het trekken van conclusies
Motie van het lid Van Weerdenburg over het gesprek aangaan over bilaterale handelsakkoorden
Asks the government, when a foreign government asks about a bilateral trade agreement, to engage seriously at bilateral level and report this to the Kamer.
and also to report this to the Kamer
tevens daarvan melding te maken aan de Kamer

Asks the government to spend no more money on development aid.
requests the government to spend not one cent more on development aid

Motie van het lid Van Weerdenburg over het openbaar maken van de brieven over Mali
Asks the government to immediately publish three confidential letters about Mali that the minister shared with parliament.
requests the government to make the letters about Mali public immediately

verzoekt de regering, de brieven over Mali (brieven d.d. respectievelijk 11 maart 2019 ( 35 000-XVII, nr. 62 ), 13 mei 2019 ( 35 000-XVII, nr. 66 ) en 18 juni 2019 ( 35 000-XVII, nr. 69 ) per direct openbaar te maken
Motie van de leden Van Weerdenburg en Edgar Mulder over intrekken van de anbi-status van Oxfam Novib
Asks the government to instruct the Tax Authority to revoke the ANBI charity status of Oxfam Novib over the Haiti abuse scandal.
requests the government to instruct the Tax Authority to revoke the ANBI status of Oxfam Novib
verzoekt de regering, de Belastingdienst op te dragen de anbi-status van Oxfam Novib in te trekken
Motie van het lid Van Weerdenburg over direct stoppen met de subsidiëring van Oxfam Novib
Asks the government to stop subsidising Oxfam Novib immediately and to inform the House quickly about options to reclaim funds paid since 2012.

verzoekt de regering, om per direct te stoppen met het subsidiëren van Oxfam Novib en de Kamer op zeer korte termijn te informeren over de mogelijkheden om te komen tot terugvordering

Asks the government to stop development aid and use the money to reverse the AOW age increase and restore the pension age to 65.
requests the government to stop development aid and use this money to reverse the increase in the AOW age
verzoekt de regering, te stoppen met ontwikkelingshulp en dit geld te gebruiken om de verhoging van de AOW-leeftijd terug te draaien
Motie van het lid Van Weerdenburg over het European Partnership for Responsible Minerals
Asks the government to immediately stop all financial support to the European Partnership for Responsible Minerals.

verzoekt de regering, per direct te stoppen met alle financiële steun aan het European Partnership for Responsible Minerals
Motie van het lid Van Weerdenburg over geen cent meer voor ontwikkelingshulp
Motion asking the government to spend no more money on development aid.
not spend another cent on development aid

Asks the government to immediately stop funding the legal sector in Somalia because courts there would apply sharia.
requests the government to immediately stop financing the legal sector in Somalia
verzoekt de regering direct te stoppen met het financieren van de juridische sector in Somalië
Motie van het lid Van Weerdenburg over direct stoppen met het financieren van de juridische sector in Somalië
Asks the government to immediately stop financing the legal sector in Somalia because courts would apply sharia law.
requests the government to immediately stop financing the legal sector in Somalia
verzoekt de regering, direct te stoppen met het financieren van de juridische sector in Somalië
qa: Antwoord op van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Bouchallikh, Kathmann, Azarkan, Ceder, Van Weerdenburg, Koekkoek, Bontenbal, Leijten, Rajkowski en Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Chinese TikTok-medewerkers krijgen toegang tot data

MPs from eleven parties asked the government about a report that Chinese TikTok staff can access data of European users, including children's data, and what steps it would take. The State Secretary answered that TikTok could not say which staff access which data, that the Irish DPC and the Dutch AP are investigating transfers to third countries, and that the government will raise the issue with TikTok but leaves enforcement to the independent regulator.
At this moment we do not know which TikTok employees have access to which data.
Op dit moment weten we niet welke medewerkers van TikTok toegang hebben tot welke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders en Van Weerdenburg over ‘nog meer Nederlands hulpgeld voor Palestijnse terroristen’

MPs De Roon, Wilders and Van Weerdenburg (PVV) asked why Dutch aid money goes to Palestinian NGO Al-Mezan, alleged to have ties with PFLP and Hamas, and demanded vetting of all Palestinian aid recipients and suspension of aid. The government denied evidence of links, said it will await an external investigation into UAWC, promised to remove posts from individual staff, and refused to halt aid or close the Ramallah mission.
The cabinet does not provide support to organisations that have ties with terrorist organisations and checks whether the Dutch contribution to these organisations is spent on the agreed objectives.

Het kabinet geeft geen steun aan organisaties die banden hebben met terroristische organisaties en controleert of de Nederlandse bijdrage aan deze organisaties wordt besteed aan de afgesproken doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over “subsidieverlening aan een Palestijnse organisatie met terreurbanden”

Two PVV MPs asked whether the Netherlands gave about 23 million dollars in subsidies to the Palestinian NGO UAWC, whether its staff were linked to terrorism, why a petition to stop funding was ignored, and whether funding will stop immediately. The ministers confirmed funding of roughly 11.7 million euros plus earlier programmes, said two staff members arrested for an alleged bombing had received overhead salary payments, paused further payments, and ordered an external investigation before deciding on continued cooperation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg en De Roon over het corruptieschandaal bij de UNRWA

PVV MPs asked the minister about an ethics report alleging abuse of power, corruption and excessive travel at UNRWA, and asked for an account of Dutch funds lost, a halt to all Dutch funding, and a repayment of transferred money. The minister answered that she awaits the UN OIOS findings, that Dutch funding is held back pending UN clarification, that no fraud is established in UNRWA's core tasks, and that the annual contribution of 13 million euro will likely continue.
I am awaiting the judgment of the independent inspectorate of the United Nations in New York.
Ik wacht het oordeel van de onafhankelijke inspectie van de Verenigde Naties in New York af
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg, De Roon en Markuszower over de financiering van een aanval op onafhankelijke Israëlische rechtspraak

PVV MPs asked whether the Dutch government financed a critical B'Tselem report on Israel's High Court and whether this undermines judicial independence. The minister answered that the EUR 176,000 grant was given under a strategic plan with B'Tselem setting its own research aims and conclusions, that Nederland did not steer the report, and that it does not regard the funding as undermining judicial independence.
There has been no substantive steering by the Netherlands.
Er is geen sprake geweest van inhoudelijke sturing door Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over het bericht dat Hamas een militaire opleiding runt met UNRWA geld

Two PVV MPs asked whether UNRWA schools in Gaza are used by Hamas for military training, how much of UNRWA's budget goes to Gaza, and whether the Dutch annual contribution of about 20 million euro should be stopped or not increased. The government said it has no evidence for the training claim, that UNRWA does not cooperate with Hamas summer camps, and that it intends to keep the annual 13 million euro contribution while assessing any additional funding case by case.
The government has no evidence for the claim in the article or the 2015 film referred to in the article.
Het kabinet heeft geen bewijs voor de claim uit het artikel of de film uit 2015 waar in het artikel naar verwezen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Van Weerdenburg over meer dan 1 miljard euro voor het Europees solidariteitskorps

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about the EU European Solidarity Corps, its proposed expansion to 350,000 youth and over 1 billion euro, asking which organisations participate, how many Dutch youth joined, what it has cost, and whether the EU should fund it. The minister answered with figures on accredited organisations, registered Dutch participants, the 378 million euro budget under the current MFF, and said the Dutch appraisal of the new proposal will follow via a BNC-fiche.
There is no list available of organisations where young people currently participate or have participated.
Er is geen lijst beschikbaar van organisaties waar jongeren op dit moment aan deelnemen of aan deelgenomen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg en De Roon over het bericht dat de Palestijnse Autoriteit voor 50 miljoen dollar een privéjet heeft aangeschaft voor Mahmoud Abbas

Two MPs asked the minister whether the Palestinian Authority bought a $50 million private jet for Abbas, whether that spending was needed, why the Netherlands rushed a 13 million euro UNRWA contribution, and whether all Dutch funding to the PA should stop. The minister confirmed a government aircraft was bought from PA and PLO funds with no Dutch or European money, defended the accelerated UNRWA payment, and rejected halting PA funding because it conflicts with the two-state goal.
No Dutch or European contributions were used for the purchase.
Er zijn geen Nederlandse of Europese bijdragen voor de aanschaf gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over de donorconferentie voor Irak

PVV MPs De Roon and Van Weerdenburg asked about Dutch participation and pledges at the February 2018 Iraq donor conference in Kuwait, including whether taxpayer money should go to Iraq rather than domestic needs, and whether a full list of pledges would be shared. The minister confirmed participation, cited a EUR 12 million stabilisation contribution and conditional aid, and said no full overview of pledges had been compiled, citing a roughly USD 30 billion total from the Kuwaiti chair.
No overview has been made of all the pledges made during the conference.
Er is geen overzicht gemaakt van alle toezeggingen gedaan tijdens de conferentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg en De Roon over het bericht dat Robert Mugabe benoemd is tot goodwill-ambassadeur van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO)

PVV MPs asked whether Robert Mugabe's appointment as WHO goodwill ambassador was justified, and whether Dutch funding or membership should be suspended or withdrawn if it was not reversed. The minister answered that the appointment was unfounded, that the Netherlands had lobbied for its withdrawal, which the WHO did, and that no further measures were needed.
It is good that this decision has been withdrawn. Therefore there is no need to take further measures.
Het is goed dat dit besluit is ingetrokken. Daarom is er geen noodzaak om verdere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over het bericht dat België de hulp aan Palestijnse scholen opschort

MPs De Roon and Van Weerdenburg asked whether Dutch aid money had gone to Palestinian schools that were named after a terrorist and glorify violence, and whether a ban on all Dutch funding to such schools is warranted. The ministers answered that the Netherlands does not fund schools directly, that glorification of violence is unacceptable, that the EU and Netherlands press both parties on incitement, and that they do not agree that no Dutch money should go to Palestinian schools.
The Netherlands does not provide direct funding to schools, so also not to this particular school.
Nederland geeft geen directe financiering aan scholen, dus ook niet aan deze bewuste school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over terreurkampen voor Palestijnse kinderen georganiseerd door o.a. de Verenigde Naties

MPs De Roon and Van Weerdenburg (PVV) asked the government how many children attend alleged Hamas and UNRWA 'terror camps' and whether Dutch funding to UNRWA should stop. The government distinguishes Hamas camps from UNRWA summer camps, says it has no evidence of terrorist links to UNRWA camps, and refuses to halt UNRWA funding.

m: Amendement van het lid De Caluwé over verandering van de naam van de ROB en specifieke deskundigheid op het terrein van de financiële verhoudingen voor 2/3 van de leden
Renames the Raad voor het openbaar bestuur to include financial relations and requires two-thirds of its members to have specific expertise in financial relations.
This amendment further provides that two-thirds of the members of the Council consist of persons with expertise in financial relations between the central government and municipalities or provinces.

Dit amendement regelt voorts dat twee derde van de leden van de Raad bestaat uit personen die deskundigheid hebben op het terrein van de financiële verhoudingen tussen het Rijk en de gemeenten c.q. de provincies.

Asks the government to further weigh the remaining questions on the Gemeentefonds housing and spatial planning subcluster before the full recalibration.
requests the government to make a further assessment of the remaining issues in the housing, spatial planning and urban renewal subcluster
verzoekt de regering, een nadere afweging over de resterende vraagstukken van het subcluster Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijk Ordening en Stedelijke Vernieuwing te maken

Asks the government to inventory local democracy wishes for experiments with democratic renewal and examine removing obstacles to them.

Asks the government to produce an action plan to involve young people more in politics, building on existing initiatives.
requests the government to come up with an action plan to involve young people even more in politics
verzoekt de regering, met een actieplan te komen om jongeren nog meer bij de politiek te betrekken
Motie van de leden De Caluwé en Koşer Kaya over de eigen regie van burgers over hun gegevens

Asks the government to investigate how citizens could get control over their data, including insight into which officials viewed or shared it and the option to automatically share limited data with chosen bodies.
so that they gain insight into which official has viewed, used or passed on which data
• zij inzage krijgen in welke functionaris welke gegevens heeft ingezien dan wel gebruikt of aan een ander verstrekt heeft;
Motie van het lid De Caluwé over creatieve ICT-vernieuwers bij de overheid
Asks the government to create a small group of creative ICT innovators with outside experts, financed from the existing ICT budget, to propose digital products.
to set up a small group of creative ICT innovators
een kleine groep creatieve vernieuwers op ICT-gebied samen te stellen
Amendement van het lid De Caluwé over het niet verstrekken van gegevens over de shopomzet ten behoeve van het biedboek
Removes the requirement that tenants of fuel stations provide shop revenue data for the auction bid book.
does not provide competition-sensitive data on shop revenue for the bid book for the auction
geen concurrentiegevoelige gegevens over de shopomzet ten behoeve van het biedboek voor de veiling verstrekt
Amendement van de leden De Caluwé en Bisschop over het beperken van de territoriale geldigheid van de vervangende Nederlandse identiteitskaart tot het Europese deel van Nederland
Provides that a replacement Dutch identity card is valid only in the European part of the Netherlands and requires notifying other countries.
A replacement Dutch identity card is not valid outside the European part of the Netherlands.
Een vervangende Nederlandse identiteitskaart is niet geldig buiten het Europese deel van Nederland.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden De Caluwé en Sjoerdsma ter vervanging van nr. 13 dat beoogt het bedrag voor bijdragen aan rechtsstaatontwikkeling, wederopbouw, vredesopbouw, versterkte legitimiteit
Shifts budget between development aid articles, raising funds for rule-of-law development, reconstruction and anti-corruption work.

Amendement van de leden De Caluwé en Sjoerdsma ter vervanging van nr. 8 dat beoogt het bedrag voor bijdragen aan rechtsstaatontwikkeling, wederopbouw, vredesopbouw, versterkte legitimiteit van democra

Dit amendement heeft als doel de bijdragen aan rechtsstaatontwikkeling, wederopbouw, vredesopbouw, versterkte legitimiteit van democratische structuren en tegengaan van corruptie met 4 miljoen euro te verhogen
Motie van het lid Van Laar c.s. over een bijdrage voor GAVI van ten minste 250 miljoen euro

requests the government to commit a contribution of at least 250 million euro to GAVI for 2016 to 2020
verzoekt de regering, GAVI voor de periode van 2016 tot 2020 een bijdrage toe te zeggen van ten minste 250 miljoen euro

Amendement van het lid De Caluwé dat beoogt het bedrag voor bijdragen aan rechtsstaatontwikkeling, wederopbouw, vredesopbouw, versterkte legitimiteit van democratische structuren en tegengaan van corr

De storting in het Dutch Good Growth Fund wordt in 2014 met EUR 50 mln verlaagd, dit bedrag krijgt een alternatieve bestemming binnen de ODA-begroting
Motie van het lid Van Laar c.s. over expliciete aandacht voor vrouwen en meisjes in beleidsdocumenten

requests the government to include in all development cooperation policy documents whether and how girls and women benefit from that policy
verzoekt de regering om in alle beleidsdocumenten over ontwikkelingssamenwerking op te nemen of en hoe meisjes en vrouwen baat hebben bij dat beleid

Motie van de leden De Caluwé en Baay-Timmerman over trainingen Afghaanse politievrouwen continueren
Asks government to continue and intensify training of Afghan policewomen and fund recruitment, without any link to checks on the executive.
to continue and intensify the valuable training of policewomen
de waardevolle trainingen aan politievrouwen te continueren en te intensiveren
Amendement van het lid De Caluwé over het verhogen van het bedrag voor bijdragen aan het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven en een verbeterd investeringsklimaat in ontwikkelingslanden
Shifts 50 million euro within the development budget from multilateral, partner-government and NGO contributions to contributions for Dutch business and investment climate.
Coverage for this amendment is found in the contributions to multilateral organisations, partner-country governments and NGOs and knowledge institutions under 1.3.
Dekking voor dit amendement wordt gevonden op de bijdragen aan multilaterale organisaties, overheden in partnerlanden en ngo's en kennisinstellingen onder 1.3.
Amendement van het lid Voordewind c.s. over alternatieve besteding binnen de ODA-begroting
Reallocates development aid budget lines within the ODA budget to Syria emergency aid, child labour and child welfare, and other programmes.
The contribution to the Dutch Good Growth Fund is reduced by EUR 50 million in 2014 and this amount receives an alternative allocation within the ODA budget
De storting in het Dutch Good Growth Fund wordt in 2014 met EUR 50 mln verlaagd en dit bedrag krijgt een alternatieve bestemming binnen de ODA-begroting
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 27 over het inzetten van 2,5 miljoen euro via de maatschappelijke organisaties in Rwanda
Shifts 2.5 million euro from sectoral budget support to Rwanda into civil society organisations in Rwanda, a foreign aid allocation without bearing on executive checks.
This amendment aims to deploy 2.5 million euro via civil society organisations in Rwanda (art 2.5).
Dit amendement beoogt € 2,5 miljoen in te zetten via maatschappelijke organisaties in Rwanda (art 2.5).
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jasper van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 47 over het toekennen van een bedrag aan het Global Fund
Amendment moving 7 million euro within the foreign affairs budget from good governance aid for Rwanda to the Global Fund.
This amendment aims to allocate 7 million euros to the Global Fund
Dit amendement beoogt een toekenning van 7 miljoen euro aan het Global Fund
Amendement van het lid Jasper van Dijk c.s. over het toekennen van €8 miljoen aan het Global Fund
Shifts 8 million euro in the budget to the Global Fund from the good governance article to the health and development article.
This amendment aims to allocate 8 million euro to the Global Fund
Dit amendement beoogt een toekenning van 8 miljoen euro aan het Global Fund
Amendement van de leden Jasper van Dijk en De Caluwé dat een toekenning van 9,51 miljoen euro aan het Global Fund beoogt
Moves 9.51 million euro from one budget article to another to fund a contribution to the Global Fund, with no bearing on executive checks.
This amendment aims to allocate 9.51 million euro to the Global Fund (art. 5.4).
Dit amendement beoogt een toekenning van 9,51 miljoen euro aan het Global Fund (art. 5.4).
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over het verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor FLOW met € 10 miljoen in 2013
Shifts €10 million within the development budget from Mali budget support to the FLOW fund for women and girls in developing countries in 2013.
Coverage is provided by a reduction of article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden door een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Motie Maij c.s. over een nationaal comité van UN Women in Nederland
Asks the government to investigate options and costs for facilitating a Dutch national committee of UN Women and inform the House before the 2014 budget.
requests the government, before the 2014 budget debate, to examine the options for facilitating a national committee of UN Women in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering, voor de behandeling van de begroting voor 2014 te onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de vestiging van een nationaal comité van UN Women in Nederland te faciliteren
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. over het verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor FLOW met € 10 miljoen in 2013
Amendment moving 10 million euros to the FLOW fund for women in developing countries in 2013, financed by cutting budget support for Mali.
Funding is provided by a reduction of article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden door een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. over het in 2013 eenmalig verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor UN-Women met € 2 miljoen
Increases funding for UN Women by 2 million euros in 2013 by reducing budget support for Mali.
Funding is provided by reducing article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden via een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Amendement van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over het inzetten van € 1,5 miljoen via maatschappelijke organisaties in Rwanda
Proposes moving €1.5 million within the foreign aid budget to civil society organisations in Rwanda and stopping sectoral budget support to Rwanda.
sectoral budget support should now be stopped
zou sectorale begrotingssteun nu moeten worden stopgezet
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over het reviseren van een ingezonden stuk voor Computable door een topambtenaar van het ministerie

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a senior civil servant from the ministry revising an op-ed critical of MPs before it was submitted to Computable, and whether this was acceptable and what measures would follow. The minister confirmed a fact-check was done at the author's request, described the revisions as minor, and said no measures would be taken.
In this case a check for factual inaccuracies was carried out; there was no co-writing.
Er is in dit geval een check op feitelijke onjuistheden gedaan, er is niet meegeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over het artikel ‘Een skelettransplantatie voor de BRP’.

The MP De Caluwé asked the Minister of Interior whether the phasing out of code generators in the BRP population-register software amounted to replacing its entire skeleton, and why this was presented as a mere improvement rather than a material change, including questions on budget, schedule and code quality. The Minister answered that refactoring changes no functionality, that the step was a routine part of development following consultation with the interbestuurlijke stuurgroep, that KPMG reports improved maintainability, and that a fuller assessment of the effects on planning will follow in the next progress report.

I informed you in the progress letter that I asked the programme and the inter-administrative steering group to take the necessary steps in the coming months to complete the validation of the integrated planning.

Ik heb u in de voortgangsbrief gemeld dat ik het programma en de interbestuurlijke stuurgroep heb gevraagd in de komende maanden de nodige stappen te ondernemen om de validatie van de integrale planning af te ronden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwéover het artikel ‘Gluren in privégegevens’

The VVD MP De Caluwé asked the Minister of the Interior about civil servants looking at and sharing private data without authorisation, how this is registered, prevented and checked, and how online citizen services will be secured. The Minister answered that organisations register breaches themselves (34 of 557 Rijk breaches in 2015 were in the broad leaking/misuse category), that confidentiality duties and sanctions apply, that only targeted checks on logs are allowed, and that a government-wide information security baseline (BIO) and email security standards are being introduced.
Logging data must first show whether there is a justified suspicion of unauthorised actions.
Uit logginggegevens moet eerst blijken of er sprake is van een gerechtvaardigd vermoeden van niet-geautoriseerde handelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en De Caluwé over het artikel ’Disrepair causes Statia court session to move’’

MPs Bosman and De Caluwé asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that a courthouse building on Sint Eustatius was too dilapidated to use, and about responsibility for maintenance, affected hearings, costs and other closed state buildings. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained that ownership was unclear for years, said repair works are ordered and funded, and answered that hearings were moved to other venues while other buildings are not closed.
The Ministry of BZK has also ordered repair works to be carried out, for which funds have also been made available.
Ook heeft het Ministerie van BZK opdracht gegeven om herstelwerkzaamheden te verrichten, waarvoor ook middelen ter beschikking zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over eisen die aan pasfoto’s worden gesteld

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about passport photo requirements under the Fotomatrix 2007, including municipalities applying inconsistent rules on glasses, hair, face coverings and temporary tattoos, and about automated photo booths and information provision. The Minister said the Fotomatrix is binding and based on ISO/EU standards, that inconsistencies in application are possible given thousands of officials, that applicants can object and appeal, and that he will keep informing municipalities and photographers, but he declined to tighten the rules or ban tattoos.
That does not prevent me from continually drawing municipalities' attention to the correct application of the acceptance criteria.
Dat laat onverlet dat ik de juiste toepassing van de acceptatiecriteria voortdurend onder de aandacht breng bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over aangifte van belastingen in het buitenland

A VVD MP asks the Interior Minister why Dutch citizens abroad must collect their DigiD in person at a counter, which is burdensome, and whether this conflicts with the digital government ambition. The minister says the digital tax filing exemption for expats stays for now, that a face-to-face check is needed for reliability, and that research into an easier procedure has been started.

That is why I am currently having research done into whether and to what extent it is possible to facilitate a simpler and less burdensome issuing procedure while maintaining the necessary level of reliability.

Daarom laat ik momenteel onderzoeken of en in hoeverre het mogelijk is om met behoud van het noodzakelijke betrouwbaarheidsniveau een eenvoudiger en minder bezwarende uitgifteprocedure te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman, De Caluwé en Oosenbrug over het bericht “beveiliging tientallen gemeentesites lek: persoonsgegevens niet veilig”

MPs Veldman, De Caluwé and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Interior about a reported security flaw (DROWN/SSL) exposing dozens of municipal websites and whether municipalities protect personal data, and what sanctions and oversight apply. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own information security under the BIG framework, that the Dutch DPA can impose instructions, fines or penalties, and that the government is preparing legislation on digital government services.
Information security of municipalities is a local responsibility.
Informatiebeveiliging van gemeenten is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over de proef met het publiek middel voor online inloggen bij de overheid

The Kamervragen from MP De Caluwé ask the Minister of Interior about delays and inconsistencies in the pilots of a public online login means (DigiD replacement via eID card), including timing, the commission's evaluation, and privacy risks of commercial providers knowing login behaviour. The minister answers at length, largely reaffirming the commitment to a public means by 2017, explaining the pilot timelines and privacy safeguards, though some answers restate policy without fully resolving the concerns.
I am having it examined whether and, if so, how this exchange period can be shortened.
Ik laat onderzoeken of en zo ja hoe deze omwisselingstermijn kan worden verkort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over de lopende pilots eID

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why no complete overview of the running eID pilots had been provided, including public and private pilots, and requested details per pilot. The Minister said he disagrees that the situation is odd, explains participation is open to registered parties, and provides an overview of public-domain pilots in an annex while noting the authentication means may change.
Annex 1 contains the overview of the pilots that fall under my responsibility.
In de bijlage 1 vindt u het overzicht van de pilots die onder mijn verantwoordelijkheid vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Neppérus over de pilots voor het eID (elektronische identiteit) stelsel

MPs De Caluwé and Neppérus asked whether a bank-login pilot with the Tax Administration could start before evaluation criteria for the eID pilots were discussed with the House, and whether it would wait for that discussion. The minister confirmed the criteria would be sent in time for the 25 November consultation, but said the bank pilot starts mid-December, after that meeting, with a small group and wider use from 1 March.
The State Secretary for Finance will inform you in a separate letter in more detail about the evaluation criteria for the bank pilot.
De Staatssecretaris van Financiën zal u in een separate brief nader informeren over de evaluatiecriteria voor de bankenpilot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over de eID Pilots

MP De Caluwé asked the Interior Minister about the e-ID pilots: whether the evaluation criteria would be made SMART and tied to the entry conditions, and what the status of the pilots is. Minister Plasterk answered that the criteria will be sent before the November committee meeting, that evaluation criteria and entry conditions are distinct, and that 14 e-ID providers are in the accession process with pilots expected to start around year-end.
You will receive the criteria in good time before the committee meeting of 25 November.
U ontvangt de criteria tijdig voor het Algemeen Overleg van 25 november aanstaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en De Caluwé over de meerjarenplannen van de Raad voor de Rechtspraak

Two MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers how access to justice at reasonable distance is guaranteed under the judiciary's multi-year plans, and about regional employment effects and coordination with other government relocations. The minister answered that the 32 court locations remain legally fixed, that the relocation may shift jobs locally but not reduce total judiciary employment, and that the housing minister will report in autumn on regional employment effects.
The proposed location policy, as described in the proposed multi-year plan, leads to a shift of jobs within a number of courts.
Het voorgenomen locatiebeleid, zoals beschreven in het voorgenomen MJP, leidt tot een verschuiving van arbeidsplaatsen binnen een aantal gerechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en De Caluwé over het inzicht van verhuurders in adresinschrijvingen

MPs Van der Linde and De Caluwé asked the Minister of Interior how landlords can access information on who is registered at their properties, and whether this helps reduce fraud and nuisance. The Minister answered that systematic access is not possible under BRP and data protection law, and pointed to municipal cooperation and landlords' own responsibilities as alternatives.

This is contrary to legislation (BRP and Wbp) and would open the door to the undesirable situation that personal data under government responsibility could be provided to all commercial organisations and private individuals.

Dit is in strijd met wetgeving (BRP en Wbp) en zou de deur openzetten naar de onwenselijke situatie dat persoonsgegevens die vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de overheid, verstrekt kunnen worden aan alle commerciële organisaties en particulieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en De Caluwé over digitale dossier- en archiefvorming

MPs Veldman and De Caluwé asked the Minister of Interior about a warning letter from local officials on poor digital record-keeping and its consequences for openness of government, and what steps follow. The minister says the warning is taken seriously, points to existing archiving standards, metadata schemas and projects such as AIDO and Archief 2020, and notes that all government documents fall under the Wob regardless of medium.
Every document held by the government in principle falls under the Wob (Freedom of Information Act).
Elk document dat bij de overheid berust, valt in principe onder de Wob.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Rutte inzake het bericht "Opeens wit: ophef over verfbeurt consulaat Angola" over het verven van het Rijksmonument in Rotterdam, waarin het consulaat van Angola is gevestigd

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the painting of a listed Rotterdam building housing Angola's consulate without a permit, and whether the consulate could be held liable. The minister answered that no permit was granted, that the building is not foreign territory, that the municipality is the competent authority, and that talks on restoration are ongoing.
Supervision of compliance with procedures for changes to national monuments is in principle not the responsibility of the national government but of municipalities.
Het toezicht op de naleving van de procedures voor wijzigingen aan rijksmonumenten ligt in beginsel niet bij de rijksoverheid maar bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over het rapport van Human Rights Watch, waarin de organisatie melding maakt van 47 buitengerechtelijke executies in Burundi

MP De Caluwé asked the minister about the HRW report on 47 extrajudicial killings in Burundi and whether Dutch rule-of-law funding reached the implicated units. The minister confirmed the report, said Dutch-funded police and army programmes may have touched individuals involved, and reported requesting an independent Burundian investigation, with conditional threats to suspend aid.
The Netherlands will urge the Burundian government to expand the investigative commission with members of Burundian civil society.
Nederland zal er bij de Burundese overheid op aandringen om de onderzoekscommissie uit te breiden met leden van het Burundese maatschappelijk middenveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over het bericht “EU doneert 234 miljoen aan Zimbabwe”

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the EU is donating 234 million euros to Zimbabwe, including whether it is budget support, what conditions apply, and whether sanctions on the regime should preclude such aid. The minister answered that the programme is not budget support, targets health and rural development via non-state and international partners, and that restoring aid relations is separate from sanctions on President Mugabe, which were extended for one year.
No budget support is provided from the programme.
Vanuit het programma wordt geen begrotingssteun verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwe over het bericht "geen verzekering voor ebola-arts"

An MP asked whether the government should guarantee medical repatriation and reserve funds so Dutch doctors willing to treat Ebola patients are not left uninsured. The minister answered that repatriation remains primarily the responsibility of employers and insurers, with the government stepping in only if they cannot arrange it, backed by a US aircraft arrangement and an EU guarantee.
The starting point is that responsibility lies in the first instance with the insurer and the employer.
Uitgangspunt is dat de verantwoordelijkheid in eerste instantie bij de verzekeraar en de werkgever ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over de Wereldomroep

An MP asked the minister about press reports of disagreement between the director and editor-in-chief of Radio Netherlands Worldwide, its financial viability, and whether an interim evaluation would be held. The minister replied that the ministry does not intervene in staff matters of subsidised organisations, that an external interim evaluation will take place in early 2015, and that consultation with RNW continues.
As is known, organisations subsidised by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs operate at arm's length and thus independently of the Ministry.
Zoals bekend functioneren door het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gesubsidieerde (maatschappelijke) organisaties «op afstand» en daarmee onafhankelijk van het Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, De Caluwé, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Servaes over het bericht dat President Museveni de omstreden anti-homowet heeft ondertekend

MPs from several parties asked the government how it would respond to President Museveni signing Uganda's anti-homosexuality law and what measures it would take. The minister answered that the Netherlands suspended justice-sector aid and human-rights-conditioned support, pressed Uganda diplomatically, and would push the EU to condemn the law and withhold budget support, while promising to review support for LGBT groups.
Immediately after the law was signed, the cabinet suspended aid to the Ugandan government in the justice sector.
Meteen na het ondertekenen van de wet heeft het kabinet de hulp aan de Ugandese overheid in de justitiële sector opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Ark over het bericht dat in Uganda een Belg vastzit vanwege homoseksualiteit (definitief)

MPs De Caluwé and Van Ark asked the government about reports that a Belgian man was detained in Uganda over alleged homosexual conduct, whether other Europeans were held, the status of Uganda's anti-homosexuality bill, what aid had done for LHBT people, and whether aid would be suspended. The minister answered that the Belgian was released on bail and has left Uganda, that no other Europeans are known to be held, that the President signalled he would not sign the bill in its current form but later indicated he would, and that the Netherlands will await formal presidential signature before reacting while consulting LHBT organisations on aid measures.
Depending on those discussions, we want to consider whether and which measures we take.
Afhankelijk van die gesprekken willen we bezien of en welke maatregelen we nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Ark over het bericht dat het parlement in Oeganda een anti-homowet heeft aangenomen

MPs De Caluwé and Van Ark asked whether the government would condemn Uganda's anti-homosexuality law, whether budget for Uganda would be cut or redirected to LGBT groups, and whether it would coordinate action with donors. The government answered that the law is not yet in force, that Nederland has urged joint EU pressure and raised concerns with Uganda's prime minister, that existing funds already support LGBT-related organisations, and that it will examine options for extra support without committing to budget cuts yet.
It is too early to decide on consequences once the law is introduced.
Het is te vroeg om te besluiten over consequenties bij de invoering van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Ark over de doodslag van twee mannen vanwege seksuele gerichtheid

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a reported video of two gay men beaten to death in Kenya, and whether the government would press for prosecution and cut aid if not prosecuted. The minister answered that the event apparently did not take place in Kenya, so no Kenyan investigation exists, and declined to take further action on that basis.
On the basis of environmental details it is clear that it did not take place in Kenya.
Op basis van omgevingsdetails is wel duidelijk dat het niet in Kenia heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Caluwe en Ten Broeke over steniging in Afghanistan

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign and development ministers about a reported proposal in Afghanistan's law reform working group to reintroduce stoning, and whether Dutch funding to the Afghan bar association should be stopped. The ministers answered that no such proposal was made by the sub-working group or the bar association chair, that Dutch funding is for lawyer training via local partners, and that Nederland will monitor the reform and raise concerns if needed.
The Netherlands will monitor the criminal law reform process with its partners and, if necessary, raise this point again.
Nederland zal met de partners het proces van de herziening van de strafwet monitoren en indien nodig, dit punt opnieuw onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Verheijen over het bericht 'EU aid lost in Palestine'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether she knew of a report claiming over a billion euros of EU aid was lost in Palestinian territories through corruption and mismanagement, and whether aid should be halted and a programme-wide audit requested. The minister confirmed awareness of the press report, said she had not yet seen the unpublished European Court of Auditors report, and declined to prejudge its findings while promising to inform parliament by letter once it is published.
I am not aware of the content of the report since it has not yet been released.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de inhoud van het rapport aangezien het nog niet is vrijgegeven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Verheijen over verdwenen EU-gelden in Congo

Two MPs from the VVD asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that EU aid to Congo was largely wasted and whether the EU overlooked corruption. The minister agreed the European Court of Auditors found serious shortcomings, said the government will press the Commission to follow the recommendations, and answered the remaining questions on Congo's fragility, Dutch funding shares, Mali and aid levels.

The cabinet agrees with the Court's recommendations to increase aid effectiveness and will, now that programming of the Eleventh EDF begins, press Commissioner Piebalgs to have the EU follow up on these recommendations.

Het kabinet is het eens met de aanbevelingen die de Rekenkamer doet om de effectiviteit van steun te vergroten en zal er, nu de programmering van het Elfde Europees Ontwikkelingsfonds (EOF11) van start gaat, bij Commissaris Piebalgs op aandringen dat de EU gevolg geeft aan deze aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over hulpgelden voor de Syrië crisis

MP De Caluwé asked whether the 7.5 million euro of Syria aid announced for the Syrian Red Crescent would reach refugees in rebel-held areas, and how spending would be controlled. Minister Ploumen replied that the funds now go to UNHCR as unearmarked aid for the most vulnerable displaced people, that UNHCR is responsible for reaching them and monitoring its programmes, and that there is no reason to doubt its efforts.
The money therefore does not go to the Syrian Red Crescent (SARC). With this unearmarked contribution UNHCR can decide on the ground where aid is most needed.
Het geld gaat dus niet naar de Syrische Rode Halve Maan (SARC). UNHCR kan met deze ongeoormerkte bijdrage ter plaatse bepalen waar de hulp het meest nodig is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Visser en De Caluwé over de organisatie ‘Dutch International Guarantees for Housing’ (DIGH)

MPs Visser and De Caluwé asked whether Dutch housing corporations guaranteeing DIGH loans for social housing in developing countries amounts to an implicit state guarantee, whether these fall under ODA rules, whether guarantees are reviewed for necessity and fee cover, and whether such activity belongs to corporations' core tasks. The minister answered that corporations guarantee loans with their own capital, the state is not directly liable, no new guarantees have been issued since mid-2012, and the Herzieningswet novelle will address corporations' activities abroad.

In my proposals within the novelle to the Herzieningswet, in light of this cabinet's aim that corporations serve the public interest in their area, I will further address the limits arising from this for corporations' activities abroad.

Ik zal bij mijn voorstellen in het kader van de novelle bij de Herzieningswet, mede in het licht van de doelstelling van dit kabinet dat corporaties dienstbaar zijn aan het publieke belang in hun werkgebied, nader ingaan op de beperkingen die hieruit voortvloeien voor activiteiten van woningcorporaties ten behoeve van het buitenland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Caluwé over verdeling van de gelden van de Samenwerkende Hulporganisaties (SHO) voor Syrië

An MP from the VVD asked the minister whether Dutch NGO fundraising for Syria (Giro 555 by SHO) is fairly distributed, given reports that two member organisations, CARE and World Vision, are not focused on Syrian refugees. The minister answered that both organisations are active in the Syria regional response, that the NGOs themselves set the allocation key, and that the government's own 4 million euro contribution goes to UNICEF and the Lebanese Red Cross.
As with previous SHO actions, it is up to the participating NGOs to determine the allocation key.
Het is, gelijk eerdere acties van SHO, aan de deelnemende NGO's om de verdeelsleutel te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Oosten over interlandelijke adopties uit Ethiopië

Two VVD MPs asked whether Wereldkinderen, which receives MFS-II development funds, financed intercountry adoptions in Ethiopia exposed by Brandpunt, and what the government will do about adoption procedures and the legal status of adoptions obtained irregularly. The state secretary answered that the adoptions predate MFS-II funding, that adoption agencies receive no government money, and that existing safeguards suffice, with no new action planned.
In view of these measures, it is not necessary to take action now.
Gelet op deze maatregelen is het niet noodzakelijk om nu actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Dijkhoff over het verbieden van Niet-Gouvernementele Organisaties (NGO's) in Oeganda

Two VVD MPs asked the government whether Uganda's banning of 38 NGOs for allegedly promoting homosexuality was acceptable and whether development aid of about 6 million euro per year should be suspended. The minister replied that the NGO Council has said it will not act on the minister's call, so suspension is not currently at issue, and described Dutch efforts on the LGBT situation through political dialogue and funding of human rights organisations.
For now, given what was stated in the answer to question 2, this is not an issue.
Vooralsnog is dit gelet op het gestelde in antwoord op vraag 2 niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Caluwé over Oeganda onderzoekt verdwijnen Nederlands geld

MP De Caluwé asked the State Secretary about reports that Uganda is investigating missing Dutch funds at Nuffic, when the outcome will be published, when the Ugandan police investigation will conclude, and whether a broader review of Nuffic spending is needed. The State Secretary replied that Nuffic's own inquiry is paused pending the Ugandan Auditor General's report, expected by end of July, that the embassy is monitoring the police probe, and that a broader review is not currently warranted.
I expect to be able to inform you of the outcome of the investigation by the end of July at the latest.
Ik verwacht u uiterlijk eind juli over de uitkomst van het onderzoek te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord vragen De Caluwé en Haverkamp over Vliegveld Valkenburg

MPs De Caluwé and Haverkamp asked about the redevelopment of former Valkenburg airfield, the early end of recreational flying there, and alternatives such as a glider airfield. The state secretary answered that accommodating general aviation is primarily a provincial and municipal responsibility, that the RVOB needs the site cleared for preparatory work in 2012, and that the province is still looking for an alternative location.
The accommodation of General Aviation (GA) is a shared responsibility of the national government and the province.
De accommodatie van General Aviation (GA) is een gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid van het Rijk en de Provincie.
Antwoord vragen het lid De Caluwé over een verkenningsmissie van burgemeesters naar Oeganda

An MP asks the state secretary about a VNG-led municipal delegation (Deventer, Goes, Gemert-Bakel) visiting Uganda under the Connect2Uganda label, and whether municipal and VNG activity abroad is limited to specific municipal expertise. The state secretary says the mission served the government-funded LGCP programme, that the expertise includes political-administrative capacity, that programme plans and annual reports will be reviewed under the subsidy framework, and that municipalities are autonomous in such decisions.
The annual plans and reports will be assessed by me and discussed in the regular consultation between the department and VNG International.
De jaarplannen en rapporten worden door mij beoordeeld en besproken in het reguliere overleg tussen het departement en VNG International.
Antwoord vragen De Caluwé inzake de oorzaak van het incident bij de sluis Eefde op 3 januari 2012

An MP asked the minister whether she knows and endorses the TNO report on the cause of the Eefde lock accident, the timing of follow-up research, the consequences for damage claims by entrepreneurs, and how similar accidents will be prevented given that the damage escaped normal inspection. The minister confirmed the report and its conclusions, said follow-up research is underway with results expected by September, referred damage claims to individual entrepreneurs and an open nadeelcompensatie scheme, and announced a redesign of the upper door suspension that can be inspected normally.
The approach and delivery date are still being discussed between RWS and TNO. The expectation is that the results of the follow-up research will be known by September this year at the latest.
Over de aanpak en opleverdatum vindt nog overleg plaats tussen RWS en TNO. De verwachting is dat uiterlijk september dit jaar de resultaten van het vervolgonderzoek bekend zijn.
Antwoord vragen Leegte en De Caluwé naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Vliegtaks EU nekt Schiphol’

MPs Leegte and De Caluwé asked the state secretary whether he endorses the KiM report finding that the EU emissions trading system will cost aviation heavily and weaken Schiphol and European carriers, and what he will do about it, including pursuing a global instead of EU-only approach. The state secretary agreed the report shows the ETS is effective but may harm competitiveness, said he raised the report at the Environment Council and asked for comparable studies, and stated he backs a global system through ICAO.
At the Environment Council of 9 March I promised the European Commission that I would send it the report, and asked both the Commission and the member states to carry out a comparable study.

In de Milieuraad van 9 maart heb ik de Europese Commissie beloofd het rapport te zullen toesturen en zowel de Europese Commissie als de lidstaten gevraagd een vergelijkbaar onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Vragen van het lid De Caluwé (VVD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de inwerkingtreding Scheepsafvalstoffenverdrag (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether the Dutch state can ensure adequate waste-water reception facilities for passenger ships under the Scheepsafvalstoffenverdrag entering into force on 1 January 2012, and whether ships will be fined for lack of facilities. The minister replies that commercial collectors can serve the passenger fleet, that the sector must make its own arrangements, and that the ministry will monitor progress but gives no firm guarantee against fines.
I will monitor whether this process develops well and stay in contact about it with the inland shipping sector, the waste collectors and the SAB.
Ik zal monitoren of dit proces zich goed ontwikkelt en daarover contact houden met de binnenvaartsector, de afvalinzamelaars en de SAB.
Vragen van het lid De Caluwé (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over mogelijke afdrachten door hulporganisaties aan rebellenbeweging Al Shabaab (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

The MP asks whether humanitarian organisations, including Dutch ones, pay levies to Al Shabaab to operate in Somalia, and whether the government will oppose such payments and support a joint boycott, including responding to a USAID initiative. The state secretary answers that Dutch aid organisations say they make no payments, that EU and UN sanctions prohibit funds to Al Shabaab except narrow humanitarian exemptions, that payments cannot be excluded with certainty, and that he supports organisations doing everything to prevent diversion.
However, I expect Dutch and international aid organisations to do everything in their power to prevent this.
Ik verwacht echter van Nederlandse en internationale hulporganisaties dat zij alles in het werk stellen om dit te voorkomen.
Vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over hongersnood in Oost-Afrika (ingezonden 13 juli 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs about the famine in East Africa, the Kenyan closure of the Ifo II refugee camp, Dutch contributions to it, and whether Kenya should be pressed to open it. The state secretary answered that the crisis is severe, that Nederland contributed 500,000 euro earlier and an extra 2 million euro for UNHCR, and that the Dutch government has repeatedly urged Kenya to open the camp extension.

In addition, the Netherlands has held regular consultations in Nairobi with the Kenyan government on the refugee situation, both bilaterally and within the EU, repeatedly calling for the extension to be opened.

Daarnaast heeft Nederland in Nairobi geregeld overleg met de Keniaanse regering over de vluchtelingensituatie, zowel bilateraal als binnen EU-verband, waarbij meermaals is gepleit voor openstelling van de uitbreiding.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Rog en Asante ter vervanging van nr. 19 over doorberekenen toezichtskosten transnationaal onderwijs
Amends the Education Supervision Act so that all costs of supervising transnational education are charged to the institution, with amounts set by ministerial regulation.
The costs related to exercising supervision over compliance with article 1.19 of the Higher Education Act are borne by the higher education institution

De kosten die samenhangen met de uitoefening van het toezicht op de naleving van artikel 1.19 van de Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek, komen ten laste van de instelling voor hoger onderwijs
Amendement van de leden Asante en Rog over wettelijke eisen aan het verzorgen van opleidingen in het buitenland
Makes ministerial approval mandatory for offering education abroad, with statutory refusal grounds and a four-week parliamentary pre-submission of the implementing decree.
The Minister submits the draft general administrative order to both Houses of the States General
Onze Minister legt het ontwerp van een algemene maatregel van bestuur als bedoeld in het vierde en vijfde lid voor aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal.
Amendement van de leden Rog en Asante over doorberekenen toezichtskosten transnationaal onderwijs
Requires transnational education providers to bear the full cost of inspection of their activities, with amounts set by ministerial regulation.
are borne by the higher education institution on whose behalf the supervision is exercised
komen ten laste van de instelling voor hoger onderwijs ten behoeve waarvan de uitoefening van het toezicht plaatsvindt
Amendement van de leden Asante en Rog over een toestemmingsvereiste en terugvloeien van inkomsten

Requires ministerial permission for education abroad, lets the minister refuse or withdraw it on quality grounds, and requires the draft general administrative order on refusal grounds to be submitted to both chambers first.
The minister submits the draft general administrative order referred to in the fourth and fifth paragraphs to both chambers of the States General.
Onze Minister legt het ontwerp van een algemene maatregel van bestuur als bedoeld in het vierde en vijfde lid voor aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal.
Motie van de leden Mei Li Vos en Asante over actief aanbieden van schakeltrajecten
Motion asking the government to engage universities so bridging programmes are actively offered, to explore credit for them, and to end extra admission requirements for students.
universities do not actively offer pre-master programmes to students
universiteiten premasters niet actief aan studenten bieden
Motie van de leden Bruins en Asante over goede en laagdrempelige psychische hulpverlening op iedere instelling
Asks the government to consult higher education institutions and student organisations on an action plan for accessible psychological care at every institution.
requests the government to consult higher education institutions, student psychologists and student organisations
verzoekt de regering, in overleg te treden met instellingen in het hoger onderwijs, studentenpsychologen en studentenorganisaties
Motie van het lid Verhoeven c.s. over het waarborgen van de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs
Motion asks the government to safeguard accessibility of higher education by agreeing frameworks with student unions on selection in master programmes.
requests the government to safeguard accessibility of higher education at sector and institution level
verzoekt de regering om, de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs op sectoraal en instellingsniveau te waarborgen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asante inzake hogescholen en universiteiten die onrechtmatige studiekosten in rekening brengen bij studenten.

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether higher education institutions charging students extra mandatory fees beyond tuition, tied to study credits, is unlawful, and what the Minister will do about it. The Minister acknowledged the reports, said such charges are undesirable and that the Inspectorate has been asked to assess them with enforcement if needed, and committed to working with the ISO and reviewing the rules with institutional bodies.
The ISO has since sent me the inventory and it was then shared with the Inspectorate of Education. I have asked the inspectorate to assess this.
Het ISO heeft mij de inventarisatie inmiddels doen toekomen en deze is vervolgens gedeeld met de Inspectie van het Onderwijs. Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asante over prijzige stoomcursussen voor aankomende studenten

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether expensive commercial 'stoomcursussen' preparing students for selection days create inequality and what the government will do about selection in higher education. The minister agreed they are undesirable, said schools and institutions should prepare students and that numerus fixus programmes fell from 199 to 91, and pointed to LOB reforms and access initiatives without committing to new binding measures.
I find it very undesirable when candidate students feel the need to use such commercial steam courses.
Ik vind het zeer ongewenst wanneer kandidaat-studenten de noodzaak ervaren gebruik te moeten maken van dergelijke commerciële stoomcursussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Asante over het vertrek van een leerling van het Waterlant College

MPs Vermue and Asante asked about a pupil who left Waterlant College after reportedly being the only white pupil in his class and facing bullying, and about segregation and parental involvement in schools. The state secretary called the situation undesirable, said the Inspectorate has been in contact with the school and will discuss the case with the governing body, and pointed to existing anti-bullying duties and support tools without committing to a new investigation.
Following earlier contact with the school management, the inspectorate will discuss this case with the competent authority of Waterlant College in the short term.
In vervolg op het eerdere contact met de schoolleiding zal de inspectie deze zaak op korte termijn bespreken met het bevoegd gezag van het Waterlant College.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Tanamal en Asante inzake het aanbod van psychische hulp voor studenten

Two MPs asked the ministers whether student psychological help is adequately provided and facilitated across higher education institutions, and whether taboos and access barriers are being addressed. The minister answered that institutions decide staffing, that national norms are unnecessary, that all universities offer psychological help, and that regular mental health care and open institutional culture are the proper routes.
It is up to the institutions themselves to decide how many student psychologists they appoint.
Het is aan de instellingen zelf om te bepalen hoeveel studentpsychologen zij aanstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Asante over Mantelzorgende studenten

Two MPs asked the state secretary and education minister about carer students' stress, dropout and support by institutions and municipalities. The government answered that support is case-by-case via study advisers and hardship funds, pointed to municipal duties under the Wmo 2015, and described a flexible-study experiment, without committing to new national programmes.
In a letter to the aldermen I will ask for attention to this.
In een brief aan de wethouders zal ik hier aandacht voor vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asante inzake ontgroeningen door studentenverenigingen van studenten aan universiteiten en hogescholen

An MP asked the education minister how she views the hazing (ontgroening) practices of student associations at Groningen and Amsterdam, whether the Groningen university's initial response and the association's culture are acceptable, and whether she will force universities to impose harsher sanctions. The minister condemned the incidents, said the university and the Hanzehogeschool have agreed hazing must end, spoke with the national association council, and said she will keep discussing sanctions with institutions without committing to binding measures.
I expect them to act firmly against student associations where such unacceptable incidents take place.
Ik verwacht dat zij stevig optreden tegen studentenverenigingen waar dergelijke ontoelaatbare incidenten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Marcouch en Asante over een ernstig incident bij een ontgroening in Groningen

MPs Recourt, Marcouch and Asante asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a serious injury during a Groningen student hazing and whether criminal prosecution, victim reporting, and a 25,000 euro confidentiality fine clause in a student association contract are legally valid. The Minister said mistreatment is condemnable, the public prosecutor opened an ex officio investigation, the association filed a report, and the confidentiality fine is a civil, not criminal, sanction that can be contested or moderated.
While this investigation is ongoing, I will not make substantive statements.
Lopende dit onderzoek doe ik geen inhoudelijke mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asante inzake Studiefinanciering bij een schakeljaar

An MP asks whether students on bridging programmes (schakeltrajecten) that are not counted as full-time education can be denied student finance by DUO, and how this is justified. The minister answers that such programmes are not accredited degree programmes, are self-funded like other contract education, and students can use savings, work, parental support or living at home; a ResearchNed study on their number is pending and will be sent in early 2017.
These programmes are not accredited courses and do not lead to a diploma, but facilitate progression.
Deze trajecten zijn geen geaccrediteerde opleidingen en leiden niet op tot een diploma, maar faciliteren doorstroom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Kabinet, schep duidelijkheid over de verhuisboete voor bedrijven'

An MP from the VVD asks the government about the proposed conditional final dividend tax settlement (Spoedwet conditionele eindafrekening dividendbelasting) and its effects on the Dutch investment climate, legal soundness, EU and treaty obligations, and SMEs. The government replies that it has serious objections on effectiveness, treaty conflict, free movement of capital, state aid risk and legal uncertainty, and that the Council of State advised against proceeding.
The cabinet has several objections to the bill.
Het kabinet heeft meerdere bezwaren tegen het initiatiefwetsvoorstel.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de aanschaf van beademingsapparatuur die niet bruikbaar is op de intensive care

Two SP MPs asked whether part of the first 100 ventilators from Philips, and planned Demcon machines, are unsuitable for ICU use, and asked about expert advice, serial numbers, distribution lists and disposables. The minister answered only by referring to a COVID-19 update letter, providing no substance on the questions themselves.

The written questions from MPs Hijink and Marijnissen (both SP) to the ministers of Medical Care and Economic Affairs and Climate about the purchase of ventilation equipment unusable in intensive care (2020Z06022) have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (beiden SP) aan de ministers voor Medische Zorg en van Economische Zaken en Klimaat over de aanschaf van beademingsapparatuur die niet bruikbaar is op de intensive care ( 2020Z06022 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de rampzalige kaalkap van bossen voor biomassa

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that large forest areas in Estonia and Latvia are being clear-cut for wood pellets used in the Netherlands, and whether earlier denials and the policy on biomass are defensible. The minister denies that whole forests are cut for Dutch pellets, cites Estonian data showing forest area growing, defends biomass as climate-neutral during the transition, and promises to revert on the Van Esch motion on ending subsidies.
I will revert as soon as possible on the implementation of the Van Esch motion (Kamerstuk 30 175, no. 360).
Ik kom zo spoedig mogelijk terug op de uitvoering van Motie Van Esch (Kamerstuk 30 175, nr. 360 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het uitfaseren van subsidies voor houtige biomassa

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about phasing out subsidies for woody biomass, citing a PBL advice, the CO2 accounting of biomass, and the ecological and emissions concerns raised by experts and NGOs. The minister answered in detail on volumes, subsidy amounts (about 4.95 billion euro for 2020-2032 in the table, 9.5 billion in total commitments), the carbon-neutrality assumption, and the phase-out timeline, but committed to a later response on the Van Esch motion and left the phase-out date to a future cabinet.
I will return shortly on the implementation of the Van Esch motion (Kamerstuk 30 175, no. 360).
Ik kom op korte termijn terug op de uitvoering van Motie Van Esch (Kamerstuk 30 175, nr. 360).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het artikel 'Buitenlandse investeerders gaan er vandoor met miljoenensubsidies én winst van zonneparken'

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports that foreign investors own most of the largest solar parks and take subsidy money abroad, and how this fits the Climate Agreement's 50% local ownership goal. The minister disputes the scale of the subsidy-outflow claim, says foreign ownership is acceptable in a free European market, and says local ownership will grow and best-practice guidance for municipalities is being prepared, but declines to change SDE++ conditions.
I therefore do not take a negative view of such developments.
Ik sta dan ook niet negatief tegenover dergelijke ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Bisschop over het opkopen van zonneparken door buitenlandse investeerders

Two SGP MPs asked the ministers about foreign investors buying up large solar parks, the resulting outflow of subsidy money, and whether ownership and landscape-integration commitments could be enforced. The minister defended open resale and said there is no generic 50% local-ownership obligation, stating that participation remains voluntary and municipalities can only require good-faith efforts.
I therefore do not take a negative view of reselling solar parks to (foreign) investors.
Ik sta dan ook niet negatief tegenover het doorverkopen van zonneparken aan (buitenlandse) investeerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de duurzaamheid van houtige biomassa

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Estonian forest cutting, whether the Dutch sustainability certification schemes for wood biomass (SBP, FSC, PEFC) guarantee sustainability, and how they are controlled. The minister disputed the reported forest-area decline, said the schemes meet Dutch criteria and that checks by accredited bodies apply, but declined to disclose company certificate use and specific shipment details as confidential.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Laçin en Van Kent over het vrijkomen van kankerverwekkend chroom-6 bij werkzaamheden aan de Onyxkolencentrale

MPs asked whether chromium-6 released during maintenance at the Onyx coal plant exposed workers, whether independent investigation and compensation are in place, and whether the plant closes on 1 January 2021 and how much subsidy goes to workers. The minister replied that the Inspectorate found no proven exposure but could not exclude it, ordered dust clean-up and tighter controls, said closure timing depends on subsidy conditions, and noted that employer liability and a planned hardship scheme for occupational disease are being developed.
That is not known to me.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het artikel 'Ik wil niet meer alleen maar over de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) praten'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked the ministers why a permit for replacing a damaged manure cellar in Groningen has taken eighteen months, and what can speed up gas-damage procedures. The minister explains that permitting lies with municipalities and the province, that the Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen is still reviewing sector responses to its expert advice on manure-cellar damage, and points to the Versterken bill and coordination efforts to speed up procedures.
The permitting process for building a manure basin falls under the authority of the municipality and province.
Het vergunningsproces voor de bouw van een mestbassin valt onder het gezag van gemeente en provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het vaststellen van Erkende Maatregelen

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about how Erkende Maatregelen for energy saving are set, including whether subsidies should be counted in payback calculations and whether a transparent framework exists. The minister answers that the payback methodology was fixed in 2019, that subsidies are deliberately excluded because they are uncertain and not mandatory, and that the lists will be updated in 2021-2022 with Parliament informed during 2021.
Parliament will be informed during 2021 about the process and planning of the next update.
Uw Kamer wordt in de loop van 2021 geïnformeerd over het proces en de planning van de volgende actualisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over energiebesparing van datacenters

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about energy-saving obligations for new data centres, which fall under the EU ETS and are exempt from Wet milieubeheer energy-saving duties, and about PUE standards and waste heat. The minister confirmed the exemption, said a review of norms for ETS firms is ongoing with a decision left to a future cabinet, declined to give individual PUE figures, and pointed to planned broadening of the energy-saving duty and the Wet Collectieve Warmtevoorziening heat-pickup right.
It is up to a future cabinet to decide on any norms for energy saving.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om over eventuele normering op energiebesparing te besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Grote bedrijven maken hun belofte om energie te besparen niet waar'

A Labour Party MP (Van der Lee, GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that large companies had not met their energy-saving pledges under the MEE agreement, including an unexplained 24 PJ residual. The minister denied the residual was excluded, argued total energy use fell in 2019, and said the agreements lacked sanctions and are being reviewed, with a decision left to a future cabinet.
This item has been included in the results of the MEE agreement.
Deze post is meegenomen in de resultaten van het MEE-convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over ondernemers in Groningen en Fryslân die knel komen te zitten

MPs Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk and Moorlag asked whether start-up businesses hit by COVID-19 measures, such as hairdressers and hospitality firms without a reference turnover, are adequately compensated and whether the schemes could be changed. The State Secretary replied that a new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme will cover start-ups' fixed costs, that monthly turnover calculations are not feasible, and that fully closed sectors get up to 85% fixed-cost subsidy.
