With the new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme, the cabinet wants to give these entrepreneurs a reasonable subsidy for their fixed costs.
Met de nieuwe regeling Tegemoetkoming Starters wil het kabinet deze ondernemers een redelijke subsidie bieden voor hun vaste lasten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het rapport van Gronings Perspectief over Voortgang en voetangels in het gaswinningsdossiers, Professionals over een complex systeem

An MP asked the ministers about a Groningen Perspectief report finding that officials and professionals in the gas-extraction file are overburdened by a fragmented, complex system. The minister reports that NAM has no role in damage handling or reinforcement, outlines existing channels, the reinforcement bill and communication measures, and largely states that existing processes are sufficient without committing to a structural change.

It is of great importance that the central government, the region, experts, the House and civil society organisations remain in constant contact to reach the best possible solutions for the situation in Groningen.

Het is van groot belang dat Rijk, regio, experts, Kamer en maatschappelijke organisaties voortdurend met elkaar in contact blijven om tot de best mogelijke oplossingen voor de situatie in Groningen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Nauwelijks coronasteun voor startende ondernemers: 'Ik hou het nog drie maanden vol'’

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked why businesses founded in 2020 cannot access the NOW and TVL COVID support schemes, and what alternatives were considered. The State Secretary answered that a separate Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme will use Q3 2020 as reference revenue, with about 180 million euro budgeted, after alternatives such as constructed reference revenue and flat payments were rejected for fairness and feasibility reasons.
To be able to support businesses that started in the period from 1 October 2019 through 30 June 2020, the cabinet will develop a separate scheme for starters.
Om ondernemingen die zijn gestart in de periode vanaf 1 oktober 2019 tot en met 30 juni 2020 te kunnen ondersteunen, zal het kabinet een separate regeling voor starters ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Verhoeven, Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat er tientallen communistische partijcomités binnen Nederlandse bedrijven in China bestaan

MPs from D66 and CDA asked the government whether it knew of Chinese Communist Party committees in Dutch companies in China, what economic or strategic effects this has, whether the government has agreements with these firms, and whether intellectual property is being stolen. The minister answers that the government is aware of such committees and offers general advice to firms, cites an EU Chamber survey suggesting limited influence, says precise numbers of party-linked board members are not held, and declines to comment on intelligence investigations.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on specific investigations by the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Over specifieke onderzoeken van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het artikel 'Zonne-eilanden in IJsselmeer als mogelijke energiebron'

MPs Bromet and Van der Lee asked the ministers about a proposal for solar islands on the IJsselmeer, the route map for solar on water, the Agenda IJsselmeergebied 2050, and the Wieringerhoek MIRT project that excluded energy generation. The minister answered that a route map was sent to parliament, a pilot pre-study is ordered, the Wieringerhoek scope will be assessed at the planuitwerkingsfase, and more clarity is expected in 2021 and autumn 2021.
In addition, Rijkswaterstaat has been commissioned to carry out a pre-study for a pilot with floating solar panels on the IJsselmeer.
Daarnaast is opdracht gegeven aan Rijkswaterstaat tot een pre-verkenning voor een pilot met drijvende zonnepanelen op het IJsselmeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van der Lee over het bericht dat het Noorse verzekeringsbedrijf ‘DNV GL’ de certificatie voor Nord Stream 2 intrekt

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about DNV GL withdrawing certifications for Nord Stream 2, the consequences for completion, the status of the court and arbitration cases, and enforcement of the EU gas directive. The government answered that alternative routes are unknown, that it opposes US sanctions but will not anticipate their effects, that the cases are pending and the gas directive is currently applied strictly, and that it will not comment on matters before courts.
It is not appropriate for the cabinet to respond to matters that are before the courts.
Het past het kabinet niet om te reageren op zaken die onder de rechter zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over transparantie en duidelijkheid bij nieuwe kleine gasvelden

An MP asked the minister about transparency and participation for five new small gas fields near the Drenthe, Friesland and Overijssel border, the cumulative subsidence effects, and binding energy-transition conditions. The minister says participation sessions are being organised, explains why the fields are treated separately while cumulative effects are assessed by TNO and SodM, and says a Ternaard-style benefit agreement is being considered but decisions will outlast this cabinet.
I share your view that improvements in the reasoning of the decision on the Westerveld extraction plan, where applicable, should also be taken into account in future decisions.
Ik deel uw mening dat verbeteringen in de motivering van het besluit op het winningsplan Westerveld, indien van toepassing, ook betrokken moeten worden bij toekomstige besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘het rücksichtslos afsluiten van energie in een seniorenwoning’

An SP MP asked why an energy network operator disconnected a pensioner's flat for six months without arranging a new connection or a settlement, and whether rules should be tightened. The minister answers that the disconnection followed the prescribed policy after repeated warnings and a court ruling, that the recent Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening amendment and a covenant will reduce disconnections, and sees no need for further talks with Stedin.
Disconnecting energy may therefore not simply be done.
Afsluiten van energie mag dan ook niet zomaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat een glastuinbouwbedrijf door de verhoogde Opslag Duurzame Energieheffing (ODE) overschakelt van elektriciteit naar gas

An MP asked the ministers whether the rise in the ODE energy levy, which pushes a greenhouse firm back from electricity to gas, undermines electrification and whether compensation will be paid. The government acknowledged the fiscal incentive problem, promised a compensation scheme and an evaluation in spring, but refused to revisit the levy rates in the short term.
I am not prepared to reconsider the rates in the short term.
Ik ben niet bereid om de tarieven op korte termijn te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de weeffout in de subsidiëring voor CO2-afvang en -opslag (Carbon Capture Storage)

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the SDE++ subsidy for carbon capture and storage (CCS) is distorted by the national CO2 levy and ETS prices, and whether this delays the energy transition, across 20 questions. The Minister rejects the alleged flaws, defends the design of the levy and the subsidy, notes that bank guarantees and the 7.2 Mt cap limit the risk, and states that the requested tender figures will follow after assessment.
At this moment the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO.nl) is assessing and checking the applications.
Op dit moment is de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO.nl) bezig met het beoordelen en controleren van de aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over "hedge funds en vermogensbeheerders die NOW steun ontvangen"

An MP asked whether hedge funds and asset managers receive NOW wage-subsidy support, whether bonuses to non-board traders are paid with public money, and whether support should be restricted or clawed back. The minister replied that eligibility is sector-neutral, no separate register of such firms exists, the bonus ban covers only management and board, and no clawback or new restrictions are planned beyond existing rules.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Harbers over het bericht dat bewoners in Transvaal al dagen in de kou zitten

MPs Koerhuis and Harbers asked about residents of Transvaal in The Hague left without heating for days, a shortfall on the Energiek 2 district heating network owned by housing corporation Staedion, and whether corporations may run heat networks and why they are exempt from the Warmtewet licensing requirement. The minister answered that outages affected about 50 then about 20 homes, that tenants' protection lies with tenancy law and courts or the Huurcommissie, that ACM may enforce for non-tenants, and that no revision of the exemption is planned.
For tenants, disputes can be brought before the court or the Huurcommissie.
Bij geschillen ligt voor huurders de weg naar de rechter of Huurcommissie open.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Agnes Mulder, Sienot, Bromet, Nijboer en Dik-Faber over het rekenmodel waardedalingsregeling dat gedupeerden benadeelt

MPs asked whether the IMG's depreciation model disadvantages the hardest-hit Groningen homes and whether the minister would intervene to apply an individual-level alternative proposed by De Kam and Blanken. The minister replied that the IMG independently sets its own method under the Tijdelijke wet Groningen, that it chose the variant giving the highest average outcomes, and that intervening would undermine its independence, though objections and appeals remain available.
It is not for me but for the IMG to determine, within the legal framework, which method it uses to handle all types of damage, including depreciation damage.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan het IMG om binnen de wettelijke kaders te bepalen welke werkwijze zij hanteert voor de afhandeling van alle schadevormen, waaronder schade door waardedaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de subsidieregeling Specifieke uitkering ventilatie in scholen

An MP asks the Dutch government about the SIVUS subsidy scheme for school ventilation, including whether school boards or municipalities bear primary responsibility for funding building ventilation and whether the investment ban for school boards is compatible with the required substantial works. The minister replies that school boards and municipalities share responsibility, that a bill to ease investment rules and an interdepartmental review are underway, and that funds have already been made available.
As communicated earlier before the summer, a bill is being prepared to improve the planning of housing investments.
Zoals eerder voor de zomer gecommuniceerd, is een wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding om de planvorming voor investeringen in huisvesting te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht 'EU-akkoord over klimaat: 55 procent minder uitstoot in 2030'

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the EU agreement to cut emissions 55% by 2030, the implications for the Netherlands, the gap with the national climate target, and green recovery investment. The minister welcomes the EU target, says the Klimaatakkoord is progressing, commits to an inter-ministerial study group report and to leaving the remaining gap to the next cabinet.
The study group's report was sent to your House on 29 January.
Het rapport van de studiegroep is op 29 januari jl. aan uw Kamer verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het winnen van gas onder Spijkenisse

An MP asked the minister about gas extraction under Spijkenisse, including delayed seismic monitoring stations, reported tremors, damage claims and information for residents. The minister answered that the stations were installed and connected, no earthquakes were registered, and that a compensation commission and a risk management plan exist.
I have already stipulated in the approval decision that the measuring station must be placed and connected to the KNMI network by 13 January 2021.
Ik heb reeds in het instemmingsbesluit vastgelegd dat het meetstation voor 13 januari 2021 geplaatst en aangesloten dient te zijn op het KNMI-netwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over de Gasopslag in Norg

MPs Dik-Faber and Mulder asked about seismic risk, ground movement and damage compensation linked to the Norg gas storage, including the IMG's suspension of damage claim decisions in Drenthe. The minister answers that risks are low, that monitoring and the IMG's compensation process are adequate, and that the IMG is independent and is awaiting TU Delft and TNO advice.
The IMG is independent in its working method as a zbo. I attach great value to this independence; the IMG itself decides how it handles the aforementioned damage claims.
Het IMG is als zbo onafhankelijk in haar werkwijze. Ik hecht grote waarde aan deze onafhankelijkheid, het IMG bepaalt zelf hoe het omgaat met bovengenoemde schade-afhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Slootweg en Amhaouch over het gedrag van Centric-topman Gerard Sanderink

CDA MPs asked ministers about Centric executive Gerard Sanderink's alleged threats to an inspector, destruction of evidence, ignored court rulings, and DNB's reliance on Centric software. The government answered that it would not publish his correspondence absent a request from investigators, that DNB as a contract partner monitors Centric, and that it cannot judge a private firm, while describing supervisory board powers in general terms.
At this moment I see no reason to make the correspondence in question public without a request from the bodies you mention.
Ik zie op dit moment geen redenen om bedoelde correspondentie openbaar te maken zonder dat daar een verzoek ligt van door u genoemde instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het nieuwe investeringsbeleid van de Nederlandse ontwikkelingsbank (FMO)

An MP asks the Dutch government about FMO's proposed phase-out of fossil fuel investments, including gas, and whether the state as shareholder should require alignment with the Climate Agreement. The minister answers that FMO has not yet decided, that the state is a distant shareholder leaving individual investment choices to FMO, and that the government is pursuing gradual phase-out in multilateral finance.
However, the state is a distant shareholder. It is up to the holdings themselves to determine how individual investments relate to climate-related and other (impact) objectives.

De staat is echter aandeelhouder op afstand. Het is aan deelnemingen zelf om te bepalen hoe individuele investeringen zich verhouden tot klimaat gerelateerde doelstellingen en andere (impact) doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Van Raan over het artikel 'Stukken bos kaalgekapt in Estland voor Nederlandse biomassacentrales'

MPs Sienot, Dik-Faber and Van Raan asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports that whole forests in Estonia were clear-cut to supply Dutch biomass plants, and about controls and sustainability. The minister disputed that this reflects the picture, pointed to strict Dutch sustainability criteria, certification and verification by conformity bodies, and promised to investigate the signal further and discuss it with Estonia.
I want to investigate this signal further and enter into discussion with the authors of the report 'The dark side of the wood pellet'.
Ik wil dit signaal verder onderzoeken en in gesprek gaan met de opstellers van het rapport «De duistere kant van de houtpellet».

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de brief van 19 december 2019 van de gemeente Horst aan de Maas aan mij over geothermie in Noord- en Midden Limburg en het nieuwsbericht ‘Aardwar

MPs Van der Lee and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked about a Horst aan de Maas letter and news report on halting geothermal projects in Limburg over possible seismic links, and the roles of the ministry and SodM. Minister Wiebes answered that geothermal near the Roer fault is not yet safe enough, that SodM is supervisor and adviser, and that he sees no pilot project as a good idea.
SodM is first of all a supervisor and in addition an adviser in the permitting process, including for the extraction plan.
SodM is allereerst toezichthouder en daarnaast adviseur in het vergunningsverleningsproces, waaronder ook bij het winningsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht 'Vergoeding lekke mestkelder ‘lachertje’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about reports that compensation for leaking manure cellars damaged by Groningen earthquakes would be based on economic rather than actual damage, and about timelines and the IMG's approach. The government answered that the IMG will publish its method for manure cellar damage in early 2021, that the expert panel advised repair costs unless they exceed 1.25 times capitalised business damage, and that the IMG's independence limits pre-empting its decision.
It is not appropriate for me to anticipate this, also given the independence of the IMG.
Het past mij niet, ook gelet op de onafhankelijkheid van IMG, hier nu al op vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over samenwerking Nederlandse universiteiten met China.

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers about Dutch universities' cooperation with China, including whether contracts are tracked centrally, whether guidelines exist, and whether China-specific rules are needed. The government answered that institutions are autonomous and not obliged to register partnerships centrally, that RVO found faculty-level MoUs sometimes escape university board view, and that landen-neutral knowledge-security guidelines are being drafted for the second quarter of 2021.
I will, together with my colleagues, discuss this with the knowledge sector to explore what (administrative) agreements can be made on this.
Ik ga, samen met mijn collega's, hierover in gesprek met de kennissector om te onderzoeken op welke manier we hier (bestuurlijke) afspraken over kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de waardedalingsregeling

MPs ask why owners of homes slated for demolition or rebuilding are excluded from the Groningen home-value-loss compensation, why some applications are rejected, why residents in some postcode areas or who moved away are excluded, and whether NAM-compensated residents can get reassessment. The minister answers that the IMG applies a methodology based on advisory committee advice, that demolished/rebuilt homes are generally assessed as having gained value, that rejections follow legal limits, that a 2021 external review of past NAM settlements is planned, and that most decisions meet the 8-week deadline.
I have informed your House that, to give a well-founded answer on whether residents have been treated justly, I will request an independent assessment based on research by an external party.

Ik heb uw Kamer inmiddels meegedeeld (Kamerstuk 33 529, nr. 832 ) dat ik, om een goed onderbouwd antwoord te kunnen geven op de vraag of bewoners recht is gedaan, een onafhankelijk oordeel zal vragen op basis van onderzoek door een externe partij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Amhaouch en Postma over het bericht 'Onbegrip bij provincie over weigering Rijk om informatie voor stikstofaanpak te delen'

CDA MPs asked the agriculture minister why the national government refuses to share nitrogen-related farm data with provinces on privacy grounds, and whether this delays regional nitrogen plans, and asked about a study focusing on peak-polluting farms. The minister answered that privacy-sensitive data is not essential, that provinces already hold much of the information, that work on an alternative data-access solution is ongoing, and that the study reflects only one part of the broader approach.
I am working with RVO and BIJ12 (on behalf of the provinces) on an alternative solution to make the last part of the relevant information accessible to the provinces.
Ik werk samen met RVO en BIJ12 (namens de provincies) aan een alternatieve oplossing om het laatste deel van de relevante informatie toegankelijk te maken voor de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over zandwinning

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about sand extraction in the North Sea, including whether sand used to compensate subsidence from gas and salt mining is a justified use of a scarce resource and whether a priority rule applies. The minister answered that North Sea sand is not scarce for the Netherlands, that sand extraction for coastal protection has national priority under the Nationaal Waterplan, and that the questions could not be answered in time before the committee meeting.
For the Netherlands, sand from the North Sea cannot be called scarce.
Voor Nederland geldt dat het zand afkomstig uit de Noordzee niet schaars te noemen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het uitblijven van een vervolgingsbeslissing in de strafzaak tegen de NAM

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked why the public prosecutor has still not decided on prosecuting the NAM five years after the Groninger Bodem Beweging filed its complaint, despite the investigation being completed in September 2019, and whether the delay amounts to a de facto refusal to prosecute. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the investigation and assessment were complex, that the NAM's response period and COVID-19 caused further delay, and that the prosecution service will publish its outcome and position soon, while declining to comment on the Court of Appeal's findings or on the merits of pending decisions.

Moreover, the prosecution service has informed me that it will soon make the outcome of the investigation public, and at that point the position the prosecution service takes in this case will also be made public.

Overigens heeft het OM mij bericht dat zij binnen afzienbare tijd naar buiten komen met de uitkomsten van het onderzoek en dan zal tevens het standpunt dat het OM in deze zaak inneemt, naar buiten worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de ontwikkeling en distributie van coronavaccins

An SP MP asks the health and economic affairs ministers about COVID-19 vaccine patents, C-TAP participation, global distribution, public funding, pricing transparency, mRNA safety and vaccination registration. The minister defends the intellectual property system, says compulsory licences are not currently warranted, cites confidentiality for withholding price details, and promises further information to parliament.
The information is preferably public, but may remain confidential because of commercially sensitive information or the negotiating position.
De informatie is bij voorkeur openbaar, maar kan omwille van bedrijfsgevoelige informatie, of de onderhandelingspositie, vertrouwelijk blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de schadelijke gezondheidseffecten van windmolens en biomassacentrales

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether wind turbines and biomass plants harm residents' health, why they are not removed, whether enforcement via penalties or shutdowns has been used, and whether climate policy is harmful. The government replied that noise norms protect residents, that evidence of direct health effects is lacking, that three penalty orders for turbine noise have been imposed since 2013, and that it does not accept that climate policy is harmful.

I have asked the RIVM to make existing knowledge on low-frequency noise in general, including from sources other than wind turbines, more accessible and to examine which aspects of low-frequency noise require further research.

Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd om de bestaande kennis omtrent laagfrequent geluid in het algemeen, dus ook afkomstig van andere bronnen dan windmolens, beter toegankelijk te maken en na te gaan naar welke aspecten van laagfrequent geluid nader onderzoek gewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht ‘Onafhankelijk onderzoek pro-kernenergie blijkt van oud directeur Borssele’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a pro-nuclear study (ENCO report) was compromised because one of its authors was a former director of the Borssele nuclear plant and chairs a nuclear-promotion organisation, and whether it should be reviewed by an independent body such as PBL. The minister answered that the author's involvement ended about ten years earlier, that expertise rather than conflict of interest drove the selection, that ENCO also works for anti-nuclear governments, and that there is no reason to distance the government from the report or to have it independently reviewed.
In my view, conflict of interest is not at issue here.
Volgens mij is belangenverstrengeling hier niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Nederlands kabinet vindt eisen Europees coronafonds lastig’

An MP asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs why the cabinet would not submit a national recovery plan in the first EU window and whether Dutch firms would lose EU coronavirus recovery funds as a result. The minister replied that the final decision is left to the incoming cabinet, that Dutch funds are not lost because later submission windows remain open, and that the government is taking other steps to protect the level playing field.
The cabinet deliberately chooses to leave the final decision on the reforms and investments to be included in the Recovery and Resilience Plan to the new cabinet.

Het kabinet kiest er bewust voor om het definitieve besluit over de hervormingen en investeringen die in het Recovery and Resilience Plan ( RRP) worden opgenomen door het nieuwe kabinet te laten nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van der Lee over het rapport van ENCO

MPs Sienot and Van der Lee ask the minister about the ENCO report on nuclear energy, questioning its quality, independence, assumptions about renewables and costs, and how it was commissioned. The minister answers that the study followed proper procurement and transparency rules, will release the related documents after the Wet Openbaarheid van bestuur procedure, and defends the report's assumptions while declining a separate review before the roundtable.
Once the procedure has been carefully completed, I will send the documents to your House.
Nadat de procedure zorgvuldig is doorlopen, zal ik de stukken aan uw Kamer zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Ploumen over mijn eerdere antwoorden op Kamervragen over een zinkgat in Kerkrade

MPs Beckerman, Nijboer and Ploumen pressed the minister on who is liable for damage from a sinkhole in Kerkrade, whether the Waarborgfonds Mijnbouwschade had been contacted, whether residents were informed of risks, whether 12 people lived in the adjacent building, and what lessons were learned. The minister answered that the Waarborgfonds is liable for mining damage to private persons, that no structural damage to homes has been found, that the municipality handles communication, that the adjacent building was unoccupied apart from a foundation's use, and that lessons will be discussed after remediation finishes in June 2021.
Some time after the shaft is tapped, remediation of the shaft begins.
Vervolgens wordt enige tijd na het aanboren van de schacht de sanering aangevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van den Berg, Palland, Postma en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Keuringsinstantie DCI Joure (NKIP) in Chinese handen'

MPs from the CDA asked the Infrastructure and Environment and Economic Affairs ministers whether the Dutch yacht certification body DCI Joure, which became fully Chinese-owned in November 2019, poses risks, whether the takeover could have been screened, and what monitoring applies. The government answered that the takeover falls outside existing investment screening, that accreditation by the RvA and supervision by the ILT ensure quality and independence, and that it sees no national security risk.
The cabinet establishes that there are no risks to national security from the takeover of this body, which oversees the quality of pleasure craft.
Het kabinet stelt vast dat er voor de nationale veiligheid geen risico’s zijn bij de overname van deze instantie, die toeziet op de kwaliteit van plezierjachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de investeringsaftrek voor windenergie op zee

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether windfarm investment should be made attractive, given the investment deduction available to offshore gas. The minister replied that offshore wind is key to the energy transition, that the investment deduction applies only to oil and gas projects under the Mining Act, and that the government will send a broader letter on the future rollout of offshore wind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Bromet over het artikel 'NAM wil productiewater Schoonebeek injecteren in Drentse gasvelden'

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers about NAM's plan to inject produced water from Schoonebeek into Drenthe gas fields, including cross-border risks and the lack of direct information to the German municipality of Emlichheim. The minister answered that no cross-border risks are currently expected, that the municipality was informed via documents but not actively involved under the bilateral framework, and that risks will be examined in an MER and permit process overseen by SodM.
For the planned injection in the Schoonebeek region there are currently no cross-border environmental effects.
Bij de voorgenomen injectie in de regio Schoonebeek is er op dit moment geen sprake van grensoverschrijdende milieugevolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bieden van perspectief aan ondernemers na de gedeeltelijke lockdown en het onderzoek naar aanleiding van het OMT-advies over restaurants

An MP from the VVD asked the government how it would respond to the OMT advice on restaurants and the promised talks with hospitality and events sectors about prospects after the partial lockdown, including progress on FieldLab initiatives. The government answered that talks with sector representatives are ongoing, that segmented measures are being discussed, that FieldLab programmes for events are being developed with a possible start in January, and that the RIVM advice on the events FieldLab is pending.
The cabinet would like sectors to come forward with new initiatives if these can offer new prospects.
Het kabinet ziet graag dat sectoren zich melden met nieuwe initiatieven als die nieuwe perspectieven kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over onderbetaling bij de RVO

MPs Van Dijk and Moorlag asked why externally hired staff at RVO, via detacher USG Legal, receive lower pay than colleagues doing the same work, and what the government will do about it. The minister says RVO is not the formal employer, the contractor's own terms apply under a results-based contract, the Inspectie SZW found the wage-ratio norm was breached, and that the government will respond to the advisory team's recommendations on temporary work agencies.
However, article 27 of the General Government Terms for Services (ARVODI), which apply to the framework agreement, provides that the staffing agencies as formal employers must act as good employers.

Wel is in artikel 27 van de Algemene Rijksvoorwaarden voor Diensten (ARVODI) die van toepassing zijn op de raamovereenkomst bepaald dat de detacheringsbureaus als de formele werkgevers zich als goed werkgever gedragen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het bericht 'Nieuwe studie: elektrische auto gaat langer mee dan gedacht'

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked the ministers how the TU Eindhoven study showing longer EV lifespans and lower battery CO2 emissions affects climate policy and the cost-effectiveness calculations of the Klimaatakkoord. The Staatssecretaris largely endorsed the study, defended the cost-effectiveness estimates with sensitivity analyses, said the models are kept up to date, and promised to improve consumer information on used EVs.
The ministry will continue to monitor these developments.
Het ministerie blijft deze ontwikkelingen monitoren.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Is er nog leven voor VDL Nedcar na 2023 nu BMW afhaakt’

MPs Amhaouch and Van Helvert asked the government whether it had contacts with VDL Nedcar, BMW or the German government about BMW ending its contract, which ministries are involved in finding a solution, and whether an integral action plan for the region will be made. Minister Wiebes answered that contacts with VDL Nedcar and BMW took place at high level, no contact with the German government occurred on the contract, several ministries and NFIA help find new clients, and a regional development package with funding and road projects is being pursued.
The cabinet is generally reticent about publishing information on the content of specific contacts with businesses.
Het kabinet is over het algemeen terughoudend met het publiceren van informatie over de inhoud van specifieke contacten met het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Paternotte over het artikel ‘Losser wil pilotgebied worden voor uitwisseling duurzame energie met Duitsland’

MPs Sienot and Paternotte asked whether cross-border medium-voltage electricity exchange between Dutch, German and Belgian border municipalities could be enabled, and whether Losser, Emmen and Kerkrade could be designated pilot Local Energy Communities. Minister Wiebes answered that EU rules on interconnection must be kept, that he will not change them, and that he will not designate pilot areas because communities can be set up by residents and municipalities themselves.
These European rules and principles I cannot and will not change.
Deze Europese spelregels en principes kan en wil ik niet veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het verzekeren van zonnepanelen en voor de kosten van het opruimen van schade veroorzaakt door brand bij zonnepanelen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about insurability of rooftop solar panels and who pays for cleanup of particles spread after fires, and whether food safety is checked. The minister answered that industry and insurers are working on quality standards and cleanup methods, that no new government intervention is planned, that producers bear food-safety responsibility under NVWA supervision, and that RIVM and IFV research is ongoing.
At this moment, beyond continuing these talks, I foresee no additional role for the government here.
Op dit moment voorzie ik hier bovenop de voortzetting van deze gesprekken geen aanvullende rol voor de overheid in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de klimaatplannen van olie- en gasbedrijven

An MP asks the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Finance whether oil and gas companies' climate plans are adequate for 1.5°C, about Shell's greenwashing, fossil fuel licensing, tax incentives, export credit and FMO financing, advertising, and the Climate Day platform for Shell and BP. The minister largely defends continued gas extraction from small Dutch fields, says a review of fossil fuel fiscal incentives will be completed in Q1 2021, and declines to ban fossil fuel advertising or remove Shell and BP from the Climate Day.
Unfortunately, this overview cannot yet be provided with sufficient care at this time.
Dit overzicht kan op dit moment helaas nog niet met voldoende zorgvuldigheid worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de betrouwbaarheid van VN-klimaatrapporten op 16 oktober 2020

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a UN report on disasters, which speaks of a rising trend while also claiming a 15% decline since 2000, is reliable, and urges Netherlands to withdraw from the Paris Agreement. The minister rejects the criticism, defends IPCC reports as the primary basis for climate policy, and refuses to withdraw from the Paris Agreement.
The Netherlands will continue to commit to ambitious implementation of the Paris Agreement in the fight against climate change.
Nederland zal zich in de strijd tegen klimaatverandering blijven inzetten voor een ambitieuze uitvoering van de Overeenkomst van Parijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over hoe de samenleving in het gaswinningsgebied Groningen door de overheid wordt verscheurd 2.0

An SP MP asked the Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about residents of Groningen gas-field villages facing demolition and rebuilding of houses with limited choice, unfair treatment of owners who lost upgrades, and the fairness of differing 'regie' under the Bouwakkoord. The minister defended the process, admitted that individual wishes and upgrades cannot be fully guaranteed under current building rules, and promised to explore agreements to speed up reinforcement.
I am aware that residents of the earthquake region may experience stress and uncertainty as a result of gas extraction.
Ik ben mij ervan bewust dat bewoners van de aardbevingsregio door de gevolgen van de gaswinning stress en onzekerheid kunnen ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “hoe de samenleving in het gaswinningsgebied Groningen door de overheid wordt verscheurd”

An SP MP asks the Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about unequal treatment of residents of Overschild (Groningen) across three reinforcement batches, including differing subsidies, delays, and damage handling. The minister confirms the statements and admits some unexplainable differences are unavoidable, promising talks with the region and a clarifying update soon.
Although I agree with you that it is important to prevent differences where possible, especially at neighbourhood level, this is unfortunately unavoidable.
Hoewel ik met u deel dat het van belang is om waar mogelijk verschillen te voorkomen, zeker op wijkniveau, is dit helaas onvermijdelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het bericht 'Miljarden vliegen weg bij Tata'

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked the ministers whether reports that billions of euros flowed from Tata Steel Netherlands to its Indian parent show unpaid corporate tax, mismanagement, or threats to investment. Minister Wiebes answered that tax secrecy (art. 67 AWR) prevents comment on an individual taxpayer, that the Tax Authority supervises on a risk basis, that he sees no grounds for intervention, and that Tata Steel's investment plans are sound, while rejecting new rules restricting profit transfers.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de causaliteit van schade en gaswinning

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether earthquake damage in Groningen can be linked to gas extraction even far from the epicentre, and questions the IMG's decision to pause claims in part of the area. The minister says the IMG is independent, applies the statutory presumption of causation, and has temporarily suspended decisions on about 1,250 claims pending expert advice on subsidence, while answering several questions only partly or with reference to other bodies.
The IMG applies the presumption of evidence and will continue to apply the presumption of evidence in the future.
Het IMG past het bewijsvermoeden toe en blijft het bewijsvermoeden in de toekomst toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee naar aanleiding van het bericht 'ACM Congestieproblemen nemen komende jaren verder toe'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about ACM's warning that grid congestion will worsen and that network operators are investing too little, and about financing, technician shortages and investment rules. The minister acknowledged the congestion problem, pointed to coordination via regional energy strategies and the regulator's review of investment rules, and said that ACM alone decides whether investments are efficient.
I will therefore continue, in cooperation with the grid operators, ACM, local governments and market parties, to work on alleviating the problem.
Ik zal daarom in samenwerking met de netbeheerders, de ACM, decentrale overheden en marktpartijen blijven inzetten op verlichting van de problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de gezondheidsschade van windturbines

Mr Baudet (FvD) asked whether wind turbine noise, especially low-frequency noise, causes serious health problems for residents, citing a Danish 20 dB indoor limit, a German 1,000 m distance rule, and the precautionary principle, and asked for a halt to nearby turbine projects. The State Secretary answered that no conclusive evidence exists yet, that Dutch noise norms cover the full spectrum and are about as strict as the Danish norm, that the RIVM will review the unpublished LUMC study, that a low-frequency research programme will be reported by summer 2021, and that existing projects will not be halted.
I will ask the RIVM to look at the research results when they are published.
Ik zal het RIVM vragen naar de onderzoeksresultaten te kijken wanneer deze gepubliceerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Gerven over de aanhoudende klachten rond laagfrequent geluid bij windturbines

SP MPs asked why, despite RIVM findings on low-frequency wind turbine noise, no additional noise or distance norms exist, and whether health studies and a community-inclusive knowledge platform will follow. The government answered that current Dutch noise norms are adequate, that no distance norm or separate low-frequency norm is needed, that a health study will be explored with RIVM, and that existing platforms already represent residents.
Yes, the current norm assumes a serious nuisance rate of about 9% at the maximum permissible noise load.
Ja, de huidige normering gaat uit van een percentage ernstige hinder van ongeveer 9% bij de maximaal toelaatbare geluidbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Uitgaan is nu een avondje zitten’

An MP asked several ministers about illegal parties during COVID restrictions, enforcement numbers, the option of controlled reopening of venues, and support for the sector. The government answered that enforcement data cannot be split by party type, that nightclubs stay closed due to infection risk, that a ventilation pilot is being prepared, and that financial support schemes continue.
Unfortunately, a breakdown by illegal parties and festivals cannot be made.
Een uitsplitsing naar illegale feesten en festivals is helaas niet te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Proefproject 'van gas af' stilgelegd'

PVV MPs asked whether the Purmerend Overwhere-Zuid gas-free pilot, a Programma Aardgasvrije Wijken project, was halted, questioning costs, the EUR 6.9 million allocation and the EUR 100 million second round. The minister replied that the pilot was not stopped but delayed for evaluation, that the funds are a municipal decentralisation grant rather than a subsidy, and that she stands by the programme's learning goal.
An overview of progress at the pilot sites will be sent to your House in the first quarter of 2021 through the annual progress report of the PAW.
Een overzicht van de voortgang bij de proeftuinen zal ik aan uw Kamer sturen in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 middels de jaarlijkse voortgangsrapportage van het PAW.
Antwoord op vragen van de lede Madlener en Kops over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake een biomassacentrale in Vierpolders

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether his earlier denial of subsidy for a biomass plant in Vierpolders still holds, given that the plant received a subsidy decision in 2018. The minister said the subsidy is only paid once the project is realised and producing, the decision will not be withdrawn if the initiator complies with the conditions, and the plant's wood fuel meets sustainability requirements, while refusing to halt all biomass and climate subsidies.
That is not the case at this moment.
Dat is op dit moment nog niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Asscher en Kwint over het bericht ‘Cultuursector meldt met 62 procent relatief grootste omzetverlies bij UWV’

MPs Van den Berge, Asscher and Kwint asked the ministers whether the culture sector's 62 percent turnover loss at UWV, the delay in support, the adequacy of the second support package, the talent drain, the link with the April motion, sector robustness and events-sector compensation were acceptable. The minister responds that substantial support (about 1.3 billion euros in total) has been provided in stages, that the second package covers January to June 2021, and that further measures are under discussion with the sector and the Raad voor Cultuur.
I regret that institutions and businesses in the cultural and creative sector have to decide to dismiss staff because of this crisis.
Ik betreur het dat instellingen en ondernemingen in de culturele en creatieve sector door deze crisis moeten besluiten tot het ontslaan van personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over haperende warmtepompen en stijgende energierekeningen

An MP from the PVV asked ministers why residents of Spoorwijk in The Hague have had faulty heat pumps and rising energy bills, and questioned the energy transition's affordability and claims of lower bills. The minister replied that the Warmtewet protects heat consumers, the government cannot guarantee total energy bills, and the Ecorys and PBL findings are disputed, while a related question was answered separately.
It is therefore not the role of the Minister to assess these individual cases.
Het is dan ook niet de rol van de Minister om deze individuele gevallen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Slootweg over "de effectiviteit van het tijdelijk verlagen van de btw en het invoeren van een kinderbonus"

MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the ministers whether a German study showing a child bonus is more effective than a VAT cut for stimulating consumption applies to the Netherlands, and whether the CPB should be asked to do similar research. The minister answered that extra costs for households with children are limited and varied, that the government will not add a child bonus but raises the child-related budget for large low-income families, and that CPB evidence favours income tax cuts over VAT cuts or transfers.
Given the findings from the German study, it is relevant that the Dutch cabinet has allocated funds for the purchase of digital learning materials to make home schooling accessible to all children.

Gelet op de bevindingen uit het Duitse onderzoek is relevant dat het Nederlandse kabinet middelen heeft vrijgemaakt voor de aanschaf van digitale leermiddelen om thuisonderwijs voor alle kinderen toegankelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het bericht ‘Black turbine blade ‘can cut bird deaths’’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about a report that painting turbine blades black could cut bird deaths, and whether the government would test this in the Netherlands. The minister replied that no black-blade test is currently running in the Netherlands, that the sector has shown interest in one at Eemshaven, and that bird-protection measures are being pursued through a joint programme with provinces and the sector.
In principle I am open to this kind of testing by the sector, provided that safety for air traffic is well assured.
Ik sta in principe open voor dit soort testen door de sector, mits de veiligheid voor het luchtverkeer goed geborgd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over “stijgende energierekeningen en vaste lasten door warmtepompen”

An MP (PVV) asks the ministers whether the energy transition to gas-free homes, including heat pumps, has raised energy bills and created energy poverty, and whether they will reverse course. The government replies that the transition must stay affordable, cites subsidies and the Warmtefonds, declines to comment on the Transvaal case (referred to the complaints committee), disputes the Ecorys projections as outdated, and rejects reversing the connection obligation removal.
I cannot go into this specific case, as the matter is being referred to the complaints committee.
Ik kan niet ingaan op dit specifieke geval, aangezien de kwestie wordt voorgelegd aan de geschillencommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Postma en Omtzigt over de toepassing van het tonnageregime voor de offshoresector

MPs Mulder, Postma and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch tonnage tax regime is stricter than in other EU countries, whether it covers vessels used to build offshore wind farms, and what this means for cost and competitiveness. The government answered that the Dutch regime is stricter on some points (e.g. Denmark allows construction-vessel profits), that wind-farm operation profits are excluded, that transport vessels to offshore parks can qualify, and that it will await an evaluation due in early 2021 before deciding on any change.
The cabinet wants to await the aforementioned evaluation before making statements on the desirability and design of any possible adjustment to the tonnage regime.
Het kabinet wil de hiervoor genoemde evaluatie afwachten, alvorens uitspraken te doen over de wenselijkheid en vormgeving van een eventuele aanpassing van de tonnageregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Ploumen over een sinkhole in Kerkrade

Three MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a sinkhole in Kerkrade caused by sanitising an old mine shaft, covering instability, funding, liability, resident information, lessons learned and damage to neighbouring homes. The minister answered that the shaft is being sanitised, funded through a 12 million euro package, that damage claims go to the Waarborgfonds Mijnbouwschade, and that the municipality is monitoring nearby homes, with a follow-up consultation planned.
After the remediation, this historic shaft will be stabilised and safe.
Na de sanering is deze historische schacht gestabiliseerd en veilig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over de uitzending van Zembla over Apotex

Two CDA MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the sale of Apotex Leiden to Indian firm Aurobindo, the risks of dependence on foreign medicine production, and related investment screening. The minister answered that the state is willing to provide a loan to help a Dutch takeover by Innogenerics, that no talks with the top of Apotex took place, and that the government is working on EU-level mapping of medicine supply chains and a broader investment screening mechanism.
I am in consultation with sectors and experts to discuss what a good approach is to move further on this.
Ik ben in overleg met sectoren en deskundigen om te bespreken wat een goede aanpak is om hierin verder te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het de postcoderoosregeling en de nieuwe subsidieregeling voor energiecoöperaties

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the gap between the expiring postcode-rose scheme and the new subsidy scheme for energy cooperatives, including transition rules for new members and the timeline. The minister replied that the new subsidy scheme will be published around the turn of the year with an open window from 1 April 2021, that the PBL final advice settles the subsidy amounts, and that the consequences of the transition rules are still being discussed within cabinet.
I will inform your House about the start of the internet consultation.
Ik zal uw Kamer berichten over de start van de internetconsultatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Hack bij Apollo Vredestein toont zwakke cyberbeveiliging Nederlandse bedrijven' en het bericht 'Overheid wist wie kwetsbaar was, maar liet bedrij

Two MPs (Van den Berg and Amhaouch, CDA) asked the ministers about reports of a hack at Apollo Vredestein and claims that government knew which firms were vulnerable but did not warn them, raising questions on SME cyber-security, incident reporting duties and NCSC mandate limits. The government answered that cyber-security is a priority, that voluntary measures and the Digital Trust Center cover non-vital firms, and that the NCSC could not lawfully share certain threat data at the time, with a planned DTC expansion and a review of government powers in digital crises.

In addition, the NCSC has a statutory task, insofar as necessary to prevent adverse societal consequences, to pass on information about threats and incidents concerning network and information systems of other organisations, including personal data obtained from analyses for its primary task.

Daarnaast heeft het NCSC, voor zover noodzakelijk ter voorkoming van nadelige maatschappelijke gevolgen, krachtens de wet als taak om informatie over dreigingen en incidenten met betrekking tot netwerk- en informatiesystemen van andere organisaties (waaronder ook persoonsgegevens), die is verkregen bij analyses ten behoeve van de primaire taak, door te verstrekken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Kernenergie volgens Wiebes betaalbaar, experts twijfelen’

MP Sienot (D66) asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the ENCO report on nuclear energy costs conflicts with TNO and Kalavasta/Berenschot studies, and challenges ENCO's independence, model transparency, assumptions (50% wind/solar in 2040, 100% capacity factor, LCOE) and the risk of delaying regional energy plans. The minister defends the study's different scope and assumptions, says the models' sources are public, commits to asking researchers in the Dijkhoff motion market consultation to consider all relevant reports, and maintains the Climate Agreement targets.
I intend, when carrying out the Dijkhoff et al. motion, to ask the researchers in the market consultation to take all relevant reports into account.
Ik ben voornemens om bij het uitvoeren van de motie Dijkhoff c.s., bij de marktconsultatie de onderzoekers te verzoeken alle relevante rapporten te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over biogrondstoffen

The MP asks about biomass energy: whether the government will talk with environmental groups and Vattenfall, phase out subsidies for wood-fired heat and power, tighten emission limits near homes, and revise RED II. The minister answers that stakeholder consultation is ongoing, existing subsidies will not be revoked, phasing out subsidies and tightening emission norms are planned, and disputes about the Diemen plant are for the courts.
Furthermore, it is not for me to interfere in the legal proceedings that are ongoing on this matter.
Het is verder niet aan mij om mij te mengen in gerechtelijke procedures die hierover lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Gevoelige nederlaag voor netbeheerders in strijd om verwijderingsbijdrage’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a court ruling on gas grid disconnection charges and its wider consequences, including whether residents who ordered disconnection can reclaim costs and whether a structural solution and dialogue with grid operators are needed. The minister declined to comment substantively on the ruling because similar cases are pending, said the ruling is case-specific, and promised to consult the ACM and grid operators on an interim solution and report to parliament later this year.
I do not consider it my place to comment substantively on the court ruling, partly because similar legal cases are currently pending.
Ik vind het niet aan mij om inhoudelijk in te gaan op de rechterlijke uitspraak, mede omdat er momenteel nog vergelijkbare rechtszaken spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over het bericht  dat honderden Nederlandse economen meer investeringen aanraden in sociale gelijkheid en verduurzaming

MPs Marijnissen and Alkaya asked whether the government shares economists' call for more investment in social equality and sustainability, whether debt can safely rise, whether Groeifonds should prioritise jobs, and whether austerity is off the table. The ministers answered that existing support, investment acceleration and the Nationaal Groeifonds already address these goals, that debt must stay manageable, and that no choice is made between corporate tax and social security, while offering no new proposal.
The cabinet will submit a recovery plan for the RRF to the Commission in spring 2021.
Het kabinet zal in het voorjaar van 2021 een herstelplan voor de RRF bij de Commissie indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over investeringen in de plasticindustrie

MP Van Raan asked the government about investments in the plastics industry, including Shell and financial institutions, recyclate requirements, a tax on virgin plastic and OECD guidelines. The government answered that it expects firms to follow OECD and UN guidance, will raise the plastics pact and recyclate use at EU level, sees no national import levy as current, and will not yet decide on additional measures.

The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally, including banks, insurers and pension funds, to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal ondernemen, waaronder banken, verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen, dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor Multinationale Ondernemingen (OESO-richtlijnen) en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's) naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de NAM die geen bemoeienis meer heeft in afhandeling van de bevingsschade

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about NAM's claim that it has finished handling Groningen earthquake damage claims, including whether old claims are settled, pending lawsuits, vouchers, and disputes over payments. The Minister replies that all 6,199 old claims have been offered settlements and arbiter rulings followed, with about 25 cases still before the civil courts and some payment disputes ongoing.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het onderzoek ‘Maatschappelijke kosten-batenanalyse naar toekomstige inpassing van drie alternatieven voor opwek van zonne-energie’ van Berenschot en Kalavasta

MP Moorlag asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a cost-benefit study by Berenschot and Kalavasta, which concluded that rooftop solar should be promoted more from a societal perspective, and about whether subsidies should favour projects with higher social value and whether solar parks have a better business case than rooftop solar. The minister said the conclusion fits existing policy, rejected the need for better business cases beyond the SDE++ subsidy, and argued the SDE++ does not currently favour ground-mounted parks over rooftops because of differing assumptions on self-consumption.
I therefore do not believe that solar parks have a better business case than rooftop solar projects.
Ik ben daarom niet van mening dat zonneweides een betere businesscase hebben dan zonprojecten op daken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over het artikel Weilanden vol glas van zonnepanelen na hevige brand: nieuw probleem voor milieudiensten

MPs Geurts and Agnes Mulder asked the government whether glass shards and debris from solar panels released in fires that settle on surrounding land are a known problem, what the health risks are, and whether a national protocol and insurance-sector discussion are planned. The minister answered that RIVM will run fire experiments, IFV will consider a protocol, the farmer bears responsibility for food safety, and the insurance issue is separate, promising further steps after the research.
In consultation with the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, I will, on the basis of the RIVM research, examine whether follow-up steps are necessary.
Ik zal, in overleg met de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, aan de hand van de onderzoeken van het RIVM bezien of er eventueel vervolgstappen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het bericht ‘Sloop dreigt voor onafgebouwd testcentrum getijde-energie bij de Grevelingendam’

Two D66 MPs asked whether the unfinished tidal energy test centre at the Grevelingendam should be revived given its innovation potential, and whether the permit withdrawal could be postponed. The minister answered that the sector offers limited innovation potential, a market scan will show by 31 December 2020 whether a new party will complete the centre, and otherwise Rijkswaterstaat will demolish it so sluicing can resume.
By 31 December 2020 it will be known whether there is interest and under what conditions parties want to participate.
Uiterlijk 31 december 2020 zal bekend zijn of er belangstelling is en onder welke voorwaarden partijen willen instappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de vergunningverlening aan Vattenfall voor de bouw van een biomassacentrale in Diemen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about permitting and subsidy for Vattenfall's biomass plant in Diemen, and whether a moratorium on new biomass subsidies should be introduced. The minister said a subsidy decision was already taken, refused a moratorium while citing a forthcoming biomass sustainability framework and phase-out measures.
The national government plays no further role in this.
Het Rijk speelt hierbij verder geen rol.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Kwint over diverse berichten aangaande ontslagen bij poppodia en andere culturele instellingen

An MP asked ministers about reports of layoffs at Dutch music venues and cultural institutions during the COVID-19 crisis, and whether support schemes such as NOW, TOZO and TVL would be extended. The minister replied that support measures would be continued for nine months and that a range of additional funding, loan and fieldlab arrangements exist, while stating that not every organisation can be saved.
As I indicated in the debate of 29 June, I want to prevent bankruptcies as much as possible.
Zoals ik heb aangegeven in het debat van 29 juni jl. wil ik faillissementen zoveel mogelijk zien te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het ondersteunen van de fossiele energiesector in Nederland naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van Oil Change International en Milieudefensie

An MP asked the government about a study by Milieudefensie and Oil Change International claiming over EUR 8 billion a year in support for the fossil sector, about export credit insurance for fossil projects, about ending support for new North Sea gas drilling, and about implementing a motion to phase out fiscal incentives. The minister disputes many of the study's figures, says export credit premiums are cost-covering, refuses to end fossil support unilaterally or to push other North Sea states to abolish their incentives, and sends a letter on phasing out fossil incentives.
At this time I do not think it wise to seek, together with the other North Sea countries, the abolition of fiscal incentives for new gas drilling in the North Sea.
Ik vind het op dit moment niet verstandig om met de andere Noordzeelanden te streven naar afschaffing van fiscale prikkels voor nieuwe gasboringen in de Noordzee.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘Nog altijd miljarden euro’s subsidie naar fossiele energiesector’ naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van Oil Change International en Milieudefensie

An MP asked the government about a report claiming fossil-fuel subsidies in the Netherlands are rising and slowing the energy transition, and asked for the government's definition, its progress on phasing out such subsidies, and its total climate spending. The minister acknowledged the report but disputed its figures, said the government uses the WTO definition, committed to phasing out fossil incentives in line with international agreements, and listed the climate and energy funds available in this cabinet period.
The cabinet agrees that no subsidies or financial incentives for fossil fuels belong in the transition.
Het kabinet deelt de mening dat in de transitie geen subsidies of financiële prikkels voor fossiele brandstoffen passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat de grootste vervuilers amper betalen aan klimaatbeleid

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether heavy industry pays too little for climate policy while SMEs and households fund subsidies that benefit major emitters, and asked about ending industrial energy-tax exemptions. The minister rejected the premise, arguing heavy industry does pay through the ODE levy and the CO2 levy, that exemptions protect competitiveness pending EU reform, and that the 2020 levy shift relieves households and SMEs.
The cabinet welcomes this reform, because it may offer room to limit specific exemptions for companies or sectors, while preserving a level playing field.
Het kabinet verwelkomt deze hervorming, omdat die ruimte kan bieden om specifieke uitzonderingen voor bedrijven of sectoren te beperken, met behoud van het gelijke speelveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over biomassa uit Estland

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals ask the ministers about clear-cutting and biodiversity loss in Estonian forests supplying wood pellets to Dutch subsidised biomass plants, including Natura 2000 logging, overexploitation, corruption risks and whether subsidies should stop. Minister Wiebes answers that Dutch sustainability criteria under the SDE+ scheme apply, that the government sees no reason for independent research, and that Estonian forest regulation is primarily Estonia's responsibility.
I am not aware of how much biomass is imported annually from Estonia.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel biomassa er jaarlijks geïmporteerd wordt uit Estland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Zonneparken: goud voor de ontwikkelaars, nauwelijks verdiensten voor inwoners’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether residents benefit from solar park profits and whether the SDE+ subsidy and levy shift undermine public support, and asked about foreign ownership, unfair climate policy, and shared ownership targets. The minister answered that participation agreements in the Climate Agreement are being implemented, that SDE+ covers only the unprofitable top with a reasonable return, that foreign ownership cannot be controlled under EU rules, and that a participation monitor and a 50% local ownership target are being pursued.
Data on solar parks owned by foreign shareholders is not available to me, and it is also not possible to verify this.
Gegevens over zonneparken die in handen van buitenlandse aandeelhouders zijn, heb ik niet tot mijn beschikking en het is ook niet mogelijk om dit te controleren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over de berichten 'Nederland moet haast maken met groen economisch herstel na de coronacrisis' en 'We staan op een kantelpunt voor het klimaatbeleid'

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the government about green economic recovery after the COVID-19 crisis, including investment advice from the PBL, IEA, DNB and SER, hydrogen competitiveness, the CO2 levy, KLM sustainability conditions, and workforce retraining for the energy transition. The minister responded that the Klimaatakkoord forms the basis for green recovery, that additional investments via the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility and accelerated projects (about EUR 2 billion) are being prepared, and that the CO2 levy for industry proceeds from 1 January 2021 without delay.
The cabinet wants to make room for additional investments via the European Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF).
Het kabinet wil ruimte maken voor aanvullende investeringen via de Europese Recovery and Resilience Facility (RFF).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de verergering van de situatie in Groningen

Labour MP Nijboer asked about slow progress on house reinforcement in Groningen, inspection reports not being shared, delays and uncertainty for residents, foundation research and compensation disputes, and why these problems persist compared with the speed of the COVID response. The minister answers that inspection reports are available on request, that prioritisation and capacity limits cause delays, that a few specific cases will be discussed or have advice sent, and that a versnellingspakket is intended to speed up reinforcement.
Residents can ask their assigned NCG resident supporter or the municipality's area director whether and when their address is included in the municipal action plans.
Bewoners kunnen bij de hun toegewezen bewonersbegeleider van NCG of gebiedsregisseur van de eigen gemeente informeren of en wanneer hun adres is opgenomen in de gemeentelijke plannen van aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over flinke methaanlekken op de Noordzee

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a study finding methane leaking from abandoned North Sea wells and whether licensing and the offshore mining policy should be tightened. The minister said TNO will research the anthropogenic share of emissions, that SodM will act if measures are needed, and that no decision on policy changes or consultation with other North Sea states is yet warranted.

SodM, as supervisor of oil and gas extraction in the North Sea, has already instructed TNO to further investigate what share of emissions at and around wells is anthropogenic and what share is natural.

SodM heeft, als toezichthouder op de olie- en gaswinning in de Noordzee, TNO inmiddels opdracht gegeven nader uit te zoeken welk aandeel van emissies bij en rond putten antropogeen is en welk aandeel natuurlijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP asks the government to justify continued COVID-19 restrictions, their proportionality, effects on mental health, economy and poverty, and the scientific basis for distancing and ventilation advice. The ministers respond that restrictions remain necessary to control the virus, describe the OMT and BAO advisory process and support measures, and state that herd immunity was never a goal.
The decision whether the measures proposed by the OMT are implemented is then up to the cabinet.
De afweging of de maatregelen die het OMT voorstelt worden uitgevoerd, is vervolgens aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het onmiddellijk stopzetten van biomassa

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why biomass is treated as a climate reduction and whether it should be stopped immediately, calling the policy climate fraud. The minister rejected the fraud characterisation, maintained that biomass is necessary for the Climate Agreement targets, and said the sustainability framework for biomass will be sent to parliament after the summer.
In the sustainability framework for biomass expected to be sent to parliament after the summer, the cabinet will further address the role of sustainable biomass in achieving those targets.
In het duurzaamheidskader voor biomassa dat naar verwachting na de zomer aan Kamer zal worden aangeboden, zal het kabinet nader ingaan op de rol van duurzame biomassa om die doelen te bereiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het niet isoleren van opslagtanks voor oliën die warm gehouden moeten worden

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why half of heated oil storage tanks are poorly insulated and what will be done to enforce insulation and energy-saving duties. The minister said there is no central registry, that responsibility lies largely with decentralised authorities, pointed to voluntary energy agreements and monitoring, and noted a planned CO2 levy, without committing to a new concrete measure.

Because decentralised authorities (provinces, municipalities, delegated environmental services) are the competent authority for permitting and for supervision and enforcement of the energy-saving obligation, no central register is kept of insulation of oil storage tanks in the Netherlands.

Omdat de decentrale overheid (provincie, gemeente, gemandateerde omgevingsdiensten) bevoegd gezag is voor vergunningverlening en voor toezicht en handhaving van de energiebesparingsplicht, wordt er geen centrale registratie bijgehouden van isolatie van opslagtanks voor olie in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de drie aardbevingen in Groningen de afgelopen week

MP Beckerman asked the ministers about three earthquakes in Groningen, the response to affected residents, damage claims backlogs at the IMG, COVID-related delays, reinforcement operations and a new norm. The minister replied that gas extraction will end around 2022, that damage handling and reinforcement are ongoing with a six-month target, that a new norm will be applied from 1 September 2020, and that the government is consulting the region, but he declined to answer the questions in the one-week timeframe requested.
The IMG is an independent administrative body and determines its own working method for handling damage claims.
Het IMG is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan en bepaalt zijn eigen werkwijze voor de afhandeling van schademeldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Graaf over het ontwerpinstemmingsbesluit Winningsplan Nedmag en de zoutwinningsactiviteiten in Zuidwending

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the draft Nedmag salt-mining permit in Zuidwending, covering water board and local advice, subsidence and cumulative risks, damage claims and reversal of the burden of proof, diesel and well sealing, permit duration, financial guarantees, and reuse of caverns. The Minister answered that advice was weighed and reflected in conditions (no further extraction from VE-3, limited TR-9, financial guarantee before extraction starts), that a Mining Damage Committee handles claims without a statutory burden-of-proof reversal, and that the permit length and diesel risks are considered adequate under SodM oversight.

Partly on the basis of the advice, I do not consent to further salt extraction from cavern VE-3, and I limit extraction from cavern TR-9 to prevent it from becoming too large and merging with the cluster.

Ik stem mede op basis van de adviezen niet in met verdere zoutwinning uit caverne VE-3 en ik beperk de zoutwinning uit de caverne TR-9 om te voorkomen dat deze caverne te groot wordt en aan het cluster groeit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over ‘het verlengen van opsporingsvergunningen voor olie en gas aan Vermilion zonder aan wettelijke criteria te voldoen’

An MP asked the minister why an expired Vermilion oil and gas exploration licence still appears as extended, whether an eight-year extension is being pursued without meeting legal criteria, and how municipal objections will be addressed. The minister confirmed the pending extension request, said the licence registration does not confer rights, denied a practice of halving requested terms, and committed to no new onshore exploration licences and enforcement by the State Supervision of Mines.
I have not yet made a decision on extending the validity period of the licence or on the exact term of this extension.
Ik heb nog geen besluit genomen over het verlengen van de geldigheidsduur van de vergunning of over de exacte termijn van deze verlenging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over de oproep van de Burgemeester van Loppersum voor een andere aanpak voor de versterkingsoperatie in Groningen

MPs asked whether the government will act on the Loppersum mayor's call for a crisis team and an emergency law to speed up the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation. The minister says the government is pursuing faster implementation, is in talks with the mayor and regional administrators, and will inform parliament on outcomes, while the reinforcement bill is still being revised after the Council of State's advice.
In line with our commitment in the General Consultation on Mining/Groningen of 24 June, we will inform the House of the outcomes as soon as possible.
Conform onze toezegging in het Algemeen Overleg Mijnbouw/Groningen van 24 juni jl. informeren wij uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘Eaton in Hengelo schrapt 300 arbeidsplaatsen’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Eaton's announced loss of about 300 jobs in Hengelo, whether it forms a pattern with Vredestein moving production abroad, and what the government would do to keep jobs in Twente. The minister said the company bears responsibility for its restructuring, that no clear pattern exists, that officials are talking with the province and Oost NL, and that a Regio Deal and a social plan are the relevant instruments.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Eaton in Hengelo schrapt 300 arbeidsplaatsen’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Eaton's plan to cut 300 jobs in Hengelo by moving production to lower-cost countries, and about the government's response, industrial strategy and contacts with the company and regional bodies. The minister answered that the ministry was only informed on 1 July, that it and local authorities were not consulted beforehand, that talks are ongoing via Oost NL, and that the industrial vision for the manufacturing sector will follow in autumn.

The ministry and the local authorities were not involved in the considerations behind the relocation of production and outsourcing of company units and therefore had no opportunity to take action beforehand to influence this plan.

Het ministerie en de lokale overheden zijn niet meegenomen in de overwegingen van de productieverplaatsing en outsourcing van bedrijfsonderdelen en hebben daarom geen mogelijkheden gehad om vooraf acties te ondernemen dit voornemen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de gaswinning in Pernis

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about gas extraction at Pernis, including the seismic risk, the extension of production to 2030, production volumes above the 20% margin, resident involvement and possible earthquake impacts.
