The minister replied that the seismic risk assessment has not changed, that a risk management plan and accelerometers were required under SodM guidance, that production stays within licensed volumes, and that residents can obtain information via the website and a planned consultation with the region.
The seismic risk in the extraction plan has been carried out by the NAM in accordance with the Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) guideline.
Het seismisch risico in het winningsplan is conform de leidraad van Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) uitgevoerd door de NAM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en De Groot over stikstofuitstoot

D66 MPs asked why provinces permitted two power plants to switch to biomass with higher nitrogen emissions by using intern salderen on old permits, and whether this conflicts with the government's nitrogen reduction goals. Minister Schouten defends the permits as lawful and within existing rules, says the new permits set lower maximum emissions, and declines to reopen or tighten permits or launch wider investigations.
I see no possibility to apply stricter policy or to further restrict permits that have become final in law.
Bovendien zie ik geen mogelijkheid om een strenger beleid te hanteren of in rechte vaststaande vergunningen verder in te perken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de toename van de stikstofuitstoot door de biomassacentrales in Diemen en Geertruidenberg

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether biomass plants in Diemen and Geertruidenberg, licensed on maximum historic emissions and without netting out unused headroom, would raise nitrogen emissions, and questioned the NOx standards. The minister answers that the provinces are competent authority, that permits were granted via internal netting within the rules, that actual emissions may rise under full operation, and that stricter emission standards are planned for 2022.
It should be noted first that the provinces are the competent authority for these permits. I therefore cannot intervene in their assessment of the permit.
Vooropgesteld moet worden dat de provincies bevoegd gezag zijn voor deze vergunningen. Ik kan dan ook niet treden in hun beoordeling van de vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het injecteren van afvalwater in Twente en Zuidoost-Drenthe

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reinjecting wastewater from oil and gas production in Twente and Southeast Drenthe, including corrosion, a leak at Emlichheim, costs, water use, and whether the risk assessment framework should be re-evaluated before expanding injection. The minister answered that the injected water is not hazardous, that the regulator SodM oversees well integrity, and that the scheduled six-yearly evaluation will be brought forward to 2021 while the current methodology is considered adequate, but gave no detailed cost or energy figures.
I cannot give specific information on the costs of maintenance, repair and renewal of the transport pipelines and injection locations.
Ik kan geen specifieke toelichting geven op de kosten voor onderhoud, reparatie en vernieuwing aan de transportleidingen en injectielocaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Lodders over het artikel ‘Unilever wake-upcall voor het kabinet’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the potential departure of head offices such as Unilever's, its effects on the economy and on SMEs, and the investment climate. The minister answered that head offices matter as decision centres, that Unilever's structural simplification leaves Dutch activities unchanged, and that the government will study how to strengthen the investment climate by early 2021 while pointing to earlier tax and labour-cost policy reviews.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over biomassa

Baudet (FVD) asked the minister about biomass power plants: whether burning biomass emits more CO2 than coal, how permit and subsidy responsibilities are divided among national, provincial and municipal government, and whether the government will reconsider calling biomass sustainable. The minister answered that biomass is climate-neutral when sustainable, that an integral sustainability framework is being prepared, that permitting is decentralised, and that the government will not reconsider its position, while declining to provide data on pending permit applications.
I do not have this information: permit, extension and amendment applications are submitted locally and are not centrally recorded.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie: vergunning-, verlengings- en wijzigingsaanvragen worden decentraal ingediend en niet centraal bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de olieprijs die onder nul dollar zakt

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the oil price falling below zero, and how this affects gas and oil operators, mine damage compensation, safety, decommissioning, workers, Vermilion's liabilities and EBN. The minister answered that the Dutch oil sector is small, that the government does not guarantee compensation for residents but the Commissie Mijnbouwschade handles claims, that safety and decommissioning are secured through supervision and financial security, and that workers' retraining is a matter for the sector itself.

The government does not guarantee compensation for residents, but as I indicated in my letter of 9 June 2020, I ensure a low-threshold, transparent and expert handling of damage by the Commissie Mijnbouwschade, which takes on the burden of proof.

De overheid staat niet garant voor schadeloosstelling van omwonenden, maar zoals ik mijn brief van 9 juni 2020 heb aangegeven zorg ik voor een laagdrempelige, transparante en deskundige afhandeling van schade door de Commissie Mijnbouwschade die de bewijslast oppakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een brand bij de RWE centrale in de Eemshaven

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a fire at the RWE coal plant in Eemshaven, whether it occurred in the biomass fuel intake, what caused it, and whether investigations and safety reviews would prevent recurrence. The minister answered that the owner is investigating the cause, partly through an external party, that the fire was in the logistics intake on the quay rather than the biomass processing section, and that the competent authority, the province of Groningen, decides on any further measures.

Based on the conclusions of the investigation and any recommendations, it is up to the competent authority to assess whether there is reason to make adjustments, within the applicable laws and regulations.

Op basis van de conclusies van het onderzoek en eventuele aanbevelingen is het aan het bevoegd gezag om te beoordelen of er aanleiding is om aanpassingen te doen, binnen de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Kops over het bericht ‘Zes locaties in beeld voor stookfabriek in Vierpolders’

Two PVV MPs asked the government about a reported plan for a biomass wood-burning plant in Vierpolders, claiming biomass emits more CO2 than coal and gas, questioning whether it is sustainable, and asking whether subsidies will be stopped. The minister rejected the claims, said biomass is a necessary transition alternative, confirmed no new subsidy for solid wood-fired electricity and no subsidy for heat plants under 5 MWth in the autumn 2020 SDE++ round, and promised a sustainability framework and a phase-out strategy.
No new subsidy will be made available for the use of solid woody biomass for the production of electricity only.
Er wordt geen nieuwe subsidie beschikbaar gesteld voor het gebruik van vaste houtige biomassa voor de productie van uitsluitend elektriciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet, Palland en Postma over het bericht 'Indrukwekkend corona-protest met tientallen historische schepen bij eiland Pampus: 'Net Sail Amsterdam’'

CDA MPs asked the ministers about a protest by historic sailing charter vessels near Pampus, the sector's loss of income under COVID measures, subsidies for historic vessels, and how to preserve the sector after the crisis. The government answered that Mondriaan Fund restoration schemes apply, sets out available COVID support measures for the sailing charter sector, and says it is willing to consult municipalities, provinces and the sector, but did not answer within the two-week deadline.
Of course I am willing to consult with the other relevant departments, the mentioned subnational governments and the sector.
Uiteraard ben ik bereid om samen met de andere betrokken departementen in overleg te treden met de genoemde medeoverheden en met de sector
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee inzake het bericht 'Oplossing dubbele heffing energiebelasting loopt vertraging op'

An MP asks the ministers whether the double levy of energy tax on battery storage will be resolved, given the delay and the absence of a fix in Budget 2021. The State Secretary answers that the issue is being studied with the sector, is delayed by the Climate Agreement, COVID-19 and forthcoming EU rules, and will be part of the upcoming energy tax evaluation.
The cabinet continues to actively work on developing a solution to implement this motion in consultation with the sector.
Het kabinet blijft actief inzetten op het uitwerken van een oplossing ter uitvoering van deze motie in overleg met de branche.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Ondernemingsraad in Enschede zegt vertrouwen op in Vredestein-directie’ en het bericht ‘Bedenkelijke praktijken rond Hongaarse subsidie aan eigenaar V

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about the Apollo Vredestein plant closure in Enschede, the works council's loss of confidence in management, and questions about Hungarian subsidy practices and EU notification. The minister answered that the matter is for the parties themselves, that the Hungarian government and the Commission must decide on further investigation, and that the government is working with the province and municipality to limit job losses.
It is for the Hungarian government to assess whether investigation is needed.
Het is aan de Hongaarse overheid om te beoordelen of onderzoek nodig is.

Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Raan over de benoeming van de oud-staatssecretaris van Financiën, de heer Menno Snel, tot commissaris bij IHC en de directeur van Atradius DSB als bestuurder in de Stichting Continuïteit IH

An MP asked whether the appointment of former state secretary Menno Snel to IHC's supervisory board and of the Atradius DSB director to the Stichting Continuïteit IHC board created conflicts of interest and why parliament was not informed earlier. The government answered that the timing of communication depended on IHC's final agreement, and that the foundation's board has no involvement in IHC's transactions, so no conflict of interest arises.
Changes to the Supervisory Board could only be communicated once there was final agreement on the takeover and refinancing of IHC.
Over wijzigingen in de Raad van Commissarissen kon pas worden gecommuniceerd op het moment dat er definitieve overeenstemming was over de overname en herfinanciering van IHC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Bruins over veilige evenementen

MPs Schonis and Bruins asked why event organisers cannot obtain permits for safe events such as drive-in venues under the general ban, and why Dutch rules differ from Germany and Denmark. The minister replied that the ban was lifted from 1 July, that local authorities now decide case by case, and that economic support schemes exist, but declined to give a detailed rationale for why safe events were not permitted earlier.
It is up to the local authorities to determine whether organisers can adequately arrange their activity at 1.5 metres and meet the other applicable measures.

Het is aan de lokale autoriteiten om te bepalen of organisatoren hun activiteit voldoende op anderhalve meter in kunnen richten en tevens aan andere van toepassing zijnde maatregelen kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Schonis over het besluit om de ILT te verzoeken tot handhaving Verordening (EG) 261/2004 passagiersrechten luchtvaart

MPs Paternotte and Schonis asked whether the government's instruction to the ILT not to enforce EU passenger refund rules for COVID-era flight vouchers, and the planned withdrawal of that instruction, leaves consumers exposed to delayed refunds and airline insolvency. The minister answered that the instruction is withdrawn so the ILT resumes enforcing Regulation 261/2004, that the ILT can act against systematic non-compliance but not individual refund delays, and that the government has lobbied the European Commission for an EU guarantee on vouchers.
With this, the ILT will again enforce Regulation (EC) 261/2004.
Daarmee gaat de ILT de Verordening (EG) 261/2004 weer handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Miljoenen slimme meters ongeschikt voor energietransitie'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether millions of smart meters can continuously transmit energy data, why no requirements were set, and what will happen to the PAMR frequency used by grid operators. The minister answered that the current P4 readout meets present needs, that the frequency licence was extended to 2024 with commitments to protect meter continuity, and that a policy decision on future use will follow after further studies.
When the frequency space is re-issued, provisions will be made where necessary to ensure the continuity of the smart meters.
Bij een heruitgifte van de frequentieruimte zullen zo nodig voorzieningen worden getroffen om de continuïteit van de slimme meters te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Thialf moet zonnepanelen uitzetten om verzekerd te blijven’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the Thialf ice rink must switch off its solar panels to keep its insurance, whether the government would mediate, and whether a state insurance scheme could be introduced. The minister called it a specific case, said he would stay involved in general industry talks but saw no role for government in the individual dispute, and ruled out a government insurance scheme.
Since the talks between Thialf and its insurer concern an individual case, I see no additional role for the government in these talks.
Aangezien de gesprekken tussen Thialf en hun verzekeraar een individueel geval betreffen zie ik in deze gesprekken geen aanvullende rol voor de overheid weggelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over ondernemers die tussen wal en schip vallen bij het aanvragen van de NOW-regeling

MPs asked whether entrepreneurs who changed legal form, took over a business or started in early 2020 fall through the cracks of the NOW wage-subsidy scheme, and whether affected firms can be compensated and included in a second package. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the scheme cannot be adapted to every case, refuses to quantify affected firms, and declines to extend eligibility to businesses without a full reference month of turnover.
I am aware of the problem of businesses that had not yet generated a full month of turnover before March.
Ik ben op de hoogte van de problematiek van bedrijven die voor maart nog geen hele maand omzet hebben gedraaid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘NAM wil productiewater Schoonebeek injecteren in Drentse gasvelden’

An MP asked the minister about NAM's plan to inject production water from Schoonebeek into empty gas fields in southeast Drenthe, including why extra capacity is needed, whether a new permit is required, how it compares to Germany, and seismic risk. The minister answered that NAM has not yet formally filed, that a permit and seismic risk assessment with SodM advice will be required, and that injection is currently the best option given pipeline capacity limits.
An injection permit will only be granted if injection can be done safely, and without a permit no injection into the subsurface may take place.
Een injectievergunning wordt alleen verstrekt als injectie veilig kan en zonder vergunning mag er niet in de ondergrond geïnjecteerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de waardedalingsregeling in het Groninger aardbevingsgebied

An MP asks the minister why the Groningen waardedaling (value-loss) compensation scheme uses a 20% postcode threshold, excludes people who lost out via NAM settlements, and disadvantages residents outside the core area. The minister answers that the independent IMG chose the Atlas voor Gemeenten method on expert advice, that the 20% figure is a result of the research rather than a condition, and that IMG sets its own procedures, so no direct change is promised.
I would like to emphasise the independence of the IMG.
Ik benadruk hier graag de onafhankelijkheid van het IMG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over zonnepanelen op water

MP Dik-Faber asks how many locations are considering floating solar on water, what is known about ecological effects, whether natural areas like the IJsselmeer should be considered, and how the solar ladder (preferring roofs and facades) applies. The minister says roughly a dozen floating projects have been permitted, ecological research is ongoing, natural areas are not excluded in principle, and the solar ladder will be monitored within the RES process.
The competent authority also takes the ecological impact into account in the permit assessment.
Het bevoegd gezag neemt bij de vergunningverlening ook de ecologische impact mee in de afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de inzet van biomassa

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports of forest clearing in Estonia for biomass pellets, whether biomass is CO2-reducing, and whether the 14 billion euro in subsidies is justified. The minister denies that whole forests are cleared for Dutch use, says subsidised pellets must meet sustainability criteria that are checked, defends biomass as climate-neutral when sustainable, and rejects ending climate policy.
All wood pellets used in the Netherlands with subsidy must meet strict sustainability criteria.
Alle houtpellets die in Nederland met subsidie worden gebruikt, moeten voldoen aan strenge duurzaamheidscriteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over het ontbreken van overeenstemming tussen winkeliers en vastgoedeigenaren

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked whether landlords and retail tenants are reaching rent-relief agreements, whether the Steunakkoord agreements are binding and could be declared generally binding, and whether legislation is needed. The State Secretary replied that most tenants and landlords have made case-by-case agreements, that a legal basis for generally binding private agreements does not exist, and that no legislative proposal is planned.
To declare private agreements generally binding, a legal basis is required. That does not currently exist.
Om private afspraken algemeen verbindend te verklaren, is een wettelijke grondslag nodig. Die bestaat nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Vestager urges stakebuilding to block Chinese takeovers’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the COVID-19 crisis makes Dutch firms vulnerable to unwanted takeovers, especially by Chinese buyers, and what instruments exist to screen them. The minister said some firms are cheaper to acquire but no takeover wave has occurred, cited existing corporate defences and several pending investment-screening laws, and announced a 2 June 2020 reference date for retroactive screening.
The cabinet therefore in principle supports the proposal of Commissioner Vestager to take additional measures to protect companies against hostile takeovers.
Het kabinet staat daarom in beginsel positief tegenover het voorstel van Eurocommissaris Vestager voor het nemen van extra maatregelen om bedrijven te beschermen tegen vijandelijke overnames.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Pandemie zal opmars China niet stuiten, maar juist versnellen’

CDA MPs Van den Berg and Van Helvert asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the COVID-19 crisis would accelerate China's geopolitical expansion in Europe and the Netherlands, and what measures the government would take, including on investment screening and a possible revision of the China strategy. The government replied that it sees no concrete indications of China acting differently than normal, pointed to the FDI screening regulation and planned investment-screening legislation (including a retroactive reference date of 2 June 2020), and said the China strategy's basic approach still holds.
The development of the legislation follows a critical timeline. Introducing the law on an accelerated basis is not desirable.
De totstandkoming van de wet- en regelgeving volgt een kritiek tijdspad. De wet versneld invoeren is niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘China laat het oog vallen op (verzwakte) Nederlandse bedrijven’

An MP asked ministers about reports that Chinese investors are eyeing weakened Dutch maritime firms, including the role of state aid and risks of takeovers during the COVID-19 crisis. The government denied seeing a rise in such takeovers, pointed to existing protective instruments and forthcoming investment-screening legislation, and committed to monitoring the sector and exploring measures.
The cabinet is developing both sector-specific and generic instruments for this.
Het kabinet ontwikkelt hiervoor zowel sectorspecifiek als generiek instrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de ondersteuning van mkb-bedrijven tijdens de Corona-crisis

Member Stoffer (SGP) asked the government about support for SMEs during the COVID-19 crisis, covering BMKB loan guarantees, TOGS and NOW subsidy eligibility, payment terms, and tax payment relief. The minister answered most questions with concrete measures such as lower BMKB provisions, extended loan terms, expanded TOGS sector lists, and an extension of the tax payment deferral to 1 October 2020, while declining to make blanket changes such as broad rate alignment or suspending labour law obligations.
The cabinet has decided to extend the term of the BMKB-C to 4 years.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om de looptijd van de BMKB-C te verlengen tot 4 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de uitspraak van de Raad van State die zegt dat mijnschade niet verjaard is

Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a Council of State ruling that Groningen... Limburg mining damage claims are not time-barred, asking about compensation timelines, the Guarantee Fund, notification of homeowners, the Commission for Mining Damage, and whether the statute of limitations should be abolished. Minister Wiebes answered that the ruling complicates the planned public pre-financed fund, that compensation will be paid and a new decision on devaluation taken within 12 weeks, that the Guarantee Fund is sufficiently filled, and that the Commission for Mining Damage is targeted to start on 1 July 2020, while declining to abolish the limitation period.
I see no reason to abolish the statute of limitations for mining damage.
Voor het afschaffen van de verjaringstermijn bij mijnbouwschade zie ik geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over vouchers voor geannuleerde vluchten voor Nederlandse klanten

An MP asked the government whether Dutch passengers with cancelled flights are entitled to refunds rather than vouchers, and how this compares with Israel, where refunds were paid, and whether vouchers are safeguarded if airlines go bankrupt. The Minister answered that passengers are entitled to refunds under EU Regulation 261/2004, that the government tolerated vouchers only temporarily, has withdrawn that tolerance, and is pushing for a European voucher guarantee, while stating that vouchers are an acceptable alternative in the crisis and that voucher holders rank as unsecured creditors.
On 14 May I informed the House that I had withdrawn the instruction to the ILT early.
Op 14 mei heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat ik de aanwijzing aan de ILT vroegtijdig heb ingetrokken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over Een noodfonds voor de Wadden

An MP asked the minister whether a dedicated emergency fund for the Wadden islands should be created to protect jobs and invest in the region's future, given tourism's collapse during the COVID-19 crisis. The state secretary declined a separate Wadden fund, pointing to a second national support package, a fixed-cost allowance, and a government taskforce on the hospitality economy that could cover the region.
The cabinet therefore does not consider a separate emergency fund for the Wadden to be expedient.
Een apart noodfonds voor de Wadden acht het kabinet daarom niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Schonis over het uitreiken van 'coronavouchers' door reisorganisaties en het bericht 'Europese Commissie handhaaft recht op geld terug bij annulering'

MPs Paternotte and Schonis asked whether consumers must still pay travel-operator deposits and accept vouchers instead of refunds for cancelled trips, and whether the minister's instruction to the ILT not to enforce refund rules for airline vouchers conflicts with EU law. The minister answered that consumers keep a legal refund right enforceable in court, that the ILT's instruction was withdrawn so Regulation 261/2004 is enforced again, and that the government supports voucher attractiveness and a possible EU voucher guarantee while promising further letters.
A passenger has a statutory right to a refund and can enforce it through the court, possibly with help from a claims bureau.
Een passagier heeft een wettelijk recht op terugbetaling en kan dat afdwingen via de rechtbank, eventueel met hulp van een claimbureau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over overheidssteun aan Tata Steel

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether siphoning roughly 100 million euro a year of profit from Tata Steel's Dutch subsidiary, while it receives Covid aid and CCS subsidy, harms Dutch steel employment, and whether conditions or industrial policy can keep profits in the Netherlands. The minister answers that shareholder profit distribution is a company matter constrained by EU law, that Covid support may carry conditions such as no dividends and job retention, and that a profit-earmarking industrial policy would deter investment; he declines to share the content of stakeholder talks citing confidentiality.
Due to the confidential nature of all these conversations, I do not feel free to share the content and outcomes of these conversations with the House.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter van al deze gesprekken voel ik mij niet vrij om de inhoud en uitkomsten van deze gesprekken met de Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Futselaar over ‘400 miljoen voor IHC’ 2020

Two SP MPs asked why IHC, a shipbuilder with losses predating COVID-19, received state support worth about 400 million euros, questioning market logic, the absence of a state stake, management accountability, and the use of emergency procedure. The minister answered that losses began in 2016, that the state's support consists of insurance, guarantees and a bridge loan rather than a direct 400 million, and that a private consortium is taking over with governance seats for the state, while declining to disclose several financial details.
It is not for the State to disclose the amounts these parties contribute.
Het is niet aan de Staat om de bedragen die deze partijen inbrengen bekend te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat voetbalclubs met succes een beroep deden op de regeling waarbij de overheid maximaal 9.538 euro van een maandsalaris betaalt

Van Raan (PvdD) asked whether the NOW wage subsidy, capped at twice the maximum daily wage, gave pro football clubs excessive compensation compared with support for self-employed workers, and about pay levels in football. The minister answered that NOW is a wage subsidy to employers to preserve jobs, not individual compensation, that the cap applies equally to all sectors, and that the government lacks detailed salary data for football, giving medians instead.
The UWV, which implements this scheme, does not have information at this level of detail.
Het UWV, dat deze regeling uitvoert, beschikt niet over informatie op dit detailniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Sienot over de aanhoudende droogte, natuurbranden en het verband met het snel opwarmende klimaat

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about recurring drought, forest and nature fires in the Netherlands and Europe, their link to rapid warming, economic damage, prevention measures and whether the climate targets should be tightened. The minister answered that fire statistics only exist since 2017, that drought risk grows with warming, that prevention runs through regional fire-risk programmes and drought and adaptation policy, that the Copernicus report confirmed known trends without prompting a new European meeting, and that the Netherlands supports a higher EU 2030 target.
The Copernicus report has not given rise to organising a European meeting or to accelerating climate measures.
Het Copernicus-rapport is geen aanleiding geweest voor het organiseren van een Europees overleg of klimaatmaatregelen versneld kunnen worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het toezicht en de handhaving van de energiebesparingsplicht

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about weak supervision and enforcement of the energy-saving obligation by municipal environmental services, including infrequent inspections, missing re-inspections and absent municipal energy targets, and asks whether companies' Covid support should be conditional on compliance. The Minister replies that municipalities are responsible for enforcement, offers additional capacity funding including re-inspections, and says he has urged municipalities to act, but declines to link Covid support to compliance, saying the effects of Covid on climate policy are still being explored.
Because the decentralised government is the competent authority for supervision and enforcement of the energy-saving obligation, no central register is kept.
Omdat de decentrale overheid bevoegd gezag is voor de toezicht en handhaving van de energiebesparingsplicht, wordt er geen centrale registratie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van der Lee over een mogelijke uitzondering voor Nord Stream 2 op de Gasrichtlijn

MPs Van Ojik and Van der Lee asked the ministers whether Nord Stream 2 could obtain an exemption from the EU Gas Directive, what input the Netherlands gave the German regulator, and how energy dependence and security are being addressed. The minister answered that the Netherlands considers it the German regulator's decision, that Nord Stream 2 may appeal and has pursued other legal routes, and that the government sees no immediate need for extra measures on energy dependence.

In my response to the Bundesnetzagentur, I indicated on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs as well that it is not up to the Netherlands to assess whether EU regulations provide a sufficient basis for granting the derogation Nord Stream 2 requested.

In mijn reactie aan Bundesnetzagentur heb ik mede namens de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken aangegeven dat het niet aan Nederland is om te beoordelen of de EU-regelgeving voldoende basis biedt voor het verlenen van de door Nord Stream 2 gevraagde afwijking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, De Groot, Van Eijs, Paternotte en Schonis over het bericht ‘Dutch spell out green ideas for EU recovery fund’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Agriculture about a Dutch non-paper proposing a green EU recovery, including conditioning state aid on the national climate plan, early energy and circular investments, and an exclusion list for the Just Transition Fund. The government said the non-paper was an informal civil-servant document, declined to share such papers routinely, and gave largely non-committal answers, deferring concrete national plans until after the Commission's proposals and an August decision.
However, the cabinet considers sharing all such informal civil-servant lobbying documents at all times neither opportune nor desirable for effective Dutch advocacy in Brussels.
Echter, het kabinet acht het te allen tijde delen van al deze ambtelijke beïnvloedingsdocumenten niet opportuun noch wenselijk voor effectieve Nederlandse belangenbehartiging in Brussel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het uitsluiten van plantaardige zuivel van Europese landbouwsubsidies

An MP asks whether EU agricultural subsidies (CAP pillars 1 and 2) exclude plant-based dairy producers and whether this conflicts with government policy to shift toward a more plant-based society. The minister answers that the rules define dairy as animal-derived, that plant-based producers are not excluded from CAP support if they meet the scheme conditions, and that the government will promote plant-based alternatives in the new CAP and national strategic plan.
The starting point is that the supported actions contribute to achieving the stated objectives.
Het uitgangspunt is dat de ondersteunde acties bijdragen aan het behalen van de genoemde doelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over stroomlevering door zonnepanelen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid capacity and voltage problems preventing households with solar panels from feeding electricity into the grid, including whether grid operators must guarantee feed-in and compensate affected households. The minister acknowledged the problem, said guaranteeing feed-in everywhere would be disproportionately costly, noted grid operators must resolve issues within a reasonable time, and rejected a compensation scheme analogous to outage compensation.
However, I cannot guarantee that grid operators will in all cases have capacity available in time or be able to prevent voltage problems.
Ik kan echter niet garanderen dat netbeheerders in staat zijn in alle gevallen ook tijdig de capaciteit beschikbaar hebben of spanningsproblemen kunnen voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het bericht “Kabinet schuift vanwege corona ook CO2-heffing industrie voor zich uit”

GreenLeft MPs asked why a press report said the government was postponing the industry CO2 levy due to COVID-19, whether the 2022 start date still held, and why climate plans were leaked to the press rather than shared with parliament. The State Secretary replied that the levy is still planned for 1 January 2021 as agreed in the Climate Agreement, that the bill goes to parliament with Budget Day, and that the Urgenda package was already sent to parliament.
The bill will be presented to your House as part of the 2021 tax package on Budget Day.
Het wetsvoorstel zal als onderdeel van het belastingplanpakket 2021 met Prinsjesdag worden aangeboden aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het uitstellen van klimaatmaatregelen en het bericht dat de CO2-heffing mogelijk wordt uitgesteld

An MP asked whether the CO2 levy for industry and the aviation tax were being postponed due to the COVID-19 crisis, and how climate and biodiversity goals fit with the economic recovery. The minister denied that the CO2 levy is postponed, said the aviation tax may be delayed under its entry-into-force clause, and gave only general answers on the broader questions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat er in Zaandam een biomassacentrale zonder vergunning in gebruik is genomen

An MP asked the ministers about a biomass plant in Zaandam that began operating without a permit, asking why this was allowed, who is liable, and whether such plants should be built near schools and homes. The government answered that the plant was permitted under nature and municipal rules, that the permitting authorities (province and municipality) are responsible, that the environmental permit requirement for smaller plants is being reviewed, and that it will work with the other ministry on tighter criteria.
As part of the Clean Air Agreement I am examining whether laws, regulations and permit requirements should be tightened.
Als onderdeel van het Schone Lucht Akkoord ben ik aan het kijken of wet- en regelgeving en vergunningseisen aangescherpt moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over het bericht 'Ondernemers in krediet-ellende'

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the ministers about reports that small business credit applications face long waits, heavy paperwork and high costs, and whether banks are committed to fast processing for small loans, whether 100% state guarantees or a role for Qredits would help. The state secretary replied that processing times are improving, points to the new small-loan guarantee scheme and optimisations to existing schemes, argues a 100% German-style guarantee is unsuitable for the Netherlands, and notes the reply came late.
The cabinet has also recently announced a separate guarantee scheme for small entrepreneurs with limited credit needs, where the credit assessment process can largely be carried out automatically.

Het kabinet heeft daarnaast recent een aparte garantieregeling aangekondigd voor kleine ondernemers met een beperkte kredietbehoefte, waarbij het kredietbeoordelingsproces grotendeels automatisch kan worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over aardgasvrije woningen (Startmotorkader Warmtenetten)

An MP from the PVV asked about the Startmotorkader Warmtenetten, which uses a EUR 200 million subsidy so housing associations can disconnect homes from gas and connect them to heat networks while keeping tenants' housing costs neutral, and questioned whether heat-network costs can really stay below gas bills and who ultimately pays. The Minister for Home Affairs defended the framework and the cost-neutrality goal, noting it is not guaranteed for every household, that the Warmtewet caps tariffs at the gas-reference level, that costs are shared between companies, landlords, society and residents, and that the government will not halt the gas-free transition.
I will inform the House after the summer about the results of this study.
Ik informeer uw Kamer na de zomer over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verbijstering van politici over de totstandkoming van Windpark Spui in Piershil/Nieuw-Beijerland

MPs asked about the impact of the Windpark Spui wind farm on local residents, including noise nuisance, compensation, health effects, minimum distance norms and foreign ownership of subsidised turbines. The minister replied that provincial authorities are competent, that noise norms are met, that no scientific basis exists for 'turbine syndrome', and that further research on low-frequency noise is awaited, without committing to new national measures.
Because the province of Zuid-Holland is the competent authority for wind farm Spui, I am not directly involved in this wind farm.
Omdat de provincie Zuid-Holland bevoegd gezag is voor windpark Spui, ben ik niet direct betrokken bij dit windpark.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de inzet van biomassa

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about biomass burned in four coal plants, permit headroom, emission norms (NOx) and compliance with EU best-available-techniques rules. The minister answered that most plant-level data is unavailable or confidential, that the government is studying tighter emission limits for small and medium biomass installations with a report due in 2020, and that continued biomass subsidies are needed for the climate transition.
Individual plants are not reported on, because this may contain competitively sensitive information.
Over individuele centrales wordt niet gerapporteerd, omdat dit concurrentiegevoelige informatie kan bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor de archeologie

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked whether archaeology firms can access COVID-19 support schemes (TOGS, NOW), late payment rules, and heritage education funding. The minister declined to add the broad SBI code 7220 to TOGS, pointed to other support schemes, and promised to consider extensions to the archaeology quality registration.
I am in consultation with the SIKB, the CCvDA and the IOeE about which leniency measures are needed to keep the archaeology quality system functioning.

Ik ben in overleg met de Stichting Infrastructuur Kwaliteit Bodem (SIKB), het centraal College van Deskundigen in de Archeologie (CCvDA) en de Inspectie voor Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed (IOeE) over welke coulancemaatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Futselaar en Alkaya over ondersteuning voor zelfstandigen en de culturele sector

MPs Kwint, Futselaar and Alkaya asked the government about support for self-employed workers and the cultural sector during the COVID-19 crisis, including eligibility criteria, compensation for cancelled events, and a guarantee fund. The government answered that existing general measures apply, cited extra funding of 300 million euro for culture, and explained why certain sectors were included or excluded from the TOGS scheme.
On Tuesday 7 April the extension to non-food retail and a second extension were communicated to the House.
Op dinsdag 7 april jl. is de uitbreiding met non-food retail en nog een tweede uitbreiding aan uw Kamer gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over steunmaatregelen voor taxichauffeurs en marktkooplieden tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Azarkan and Öztürk asked why taxi drivers and market traders were excluded from the Noodloket and later TOGS support schemes due to wrong SBI codes, and whether these groups would be admitted. The minister answered that both groups were added to the TOGS scheme (taxi from 15 April, non-food market traders from 30 March and 15 April) and that the technical problems with the Noodloket had been resolved, with applications open until 26 June 2020.
This group can submit an application to the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO.nl) from 15 April 2020.
Deze groep kan vanaf 15 april 2020 een aanvraag indienen bij de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO.nl).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Harbers over de uitspraken van netbeheerders over de energietransitie

MPs Koerhuis and Harbers asked ministers about grid operators' statements on the energy transition, including whether older homes can be heated without gas, reuse of gas infrastructure for green gas and hydrogen, and costs of replacing the gas network. The minister answered that the transition follows the 'feasible and affordable' principle, that municipalities will decide per neighbourhood with local analysis, and that cost estimates depend on future hydrogen availability, so no firm numbers on connections remaining are given yet.

Because there is still uncertainty about the availability of sustainable gas for now, and because a first picture of the future heat supply will only emerge from the Heat Transition Visions at the end of 2021, I cannot in this phase say how many homes will remain connected to the gas network.

Doordat er voorlopig nog onzekerheid bestaat over de beschikbaarheid van duurzaam gas en omdat pas eind 2021 uit de Transitievisies Warmte een eerste beeld ontstaat van hoe de toekomstige warmtevoorziening is samengesteld kan ik in deze fase geen uitspraken doen over het aantal woningen dat aangesloten blijft op het gasnet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Bijna helft oudere huizen steenkoud zonder gas’

An MP asked the government whether older homes will still need a gas connection because heating demand on cold winter days cannot be met by insulation and alternatives, and how network operators' warnings fit with the Climate Agreement. The minister rejects that claim as a firm conclusion, stating that heating options (heat pumps, heat networks, hybrid solutions) will be assessed per neighbourhood and that municipalities lead the transition with residents' interests protected.
I therefore do not endorse the stated claim.
Ik onderschrijf de genoemde stelling daarom niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'VDL Groep verliest busorder aan Chinees bedrijf'

MPs Amhaouch and Palland (CDA) asked how VDL Groep lost a bus order to Chinese BYD Auto, whether the tender was fair, and what the government will do about foreign subsidies and reciprocity in procurement. The Secretary of State answered that the buses were a private purchase by concessionaire Keolis rather than a tender, found no evidence of unfair competition, acknowledged that current powers to investigate foreign subsidies are limited, and pointed to a proposed EU level playing field instrument and reciprocity measures.

At the same time, I must note that the current possibilities for investigating companies that may receive discriminatory financial support, and for taking action against them if this proves to be the case, are limited.

Tegelijkertijd moet ik constateren dat de mogelijkheden op dit moment beperkt zijn om onderzoek te doen naar bedrijven die mogelijk discriminatoire financiële steun ontvangen, en op te treden tegen bedrijven indien dat het geval blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het bericht ‘Dik half jaar wachten voor plaatsen snellader geen uitzondering’

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked about reported waits of up to half a year to connect fast-charging points to the grid, and how businesses can be supported. The Staatssecretaris answers that the National Agenda for Charging Infrastructure, regional partnerships, grid operator planning and guidance documents are being used to speed up rollout, without committing to a new concrete measure beyond existing plans.

Specifically for speeding up fast chargers at motorway service areas, I have asked Rijkswaterstaat to explore how many fast chargers could be added at service areas (up to 2030) and how the government can facilitate this.

Specifiek voor het versneld plaatsen van snelladers op verzorgingsplaatsen langs de snelweg heb ik Rijkswaterstaat gevraagd om te verkennen hoeveel snelladers er op de verzorgingsplaatsen bijgeplaatst zouden kunnen worden (tot 2030) en op welke wijze de overheid dit mogelijk kan faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het sluiten van de Nederlandse kolencentrales

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the Netherlands would close coal plants when other countries keep building them, whether this undermines energy reliability, and whether the government will withdraw from the Paris Agreement. The minister answered that the government is preparing additional measures under the Urgenda ruling, that the coal ban has a small global temperature effect but is an effective national CO2 measure, that energy reliability is currently in order according to TenneT, and that the government will not withdraw from Paris.
I will inform the House shortly about the results of this.
Ik zal de Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de resultaten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht ‘Klimaatwet Timmermans onderuitgehaald’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that the European Parliament's legal service judged the Commission's climate law proposal unlawful for delegating essential elements to delegated acts, and whether the Minister would reject the plans and consider leaving the EU. The Minister agreed the 2030–2050 trajectory is an essential element that should not be delegated, shared concern about the choice of delegated acts, but rejected the claim of illegality, defended monitoring of member states, and refused to withdraw support or consider EU exit.

Specifically on this point, the cabinet states in the BNC fiche that setting the optimal trajectory between 2030 and 2050 is seen as an essential element of the law, and therefore the cabinet argues that the trajectory between 2030 and 2050 should not be able to be fixed as a delegated act.

Specifiek op dit punt stelt het kabinet in het BNC-fiche dat het vaststellen van het optimale traject tussen 2030 en 2050 als essentieel element van de wet wordt gezien en daarom pleit het kabinet dat het traject tussen 2030 en 2050 niet als gedelegeerde handeling dient te kunnen worden vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat het kabinet de productie van kolencentrales omlaag wil brengen­

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the cabinet wants to reduce coal plant output to meet the Urgenda obligations, asking about the CO2 reduction, budget, timeline, effect of the COVID-19 slowdown, and whether to reconsider. The minister answered that a package of measures including coal plants is being prepared and will be sent to parliament shortly, declined to anticipate it on most questions, and explained that carbon leakage and the ETS waterbed effect will likely play only a limited role.
The cabinet is currently working on a package of additional measures to contribute to implementing the Urgenda ruling.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment aan een pakket met aanvullende maatregelen om een bijdrage te leveren aan de uitvoering van het Urgenda-vonnis.
Antwoord op vragen van van het lid Moorlag over stikstofemissie ten gevolge van houtstook

An MP (Moorlag, PvdA) asked the ministers whether Dutch emission limits for NOx and dust from biomass power plants in the Activiteitenbesluit comply with EU rules and whether they should be tightened, citing a Mobilisation for the Environment letter. The state secretary replied that the limits meet EU requirements, that TNO is studying tightening them under the Schone Lucht Akkoord, and that provinces and municipalities will apply Best Available Techniques in permitting.
In the context of the Clean Air Agreement I am having TNO research the possibilities for tightening these emission limit values
In het kader van het Schone Lucht Akkoord laat ik TNO onderzoek doen naar de mogelijkheden van aanscherping van deze emissiegrenswaarden

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het Britse Hof van Beroep heeft geoordeeld dat uitbreidingsplannen voor London Heathrow Airport strijdig zijn met de klimaatdoelstellingen uit het Parijsakkoor

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government whether aviation can still ignore the Paris Agreement after a UK Court of Appeal ruled Heathrow expansion plans unlawful, and how Dutch airport plans such as Schiphol growth and Lelystad Airport fit with climate goals. The government answers that aviation emissions are addressed through ICAO and national sector agreements, that the UK ruling concerns UK planning law, and that Dutch airport decisions require environmental impact assessments which are still pending, without committing to halt the projects.
The government's aim is to achieve CO2 reductions based on the measures described in my letter on aviation climate policy of 27 March 2019.
Het streven van het kabinet is om CO 2 -reducties te realiseren op basis van de maatregelen die zijn beschreven in mijn brief over het klimaatbeleid voor de luchtvaart van 27 maart 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de omgang van grote ondernemingen met betaaltermijnen in verband met het coronavirus

MP Moorlag asked whether large companies may unilaterally extend payment terms to suppliers during the coronavirus crisis, and what the government will do to prevent this. The state secretary answered that payment terms above 60 days for SMEs are void under Dutch civil law, that the government has spoken to companies that signalled such extensions and they committed to legal terms, and that a shorter 30-day limit is planned.
I have received signals that some large companies want to stretch payment terms due to the economic situation caused by the coronavirus.
Ik heb signalen gekregen dat enkele grote ondernemingen de betaaltermijnen naar aanleiding van de economische situatie als gevolg van het coronavirus willen oprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Graaf over een werkbezoek aan Groningen op maandag 2 maart 2020

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked the ministers about differing reinforcement regimes in Overschild, slow reinforcement advice, cost recovery from NAM, small-field gas damage claims, vacant housing, and Delfzijl evacuations. Minister Ollongren answered that regime differences are unavoidable given evolving policy, that the new law gives residents a choice of control, and that the damage protocol and Commission should be operational by 1 July 2020, while largely deferring details to other bodies.
The bill does not change agreements made within the implementation of the various batches.
Het wetsvoorstel brengt geen wijzigingen aan in afspraken die in het kader van uitvoering van de verschillende batches zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Ronnes over zonnepanelen op sociale huurwoningen

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers how to rapidly expand solar panels on social rental housing, including a proposal from Urgenda and housing corporations to use part of the landlord levy in 2020. The government answered that the levy cannot be used this way, pointed to SDE+/SDE++ subsidies and a planned bill on corporations' energy generation, and said it would present a further package to meet the Urgenda ruling.
I am positive about the initiative of Urgenda and housing corporations to expand the number of solar panels on roofs.
Ik sta positief tegenover het initiatief van Urgenda en woningcorporaties om het aantallen zonnepanelen op daken uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht ‘Zonne-energiesector laat doos van Pandora gesloten: ‘Producent van morgen betaalt recyclingkosten voor producent van gisteren’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether solar panel recycling costs are financed by current producers paying for past panels, and whether a funding shortfall could arise. The state secretary answered that producers and importers bear recycling costs under extended producer responsibility, that the pay-as-you-go system avoids a shortfall, and that an AVV application by Stichting OPEN has been submitted for assessment.
I will assess the application and publish a draft decision for public comment in the Staatscourant as soon as possible.
Ik zal de aanvraag beoordelen en zo spoedig als mogelijk is een ontwerpbeschikking voor zienswijze publiceren in de Staatscourant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Geurts en Von Martels over schade aan mestkelders, ventilatiekanalen en funderingen veroorzaakt door mijnbouwactiviteiten in Groningen

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers whether agricultural damage to manure cellars, ventilation shafts and foundations from Groningen gas extraction had been wrongly excluded from reinforcement and damage handling by NAM, CVW and the TCMG, and how farmers are heard and supported. The government answered that the TCMG handles new damage claims, uses civil liability law with the statutory presumption of causation, is consulting an expert panel on manure cellar damage due around June 2020, and is working with the Province on a programmatic approach for farmers.
The panel's advice is expected to be ready around mid-June 2020.
Naar verwachting is het advies van het panel medio juni 2020 gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over vergoeding nieuw gevonden schade tijdens herstelwerkzaamheden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate how new earthquake damage found during repairs is handled, whether there is a priority procedure, how quickly costs are reimbursed, and what residents should do about extra work costs and contractor bills they cannot pay. The minister replied that newly discovered damage can be reported to the TCMG, which decides whether to include it in an existing or new procedure, that the damage calculation includes reasonably expected extra work, that objection and appeal remain open, and that the contractor variant exists but is little used; no figures are kept on how often new damage is found.
The TCMG has indicated that no exact figures are known because it is not recorded how often new mining damage is discovered during repairs.
De TCMG heeft laten weten dat er geen exacte aantallen bekend zijn omdat niet wordt geregistreerd hoe vaak het voorkomt dat tijdens het herstel nieuwe mijnbouwschade wordt ontdekt.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de aardbevingen van 22 en 23 maart ten tijde van corona

An MP asked ministers about earthquakes in Groningen on 22-23 March 2020 during the coronavirus lockdown, including whether residents can safely stay home, whether monitoring thresholds were exceeded, the TCMG's reduced evening availability, relocation to temporary housing, speeding up reinforcement, and asking Shell/NAM for extra money. The ministers answered that no monitoring thresholds were exceeded, that TCMG adjusted opening hours and piloted remote damage inspections while keeping acute-unsafe-situation handling, that reinforcement is being accelerated as gas extraction falls, and that all reinforcement costs are borne by NAM and its shareholders.
I have the authority to intervene in extraction at any time if the safety situation gives cause for it.
Ik heb de bevoegdheid om te allen tijde in de winning in te grijpen als de veiligheidssituatie daar aanleiding toe geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de bomenkap voor stadsverwarming in Purmerend

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked whether 16,000 trees were felled in the Schoorl dunes, whether the wood fed Purmerend's district heating, and whether a Staatsbosbeheer representative's roles (Enerco, Energiehout, former FSC board) amounted to conflict of interest. The minister answers that the felling was a 2018-2019 thinning, the wood went to the wood industry, and no conflict of interest exists given functional separation and that FSC does not certify.
In response to your questions I obtained information from Staatsbosbeheer.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van uw vragen informatie ingewonnen bij Staatsbosbeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Hoe de Facebook-CEO zichzelf zou inperken‘

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a report on Facebook's CEO resisting regulation, algorithm audits, tax reform for tech firms, unfair competition from big tech, innovation effects of acquisitions, and tech employment in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered each question, mostly stating existing policy, pointing to ongoing EU and OECD processes, and making a moral appeal to tech firms, without committing to new concrete measures.
For the latest state of affairs I refer you to the State Secretary of Finance.
Voor de laatste stand van zaken verwijs ik u graag naar de Staatssecretaris van Financiën
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat Shell de Nationale Boomfeestdag van Staatsbosbeheer sponsort

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether Shell's sponsorship of the Nationale Boomfeestdag, its climate record, and related tree-planting and flight-compensation claims amount to greenwashing and misleading children's education material. The government confirmed the sponsorship, said climate responsibility lies with companies and the Klimaatakkoord, declined to assess school learning materials citing school autonomy, and promised a separate letter on the voluntary CO2 compensation market.
The cabinet regularly receives questions about the content of learning materials.
Met enige regelmaat krijgt het kabinet vragen over de inhoud van leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Chemelot zet vol in op energie- en chemiesnelweg’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Chemelot industrial site's need for pipelines and energy infrastructure linking Rotterdam, Germany and offshore energy, and about rail transport of hazardous substances. The minister answered that a taskforce on industrial infrastructure is examining the connections, that a cost-benefit study points to modal shift to pipelines, and that talks with the province and companies will follow.
I have made arrangements with the province to discuss this with them soon.
Ik heb afspraken gemaakt met de provincie om dit binnenkort met hen te bespreken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Beckerman en Agnes Mulder over het rapport van de Noordelijke Rekenkamer ‘Herverdeling onder Hoogspanning, een onderzoek naar de verdeling naar de kosten en baten rondom wind- en

MPs asked the ministers about the Northern Audit Office report on how costs and benefits of wind and solar parks are distributed, including whether provinces can enforce compensation for residents and whether uniform national rules are needed. The minister said financial participation is important, that provinces' legal powers are being mapped with the interbestuurlijk level and will be reported after summer 2020, and that he opposes uniform national legal norms because projects differ.
Within interbestuurlijk consultation, it is currently being mapped which legal possibilities and powers decentralised governments have to set requirements on financial participation.
Binnen interbestuurlijk verband wordt momenteel in kaart gebracht welke juridische mogelijkheden/bevoegdheden decentrale overheden hebben om eisen te stellen aan financiële participatie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over strengere regulering en betere certificering van zowel installateurs als installatiebedrijven met betrekking tot kleinschalige duurzame energie installaties

MP Van der Lee asked the ministers whether stricter regulation and certification of installers and installation firms for small-scale renewable energy systems is needed, citing fire problems with pellet stoves and poor installations. The minister replied that installer quality is a shared concern, that EZK required certified installers and product standards under ISDE, that no broadly supported industry proposal emerged, and promised talks with industry and a letter to the House afterwards.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over onduidelijke tarieven bij laadpalen voor elektrische auto’s

MPs Sienot and Schonis asked the government about unclear and non-transparent charging tariffs at public EV charge points, and whether the price-transparency agreements with the sector would be met in 2020. The minister acknowledged the need for transparency, described the existing pricing structure and agreements with the sector and ACM, and declined to impose a standard tariff, while committing to further steps such as a legislative change and a sector-wide data exchange by 1 June 2020.
I have made further agreements on price transparency with the industry associations of operators and service providers within the National Agenda for Charging Infrastructure (NAL).
Ik heb met de brancheverenigingen van exploitanten en serviceproviders in het kader van de Nationale Agenda Laadinfrastructuur (NAL) nadere afspraken gemaakt over prijstransparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Diks over schaliegas en plastic

MPs Van der Lee and Diks asked about plastic pellet pollution, shale gas-driven plastic production, bank and insurer investments in shale gas and plastics companies in Argentina, and whether damages can be recovered from polluters. The minister answered that the government shares concern about plastic pollution, points to EU and national initiatives, says it has no oversight of the investments or the claimed harms, leaves responsibility for IMVO due diligence and compensation with companies and financial institutions, and confirms that polluters bear restoration costs under Dutch law.
The cabinet has no insight into the investments of the named banks and insurers in shale gas and plastics companies and therefore cannot confirm the investment figures.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de investeringen van de genoemde banken en verzekeraars in schaliegas- en plasticbedrijven en kan investeringscijfers dan ook niet bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palland, Amhaouch, Wiersma, Verhoeven, Bruins, Gijs van Dijk, Van Kent en Stoffer over het aangekondigde massaontslag bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs asked the government about the announced loss of 750 jobs at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, a new Hungarian plant that received subsidies, and whether EU state aid rules were breached, and whether the government would press the Commission or the company. The minister replied that the Commission judged the Hungarian aid compatible with the internal market, saw no reason to contact the Commission or Hungary, said there were no prior warnings of reorganisation in contacts with the owner and the Enschede management, and left the social plan to the company while pointing to a regional deal.
Should further study of the case give cause for it, I will bring this to the attention of the Commission and my colleagues involved.
Mocht er na verdere bestudering van de casus aanleiding toe zijn dan zal ik dat bij de Commissie en mijn collega's die hierbij zijn betrokken onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat Apollo/Vredestein 750 fulltime-equivalent (fte) aan banen wil schrappen in de locatie in Enschede

An SP MP asks the Economic Affairs minister about Apollo Vredestein's plan to cut 750 FTE jobs in Enschede, including whether the government was informed, whether it intervened, the Hungarian factory and possible EU state aid, and eligibility for the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund. The minister answers that the reorganisation is a company strategic decision, that the government cannot prevent it but works to retain firms, that Hungarian rather than EU subsidies were involved and were found compatible by the Commission, and that an EGF application is undetermined.
However, this planned reorganisation is a strategic consideration of the company.
Deze voorgenomen reorganisatie is echter een strategische overweging van het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Chipsector onderuit na uitlekken Amerikaanse plannen‘

Two MPs asked whether the government would raise with the US a planned licensing requirement on exports to China of chip-making equipment containing US components, and how it fits international law and EU policy. The minister said the US De Minimis Rule already applies, that the government will await the formal US position before commenting, and that it aims to secure good international arrangements for the semiconductor value chain.
The cabinet does not want to anticipate unconfirmed reports and for now awaits the formal position of the US government and any changes to US legislation.
Het kabinet wil niet vooruitlopen op onbevestigde berichtgeving en wacht vooralsnog het formele standpunt van de Amerikaanse regering en eventuele wijzigingen in de Amerikaanse wetgeving af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens, Van Dijk, Moorlag en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het Coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party (PvdA) asked the ministers of health, social affairs, economic affairs and the state secretary of justice about IC bed capacity, care for budget holders, immigration detention during the coronavirus crisis, temporary worker and self-employed income support, Schiphol security staff conditions, childcare leave and state support for firms. The minister answered most questions substantively, describing measures and plans, while declining to commit to a fixed IC bed scenario beyond referring to earlier letters and saying the 40-hour norm and PBM supplies were still under review.
I refer you to that for brevity.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inkomensongelijkheid en de gevolgen van statistische keuzes

MP Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Economic Affairs about a claim that statistical choices (deducting interest, excluding capital gains) make income inequality look smaller, and whether indirect and local taxes make the tax system regressive. The State Secretary acknowledged wealth inequality, defended CBS and OECD statistical conventions, and argued that indirect taxes are not necessarily more burdensome for low incomes.
I am aware of the article. I agree that wealth is distributed more unequally than income.
Ik ben bekend met het artikel. Ik onderschrijf dat vermogens ongelijker verdeeld zijn dan inkomens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over de uitzending van EenVandaag over biomassa uit de Verenigde Staten

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the ministers about an EenVandaag broadcast on US wood pellets and whether whole trees are used for biomass sold to the Netherlands. Minister Wiebes said he lacked 2019 data, would not name companies citing commercial confidentiality, and argued that sustainability criteria apply regardless of origin and of US Paris Agreement membership.
I cannot say which companies these are, because this is commercially confidential information.
Ik kan niet aangeven om welke bedrijven dit gaat, omdat dit bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Futselaar over de gevolgen van het coronavirus en de dalende olieprijzen op de economie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs how the coronavirus and falling oil prices will affect the economy, whether governments should act themselves, and about stimulus plans in Germany, France, Italy and Spain, mortgage relief, the investment fund and support for small businesses. The minister answered that the impact is not yet predictable, that the government is taking measures such as short-time work and liquidity support, and that further measures will follow if needed.
Depending on developments, the cabinet will take necessary and appropriate follow-up measures if the situation so requires.
Afhankelijk van de ontwikkelingen zal het kabinet noodzakelijke en passende vervolgmaatregelen treffen indien de situatie daartoe noopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de correctie op transporttarieven voor grootverbruikers

MP Van der Lee asked whether the statutory volume correction gives large consumers up to 90% off electricity transport tariffs, which sectors and how many firms benefit, the total cost, whether it rewards flat consumption rather than off-peak use, and whether it has been evaluated. Minister Wiebes answered that the correction varies between 0% and 90%, that 60 firms (mainly data centres and energy-intensive industry) used it in 2019 at a total of EUR 48 million, that it does reward flat consumption but cannot be redesigned for savings or off-peak use without breaking cost-causation rules, and that perverse effects will be considered in the forthcoming Energy Act.
In doing so I will also look at whether the volume correction scheme has any perverse effects.
Ik zal daarbij ook kijken naar het bestaan van eventuele perverse effecten van de volumecorrectieregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat een vooraanstaande klimaatscepticus werd gefinancierd door Nederlandse multinationals en klimaatbeleid probeerde te frustreren

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that Dutch companies funded a prominent climate sceptic who allegedly sought to undermine climate policy, including how ministry officials supported him and whether the damage could be recovered from the companies. The Minister declined to speculate on company intentions, said specific lobbying influence cannot be assessed, could not say which officials had contacts with him, and said the focus is on achieving future climate goals with business cooperation.

It cannot be determined with whom Mr Böttcher had contact within the Ministry of Economic Affairs during his career, and to what extent this had any influence on political choices made in that period.

Het is niet te achterhalen met wie de heer Böttcher binnen het Ministerie van Economische Zaken gedurende zijn carrière contact heeft gehad en in hoeverre dit enige invloed heeft gehad op politieke keuzes die in die periode zijn gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat een klimaatscepticus meer dan een miljoen gulden ontving van o.a. Nederlandse bedrijven met als expliciet doel om twijfel te zaaien over klimaatverandering en

An MP asks ministers whether they will act on reports that Dutch companies funded a climate sceptic to sow doubt about climate change, and whether those companies should be excluded from climate policy and education. The government answers that it is up to the companies to provide clarity, that it cannot assess the influence of sceptics, that it will not ask schools, media or the cultural sector to change their ties, and that companies funding sceptics may keep their seats at the Climate Agreement table.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel 'Klimaatsceptisch Nederland profiteert nog altijd van netwerk en geld uit fossiele industrie'

An MP from D66 asked the minister about a Follow the Money article on the climate-sceptic foundation Clintel, its links to the fossil industry, and whether the government used or had contact with climate sceptics. The minister answered that the government is not aware of using Clintel, that climate policy rests on IPCC and Dutch knowledge institutes, and that the influence of past contacts cannot be determined.
Not that I am aware of.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag en Nijboer over ‘de economische gevolgen van het coronavirus’

MPs from the PvdA asked the government about the economic effects of the coronavirus, including supply and demand shocks, short-time work, public investment, support for small businesses, and comparisons with Germany and Italy. The government answered that it is monitoring the situation, has announced a noodpakket of support measures (NOW wage subsidy, BMKB loan guarantees, tax deferrals, self-employed support), says a robust forecast is not yet possible, and defers further details to a CPB scenario publication.
The cabinet of course closely monitors economic developments.
Het kabinet houdt de economische ontwikkelingen vanzelfsprekend nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Multinationals niet langer grootste banenmotor, politie grootste werkgever‘

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a newspaper report that multinationals are no longer the largest employers and whether this reflects relocation of jobs and weaker competitiveness. The minister disputed the framing, stated that multinationals provide about 21% of employment in line with the OECD average, described job relocation as a small part of normal job dynamics, and outlined general business and investment policy without committing to specific new measures.
That multinationals would no longer be the largest engine of jobs is not something I recognise.
Dat multinationals niet langer de grootste banenmotor zouden zijn, herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de groeiende steun voor kernenergie

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why he supports nuclear energy yet the Climate Agreement excludes it, whether subsidies for wind and solar should stop, and whether a 25% land-use scenario for renewables is realistic. The Minister replies that no CO2-free source is excluded, that new nuclear is unlikely before 2030, that he will not give regular subsidies to any flexible capacity, that subsidies for wind and solar on land end after 2025, and that the 25% land-use claim is unrealistic and alarmist.
It is my aim not to give regular subsidies to any form of flexible capacity.
Het is mijn inzet om geen reguliere subsidie te geven aan welke vorm van regelbaar vermogen dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een wetenschappelijk onderzoek dat aantoont dat de methaanuitstoot van de fossiele energiesector veel hoger is dan gedacht

An MP asked the minister whether a study showing much higher fossil-sector methane leakage implies underreporting, and what Dutch emissions and measures follow. The minister answered that the national reporting is sound, offshore TNO measurements match industry figures, and an offshore methane convenant aims to halve emissions, while deferring the scientific question to IPCC processes.
There is no reason to assume that methane emissions would be greater.
Er is geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat de methaanuitstoot groter zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de plannen voor ‘grootste windpark ter wereld‘ boven Eemshaven

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about plans for a very large offshore wind park above Eemshaven, its link to the Climate Agreement, hydrogen production and the economy of the North, and what the government could contribute. The minister welcomed the initiative as potentially useful, said it is too early to assess its effects since it is still at the feasibility stage, and promised to study any concrete plans later.
The project itself is, after all, not much more than an idea for which the feasibility study still needs to be carried out.
Het project zelf is immers nog niet veel meer dan een idee waarvoor de haalbaarheidsstudie nog uitgevoerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Moorlag  en Mulder over de compensatieregeling voor omwonenden van de windparken N33 en Oostermoer

MPs Beckerman, Moorlag and Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about compensation for property value loss near the N33 and Oostermoer wind farms, including how many homes lost value and whether a 2019 VU/UvA study on turbine size and house prices calls for fairer compensation. The Minister replied that no compensation for value loss was promised, residents can apply for planning damage (planschade) compensation via the municipality or RVO, a rijksbijdrage of 2.1 million euro was added to the Drentse Monden and Oostermoer area fund, and the N33 request will be assessed similarly while no direct compensation is planned.
I do not have an overview of the number of homes in the areas of the N33 and De Drentse Monden en Oostermoer wind farms that have lost value, or the amount of value lost.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal woningen in de gebieden van de windparken N33 en De Drentse Monden en Oostermoer dat in waarde is gedaald en wat de waardedaling van deze woningen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over onbegrijpelijk hoge rekeningen bij blokverwarming
