MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked about very high bills for communal (block) heating, the Warmtewet's coverage of owner-occupiers and VvE members, the cost of checking heat meters, and how residents can challenge high bills. The minister answered that VvE-supplied heat is now excluded from the Warmtewet, that VvE members have rights under Book 5 BW and access to civil courts, and that the procedure is reasonable.
It is therefore not necessary to open the route to a complaints committee for this.
Het is dus niet nodig om hiervoor de weg naar een geschillencommissie open te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over het gebruik van warmtenetten

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the ministers why district heating costs differ from gas heating, what legal and technical barriers exist to disconnecting from heat networks, and related questions on tariff linkage, fixed versus variable costs, and temperature-based pricing. The minister replied that maximum heat tariffs are based on the gas reference so costs are on average equal, that disconnection is governed by the Warmtewet and civil law with some exceptions, and that tariff regulation is being reformed.
In my progress letter on Heat Act 2 I concluded that the current tariff system based on a gas reference is not sustainable in the long term.
In mijn voortgangsbrief over Warmtewet 2 heb ik geconcludeerd dat de huidige tariefsystematiek op basis van een gasreferentie op de lange termijn niet houdbaar is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Dik-Faber en Harbers over de organisatie van de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen

Four MPs asked the Minister about reported internal chaos at the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG), its absorption of the CVW, staff turnover and whether this threatens reinforcement work. The Minister denied chaos, called reorganisation necessary, said public execution is now with the NCG and the TCMG/IMG handles compensation, and promised further attention to staff retention and continued contact.
The image that there would be chaos, as the headline above the cited report suggests, I do not recognise.
Het beeld dat er sprake zou zijn van chaos, zoals de kop boven het aangehaalde bericht suggereert, herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘het stoppen van het sensorennetwerk in het aardbevingsgebied

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about NAM ending the TNO sensor network in the Groningen earthquake area and removing sensors from homes, including residents who wish to keep them. The minister answered that residents may keep their sensors, that consultation and an investigation into a resident-participation network are underway, that the network no longer yields new insights, and that the government will not take it over.
I have asked NAM to pause the removal.
Ik heb de NAM gevraagd het verwijderen te pauzeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het stopzetten van een zaak door Arbiter Bodembeweging

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Arbiter Bodembeweging dropping a Groningen farm family's mining damage case as the arbiter body winds down, and what this means for remaining claims. The minister answered that three manure-cellar cases will move to the TCMG if claimants withdraw, that about 33 cases remain with the arbiter (most to be decided by 1 May 2020), and declined to comment on individual cases.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het loket “Oude schades” van de provincie Groningen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the 'Oude schades' claims desk run by the Groningen province, including how many claims were assessed, rejected or granted, the role of NAM, and whether the desk should stay open. The Minister reports 193 requests with 80 in scope and 23 granted so far, that NAM makes the first assessment, that the desk closed on 1 March 2020 without extension, and that individual cases are not discussed.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de vergunningen Wet natuurbescherming (Wnb) die niet noodzakelijk zijn voor het aanvragen van SDE+-subsidies waardoor miljoenen euro’s subsidie op de plank blijven liggen

An MP asked why Wnb nature permits are not required for SDE+ subsidy applications, even though some biomass and other renewable projects are delayed for lack of them and subsidy budget stays reserved. The minister answered that the Wnb permit is not a mandatory attachment for most categories, that a stricter requirement will be introduced for certain categories in the SDE++ round, and that the province decides whether small biomass plants need a Wnb permit.
I currently have no insight into all projects for which the Wnb permit is a constraint on realisation, and therefore also not into how much commitment budget is involved.
Ik heb op dit moment geen inzicht in alle projecten waarvoor de Wnb-vergunning knellend is voor realisatie en dus ook niet hoeveel verplichtingenbudget hiermee gemoeid gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat gasbedrijven Gronings onderzoek naar duurzame energie domineren

Two SP MPs asked whether gas companies dominating the New Energy Coalition's research on sustainable energy in Groningen is problematic, including its university and subsidy links and the NAM's role. The minister defended the open involvement of fossil-fuel firms in the energy transition, said the NEC's conduct is not a government concern absent evidence of breach, and promised a study of third-party funding of research.
In accordance with this motion, a study will be carried out, with the Ministry of OCW taking the lead.
Conform deze motie zal een onderzoek worden uitgevoerd, waarbij het Ministerie van OCW het voortouw zal nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ronnes en Amhaouch over de problemen bij Centric en Oranjewoud

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about governance problems at Centric, Oranjewoud and Strukton, including an unlicensed investigator, the departure of Centric's top management, and board supervision. The government answered that Centric's services to DNB and BNG are unaffected for now, that no investigator licence exists, that FIOD received and declined to treat a complaint due to criminal proceedings, and explained the legal duties of supervisory boards, while noting the answers were delayed.
Due to overlap with investigation and prosecution under article 9:8(1)(f) of the General Administrative Law Act, this complaint, in consultation with the Public Prosecution Service, was not handled.
Wegens samenloop met opsporing en vervolging conform art. 9:8 lid 1 onderdeel f Awb is deze klacht, in afstemming met het Openbaar Ministerie, niet in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het ondersteunen van lokale initiatieven voor duurzame energie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether small local renewable energy initiatives, such as a village windmill, face disproportionate barriers in the SDE+ subsidy application process and whether RVO could help them and tolerate minor errors. The minister agreed local initiatives matter and explained that applicants can correct errors within the tender system, that RVO offers information sessions and help, but declined to add a hardship clause and did not answer the question about a faster timetable.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht ‘Nu stoppen met aardgas zorgt juist voor méér CO2-uitstoot’

An MP asked the minister whether ending gas use increases CO2 emissions, citing a professor's claim, and asked about contradictions in Dutch gas and climate policy and whether the Paris agreement should be abandoned. The minister defended a phased exit from domestic gas use by 2050 and continued extraction from Dutch fields, and said sustainable biomass is climate-neutral.
In short, we are gradually phasing out natural gas, but not gas altogether.
We gaan, kortom, geleidelijk van het aardgas af, maar niet van het gas af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat de overheid nog steeds miljarden aan investeringen in de fossiele industrie dekt

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked why the state's export credit insurance (EKV) still covers large amounts of fossil-fuel investment and whether it should be phased out, and asked the government to study the effect on climate policy. The government disputes the press figures, says about 30% of the portfolio is fossil-related, pledges to green the portfolio and measure it better, but rejects phasing out fossil cover unilaterally, citing effectiveness and jobs.
No. Phasing out in the Netherlands the granting of insurance for all investments related to fossil fuels would go too far.
Nee. Het in Nederland uitfaseren van het geven van verzekeringen voor alle investeringen die te maken hebben met fossiel gaat een brug te ver.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Van der Lee en Van Raan over de Gedragscode Zon op Land

Five MPs from different parties asked ministers about the industry-drafted Gedragscode Zon op Land (code of conduct for ground-mounted solar), its alignment with the solar-ladder motions, protection of Natura 2000 and national park areas, guidance to local authorities and RES regions, use in rijksgronden tenders, and PBL's landscape report. The government welcomed the code as consistent with the voorkeursvolgorde zon, said it will be promoted via the Nationaal Programma RES and monitored, and deferred the landscape-policy questions to a forthcoming NOVI letter.
Through the National Programme RES we will bring this code of conduct to the attention of the RES regions.
Via het Nationaal Programma RES (NP RES) brengen we deze gedragscode onder de aandacht van de RES’en.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het stoppen met zoutwinning in de Waddenzee

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether the advisory committee found the baseline measurements for salt mining in the Wadden Sea insufficient for monitoring, and whether all preparatory activities should stop given the World Heritage status. Minister Wiebes confirmed the committee's finding, rejected stopping preparatory work, and said the revised baseline would be submitted to the audit committee, with no mining allowed until monitoring is in order.
I currently see no reason for further measures.
Ik zie nu geen aanleiding voor verdere maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over stijgende energielasten door warmtepompen en laadpalen

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether rising household energy bills from heat pumps and EV chargers are acceptable, and whether he would abandon climate policy. The minister acknowledged grid investment is needed, pointed to the Climate Agreement and tax measures to lower bills in 2020, and refused to end the climate policy.
The cabinet understands the concerns surrounding the energy bill and considers it important that the energy transition be feasible and affordable for everyone.
Het kabinet begrijpt de zorgen die rond de energierekening leven en vindt het belangrijk dat de energietransitie voor iedereen haalbaar en betaalbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman en lid Hijink over het bericht dat een man in hongerstaking gaat

MPs Beckerman and Hijink asked the government how it will help Dhani Hoekstra, who announced a hunger strike over Groningen earthquake damage, and what it will do for people suffering psychological distress from gas extraction. The minister said the case is handled by responsible bodies, declined to comment on the individual case, and outlined gas-extraction phase-out, extra funding for social-emotional support and mental health care, without giving a count of users.
Beyond that, I will not comment on this individual case.
Voor het overige doe ik geen uitlatingen over deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over 70 branden met pelletkachels, d.d 21 december 2019

An MP asked about 70 fire incidents involving pellet stoves in northern provinces and about the causes, data and effect of ending the subsidy. The minister answered that no national fire data exist, that most incidents were overheating or smoke rather than house fires, and agreed to consult the stove trade about installer quality.
Inquiries with Brandweer Nederland revealed that no national data on fires involving pellet stoves are kept.
Uit navraag bij Brandweer Nederland is gebleken dat er geen landelijke gegevens van branden met pelletkachels worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over te pessimistische klimaatonderzoeken

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the minister whether climate research using pessimistic scenarios like RCP8.5 is misleading and whether the government will stop its climate agenda and withdraw from the Paris Agreement. The minister rejected these claims, arguing that worst-case scenarios remain necessary for risk planning, that sea-level rise risks justify precautionary policy, and that Dutch participation in the Paris Agreement continues.
The Netherlands is and remains a party to the Paris Climate Agreement, because it offers the greatest chance of an effective global approach
Nederland is en blijft partij bij het Klimaatakkoord van Parijs, omdat dat de grootste kans biedt op een effectieve mondiale aanpak
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht 'Wouter Bos over Invest-NL: voor minder dan 5 miljoen hoef je hier niet aan te kloppen'

MP Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether Invest-NL's director saying SMEs need not apply for financing under five million euros, and the reported minimum-amount requirement, conflict with the minister's earlier assurances and the unanimously adopted motion on SME access. The minister replied that there is no minimum investment threshold, that most current pipeline applicants are SMEs, and that the conditions are set in law, while committing to review conditions in future progress reports and evaluations.
There is no minimum investment threshold for Invest-NL.
Er is geen minimale investeringsdrempel voor Invest-NL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over de vertraging van duurzame energieprojecten vanwege de stikstofproblematiek

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why sustainable energy projects, including hydrogen projects in Groningen, are delayed by the nitrogen problem, and what measures are being taken to complete them on time. The minister answered that stricter permitting after the PAS ruling delays some large energy projects, that no complete overview exists, and listed measures such as netting schemes, lease of nitrogen space, and a planned bundling programme, with a further letter promised in spring.

There is no complete overview of projects affected, because the competent authority lies with different governments (municipalities, provinces and central government) and initiators can be both public and private parties.

Er is geen compleet overzicht van projecten die hiermee te maken hebben, omdat het bevoegd gezag hiervoor bij verschillende overheden (gemeenten, provincies en Rijk) ligt en initiatiefnemers zowel overheden als private partijen kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘Nederland zal veel eerder en veel meer gas moeten importeren dan tot nu werd gedacht’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report warning that Dutch small gas fields will decline and the country must import more gas earlier, including questions on nature and safety protections, CO2 emissions, Norwegian gas and reducing gas dependence. The minister acknowledged lower future production from small fields, said permits follow safety and environmental assessments, promised to stimulate domestic production via a Mining Act amendment, and rejected accelerating gas phase-out beyond the Climate Agreement.
A permit is required under the Mining Act for the exploration and extraction of minerals.
Voor opsporing en winning van delfstoffen is een vergunning vereist krachtens de Mijnbouwwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de Rotterdamse klimaatplannen

An MP from the PVV asks the ministers whether Rotterdam's plan to remove gas from 100,000 homes and halve CO2 emissions in ten years is feasible, whether municipalities may force homeowners off gas, what climate effect the Rotterdam plans achieve, and whether the Climate Agreement should be scrapped. The minister rejects the criticism, citing the Climate Agreement, a DCMR estimate of 0.15 megaton CO2 reduction from Rotterdam's building measures by 2030, and voluntary choices for residents, and refuses to withdraw the plans.
No one is forced to participate.
Niemand wordt gedwongen mee te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sienot over het artikel ‘Nederland zit niet te wachten op geld uit groene subsidiepot van de EU’

MPs Jetten and Sienot asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the Netherlands would not take part in the EU Just Transition Fund given its high emissions and low renewable generation, and whether it would press for funding for gas-extraction regions such as Groningen. The minister answers that the cabinet supports the mechanism but wants its size limited within the Dutch MFK position, and will argue for objective criteria that include employment effects in hard-hit regions; details are referred to a separate BNC-fiche.
The cabinet will then argue for the use of objective criteria, which should also take into account employment in the regions hardest hit by the climate transition.

Het kabinet zal vervolgens pleiten voor het gebruik van objectieve criteria, waarbij ook de werkgelegenheid in regio's die het hardst worden geraakt ten gevolge van de klimaattransitie moet worden meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins, Sienot en Lodders over het bericht dat de prijs van elektriciteit van snelladers wordt verhoogd naar 79 cent/kWH voor passanten

MPs asked whether the government will investigate market power and cartel formation among fast-charger operators after Ionity raised guest charging prices to 79 cent/kWh, and whether a maximum price should be set. The government answered that ACM is independent and has heightened attention for the sector, that the market is open and competitive, and that a maximum price is not currently under consideration.
The Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is an independent regulator.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Omdat duizenden bedrijven geen natuurvergunning hebben weten we niet hoeveel stikstof de industrie uitstoot’

An MP asked the ministers whether it is known how many companies lack a nature permit under the Nature Conservation Act, and why emissions reporting thresholds limit visibility of industrial nitrogen emissions. The government answered that the number of companies without permits is not known, that provinces are responsible for permitting and enforcement, and that industrial emissions are well covered by the Emissieregistratie, while declining to lower the reporting threshold.
It is not known how many companies wrongly lack a permit under the Nature Conservation Act.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel bedrijven er ten onrechte geen vergunning hebben in het kader van de Wet natuurbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over de publicatie van het tarievenbesluit warmteleveranciers 2020

An MP asked the minister why 2020 maximum heat tariffs rose sharply for fixed charges, connection fees and disconnection costs, and how consumers are protected from heat monopolies. The minister explained that the increases follow the new cost-based methodology set by ACM under the amended Warmtewet, that total annual costs at 35 GJ fell slightly, and that cost-based regulation will be pursued further in Warmtewet 2.
This year the maximum tariffs are based for the first time on the most recent amendment of the Heat Act (adopted in 2018) and the underlying regulations.
Dit jaar worden de maximumtarieven voor de eerste maal gebaseerd op de meest recente wijziging van de Warmtewet (aangenomen in 2018) en de onderliggende regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht ‘Vraag naar elektrische bouwmachines groeit, aanbod blijft nog achter’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether electric construction machinery can reduce nitrogen and greenhouse emissions, how tender procedures weigh e-machinery, and whether financial incentives exist. The minister answered that electrification helps air quality and emissions, that a roadmap to zero-emission machinery is being prepared, and that tax schemes (MIA/Vamil) and the DKTI subsidy support adoption.
The national government, together with construction firms, manufacturers and suppliers of construction equipment, is mapping the developments needed to speed up the pace.
Het Rijk brengt samen met bouwbedrijven, fabrikanten en leveranciers van bouwmaterieel de benodigde ontwikkelingen in kaart om het tempo op te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een belasting op luchtvervuiling in de Nederlandse industrie

An MP asked the ministers whether a tax on industrial air pollution, as proposed by the CPB, is effective and feasible, and what its production and emissions effects would be. The government agrees pricing is a useful instrument, notes modelled production declines of about 4-8% by 2030 with wide uncertainty, and says further study is needed before deciding, preferably at European level.
Should emission reductions fall short of the targets in the future, it would make sense to explore the costs and benefits of additional instruments.
Mocht in de toekomst de emissiereductie achterblijven bij de doelen, dan ligt het in de rede om de kosten en baten van aanvullende instrumenten te verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht “Aanleg van zonnedaken stokt door stijgende verzekeringspremies”

An MP asked the minister whether doubled insurance premiums for rooftop solar threaten the energy transition, whether they are proportionate, and whether independent research and training measures are needed. The minister said premiums are a small part of renewable costs, that insurance pricing is primarily a market matter overseen by the ACM, and pointed to existing certification and information initiatives.
It is up to insurers themselves to assess the risks and set premiums on that basis.
Het is aan verzekeraars zelf om een inschatting te maken van de risico’s en op basis daarvan de premies te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de verzekering van zonnepanelen

PvdA MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether high insurance premiums are hindering solar panel installation, whether the government should intervene if private parties do not solve the insurance problem, and what rules govern fire safety and location choice. Minister Wiebes answered that the effect of premiums is unknown but likely small, that talks with insurers are constructive so no larger government role is planned, that fire safety rules exist and a standards review has started, and that the government supports prioritising rooftops in regional planning.
I have no information on the extent to which the level of insurance premiums hinders the installation of solar panels.
Ik heb geen informatie over in hoeverre de hoogte van verzekeringspremies belemmerend werkt op de aanleg van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het bericht dat de overheid tuinders hielp om het ETS te ontwijken

MPs Bromet and Van der Lee asked whether the government helped greenhouse growers avoid the EU ETS by splitting companies and treating gas boilers as back-up, and why this was not debated with parliament. Minister Schouten answered that the affected firms left the ETS for legitimate reasons, that the NEa supervises to prevent misuse, that the rules were not put to parliament as they implement EU-based provisions, and that removing the back-up rule would be undesirable and contrary to EU law.
The NEa checks permit applications from companies that thereby cease to fall under the ETS against the legal framework so that the rules cannot be abused.
De NEa toetst de vergunningaanvragen van bedrijven waardoor ze niet langer onder ETS vallen aan het wettelijk kader zodat geen misbruik gemaakt kan worden van de regels.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over het niet verstrekken van een volmacht door de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) voor betalingen van versterkingsprojecten

An SP MP asked why residents in Groningen could not sign depot agreements for reinforcement works after NAM's role ended on 1 January 2020, who holds the authority, and how residents could start in January. The Minister answered that no work was blocked, that the NCG now signs depot agreements in place of NAM, and that ongoing cases continue under the NCG, with advance payments used in the interim.
As a result, since 1 January 2020 it is the NCG, not NAM, that concludes the depot agreements for reinforcement with residents.
Het gevolg van die handeling is dat sinds 1 januari 2020 niet NAM maar de NCG de depotovereenkomsten voor de versterking aangaat met de bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de overheid de glastuinbouw heeft geholpen om het betalen van de CO2-prijs te ontwijken

An MP asked whether the government helped greenhouse horticulture firms escape the EU ETS carbon price, and whether this undermines climate goals and public trust. The ministers deny any improper help, say firms left the ETS for legitimate reasons under NEa supervision, and reject changing the arrangement or pursuing unpaid sums.
Given the NEa's supervision of the legal rules, I have confidence that possible misuse of the rules is very small.
Door het toezicht van de NEa op de wettelijke regels heb ik er vertrouwen in dat mogelijk misbruik van de regels erg klein is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van der Lee over het artikel 'Overheid hielp tuinders Europese CO2-prijs te ontwijken'

MPs Sienot and Van der Lee asked whether the government helped greenhouse growers escape the EU ETS carbon price by splitting firms and classifying gas boilers as backup, and whether this undermines climate targets. The minister denies any evasion: the firms left the ETS legitimately, the NEa supervises misuse, and the sector remains subject to the CO2 sector system with compensation for overshoot.

There are three reasons why companies no longer participate in the ETS: 1. companies reduced the capacity of their installations; 2. companies split up; 3. companies no longer meet the ETS criteria based on the 'back-up scheme'.

Er zijn drie redenen dat bedrijven niet meer deelnemen aan het ETS: 1. Bedrijven hebben het vermogen van hun installaties verminderd; 2. Bedrijven hebben zich opgesplitst; 3. Bedrijven voldoen op basis van de «back-up regeling» niet langer aan de ETS-criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de vertraging van de wet Versterken

An MP asked why the Versterken (reinforcement) bill for Groningen earthquake-damaged homes was delayed, including the short two-week internet consultation and when it would reach the Council of State. The minister replied that the bill was put to consultation on 6 November, the short period was chosen to speed things up after prior consultation with stakeholders, the bill is expected to go to the Council of State that month, and the timetable depends on close coordination with the region.
The aim is to submit the bill to the Council of State for advice this month.
Het streven is om het wetsvoorstel nog deze maand ter advisering voor te leggen aan de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de aflevering van het programma Radar over de installatie van warmtepompen

An MP asked the ministers about consumer complaints over heat pump installations, calling for stricter government oversight, accreditation of installers and guarantee schemes. The minister answered that the market and sector should first address the problems, saw no role for the government in intensified supervision or mandatory accreditation, but committed to consulting the installation sector on better quality assurance.
I currently see no role for the government in supervising more intensively or imposing direct regulation in the form of accreditation.
Ik zie vooralsnog geen rol voor de overheid om intensiever toe te zien of directe regulering in de vorm van accreditatie op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Palland over het gelijk speelveld voor fruittelers

MPs Van den Berg and Palland asked whether fruit growers' sales cooperatives can counter buyers, whether market elements create an uneven playing field, whether the ACM has investigated market power in fruit, and when the amended Competition Act and unfair trading practices law take effect. The government answered that growers see themselves as weak, that the agro-nutrimonitor covers six chains but not fruit as a whole, and gave an entry-into-force date of 1 July 2021 for the Competition Act change.
The ACM has so far not conducted any research into the fruit sector as a whole.
De ACM heeft tot op heden geen onderzoek gedaan naar de fruitsector als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het schimmeldrama in aardbevingsgebied

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked about mould and damp in social rental homes in the Groningen earthquake area, including Woongroep Marenland's four years of neglected maintenance, timelines for repairs, compensation for tenants, and corporations' communication. The minister apologised via the corporation, outlined planned repairs and a national approach to damp and mould, but offered no direct compensation and pointed tenants to the rent tribunal.
four years of uncertainty and living in a home with mould is not acceptable
vier jaar onzekerheid en leven in een woning met schimmel is niet acceptabel
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het INTERREG-programma

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether INTERREG A programmes should fund cross-border bottlenecks beyond innovation, such as infrastructure, labour market, education and governance, and whether the new Flanders-Netherlands programme could include such themes. The State Secretary answered that the cabinet focuses INTERREG A programmes on innovation, sustainability, energy transition and climate adaptation while reducing border barriers, with programme budgets still dependent on the EU multiannual financial framework negotiations.
For Interreg A programmes the cabinet is focusing further on the societal themes of innovation, sustainability, energy transition and climate adaptation, and on reducing the border-barrier effect.

Het kabinet zet voor Interreg A-programma's in op een verdere focus op de maatschappelijke thema's innovatie, duurzaamheid, energietransitie en klimaatadaptatie en het verminderen van de barrièrewerking van grenzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat vogels kleiner worden door klimaatverandering

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the government about reports that birds are shrinking due to climate change, including the red knot study and its implications for biodiversity and the Wadden Sea. The minister acknowledges the research, says climate change is one cause of biodiversity loss, notes the Wadden Sea's importance for migratory birds, and points to existing climate and Wadden policy without committing to new action.
This is a scientific question that I cannot assess.
Dit is een wetenschappelijk vraagstuk dat ik niet kan beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de mogelijke claim tegen de Nederlandse staat van Uniper en RWE, op basis van de ISDS-clausule in het Energie Charter Treaty

An MP asked the ministers about threatened ISDS claims by Uniper and RWE against the Dutch state under the Energy Charter Treaty after the coal ban, and about the treaty's future. The government answered that no formal claim exists yet, that intra-EU ISDS is not possible after Achmea, that a 10-year transition period compensates the plants, and that modernisation negotiations are underway rather than withdrawal.
On that basis the Netherlands is not considering withdrawing from the Energy Charter Treaty and is focusing in the coming period on modernising the treaty.
Nederland overweegt op grond daarvan niet om uit het Energiehandvestverdrag te stappen en zet de komende tijd in op de modernisering van dit verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de berichten 'Datacenters in Nederland raken in wurggreep van Amerikanen' en 'Nederlandse bouwer van datacenters failliet'

An MP asked ministers whether Dutch data centres and citizens' and companies' data risk falling under US control, who owns government-used data centres, and whether the planned investment screening should be accelerated. The government answered that data centre acquisitions above 40 MW will fall under the draft telecom control law, that the investment screening bill is planned for end-2020, and that the cabinet will examine whether data centres should become vital infrastructure, while deferring details on government-used data centres to a later letter.
At the AO Digitale Overheid of 4 December 2019, the Minister of the Interior committed to inform the House by letter about data centres used by central government.

In het AO Digitale Overheid van 4 december 2019 is door de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties toegezegd uw Kamer per brief te informeren over datacenters die door de rijksoverheid in gebruik zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat er gebrek aan ruimte in de ondergrond is voor het aansluiten van wind- en zonneparken

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a shortage of underground space for cables threatens connecting wind and solar projects, how long the problem has existed and what is being done. The minister acknowledged local scarcity, pointed to cable pooling and regional energy strategies, and declined to see a general under-recognition of the problem.
It is true that, depending on the local situation, a shortage of underground space for cables can arise.
Het is waar dat er afhankelijk van de lokale situatie schaarste kan ontstaan aan ruimte in de ondergrond voor kabels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over korten op de bijstand vanwege zonnepanelen

MPs asked whether returns from home solar panels count as means under the Participatiewet and could lead to benefit reductions, and whether municipalities differ in applying this. The State Secretary answered that such returns for private use are a saving on energy use, not income, so they do not affect benefit entitlement, while noting the ministry does not know whether municipalities take them into account.
Whether, and if so to what extent and in which municipalities, the return from solar panels is taken into account when assessing entitlement to benefit is not known to the Ministry of SZW.

Of en zo ja, in welke mate en bij welke gemeenten er bij de beoordeling van het recht op bijstand wél rekening wordt gehouden met de opbrengst van zonnepanelen is bij het Ministerie van SZW niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de vervuiling door gaswinning in de provincie Overijssel

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about soil and groundwater pollution from gas extraction in Overijssel, including timelines for remediation at Wanneperveen-1 and Tubbergen-7, drinking water quality, and monitoring of old wells. The minister answered that the locations are not urgent under the Wbb, that the province is competent authority for historic contamination, that remediation is proceeding with NAM, and that SodM continues its investigations.
It is not for the Ministry of EZK to draw up an action plan for these locations.
Het is niet aan het Ministerie van EZK om voor deze locaties een plan van aanpak op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Beckerman over de uitspraak van SodM-topman dat omgekeerde bewijslast ook buiten Groningen moet gelden

MP Beckerman asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why he does not follow the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) advice to extend the reversed burden of proof to mining damage outside Groningen, and why residents must prove their damage. The Minister answers that a statutory presumption is justified only for Groningen, and instead creates a Commissie Mijnbouwschade to investigate reported damage elsewhere, expected operational by mid-2020.
I follow the advice of the Technical Committee on Subsidence (Tcbb) on this point.
Ik volg het advies van de Technische commissie bodembeweging (Tcbb) op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de moeizame aansluiting van zonnepanelen op het elektriciteitsnetwerk

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the difficulty of connecting solar panels for a football club in Nieuw Buinen, including grid capacity, the division of roles between the network operator and the ACM, and the risk of losing SDE+ subsidy. The minister said no connection can be guaranteed, pointed to a pending ACM exemption request and a general decree (AMvB) planned for 1 July 2020, and noted that the subsidy deadline can be extended by one year.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de verkoop van Eneco

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the sale of Eneco to a Japanese consortium should be stopped, and what it means for jobs, customers and energy prices. The minister answers that the municipal shareholders decide on the sale, that he will test the deal against public interests such as security of supply, and that Eneco stays Dutch with jobs and customer terms unchanged.
Subsequently, I will test the takeover against its effects on the public interests of public safety, security of supply and security of delivery.
Vervolgens zal ik de overname toetsen op de gevolgen van de investering voor de publieke belangen van openbare veiligheid, voorzieningszekerheid en leveringszekerheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Bomen stoken in centrales? Waanzin!’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a critical newspaper article on burning trees in power plants, questioning the minister's claim that whole trees do not end up in Dutch wood pellets, the carbon debt of biomass, and biodiversity in production forests. The minister defended the sustainability criteria for subsidised pellets, acknowledged limited US pellet imports, and announced that small pellet stoves and biomass boilers will no longer be subsidised from 2020 while air emission norms for mid-sized plants are examined.
I do not have the specific cost breakdowns that companies use, and I could not share them because this is commercially confidential information.
Over de specifieke kostenverdelingen zoals bedrijven deze hanteren beschik ik niet en deze zou ik ook niet kunnen delen omdat dit bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over bodemverontreinigingen bij mijnbouwinstallaties

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether soil contamination at Wanneperveen-1 and other mining sites could stem from underground leakage, including barium from drilling mud, and whether oversight and research are adequate. The minister answers that contamination is shallow, consistent with historic drilling-mud practices and not evidence of underground leakage, that SodM applies current rules, that the Monster gas leak was repaired under SodM supervision, and that ongoing SodM monitoring of abandoned wells continues.
SodM supervises the proper functioning of the well integrity management system of the mining company.
SodM houdt toezicht op de adequate werking van het putintegriteitsmanagementsysteem van de mijnbouwonderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van het Van der Lee over de berichtgeving aangaande het onderhoud op de NAM locatie in Rossum

MP Van der Lee asked about reports of bacterial corrosion and maintenance at NAM's Rossum wastewater injection sites, whether injection should be halted, whether the regulator will test the wells and sample the water, and about incidents at Schoonebeek and contact with German authorities. The minister answered that corrosion inspections and maintenance are underway, that SodM sees no need to stop injection or to conduct its own well or water sampling (while announcing extra targeted checks on sampling), and listed ten incidents at Schoonebeek since 2011.
SodM sees no reason to do so. The pressure present between the casing and the injection tube shows the integrity of both tubes and proves that both barriers are still intact.
SodM ziet daartoe geen aanleiding. De aanwezige druk tussen de verbuizing en de injectiebuis toont de integriteit van de beide buizen aan en bewijst dat beide barrières nog intact zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over compensatie voor de gaswinning in het Waddengebied

MPs Van der Lee and Bromet asked whether the 448 million euro investment agenda for compensating gas extraction under the Wadden Sea is justified, whether the Waddenfonds has been used for natural restoration, and whether it should be used for nature and farmers' transition. The minister answered that the proposed projects were narrowed to a 6 million euro per year contribution over ten years conditional on extraction, that the Waddenfonds has spent roughly 46% on ecology since 2012, and that the fund's allocation will reach a 50/50 split by 2026.
I do not intend to spend 448 million euros and will also not charge the taxpayer.
Ik ben niet van plan 448 miljoen euro uit te geven en zal ook geen rekening bij de belastingbetaler neerleggen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een stijgende energierekening voor huishoudens

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about rising household energy bills, including whether TenneT's tariff increase would be passed on to households via regional grid operators. The minister confirmed that household network tariffs rise by about 5 euro per year in 2020, that TenneT's increase only reaches regional tariffs in 2022 under the current method, and that the ACM will review grid costs, while noting energy tax cuts offset the rise, though he declined to give the full 2022 impact.
At this moment it is therefore not possible to make statements about the overall development of network tariffs in 2022 and beyond.
Het is op dit moment dus niet mogelijk om uitspraken te doen over de totale ontwikkeling van de nettarieven in 2022 en daarna.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het toenemende aantal huishoudens dat de energierekening niet meer kan betalen

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the rising number of households unable to pay energy bills and whether the government's energy and climate policy causes energy poverty. The minister rejected the link, pointed to Klimaatakkoord measures shifting costs to businesses and lowering the tax burden on households, and said the government monitors energy bill affordability, but did not commit to reversing policy.
The cabinet keeps a close eye on developments in energy bills and monitors the development of the energy bill.
Het kabinet houdt een vinger aan de pols en volgt de ontwikkeling van de energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Milieuorganisaties: stroom wordt nauwelijks groener’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report finding that electricity is hardly becoming greener, covering business demand for green power, purchase contracts, reporting obligations and CO2 pricing. The minister largely defended current market arrangements, pointed to full disclosure from 2020 and the Climate Agreement, and promised further information to parliament on energy saving obligations by mid-2020.
The cabinet considers it important that more information, transparency and standardisation on climate is introduced in all links of the financial chain.
Het kabinet vindt het van belang dat er meer informatie, transparantie en standaardisering komt op het gebied van klimaat in alle schakels van de financiële keten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over de UN Climate Action Summit van 23 september

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government knows banks and insurers invest heavily in shale gas and plastics, whether it will press for action at the UN Climate Action Summit, and whether it will pressure financial institutions to restrict such financing. The minister confirmed awareness, pointed to national climate policy, the ban on new shale gas exploration permits, plastics programmes, and the Platform for Sustainable Finance, but made no commitment to restrict financing directly.

It is a good thing when insurers, banks and other financial institutions are open about the environmental and climate effects of their investments, so that their customers can make an informed choice.

Het is een goede zaak wanneer verzekeraars, banken en andere financiële instellingen open zijn over de milieu en klimaateffecten van hun investeringen, zodat hun klanten een gefundeerde keuze kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Van Eijs en Schonis over het artikel ‘Duurzaamheid blijft ondergeschoven kind bij aanbestedingen in de bouw’

D66 MPs asked whether sustainability plays too small a role in public construction tenders and whether this jeopardises the 2050 climate goals. The government answers that sustainability can be included in many tender criteria, outlines Rijksoverheid purchasing strategy, Klimaatakkoord measures, CO2-Prestatieladder and MKI/MPG instruments, and the status of motion Schonis on smart maintenance pilots.
For central government this has led to drafting a new procurement strategy for Rijk purchasing, aimed at sustainable, social and innovative purchasing.
Voor de rijksoverheid is dit aanleiding geweest voor het opstellen van een nieuwe inkoopstrategie voor de inkoop van het Rijk, gericht op duurzaam, sociaal en innovatief inkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht ‘Pelletfabrieken in North Carolina gesteund met Nederlandse miljarden‘

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether he was aware of reports that Dutch billions support US wood pellet factories, and questioned the sustainability and cost of imported biomass subsidies under the SDE+ scheme. The minister confirmed awareness, said the subsidy regime favours cost-effective techniques with up to 3.6 billion euro for imported pellets, defended the sustainability criteria and the accounting of emissions at the source, and refused to halt biomass or climate policy.
Imported wood pellets – which are not only imported from the United States – currently qualify for a subsidy of up to 3.6 billion euro.
Geïmporteerde houtpellets – die niet alleen uit de Verenigde Staten geïmporteerd worden – komen op dit moment in aanmerking voor maximaal 3,6 miljard euro subsidie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de reactie op het verzoek van het lid Van der Lee inzake aanwijzingen dat staalfabriek Tata Steel meer CO2 uitstoot dan wordt opgegeven (Kamerstuk 32813, nr. 397)

An MP asks the minister to respond to a Groene Amsterdammer analysis suggesting Tata Steel emits more CO2 than reported, based on its permit application, and asks whether further investigation will be done. The minister replies that the permit-based figures are not directly comparable to actual emissions, defends the reported NEa data as verified, and declines additional measurement as disproportionately costly.
I have confidence in the NEa's judgement of the figures reported by Tata.
Ik heb vertrouwen in het oordeel van de NEa over de door Tata gerapporteerde cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het verzekeren van zonnepanelen tegen hagelschade

PvdA MPs asked whether insurers dropping cover for invisible hail damage to solar panels leaves homeowners unprotected, and what the government will do about it. The Minister of Finance answered that some insurers have excluded this risk in their terms, that the share of uninsured owners is unknown, and that the matter is primarily for insurers and the market, with no concrete government action committed.
I consider this primarily a matter between insurers, market parties and owners of solar panels.
Ik beschouw dit primair als een zaak tussen verzekeraars, marktpartijen en eigenaren van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over milieucriminaliteit

Two D66 MPs asked ministers about environmental crime, covering police expertise, illegal bird trapping and eel poaching, illegal waste transport, subsidy and manure fraud, and air-gun regulation. The government answered that police capacity is adequate, that some enforcement data are not registered or fall under provincial responsibility, and that a bill requiring permits for high-power air guns is nearly ready.
Control over bird trapping has been the responsibility of the provinces since 2017, so I will not give a picture or figures on this.
De controle op het vangen van vogels ligt sinds 2017 bij de provincies, daarom zal ik hier geen beeld of cijfers voor gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Groene banen illusie – TNO blijkt te optimistisch te zijn geweest over effecten klimaatakkoord'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the government was misled by TNO, which revised its estimate of green job gains from the Climate Agreement to roughly zero in the long run, and whether the climate policy should be scrapped. The minister said TNO's internal complaint procedure worked well, that the study shows short-term job gains may not last, and rejected the claim that climate policy is unaffordable or senseless.
It is commendable that TNO has internal procedures whereby the complaint was taken seriously and that TNO subsequently also attached consequences to it.
Het valt te waarderen dat TNO interne procedures heeft waardoor de klacht serieus is opgepakt en dat TNO er vervolgens ook consequenties aan verbonden heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over de primaire energiefactor (PEF) voor elektriciteit

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked whether a primary energy factor (PEF) of 1.45 for electricity is still realistic, given 2018 renewable shares of 7.4% and the need to align with the KEV forecast, and whether a low PEF misleads home buyers. The minister maintains 1.45 is realistic because renewable growth and coal reduction will bring the outcome in line, rejects revising the PEF to the KEV because it would delay near-zero-energy buildings, and says the PEF change was requested by the heat pump sector and the NEN committee.
No, that is not my intention.
Nee, dat is niet mijn voornemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Nederland verontwaardigd: 'onze' Clauscentrale wil stroom gaan leveren aan België'

MPs Sienot and Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a plan by RWE to supply electricity from the Clauscentrale directly to Belgium, raising concerns about security of supply and CO2 emissions. The minister agreed the supply should go via the interconnector rather than a direct connection, said he has raised this with RWE and his Belgian counterpart, but declined to commit to shifting CO2 emissions to Belgium, citing the ETS point-source rules.

However, I am of the view that the supply of electricity to the Belgian grid should take place via the Dutch-Belgian interconnection capacity and not via a planned direct connection to the Belgian grid

Ik ben echter van mening dat de levering van stroom aan het Belgische elektriciteitsnet dient plaats te vinden via de Nederlands-Belgische interconnectiecapaciteit en niet via een voorgenomen rechtstreekse aansluiting op het Belgische net
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de schadelijke gezondheidseffecten van klimaatbeleid

An MP asked ministers whether municipal health service (GGD) warnings that climate policy such as wind turbines, biomass plants and home insulation may harm health, and claims of noise and biomass harms, are accepted. The minister says the GGD concerns are taken seriously, promises a letter in a few months on health and safety risks of the energy transition, and rejects claims that climate policy is harmful or that the government does not weigh health effects.
Therefore I will send your House a letter in a few months with a further response to those reports.
Daarom zal ik over enkele maanden uw Kamer een brief sturen met een nadere reactie op die rapporten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het interview op RTVNoord ‘Minister Eric Wiebes blikt terug’

An SP MP asked the Economic Affairs minister who was responsible for the Groningen reinforcement operation, when the Centrum Veilig Wonen's underperformance became known, why the CVW was to be wound down, and how progress compares with earlier reports. The minister answered that responsibility shifted from NAM to the ministries, that the CVW contract was not renewed to distance NAM, and that figures are provisional and not fully comparable with earlier quarterly reports.
The overview has been compiled with due care, but at this moment it cannot be ruled out that some figures will still be adjusted and added.
Het overzicht is met de nodige zorgvuldigheid tot stand gekomen maar het valt op dit moment niet uit te sluiten dat er op onderdelen nog aantallen worden aangepast en toegevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kerstens over het bericht dat door Oost NL gesteunde Chinese spookbedrijven verdacht worden van uitbuiting van illegale werknemers

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked whether government-backed regional agency Oost NL supported Chinese companies suspected of exploiting illegal workers, and what action will be taken. The minister acknowledged serious labour-law violations found by the Inspectorate SZW, said Oost NL will pause expansion support and that municipalities decide on closures, and largely deflected responsibility to the companies, the inspectorate and municipalities.
Because this information is commercially confidential, RVO.nl does not disclose specific company information for tax schemes, guarantees, indirect financing arrangements and suretyships.

Vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van deze informatie geldt voor fiscale regelingen, garantstellingen, indirecte financieringsregelingen en borgstellingen dat RVO.nl geen specifieke bedrijfsinformatie openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de onderschatting van economische groei

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether GDP growth is systematically underestimated due to digitalisation and quality adjustment, what the cabinet and CPB do about it, whether a formal trajectory will be started, and which spending would change. The minister partly agrees, says more research is needed, notes ongoing CBS and UN/EU revision work, sees no need for a new formal trajectory, and says it is hard to name affected spending.
Given these ongoing trajectories, I do not consider it necessary to formally start a new trajectory.
Gezien deze lopende trajecten, acht ik het niet nodig om in formele zin een nieuw traject te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het «Special Report on the Ocean and Cryosphere in a Changing Climate  (SROCC)» van het IPCC

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers about the IPCC special report on oceans and the cryosphere, covering glacier loss, marine heatwaves, ocean acidification, marine protected areas and fisheries. The government answered at length, mostly restating the IPCC findings and pointing to the forthcoming cabinet appraisal and international negotiations, with few concrete commitments.
A comprehensive cabinet appraisal of the IPCC report on oceans and the cryosphere has been sent to the House.
Een uitgebreide kabinetsappreciatie van het IPCC-rapport over oceanen en de cryosfeer is aan de kamer toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over "de landsadvocaat die ruim 2,1 miljoen euro verdiende aan de Groninger gaswinning"

SP MPs asked for a total overview of legal costs in Groningen gas-damage lawsuits, costs per case, and how the State Attorney's costs relate to the damage claims and the 200,000 euro legal-aid amendment. The minister provided yearly fees for the State Attorney in civil suits against the State, the number and cost of the six Northern Netherlands cases, declined to discuss the individual Nijhof case, and said the costs are not charged to compensation budgets while cost-minimisation remains the aim.
I cannot go into individual procedures that have been or are being conducted.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele procedures die zijn of worden gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Leijten over “ambtenaren die deelnemen aan belastingcommissies van lobbyclubs van buitenlandse bedrijven”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether civil servants should sit on tax committees of foreign business lobby groups such as AmCham, and whether NFIA staff participation creates conflict of interest and loss of role clarity. The minister answered that participation as a listening observer (toehoorder) is justified for signal-gathering and network building, that the NFIA has no membership except a French chamber corporate membership, and declined to publish meeting records or systematic participation data.
It is not for me to make the points raised in such consultations public.
Het is niet aan mij om ingebrachte punten uit dergelijke overleggen naar buiten te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het advies van SodM op het winningsplan van Nedmag

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about SodM's advice on Nedmag's salt mining plan and whether the cumulative subsidence effects in the region, as demanded by an adopted motion, were studied before deciding. The Minister said cumulative subsidence was covered in the advice, will address the motion in the final decision, has asked TNO for subsidence maps, and does not expect a decision before Q1 2020 after further advice and public objection procedures.
In assessing the application I will give effect to this motion.
Bij de beoordeling van de aanvraag zal ik invulling geven aan deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de gevolgen van stikstofcrisis voor projecten in olie- en gassector

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that dozens of oil and gas projects have stalled due to the nitrogen crisis, and about the consequences for gas imports, the Groningen field phase-out and possible temporary exemptions. The minister confirmed at least 33 stalled projects, said the Groningen phase-out is not delayed, and outlined permitting routes and a forthcoming package of measures.
According to a list from NOGEPA, at least 33 projects are known to be stalling due to the nitrogen issue.
Uit opgave van NOGEPA blijkt dat voor zover nu bekend zeker 33 projecten stilvallen door de stikstofproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Sienot over de gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Dik-Faber and Sienot asked the minister about gas extraction under the Wadden Sea, including whether the NAM study on long-term subsidence is independent, the timing of results, the Auditcommissie's role, sea-level rise, Natura 2000 nitrogen effects, the permit procedure, and whether decisions should wait for a debate. The minister answered that the NAM study was commissioned by him, results go to the Auditcommissie with advice expected late 2019 or early 2020, the NAM has commercial interests, and gas extraction may continue within existing permits and the Mijnbouwwet/Wet natuurbescherming framework.
I expect the advice of the Auditcommissie at the end of 2019 or the beginning of 2020. I aim to send this advice and my response to your House in the first months of 2020.
Het advies van de Auditcommissie verwacht ik eind 2019 of begin 2020. Ik streef er naar dit advies van de Auditcommissie en mijn reactie daarop in de eerste maanden van 2020 aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de bescherming van consumenten bij een faillissement van een energieleverancier

An MP asked the ministers whether consumers have enough insight into an energy supplier's financial health, whether the regulator ACM can intervene earlier and stricter entry rules should apply, and whether consumers should be compensated from a guarantee fund after a supplier's bankruptcy. The minister answered that supply security is already guaranteed, that stricter licensing and supervision are being examined for the new Energy Act, and that a compensation fund is not proportionate given its risks.
This may lead to tightening of the licensing requirements and of ACM's supervision of them.
Dit zal mogelijk tot een aanscherping van de vergunningseisen en het toezicht door ACM daarop leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “het bericht dat klanten slecht beschermd zijn tegen het faillissement van hun energieleverancier”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a Consumentenbond study showing that energy customers are poorly protected if their supplier goes bankrupt, including whether consumers can recover lost prepayments and whether a guarantee fund should be explored. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to licensing and ACM supervision, said stricter supplier requirements are being examined for the new Energy Act, and rejected a guarantee fund because of market risks.
This may lead to tightening of the licensing requirements and of ACM's supervision of them.
Dit zal mogelijk tot een aanscherping van de vergunningseisen en het toezicht door ACM daarop leiden.
Antwoord op de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over het gebruik van biomassa als energiebron

MPs Dik-Faber, Sienot and Agnes Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the DNV-GL report on biomass emissions, subsidy amounts, sustainability criteria, planned plants and the RES regional energy strategies. The minister responded that a TNO study on tighter emission limits for small and medium biomass plants is underway, that a sustainability framework is being prepared with an SER advisory report expected in early 2020, and that subsidies for biomass plants continue for now.
I cannot disclose the origin of the wood pellets of a specific company, because this information is commercially confidential.
De herkomst van de houtpellets van een specifiek bedrijf kan ik – in verband met bedrijfsvertrouwelijke aard van deze informatie – niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops vragen gesteld naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Biomassa veel vervuilender dan gas en kolen’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether biomass is a wasteful, polluting energy source and whether subsidies should stop, citing an EASAC report. The minister rejected that reading, said the report raises valid points rather than concluding biomass is wasteful, and committed to restraint in new biomass subsidy decisions if supply shortfalls are expected by 2030.
During that period the cabinet commits to exercise restraint in issuing new subsidy decisions to stimulate the use of sustainable biomass.
Gedurende die periode committeert het kabinet zich om terughoudend te zijn in het afgeven van nieuwe subsidiebeschikkingen ter stimulering van het gebruik van duurzame biomassa

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan vragen over het advies van de commissie-Remkes en de implicaties voor de subsidie voor het (bij)stoken van biomassa in energiecentrales en de aanleg van nieuwe biomassacentrales

An MP asks whether the government will reconsider subsidies for biomass co-firing and new biomass plants in light of the Remkes commission advice and scientific criticism of biomass sustainability. The minister refuses to reconsider, defends biomass as sustainable and necessary for climate targets, but commits to not granting new subsidies for biomass once shortages are expected before 2030, pending a sustainability framework.
The cabinet is not responsible for the construction of biomass power plants.
Het kabinet gaat niet over de bouw van biomassacentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het tekort aan netcapaciteit

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the saturated electricity grid, which cannot yet connect new solar parks, wind farms and large companies, makes the renewable energy policy absurd, and whether the government would stop connecting renewables and subsidies. The minister rejected the framing, explained grid reinforcement, flexibility and transport-capacity requirements for SDE+ subsidies, and promised a progress letter in early 2020.
Early 2020 I will inform the House about the progress of these measures.
Begin 2020 zal ik de Kamer informeren over de voortgang van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ’Elektriciteitsnet op steeds meer plekken vol’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the electricity grid is full in more places, blocking connections for large businesses, long permit procedures, greenhouse growers forced to switch off lights, the need for a national masterplan, technical staff shortages, and why grid investment lagged behind renewable expansion. The minister acknowledged the congestion, described procedural shortening and regional energy strategies, said a masterplan would be a coordination effort rather than spatial zoning, announced a programme startnotitie and appraisal due in 2020, and explained the lag by faster-than-planned renewable growth.
At the beginning of 2020 I will adopt a starting note for the energy main structure programme and send it to the House, setting out the precise scope and planning of the programme.
Begin 2020 zal ik een startnotitie voor het programma energiehoofdstructuur vaststellen en naar de Kamer sturen, waarin staat wat de precieze reikwijdte en planning van het programma wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘Nederland achter met hernieuwbare energie’

An MP asks why the Netherlands lags on renewable energy targets, what steps the government takes, and whether biomass dependence is a concern. The minister answers that the 14% 2020 target will be missed (about 11.6%), cites growth in renewable output, subsidy schemes, a SDE+ round in 2020, grid congestion, project delays and a possible statistical transfer, and says biomass use will be prioritised toward 2050.
On top of that, the cabinet is making a final push with a package of additional measures to achieve the 14% renewable energy target for 2020.
Daarbovenop zet het kabinet de eindsprint in met een pakket aan aanvullende maatregelen om het doel voor 14% hernieuwbare energie in 2020 te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de honderden miljoenen euro's aan lobbyuitgaven van olie- en gasgiganten

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked whether the government accepts a Corporate Europe Observatory finding that oil and gas lobbying spent over 251 million euro to slow EU climate targets, and whether it will hold Shell and others to account and limit their influence on climate policy. The minister said the figures are not known to the government, that the government does not track individual firms' lobbying, that companies may pursue their interests within the rule of law, and that the Klimaatakkoord deliberately involves industry alongside other stakeholders.
All parties are always free to pursue their interests as long as this stays within the bounds of the rule of law.
Het staat alle partijen altijd vrij hun belangen te behartigen zolang dit binnen de grenzen van de rechtstaat past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Chili toch geen gastheer klimaattop’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the Netherlands could host the UN climate summit after Chile withdrew as host. The minister answered that Spain will take over hosting COP25 in Madrid on the planned dates, with Chile remaining chair.
As already communicated in the media, the UNFCCC has decided that Spain will take over Chile's duties as host of COP25.
Zoals reeds gecommuniceerd in de media heeft de UNFCCC besloten dat Spanje de taken van Chili als gastheer van COP25 zal overnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat bezwaar maken tegen windmolenparken zinloos is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether objecting to wind farms is pointless, whether residents were informed early enough, whether the Crisis- en herstelwet undermines participation, and whether noise and shadow flicker should be grounds for objection, citing WHO noise guidance and comparisons with neighbouring countries. The minister answered that participation is a shared responsibility of the competent authority and developer, that legal norms for noise and shadow flicker exist and courts can annul plans that breach them, that no separate low-frequency norm is needed, and that a RIVM study on the WHO report is pending with a compensation overview promised before summer 2020.
Opportunities for public participation and legal protection are secured in laws and regulations.
Inspraakmogelijkheden en rechtsbescherming zijn geborgd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Sienot over het bericht ‘Toezicht op energiebesparingsplicht bedrijven faalt’

MPs Van der Lee and Sienot asked why the energy-saving obligation for businesses is poorly enforced, because regulators do not know which firms are covered and grid operators may not share consumption data, and asked about capacity and use of a EUR 3 million amendment. The minister answered that the scope was known to be unclear, that a court case on data sharing is pending, that a legal duty for grid operators to share data is being considered, and that reporting and extra funds are improving oversight.
A court case is currently pending between a municipality, on behalf of an environmental service, and a grid operator over providing the consumption data.
Er loopt op dit moment over het verstrekken van de verbruiksgegevens een gerechtelijke procedure tussen een gemeente, namens een omgevingsdienst, en een netbeheerder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel “Verplichte bijmenging waterstof in gasnet om vraag te creëren”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about proposals to mandate hydrogen blending into the gas grid and related technical, sectoral and market questions. The minister answered that blending is being explored at European level, that grey hydrogen blending makes little climate sense, and that a broader hydrogen programme under the Climate Agreement will be pursued, without committing to a binding mandate.
I see the hydrogen envoy's proposal in the context of an emerging European discussion.
Ik zie het voorstel van de waterstofgezant in de context van een beginnende Europese discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de uitzending van EenVandaag over de versterkingsoperatie

An SP MP asked the minister about an EenVandaag broadcast on the Groningen reinforcement operation, including residents who received reinforcement advice but are not yet scheduled for works, and why records are only available via FOI requests. The minister explained that advice was issued under the older NPR 2015 standard, that residents were told advice creates no rights, that reassessment via a sample is pending, and gave progress figures.
Once there is clarity on what this will mean for the actual reinforcement, the cabinet will inform residents and your House about it.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over wat dit voor de daadwerkelijke versterking zal gaan betekenen, zal het kabinet de bewoners en uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het versterken van woningen in Groningen

MP Nijboer asks why residents of Loppersum were promised reinforcement of their homes that has not been carried out, why the HRA risk model yields so few high-risk addresses, and how many acute unsafe situations have occurred. The minister answers that no binding promise was made, that a sample check of normal-risk addresses is ongoing, that the scope remains about 26,000 addresses, and that acute unsafe situation reports are handled within 48 hours.
Once there is clarity on what this will mean for the actual reinforcement, the cabinet will inform the residents and your House.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over wat dit voor de daadwerkelijke versterking zal gaan betekenen, zal het kabinet de bewoners en uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over EZK-gerelateerde kosten van Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the minister for economic affairs to quantify the costs to the state of (non-Western) immigrants in EZK policy areas, compared with the revenue they generate, broken down by year. The government answered that EZK has no administrative system linking policy spending to migration background, so no such data exist, and referred the cost question to the minister of social affairs.

Since that answer, the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate has not adopted an administrative system relating policy spending to the possible (Western or non-Western) migration background of recipients.

Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat is sinds die beantwoording niet overgegaan tot een administratiesysteem waarbij uitgegeven beleidsgelden worden gerelateerd aan de eventuele (westerse of niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond van ontvangers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over “de lobby van multinationals die al jaren helpen de politieke agenda te formuleren”

An MP asks the Economy minister about informal lobbying by multinationals (ABDUP, PHAUSD) and their access to government, including meetings with ministers, tax lobbying, and Wob requests. The minister acknowledges the contacts as legitimate stakeholder dialogue, says the government has no oversight of ABDUP and no minutes, declines to disclose confidential exchanges, and rejects claims of undue influence.
It is not for me to make public the points raised in such consultations.
Het is het niet aan mij om ingebrachte punten uit dergelijke overleggen naar buiten te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot naar aanleiding van een artikel in de Volkskrant van 9 september jl. waarin werd betoogd dat subsidies op fossiele brandstoffen dubbel zo hoog zijn als voor duurzame energie

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch fossil fuel subsidies are double those for renewables, whether the state uses the same definition as the European Commission, and what measures will phase out fossil subsidies. The minister disputes the cited figures, says an IEA review and a stock-take are underway, and promises to inform parliament once the report is ready.
Once this report is ready, I will inform your House further.
Wanneer dit rapport gereed is, zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de onhoudbare situatie in Woltersum

The MP asks whether houses in Woltersum needing both damage repair and reinforcement are identified, why they are classed as acutely unsafe despite not being high-risk, and how the NCG and TCMG will coordinate combined files. The minister says four addresses are prioritised by NCG, one acute unsafe situation was resolved with shoring, and a cooperation agreement signed on 11 September 2019 will allow coordinated 'combination files' through a one-counter approach starting with a selection of cases.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over “de alternatieve luchtvaartnota van Natuur & Milieu, Greenpeace en Natuur en Milieufederatie Noord-Holland, waaruit blijkt dat krimp van de luchtvaart onvermijdelijk is.”

MP Van Raan asks the government whether it endorses the claims in an alternative aviation policy paper by environmental NGOs, including that aviation must shrink, that technical measures are insufficient, and that health and noise harms and nitrogen deposition require action. The minister answers that the government pursues a broad mix of climate instruments, will assess volumes via the PlanMER, does not endorse all claims (e.g., on economic importance), and will consider the paper's ideas in the forthcoming Luchtvaartnota without committing to a shrinkage scenario.
The government's approach is primarily aimed at achieving the necessary emission reductions through this route.
De inzet van het kabinet is er primair op gericht om via deze weg de benodigde emissiereducties te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘NXP verkoopt zijn audiodivisie aan het Chinese Goodix’

An MP asked the economics minister whether NXP's sale of its audio division to China's Goodix, and the resulting national-security risk, warranted government intervention, including the screening criteria used by competition authorities and possible new measures. The government replied that intervention is reserved for direct public interests, that the authority reviews only competition effects, that the telecom ownership bill would not cover this deal, and that it sees no reason yet for new measures beyond planned investment screening.
Only in exceptional cases will the central government consider interventions within the existing frameworks.
Slechts in bijzondere gevallen zal de rijksoverheid binnen de vigerende kaders interventies willen overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over de nieuwe interne regels van de Europese Investeringsbank (EIB) voor het uitlenen van geld aan energieprojecten

MPs Van der Lee and Snels asked whether the government would oppose the EIB's revised Energy Lending Policy, specifically the loopholes for gas plants with 'credible' low-carbon gas plans and a one-year extension for gas infrastructure projects, and whether it would push for a firm emissions limit before the 15 October 2019 Board meeting. The Minister answers that the Netherlands supports a firmer policy, prefers the original emissions limit definition, and will push for phasing out fossil fuel financing and for an ambitious outcome, while noting the decision is still under negotiation.
The Netherlands is strongly committed to this in the negotiations and will work to bring other countries along to a clear and ambitious policy.
Nederland maakt zich hier in de onderhandelingen hard voor en zet zich in om andere landen mee te krijgen voor een beleid dat helder en ambitieus is.
