Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over gasvrij wonen

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the ministers about SCP findings that public support for gas-free homes is narrow and that households feel imposed upon, and whether the policy should be abandoned. Minister Ollongren answered that support is important and taken seriously, that the policy will not be scrapped, that co-decision with residents is planned via neighbourhood pilots, and that nuclear energy is not excluded.
It is essential that measures in the built environment are implemented with good involvement of residents and building owners.
Het is essentieel dat de uitvoering van maatregelen in de gebouwde omgeving plaatsvindt met een goede betrokkenheid van bewoners en eigenaren van gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het CETA-verdrag dat afbouw gaswinning in de weg staat

MPs Beckerman and Alkaya asked whether the CETA trade agreement could allow gas companies to claim compensation that burdens the Dutch state and hinders the Groningen gas phase-out and energy transition. The minister answered that no claims are expected, that CETA preserves the state's right to regulate in the public interest, and that the Netherlands cannot guarantee CETA's fate if it does not ratify.
The CETA treaty text explicitly confirms the right of governments to regulate in the public interest.
De verdragstekst van CETA bevestigt expliciet het recht voor overheden om te reguleren in het publieke belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Kops over het bericht 'Alarmerende klimaatstudie blijkt niet te kloppen’ in de Telegraaf van 30 september 201

PVV MPs Wilders and Kops asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a retracted sea-level study and claims of climate scaremongering undermine government climate policy. The minister replied that correcting errors shows peer review works, that policy rests on the IPCC, that the retracted study used a method without broad consensus, and that sea-level rise and climate change are well documented.
There is no question of scaremongering.
Er is geen sprake van bangmakerij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het artikel 'Minister Wiebes over compensatie NAM: "Voelt heel verkeerd, maar moet wel"'

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister why a provisional 90 million euro payment to Shell and ExxonMobil over Groningen gas production cuts is justified, on what legal basis, and why these companies should be compensated given harm to Groningers. The minister answers that the payment secures gas storage at Norg for an accelerated Groningen phase-out, that the amount is not final, that legal advice was taken but offered only in a confidential briefing, and that he will keep the House informed.
I am willing to inform the House further in a confidential briefing.
Ik ben graag bereid om uw Kamer nader te informeren in een vertrouwelijke briefing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht: ‘Deelautoproject botst op taaie Woningwet’

An MP asked whether the Housing Act blocks a shared electric car project with housing corporations and whether rules should be changed to let corporations send surplus solar power to shared cars. The minister said the Act already allows corporations to lease roofs to third parties, but will not widen corporations' remit to energy production, while promising to examine further cooperation options.
However, I am willing, when elaborating the policy intention, to examine how the options for corporations to cooperate with such initiatives can be further expanded.
Wel ben ik bereid om bij de uitwerking van het beleidsvoornemen te bezien hoe de mogelijkheden voor corporaties om met dergelijk initiatieven samen te werken verder kunnen worden vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht ‘Netbeheer Nederland verwacht op veel meer plaatsen problemen met netcapaciteit’,

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why grid operators may use reserve capacity for large projects but not for small initiatives such as VV Nieuw Buinen, and whether temporary use of reserve systems should be allowed for small projects. The minister answered that exemptions from the redundancy requirement are granted temporarily by the ACM regardless of project size, that a general exemption decree is planned for early 2020, and that a TenneT exemption application for the Stadskanaal area is pending.
The size of the project is not a determining factor in whether an exemption from the redundancy requirement is granted.
De grootte van het project is geen bepalende factor voor het wel of niet verlenen van een ontheffing van de redundantie-eis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over Shell’s kindermarketingfestival Generation Discover 2019

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether Shell's children's festival Generation Discover, which promotes fossil-fuel-friendly energy views and allegedly misleading teaching materials, is compatible with climate goals, and what government will do to prevent such incidents and avoid officials attending. The ministers answered that the government is not involved in or responsible for the festival, that schools decide for themselves, that no public funds go to it, and that the Shell climate commitment is noted.
The central government is not involved in or responsible for Generation Discover.
De rijksoverheid is niet betrokken of verantwoordelijk voor het Generation Discover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een onderzoek naar kernenergie als vermeend klimaatvriendelijke energievoorziening

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the government agrees with a German DIW study concluding that nuclear power is too costly and dangerous to be a climate-friendly option, and asked about construction cost overruns, public financing, private plans for a Dutch plant and the policy stance. The minister rejected the study's conclusions, citing standardisation, recent cost-effectiveness analyses and the need to keep all low-carbon options open, while acknowledging cost overruns and that no private firm has concrete plans for a Dutch plant.
I also refer you to my recent answers to questions from Member Yeşilgöz-Zegerius (VVD), in which I indicate that the transition to low-CO2 energy production poses a major international challenge.

Ik verwijs u tevens naar mijn recente antwoorden op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius (VVD) waarin ik aangeef, dat de overgang naar een CO 2 -arme energieproductie internationaal tot een grote opgave leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Kabinet laat Caribische ouderen achter in ‘mensonwaardig bestaan’

An MP from D66 asked several ministers about reports that elderly residents of the Caribbean Netherlands live in poverty and that government support is inadequate. The state secretaries acknowledged the difficult situation, pointed to measures and shared responsibility with island authorities, but gave limited concrete timelines and said the Ombudsman's criticisms are addressed through ongoing monitoring.
The cabinet understands the wish of the National Ombudsman for more clarity on the timeline of the announced measures.
Het kabinet begrijpt de wens van de Nationale ombudsman om meer houvast voor wat betreft het tijdpad van de aangekondigde maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een falend warmtepompsysteem in Duindorp

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether residents of Duindorp should bear costs from a failing experimental heat pump heat network, how they can secure reliable heating, and who is responsible for fixing faults. The minister answered that heat network users must be protected under the Warmtewet, that disputes go to the independent complaints committee, the ACM or the courts, and that the warmtepomp damage is not expressly compensated but the general supply obligation suffices.
It is for the complaints committee or, in case of rent, the Rent Tribunal, and ultimately the court, to rule on such conflicts and, related to that, on who is responsible for costs.

Het is aan de geschillencommissie of – ingeval van huur – de Huurcommissie en uiteindelijk aan de rechter om uitspraken te doen over dergelijke conflicten en in samenhang daarmee de vraag wie verantwoordelijk is voor kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de aangekondigde importheffing voor afval

An MP asked the government about the risk that a planned import levy on waste would push waste to landfill abroad or in the Netherlands, increasing CO2 emissions, and about its revenue, heat supply and renewable energy effects. The state secretary answered that leakage risks were limited, estimated a 4 Mton reduction package, gave a revenue forecast, and declined to reconsider the measure.
A reconsideration of this measure is, as far as the cabinet is concerned, therefore not on the table.
Een heroverweging van deze maatregel is wat het kabinet betreft dan ook niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de wanhoop van huurders in Middelstum

An MP asked ministers about tenants in Middelstum, Groningen, who face forced double relocation due to earthquake reinforcement and asked about compensation, sloop/rebuild numbers, and support. The minister acknowledged the burden, cited legal relocation allowances and an extra payment of €609.50 for the double move, said corporations and tenants must resolve the dispute with a mediator, and committed to consulting NCG and housing corporations.
Because this is a recurring problem, I will take the initiative to consult with NCG and housing corporations.
Omdat dit een terugkerend probleem is zal ik het initiatief nemen om in overleg te treden met NCG en woningcorporaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘Industrie vreest streep door waterstofambities Klimaatakkoord’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about industry concerns that hydrogen production may not qualify for SDE++ subsidies, and about the emission factor used in PBL's draft advice. The minister replied that the advice is still provisional, that a decision will follow the final PBL advice in November, and that hydrogen projects are supported through other schemes and a phased programme, with stakeholder consultation ongoing.
Following the final advice, I will decide which technologies will be opened up under which conditions in 2020.
Naar aanleiding van het definitieve advies zal ik een besluit nemen over welke technieken tegen welke condities worden opengesteld in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het "Special Report on Climate Change and Land" van het IPCC

An MP asks the government about the IPCC Special Report on Climate Change and Land, including the links to diet, livestock, forest and the Schijf van Vijf. The government answers that the report shows effective strategies exist, that a full appraisal will follow in November, and that it does not draw the conclusions the MP attributes to the IPCC.
A comprehensive appraisal of the IPCC report will be sent to you in November (together with that of the forthcoming special report on Oceans and Ice).
Een uitgebreide appreciatie van het IPCC-rapport ontvangt u in november (tezamen met die van het nog te verschijnen speciale rapport over Oceanen en IJs).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over de ongepaste en onwettelijke inzage in de onderzoeksopzet Shell Papers

Two SP MPs asked whether the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate's request for the research outline of a journalistic FOIA request on Shell was improper and unlawful. The minister answered that the request was too broad and needed clarification under the Wob, that EZK speaks on behalf of 14 other bodies without a formal mandate, and that the purpose question was asked only to specify the request, not to restrict journalism.
It is up to the requester to indicate what specific information they wish to receive; the administrative body can only assist in this.
Het is aan de verzoeker om aan te geven waar hij of zij specifiek informatie over wenst te ontvangen; het bestuursorgaan kan hierbij slechts behulpzaam zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de gezondheidssituatie van veel Groningers in het aardbevingsgebied

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the health situation of Groningen residents affected by earthquakes, including slow damage settlement, reinforcement delays, support for vulnerable residents, the buy-out scheme and a complaints line. The minister answers that the government is accelerating damage handling and reinforcement, taking over settlement from NAM, creating a new institute (IMG) and offering social-emotional support and a special cases committee, while declining to say whether health risks differ from elsewhere in the Netherlands.
I cannot draw conclusions about the different risks of health problems in Groningen compared with the rest of the Netherlands.
Daarom kan ik geen conclusies trekken over de verschillende risico’s op gezondheidsproblemen in Groningen ten opzichte van de rest van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat kleine gasvelden in Noord-Nederland versneld worden leeggehaald

An MP asked the minister whether small Northern Dutch gas fields are being depleted faster than agreed, whether old wells are being reused, and what the risks are, given the Groningen earthquake experience. The minister denied faster extraction, said SodM supervises compliance with production plans and permits, dismissed claims of greater seismic risk, and declined to halt extraction.
No, the assumption that the small gas fields are being depleted faster and that more is being extracted than agreed is incorrect.
Nee, de veronderstelling dat de kleine gasvelden sneller worden leeggehaald en dat er meer wordt gewonnen dan afgesproken, klopt niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over journalistiek onderzoek naar kleine gasvelden in Noord-Nederland

MP Beckerman asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a journalistic report claiming small gas fields in the northeast are being drained faster than permitted, and asks about closures, phase-out plans, damage handling and compensation. The minister denies accelerated extraction, points to declining production figures and the permit-change procedure, and promises a new liability-guarantee bill and a national damage scheme, but gives only general answers on several points.
The assumption that more natural gas is being extracted from small fields than originally licensed, and that the small fields are being drained faster, is incorrect.
De veronderstelling dat er meer aardgas gewonnen wordt uit kleine velden dan oorspronkelijk vergund en dat de kleine velden versneld worden leeggehaald, is onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie naar het overschrijden van dagvolumes

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into gas producers exceeding permitted daily volumes from small Groningen-area fields, and what consequences, monitoring and information to residents would follow. The minister answered that the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) handles enforcement, that criminal investigations are normally conducted confidentially and their outcomes are for the prosecutor to communicate, and that existing instruments are adequate.
It is customary for the Public Prosecution Service to conduct criminal investigations in silence.
Het is gebruikelijk dat het OM de strafrechtelijke onderzoeken in stilte uitvoert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over de berichtgeving ‘Canadees bedrijf zou veel meer gas winnen uit veld Diever dan toegestaan’

MP Sienot asks whether the minister knows of a Canadian company extracting three times the permitted gas from the small Diever field, the reason for the criminal investigation, and what is being done about possible safety risks and overshoot of permits. The minister confirms SodM enforced against overextraction, says the criminal investigation was triggered by SodM's standard referral to the prosecutor, and states SodM knows of no current permit overshoots, with existing enforcement tools deemed sufficient.
Neither SodM nor I are substantively informed of the mentioned criminal investigations.
SodM noch ik zijn inhoudelijk op de hoogte van de genoemde strafrechtelijk onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over `Wob-verzoeken Groningen`

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about RTV Noord's report that the ministry misleads Groningers, the 'underpromise and overdeliver' principle, the many pending Wob (freedom of information) requests on gas extraction, and transparency. The minister denied misleading residents, said he would share information needed for parliamentary oversight, listed ten pending Wob requests, and argued that publishing technical documents would not reduce residents' stress.
I provide the House with the information necessary for the exercise of its supervisory task.
Ik voorzie de Kamer van de informatie die nodig is voor de uitoefening van zijn controlerende taak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het NRC-artikel ‘De weerbarstige realiteit van Wiebes’ beloftes’

MP Beckerman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a NRC article claiming the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation had stalled and that promises were broken, and asked why reports were withheld, how many addresses were inspected, how the engineering tenders and damage compensation (old damage, arbitration, legal aid) are handled. The minister denied a standstill, said the reports were shared with stakeholders rather than confidential and summarized the new risk-based approach, progress dashboard, new public implementing organisation and commitments on arbitration payments, while giving few concrete figures and deferring some details.
For completeness, I have attached the reports, which as indicated have been shared with civil society organisations and other governments.
Volledigheidshalve heb ik de rapporten, die zoals aangegeven zijn gedeeld met maatschappelijke organisaties en medeoverheden, bijgevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over huurverhogingen in aardbevingsgebied 2.0

Two MPs asked whether a housing corporation's rent increases for tenants in a Groningen earthquake-risk complex, which was flagged as elevated risk, were justified, and what tenants could do. The minister answered that the increase was regular, that reinforcement assessments are handled by the National Coordinator Groningen, that tenants can object to the Rent Tribunal, and that she is not party to the dispute and will not reverse it.
I am not a party to this matter and it is not for me to reverse the rent increase.
Ik ben geen partij in deze kwestie en het is niet aan mij om de huurverhoging ongedaan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over geschonden mensenrechten in Groningen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about UN Human Rights Committee recommendations on Groningen gas extraction, compensation, reinforcement of homes, health and rights protection, and a timetable for measures. The minister responds that gas extraction is being phased out faster than planned, that damage handling and reinforcement are top priorities with new legislation (Tijdelijke Wet Groningen) submitted, and that a timetable cannot be given exactly but key milestones are listed.
The cabinet remains firmly committed to bringing gas extraction from the Groningen field to zero as quickly as possible, compensating damage and strengthening homes.
Het kabinet zet zich onverminderd in om de gaswinning uit het Groningenveld zo snel als mogelijk naar nul te brengen, de schade te vergoeden en de huizen te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de lijst met onveilige gebouwen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Groningen list of unsafe buildings accounts for renovations and whether the Hazard and Risk Assessment model is reliable, given that it relies on assumptions and is run by the NAM. The minister acknowledges renovations are included, defends the HRA as an internationally recognised prioritisation tool verified by SodM, TNO and the Raad van State, and promises public management of the model and a TNO verification tool.
However, I consider it important that the HRA model comes under public management as soon as possible.
Wel acht ik het van belang dat het HRA model zo snel mogelijk in publiek beheer komt.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over dat er mogelijk meer versterkingen nodig zijn door onnauwkeurige metingen

An MP asked ministers whether inaccurate seismic measurements mean more Groningen homes need reinforcement, the timing of NAM risk calculations, interim support for residents, and clarity on KNMI and NAM roles. The government says the reinforcement is not halted or delayed, the SodM audit takes 12 to 18 months, the KNMI/NAM roles await an evaluation, and tenants' safety and compensation are covered through corporation agreements.
As promised in the letter of 10 July, we adopt this SodM advice.
Zoals in de brief van 10 juli jl. (Kamerstuk 2019Z14913 ) toegezegd nemen wij dit advies van SodM over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht Hoofdpijn in je milieuhuis

PVV MPs asked whether residents of gas-free renovated homes in Zoetermeer's Palenstein district, who reported headaches and poor air, show that the energy transition harms health, and whether the gas-connection obligation and the gas-free programme should be reversed. The minister acknowledged ventilation problems that have been fixed, rejected reversing the gas-free policy and the pilot neighbourhoods, and defended the climate case while promising monitoring by GGD Haaglanden.
Based on these measurements, GGD Haaglanden classifies the ventilation (CO2 values) in the measured homes as good.
Op basis van deze metingen classificeert GGD Haaglanden de ventilatie (CO 2 -waarden) in de gemeten woningen als goed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht Paula (79) en Wiggert (82) in stress door ‘gedwongen’ verduur

A PVV MP asked the Minister of the Interior about elderly tenants in The Hague facing forced gas disconnection and renovation by housing corporation Vestia, with rent increases, no replacement housing and health concerns. The minister acknowledged the stress, described compensation and support measures, rejected the claim that Vestia should be called to order, and said no other similar cases are known.
I have no data on the number of these.
Over het aantal daarvan heb ik geen gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over vergunningen voor grote staalhardingsovens in Schiedam

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a steel hardening furnace expansion at Dominial in Schiedam, which allegedly started before its permit, and its extra gas use amid Groningen gas reduction and climate goals, along with the municipality's objections and calls for a policy framework. The minister replies that the gas increase is manageable given Dominial can use pseudo-Groningen gas, that the Klimaatakkoord will give municipalities more tools (Wet Milieubeheer update by 1 July 2020), and that permits are currently halted pending the PAS fallout.
With the agreements from the Klimaatakkoord, municipalities and provinces will get more opportunities to anticipate the energy transition.
Met de afspraken uit het Klimaatakkoord krijgen gemeenten en provincies meer mogelijkheden om te kunnen anticiperen met het oog op de energietransitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over mijnbouwactiviteiten in het waddengebied

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether the government shares concerns about mining in the Wadden Sea World Heritage area, whether UNESCO's letter signals concern, and whether a moratorium on new mining is needed. Minister Wiebes replied that strict conditions, monitoring and an independent audit committee apply, that UNESCO's letter is a standard procedural request, and that no moratorium is considered necessary.
Nederland expects to send the reply letter to UNESCO in September 2019. The Minister of LNV will inform your House about this.
Naar verwachting zal Nederland de antwoordbrief aan UNESCO in september 2019 versturen. Uw Kamer zal hierover door de Minister van LNV worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Samenwerkende overheden brengen advies aan minister uit over Zuid-West 380kV hoogspanningsverbinding’

MP Van der Lee (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the above-ground 380kV Zuid-West line through the Natura 2000 Brabantse Wal and Bergen op Zoom area conflicts with the routing principle of avoiding new landscape crossings, and why the underground cable option in the existing pipeline corridor, supported by residents and municipalities, is not chosen, including in light of the Council of State's PAS ruling. The Minister answered that the choice was a broad weighing of several aspects, that TenneT and LSNed found an underground option in the pipeline corridor feasible, and that he intends to ask TenneT to investigate an extended cable route, without deciding on the tracé yet.

I intend, in line with the advice of the cooperating authorities, to ask TenneT to examine, together with stakeholders, an extended cable route in the pipeline corridor connecting to the Brabantse Wal.

Ik ben voornemens, in overeenstemming met het advies van de samenwerkende overheden, aan TenneT te vragen om samen met de belanghebbenden een verlengd kabeltracé in de buisleidingstraat aansluitend op de Brabantse Wal nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over het plan voor een gebiedsfonds waar omwonenden van het windpark N33 niet blij mee zijn

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about residents' dissatisfaction with a proposed community fund for the N33 wind park, including whether participation was handled badly, whether the ministry chose the location, whether residents will be compensated, and where residents can go for planning-damage claims. The minister answered that residents were informed and consulted at several stages, the location was chosen by the province and later adopted nationally, the Council of State found the plan compliant, no compensation is planned beyond a developer contribution to a community fund, and planning-damage claims go to the municipality and RVO.
The Council of State ultimately reviewed the plan and the procedure against the legal requirements and concluded that the plan meets the requirements of proper spatial planning.
De Raad van State heeft het plan en de procedure tenslotte getoetst aan de wettelijke vereisten en heeft geconcludeerd dat het plan voldoet aan de vereisten van een goede ruimtelijke ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over een interview met MKB-Nederland en Greenpeace bij het radioprogramma Radio EenVandaag

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an EenVandaag interview on energy tax exemptions and the Opslag Duurzame Energie (ODE) levy, including which sectors are exempt, shares of gas and electricity unpaid, revenue foregone, ETS firms' payments, and whether exemptions will be abolished. The minister answered that exemptions are largely mandated by EU rules, gave estimates and data limits (no firm-level data available), and said the Klimaatakkoord proposal shifts burden toward large industrial users while SMEs are protected.
Consumption figures for individual companies are not available.
Verbruikscijfers voor individuele bedrijven zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de kosten van het klimaatbeleid

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers whether citizens are entitled to full information on the costs of climate policy, including PBL and CPB cost figures for the Klimaatakkoord, the effects of road pricing on remote residents, and whether existing climate policy should be included in the calculations and a second opinion obtained. Minister Wiebes answered that PBL puts national extra costs at 1.6 to 1.9 billion euros in 2030, CPB puts household burdens of the draft accord at 0.3 billion and total household energy and climate burdens at 3.3 billion, that road-pricing effects cannot yet be assessed, and that the planning bureaus themselves decide on their work programmes and no separate budget was set aside.
Because it is not yet clear whether and in what form road pricing will be introduced in the future, this question cannot be answered.
Omdat het nog niet duidelijk is of en welke vorm van rekeningrijden op termijn wordt ingevoerd is deze vraag niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Laçin over het artikel in de NRC “Nederland betaalde miljoenen maar Tata bouwt in India”

Two SP MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister why a subsidised Hisarna blast furnace is being built in India rather than IJmuiden, and whether subsidy policy should change. The minister denies undue pressure from Tata Steel, says the scale-up plant was needed as an intermediate step, rejects leakage claims, and says the government will only take action on trade if needed.
The conversation with Tata Steel about subsidy options was not conducted in that way, and Tata Steel exerted no pressure, as is suggested here.
Het gesprek met Tata Steel over subsidiemogelijkheden is niet op die manier gevoerd en er is door Tata Steel geen druk uitgeoefend, zoals hier wordt gesuggereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de rechten van Groningers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Supreme Court's answers on Groningen earthquake damage, state responsibility before 2005, compensation for lost living enjoyment and immaterial damage, and whether exclusive jurisdiction for the Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen conflicts with Article 112 of the Constitution. The minister answered that the proposed Tijdelijke Wet Groningen would channel all damage claims to the IMG, that the state took steps from 2013 and decided to end gas extraction in 2018, and that after Raad van State advice the law was amended so victims can still go to the civil court.
The Council of State, in its advice on the Temporary Groningen Act, notes among other things that distancing the operator does not require making the Institute exclusively competent to settle damage.

De Afdeling Advisering van de Raad van State (de Afdeling) wijst er in haar advies over het wetsvoorstel voor een Tijdelijke Wet Groningen onder meer op dat het voor het op afstand plaatsen van de exploitant niet noodzakelijk is om het Instituut exclusief bevoegd te maken tot het afhandelen van schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de flinke groei CO2 Luchtvaart terwijl reductie van de uitstoot van CO2 nodig is

An MP asks the minister why aviation CO2 emissions in the Netherlands grew sharply despite the need for reductions, and whether aviation's non-CO2 climate effects, international aviation's place in national targets, and ETS impacts are adequately addressed. The minister acknowledges that aviation emissions have grown, says a 2030 reduction below 1990 levels is unrealistic, commits to a 2030 target equal to 2005 levels for international aviation, and states that non-CO2 effects cannot yet be reliably quantified, with further research and a forthcoming aviation policy note pending.
International aviation has grown so strongly over the past 30 years that a reduction in 2030 compared with 1990 CO2 emissions is hardly realistic.
De internationale luchtvaart is de afgelopen 30 jaar dermate sterk gegroeid dat een reductie in 2030 ten opzichte van de CO 2 emissies in 1990 weinig realistisch is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Extra uitstoot door afscheid kernenergie’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about IEA warnings that phasing out nuclear power could add emissions, alternatives to nuclear for reliable supply, and how to stimulate new plants. The minister answered that phase-out without replacement would raise CO2 emissions, listed alternative low-carbon sources, said new plants are a market initiative, and noted the Borssele plant is licensed to 2034.
Before 2030, no new nuclear power plant is expected to become operational in the Netherlands.
Voor 2030 wordt er in Nederland naar verwachting geen nieuwe kerncentrale operationeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat mensen hun servicekosten niet terugkrijgen als een concert wordt geannuleerd

An SP MP asked whether ticketing company Ticketmaster breaks the law by not refunding service fees when a concert is cancelled, and how consumers can enforce their rights. The State Secretary confirmed the ACM considers non-refunding unlawful, pointed to the ACM's enforcement powers, consumer complaint routes, and said ticket prices and fees are not capped by law, only subject to transparency requirements.
It is up to the ACM to judge whether companies comply with the consumer protection rules.
Het is aan de ACM om te oordelen of bedrijven zich houden aan de consumentenbeschermingsregels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over drijvende zonnepanelen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a plan for floating solar panels on open water and the grid operator Liander's call to limit new solar parks due to grid capacity, including costs, subsidies, environmental risks and whether connections should be stopped. The Minister answered that the market will develop such projects under the technology-neutral SDE+ scheme, that effects on nature are uncertain but may offer opportunities, and that grid scarcity is being addressed through consultation with local governments, grid operators and market parties, referring to a letter on grid capacity.
It is still unclear how large the plans are exactly and whether they will be realised.
Het is nog onduidelijk hoe groot de plannen precies zijn en of ze gerealiseerd zullen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de berichten 'Uitstoot vervuilend lachgas Chemelot jaren niet gemeld' en 'Lachgas: het stille klimaatprobleem van Limburg'

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the government about reports that Chemelot's Anqore plant had emitted large amounts of nitrous oxide unmeasured and unreported for decades, and about oversight and accountability for that. The minister acknowledged the omission, said Limburg province is the competent authority responsible for monitoring, and said the emissions have been corrected in the registry and that a one-off financial incentive of €42 million is being provided to Fibrant to reduce nitrous oxide.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Gevaarlijke gasleidingen in Nederland versneld vervangen na explosie Den Haag’

MPs Sienot and Van Eijs asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of the Interior about the accelerated replacement of risky grey cast-iron gas pipes after an explosion in The Hague, why some network operators acted slowly, and whether gas-free housing could help. Minister Wiebes answered that SodM supervises an accelerated plan, that the cause of the third incident is not yet explained, that safety is leading, and that he will support network operators where needed.
Now that the precise underlying cause of the third incident, a crack in the gas pipe in The Hague, cannot be explained, it is (still) not possible to establish a link with the earlier incidents.

Nu de precieze achterliggende oorzaak van het derde incident, een scheur in de gasleiding in Den Haag, niet kan worden verklaard, is het (nog) niet mogelijk een relatie te leggen met de eerdere incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de landelijke risico’s door gevaarlijke gasleidingen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the national risks of hazardous gas pipes (grey cast iron and asbestos-cement), including accountability, prioritisation, replacement deadlines and how residents are informed. The minister agreed with the SodM report, said replacement should be accelerated, that the 2040 end date stands, and that Stedin's prioritisation was broadly correct, while deferring to SodM and network operators on details.
I endorse SodM's advice to the network operators and will also convey this to the network operators.
Ik onderschrijf het advies van SodM aan de netbeheerders en dit zal ik ook richting de netbeheerders uitdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der  Molen  en Van den  Berg over het  bericht 'Universiteiten nemen spionagerisico voor lief'

MPs Van der Molen and Van den Berg asked the ministers whether Dutch universities are exposed to espionage and theft of research findings, whether foreign students should be excluded, and what measures will strengthen security awareness. The government says it is examining broader knowledge-security rules, outlines existing legal tools (Iran and North Korea sanctions screening), declines to give case details or figures, and points to existing platforms and agencies while deferring the outcome of ongoing reviews.
The cabinet does not make public statements about case details that affect the current knowledge level and modus operandi of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over casuïstiek die het actuele kennisniveau en de modus operandi van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten raken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het artikel van De Volkskrant van 25 mei jl. onder de titel ‘een aan alle kanten stinkende affaire’

MP Wassenberg asked whether SDE+ subsidies for manure digesters are really for renewable energy or mainly serve to dispose of manure surplus and sustain intensive livestock farming, and whether the subsidy should end. The minister defended the digesters as cost-effective renewable energy producers, said existing subsidies will not be ended, and noted co-digestion is no longer a separate SDE+ category from 2019.
No, I will not end the subsidies on existing manure (co-)digesters.
Nee, de subsidies op bestaande mest(co)vergisters zal ik niet beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat Google de Android-licentie voor Huawei intrekt

MP Moorlag asked the State Secretary whether Google's revocation of Huawei's Android licence would degrade or stop updates on existing Huawei phones, whether this breaches consumer contracts, what the ACM could do, and how consumers can be informed. The State Secretary answered that Huawei expects no loss of functionality or security updates for existing devices, that any non-conformity would be a matter for the seller and ultimately the courts, that the ACM sees no consumer-law violation, and that sellers must inform buyers.
From this it appears that no consequences are foreseen for the functionality for current owners of Huawei phones.
Hieruit blijkt dat er geen gevolgen worden voorzien ten aanzien van de functionaliteit voor huidige bezitters van Huawei-telefoons.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Zonnepanelen in Den Haag blijken stoorzender en moeten uit tijdens bezoek Ivanka Trump’

An MP asked why solar panels in The Hague had to be switched off for three weeks during a visit by Ivanka Trump, and who would compensate the owners. The minister explained the C2000 emergency network required a temporary antenna, that compensation was given out of goodwill by the Foreign Ministry, and that installer knowledge and certification are primarily the sector's responsibility.
It is primarily a matter for producers and installers to ensure this.
Het is primair een zaak van producenten en installateurs om hier zorg voor te dragen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de massale kap van Nederlandse bossen

An MP from FvD asked the ministers about mass deforestation in the Netherlands, the amount of wood harvested, and the use of forest biomass for energy despite KNAW and RIVM warnings. The minister said there is no overall list of forests slated for felling, that provinces are inventorying conversions under Natura 2000 and PAS, and that biomass is considered sustainable under international criteria, while promising a forest strategy with the provinces and a review of ISDE and emission standards.
No, I do not have such an overview.
Nee, ik beschik niet over zo’n overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel 'The hidden subsidy of fossil fuels'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an article on hidden global fossil fuel subsidies, including the Netherlands' share, domestic costs and the timeline for the motion-Van Raan study on subsidy definitions. The minister answered that no consistent definition or Dutch share is available, pointed to international reform efforts and Dutch carbon pricing, and said the study will be reported after an IEA review expected later.
I cannot provide insight into the Netherlands' share of direct subsidies and tax benefits within an estimated total European amount.
Ik kan geen inzicht geven in een aandeel van Nederland in directe subsidies en belastingvoordelen in een totaal ingeschat Europees bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht ‘Staatsbosbeheer wil duidelijker bosbeleid van minister’

MPs Thieme and Van Kooten-Arissen asked the minister about Staatsbosbeheer's timber harvesting, nesting-bird protection during felling, net CO2 effects of forest loss, biomass burning and EU carbon-neutral treatment. The minister answered that harvesting is limited to regular management and calamities, that surveys precede felling under the code of conduct, and that biomass is treated as carbon-neutral under international rules, with a forest strategy to follow.
However, the forest strategy I am developing together with the provinces will also address forest management and the questions that arise.
Wel zal bij het maken van de bossenstrategie, die ik samen met de provincies ga ontwikkelen, ook worden ingegaan op het beheer van bossen en de vragen die daarbij spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de aanleg van een stroomstation in Voorne-Putten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a large converter station and underground cable at Biert in Voorne-Putten, which residents say would harm the landscape, is appropriate, and how the location was chosen and whether industrial sites and local views were considered. The minister confirmed the plans, explained a broad exploration of 25 cable routes and 10 connection sites, and said Simonshaven and Maasvlakte were selected for further study in a Rijkscoördinatieregeling procedure, with regional authorities to advise on a preferred option and landscape integration to be weighed before a spatial decision.
I will give the authorities in the region the opportunity to advise me on a preferred alternative following the IEA.
Ik zal de overheden in de regio de gelegenheid geven mij naar aanleiding van de IEA te adviseren over een voorkeursalternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘SodM legt last onder dwangsom op aan Akzo, Nedmag en Frisia’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about SodM's penalty order against salt-mining firms over incomplete REACH chemical safety reports, groundwater contamination from diesel leaks, abandonment policy, and diesel storage in caverns. The minister acknowledged the failures, said SodM's enhanced supervision continues, and outlined remediation plans and ongoing SodM review.
For that reason SodM has imposed a penalty order on the salt-mining companies.
SodM heeft om die reden de zoutwinningsbedrijven een last onder dwangsom opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, en Dik-Faber over het artikel ‘Gedupeerden gaswinning moeten twee keer zo lang wachten op afhandeling schade’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that Groningen gas-damage claimants face a total wait of about 30 months, as the TCMG postponed its decision deadline by fifteen months. The Minister acknowledged the delay, attributed it to a backlog inherited by the TCMG, and announced a one-off stuwmeer scheme offering a fixed compensation of 5,000 euro to all claims received up to 12 June 2019, with variable compensation up to 11,000 euro for claims from 1 January 2019.
I have decided to enable the TCMG to apply the fixed compensation of 5,000 euro from the stuwmeer scheme to all applications received by the TCMG up to and including 12 June 2019.
Ik heb besloten het de TCMG mogelijk te maken de vaste vergoeding van € 5.000,– uit de stuwmeerregeling te laten gelden voor alle aanvragen die door de TCMG zijn ontvangen tot en met 12 juni 2019
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de Stuwmeerregeling Groningen

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister why the one-off Stuwmeer scheme keeps a 1 January 2019 cut-off for the variable compensation (up to 11,000 euro) while extending the 12 June 2019 deadline for the fixed 5,000 euro, creating unequal treatment, and asks whether damage recovery will speed up given that delayed claimants now face longer waits. The Minister replies that the independent TCMG advised against extending the 11,000 euro variant to everyone, that a hard cut-off is needed for an administrable one-off scheme, that claimants may choose between the scheme and the regular process, and that no claims will simply be written off.
It is therefore not appropriate to lightly depart from the TCMG's advice.
Het is dus niet gepast om lichtzinnig van het advies van de TCMG af te wijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het ontbreken van draagvlak voor aardgaswinning onder het Werelderfgoed de Waddenzee

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the lack of local support for gas extraction under the Wadden Sea World Heritage site, citing a local council letter and the Fryslân provincial opposition. The minister stated that public support is not a legal ground for refusal, defended the 'hand on the tap' monitoring principle and the independent audit committee, and refused to hold an enquiry or to refuse permits in advance.
For the gas extraction at Ternaard it has been agreed that the outcomes of the environmental process will be given a place in the final decision-making.
In het geval van de gaswinning bij Ternaard is de afspraak gemaakt dat de uitkomsten van het omgevingsproces een plek krijgen in de uiteindelijke besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Geleijnse over het bericht ‘De Autoriteit Consument en Markt heeft geen gelijk, wettelijke bescherming geldt voor meer zzp’ers’

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked the ministers whether the competition authority ACM applies EU competition rules to self-employed workers too strictly, preventing them from negotiating collective rates, and whether this fosters social dumping. The state secretary answered that the ACM follows the Court of Justice's FNV KIEM ruling, that it is preparing a revised guideline on collective tariff agreements for self-employed workers around summer 2019, and that the Commission on the regulation of work will report by 1 November 2019.
The ACM has indicated that it aims to consult on the new guideline around summer 2019.
De ACM heeft aangegeven dat zij ernaar streeft om de nieuwe leidraad rond de zomer van 2019 te consulteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht 'Steeds meer biomassacentrales, goed of slecht voor het klimaat?'

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked whether biomass power plants should be paused, given air quality and sustainability concerns, and when sustainability and cascading criteria will be set. The minister replied that the sustainability framework is expected in Q1 2020, that emission standards for smaller plants are under review, that the government will not intervene in specific projects, and that it sees no legal basis to refuse permits when all rules are met.
The cabinet is not involved in the development of specific projects and intervention is therefore not an option.
Het kabinet is niet betrokken bij de totstandkoming van specifieke projecten en een interventie is dus niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht dat de Europese staalfusie Tata Steel en Thyssen-Krupp niet doorgaat

Rep. Veldman (VVD) asked the minister about reports that the Tata Steel and Thyssen-Krupp steel merger would not proceed, the Commission's reasons, the claimed long-term benefits, and whether EU competition law should be revised. The state secretary explained the Commission's merger review and remedies process, noted Franco-German calls to loosen fusion rules, and said the cabinet favours strengthening the internal market while not wanting to weaken competition, with a stated willingness to explore revisions.
The discussions between the Commission and the parties are confidential, but based on what the parties have made public, it can be inferred
De gesprekken tussen de Commissie en partijen zijn vertrouwelijk, maar op basis van wat door partijen hierover naar buiten is gebracht, valt af te leiden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Amerikaanse kerncentrales in Saoedi-Arabië, en Urenco?'

MPs Van der Lee and Van Ojik asked whether the US would sell nuclear technology to Saudi Arabia despite the Khashoggi case and Saudi nuclear weapons ambitions, and whether Urenco would supply enriched uranium to Saudi Arabia under the Almelo Treaty. The ministers answered that the US has not confirmed any export, that civil nuclear use is permitted under the NPT, that Urenco supply oversight lies with the Joint Committee whose deliberations are confidential, and that no supply to Saudi Arabia is foreseen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Baudet over de twijfels van het bedrijfsleven over de kosten van het klimaatbeleid

MPs Stoffer and Baudet asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about business doubts over the costs of climate policy, including PBL and Navigant cost estimates, the affordability of home insulation and industry investment, and public support for the energy transition. The minister largely defended the PBL analysis, citing methodological differences, promised cost reduction efforts and further transparency on models, and gave no commitment to new parliamentary oversight measures.
I share the importance of open and testable models.
Ik deel het belang van openbare en toetsbare modellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Moorlag over de kabinetsplannen over het klimaatbeleid

PvdA MPs Asscher and Moorlag asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that a draft CO2 levy would largely exempt industry, whether industry would receive the revenue back, and related questions on the Climate Agreement, household energy burdens and planning bureau analyses. The minister answered that the levy is still being explored and that industry revenue will be used to green industry, but refused to send the internal draft note to parliament and gave only general responses on the other points.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Scholen moeten vijf keer zo hard verduurzamen als ze nu doen’

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked about reports that schools must decarbonise five times faster, the low number of energy-efficiency upgrades, the Schooldakrevolutie motion, new school-building rules, and a 2016 Court of Audit recommendation on clear national school-housing ambitions. The minister replied that climate agreement commitments, the Activiteitenbesluit energy-saving duty, the Green Deal Scholen, pilot programmes and waterside balancing studies are underway, and that a Berenschot-style housing monitor is planned for 2022.
In the draft Climate Agreement, agreements have been made to achieve CO2 reduction in the built environment.
In het ontwerpKlimaatakkoord zijn afspraken gemaakt om tot een CO 2 -reductie in de gebouwde omgeving te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de milieuschade van houtstook die vele malen hoger is dan de milieuschade door aardgas of stookolie

MP Wassenberg asked the government about a CE-Delft study showing wood heating causes far higher environmental damage than gas or oil, and asked whether pellet imports, pellet classification and ISDE subsidies for biomass should be ended. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the ISDE subsidy will be critically evaluated and emission rules tightened, but refused to ban North American pellets (WTO rules) or to label wood pellet heating generically as not climate-friendly.

Because of the effect on air quality, the draft Climate Agreement announced that the cabinet, as part of the evaluation of the ISDE, will critically examine whether further stimulation of small-scale biomass combustion is desirable.

Vanwege het effect op de luchtkwaliteit is in het ontwerp-Klimaatakkoord aangekondigd dat het kabinet als onderdeel van de evaluatie van de ISDE kritisch zal kijken naar de wenselijkheid van verdere stimulering van kleinschalige verbranding van biomassa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over de uitfasering van fluorescentiebuizen

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked why the mercury exemption for fluorescent tubes under the RoHS directive has been extended beyond its five-year term, citing LED alternatives, mercury content, CO2 savings and WHO concerns. The State Secretary answered that the Commission has not yet decided on the extension requests, that a socio-economic study is nearly ready, and that the government supports a phase-out weighed against overall environmental effects and will keep pressing the Commission.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de vergroening van de auto’s van de overheid

An MP asked whether the government still stands by its 2016 commitment to green its official car fleet, given cases where replacement cars were petrol-powered and only 2% of the fleet is electric. The state secretary answered that the commitment stands, admitted the 2020 target of 20-25% electric will be hard to reach, and promised to push other ministers and a joint improvement programme.
Although I realise it will be difficult to reach the stated target still in 2020, I want to commit to it, especially now that the market for electric transport offers an increasingly better range.
Hoewel ik besef dat het lastig zal worden om het gestelde doel nog in 2020 te halen, wil ik me hiervoor inzetten, zeker nu de markt voor elektrisch vervoer een steeds beter aanbod kent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de (bij)stook van biomassa in centrales

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether biomass co-firing in coal plants is truly CO2-neutral, given transport and processing emissions, carbon-sink timing, and the planned increase in biomass use toward 2020 and 2023. The minister replied that biomass combustion is treated as CO2-neutral under international rules, that sustainability criteria require at least 70% lower chain CO2 than fossil fuels, and that the government considers biomass a necessary, efficient part of the climate transition.
I cannot provide an exact breakdown of the CO2 emissions associated with the production, transport and processing of biomass.
Ik kan geen exacte uitsplitsing geven van de CO 2 -uitstoot die samenhangt met de productie, het transport en de verwerking van biomassa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht in de Telegraaf “kleine visser zit klem”

MPs asked the government about reports that small fishers are squeezed by offshore wind farms, including access rules, fines for approaching turbines, and the progress of a Noordzee future perspective. The minister answered that the ministries share responsibility, that no record was kept of a meeting with fishers, that wind farms were opened to vessels up to 24 metres from May 2018 under conditions, and that a Noordzee agreement process and a fishing-sector perspective are underway, with evaluation in 2020.
No report was made of the meeting referred to.
Van het gesprek waarnaar wordt verwezen is geen verslag gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Chinese spionnen stelen kostbare bedrijfsgeheimen van ASML'

CDA MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch asked the ministers about reports that Chinese spies stole trade secrets from ASML, and whether this threatens national security and calls for new measures. The minister answered that the theft by ex-employees of ASML's US subsidiary was serious but showed no direct foreign government involvement, outlined existing legal and advisory protections, and promised an investment screening law in 2019 and a new China strategy.
The aim is to bring such a bill into procedure in 2019 as part of a broader package of measures.
Inzet is om een dergelijk wetsvoorstel in 2019 in procedure te kunnen brengen als onderdeel van een breder palet aan maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Sneller over het bericht 'ING en milieuorganisaties bepleiten klimaatrichtlijnen voor financiële sector'

Two D66 MPs asked whether the government will act on an NGO and ING call for climate guidelines for banks, including requesting IEA scenarios and a single carbon measurement method. The minister answered that the IEA Sustainable Development Scenario already suffices, that the Dutch financial sector's commitment to Paris-aligned targets is welcomed, and that a single measurement method is premature while harmonisation proceeds.
However, in my view it is still too early to introduce a single standard measurement method for the climate impact of investments at this time.
Het is echter wat mij betreft nog te vroeg om op dit moment één standaard meetmethode in te voeren voor de klimaatimpact van investeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de nieuwe versterkingsaanpak

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the new reinforcement approach for earthquake-damaged buildings in Groningen, including governance, the role of NAM and CVW, and resident influence. The Minister defended the Besluit versterken gebouwen Groningen, stating the owner keeps the final say, municipalities gain material client role, and NAM is removed from steering, while acknowledging ongoing concerns and committing to monitor and possibly amend the rules.
The decision gives substance to the joint agreements of the central government and regional authorities on carrying out the reinforcement, and thereby provides clarity to the people of Groningen.
Het besluit geeft invulling aan de gezamenlijke afspraken van het Rijk en regionale overheden voor de uitvoering van de versterking en daarmee duidelijkheid aan de Groningers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘EU eist van Den Haag nieuw plan voor duurzame energie’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an EU demand that the Netherlands present a new renewable energy plan and about the risk of a fine for missing the 2020 renewable target. The minister acknowledged the Netherlands lags the 14% target (projected 12.2%), blamed delays in onshore wind and rising energy consumption, declined to estimate any fine, and promised a letter before the summer recess on Joint Project Mechanism options and domestic measures.
I cannot make any statements about the amount of a possible fine; this is not currently at issue and there are still many uncertain factors.
Over de hoogte van de eventuele boete kan ik geen uitspraken doen; dit is nu niet aan de orde en er zijn nog veel onzekere factoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘windmolens medeoorzaak insectensterfte’

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about reports that wind turbines contribute to insect deaths, citing a German DLR study, and asked about insect considerations in permitting and monitoring of renewable energy. The minister said the German estimate is small relative to total insect numbers according to Dutch experts, that insects are not considered in wind permitting under the Nature Conservation Act, and that the effects of solar parks and renewable energy on insects will be explored.
In permitting wind farms under the Nature Conservation Act, insects are not taken into account.
In de vergunningverlening voor windmolenparken op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming wordt geen rekening gehouden met insecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het bericht ‘Open letter on climate-related financial risks’

MPs Van der Lee and Snels asked the finance and economic affairs ministers how they respond to a central bank open letter with four recommendations on climate-related financial risks, and whether the government will engage with the NGFS and open up climate data. The minister answers that the recommendations are valuable and largely in line with government policy, citing DNB stress tests, the Klimaatakkoord, and EU and international initiatives, while stating that the NGFS is a central bank network in which ministers are not directly involved.
I therefore strongly advocate, together with DNB and the AFM, at European and international level for integrating climate risks into banks' risk management and supervision.
Ik maak mij dan ook – samen met DNB en de AFM – in Europees en internationaal verband hard voor het integreren van klimaatrisico’s in het risicobeheer van banken, alsmede in het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over Amersfoort dat reeds in 2030 geheel van het gas af wil zijn

An MP from the PVV asks the ministers whether Amersfoort's plan to be fully off gas by 2030 is unrealistic, how municipalities can legally force homeowners off gas, and whether citizens should be protected. The minister rejects the criticism, explains that municipalities currently lack a legal basis to force disconnection but that the Rijk is considering one with legal safeguards and appeal routes, and refuses to withdraw the climate plans.
Municipalities currently have no statutory basis to force homeowners to disconnect from natural gas.
Gemeenten hebben nu geen wettelijke grondslag om huiseigenaren te dwingen van het aardgas af te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over schade ontstaan door het afsluiten van een lekkende gasput

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about damage to nearby homes caused by sealing a leaking gas well in Monster, and about liability, monitoring and the handling of claims. The minister answered that NAM is responsible for the damage, that claims are being settled, that the well is under three months of monitoring, and that a monitoring policy for abandoned wells will follow from SodM and KEM research.
NAM has committed to paying the damage and has itself pointed out to residents that they can submit a claim.
NAM heeft toegezegd de schade te betalen en heeft ook zelf de omwonenden erop gewezen dat zij een claim kunnen indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Opnieuw toestemming voor gaswinning zonder proefboring’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about gas extraction permits granted for small fields without prior test drilling, criticised by the Mijnraad, and whether such permits will be refused in the Wadden area. The Minister confirmed the permits, argued that coordinated drilling and extraction procedures and geological comparability make the approach safe, and said Natura 2000 areas are already protected by statute, without committing to a general ban on permits without test drilling.

I have prescribed that the mining company must submit to me, after the planned drilling, the results of the drilling, including at least the expected production, the expected consequences for subsidence and the Seismic Risk Analysis.

Ik heb voorgeschreven dat de betreffende mijnbouwonderneming na afloop van de voorgenomen boring de resultaten van de boring, waaronder in ieder geval de te verwachte productie, de gevolgen voor de verwachte bodemdaling en de Seismische Risico Analyse bij mij indient.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de (bij)stook van biomassa in centrales

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether biomass co-firing in coal plants is truly CO2-neutral, given transport and processing emissions, forest regrowth times, and the growing role of biomass by 2020 and 2023. The minister replied that biomass is treated as CO2-neutral under international agreements, that Dutch sustainability criteria require at least 70% CO2 savings across the chain, and that the government sees biomass as necessary for the energy transition, though it did not provide a precise breakdown of chain emissions.
I cannot provide an exact breakdown of the CO2 emissions associated with the production, transport and processing of biomass.
Ik kan geen exacte uitsplitsing geven van de CO 2 -uitstoot die samenhangt met de productie, het transport en de verwerking van biomassa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over een nieuw onderzoek naar de impact van de ongekende veranderingen rond de Noordpool

MP Van Raan (PvdD) asked ministers about media reports on a new study of rapid Arctic change, including claims of a tipping point, sea-ice and ice-sheet loss, and whether Dutch climate policy has enough margin for setbacks toward the 1.5°C goal. The minister acknowledged the study's concerning picture and the need for ambitious climate policy, while stating the 49% 2030 target stands and that policy can be adjusted as new insights emerge.
Dutch climate policy aims for a 49% reduction in 2030 compared with 1990.
Het Nederlandse klimaatbeleid is gericht op een reductie van 49% in 2030 ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Schimmigheid klimaattafels baart MKB zorgen’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the climate roundtables raise concerns among SMEs, and whether the energy transition is affordable, whether the government will consult SMEs about shifting the sustainable energy surcharge (ODE) to large industry, and whether SMEs can be supported in energy-saving measures. The minister answered that the government aims for an affordable transition, will show the effects of the ODE shift on SMEs before the bill this summer, and will assess the broader impact of the Klimaatakkoord on SMEs and inform the House in the second half of 2019.
Once this overview is ready it will be shared with MKB-Nederland and the House of Representatives.
Zodra dit overzicht gereed is zal het worden gedeeld met MKB-Nederland en de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de grootste, maar ongewenste, houtoven in Diemen

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked whether Diemen and the province of Noord-Holland must approve the permit for the Netherlands' largest wood-burning biomass plant despite air and CO2 concerns, what legal tools exist to refuse it, whether biomass is doubly subsidised, and what SDE+ subsidy applies per kWh. The minister answered that permits can only be refused for non-compliance with law, that biomass is treated as renewable and CO2-neutral under international rules, and gave the subsidy amounts (about 0.051 euro/kWh for a pellet boiler for district heating, 0.027 euro/kWh for smaller boilers).
Yes, if all laws and regulations are complied with, in particular the requirements on air emissions and air quality, the Environmental Permitting Act (Wabo) contains no ground to refuse an activity.

Ja, als voldaan wordt aan alle wet- en regelgeving – in het bijzonder ook de vereisten op het gebied van luchtemissies en luchtkwaliteit – dan kent de Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht (Wabo) geen weigeringsgrond om een activiteit te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over gasloze sociale huurwoningen

An MP from the PVV asks the ministers whether tenants of social rental housing really want gas-free renovation, questioning its costs of over 100,000 euro per dwelling and the burden on tenants, plus the use of energy coaches. Minister Ollongren rejects the premise, argues tenants can refuse renovation proposals, says the cost figures overstate the case, and defends energy coaching as awareness-raising.
Tenants have the option to reject a renovation proposal from their landlord.
Huurders hebben hierbij de mogelijkheid een renovatievoorstel van hun verhuurder af te wijzen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Ronnes en Omtzigt over de opvatting van het financieel stabiliteitscomité over het Klimaatakkoord en over de niet gepubliceerde achtergronddocumenten van het Klimaatakkoord

CDA MPs asked the ministers whether the Financial Stability Committee's warnings about mortgage lending norms and green building-linked finance conflict with the draft Climate Agreement, and why the PBL analysis's background documents and reviewer access were incomplete. The ministers replied that AFM and DNB concerns are being taken into account in designing new financing options, that the PBL published three of five background documents, and that the government holds no unpublished background documents.
It is up to the PBL to make the background documents public.
Het is aan PBL om de achtergronddocumenten openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ouderen in het aardbevingsgebied

An SP MP asked the minister about elderly, less self-reliant residents in the Groningen earthquake area: whether their homes should be treated as care buildings with higher safety standards, whether elderly people are being adequately considered, and whether ending the Eigen Initiatief strengthening route leaves them waiting. The minister replied that safety is paramount, that homes can be made age-proof during strengthening, that no new Eigen Initiatief round will open for now (though existing participants continue), and that the strengthening operation was never stopped.
However, I have no insight into which of these homes are inhabited by elderly people.
Ik heb er echter geen inzicht in welke van deze woningen bewoond worden door ouderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Moorlag en Agnes Mulder over de miljoenen waardedaling van huizen door windparken

MPs Beckerman, Moorlag and Agnes Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about property value losses near wind farms, the adequacy of the planning damage scheme, the Rijkscoördinatieregeling (RCR) limiting local participation, and profit-sharing with residents. The Minister defended the existing independent planning damage procedure, promised to update the VU study and reconsider how wind areas are designated, and said participation and ownership shares will be addressed in the Klimaatakkoord framework without legally enforcing some transparency demands.
I will consult with the VU to give substance to the update.
Ik zal in overleg treden met de VU om invulling te geven aan de actualisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het al dan niet invoeren van een CO2-heffing voor de industrie

MP Moorlag (PvdA) asked Minister Wiebes whether he had told industry representatives that no generic CO2 levy would be introduced, and whether the proposed bonus-malus scheme swap was merely cosmetic. The minister confirmed a meeting with about 35 industry representatives on the cabinet's announced measures, said he did not hold a transcript, forwarded the request for one to VNO-NCW, and stated the cabinet will introduce a 'sensible and objective' CO2 levy in place of the bonus-malus system, which PBL found insufficiently effective.
Neither I nor the staff involved have a report of this meeting.
Noch ik, noch de betrokken medewerkers beschikken over een verslag van deze bijeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het (ontbreken van) draagvlak voor aardgaswinning onder het Werelderfgoed de Waddenzee

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether local and regional support for gas extraction under the Wadden Sea World Heritage site is lacking, whether he will investigate it, and whether he will halt the planned Ternaard extraction. The minister says support is fragile, that a stakeholder process with local residents will inform a decision this autumn, but that the project is one of national interest decided by cabinet, and declines to commit to halting it.
In addition, I am considering putting the resulting package of measures to a wider group of residents in the area.
Ik overweeg om, aanvullend daarop, het resulterende pakket aan maatregelen ook nog breder voor te leggen aan omwonenden in het gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ook omgekeerde bewijslast mijnbouwschade in Drenthe

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the reversed burden of proof for mining damage recommended by the Tcbb for all of the Netherlands will be adopted, and raises confusion over Groningen versus Drenthe earthquake causes, the Commissie Mijnbouwschade, communication with residents and risk information. The minister says the Tcbb advice will be appraised before summer 2019, a bill to amend the Mijnbouwwet is expected for consultation in autumn, and he commits to better communication with municipalities and residents.
I am aware of this advice, which was drafted at my request by the Tcbb.
Ik ken dit advies dat op mijn verzoek is opgesteld door de Tcbb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘Energiesystemen minder betaalbaar en niet duurzamer’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an article on energy systems becoming less affordable and less sustainable, including global transition stagnation, falling renewable costs, Paris Agreement implementation, and the Netherlands' transition readiness ranking. The minister answered substantively, describing national and EU climate targets, cost trends, the Klimaatakkoord's flexibility and innovation agenda, and why Sweden is a useful comparator.
I will therefore continue to work within the EU and, where possible, beyond it to further accelerate the energy transition
Ik blijf mij dan ook binnen de EU en waar mogelijk daarbuiten inzetten voor een verdere versnelling van de energietransitie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Groothuizen over het artikel ‘Tweede ondernemer zwicht na dreigbrief van windmolenactivisten: 'U krijgt 48 uur'’

MPs Sienot and Groothuizen asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about a newspaper report of a second entrepreneur giving in to threats from wind-turbine activists, and what the government does against intimidation and to protect businesses. Minister Grapperhaus answered that intimidation is unacceptable, that police do not record wind-related offences separately, that local protest is largely lawful, and that businesses are primarily responsible for their own security with local authorities adding measures when risk warrants, while pointing to regional energy strategies and co-ownership to build support.
As previously indicated in answers to parliamentary questions, offences committed in relation to wind turbines are not registered by the police under a separate code.
Antwoord 3 Zoals eerder aangegeven in de beantwoording van Kamervragen 2 , worden delicten die worden gepleegd in relatie tot windmolens door de politie niet geregistreerd onder een aparte code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de informele Transportraad van 26-27 maart 2019

MPs Dijkstra and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether the EU heavy-duty and car CO2 standards adopted at the March 2019 informal Transport Council count toward the 7.3 Mton mobility target, and why NEV 2017 already assumed some of these standards. The Staatssecretaris answered that the heavy-vehicle standards contribute 0.9-1.4 Mton, explained the NEV 2017 assumptions, and said the new standards will be included in the KEV 2019.
The tightened CO2 standards for passenger, light commercial and heavy vehicles will also be included in the Climate and Energy Outlook (KEV) of 2019.
De aangescherpte CO 2 -normen voor personen-, bestel- en vrachtauto's zullen ook in de Klimaat- en Energieverkenning (KEV) van 2019 worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over hinderlijke regelgeving voor de uitrol van zonnepanelen door woningbouwcorporaties

Two PvdA MPs asked whether Woningwet rules that restrict housing corporations from installing solar panels and feeding surplus energy into the grid hinder sustainability goals, and whether corporations should get SDE+ subsidy. The minister confirmed the current limits, said corporations are eligible for SDE+ if they meet conditions, and committed to amend the Woningwet after the evaluation to allow more sustainability measures.
I intend to include these adjustments in the legislative amendments following the evaluation of the revised Housing Act.
Ik ben voornemens om deze aanpassingen mee te nemen in de wetswijzigingen naar aanleiding van de evaluatie van de herziene Woningwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Ronnes en Omtzigt over de doorrekening van het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL)

MPs Mulder, Ronnes and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the ministers about the PBL cost calculation of the draft Climate Agreement's building-sector measures, including the costs per tonne of CO2 and transparency of assumptions. The minister answered that the calculations use standard insulation assumptions, that PBL has explained its models, and that the Climate and Energy Outlook may incorporate new insights.
PBL strives for full transparency about its calculations.
PBL streeft naar volledige transparantie over zijn berekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het toestaan van meer gaswinning dan SodM adviseert

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why he permitted NAM to extract more gas from the UMOG cluster and Grijpskerk than SodM advised, whether damage occurred, where residents can claim, and when a compensation loket and a closure plan for small fields will exist. The minister replied that he follows SodM's safety assessment, that the production volumes were clarified via TNO's published overview, that no damage reports are known, and that a national mining damage commission is planned, possibly only from 2021.
I give my consent to a winning plan if, in the opinion of the supervisory authority State Supervision of Mines, extraction can take place safely and responsibly.
Ik geef mijn instemming op een winningsplan als de winning naar het oordeel van de toezichthouder Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen veilig en verantwoord kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de aanklacht tegen de EU vanwege de negatieve klimaatimpact van houtstook
