MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked the minister about a lawsuit claiming EU energy policy wrongly treats wood burning as CO2-neutral, and whether subsidies for wood burning should stop. The minister rejects the claim that wood burning is wrongly classed as CO2-neutral, says sustainability criteria and the Klimaatakkoord address carbon debt and air quality, and declines to stop subsidies.
I do not share the view that wood burning is wrongly classified as CO2-neutral.
Ik deel het standpunt niet dat houtstook onterecht wordt aangemerkt als CO 2 -neutraal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Ondernemer zwicht voor bedreigingen en stapt uit windmolenproject De Monden’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Justice about a report that an entrepreneur withdrew from the De Monden wind farm after threats, asking about condemnation, prosecution, NCTV classification, victim support and lessons learned. The government condemned threats, said a police and prosecution investigation is ongoing, and gave limited operational detail while noting a very small group breaks the law.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service are currently conducting a criminal investigation, so I cannot go into the substance of the case.
Politie en OM doen momenteel strafrechtelijk onderzoek, waardoor ik inhoudelijk niet op de zaak kan ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over mogelijke geluidsoverlast van een transformatorstation van TenneT

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers whether a TenneT transformer station in the IJmond industrial area could cause noise nuisance in Wijk aan Zee and whether a fully enclosed box should be required. The minister acknowledged concerns, stated the noise contribution is under 2 percent of cumulative noise, and said TenneT will take extra noise-reducing measures including enclosing the transformers with walls and a roof, while the compensation coils remain open at the top.
In these talks the commitment was made to noise-reducing measures, including placing the transformers in a "box".
In deze gesprekken is de toezegging gedaan tot geluidreducerende maatregelen, waaronder het plaatsen van de transformatoren in een «box».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over het artikel ‘Energielabels vaak onjuist, online winkels vaak helemaal geen label’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an NOS report that about one in five household appliances carry incorrect energy labels and many online shops show no label at all, and what will be done about enforcement, business awareness and consumer information. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to planned legislation giving the NVWA administrative fining powers, EU measures such as a product database, and a communication campaign, without giving a firm date for the bill beyond later this year.
I am working to improve this. I am doing so, among other things, through a legislative amendment to make the NVWA's enforcement powers more efficient.
Ik ben bezig om dit te verbeteren. Dit doe ik onder meer met een wetswijziging om de handhavingsmogelijkheden van de NVWA efficiënter te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Netbeheer Nederland verwacht op veel meer plaatsen problemen met netcapaciteit'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Netbeheer Nederland's expectation of grid capacity problems in many more places, its ten action points, and whether the minister would evaluate each one and send a letter on interim technical solutions. The minister answered that the action points will be taken into account, that he will consult with Netbeheer Nederland, and that he will send the letter in May.
I will take the action points of Netbeheer Nederland into account when drafting my letter on the technical interim solutions and will consult with Netbeheer Nederland.
Ik zal de actiepunten van Netbeheer Nederland meenemen bij het opstellen van mijn brief over de technische interim-oplossingen en met Netbeheer Nederland in overleg gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Agnes Mulder over problemen met en leren van pilots aardgasvrije wijken voor de toekomstige wijkaanpak

CDA MPs Ronnes and Agnes Mulder asked about problems in the Nijmegen Meijhorst zero-natural-gas renovation pilot, what central information is collected on neighbourhood pilots, costs, and planning for regional heat plans. The Minister of Interior answered that residents report renovation and comfort problems being addressed, that a Knowledge and Learning Programme and monitoring are being set up, and that further details will follow in later letters.
Your House will be informed about this in the autumn of 2019.
Uw Kamer zal hierover in het najaar van 2019 worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de doorrekeningen van het Klimaatakkoord

The MP asks why the PBL climate-agreement calculations use a 3% social discount rate, versus about 1.5% for pension funds, and whether climate investments are less diversified and riskier. The minister confirms the 3% social discount rate follows the government's MKBA guidance, explains it reflects a risk premium for public investment, and says pension funds use a different discount rate for valuing liabilities.
The use of the discount rate therefore gives insight into whether a public investment is sufficiently worthwhile from a societal point of view.
Het gebruik van de discontovoet geeft dus inzicht in de vraag of een publieke investering vanuit een maatschappelijk oogpunt voldoende loont.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Moorlag en Nijboer over meer banen in Oost-Groningen

MPs from the PvdA asked ministers whether the Opiumwet's ban on industrial use of hemp tops, which blocks CBD extraction at HempFlax in Oost-Groningen, should be relaxed to create jobs, and how Germany regulates this. The minister answered that the law only exempts fibre hemp for fibre or seed, that the juridical options are still being explored, and that talks with the businesses will follow.
At this moment I am exploring the legal possibilities.
Op dit moment ben ik de juridische mogelijkheden aan het verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de Daglichtkas

MPs Weverling and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked why the award-winning Daglichtkas solar-thermal greenhouse technology was excluded from SDE+ support, what consultation with the horticulture sector preceded this, and what the consequences are for innovation and the energy transition. The minister explains that the technology was removed from the solar-thermal category since 2018 because of overstimulation risk, that the sector was consulted on the definition, and that the effects are limited but he will consider it when designing SDE++ 2020.
In my preparations for designing SDE++ 2020, I will take the application of solar thermal in greenhouses as a specific point of attention.
In mijn voorbereidingen voor de vormgeving van de SDE++ 2020 zal ik de toepassing van zonthermie in kassen als specifiek aandachtspunt meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Asscher inzake het bericht “Met nieuwe PBL-cijfers daalt CO2-boete naar nul”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether, under the proposed bonus-malus system for industrial CO2 emissions, industry would pay no fine at current ETS price forecasts, and why the industry table did not use updated PBL price projections. The minister confirmed the malus could fall to zero at high ETS prices, said a new CO2 levy proposal would follow, and acknowledged citizens' concerns about energy and climate policy costs.
Once the decision-making on this proposal is complete, I will inform the House about it.
Zodra de besluitvorming over dit voorstel is afgerond zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Agnes Mulder over de ramingen en beleidsinformatie aangeleverd door het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL)

Two MPs (Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Mulder) asked about discrepancies between PBL energy projections (NEV 2017, updated analysis) and CBS consumption figures, PBL forecasting accuracy, model transparency and uncertainty margins. The minister answered that the gaps stem from differing assumptions, that the government does not doubt PBL's information, that PBL publishes its models and uncertainty ranges, and that he is working with PBL, CBS and NIBUD to improve communication about household energy bills.
I share the importance of public and verifiable models.
Ik deel het belang van openbare en toetsbare modellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht “Met nieuwe PBL-cijfers daalt CO2-boete naar nul” in NRC Handelsblad

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the proposed CO2 malus in the Climate Agreement could fall to zero if the EU ETS price rises, and whether a CO2 tax on top of ETS would avoid this. The minister confirmed the malus could become zero under the minimum-price design, said the cabinet will present a new CO2 levy proposal, and did not commit to re-running the PBL analysis with different assumptions.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Moorlag over de gevolgen van faillissementen van energiebedrijven voor consumenten

An MP asked the minister about consumer losses from energy supplier bankruptcies (Robin Energie, EnergieFlex), whether a guarantee fund should be created, and whether consumer protection should be strengthened. The minister said supply continuity and licensing with financial checks already protect consumers, and rejected a guarantee fund for risk-shifting and cost reasons while promising to examine extra licensing requirements and monitoring in the Energiewet 1.0.

I have no information about the average amount customers of the bankrupt energy companies Robin Energie and Energieflex may have lost, and I have no insight into how the estates of both bankrupt companies are distributed.

Ik heb geen informatie over het gemiddelde bedrag dat de klanten van de inmiddels failliete energiebedrijven Robin Energie en Energieflex mogelijk zijn misgelopen en ik heb geen inzicht in de boedelverdeling van de beide failliete bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het stoppen van het project “Heft in Eigen Hand” of “Eigen Initiatief”

MPs Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the Heft in Eigen Hand / Eigen Initiatief project was halted for about 250 households, and how it affects people's control over their homes in Groningen, including NAM and CVW involvement and wellbeing. The Minister replied that Eigen Initiatief is not stopped but has no follow-up for now because it does not fit the risk-based reinforcement approach, and committed to explore with the region whether owner-led reinforcement can be fitted within conditions.

Together with the stakeholders in the region I want to work out within which conditions a form of reinforcement under own management can be realised, as I also promised your House during the committee meeting on mining.

Samen met de belanghebbenden in de regio wil ik uitwerken binnen welke randvoorwaarden een vorm van versterking in eigen beheer gerealiseerd kan worden, zoals ik uw Kamer ook heb toegezegd tijdens het AO mijnbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de voortdurende belemmeringen die de aansluiting van kleinschalige duurzame energieprojecten op het elektriciteitsnetwerk blokkeren

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid connection bottlenecks blocking small renewable projects, such as a football club's solar panels, and about giving priority to small initiatives and local ownership. The minister said the grid operator must act non-discriminatorily, that work on connection-capacity solutions is ongoing with ACM and grid operators, and that the local 50% ownership target is a general aim still being worked out.
Together with ACM and grid operators, I am working on solution directions for the bottlenecks around connection and transport capacity.
Samen met ACM en netbeheerders werk ik aan oplossingsrichtingen uit voor de knelpunten rondom de aansluit- en transportcapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Ziengs en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Planbureau rommelt’

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the PBL environmental agency's published claims about meat, climate and nitrogen emissions were accurate, and whether policy had been based on flawed PBL data. The government answered that PBL's independence and quality are safeguarded, that the 25-40% reduction concerns agriculture-related emissions only, and that it knows of no cases where policy was based on incorrect PBL data.
In my view, the above sufficiently safeguards independence and quality now and in the future.
Het bovenstaande waarborgt in mijn ogen nu en in de toekomst voldoende de onafhankelijkheid en kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over houtstook als grootste bron van kankerverwekkende stoffen (PAK’s) in het oppervlaktewater

MP Akerboom asked whether the government will act on Deltares findings that domestic wood burning is the largest source of carcinogenic PAHs in surface water, and how this squares with ISDE and SDE+ subsidies for biomass. The Secretary of State says she supports reducing wood-burning emissions and lists measures (stove alert, emission measurement, information material, earlier Ecodesign limits), while defending SDE+ biomass support and promising an ISDE evaluation.
Based on this evaluation, a decision will be made on whether it is desirable to continue the subsidy for renewable heat based on biomass after the current scheme ends (2020).
Op basis van deze evaluatie zal de afweging worden gemaakt of het wenselijk is om de subsidie voor hernieuwbare warmte op basis van biomassa na afloop van de huidige regeling (2020) voort te zetten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL) “rommelt met de cijfers en de impact van het eten van vlees op het klimaat overdrijft”

MPs Geurts and Agnes Mulder asked about reports that the PBL overstated the climate impact of meat eating, following objections from Stichting Agri Facts, and whether the Chambers were informed of shortcomings. The minister confirmed the PBL corrected a web publication wording, rejected the claim of shortcomings and said no changes to the Klimaatakkoord calculations are needed.
Based on the objections raised by Stichting Agri Facts and the PBL's response, I have not been able to identify any shortcomings and therefore do not endorse the Foundation's claim.

Op grond van de door de Stichting Agri Facts aangedragen bezwaren en de reactie van het PBL daarop heb ik geen tekortkomingen kunnen constateren en onderschrijf ik de stelling van de Stichting dus niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Sportclubs moeten verduurzaming aantonen’

MPs of the VVD asked the ministers about a requirement that large sports clubs report energy-saving measures by 1 July 2019, with possible fines, and whether clubs run by volunteers should be exempted to avoid higher membership fees. The minister confirmed the reporting duty and its enforcement by municipalities, pointed to support from sports federations and De Groene Club, and said municipalities decide on fines and usually give time to comply.
Sports clubs with questions about the reporting duty can turn to their own sports federation or to De Groene Club.
Sportverenigingen met vragen over de informatieplicht kunnen terecht bij de eigen sportbond of bij De Groene Club.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over de grafietregen bij Wijk aan Zee

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Moorlag asked the state secretary and ministers about graphite dust nuisance from Tata Steel and Harsco near Wijk aan Zee, the status of the criminal investigation, and what could be done to end the nuisance. The government answered that the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority with enforcement instruments, that Harsco was ordered under a penalty to stop the emissions, that it will not comment on ongoing criminal investigations, and that it will send a letter to parliament around May.
As you know, the cabinet does not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Zoals u bekend is doet het kabinet geen uitspraken over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber, Agnes Mulder, Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Stress door gasellende in bevingsgebied neemt toe’

MPs asked the minister about reports that gas-extraction stress in the Groningen earthquake area is rising, the need for psychological care funding, and NAM liability for immaterial damage. The minister acknowledged the mental health problem, pointed to ending gas extraction, independent damage and reinforcement processes, regional support programmes, and said he will await the outcome of pending court proceedings on immaterial damage.
I am awaiting the outcome of the court proceedings.
Ik wacht de uitkomst van de gerechtelijke procedures af.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Moorlag over honderden miljoenen die volgens de SER Overijssel nodig zouden zijn om de klappen van de veranderende arbeidsmarkt voor mbo’ers op te vangen

MPs Van den Hul and Moorlag asked the ministers whether SER Overijssel's claims about job losses from digitalisation and the hundreds of millions needed to retrain mbo graduates are accurate. Minister Van Engelshoven answered that jobs both disappear and emerge, cannot confirm the 230 million euro estimate, and pointed to joint government-business efforts and a forthcoming Leven Lang Ontwikkelen letter.
The amount of 230 million euro that is mentioned is an estimate that I cannot confirm.
Het bedrag van 230 miljoen euro dat wordt genoemd is een schatting die ik niet kan bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het vervangen van asbestdaken voor zonnepanelen

PvdA MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether projects like Essent's 'Dakvrienden', where an energy company funds asbestos roof removal in exchange for solar panels, should be encouraged and extended to farms and private homeowners. Minister Wiebes replied that the government supports combining asbestos removal with sustainability, will examine whether support is needed, and that such private-homeowner models are for energy companies to consider, noting solar is not profitable on every roof.
Initiatives that combine the removal of asbestos roofs with sustainability are shared as good examples within the programmatic approach, and it is being examined whether support is needed.

Initiatieven die het saneren van asbestdaken combineren met verduurzaming worden in het kader van de programmatische aanpak gedeeld als goed voorbeeld en er wordt onderzocht of ondersteuning nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de klimaatplannen van grote luchtvaartmaatschappijen falen, o.a. in relatie tot de recente aankoop van aandelen Air France-KLM

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether a Transition Pathway Initiative study showing airlines' climate plans fall short, and the Dutch state's purchase of Air France-KLM shares, are compatible with climate policy, and how the state as shareholder will act. The minister answered that the study's conclusions apply broadly but the government will pursue international aviation climate measures, rejects compensation-free assumptions, and states the shareholding serves public economic interests such as Schiphol's network rather than climate goals, with climate weighed in the forthcoming Luchtvaartnota.
Climate challenges have played no direct role.
Klimaatopgaven hebben geen directe rol gespeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat de productie van de Mini naar Nederland verplaatst zou kunnen gaan worden

An MP asked the economy minister whether Nederland should pursue relocation of MINI production from the UK to the Netherlands after a BMW executive hinted at this in a no-deal Brexit scenario, and what tools exist to attract such investment. The minister said Brexit is negative for the Dutch economy but acquisition opportunities exist, described NFIA support for foreign investors, and declined to speculate on Brexit outcomes while promising to act if concrete opportunities arise.
I will not speculate on the outcome of the Brexit negotiations and the consequences companies attach to them.
Ik ga niet speculeren over de uitkomst van de Brexit-onderhandelingen en de consequenties die bedrijven daar aan verbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘Nederland onderaan EU-lijst duurzame energie’

MP Sienot asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Netherlands ranking last on EU renewable energy, proposals to add SDE+ subsidy for asbestos-roof solar, support for collective solar, grid capacity limits, foreign projects via the Joint Project Mechanism, and accelerating Climate Agreement measures. The minister acknowledged the gap to the 14% target, rejected a separate subsidy and some proposals while promising a letter on foreign projects and reporting on grid measures.
I am positive about that, provided it leads to a lower required subsidy per kWh and therefore less subsidy.
Ik sta daar positief tegenover, mits dit leidt tot een lagere benodigde subsidie per kWh en daardoor minder subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over Pallas en het Lighthouse project

MP Van der Lee asked whether the Jules Horowitz and FRM-II reactors could supply large shares of the European medical isotope market, whether Pallas lacks financiers and cannot produce before 2025, and whether the government unfairly favoured Pallas over Lighthouse. The State Secretary answered that the new reactors' capacity is well below existing reactors, that Pallas is not expected to produce before 2025, that Lighthouse received only facilitation because private investors judged the technical risk too high, and that backing both projects was judged the right course.
I am of the view that at that time it was not wise to make a choice between the two initiatives.
Ik ben van mening dat het op dat moment niet verstandig was om een keuze te maken tussen beide initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Hijink over de zorg in het aardbevingsgebied

SP MPs asked about strain on healthcare in the Groningen earthquake area, including uncertainty over reinforcement of care buildings, staff stress, sick-leave data and the status of the care plan. The minister replied that the Groninger Zorgakkoord was signed, that support coaches are provided for care staff, that no sick-leave figures exist specifically for the area, and that reinforcement costs are borne by NAM.
There are no known figures on sick leave in care and welfare specifically in the earthquake area.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het ziekteverzuim in zorg en welzijn specifiek in het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het beoordelen van woningen in Groningen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the figures in an internal memo on assessment capacity for Groningen earthquake-reinforcement homes differed from the January letter suggesting nearly 3,000 assessments in the first half of 2019, and whether residents would have clarity by then. The Minister replied that the January letter did not intend to suggest 3,000 assessments in that period, that capacity constraints and regional planning were involved, and that the government aims for 4,000 assessments per year from 2020 with an acceleration plan, while promising to inform the House of significant setbacks.
In that context, the national government and the regions acknowledged that undesirable waiting times arise for residents because intake capacity is greater than assessment capacity.
Daarbij is door Rijk en Regio onderkend dat ongewenste wachttijd voor bewoners ontstaat, omdat de opnamecapaciteit groter is dan de beoordelingscapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de afwijkende metingen bij de versnellingsmeters van KNMI

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked why the KNMI kept quiet for months about deviating accelerometer readings in Groningen, what the errors mean for the HRA model, damage assessment and public trust, and whether the measurement network will be expanded. The ministers say the errors were reported late, that KNMI's hazard maps are not affected, that an evaluation, a working group and an audit are underway, and that they cannot answer by 5 March.
We regret that the KNMI did not report the identified deviations in a timely manner.
Wij betreuren het dat het KNMI niet tijdig een melding heeft gemaakt van de geconstateerde afwijkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het bericht ‘Reactie PBL op gebruik NEV-cijfers en modellen’

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether ministries and the PBL can inspect and run the private Carbontax model, whether it has been externally validated, and what the government has spent on it. The government answered that ministries and PBL have only general knowledge of the model, that it is owned by Revnext and cannot be made public, that it is the only suitable model for the analysis, and it offered a technical briefing while listing the commissioned studies and costs.
The CARbontax model is not owned by the state but is intellectual property of Revnext, therefore it is not for the state to make it public.
Het CARbontax-model is geen eigendom van het Rijk maar is intellectueel eigendom van Revnext, daarom is het niet aan het Rijk om het openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over de positie van de civiele rechter bij de mijnbouwschade in Groningen en de toegang tot het recht

MPs Van Nispen and Beckerman asked whether the draft bill moving earthquake damage claims from civil courts to administrative law (Instituut Mijnbouwschade) weakens Groningen residents' access to justice, and what is being done to make civil justice more accessible. Minister Wiebes replied that the bill is still with the Raad van State for advice, that administrative appeal is low-threshold, that the TCMG and a 200,000 euro fund for test cases are in place, and that the civil justice reform programme and an experiment law are planned.

The bill establishing the Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen is currently with the Council of State's Advisory Division for advice. For this reason I cannot anticipate discussions touching on the content of the bill.

Het wetsvoorstel Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen ligt op dit moment voor advies voor aan de Afdeling Advisering van de Raad van State. Om die reden kan ik nu niet vooruitlopen op discussies die aan de inhoud van het wetsvoorstel raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over de berichten dat verschillende buitenlandse steden een klimaatnoodtoestand hebben uitgeroepen

MPs Van Raan and Van Kooten-Arissen asked whether the government would explain the effects of cities such as Basel, Vancouver and London declaring a climate emergency on local and national powers, and whether Dutch municipalities and provinces could declare one too. The minister answered that such declarations are symbolic with no transfer or widening of powers, that Dutch law has no rules for them, and that a climate emergency declaration would not affect the forthcoming package of CO2 measures.
In none of the cities does declaring the climate emergency widen or transfer powers of local or national governments.
In geen van de steden worden door het uitroepen van de klimaatnoodtoestand bevoegdheden van de lokale of nationale overheden verruimd of overgeheveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de marktstabiliteitsreserve en het annuleren van emissierechten bij sluiting van kolencentrales

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the waterbed effect in the EU ETS, the Market Stability Reserve, and whether closing coal plants and cancelling emission allowances is still worthwhile. The minister answered that the waterbed effect partly returns in phase 4, that coal phase-out timing is set out in a forthcoming bill, and that cancelling allowances has reduced effect but comes at significant cost.
The bill and the explanatory memorandum will be submitted to your House shortly.
Het wetsvoorstel en de memorie van toelichting zullen op korte termijn bij uw Kamer aanhangig worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het bericht dat China geen zonne- en windenergieprojecten meer zal steunen

Baudet asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that China will stop supporting solar and wind projects unless they are cheaper than coal, and about the implications for global CO2 emissions and Dutch coal plant closures. Minister Wiebes answers that China's subsidy cuts aimed to slow grid-overloading growth, that global emissions effects depend on many factors, and gives Dutch and Chinese coal and CO2 figures, plus an estimate of the Dutch coal ban's modest effect.
The proposed ban on the use of coal makes an important contribution to this.
Het voorgenomen verbod op het gebruik van kolen levert hier een belangrijke bijdrage aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het schenden van regels van zoutbedrijven bij diesel in de ondergrond

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about salt companies Nedmag and Nouryon violating rules on using diesel in underground salt caverns, why this surfaced late, whether tighter supervision and penalties apply, whether the safety reports will be shared, and whether salt mining should be curtailed or phased out. The minister confirms enforcement is underway, explains REACH registration failures, says criminal sanctions are for the prosecutor, refuses to halt or phase out mining, and promises to inform parliament after SodM's assessment.
I will inform your House of this assessment by SodM.
Ik zal uw Kamer over dit oordeel van SodM informeren.
Antwoord op ragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Week zonder vlees

An MP asked the Minister whether the government promoted the 'Week zonder vlees' and whether it would reduce meat in its own dinners, citing climate and externality costs of meat. The answer, given as a reference to an earlier Aanhangsel and without substantive content on the questions, does not address the specific questions.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2019Z03356, on a week without meat, have been answered by way of Aanhangsel Handelingen, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1896.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD), vraagnummer 2019Z03356 , inzake een week zonder vlees, zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1896 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat ruim 3.200 Belgische wetenschappers en academici de klimaatstakers groot gelijk geven

Van Raan (PvdD) asked whether Dutch climate policy has caused public concern, whether the government endorses the Scientists4Climate call for stronger climate ambition, and whether it will strengthen its own targets. Minister Wiebes answered that the government shares the concern, meets Youth for Climate, supports the call for structural measures, and sees no need to raise Dutch targets since its own goals already exceed those proposed.
No, that is not necessary, because the Scientists4Climate movement sets lower targets for 2030 and 2050 than the cabinet.
Nee, dat is niet nodig, want de beweging Scientists4Climate hanteert lagere doelen voor 2030 en 2050 dan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over slecht geïsoleerde particuliere huurwoningen

MP Beckerman (SP) asked ministers about poorly insulated private rental homes, high energy-label shares, rent freezes, and subsidies for private and corporate rentals above the liberalisation limit. Minister Ollongren answered that tenants already have legal routes (courts, rent commission, right of initiative under art. 7:243 BW), that data on maintenance and insulation are not yet available, and that subsidy options await the integrated Klimaatakkoord package.
Once the research results are available, the Chamber will be informed about them.
Zodra de onderzoeksresultaten beschikbaar zijn wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over vorderingen van de Belastingdienst inzake schadevergoedingen gaswinningsschade

MPs Beckerman and Leijten asked whether the Tax Authority taxes part of earthquake damage compensation paid to entrepreneurs and households, and whether this is fair. The minister answered that compensation for lost business income is taxed as business profit while costs of repair can be deducted, that damage compensation for private persons is generally not taxed except via box 3 wealth, and that no separate fiscal policy is planned.
I cannot respond substantively to a situation that is not described in more detail.
Ik kan niet inhoudelijk reageren op een niet nader beschreven situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat sportclubs tegenwerking ervaren bij verduurzaming

An MP asks whether uncertainty about the replacement of net metering (salderingsregeling) and the timing of a new support scheme is deterring sports clubs from investing in solar panels, and what the government will do. The minister acknowledges the need for certainty, says a concrete proposal is targeted for Q1 2019 with a start on 1 January 2021, and says the sports-sector consultation will be handled by another minister.
It is my aim to present a concrete worked-out proposal for the transformation of the net metering scheme by the end of the first quarter of 2019.
Het is mijn streven om aan het einde van het eerste kwartaal van 2019 met een concreet uitgewerkt voorstel voor de omvorming van de salderingsregeling te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Vermillion die bij Woerden naar olie wil boren

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether Vermilion's planned second well near Woerden has been licensed, where similar gas-injection oil extraction occurs, what the effects on soil and drinking water are, and whether Vermilion has a fund to cover damage. The Minister answers that no revised production plan or environmental permit has yet been submitted, that the technique is used abroad but not in the Netherlands, that environmental and safety assessments apply at the plan stage, and that a national damage protocol and Waarborgfonds cover any shortfall.
Vermilion has currently not submitted an updated production plan to me, nor applied for an environmental permit for extracting oil or gas in the Papekopveld.
Vermilion heeft op dit moment bij mij geen geactualiseerd winningsplan ingediend of een omgevingsvergunning aangevraagd voor de winning van aardolie of aardgas in het Papekopveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Dik-Faber, Sienot en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de metingen van het KNMI in de Groninger bodem niet kloppen

Four MPs asked the minister about reports that KNMI seismic acceleration measurements in Groningen were miscalibrated, covering the cause, when officials and SodM were informed, effects on hazard maps and damage assessment, and whether trust and oversight are affected. The minister answered in detail on the timeline and the KNMI error, said data are usable after correction, and committed to an SodM audit and an evaluation of KNMI's internal processes.
SodM is having an independent audit carried out on the quality of the KNMI's measured ground accelerations.
SodM laat een onafhankelijke audit uitvoeren op de kwaliteit van de gemeten grondversnellingen van het KNMI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over de stijgende energierekening

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked why the cabinet's estimate of a 108 euro rise in household energy bills differs from the CBS figure of 334 euro, and whether the cabinet will correct its distributional and purchasing-power estimates using CPB findings. The minister attributes most of the gap to market price assumptions and differing energy-use assumptions, says current inflation data give no reason to doubt the purchasing-power figures, and promises a CPB analysis of the Klimaatakkoord income effects and to improve information with PBL, CBS and others.
The cabinet considers it important to keep a clear view of how energy costs affect different households.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om goed zicht te houden hoe de energielasten neerslaan bij verschillende huishoudens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Agnes Mulder, Sienot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Ministerie erkent blunder met energierekening: Tweede Kamer boos’

MPs from VVD, D66, ChristenUnie and CDA asked why the government had used outdated 2017 PBL projections of household energy bills, which underestimated rising prices, and what the consequences are for the 2019 budget, koopkracht and the Klimaatakkoord analysis. Minister Wiebes acknowledges the government should have been less categorical and that the PBL did not update its outlook in 2018, attributes the price rise to market developments and existing policy, and promises a new PBL estimate within weeks.
The cabinet should have been less categorical at the end of last year and should have stressed more that this was a 2017 estimate.
Het kabinet had zich eind vorig jaar minder stellig moeten uitlaten en meer moeten benadrukken dat het hier ging om een raming uit 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Kröger en Renkema over het rapport ‘Last Gasp: The coal companies making Europe sick’

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about a report attributing 231 premature deaths in Europe to emissions from Dutch coal plants, and asked whether the two oldest plants should close by 2020, whether the Clean Air Accord covers this, whether Germany's RWE should be pressed, and whether RIVM should study health effects further. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to a planned legal ban on coal for electricity by 2029 (2024 for the oldest plants), said the Clean Air Accord considers power-sector emissions, reported intensified dialogue with Germany, and declined extra RIVM research.
The cabinet aims for a permanent improvement of air quality, so as to reduce health risks from air pollution.
Het kabinet streeft naar een permanente verbetering van de luchtkwaliteit, om zo te komen tot een vermindering van gezondheidsrisico's door luchtverontreiniging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Sienot over het bericht 'Zakt het warmtetarief als het losgekoppeld wordt van gas?'

Two MPs asked the minister whether heat tariffs rise with gas prices, whether decoupling them from gas would lower prices, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that tariffs are capped by a gas reference but not mandatory, that decoupling would likely raise prices on average for now, and that no clear alternative has been identified yet, with further study planned in the Warmtewet 2.0 process.
As part of preparing the next amendment of the Heat Act, I am having possible alternatives to the gas reference mapped out.
In het kader van de voorbereiding van de volgende wijziging van de Warmtewet laat ik mogelijke alternatieven voor de gasreferentie in kaart brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bezoek van de topman van Air France-KLM

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether ministers discussed declining public support for aviation, climate targets and possible aviation shrinkage with the Air France-KLM CEO during his January 2019 visit. The government confirmed the meeting covered the network, public interests and agreements, and said climate and safety were not discussed at group level but are raised regularly with KLM and Transavia.
These topics were not discussed at Air France-KLM group level in this meeting.
Deze onderwerpen zijn in dit gesprek op Air France-KLM groepsniveau niet aan de orde geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Plannen voor zonne-energie smelten als sneeuw voor de zon omdat het net volstroomt’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid congestion threatening solar energy projects and the risk that SDE+ subsidised projects cannot connect in time. The minister acknowledges that grid reinforcement takes time, explains RVO's feasibility checks, and points to joint work with grid operators, ACM and regional energy strategies (RES) as remedies.
I am examining with ACM and the grid operators which solution is appropriate for timely investment and whether the regulations should be amended for that.
Ik onderzoek met ACM en de netbeheerders welke oplossing passend is voor tijdig investeren en of de regelgeving daarvoor gewijzigd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de berichten ‘Waarschuwing: geen nieuwe zonneparken, het net kan het niet aan’ en ‘Groot probleem: voetbalclub wil zonnepanelen maar krijgt deksel op neus‘

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid capacity shortages blocking solar projects and a football club's solar installation, and whether the EDS subsidy's one-year realisation rule is unfair. The minister acknowledged the problem, said the ministry is examining solutions with ACM and grid operators, and noted extensions are possible in exceptional cases and the club may use the successor BOSA scheme.
I am examining with ACM and the grid operators which solution is appropriate for timely investment and whether the regulations should be changed for that.
Ik onderzoek met ACM en de netbeheerders welke oplossing passend is voor tijdig investeren en of de regelgeving daarvoor gewijzigd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het tekort aan aansluitcapaciteit voor duurzame energie-initiatieven

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid connection shortages hindering renewable energy projects, including whether small rooftop solar should get priority over large commercial farmland projects. The minister acknowledged the grid strain, outlined planned investments and locality checks via Regional Energy Strategies, defended technology-neutral SDE+ allocation, and declined a priority rule for small projects citing non-discrimination law.
Grid operators currently may not distinguish between applicants; they may not discriminate, in accordance with Article 23(2) of the Electricity Act 1998.
Netbeheerders mogen nu geen onderscheid maken tussen aanvragers, zij mogen niet discrimineren, conform artikel 23, tweede lid, Elektriciteitswet 1998.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Tekort aan stroomkabels voor grote hoeveelheid zonne-energie’

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether grid operators could get earlier access to wind and solar site locations, and whether relaxing the N-1 grid redundancy requirement from 99.9% to 99% would speed up connecting renewables. The minister said investment and location checks are being explored with ACM and grid operators, that the N-1 rule can be waived by general administrative order, and that a relaxation is under review without committing to a specific change.
I am investigating with ACM and the grid operators which solution is suitable for timely investment and whether the regulations should be amended for this.
Ik onderzoek met ACM en de netbeheerders welke oplossing passend is voor tijdig investeren en of de regelgeving daarvoor gewijzigd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Geurts over gevolgen van het gebrek aan netcapaciteit voor duurzame energieprojecten in Drenthe, Groningen en Overijssel

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about consequences of grid capacity shortages in Drenthe, Groningen and Overijssel for solar projects holding SDE+ subsidies that cannot connect to the grid, and whether realisation deadlines can be suspended. The minister replied that RVO can grant one year's extension case by case, that grid investment and location checks via Regional Energy Strategies are being pursued, and that talks with grid operators and ACM are ongoing.
RVO.nl has the option to grant one year's postponement of the realisation deadline from the subsidy's start date.
RVO.nl heeft de mogelijkheid om één jaar uitstel van de realisatietermijn te verlenen op de ingangsdatum van de subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel 'Boorlocatie Ameland weggespoeld, vrees voor vervuiling'

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a storm washing contaminated soil from the Hollum drilling site on Ameland into the sea, why remediation took so long, and whether NAM has enough capacity to clean up old sites. The minister confirmed the contamination with diesel and barium, explained the site had been monitored and remediation planned since 2016, declined to provide a nationwide list of unremediated sites, and said there was no indication of insufficient NAM capacity.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de NAM die de uitspraak van de Arbiter Bodembeweging niet uitvoert

MP Beckerman asks the minister why NAM does not comply with Arbiter Bodembeweging rulings on Groningen gas-damage claims, including a case where a resident waited a year for compensation, and whether a general pardon is warranted. The minister says NAM generally complies, that only one case involved fundamental objections, that the matters are individual, and that no general pardon is needed since the remaining claims are still before the arbiter.
Furthermore, it is not appropriate for me to address individual cases that are or have been before the arbiter.
Verder past het mij niet om in te gaan op individuele zaken die bij de arbiter in behandeling zijn of zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van der Lee over de afvalwaterinjectie in de voormalige gasvelden in Twente

MPs Mulder (CDA) and Van der Lee (GroenLinks) asked why NAM keeps injecting produced wastewater from Schoonebeek into former gas fields in Twente rather than treating it, and whether NAM complies with its injection permits. The minister replies that the 2015-2016 six-yearly evaluation found injection still the most suitable method, that NAM will test new purification technologies at a planned test facility, and that SodM is reviewing NAM's technical evaluation report and reports NAM complies with permit conditions.
The State Supervision of Mines (SodM) supervises NAM's water injection.
Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) houdt toezicht op de waterinjectie van NAM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de aardbeving in het zoutwinningsgebied bij Veendam

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether the government is studying the effects of a 1.3 magnitude quake near Veendam on salt caverns, whether gas-induced quakes could cause collapse or leakage, whether salt mining should be reconsidered, and whether the precautionary principle requires ending salt mining. Minister Wiebes answered that such a small quake is not expected to harm the caverns, that risks were assessed by SodM and TNO, that licences need not be reconsidered now, and that new knowledge would lead to additional conditions where warranted.

If new insights arise about the risks of salt mining, I will examine whether this gives reason to impose additional conditions on mining plans, and SodM will supervise whether the companies concerned take adequate measures.

Als nieuwe inzichten ontstaan over de risico's van zoutwinning, dan zal ik bezien of dit aanleiding geeft tot het stellen van aanvullende voorwaarden voor winningsplannen en zal SodM toezien op het nemen van adequate maatregelen door de betreffende bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de beantwoording van vragen inzake het lekken van gif door de NAM en het bericht ‘Metingen NAM-lek ver boven grens’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about gas condensate leaks by the NAM at Delfzijl, measurement levels, prior incidents, safety rules and possible unreported incidents. The Minister answered that the Veiligheidsregio and SodM are responsible for measurements and inspections, that the criminal investigation is with the Openbaar Ministerie, and that a NAM exposure study is due by 1 February 2019, while acknowledging the Veiligheidsregio initially did not apply the RIVM advisory value.
The Public Prosecution Service leads the criminal investigation. I have no insight into the status or progress of this investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie geeft leiding aan het strafrechtelijk onderzoek. Ik heb geen inzicht in de status of de voortgang van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Miljoenen liters pekelwater weggelekt’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a leak of several million litres of brine from a Nedmag pipeline in Veendam, which was discovered late and possibly caused by heavy traffic and drought. The minister answered that the province of Groningen is the competent authority for this installation, that Nedmag must pay for damage and will replace weak pipe sections, but declined to investigate causes beyond the province's role.
With regard to Nedmag's mining activities, I am the competent authority and the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) is the supervisor.
Ten aanzien van de mijnbouwactiviteiten van Nedmag ben ik het bevoegd gezag en is Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat er miljoenen liters pekelwater zijn weggelekt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that millions of litres of brine leaked from a Nedmag pipeline, including whether diesel was released, the environmental impact, monitoring, whether Nedmag should be placed under intensified supervision, and how residents were informed. The minister answered that the leak is not a mining activity, so the province of Groningen and its Omgevingsdienst are the competent authority and supervisor, that no diesel was released, that Nedmag must investigate contamination and repairs and replacement are underway, and that the province sees no reason for intensified supervision.
With regard to Nedmag's mining activities, I am the competent authority and the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) is the supervisor.
Ten aanzien van de mijnbouwactiviteiten van Nedmag ben ik het bevoegd gezag en is Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat Nedmag maximaal zout mag winnen

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Nedmag's revised salt-mining plan, subsidence of 95 cm, the April 2018 leak, new drilling, diesel use and objection rights. The minister said the plan is still under technical review by SodM, TNO and Tcbb, that a 95 cm subsidence is not allowed under the current plan, that objections are possible via a draft decision and a zienswijze procedure, and that absolute safety cannot be guaranteed.
The advice of SodM and all other advisers will be taken into account in my approval decision on this amended mining plan.
Het advies van SodM en alle andere adviseurs zal ik meenemen in mijn instemmingsbesluit op dit gewijzigde winningsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geleijnse over het bericht dat de energierekening volgend jaar fors stijgt

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports that household energy bills would rise sharply in 2019, and whether the State Secretary's figures were outdated or inaccurate. The Minister defends the Netherlands Energy Outlook (NEV) 2017 as the government's baseline, acknowledges that 2019 tariffs may come in higher, and says a review of the levy burden will follow.
To this end, the cabinet has announced a review of the distribution of the burden of the SDE levy between households and businesses.
Daartoe heeft het kabinet een verkenning aangekondigd naar de lastenverdeling in de ODE tussen huishoudens en bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de gestegen kosten voor het gebruik van warmte

MP Moorlag asks the minister whether heat tariffs rising in 2019 due to coupling to gas prices and energy taxes should be decoupled, arguing this penalises heat-network customers who do not use gas. The minister rejects decoupling for now, keeps the gas reference for maximum heat tariffs, relies on ACM's return monitoring to correct excessive returns, and commissions research on alternatives for the next Heat Act amendment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Schadelijke lekkage dreigt bij alle duurzame aardwarmteprojecten in Nederland'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports of possible leakage at geothermal projects, its environmental effects, the need for more investment, and whether households would face higher heat prices. The minister acknowledged the sector's technical challenges, said no contamination had been confirmed yet, pointed to SodM supervision and a forthcoming RIVM risk study, and stated that heat prices for end users are capped by a gas reference.
Based on the RIVM report, which will be published this month, SodM will start an environmental programme focused on the risks.
Op basis van het RIVM-rapport, dat deze maand zal worden gepubliceerd, zal door SodM een milieuprogramma worden opgestart dat zich richt op de risico's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Geleijnse over het artikel 'Schadelijke lekkage dreigt bij duurzame aardwarmte'

MPs Van Brenk and Geleijnse asked about press reports that geothermal wells risk leakage, that three installations were already halted, and about contamination, monitoring and upcoming safety rules. The minister acknowledges the sector is young, says three operators voluntarily halted wells, notes no confirmed contamination yet, and promises new legislation, SodM requirements and forthcoming RIVM and SodM reports.
I therefore also endorse SodM's position that additional requirements for well design and monitoring must be implemented as soon as possible.
Ik onderschrijf daarom ook het standpunt van SodM dat extra eisen voor putontwerp en monitoring zo snel mogelijk geïmplementeerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een studie betreffende methaanlekkages bij oude en verlaten gaswinningsputten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a University of Utrecht study on methane leakage from abandoned gas wells, the risks, the leaking well at Monster, and whether leak costs are charged to the polluter. The minister acknowledged the risks, said the current risk is very small, outlined SodM supervision of abandonment and remediation, and committed to developing a leak-detection protocol with TNO and ECN.
SodM supervises the duty of care resting on the mining company to leave wells fully and durably sealed.
SodM houdt toezicht op de zorgplicht die rust bij het mijnbouwbedrijf om putten volledig en duurzaam afgesloten achter te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ouderen die geen gebruik kunnen maken van een gunstige financiering van energiebesparingsmaatregelen

An MP asked whether people aged 75 and over can access the Energiebespaarlening and whether this age limit should be lifted given ageing and the energy transition. The minister explained the age limit of 76 applies to the youngest applicant and that some provinces guarantee loans above 75, and said extending access for older homeowners without equity is being examined in the financing fund work.

Because it is important that older people without equity can also take part in the energy transition, I am examining what options there are to better facilitate them in pre-financing sustainability measures.

Omdat het belangrijk is dat ook ouderen zonder overwaarde mee kunnen doen aan de energietransitie, bekijk ik wat de mogelijkheden zijn om hen beter te faciliteren bij de voorfinanciering van verduurzaming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de besluiten en het proces rondom de rol van biomassa en de duurzaamheidscriteria binnen het Klimaatakkoord

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister how biomass policy and sustainability criteria are being shaped within the Climate Agreement, who decides, and how biomass is prioritised and how much it will be used. The minister answered that the Visie Biomassa 2030 was translated into the draft Climate Agreement, that an independent sustainability framework will first be drafted technically and then advised on by the SER, that the cabinet decides after consulting stakeholders, and that PBL estimates additional biomass demand of 340–570 PJ by 2030, while the timing of some answers could not be met.
The cabinet decides on the sustainability criteria for biomass.
Het kabinet beslist over de duurzaamheidscriteria voor biomassa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over mogelijke sancties van de VS op Nederlandse bedrijven

MPs Amhaouch and Agnes Mulder asked the government whether it was informed about possible US sanctions on Dutch firms involved in Nord Stream 2 and what it would do to protect them. The minister answered that the government is in regular contact with the US and EU, raises concerns about disproportionate impact, rules out a Special Purpose Vehicle for now, but gives no concrete commitments beyond continued advocacy.
The Netherlands will nevertheless continue to actively raise its concerns bilaterally and within the EU, including about the consequences for Dutch business.
Nederland blijft in bilateraal en EU-verband evenwel actief zijn zorgen onder de aandacht brengen, inclusief over de gevolgen voor het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk, Van Rooijen en Geleijnse over berichten dat de Scandinavische schuldenindustrie zich met woekerrentes richt op de Nederlandse zzp'er

Three 50PLUS MPs asked the ministers whether Scandinavian lenders charging 18% to 200% interest to Dutch self-employed people (zzp'ers) are a problem requiring a rate cap, a duty of care, AFM supervision and standard creditworthiness checks. The Finance Minister answered that the government takes such signals seriously but that the scale of the problem is unclear, so it will first map the issue and rely on the industry's self-regulatory code for now, with no concrete measures yet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over stimuleringsmaatregelen voor zonnecel-dakpannen

MPs Moorlag and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked which subsidies, tax reductions and other incentives exist for solar-roof tiles beyond VAT recovery, and whether such incentives apply to them. The minister replied that the SDE+, net metering and innovation schemes apply, and that he knows of no obstacles to incentivising solar tiles.
As far as I am aware, there are no obstacles to incentivising solar energy from roof tiles under the various incentive measures.
Voor zover ik weet zijn er geen belemmeringen voor de stimulering van zonne-energie uit dakpannen in de verschillende stimuleringsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het onzekere Nederlandse vestigingsklimaat voor bedrijven door klimaatregelingen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the British chemicals firm INEOS chose Antwerp over Rotterdam for a new plant, whether Dutch climate targets were the reason, and what this means for jobs and CO2 emissions. The minister answered that INEOS cited pipeline connections and its existing Antwerp presence, not climate targets, and argued Rotterdam still offers strong opportunities for low-carbon industry.
INEOS has not disclosed how many jobs are involved with the new plant.
INEOS heeft niet bekend gemaakt hoeveel banen met de nieuwe fabriek gemoeid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Veldman over het bericht ‘Daar gaan de miljarden’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether neighbouring countries are attracting more foreign investment because of Dutch climate policy, and how carbon-leakage and competitiveness risks would be prevented. The Minister replied that Dutch investment performance is above average in Europe, that INEOS cited pipeline connections rather than climate policy, and that a level-playing-field test and PBL/CPB analysis of the draft Climate Agreement are pending.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Hoe minder kernenergie, hoe groter de opwarming'

VVD MPs Dijkhoff and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked the minister about claims that nuclear power is needed for climate targets, its place in the climate table process, the HAW report, costs, waste and the role of nuclear in Dutch policy. The minister answered that nuclear can be a cost-effective low-carbon option under current rules, that no new plant is realistic before 2030 and that no nuclear permit applications have been filed.
The Climate Agreement process is organised so that it is up to the parties at the sector tables to examine together which options can fill the CO2 reduction task.
Het proces rondom het Klimaatakkoord is zo ingericht dat het aan de partijen aan de sectortafels is om met elkaar te bekijken welke opties invulling kunnen geven aan de CO 2 -reductieopgave.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

Two PvdD MPs asked the government to react to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether ministers accept her claims about growth, fossil fuels, and intergenerational justice, and what concrete steps they will take. The government answered that the questions were answered in an appendix to the parliamentary record, referring to a separate written answer rather than addressing the substance here.
The written questions from MPs Van Raan and Akerboom (both PvdD), question number 2018Z24283, have been answered by means of Parliamentary Proceedings appendix, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom (beiden PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24283 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over gestapelde mijnbouw naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Expertmeeting' moet oplossingen bieden rond zoutwinning Nouryon en Nedmag’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about how damage from stacked mining (Groningen gas extraction plus salt mining by Nedmag and Nouryon) will be handled, including which claims body is responsible, whether the reversed burden of proof applies, timing, and the role of the National Coordinator Groningen. The Minister answered that two bodies (IMG and the Commissie Mijnbouwschade) will split claims, the reversed burden of proof applies only to Groningen gas damage, and that dismantling salt mining is not deemed necessary.
I aim to bring a bill to this effect into procedure this year.
Ik streef ernaar nog dit jaar een hiertoe strekkend wetsvoorstel in procedure te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Windindustrie verzet zich tegen betalen van huur voor zeebodem’

An MP asked whether the ground rent of 0.98 euro/MWh that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf charges offshore wind developers for the seabed is market-conform, why no EU exemption was sought, and whether it would make Hollandse Kust zuid 3 and 4 require subsidy. The minister answered that an independent valuation set the rent, that EU state-aid rules require a market-conform fee, that the business case can bear it so no exemption was requested, and that tendering without subsidy is still expected.
The amount was determined on the basis of an independent valuation that was carried out.
De hoogte is bepaald op basis van een uitgevoerde onafhankelijke taxatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Hoe energiebedrijven miljoenen stelen van klanten stadsverwarming'

MPs Yesilgöz-Zegerius (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a news report claiming heat suppliers overcharge district heating customers, questioning how the maximum 'no more than otherwise' tariff is calculated (boiler, service contract, warmtewisselaar costs and gas supplier benchmark). The minister answered that the calculation uses average, not expensive, boilers and service contracts, that the benchmark will shift to the 10 largest gas suppliers from 2020, that the ACM sets the tariff annually, and that splitting supply and network management is being studied for the Warmtewet 2.0.
Once this study is completed, I will inform the House about it.
Zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond, zal ik de Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de tarieven voor warmtelevering

MP Stoffer asked whether heat tariffs may rise by 164 euro this year due to higher gas taxes, what future gas tax increases mean for heat tariffs, and how the government will prevent heat tariffs from becoming unduly high. The minister confirmed the rise, explained that heat tariff caps follow the gas reference, and said the ACM monitors returns and the government will activate correction powers if returns prove unreasonable, while commissioning research into alternatives to the gas reference.
If necessary, I will then put into effect the provisions of the Heat Act that enable the ACM to correct any above-reasonable returns of heat suppliers in heat tariffs.

Indien noodzakelijk zal ik dan de bepalingen uit de Warmtewet in werking laten treden, die het mogelijk maken voor de ACM om eventuele hoger dan redelijke rendementen van warmteleveranciers te corrigeren in de warmtetarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over het op tijd inrichten van een keurpunt voor levende dieren voor export naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk in verband met een eventuele harde Brexit

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked whether a border inspection post for live animals imported from the UK is needed in a no-deal Brexit, whether one will be ready by 29 March 2019, and whether the government will work with business to set one up. The minister answered that no approved sea-port inspection post exists in the Netherlands or along the West European coast, that business is responsible for building one and has not yet applied, and that the government will support a solution if business takes the lead.
I am willing to work with the NVWA to facilitate business in realising a solution, if business takes the initiative to do so.
Ik ben bereid om samen met de NVWA het bedrijfsleven te faciliteren bij het realiseren van een oplossing, als het bedrijfsleven daar het initiatief daarvoor neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Van der Lee en Nijboer over woningen die eerst versterkt zouden worden, maar nu veilig blijken te zijn volgens het HRA-model

MPs Beckerman, Van der Lee and Nijboer asked the minister why Groningen homes in batches 1581 and 1588, promised reinforcement under earlier motions, now appear safe under the HRA model, and how residents keep control over their homes. The minister says reinforcement continues for batch 1588, that batch 1581 is handled via prepared advice with owner choice, declines to comment on individual cases, and stresses owners have the final say while admitting uncertainty remains.
It does not befit me as Minister to publicly exchange views on an individual case.
Het past mij als Minister niet om in het openbaar van gedachten te wisselen over een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aanpak van de problemen met aardbevingen in Groningen

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Groningen earthquake response: the Gasberaad secretary's criticism that the government is ignoring the human side, slow damage settlement (up to 15 months), and the fate of the Meerjarenprogramma after Alders left. The minister says the gas extraction phase-out addresses the cause, that damage handling has moved into public hands, that the new reinforcement approach is based on Mijnraad advice, and that he will keep meeting regional representatives.
A processing time of 15 months is not acceptable to me.
Een doorlooptijd van 15 maanden vind ik niet acceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht 'Experts boos over soepeler BENG-eisen'

GroenLinks MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked why the proposed BENG energy performance requirements for nearly zero-energy buildings were softened, who lobbied for it, and what it means for the energy transition and household bills. The minister replied that the higher numerical value reflects a new calculation method rather than a weakening, listed the consulted parties and denied any lobbying, and said the figures are not comparable and that a tighter renewable-energy requirement could hurt cost-optimality.

That the numerical value is higher than in the previously proposed requirements does not mean that the BENG requirements about to be submitted for consultation are much more lenient than the previously proposed requirements.
Dat de getalswaarde hoger is dan in de eerder voorgenomen eisen betekent niet dat de BENG-eisen die binnenkort voor consultatie worden voorgelegd veel soepeler zijn dan de eerder voorgenomen eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het zogenaamde 'Afschakelplan G-gas'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the 'Afschakelplan G-gas' (gas shutdown plan) was not shared with parliament earlier, what its status is, who is responsible for gas shutdown and how the minister's responsibility is safeguarded, and how the plan handles enforcement powers, Groningen safety trade-offs and cross-border supply. The minister answered that the plan is still under development as the 'Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas', that a definitive version is expected mid-2019, that the minister is considering clarifying his own role in the regulation, and that the plan will address enforcement and cross-border effects.
Once the definitive plan is ready, I will inform your House about it.
Zodra het definitieve plan gereed is zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over woningcorporaties die het moeilijk wordt gemaakt om te verduurzamen

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked whether the minister agrees with the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties' rejection of Groninger Huis joining a solar park, and how sustainability goals can be met if such initiatives are blocked. The minister declined to comment on the individual case (under court review), said the Woningwet's proximity rule is assessed case by case, and promised an evaluation of the Woningwet in early 2019 that will examine obstacles to housing-corporation sustainability.
As legislator, it is not for BZK to respond to individual cases.
Als wetgever is het niet aan BZK om te reageren op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht dat de Zandtsters het wachten beu zijn

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that residents of Zandt are tired of waiting, and about unclear timing and amounts of budgets for damage and reinforcement operations in Groningen, including reporting by the National Coordinator Groningen. The minister acknowledged the problems, said the NAM will bear all reinforcement costs under an agreement, that budget availability must not delay safety work, and that a progress letter will follow in January.
On the precise form of this, I will enter into discussion with the NCG.
Over de precieze vormgeving hiervan ga ik met de NCG in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over het vastlopen van de versterking in Groningen

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked the minister about reported criticism of the Groningen reinforcement operation, including claims of delay tactics, staff distrust, the HRA model, financing of home inspections and inequality between municipalities. The minister denied deliberate delay, said the HRA model is only used for risk prioritisation, confirmed NAM will cover reinforcement costs, and said some schemes will be reviewed while no concrete timetable was promised.
The implementation of the reinforcement cannot, however, wait for this.
Dit uitvoering van de versterking kan hier echter niet op wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over de veiligheid van slimme gasmeters

The VVD MP Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the safety of smart gas meters, including whether unsafe meters remain in use, how they will be replaced, and whether SodM should get enforcement powers. The minister confirmed that about 1,745 meters with too-short threads remain, that replacement is underway with SodM oversight, and that SodM gains enforcement powers on 1 January 2019.

Through the amendment of the Gas Act in the Energy Transition Progress Act (wet VET), SodM receives broader enforcement powers from 1 January 2019, including the power to impose a binding order subject to a penalty on the network operator.

SodM krijgt door de wijziging van de Gaswet in de wet Voortgang Energie Transitie (wet VET) per 1 januari 2019 ruimere bevoegdheden om handhavend op te treden, waaronder ook het opleggen van een last onder dwangsom aan de netbeheerder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over de primaire energiefactor (PEF) voor elektriciteit

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders question the government's change of the primary energy factor (PEF) for electricity to 1.45, based on the NEV 2017 forecast for 2020 rather than realised performance, arguing it implies an unrealistic 69% generation efficiency and could encourage low-efficiency electric systems. Minister Wiebes defends the change as aligning the standard with the BENG requirements from 2020, rejects the claim that low-efficiency systems will be favoured, and says the PBL uses the same data in its climate agreement calculations.
The revised PEF of 1.45 has been set on the basis of realistic expectations regarding the share of renewable electricity in 2020.
De herziene PEF van 1,45 is vastgesteld op basis van realistische verwachtingen ten aanzien van het aandeel hernieuwbare elektriciteit in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht 'Drijvende zonnepanelen wekken de meeste stroom op - alleen jammer van dat subsidiefoutje'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a proposal to devote part of the IJsselmeer to floating solar panels and about the SDE+ subsidy not accounting for higher yields of sun-tracking systems. The minister acknowledged the idea, said the Rijk is studying potential on state lands and waters, and committed to allowing extra subsidy for large sun-tracking installations from SDE+ 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Veldman over de aangekondigde bouw van een scale-up staalfabriek in India door Tata Steel

MPs Yesilgöz-Zegerius and Veldman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why Tata Steel is building a scale-up steel plant in India rather than IJmuiden, and what this means for jobs, the climate agreement and carbon leakage. The minister answered that the India plant is a necessary step for the HIsarna technology, that no commitment to build it in the Netherlands existed, and that there are no job or leakage effects.
No commitment was made that the HIsarna scale-up plant would be built in the Netherlands.
Er is geen toezegging gedaan dat de scale-up fabriek voor HIsarna in Nederland gebouwd zou worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de Waarderegeling

An MP asks why the NAM Waarderegeling compensates only a 95% purchase guarantee under the Koopinstrument for houses in the Groningen earthquake area, and why 5% is not reduced, citing the Moerdijk scheme as precedent. The minister defends the 95% level as a safety net that preserves market sales incentives, and declines to revisit it.
Against this background I see no reason to adjust the purchase price of 95% of the appraised value.
Tegen deze achtergrond zie ik geen aanleiding voor aanpassing van de aankoopprijs van 95% van de getaxeerde waarde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de manier waarop pensioenfondsen de CO2-voetafdruk van hun beleggingsportefeuille berekenen en hierover intern en extern rapporteren

An MP from D66 asked how pension funds, notably ABP, calculate the CO2 footprint of their investments, in particular whether excluding scope-3 emissions gives a distorted picture and why ABP has not included them despite its participants' requests. The minister answered that scope 1 and 2 give a good picture for individual companies, that a distorted picture is never desirable but no serious distortion is currently evident, that scope 3 may be added later, and that the ABP board has primacy over investment policy within its governance structure.
The ABP board has primacy over the implementation of the pension scheme, including investment policy.
Het ABP-bestuur heeft het primaat van de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling, inclusief het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de versterking van huizen in Meedhuizen

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the news that many houses in Meedhuizen must be strengthened under the new prioritisation model, questioning its reliability, how residents were informed, and the poor communication with the local mayor. The minister answered that the HRA model is a high-quality, science-based tool used only to prioritise high-risk homes, that residents were informed by letter and a meeting, and that a second meeting is planned for January, with individual measures decided after on-site inspection.
The HRA model is regarded by both the Mijnraad and SodM as a high-quality model, based on the best scientific knowledge currently available.
Het HRA-model wordt door zowel de Mijnraad als het SodM gezien als een hoogstaand model, gebaseerd op de beste wetenschappelijke kennis die er op dit moment is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het ontwerp instemmingsbesluit gaswinningsplan voor Spijkenisse-Intra en de ontwerp omgevingsvergunning Spijkenisse-Oost

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about the draft gas extraction approval for Spijkenisse-Intra, including whether a test drilling would precede decisions, long-term effects, groundwater, noise, resident information and damage assessment. The minister answered that the field's properties are assumed similar to neighbouring fields, that a plan revision would follow if test results differ, that monitoring and a damage route exist, and that a national damage protocol is expected in March 2019.

If the outcomes of the test drilling lead to greater expected environmental effects, subsidence and seismic risk compared with the extraction plan, NAM will have to submit a revised extraction plan, on which a new approval decision must be taken.
