Als de uitkomsten uit de proefboring leiden tot grotere verwachte omgevingseffecten, bodemdaling en seismisch risico ten opzichte van het winningsplan, dan zal NAM een aangepast winningsplan moeten indienen, waarop een nieuw instemmingsbesluit moet worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over gasimport en lange termijn contracten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the Netherlands has failed to secure gas imports, given GasTerra's warning about supply risks without more long-term contracts, and whether the Groningen gas field will be closed quickly enough. The minister answered that no additional policy is needed because the TTF hub provides ample gas, that the state holds no import contracts, and that Groningen closure will be accelerated via a measures package, without new import obligations.
My assessment is that for the time being no additional policy is needed to secure the necessary gas imports.
Mijn inschatting is dat er vooralsnog geen additioneel beleid nodig is om de benodigde import van gas veilig te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de Staat in cassatie gaat in de Klimaatzaak

An MP asked whether the State's litigation spending and the costs awarded to Urgenda in the climate case were proportionate, and whether NGOs winning against the State are fairly compensated for legal costs. The Minister said costs follow fixed rules, NGOs have the same cost claims as other legal persons, the State's appeal costs are not yet budgeted, and no change to the rules is planned.
There are fixed rules for the reimbursement of legal costs. An NGO has the same entitlement to a costs award as any other legal person incurring such costs.
Er zijn vaste regels voor de vergoeding van proceskosten. Een NGO heeft dezelfde aanspraak op proceskostenvergoeding als iedere andere rechtspersoon die dergelijke kosten maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over kansen voor Nederlandse batterij-industrie

MPs from the CDA asked the government whether a German one-billion-euro battery investment, possible Dutch battery opportunities, EU state aid rules and related Dutch initiatives could be supported. The State Secretary answered that Germany's plan is national but aligned with the EU initiative, that the Netherlands is exploring battery opportunities via RVO.nl, and that talks with the Commission and a Twente R&D initiative are ongoing, without firm commitments yet.
The German initiative is not yet sufficiently developed to establish whether, and if so how, it will use European funds, and whether it will conflict with European competition rules.

Het Duitse initiatief is nog onvoldoende uitgewerkt om te kunnen vaststellen of, en zo ja, hoe het gebruik zal maken van Europese middelen, en of het ook tegen Europese mededingingsregels zal aanlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de blinde vlek van de Nederlandse overheid voor natuurvernietiging die het gevolg is van de delving van mineralen voor onze energietransitie

MP Wassenberg asked whether the government will use permits and tenders for wind and solar parks to require responsibly sourced minerals, given environmental and human rights harm from mining abroad. The minister answered that responsibility lies with companies and the government will first give an IMVO covenant for the wind sector a chance, with possible measures only if it fails, and will examine linking supply-chain due diligence reporting to permit granting.
I want to give this IMVO covenant, in which the central government also participates as a party, a chance first.
Ik wil dit IMVO-convenant, waar wij als Rijk ook als partij aan deelnemen, eerst zelf een kans geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over een olievlek bij Farmsum

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an oil spill of toxic gas condensate from the NAM tank park in Delfzijl into a sewer and waterway at Farmsum, including what happened, whether the State Supervision of Mines was notified, health risks, recurrence and cost recovery. The minister answered in detail on the cause, the notification timeline, measured benzene levels, the imposition of enhanced supervision with extra safety measures, and that all damage will be recovered from the NAM.
To prevent such incidents from happening again, SodM has placed the tank park under enhanced supervision.
Om te voorkomen dat dit soort incidenten zich nogmaals voordoen, heeft SodM het tankenpark onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de door de gemeente Delfzijl aan te leggen noodleiding bij het NAM tankenpark in Farmsum

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a temporary emergency sewer built by Delfzijl municipality around the NAM tank park in Farmsum after condensate leaked into a canal, covering who pays, what happens to the contaminated pipes and stored water, inspection frequency, quantities released and health effects, and prevention. The minister answered that NAM pays the costs, the sewer was cleaned and reopened, about 29 m3 of condensate reached the canal with limited resident exposure, and SodM imposed additional safety measures and put the site under intensified supervision.
After discovering the cause of the condensate leak, SodM ordered NAM to repair the damage.
Na het ontdekken van de oorzaak van de lekkage van het aardgascondensaat heeft SodM de NAM gesommeerd om de schade te herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de afhandeling van de aardgascondensaatlekkage in Farmsum

An MP asks the minister whether the NAM was uncooperative and denied involvement in the Farmsum condensate leak, whether it applied for extra storage without consent, and whether residents were properly informed. The minister acknowledges the water board's complaint, says SodM found no failing by the NAM on storage, and promises to hold the NAM to transparency via SodM's supervision.
The picture the dijkgraaf gave of the NAM's attitude can be taken into account by SodM and the Public Prosecution Service in the ongoing investigation.
Het beeld dat de dijkgraaf heeft gegeven over de houding van de NAM kan door SodM en het Openbaar Ministerie worden meegenomen in het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de overslaginstallatie van het bedrijf Noordgastransport in Roodeschool

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked the minister to relocate the gas condensate transshipment facility out of the centre of Roodeschool, citing livability and fairness for Groningen. The minister agreed the facility is undesirable there and offered renewed talks, but said the operator holds valid permits, the risks do not justify forced relocation, and no compensation from gas revenues will be earmarked.
I am willing to re-engage in talks with the company and the municipality about an alternative.
Ik ben bereid opnieuw het gesprek met het bedrijf en de gemeente aan te gaan over een alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het lekken van gif door de NAM in Farmsum

Beckerman (SP) asked the minister about the NAM condensate leak at the Farmsum tank park, including exposure of residents, prior SodM inspections, BRZO status, enforcement, sewer connection, health checks, and incident history. Minister Wiebes answered in detail, saying exposure was limited, SodM placed the site under heightened supervision with measures imposed on NAM, and a criminal investigation by the Openbaar Ministerie is ongoing, which he could not comment on.
The tank park is currently under heightened supervision.
Het tankenpark staat momenteel onder verscherpt toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over dreigende acties bij Tennet

An MP asked the minister about a collective bargaining impasse at TenneT, the state-owned grid operator, and possible strike actions threatening supply security. The minister answered that TenneT seeks its own company CAO, that the state as shareholder has no formal role in collective bargaining, and that safety consultations will precede any action to protect supply.
Collective bargaining is a matter between employer and employees. The shareholder has no formal role in this.
Cao-onderhandelingen zijn een zaak tussen werkgever en werknemer. De aandeelhouder heeft hierbij geen formele rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de gevolgen van een faillissement van een energieleverancier voor consumenten

An MP asked the minister about consumer consequences when energy supplier EnergieFlex went bankrupt, including whether prepaid advances are privileged, the Consumentenbond's role and liability, the licence withdrawal timing, and whether solvency requirements or a guarantee fund should apply. The minister answered that consumers have no preferential creditor status, that customers were transferred to another supplier under the security-of-supply decrees, that Consumentenbond liability is a matter for contract law, and that solvency is checked only at licensing.
The handling of the EnergieFlex bankruptcy is still ongoing.
De afhandeling van het faillissement van EnergieFlex loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Akerboom over de pilot omgevingsmanagement gericht op de aardgaswinning onder de Waddenzee bij Ternaard

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about a pilot on local stakeholder involvement for gas extraction under the Wadden Sea near Ternaard, a UNESCO site, including why island municipalities were not involved and whether national and international interests or local support could halt the project. The minister explained the pilot aims to test participation instruments, that the municipality of Ameland declined to join, that the Hand aan de Kraan principle and the Structuurvisie Waddenzee set limits, and that local support is assessed at the end of the process without a simple yes/no veto.
Determining local support is not a simple yes or no regarding the proposed gas extraction.
Bij het vaststellen van lokaal draagvlak gaat het niet om een eenvoudig ja of nee met betrekking tot de voorgestelde gaswinning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Windparkbouwers vrezen tulpenmanie als Wiebes gaat veilen’

A GroenLinks MP asked Minister Wiebes about reports that offshore wind developers feared a tulip-mania-style auction and about the choice between SDE+ subsidies, two-way contracts for difference and auctions with price floors under the Wind Energy at Sea Act. The minister answered that the bill adds comparative-test and auction routes, that a subsidy or guarantee cannot be used for projects that would proceed without it, that CfD would require a separate legal basis, and that post-2025 budget decisions are for future cabinets.
The bill amending the Wind Energy at Sea Act supports the plans for rolling out offshore wind energy until 2030.
Het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Wet windenergie op zee ondersteunt de plannen voor de uitrol van windenergie op zee tot 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een windmolenpark in Drenthe

Mr Moorlag (PvdA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why a Drenthe wind park was permitted at 175.5 MW with 45 turbines, when the policy target was about 150 MW, and whether the turbine count could be reduced despite local opposition. The Minister answered that the chosen turbine type fits the permitted power bandwidth, that the Commission for EIA advice was considered, and that the permits are now final after a Council of State ruling, so reopening the park's size is not possible.

As I indicated during the debate with your House on 8 November 2018, from the perspective of legal certainty and a reliable government I see no possibility of now reopening the size of the wind park for discussion.

Zoals ik tijdens het debat met uw Kamer op 8 november 2018 heb aangegeven zie ik vanuit het perspectief van rechtszekerheid en een betrouwbare overheid geen mogelijkheid om nu opnieuw de omvang van het windpark ter discussie te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het verlenen van de SDE+ subsidie door RVO

An MP asked the minister about SDE+ subsidy refusals for solar parks holding only temporary environmental permits, including cooperatives whose permanent permits arrived late, and whether RVO should allow more room to supplement applications. The minister confirmed the permit requirement, said temporary permits under 15 years are a problem and about twenty of over 4,000 spring 2018 applications were refused, and rejected extra room for applicants, saying they can reapply in the next round.
I do not consider further investigation necessary.
Verder onderzoek acht ik niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Teunissen over het bericht ‘Chemieconcern Ineos overweegt miljardeninvestering en fabriek in Rotterdam’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about a possible INEOS plant in Rotterdam linked to shale gas, citing environmental, climate and plastics concerns and asking whether the government would oppose it. The minister said the plant would process imported ethane and propane (shale-derived byproducts) into ethylene and propylene, estimated about 0.8 Mton CO2 per year, acknowledged the plastics problem, and said the government would not oppose the investment but would apply climate agreements, with talks with Dutch authorities ongoing.
The cabinet wants to promote CO2 emission reduction in existing industry and stimulate the development of new industries, companies and business activity.
Het kabinet wil CO 2 -emissiereductie in de bestaande industrie bevorderen en de ontwikkeling van nieuwe industrieën, bedrijven en bedrijvigheid stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht 'Woningwet blokkeert subsidie voor zonnepanelen voor woningcorporaties'

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked whether the Woningwet blocks housing corporations from claiming SDE+ subsidy for solar panels because the electricity flows to an energy company, and whether they should amend article 45(2)(c). The minister answered that the Woningwet does not exclude SDE+ subsidy, that corporations may generate electricity only when it is directly linked to housing, and that the Woningwet evaluation including the Autoriteit woningcorporaties will examine possible obstacles by year end.
The evaluation of the revised Woningwet is currently being completed. I expect to send it to your House before the end of this year.
De evaluatie van de herziene Woningwet wordt op dit moment afgerond. Ik verwacht deze voor het eind van dit jaar naar uw Kamer te versturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat woningcorporaties geen energiesubsidies mogen aanvragen

An MP asked whether housing associations are barred from applying for SDE+ renewable energy subsidies, and why some could while others could not, and whether the rules can be harmonised. The minister replied that the Woningwet does not exclude associations from SDE+ subsidy, that electricity sold to third parties falls outside their core work, that the Aw supervises individual cases, and that the issue will be considered in the upcoming Woningwet evaluation.
Housing associations are not excluded from applying for SDE subsidy under the Housing Act, and the subsidy scheme also contains no exclusion of associations from receiving SDE subsidy.

Woningcorporaties zijn op grond van de Woningwet niet uitgesloten van het aanvragen van SDE-subsidie en ook de subsidieregeling kent ook geen uitsluiting voor verlening van SDE-subsidie aan corporaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over het bericht dat 10 jaar lang pogingen van de EU en 1 miljard euro de opslag van CO2 niet van de grond hebben gekregen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether the European Court of Auditors' finding that EU carbon capture and storage (CCS) programmes failed, and related court rulings, undermine reliance on CCS to meet CO2 targets. The minister answered that CCS remains a useful part of the emissions mix, that the EU programmes failed mainly due to an unfavourable investment climate, and that the government will not exclude options, while noting that 1.5 degrees pathways rely heavily on other measures.
The conclusion is that neither programme succeeded in ensuring CCS is applied in the EU, mainly due to the unfavourable investment climate.
De conclusie is dat beide programma's er niet in geslaagd zijn te zorgen dat CCS in de EU wordt toegepast, met name vanwege het ongunstige investeringsklimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Beckerman over het dreigende tekort aan stroom in België vanwege uitgeschakelde kernreactoren

MPs Wassenberg and Beckerman asked whether the Netherlands would supply emergency electricity to Belgium amid nuclear reactor shutdowns, raising CO2, price, reactor safety and parliamentary consultation concerns. The minister answered that Belgium seeks optimised interconnector capacity rather than extra power, that CO2 emissions cannot be excluded, that FANC is responsible for nuclear safety, and that the operational measures fall within TenneT's competence.
Question 11: Are you willing to avoid irreversible steps and submit decisions on supplying electricity to Belgium to the House?
Vraag 11 Bent u bereid om geen onomkeerbare stappen te nemen en besluiten over de levering van stroom aan België voor te leggen aan de Kamer?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over het bericht ‘TenneT zegt miljoenencontract 380kv-lijn met Heijmans op, project loopt vertraging op’

Two D66 MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that TenneT terminated a multi-million euro contract with Heijmans for 380kV pylons, causing delays, and what this means for offshore wind connections. The minister replied that TenneT, not the state, is the contracting party, that only the Zuid-West 380kV West project faces at least a one-year delay with no effect on wind farm connections, and that he has asked TenneT for clarification and urged it to resume construction quickly.
Of course I have asked TenneT for clarification and I urge that the realisation of the relevant connections be resumed as quickly as possible.
Uiteraard heb ik TenneT om opheldering gevraagd en dring ik erop aan dat de realisatie van de betreffende verbindingen zo snel mogelijk wordt hervat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de opbrengst van zonnepanelen van sportclubs

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the falling returns on solar panels for sports clubs and cooperatives, due to tax shifts and the end of net metering, warrant new support. The minister said the successor subsidy is designed to keep investments viable, that existing postcode-rose projects carry an inherent risk, and that a new stimulus scheme is being studied.
I am currently examining, partly in light of the evaluations of the net metering scheme and the postcode-rose scheme, how a new stimulus scheme can be optimally designed.
Ik onderzoek momenteel – onder andere naar aanleiding van de evaluaties van de salderingsregeling en de postcoderoosregeling – hoe een nieuwe stimuleringsregeling optimaal vormgegeven kan worden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de kaarten voor Rammstein binnen enkele minuten waren uitverkocht

An MP asked why Rammstein tickets sold out within minutes and resellers offered them at many times face value, and why the government had not enforced the motion to curb ticket profiteering. The minister answered that a national resale ban would be ineffective and unenforceable, so the government chose a consumer awareness campaign and support for existing industry initiatives instead.
Our conclusion is that such legislation is ineffective and hardly enforceable, if at all.
Onze conclusie is dat dergelijke wetgeving ineffectief en niet of nauwelijks handhaafbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Levensduurverlenging kerncentrale Borssele in strijd met verdrag van Aarhus’

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked whether the Aarhus Committee's finding that Borssele's lifetime extension breached the Aarhus Convention, and related questions on public participation, environmental impact assessment and the safety benchmark, were accepted. The State Secretary rejected a general Aarhus breach, argued the 2013 licence update required no MER, and said the second safety benchmark report is expected by the end of the year.
That is why I will study in the coming months whether additional (legal) measures need to be taken to increase citizen participation.
Daarom zal ik de komende maanden nog bestuderen of er aanvullende (wettelijke) maatregelen getroffen moeten worden om inspraak van burgers te vergroten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over VNO en het klimaatbeleid

An MP asked the ministers whether VNO-NCW's opposition to stronger climate policy, including arguments about carbon leakage that resemble a Business Europe lobbying strategy, undermines the Klimaatakkoord, and whether the government sees VNO-NCW as an obstacle. The minister acknowledges VNO-NCW's concerns about competitiveness and carbon leakage as shared points of attention, rejects the characterisation of the Klimaatakkoord as sabotaged, and states that the draft is on track to the 49% target with further elaboration needed.
I note that VNO-NCW calls attention to the international competitiveness of Dutch business and carbon leakage effects of CO2 emissions.
Ik constateer dat VNO-NCW aandacht vraagt voor de internationale concurrentiepositie van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven en weglekeffecten van CO 2 -uitstoot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht ‘Digitalisering van stroomnet loopt gevaar’

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Social Affairs about reports that a shortage of technical staff endangers digitalisation of the power grid and the energy transition, and what measures, cooperation with municipalities and UWV, and use of refugee status holders are planned. The minister answers that the government is continuing the Techniekpact, the Klimaatakkoord task group on labour market and training, a labour-market programme (VIA) and a heat-pump training Green Deal, while acknowledging that no specific grid-digitalisation initiative has been launched.
Yes, I recognise the signals from the grid operators.
Ja, ik herken de signalen van de netbeheerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Rutte in gesprek met Alibaba over Europees distributiecentrum’

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked about reports that the Prime Minister met Alibaba about a European distribution centre near Maastricht-Aachen Airport, with questions on jobs, environmental and noise impacts, the RLI mainport report, Belgian airspace arrangements and whether the government would reconsider. The minister declined to disclose details of the meeting as commercially confidential, called environmental effects a matter for future permit procedures, and reaffirmed general support for logistics investment.
It is not for the cabinet to disclose information from conversations with individual companies, as these are often commercially confidential in nature.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om informatie uit de gesprekken met individuele bedrijven openbaar te maken, omdat deze veelal bedrijfsvertrouwelijk van aard is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat VNO-NCW is aangesloten bij een machtige lobbygroep die het verhogen van de Europese klimaatambitie actief tegenwerkt

MP Van Raan asked the government about reports that employers' federation VNO-NCW belongs to Business Europe, which lobbies against raising the EU 2030 climate target, and whether this conflicts with the coalition goal of 55% reduction and with the Dutch Climate Agreement talks. The minister acknowledged the notes, said the government works constructively with VNO-NCW, committed to pursuing 55% at EU level with allied member states, and declined to warn negotiators or officials specifically about the lobbying strategy.
Both government representatives in contact with VNO-NCW and the parties at the Industry table are aware of the international context in which industry operates.
Zowel overheidsvertegenwoordigers die in contact staan met VNO-NCW als de partijen aan de Industrietafel zijn zich bewust van de internationale context waarbinnen de industrie opereert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de deal met Shell en Exxon

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the 2018 Shell/ExxonMobil deal on Groningen gas, including whether NAM could fail its obligations and how Shell's public guarantee statements square with the deal and its financial figures. The Minister confirmed that the risk exists, said the guarantees are legally binding under the tripartite agreement, and defended the adjusted financial terms as part of a balanced package, while disputing the press calculations.
The Agreement on Main Lines is a tripartite agreement between the State, Shell and ExxonMobil.
Het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen is een tripartiete overeenkomst tussen de Staat, Shell en ExxonMobil.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over bedrijfsovernames en de stakingsgolf bij AkzoNobel

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked about strikes at AkzoNobel over wages and pensions while shareholders receive large payouts, the treatment of employees in the sale of the chemicals division (now Nouryon), tax on capital repayments, and private equity sales of Dutch firms. Minister Wiebes answered that wages and pensions are for social partners, that the Rijnlands governance model and works council rights apply, that the Corporate Governance Code does not bind Nouryon or foreign investors, and that a legislative cooling-off period for listed boards is being prepared.
The cabinet attaches great value to this Rhineland model.
Het kabinet hecht grote waarde aan dit Rijnlandse model.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het stimuleren van economische sectoren rond de Waddenzee

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a national tourism summit, the Wadden islands' plea against new gas extraction under the Wadden Sea, and whether tourism rather than mining should be promoted there. The minister said the summit was a provincial initiative, that the Mijnbouwwet already restricts mining in the Wadden area, that the budget has no specific funds for Wadden tourism or mining, and that a one-dimensional focus is rarely possible in a densely populated country.

Partly on that basis, article 7a of the Mining Act, amended on 1 January 2017, was included, which in addition to the restrictions already in the Structuurvisie Waddenzee sets further limits on mining activities in the Wadden area.

Mede op basis daarvan is in de per 1 januari 2017 gewijzigde Mijnbouwwet artikel 7a opgenomen, waarin aanvullend op de beperkingen die reeds waren opgenomen in de Structuurvisie Waddenzee, nog nadere beperkingen zijn gesteld aan mijnbouwactiviteiten in het Waddengebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘opinie veiligheid Groningers staat zeker voorop’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the 2018/2019 Groningen gas extraction (19.4 bcm) exceeds the SodM safe level of 12 bcm, and whether the minister's claim that Groningers' safety comes first holds given the lack of a legal phase-out plan. The minister answers that extraction will fall below 12 bcm within a few years via measures and a phase-out plan, but that a cold year may require more extraction to avoid disconnecting consumers.
The cabinet presented a phase-out plan on 29 March.
Het kabinet heeft op 29 maart jl. een afbouwplan gepresenteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘NCTV: Windmolenhaters radicaliseren, boeren gesaboteerd’

MPs Yesilgöz-Zegerius and Laan-Geselschap asked about reports that opponents of wind turbines are radicalising, including threats, intimidation and sabotage, and what protection and data exist. The minister condemns such acts, says individuals and employers are first responsible for their own safety, notes police do not record windmill-related offences separately, and cites the DTN 48 threat assessment.
Offences committed in relation to windmills are not registered by the police under a separate code.
Delicten die worden gepleegd in relatie tot windmolens worden door de politie niet geregistreerd onder een aparte code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het verhuren van dakruimte voor zonnepanelen

MPs asked whether mortgage lenders' ban on subletting blocks business owners from leasing roof space for solar panels, and whether government will intervene. The minister says lenders may set conditions, that the banking association has drafted a model deed to ease such leases, that existing subsidies suffice and that the matter is a private contractual relationship where government will not intervene.
There is no reason for the government to intervene in this contractual relationship.
Er is geen aanleiding voor de overheid om in te grijpen in deze contractuele relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over energiecoöperaties

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked how the Wft applies to small energy cooperatives, including thresholds for membership, capital and transferability, and whether a licensing requirement exists. The government answered that cooperatives mostly qualify as businesses rather than investing, that prospectus rules apply only above a €5 million threshold with exemptions below it, and that it does not intend to burden small initiatives with unreasonable bureaucracy.
Small-scale citizen initiatives to generate sustainable energy are welcomed.
Kleinschalige initiatieven van bewoners om duurzame energie op te wekken worden toegejuicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over Nederlandse investeerders die amper geld steken in start-ups van vrouwen

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the very low share of venture capital going to women-led start-ups is simply accepted as part of the free market, what levers exist, and what the government will do. The state secretary answered that this is not accepted as a given, that institutional investors play a limited role, and that a round-table with stakeholders will be organised before deciding on further measures.
I will consider this after the round-table discussion, where I hope to gain more insight into why female-led start-ups obtain so little capital and the options available to address it.

Dit zal ik na het rondetafelgesprek bezien, waar ik hopelijk meer inzicht zal opdoen over de redenen waarom vrouwelijke start-ups zo weinig kapitaal verkrijgen en de mogelijkheden die er zijn om hier wat aan te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het Onderzoek: ‘Redenen waarom eigenaren aanbod schade-afhandeling niet hebben geaccepteerd’

MP Beckerman asked the minister why owners rejected NAM's damage settlement offers, whether 84% acceptance means fair offers, and how old damage claims will be resolved. The minister said the study covers only rejecters, that NAM revised some offers after signals, that rejecters can go to the Arbiter Bodembeweging, and that the arbiter aims to finish by September 2019.
The study gives no substantive judgment on NAM's functioning.
Het onderzoek geeft geen inhoudelijk oordeel over het functioneren van NAM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azarkan en Öztürk over flitskredieten die worden aangeboden tegen woekerrentes

MPs Azarkan and Öztürk asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about flash loans offered to businesses at usurious rates, their exclusion from consumer credit rules, and whether research into their effects would be done. The minister answered that no serious abuses are known, that the sector is developing self-regulation, and that a general market study is planned, but declined specific research and extension of consumer credit protection to small businesses.
At present I have no signals of serious abuses or major problems in this sector due to high interest rates or other costs.
Op dit moment heb ik geen signalen over ernstige misstanden of grote problemen in deze branche vanwege hoge rentes of andere kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de Nederlandse financiële stromen naar Nicaragua

Karabulut (SP) asked whether FMO's loan to Nicaraguan bank BanPro and the export credit insurance for two Damen patrol vessels to Nicaragua fit Dutch positions on the Nicaraguan human rights crisis, and what risk assessment applies. Minister Kaag answers that the loan is a private-sector investment, the insurance was granted under the policy then in force, Dutch cooperation with the Nicaraguan government is suspended, and export credit cover for Nicaragua has since been suspended.
For details on specific investments I am happy to refer you to FMO.
Voor details over specifieke investeringen verwijs ik u graag door naar FMO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over het rapport 'Duurzame en betaalbare energie in Caribisch Nederland'

Two D66 MPs asked whether geothermal exploration permits on Saba, granted by the island council to Teranova rather than via EZK and the Staatscourant, comply with the Mijnwet BES, and what the legal consequence would be. The minister answered that the Mijnwet BES contains no geothermal rules, so responsibility lies with Saba's public body, and promised to consider amending the law and consult the public bodies concerned.
I will examine how the granting of geothermal permits for the BES islands can be anchored and whether an amendment of the Mijnwet BES is desirable.
Ik zal bezien hoe de vergunningverlening rond geothermie voor de BES eilanden verankerd kan worden en of daarbij een aanpassing van de Mijnwet BES gewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de versterking van scholen in het aardbevingsgebied in Groningen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the reinforcement of Groningen earthquake-area schools (notably De Wilgenstee in Zeerijp) has been delayed or put on hold, whether NAM halted the process, and whether NAM still decides which buildings are reinforced. The minister answered that delays at the Abt Emo affect the sequencing, that the programme as a whole is not delayed, that the bouwvergunning issue is a municipal matter outside NAM's influence, and that reinforcement advice is not revised in light of the phase-out.
It cannot be ruled out that delays will arise in individual projects due to, for example, objections from local residents, delays in permit granting or unforeseen weather conditions.
Het is niet uit te sluiten dat bij individuele projecten vertraging ontstaat door bijvoorbeeld bezwaar van omwonenden, vertraging in de vergunningverlening of onvoorziene weersomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel 'Volop zonnestroom, maar de kabel is te dun'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a newspaper report that the Dutch grid cannot absorb rapidly growing solar power, including concerns about grid capacity, responsibility of grid operators versus government, and whether subsidised solar park owners face losses. The minister acknowledges capacity limits, says new substations take time, points to the Climate Table and regional energy strategies, and declines to make special arrangements for subsidised solar park owners.

To prevent grid capacity from becoming a short-term problem for connecting solar parks, the governments involved, grid operators and initiators are therefore seeking practical solutions through mutual consultation.

Om te voorkomen dat op de korte termijn netcapaciteit een probleem vormt voor de aansluiting van zonneparken zoeken betrokken overheden, netbeheerders en initiatiefnemers daarom in onderling overleg naar praktische oplossingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het onderzoek ‘Europe's renewable energy directive poised to harm global forests’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about a Princeton study warning that the revised EU renewable energy directive could harm global forests by counting wood as a low-carbon renewable fuel. The minister rejected the claims of mass deforestation and rising emissions, citing sustainability criteria and stricter Dutch rules, and promised to send a reaction before the European Parliament vote.
Your House will receive my reaction before the final vote on the revision of the renewable energy directive by the European Parliament.
Uw Kamer ontvangt mijn reactie voordat er definitief gestemd wordt over de herziening van de richtlijn hernieuwbare energie door het Europees Parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over kosten van de klimaatmaatregelen en de energietransitie

MP Baudet asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the total costs of climate and energy transition measures, household burdens to 2030, staffing, and the expected climate effects. The minister said no total figure can be given, listed budget clusters for 2018 and noted that the 2030 national cost is estimated at 3 to 4 billion euro per year, with household costs to be clarified after the Klimaatakkoord is costed.
A total amount for all costs of climate- and energy-related measures cannot simply be given.
Een totaalbedrag voor alle kosten van klimaat- en energiegerelateerde maatregelen is niet zomaar te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat Shell-directeur Marjan van Loon de stad Den Haag gaat adviseren over duurzaamheid

An MP asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that Shell's director advises The Hague on sustainability, whether Shell's advice is credible, and what steps government will take regarding local advice and Shell's role. The minister answered that local advisory appointments are for the municipality and its council to oversee, that Shell is one of many parties in the energy transition, and that it is up to local governments to disclose their advisory bodies.
It is not for the national government to direct decentralised authorities, in this case the Hague municipal executive, on their hiring of advisers.
Het is niet aan het Rijk om decentrale overheden, en in dit geval het college van B&W van Den Haag, aan te sturen op hun inhuur van adviseurs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat methaanuitstoot door gasindustrie groter is dan gedacht

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that methane emissions from the gas industry are higher than assumed, and whether measurement rather than sector estimates should be used, plus whether a national measuring programme and offshore leak measures will follow. The Minister says the current estimate-based method, reviewed with SodM, is adequate, that a harmonised protocol was adopted, that a national measurement programme will be examined with SodM and NOGEPA, and that a TNO study on possible shallow-gas leaks at abandoned wells will report in Q1 2019.
I will consider with SodM and NOGEPA whether an additional measurement programme is needed and, if so, how it should take shape.
Ik zal met SodM en NOGEPA bezien of een aanvullend meetprogramma nodig is en zo ja hoe dit vorm moet krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht dat er ook bevingen bij zoutwinning kunnen ontstaan

MPs Beckerman (SP) and Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about KNMI findings that salt mining can cause tremors near Groningen, the risk of a salt cavern near Winschoten, the advice to halt new wells in Veendam, damage compensation liability, and whether salt mining should be phased out. The minister denied the problems are more serious than thought, said the Winschoten cavern is stable but monitored, said the Veendam expansion requires an amended mining plan by 1 January 2019, and committed to follow SodM recommendations.
Individuals who believe they have suffered damage can, after the mining company has rejected the claim, appeal to the Technical Committee on Soil Movement (Tcbb).
Particulieren die menen schade te hebben kunnen, nadat deze claim is afgewezen door het desbetreffende mijnbouwbedrijf, een beroep doen op de Tcbb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Limburgse aardwarmte stuit op breuklijnen en strenge toezichthouder’

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about start-up problems in geothermal projects, including the claim that half of existing projects are stalled, and whether these problems are structural and what has been done since a critical SodM report. The Minister disputes that half are stalled, says there is no sign of a structural problem, and points to the revised mining law, the sector's Masterplan Geothermie and an innovation roadmap, plus a planned expanded role for EBN.
I do not recognise the finding that half of the geothermal projects are stalled.
Ik herken de constatering dat de helft van de geothermieprojecten stil ligt niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Boze gasleveranciers stellen staat aansprakelijk voor kosten inkoop gasverliezen’

An MP asked the minister whether fourteen gas suppliers holding the state liable for gas-loss costs after 2019 is accurate, and whether a deleted legal basis in the Energy Transition Act was an error and when it will be fixed. The minister confirmed the letter and the drafting error, said the fix will be introduced quickly but practical implementation is set for 1 January 2020, and does not expect liability claims to succeed.
The legal basis for incorporating the costs into the tariffs will be introduced as quickly as possible through the amendment note referred to in the answer to question 3.
De wettelijke basis om de kosten in de tarieven te verdisconteren wordt met de in het antwoord bij vraag 3 genoemde nota van wijziging zo snel mogelijk ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Wiebes over incomplete lijst onveilige woningen: 'Het valt mij ook tegen''

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why no complete list of unsafe buildings in the Groningen earthquake area exists yet, how the figure of about 1,500 was established, whether residents can get free inspections, and when they will have certainty. The minister replies that about 1,500 buildings were identified via modelling and checked, that priority goes to careful communication over speed, and that the NCG will deliver a plan of action shortly, after which residents will be informed.
The NCG expects to be able to deliver the plan of action in the short term, after which I will send it to your House.
De NCG verwacht het plan van aanpak op korte termijn te kunnen opleveren, waarna ik dit aan uw Kamer zal aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Windparkbouwers vrezen tulpenmanie als Wiebes gaat veilen’

An MP asks the minister whether the wind sector's warnings about overoptimistic bidding in subsidy-free auctions for offshore wind justify government guarantees, and why a Contract for Difference option is excluded from the law. The minister replies that bidders bear the market risk, that the subsidy procedure remains as a fallback, that the option of a guaranteed price floor cannot be written into law because subsidies can only be granted where needed, and that the bill will not be delayed until the Klimaatakkoord is concluded.
It is up to the market parties to make bids such that the wind farm is realised.
Het is aan de marktpartijen om zodanige biedingen te doen dat het windpark wordt gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Jetten over de gevolgen van de Brexit voor de Nederlandse luchtvaart

MPs Paternotte and Jetten asked the government about the consequences of a no-deal Brexit for Dutch aviation, including Airbus contingency plans, flight permissions, licences and a future air services agreement with the UK. The minister answered that companies are responsible for their own preparations, that the government will work with the EU and sector partners on contingency measures, and that aviation rights with the UK will be sought at EU level.
It is not the role of the cabinet, certainly not for individual companies, to speculate about the possible relocation of activities.
Het is niet de rol van het kabinet, zeker niet bij individuele bedrijven, om te speculeren over de mogelijke verplaatsing van activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Ojik over het ‘Verdrag tussen de Regering van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Regering van Australië inzake olievoorraadovereenkomsten’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the Netherlands-Australia oil stockholding treaty is efficient given Australian stocks stored in the Netherlands, whether it mainly benefits Dutch oil companies, and what value it has for citizens. The minister answered that stock location does not matter in IEA collective actions, that Australia has long failed its stockholding obligation, and that the treaty lets Australia buy oil tickets from Dutch firms, a usual commercial activity.
The treaty makes it possible for Australia to purchase oil tickets from oil companies established in the Netherlands.
Het verdrag maakt het voor Australië mogelijk om olie-tickets aan te kopen bij in Nederland gevestigde oliebedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Ongeplande uitval kerncentrale Borssele kost zeker tien miljoen’

An MP asked about the unplanned outage of the Borssele nuclear plant, the decommissioning fund, cost estimates, ageing risks and the finances of the shareholders. The government answered that the decommissioning fund is on schedule (EUR 201.4 million by end 2017), that the plant's reliability is not expected to decline, and that closing early would cost more than the planned 2033 closure.
I do not have the requested information for each central plant in Europe.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde informatie per centrale in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Jetten over het bericht dat Hardenberg in alle nieuwbouwwijken gasaansluitingen toelaat

Two MPs from D66 asked ministers whether Hardenberg's blanket exemption from the gas connection obligation for all new-build neighbourhoods was lawful and in line with the law's intent. The minister answered that the municipal exemption power is limited to specific projects or locations, that he cannot judge whether Hardenberg complied with the rules, and that objection and appeal are open to affected parties.
Whether the college of mayor and aldermen of the municipality of Hardenberg took this decision in accordance with the provisions of the law, I cannot assess.
Of het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de gemeente Hardenberg dit besluit conform de bepalingen in de wet heeft genomen, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Wassenberg en Ouwehand over de jaarlijkse milieuschade van ruim 37 miljard euro

MPs Van Raan, Wassenberg and Ouwehand asked the government about the roughly 37 billion euro annual environmental damage from Dutch firms and consumers, the CO2 minimum price, aviation emissions, livestock and imported environmental costs, and whether environmental costs are included in fiscal and policy calculations. The Minister mostly defended existing policy, said the PBL figures are uncertain and not fully comparable, pointed to planned True Pricing work and aviation measures, and declined to give some requested estimates.
The multi-year programme I have in mind should provide more insight into the cost-shifting mechanisms.
Het meerjarenprogramma dat mij voor ogen staat moet meer inzicht in de afwentelingsmechanismen opleveren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Ronnes over het potentiële gebruik van slimme meters voor energiebesparing

MPs Mulder and Ronnes asked the ministers about the evaluation of the energy-saving covenant, weak uptake of smart-meter energy-saving services, and smart thermostats. Minister Wiebes answered that the evaluation is expected by end 2018, that the covenant is expected to be complied with, and that policy measures are limited to voluntary sector commitments and subsidies.
I assume that the Covenant will be complied with.
Ik ga er vanuit dat het Convenant zal worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het bericht dat groene stroom in Nederland het duurste van Europa is

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether rising prices of Dutch green electricity certificates raise costs for businesses and consumers and what will be done about the price of non-green electricity. The minister said certificate prices reflect demand for Dutch-origin green power, that businesses buy them voluntarily, and pointed to the EU ETS, a planned CO2 minimum price and the forthcoming Klimaatakkoord.
It is not possible to give the exact prices and price increase, because there is no index for GvOs.
Het is niet mogelijk om de exacte prijzen en prijsstijging weer te geven, omdat er geen index voor GvO’s is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de besluitvorming rondom het beloningsbeleid bij bedrijven met een Stichting Administratiekantoor

An MP asked whether the Stichting Administratiekantoor (STAK) vote was decisive in approving higher executive pay at Van Lanschot Kempen, and whether its use of voting rights for pay matters is consistent with the Corporate Governance Code and the law. The minister answered that the STAK's votes could not be shown to be decisive, that the STAK's governance meets the Code, that the law gives voting rights to the shareholder, and that the government is consulting on tighter pay rules.
It is not known how the certificate holders who did not use their power to vote by proxy would have voted had they invoked that power.
Het is niet bekend hoe de certificaathouders die geen gebruik hebben gemaakt van hun bevoegdheid om door middel van een volmacht hun stem uit te brengen zouden hebben gestemd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de toegenomen populariteit van gasgestookte ketels, met name in nieuwbouw

MP Wassenberg asks whether the rising popularity of gas boilers, especially in new-build homes, undermines Dutch climate targets, the Groningen gas phase-out and the 2050 gas-free goal, and whether government policy and gas connections should be changed. The minister replies that gas-boiler demand has not risen sharply, that heat pumps are gaining share, that the gas connection obligation for new homes was abolished from 1 July 2018, and that municipalities will set neighbourhood plans and the Klimaatakkoord will support the transition.
I have asked RVO to explain these figures.
Ik heb RVO gevraagd om deze cijfers toe te lichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de uitspraken van Duitse Minister Altmaier inzake de Energiewende

An MP asked the ministers about German Minister Altmaier's claims that renewable energy is costly, that the EU target is unreachable and that subsidies could end within five years, plus a critical report on wind-energy cost sharing. The minister rejected the cost claims as based on outdated feed-in tariffs and flawed assumptions, agreed subsidies may phase out in four to five years at the optimistic end, and defended the gas and nuclear positions.
With the intentions in its own coalition agreement, Germany is one of the most ambitious EU member states regarding the share of renewable energy in the total energy mix.
Met de voornemens in haar eigen regeerakkoord is Duitsland één van de meest ambitieuze EU-lidstaten als het gaat om het aandeel hernieuwbare energie als onderdeel van de totale energiemix.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Palmolieproducent verstopt ‘foute’ plantage in schaduwbedrijf en maskeert ontbossing'

MPs Diks and Van der Lee asked whether palm oil firms use shadow companies to hide deforestation and whether rules and enforcement should be tightened. The Minister answered that the matter is largely for producer countries to regulate, that Dutch industry commitments are the key lever, and that existing certification and forest governance efforts continue.
Adjusting the legislation on this is up to these countries themselves and is currently no reason to tighten laws in the Netherlands or Europe.
Aanpassing van de wetgeving daar omtrent is aan deze landen zelf, en vormt nu geen reden om de wet- en regelgeving in Nederland of Europa aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gerepareerde scheuren die niet bestand zijn tegen nieuwe bevingen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether repaired cracks from earthquakes in Groningen fail under new tremors, how often this occurs, whether repair methods were effective, and why the TNO research was not published immediately. The minister confirmed repaired damage can recur, cited 39 of 476 repaired cracks reappearing after one quake, pointed to the gas production phase-out and a forthcoming law on public damage handling, and said NAM commissioned the research and published it.
As Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, I had no role in the client-contractor relationship between NAM and TNO.
Ik had als Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat geen rol in de opdrachtgever-opdrachtnemersrelatie tussen NAM en TNO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de schadeafhandeling en versterkingsoperatie in Groningen

An SP MP asks the minister about the slow handling of Groningen earthquake damage claims, the Arbiter backlog, NAM's automatic referral of large C-damage claims, and the uncertainty surrounding reinforcement operations. The minister responds that old claims are being resolved, refuses to compensate residents directly at state expense, promises to review the TU Delft report and to send an assessment to parliament, and acknowledges that reinforcement uncertainty has damaged residents' trust.

I will shortly send your House a final report from NAM on the approach to old damage cases, with exact figures on how many residents accepted NAM's offer and how many of them registered with the Arbiter.

Ik zal uw Kamer binnenkort een eindrapportage van NAM aanbieden over de aanpak oude schadegevallen, met exacte cijfers over hoeveel bewoners het aanbod van NAM hebben geaccepteerd en hoeveel van hen zich bij de Arbiter hebben aangemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de belofte dat mensen uit batch 1588 voor 19 juli duidelijkheid zouden hebben en de gevolgen voor de stressbeleving van mensen wanneer dit niet gebeurt

An SP MP asked whether residents of batch 1.588 received the promised letter giving clarity before 19 July, and about stress and distrust when clarity is delayed. The minister confirmed the letter was sent, said the group's composition is unchanged and the reinforcement approach can proceed, and reported on the health action plan and related programmes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat stukken Arctische permafrost zelfs in de winter niet meer zijn bevroren

An MP asked the ministers whether reports that some Arctic permafrost no longer freezes even in winter, and possibly thaws faster than expected, should affect climate policy and CO2 reduction targets. The minister answered that the IPCC projects substantial permafrost loss, that the next IPCC special report will incorporate recent studies, and that it is too early to say what this means for ambition levels, while noting that current models can still support climate policy if the extra emissions are subtracted from the remaining carbon budget.
It is still too early to make a statement about the consequences of these insights for the level of ambition and reduction targets.
Het is nog te vroeg om een uitspraak te doen over de consequenties van deze inzichten voor het ambitieniveau en reductiedoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het Dutch Venture Initiative (DVI-I en DVI-II)

An MP asked the economic affairs ministry about the Dutch Venture Initiative (DVI-I and DVI-II), concerning whether public funds crowd out private investors, whether pension funds get unique access, whether the revolving fund makes the state act like a bank, and whether investments should only go where markets fall short. The State Secretary answered that the funds aim to crowd in private capital, that DVI can take smaller shares to leave room for market parties, and that the state's participation is not comparable to bank lending.
This concerns genuine investments in a fund. I therefore do not share the view that the government acts as a bank by using revolving funds.
Dit gaat echt om investeringen in een fonds. Ik deel dan ook niet de mening dat de overheid zich met het gebruik van revolverende fondsen als bank opstelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over plastic als belangrijke bron van broeikasgas

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether litter plastics are a significant greenhouse gas source and whether emissions from them are estimated or monitored in the Netherlands. The minister confirmed the research finding, said no estimates exist and that the RIVM will follow international research, and stated that litter plastics are not yet included in climate policy.

Climate policy currently does not take into account greenhouse gas emissions from litter plastics, because until now these have not been considered a relevant emission source with substantial emissions.

Er wordt in het klimaatbeleid momenteel geen rekening gehouden met de uitstoot aan broeikasgassen door zwerfplastics omdat dit tot nu toe niet beschouwd is als relevante emissiebron met een substantiële emissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de CO2-uitstoot van de luchtvaartsector wéér is gestegen

An opposition MP asked the ministers whether rising aviation CO2 emissions, the role of market-based schemes and the government's international ambitions are acceptable and what the government will do. The minister answered that aviation emissions must fall, pointed to ICAO, CORSIA, the EU ETS and the national Duurzame Luchtvaarttafel, and rejected the claim that aviation has a free pass under Paris.
Aviation CO2 emissions must be reduced.
De CO 2 uitstoot door de luchtvaart dient te worden gereduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het rapport ‘Beschikbaarheid van Nederlandse verse houtige biomassa’, van Probos, d.d. 10 augustus 2018

An MP asked the minister about a Probos report on available fresh woody biomass, citing risks of rising demand, cheap unsustainable imports and price increases undermining existing plants, and asked about monitoring, SDE+ changes and an import norm. The minister largely defended current policy, opened a wood pellet category for district heating from 2019, and rejected an import norm, promising no proactive government warnings to initiators.

To also give these projects the opportunity to become sustainable without further burdening the market for fresh woody biomass, I will open a district heating category for boilers based on wood pellets from the spring SDE+ 2019 round.

Om ook deze projecten de mogelijkheid te geven te verduurzamen zonder de markt voor verse houtige biomassa verder te belasten, zal ik een categorie stadsverwarming voor ketels op basis van houtpellets open gaan stellen vanaf de voorjaarsronde SDE+ 2019
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de deal met Shell en Exxon

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Groningen gas deal with Shell and ExxonMobil, including the 2035 end date for liability, the legal strength of a feared 70 billion euro compensation claim, the role of the Finance Minister, and whether the government was outmaneuvered by the companies. The Minister answered that liability remains without time limit, that the claim risk was assessed internally with the Landsadvocaat advising, that the indicative loss is 1.65 billion euro through 2022, and that the Finance Ministry was involved, while promising a confidential technical briefing.
I will provide your House with more clarity on the commercially confidential elements of the Principal Agreement during the confidential technical briefing.
Ik zal uw Kamer meer duidelijkheid verschaffen over de bedrijfsvertrouwelijke elementen van het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen tijdens de vertrouwelijke technische briefing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het oordeel van hoogleraar ondernemingsrecht Bartman, dat het akkoord dat de minister met Shell en Exxon sloot ‘buitengewoon mager’

An MP asked the minister about law professor Bartman's view that the Shell and Exxon Groningen gas agreement was 'remarkably meagre', including whether the state could have dissolved the original contract or claimed mining damage as unforeseen circumstances, and whether the agreement was legally binding. The minister defended the agreement as balanced, said it was binding since signing, pointed to the courts for the unforeseen-circumstances question, and declined to reopen negotiations or involve parliament more beforehand.
I will provide your House with more clarity on the commercially confidential elements of the Agreement in principle during the confidential technical briefing in September.
Ik zal uw Kamer meer duidelijkheid over de bedrijfsvertrouwelijke elementen van het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen verschaffen tijdens de vertrouwelijke technische briefing in september.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de tarieflijst Tijdelijke Commissie Mijnbouwschade Groningen (TCMG) waarin ook de overlastvergoeding genoemd wordt

The MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the TCMG tariff list, which includes a 250 euro nuisance allowance, asking whether it applies only to post-31 March 2017 damage claims, whether tenants and old-damage claimants are covered, and whether the payments affect tax and benefits. The Minister answered that the TCMG handles only claims after 31 March 2017 while NAM handles old claims generously, that tenant arrangements are being explored, and that the allowance does not affect other compensation, though the claim must be filed individually.
The TCMG expects to be able to provide clarity on this in the short term.
De TCMG verwacht hier op korte termijn duidelijkheid over te kunnen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag  en Nijboer over de risico's bij zoutwinning

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about risks from salt mining, including long-term cavern instability, sinkholes in Twente, a Heiligerlee cavern, and leakage at Veendam, citing an SodM report. The minister acknowledges long-term risks need more attention, describes monitoring and remediation plans with AkzoNobel and Nedmag, and promises further information on a single damage desk and reports.
SodM has given supervision of the salt sector greater priority.
SodM heeft het toezicht op de zoutsector meer prioriteit gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de zoutwinning in de gemeente Midden-Groningen

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about salt mining by Nedmag in Midden-Groningen, including alleged drilling against the permit, a leak incident, accelerated subsidence and damage risks, and a claims desk for mining damage. The Minister says no drilling is currently taking place, the objection will be handled by SodM, the leak investigation is ongoing, and that the Tcbb advice on a claims desk will be implemented with a further letter to parliament.
SodM will handle the objection according to the procedure within the set time limit.
SodM zal het bezwaar behandelen volgens de procedure binnen de daarvoor vaststelde termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over het instellen van een bouwdepot voor gebouweigenaren in het Groningse aardbevingsgebied

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a critical article claiming that the decision to end Groningen gas extraction disrupted damage settlement, reinforcement, village renewal and regional outlook, and asked for an independent study of a building-fund proposal giving owners control over their building budgets. The Minister acknowledged a course change requiring rethinking of the reinforcement operation, rejected the claim that prior steps had collapsed, and said the building-fund option is being explored alongside other options with a new approach to be informed to parliament soon.
My aim is to inform your House of the progress in the short term.
Mijn streven is om uw Kamer op korte termijn te informeren over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Alders: De NAM mengt zich toch in nieuwe versterking'

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM improperly interfered in the Groningen house-reinforcement operation by sending calculations and positions to TNO and NEN, contrary to earlier assurances, and what the government will do to restore trust. The Minister answered that the information exchange was an ordinary part of independent advisory work, that the NAM email caused an unwarranted impression that was quickly clarified, and that NAM will not co-decide but will pay for reinforcement, with a regional consultation outcome promised in autumn.
I am currently in consultation with the region on how the reinforcement operation is organised.
Ik ben op dit moment in overleg met de regio over de inrichting van de uitvoering van de versterkingsopgave.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht op de website van de belastingdienst getiteld 'Wat betekent de vergoeding voor aardbevingsschade voor mijn toeslagen?'

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether compensation for Groningen earthquake damage should reduce childcare and child benefit allowances, and whether recipients face double harm and other benefit effects. The minister answered that compensation should leave people no worse off, that only a very limited group is affected through box 3 income, that such effects count as consequential damage claimable at the TCMG, and that no specific fiscal regulation is planned.
I am asking the TCMG to actively inform about this and am looking with them at how this can best be arranged in practice.
Ik vraag de TCMG hier actief over te informeren en kijk met hen hoe dit uitvoeringstechnisch het beste kan worden geregeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Geurts en Ronnes over aansluiting en planning van duurzame energie projecten met betrekking tot elektriciteitsnetwerken en beschermen natuur, landschap en vruchtbare landbouw

MPs from the CDA asked the Economic Affairs minister about grid connection delays for renewable energy projects, the statutory connection deadlines and sanctions, planning coordination with regional governments, and protecting nature, landscape and farmland from solar parks. The minister answered that the 18-week deadline is increasingly exceeded for some connections, that no sanctions have been imposed to date, and that regional energy strategies and the national environment vision will address spatial coordination.
For connections to the low and medium voltage grid there is no uniform recording of exceedances of the deadlines.
Voor aansluitingen op het laagspannings- en middenspanningsnet is er geen uniforme vastlegging van overschrijdingen van de termijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Jetten over het terugdringen van de klimaatimpact van de financiële sector

MPs Dik-Faber and Jetten asked whether other Dutch banks, insurers and pension funds have published commitments to measure and reduce the climate impact of their full balance sheets, and whether the minister will make concrete agreements with the financial sector in the Klimaatberaad as required by an outstanding motion. The minister replied that about fifteen financial firms pledged to measure climate impact by 2020 and that a financial task group within the Klimaatakkoord talks will develop plans, without committing to specific agreements.
Soon I will inform your House about progress towards a Climate Agreement.
Binnenkort informeer ik uw Kamer over de voortgang om te komen tot een Klimaatakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht dat er een zwarte lijst komt voor frauduleuze aanbieders van bedevaarten naar Mekka

An MP asked the government about reports of a blacklist for fraudulent Hajj travel providers, whether consumers are adequately protected, and whether the regulator and prosecutor should be alerted. The state secretary said existing consumer protection rules are sufficient, that organising the market is not a government task, and that the signal was passed to the ACM, which is independent in setting its enforcement priorities.
I have meanwhile passed this signal on.
Ik heb inmiddels dit signaal doorgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het bericht dat energiebedrijven met miljardenclaims klimaatbeleid tegenhouden

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that energy companies use multi-billion-euro claims under the Energy Charter Treaty to block climate policy, including whether Dutch letterbox firms exploit the treaty. Minister Kaag replied that the treaty gives investors limited protection, that the Netherlands opposes letterbox firms using it, and that renegotiation in 2019 will seek an explicit right for states to regulate in the public interest.
The cabinet will, among other things, advocate that letterbox companies be excluded from protection under the Energy Charter Treaty.
Het kabinet zal er daarbij onder meer voor pleiten dat brievenbusfirma’s worden uitgesloten van bescherming onder het Energiehandvestverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over internationale energiebedrijven die Nederland gebruiken om miljoen te eisen

Dutch MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether international energy investors use the Energy Charter Treaty to claim compensation from states over energy policy, and whether Dutch shell companies are used for such claims. The government answered that investors can bring arbitration under the treaty for unlawful state conduct, that Nederland has never been sued, and that it will work to amend the treaty to stop shell-company claims.
The cabinet is therefore committed to amending the Energy Charter Treaty on this point.
Het kabinet zet zich dan ook in om het Energiehandvestverdrag op dit punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het artikel “Reductie van broeikasgas blijft achter, biomassa is slechte energiebron”

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the Ministers whether they share concerns that growing biomass energy use worsens air quality and health, and asked about integrating climate and air quality policy and tightening emission rules for medium-sized boilers. The government answered that biomass does not necessarily worsen air quality, referred to the Schone Lucht Akkoord and a stookalert under development, said emission rules are already in place and to be reviewed in the 2019 ISDE evaluation, but declined to fully integrate climate and air quality policy.
In the 2019 evaluation of the ISDE scheme I will include the effects on (local) air quality as one of the criteria in assessing the scheme.
Bij de evaluatie van de ISDE-regeling in 2019 zal ik de effecten op de (lokale) luchtkwaliteit meenemen als een van de criteria bij de beoordeling van de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over de investeringen in kolencentrales in de Westelijke Balkan

Two SP MPs asked the government about Chinese investment in coal plants in the Western Balkans, whether this shows weak EU accession commitment, how it affects Dutch coal phase-out and EU climate targets, and whether the Netherlands will raise environmental standards with EU partners. The minister answered that accession countries must align with EU law including the ETS, that the EU 40% target stays, that accession is a long process with strict, fair criteria, and that the Netherlands will continue to insist on these conditions including environmental ones.
The cabinet adheres to a strict and fair EU accession policy and consistently emphasises this in European forums.
Het kabinet houdt vast aan een strikt en fair EU-toetredingsbeleid en benadrukt dit steevast in Europees verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de beving bij Warder

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the June 2018 earthquake near Warder, its link to gas fields, damage claims, safety risks of small gas fields, monitoring, and whether small-field extraction should be phased out faster. The Minister confirmed the quake is classified as induced, most likely by gas extraction, but said causation from the nearest field cannot be stated with certainty; he reported one minor damage claim, found no monitoring change needed, and saw no reason to accelerate phase-out.
No, I do not see that reason.
Nee, die aanleiding zie ik niet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Meer meten in aardbevingsgebieden’ waaruit blijkt dat er te weinig meetopstellingen in Noord-Holland zijn om aardbevingen door gaswinning goed te analyseren

An MP asked whether the seismometer network in North Holland is adequate to analyse gas-induced earthquakes, whether the Warder gas field could be larger than assumed, whether the soil composition makes the area more sensitive, and whether the minister will consult the Onafhankelijk Meten Effecten Mijnbouw platform. The minister replied that the six existing stations meet the SodM risk-based guideline, the annual monitoring plans can be adjusted if needed, no evidence suggests the field is larger than stated, clay and peat are common in the Netherlands, and staff will consult the platform.
That does not mean, incidentally, that the size of the monitoring network is set in stone.
Dat wil overigens niet zeggen dat de omvang van het meetnet in steen gebeiteld is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat het bedrijf Nedmag zijn zoutwinningslocatie sluit als gevolg van problemen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a leak and pressure drop at Nedmag's Tripscompagnie salt field, its accelerated shutdown, risks of subsidence and groundwater contamination, stacked mining in Groningen, and whether the Borgercompagnie expansion should be halted. The minister answered that the leak is stabilised and under SodM-supervised investigation, that the field will be wound down over about eighteen months, and that pending expansion permits are on hold until the leak's cause and effects are clear, but gave no firm halt commitment.
The investigation into the cause and effects of the leak is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de oorzaak en effecten van de lekkage is nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van den Berg over het bericht dat Noord-Holland opheldering eist over uitspraken Wiebes over Pallas-reactor

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government will act quickly so that Noord-Holland's final 40 million euro loan tranche to the Pallas reactor foundation is released and isotope supply delays are avoided. Minister Bruins answered that a go/no-go decision is expected soon, that the province is responsible for the loan decision, and that intensive contact with Noord-Holland is ongoing, without committing to a specific new step.
I am not responsible for the decision-making of the province of Noord-Holland.
Ik ben niet verantwoordelijk voor de besluitvorming van de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht “Bestaand aardgasnet kan 30% waterstof aan?”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that the existing gas grid could handle 30% hydrogen blending, and about the feasibility, timing, costs and safety of hydrogen blending as a way to reduce Groningen gas dependence and CO2 emissions. The minister answered that current regulation allows only very small hydrogen shares, that safety issues for appliances make blending impractical now, that large-scale hydrogen use is not expected before 2030, and that the government has no cost insight, leaving that to market parties.
I currently have no insight into the costs.
Ik heb momenteel geen inzicht in de kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Ruim 600 euro ‘afsluitboete’ voor huiseigenaar die gasloos gaat wonen, dat mag dus niet’

MP Van der Lee asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why network operators such as Liander require full removal of gas connections when customers cancel, making such cases depend on costly disputes, and whether sealing is sufficient and fees can be abolished. The Minister says the Dispute Commission ruled Liander had not shown removal was necessary, that the government asked network operators to justify removal and consider cheaper options within the Climate Agreement, and that cost-based charging rules apply, while defending cost recovery.

That is why I have also asked the network operators to promptly inform me about the necessity of always removing the connection and to further examine whether cheaper solutions are actually responsible.

Daarom heb ik de netbeheerders ook gevraagd mij spoedig te informeren over de noodzaak om altijd de aansluiting te verwijderen en om nader te bezien of goedkopere oplossingen daadwerkelijk verantwoord zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Agnes Mulder over geluid van warmtepompen en airco’s voor omwonenden

MPs Ronnes and Agnes Mulder asked the ministers about noise from heat pumps and air conditioners affecting neighbours, including existing national rules and possible measures. The government answered that the Bouwbesluit 2012 currently sets no neighbour-protection noise rules, that it intends to add them later in 2018, and that municipalities can use APV noise provisions in the meantime.
No rules are set in the Bouwbesluit 2012 on the noise of heat pumps and air conditioners to protect neighbours.
Aan het geluid van warmtepompen en airco’s worden in het Bouwbesluit 2012 geen regels gesteld ter bescherming van omwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over vergunningsaanvragen van energie-intensieve activiteiten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether municipal environmental services can set energy-related conditions in permits for energy-intensive activities, and whether they should be able to apply local climate and energy policy. The minister answered that permits can impose energy-efficiency requirements for non-ETS installations, that ETS installations are exempt, that local criteria can be raised in the Klimaatakkoord talks, and that no overview of permit applications is available.
It is not possible to provide an overview of business activities that meet the criterion you mention.
Het is niet mogelijk om een overzicht te geven voor bedrijfsactiviteiten die voldoen aan het criterium dat u noemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de spanning tussen oude en nieuwe schades
