An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about cases where damage from before 31 March 2017 worsened after later earthquakes, so that residents could be bounced between NAM and the TCMG, and about the handling and privacy of old files. The minister answered that no such cases of residents being sent back and forth are known, that old files are partly retained and remain accessible until year-end, and that a temporary handover with the resident's consent is possible.
In any case, there should be no situation in which residents are endlessly sent from one body to the other.
Er mag sowieso geen sprake van zijn dat bewoners eindeloos van de ene naar de andere instantie worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het rapport ‘Reflectie op de Nieuwbouwregeling – Van schadevergoeding naar stimuleringsregeling in het Groningse aardbevingsgebied’

An MP asked the minister about a report recommending replacement of the Groningen new-build earthquake-resistance regulations, the NAM's dominant role in the allocation committee, and construction delays. The minister acknowledged the report, said he would consult regional parties and send a reflection with supplementary research by September 2018, but gave no firm commitment on the NAM role or the six proposed changes.
I will send the reflection together with the additional research by the RVB to your House by September 2018 at the latest.
Ik zal de reflectie tezamen met het aanvullende onderzoek van het RVB uiterlijk in september 2018 aan uw Kamer sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat de voormalig inspecteur-generaal van het Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen het onbegrijpelijk vindt dat de versterking van 1588 woningen momenteel opgeschort is

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the reinforcement of 1,588 homes in Groningen has been suspended after former SodM inspector-general Jan de Jong called this incomprehensible, and whether the minister accepts De Jong's view on earthquake risk. The minister answered that all necessary reinforcement will proceed, that the Mijnraad advice due around 1 July 2018 will be awaited before decisions on the batch, and that he will act on that advice in consultation with the region.
Pending the advice the Mijnraad will deliver around 1 July 2018, no new reinforcement advice letters will be sent for a short period.
In afwachting van het advies dat de Mijnraad omstreeks 1 juli 2018 zal opleveren worden kortstondig geen nieuwe versterkingsadviezen verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ‘de NAM die weigert op te draaien voor de versterkingskosten’

An MP asks the minister why NAM refused to pay for Groningen reinforcement costs, whether NAM sought to suspend reinforcement of unsafe homes, why it still has influence over safety decisions, and whether the Algemene Rekenkamer should advise before signing a Akkoord op hoofdlijnen. The minister denies NAM raised costs as a reason, says NAM sought consultation over pace and safety, promises independent organisation of the reinforcement operation, and offers a confidential briefing on the agreement.
I want to offer your House maximum transparency, and have therefore sent the Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen, cleansed of commercially sensitive information, to the House
Ik wil uw Kamer maximale transparantie bieden, en heb daarom het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen, geschoond van bedrijfsgevoelige informatie, naar de Kamer gestuurd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de zorgen over het verscherpte toezicht op AkzoNobel dat van kracht blijft

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the continued enhanced supervision of AkzoNobel's salt mining, including delayed enforcement after leaking brine pipes, leaking wells, the lack of a decommissioning (abandonment) policy, unexplained cavern changes at Heiligerlee, and diesel-free mining research. The minister answers that the leaks were due to manufacturing defects, that SodM found a penalty order disproportionate, that AkzoNobel will be asked for further plans, and that SodM will publish studies in the autumn, with a response on the sector report due in September.
Under those circumstances, SodM considered a penalty order not proportionate.
SodM vond onder die omstandigheden een last onder dwangsom niet proportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de zorgen van SodM over zoutwinning door AkzoNobel

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) concerns over salt extraction by AkzoNobel, including cavern shape changes near Heiligerlee, leaks, and the location and risks of ongoing extraction. The minister answered that monitoring networks are being set up, that residents are informed via company channels, that leaks are investigated under SodM supervision, and that no reason exists to suspend extraction as SodM has not judged the risks unacceptable.
I will ask SodM to interpret the results of this research and make them public.
Ik zal SodM vragen om de resultaten dit onderzoek te duiden en openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Dutch Trade and Investment Board (DTIB)

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Trade whether the Dutch Trade and Investment Board (DTIB) and its successor the ISB-NL are lobby organisations, who sits on them, whether their composition and minutes are transparent, and what they cost. The minister replied that they are public-private advisory platforms rather than lobby bodies, gave the 2017 membership list, promised to publish future ISB-NL members and agendas subject to business confidentiality, and said a WOB decision was published late.
Account must be taken of business-sensitive information, and it must be ensured that discussions within the ISB-NL can be held as openly as possible.
Daarbij zal wel rekening gehouden moeten worden met bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en moet worden gewaarborgd dat gesprekken binnen de ISB-NL zo open mogelijk gevoerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Karabulut over de Nederlandse deelname aan de Iran Oil Show

MPs Beckerman and Karabulut asked whether Dutch government support for Dutch firms at the Iran Oil Show, including RVO and Dutch Energy Solutions programmes for the Iranian gas market, is consistent with Dutch climate policy, and what support is given to the oil and gas sector. The minister answered that participation is a matter for individual firms, that no direct financial aid is given, that the support is mainly embassy networking and export instruments, and that the government sees no reason to stop it.
It is up to individual companies to decide which international events they wish to attend.
Het is aan individuele bedrijven om te bepalen aan welke internationale bijeenkomsten zij willen deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over beleggingen van het pensioenfonds ABP

An SP MP asked ministers whether the ABP pension fund's rising fossil fuel investments, and its holdings in companies harming climate and environment, are acceptable for a fund serving public-sector workers, and what steps the government will take. The minister answered that ABP invests for employees rather than the state, that engagement with companies is the chosen approach, that IMVO covenants with the financial sector are being negotiated, and that the IORP directive will require more disclosure to members.
As also mentioned in the answer to question 1, ABP is the pension fund of the employees concerned and not of the government.
Zoals ook genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 1, is ABP het pensioenfonds van betreffende werknemers en niet van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen dat de Staat heeft gesloten met Shell en ExxonMobil

An MP asks why the Groningen gas settlement with Shell and ExxonMobil was not submitted to parliament in advance, why NAM's liability and the confidentiality of the deal were handled as they were, and how costs, dividends and the Groningen compensation fund are divided. Minister Wiebes answers that the agreement was lawful without prior parliamentary approval, that NAM remains liable through the Staat-run fund, and gives partial figures while deferring the year-by-year breakdown to later.
Now that the negotiations are concluded, you can debate the agreement with me and use parliament's budgetary powers to check its financial consequences.
Nu de onderhandelingen zijn afgerond kunt met mij in debat gaan over het akkoord en aan de hand van het parlementaire budgetrecht de financiële gevolgen hiervan controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huurverhogingen in aardbevingsgebied

An SP MP asked ministers about rent increases imposed by housing corporations in the Groningen earthquake area on tenants whose homes are unsafe and not yet reinforced, and about compensation and reinforcement timelines. The ministers said corporations decide rent increases, tenants can seek reductions via the Huurcommissie, reinforcement plans await advisory reports, and value-loss compensation is being studied.
Rental regulations provide that tenants can go to the Rent Tribunal and that the Rent Tribunal can judge a rent increase as unreasonable
De huurregelgeving regelt dat huurders naar de Huurcommissie kunnen stappen en dat de Huurcommissie een huurverhoging als onredelijk kan beoordelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat een zonnebedrijf zich schuldig zou maken aan dubieuze grondtransacties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether solar company Powerfield's land transactions amounted to speculation, whether subsidies were justified, and whether the energy transition is better left to public hands. The minister declined to judge the company's conduct, deferring to the AFM and police, explained SDE+ subsidy rules and that unrealised projects receive no subsidy, and said private parties are better placed to develop projects.
It is not for me to judge land speculation.
Het is niet aan mij te oordelen over grondspeculatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Remco Dijkstra over het stroomnetwerk rond Haarlemmermeer

MPs Yesilgöz-Zegerius and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about electricity capacity shortages around Haarlemmermeer and the 29 April 2018 power outage at Schiphol. Minister Wiebes answered that grid expansion is underway, referred to earlier answers on several questions, said the Schiphol outage report is pending, and denied a causal link between capacity shortages and the Amsterdam outages.
I will not go into causes and consequences ahead of the final outcomes of this investigation.
Ik ga niet in op oorzaken en gevolgen vooruitlopend op de definitieve uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de verdringing en verrijking door zonneparken

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about solar parks displacing farmland, land-price effects, overcompensation of landowners, and whether state-owned land should be used. The minister acknowledged land-use pressure, placed primary responsibility on municipalities and provinces, promised to address efficient land use in the Climate Agreement and National Environmental Vision, and deferred the compensation questions to market parties and an interdepartmental policy review.
In this context I consider it important that we handle agricultural land carefully in the Netherlands and that this is taken into account in spatial considerations for placing solar panels.
Ik vind het in dit kader van belang dat we in Nederland zorgvuldig omgaan met landbouwgronden en dat dat wordt betrokken bij de ruimtelijke afwegingen voor de plaatsing van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over de berichtgeving omtrent de mogelijke toekomstige zoutwinning ten zuidoosten van Enschede

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why the municipality of Enschede was not informed about salt-mining plans by SGW, and how information and involvement of municipalities will be improved. The minister answers that no formal municipal role existed under the old procedure, that the amended Mijnbouwwet now gives municipalities an advisory role, and that a consultation and information evening will be organised.
I agree with the municipality of Enschede's position on the role it wants in the permit processes for salt mining.
Ik ben het eens met het standpunt van de gemeente Enschede over de door haar gewenste rol in de vergunningenprocessen voor de zoutwinning.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Beckerman en Futselaar over een geplande zoutwinning in de gemeente Enschede

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked why the municipality of Enschede was not informed or consulted about a German company's planned salt mining, and about the risks of subsidence. The minister replied that under the old Mining Act municipalities had no formal role, that the new Act gives them an advisory role, that the national minister must decide on mining and that the company still lacks an approved extraction plan.
I agree with the municipality of Enschede's position on the role it wishes to have in the permit processes for salt extraction.
Ik ben het eens met het standpunt van de gemeente Enschede over de door haar gewenste rol in de vergunningenprocessen voor de zoutwinning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het ontwerpinstemmingsbesluit voor het winningsplan Pieterzijl Oost en Borgsweer

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the draft approval decision for the Pieterzijl Oost gas field production plan, covering cost-benefit and seismic risk, deviated drilling, formation depth and stimulation, a 2016 production test, and water injection at Borgsweer. The Minister answered that seismic risk falls in the lowest category, that the detailed stimulation work programme will be submitted to SodM and NAM may share it publicly, and that the 2016 production test was agreed with SodM.
It is up to SodM whether and how they handle the publicity of the approval of this work programme.
Het is aan het SodM of en hoe ze omgaan met de openbaarheid van de goedkeuring van dit werkprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz, Dik-Faber, Jetten en Agnes Mulder over het vertrek van de NCG

MPs asked about the role of the National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) after its director Alders resigned, covering its remit, houses inspected and reinforced, the shift of damage handling to an independent commission, funding, timelines for reinforcing 2,500 homes, and continuity of the programme. The minister answered in detail, stating the NCG no longer handles damage claims, that reinforcement decisions should be made independently of NAM with advice from the Mijnraad, and that continuity is being secured.
Because of these developments, the NCG no longer has a role in damage handling.
Vanwege deze ontwikkelingen heeft de NCG geen rol meer in de schadeafhandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de tegenstelling tussen de woorden en daden in het innovatiebeleid van het departement

MP Van der Lee asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the ministry's innovation spending contradicts its stated focus on specific, thematic innovation, citing a press analysis showing generic spending rising while specific spending fell. The State Secretary disputes that analysis, presenting figures showing specific innovation spending rose 56% (EZK) since 2012 and generic spending 8%, and says generic and specific policy complement each other and will both be kept.
Before the summer I will send your House a letter elaborating this policy adjustment in connection with the intensification of funds for applied research in the coalition agreement.
Voor de zomer stuur ik uw Kamer een brief waarin deze beleidsaanpassing wordt uitgewerkt in samenhang met de in het Regeerakkoord opgenomen intensivering van middelen voor toegepast onderzoek.
Antwoord op van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘IT-controleurs: te weinig investeringen in cyberbeveiliging’

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked whether accountant reports give enough attention to cybersecurity and ICT, whether rules exist requiring accountants to check companies' cybersecurity measures, and whether supervision should assess effectiveness. The state secretary agreed cybersecurity matters, pointed to existing audit-related rules and the NIS Directive, and said the government prefers to leave organisations free to choose their own instruments.
I want to give organisations further room for now to choose for themselves the right instruments to make their business cybersecure.
Ik wil organisaties verder vooralsnog de ruimte geven om zelf de juiste instrumenten te kiezen om hun bedrijf cybersecure te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over het rapport ‘Duurzame en betaalbare energie in Caribisch Nederland’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about results, targets, timelines and affordability of renewable energy in the Caribbean Netherlands following a report. The minister replied island by island (Saba, Sint Eustatius, Bonaire), noting new solar and wind capacity, prioritising reliability and affordability on Bonaire, and stating that small consumers have an affordable tariff though not a cheap one.
A sustainable energy supply is of great importance in the Caribbean Netherlands, as are safety, security of supply and affordability.
Een duurzame energievoorziening is van groot belang in Caribisch Nederland, evenals veiligheid, leveringszekerheid en betaalbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het budgetrecht van de Kamer ten aanzien van een nieuwe deal met Shell en Exxon

Nijboer (PvdA) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers why the cabinet refuses prior parliamentary approval of the Shell and Exxon Groningen gas deal, despite a motion, and how this fits parliament's budget power and the ministers' competence to bind the state. The minister replied that prior publication would endanger negotiations, that Article 4.6 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 allows ministers to conclude agreements without prior consultation, and that parliament will be informed once a framework agreement is reached, but the cabinet will not seek prior approval.
For these reasons, the cabinet will immediately inform the House of Representatives once a framework agreement with Shell and Exxon has been concluded.
Om die redenen zal het kabinet de Tweede Kamer terstond informeren op het moment dat een akkoord op hoofdlijnen is afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Van der Lee over het SER-advies Energietransitie en werkgelegenheid

MPs Özdil and Van der Lee asked ministers about an SER advisory report on the energy transition and employment, including shortages of qualified staff, language barriers for status holders, and VCA certification requirements. The ministers acknowledged the labour-market challenge, pointed to retraining, a Klimaatakkoord task group, and talks with industry on certification differentiation, without committing to specific new government investment.
Where this does not lead to the desired results, there must be a good social plan.
Daar waar dit niet tot de gewenste resultaten leidt moet er een goed sociaal plan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Ruim 600 euro 'afsluitboete' voor huiseigenaar die gasloos gaat wonen, dat mag dus niet’

GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Geschillencommissie Energie ruling that a grid operator could not charge a homeowner over 600 euro for fully removing a gas connection, and whether the Wet VET and the motion on low disconnection tariffs remain adequate. The minister answered that the ruling has no general effect, that grid operators will be asked to review whether cheaper sealing solutions are safe, and that talks with grid operators on lowering disconnection costs are ongoing.
This ruling has no general effect.
Deze uitspraak heeft geen generieke werking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over de stijging van water- en elektriciteitstarieven op Bonaire

MPs Jetten and Diertens asked the ministers about rising water and electricity tariffs on Bonaire and whether low-consumption households are unfairly burdened. The government answered that it has provided subsidies, is preparing a short-term amendment to the Wet elektriciteit en drinkwater BES to restore a discount for small consumers, and will examine tariff options, while stating that the subsidy does not imply dependence on the Netherlands.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over versterkingsproblemen in Groningen

Nijboer (PvdA) asks why one side of a street in Overschild is being reinforced against earthquakes while the other side is not, and why residents remain uncertain while the government pauses reinforcement decisions. Minister Wiebes replies that reinforcement continues for homes already advised or under way, that a pause on new decisions lasts until expert advice (Mijnraad) is available before summer, and that the region suspended consultation over this pause.
In the intervening weeks, therefore, no new reinforcement advice will be issued to residents and no new decisions will be taken on how homes not yet in the implementation phase are reinforced.

In de tussenliggende weken worden daarom geen nieuwe versterkingsadviezen uitgebracht aan bewoners en worden geen nieuwe besluiten genomen over de wijze van versterking van woningen die nog niet in de uitvoeringsfase zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Van Tongeren over de afhandeling van oude schades door de NAM

MPs Beckerman, Nijboer and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that NAM handles old Groningen damage claims carelessly, including forgotten files and delays after court rulings. The Minister says NAM must process claims carefully and promptly, reports that over half of old claims are resolved, and points to an independent survey and the Onafhankelijke raadsman and Arbiter Bodembeweging as routes for complaints.
In principle I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga in beginsel niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de frauduleuze ondergang van het The Hague Institute for Global Justice

Labour MP Moorlag asked the minister about the collapse of The Hague Institute for Global Justice, which received a 17.45 million euro subsidy, and whether the board and management acted improperly and whether the subsidy can be reclaimed. The state secretary answered that the subsidy was used lawfully and verified, that the institute failed to become financially independent, that management did not demonstrably act improperly, and that recovery is only possible in cases of deliberately false information, which is not indicated.
On the basis of the information provided, the subsidy was finalised.
Op basis van de verstrekte informatie is de subsidie vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het financiële fiasco rondom het Haagse Institute for Global Justice (IGJ)

MPs Baudet and Hiddema asked about the financial collapse of the Hague Institute for Global Justice (IGJ), its government subsidies, the oversight failures of its supervisory board chair Dick Benschop, and whether his nomination as Schiphol CEO should be suspended. The government answered that the subsidy was properly spent on the basis of accountability documents, that the Rijk is not liable for debts, that IGJ was declared bankrupt, and that it sees no reason for an investigation or to suspend Benschop's appointment.
Based on the accountability documents, there are no indications that the subsidy was not spent in accordance with its purpose and conditions.
Op basis van de verantwoordingsdocumenten zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat de subsidie niet conform het doel waarvoor en de voorwaarden waaronder deze verleend is, is besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het The Hague Institute for Global Justice

An SP MP asks the minister about The Hague Institute for Global Justice, questioning whether gas-revenue funding was wasted on luxury events and whether the supervisory board failed to act. The government answers that the one-off subsidy met its conditions, that the board appointments followed the statutes, and that the institute's activities fit the subsidy's purpose.
It was the responsibility of the interim board to appoint the members of the Supervisory Board in accordance with the articles of association.
Het was de verantwoordelijkheid van het tijdelijk bestuur om de leden van de Raad van Toezicht te benoemen conform de statuten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het artikel ‘Hout stoken in woonwijken moet aan banden worden gelegd’

An MP asks the state secretary and minister about the health, climate and environmental effects of residential wood burning, and whether national rules and subsidies for wood and pellet stoves should be restricted. The government acknowledges that wood smoke causes pollution and local nuisance, says it will work with municipalities on feasible measures, but defends biomass as renewable and keeps subsidies for pellet stoves in place.
I consider it important to give municipalities tools to address actual nuisance situations.
Ik vind ik het belangrijk om gemeenten handvatten te geven om daadwerkelijke overlastsituaties aan te kunnen pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over huiseigenaren die door de energietransitie op kosten worden gejaagd

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the government will stop municipal natural-gas-free pilot neighbourhoods that impose high costs on homeowners, and calls the energy transition undemocratic. The minister replies that the costs must be shared fairly, that financing instruments are being developed, and that the energy transition is necessary and affordable if proportionate, without committing to halt the projects.
The distribution of the burdens is one of the biggest issues I am currently dealing with.
De verdeling van de lasten is een van de grootste vraagstukken waar ik me op dit moment mee bezig houd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het ETS in het kader van het rapport Groene groei van het CBS

An MP asked the ministers about the low Dutch emissions reduction under the EU ETS, whether the ETS and the MSR conflict with a national minimum CO2 price, how the surplus is determined, and whether binding reduction targets are preferable to price mechanisms. The government attributed the limited reduction to efficient, export-oriented sectors, denied any conflict, explained the surplus calculation, and rejected the preference for binding targets over pricing.
This has unfortunately not proven possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de risico's die de overbelasting van de elektriciteitsvoorziening brengt voor de digitale koppositie van Nederland

An MP asks the minister about grid capacity shortages threatening datacenter growth in the Netherlands, including a Schiphol outage, the causes of delays, and industry proposals. The minister answers that no current shortage is shown, that a new substation site is needed in Haarlemmermeer, that investment-planning rules were tightened in the Wet Voortgang Energietransitie, and that the issue will be addressed in the climate accord talks, without committing to a dedicated working group.
The cause of the outage that occurred at Schiphol on 29 April is not yet known.
De oorzaak van de storing die zich 29 april jl. op Schiphol heeft voorgedaan is nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de NAM die uitspraken van de arbiter naast zich neerlegt

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM repeatedly fails to implement Arbiter Bodembeweging rulings, delaying compensation for Groningen earthquake damage, and what will be done. The minister denies the pattern, says NAM is working on old damage claims and that the Onafhankelijke Raadsman's concerns will be raised, and rejects amending the arbiter's rules to cover consequential damage.
I therefore see no reason to amend the regulations.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om de reglementen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Van Tongeren en Nijboer over de afhandeling van oude schades

MPs Beckerman, Van Tongeren and Nijboer asked the minister whether NAM's handling of old Groningen earthquake damage claims is truly successful, raising concerns about low offers, inspections, the six-week arbiter deadline, the waardevermeerdering scheme, independent research, complaints channels and enforcement of arbiter rulings. The minister replied that acceptance rates are encouraging but success is not yet certain, pointed to an independent study and a SNN scheme for the former buitengebied, and said he cannot impose a deadline on NAM but will press it to act on arbiter rulings.
In addition, an independent investigation into the handling of old damage reports has been started. I will inform your House of the outcomes of this investigation.
Daarnaast is een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de afhandeling van oude schademeldingen gestart. Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over ‘groene leningen’ voor het energieneutraal maken van woningen

An MP from the PVV asked the ministers about proposed green loans to make homes energy-neutral, including repayment terms, ownership of installations, and affordability. The government answered that a pilot in Heerhugowaard is voluntary, that details such as interest rates, terms and repayment consequences are still being studied, and that it rejects the claim that its climate policy has failed.
Details are still being worked out by the parties involved. I therefore have no insight at this stage into the interest rates, terms and other conditions.
Details worden door de betrokken partijen nog uitgewerkt. Ik heb derhalve in dit stadium geen inzicht in de rentepercentages, termijnen en andere voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over windenergie en luchthaven Lelystad

An MP asked ministers whether reopening Lelystad Airport for small aviation and its flight-path restrictions would obstruct planned wind parks in Flevoland and the Energy and Climate Agreements, and what the cost and compensation implications would be. The minister answered that the government is seeking spatial solutions for both aviation and wind energy, that exact routes and turbine heights are still under review, and that cost allocation is still being discussed without concrete figures.
I will keep you informed of the progress of this.
Over de voortgang hiervan zal ik u op de hoogte houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huurders duizenden euro’s meer moeten betalen door blokverwarming

The SP MP Beckerman asked whether tenants of a Staedion apartment complex facing large heating bills after the installation of heat meters could be helped, whether independent research into the meters and bills was warranted, and what measures would prevent such cases. The minister replied that the change to metered billing explains the higher costs, that no independent research is planned because tenants can turn to the rent tribunal and courts, and that the landlord has offered consultations and any overcharge would be refunded.
If there are indeed excessive charges, that amount will of course have to be refunded.
Mocht er overigens sprake zijn van teveel in rekening gebrachte kosten, dan zal dit bedrag vanzelfsprekend moeten worden terug betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Energy Hogs: Can World's Huge Data Centers Be Made More Efficient?’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the energy use and CO2 emissions of data centres, the transparency of large players such as Netflix, use of renewable energy and waste heat, and the PUE efficiency index. The Minister answered that data centres emit indirectly via electricity generation, that the MJA3 covenant and the Climate Agreement address efficiency, renewables and waste heat, and that no share of waste-heat potential is measured.
A percentage of the total potential that is usefully used has not been mapped.
Een percentage van het totale potentieel dat nuttig gebruikt wordt, is niet in beeld gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een tekortschietende capaciteit van het stroomnetwerk in Groningen en Drenthe om de geplande zonneparken te faciliteren

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether grid capacity in Groningen and Drenthe is sufficient for planned solar parks, and whether a national spatial vision for solar energy and short-term measures are warranted. The minister acknowledged the grid is reaching its limits, attributed this to rural conditions, low land prices and active local policy, and said the issue will be addressed in climate tables and the National Environmental Vision, without committing to a concrete new measure.
In the short term, the governments involved, grid operators and the sector will have to seek a practical solution in consultation.
Voor de korte termijn zullen de betrokken overheden, netbeheerders en de sector in overleg een praktische oplossing moeten zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over de verduurzaming van woningen

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether builders place marginal solar panels merely to meet energy norms, and whether the minister would engage the sector, municipalities, or change building rules to improve rooftop solar use. The minister said builders comply legally with permits and contracts, pointed to forthcoming BENG nearly-zero-energy requirements as the solution, and declined to add specific rules or start talks with the sector.
I will therefore not include specific requirements in the building regulations.
Ik zal daarom geen specifieke eisen opnemen in de bouwregelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Enschede ontevreden over zoutwinningsplan Ganzebos’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why Enschede and Overijssel say the ministry does not respond to their advice on the Ganzebos salt-mining plan, including vibration monitoring, alternative mining agents, cavern reuse and communication. The minister replied that advice is weighed and motivated in the decision, that existing KNMI seismometers suffice, that AkzoNobel is already researching alternatives, and that cavern reuse belongs in a separate permit; liability for the concession stays with AkzoNobel Salt B.V.
In the draft consent decision for Ganzenbos I also weighed the advice and gave reasons for it in the considerations of the decision.
Ook in het ontwerpinstemmingsbesluit Ganzenbos heb ik de adviezen meegewogen en gemotiveerd in de overwegingen van het besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Steenkolenoverslag Rotterdamse haven met 25 jaar verlengd'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether Rotterdam port should discourage coal transshipment, whether it can use tariffs, who is responsible for its long-term strategy, whether there is a vision for jobs as fossil sectors phase out, and whether coal quays could handle containers. The minister replied that restricting coal transshipment would only shift flows to Germany and Belgium, that reductions are already visible, that tariffs are a matter between the port authority and its clients, and that the port authority and the state share strategic responsibility within the Havenvisie and the climate agreement process.
Phasing out coal transshipment in Rotterdam would merely shift this cargo flow and the associated added value and employment to German and Belgian seaports.
Het afbouwen van kolenoverslag in Rotterdam zou deze ladingstroom en de daaraan verbonden toegevoegde waarde en werkgelegenheid enkel verplaatsen naar Duitse en Belgische zeehavens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht 'Woonarken aan Weesper dijk moeten áán het aardgas: ‘Gas is toch op z’n retour?'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether houseboat residents in Weesp being forced onto natural gas, and the municipality's role, conflict with the goal of a gas-free built environment, and whether the threshold for sustainable alternatives should be lowered. The Minister answered that the grid operator is obliged under the Gas Act to connect these residents, that municipalities currently cannot compel residents of existing homes to choose a non-gas alternative, and that the Klimaatakkoord table for the built environment will address phasing out gas.
At present it is not possible for municipalities to force residents of existing homes to choose an alternative to a gas connection.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk voor gemeenten om bewoners van bestaande woningen te dwingen om te kiezen voor een alternatief voor een gasaansluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het versneld smelten van het ijs op Antarctica

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a UK study finding faster underwater melting of Antarctic ice, its link to a KNMI study, and whether it should accelerate climate policy. The minister confirmed the study, said the findings do not justify revising prior conclusions given model uncertainty, and said climate policy acceleration is already in the coalition agreement while sea-level policy falls to another minister.
The cabinet has chosen in the coalition agreement to accelerate climate policy.
Het kabinet heeft in het regeerakkoord gekozen voor een versnelling van het klimaatbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Agnes Mulder over de enorme stijging van elektriciteitstarieven op Bonaire

CDA MPs asked why electricity tariffs on Bonaire rose about 24% from January 2018, whether they are cost-covering, and whether there is protection for vulnerable consumers. The minister said tariffs were previously kept artificially low by a subsidy funded by Dutch taxpayers, that the rise is mainly due to oil prices and network costs, that a subsidy will lower network tariffs and a bill for drinking water is being prepared, and that a usage-independent tariff is introduced on 1 April.
I am in discussion with WEB about how to deploy the subsidy.
Ik ben in gesprek met WEB over hoe de subsidie in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over oogstramingen CBS

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked why provisional onion and potato harvest estimates by CBS were sometimes revised down, whether provisional figures distort prices, and whether publication could be limited to final figures. The minister disputed the premise that revisions were mainly downward, said CBS publication is a legal duty and serves transparency, and noted there is no EU obligation to publish provisional estimates.
The claim that final estimates generally came out lower in the period 2010–2017 is therefore not correct.
Het gestelde dat de definitieve ramingen over het algemeen lager uitvielen in de periode 2010 – 2017 is dus niet juist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Van Engelshoven stelt 17 miljoen euro beschikbaar voor Gronings erfgoed’

MPs asked whether the government will extend subsidies for mining-damaged national monuments in Groningen to monuments outside the ten earthquake municipalities, and about complaints that NAM damage offers ignore monumental value. The minister answered that monuments outside those municipalities are not eligible for the earthquake-specific subsidies but can use other schemes, and that expert damage assessment remains a principle in the TCMG process.
It is correct that these national monuments are not eligible for the relevant subsidy schemes.
Het klopt dat deze rijksmonumenten niet in aanmerking komen voor de betreffende subsidieregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de stormloop op grond voor zonneparken

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Agriculture about a rush of investors onto farmland for solar parks, its effects on land prices, young farmers, biodiversity, and whether rooftops and other land should be prioritised. The minister answered that municipalities and provinces are primarily responsible, that the government will consider rooftops and its own property, will include the issue in the Climate Agreement, and will inform parliament before summer 2018, but gave no binding national restriction.
The responsibility for this lies primarily with municipalities and provinces.
De verantwoordelijkheid hiervoor ligt primair bij gemeenten en provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de wetenschappelijke borging van het klimaatbeleid

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the scientific underpinning of climate policy is balanced, in particular whether the PBL study excluded production and behavioural measures and whether the KNAW should provide independent scrutiny. The minister replies that PBL is independent and responsible for its own study choices, that no new study is needed, that sector tables will decide measures, and that no second independent opinion is planned.

The independence of the PBL is legally anchored, and as an independent knowledge institute the PBL provides substantiated knowledge, facts and analyses for public debate and policy formation in the Netherlands.

De onafhankelijkheid van het PBL is wettelijk verankerd en als onafhankelijk kennisinstituut levert het PBL onderbouwde kennis, feiten en analyses ten behoeve van het maatschappelijk debat en de beleidsvorming in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de afhandeling van bestaande complexe gevallen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether existing complex Groningen earthquake damage cases fall under the new damage protocol and how they will be resolved by 1 July 2018. The minister answered that pre-March 2017 claims are handled by NAM with a deadline of 1 July 2018, that all old claims get access to the Arbiter Bodembeweging, and that moving them to the new protocol is not feasible.
In addition, after consultation with NAM and the Arbiter Bodembeweging, I have decided to give all damage reports from before 31 March 2017 access to the Arbiter Bodembeweging.
Daarnaast heb ik, na overleg met NAM en de Arbiter Bodembeweging, besloten om ook alle schademeldingen van voor 31 maart 2017 toegang te geven tot de Arbiter Bodembeweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over ernstige gevolgen van de notificatierichtlijn

The SP MP Leijten asked whether the proposed revision of the EU services notification directive, with its standstill period, threatens democratic processes, burdens municipalities and the Commission, and whether the Netherlands should withdraw from it. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands opposes an extra three-month standstill (which was dropped from the general approach), that the notification duty already exists and only moderately expands, and that municipalities can still adopt ordinances without prior Commission approval.
During the trilogue negotiations as well, I will continue to work hard on this.
Ook tijdens de onderhandelingen in de trilogen zal ik mij hiervoor in blijven spannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Jetten over een mogelijk 'klimaatakkoord' voor de luchtvaart

D66 MPs asked the ministers about the ICAO CORSIA aviation emissions scheme, including its effectiveness, transparency, enforcement, offset quality, biofuel sustainability criteria, participation and Dutch lobbying. The government answered every question on substance, acknowledged concerns on offset quality and biofuel criteria, and committed to raising them in future EU and ICAO evaluations.
The Netherlands will use these and other evaluation moments to further improve the system on sustainability, effectiveness and environmental integrity.
Nederland zal van deze en andere evaluatiemomenten gebruik maken om het systeem verder te verbeteren op punten als duurzaamheid, effectiviteit en milieu-integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Lee over de overname chipbedrijf NXP door Qualcomm

MPs Van den Berg and Van der Lee asked the minister about the US block of Broadcom's bid for Qualcomm, whether the Qualcomm takeover of NXP warrants investigation on national-security or critical-infrastructure grounds, and related EU competition and battery questions. The minister declined to judge the US decision because the CFIUS advice is confidential, found no reason to treat chip design and manufacturing as a vital process, and said the EU supports 5G development.
Because the CFIUS report is confidential, it is not known on what grounds CFIUS reached its advice to the President.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van het CFIUS-rapport is niet bekend op welke gronden CFIUS tot het advies aan de President is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over de adviesaanvraag over de sluiting van Siemens Hengelo

MPs Amhaouch and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Siemens' works council request to close the profitable Hengelo plant, including whether the government would seek to influence the supervisory board. The minister said he is in contact with Siemens Nederland's management and Siemens AG, which committed to preserving jobs, but that the supervisory board makes its own judgement and he will not intervene in a strategic corporate decision beyond offering help.
The management boards of Siemens Nederland and Siemens AG are responsible for taking a strategic decision such as the proposed closure of Hengelo.
De directies van Siemens Nederland en Siemens AG zijn verantwoordelijk voor het nemen van een strategisch besluit als de voorgenomen sluiting van Hengelo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de uiterste afrekendatum van warmteverbruikers

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the Heat Act sets no deadline for heat suppliers to send annual or final bills, leaving consumers exposed to late surprise bills, and whether a six-week deadline and enforcement tools would be introduced. The minister agreed the gap is a problem, pointed to an amendment to the Heat Act and decree setting a six-week deadline, and said consumers can use dispute committees or courts, so no further measures are planned.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over onvoorziene fiscale gevolgen van de bevingsschade

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether unclear tax treatment of Groningen earthquake damage compensation, including immaterial damage and house value loss, creates uncertainty and how it is taxed for individuals and businesses. The government answered that such compensation is generally not taxable income for private persons, may count in Box 3 wealth depending on use, explained business relocation rules, and promised a publication on the Tax Administration website.
The intention is to include on the Tax Administration website a publication setting out the tax treatment of the compensation schemes.
Het voornemen is om op de website van de Belastingdienst een publicatie op te nemen waarin de fiscale behandeling van de compensatieregelingen is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over kloksystemen op basis van vingerafdrukken

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked whether employers may require employees to give fingerprints for clock systems, whether unpaid hours for refusers is unlawful, and whether private collection of fingerprints is acceptable. The state secretary answered that under the GDPR and the UAVG, biometric fingerprint processing is allowed only for authentication or security purposes, that refusers must be offered an alternative, and that the Data Protection Authority and courts assess specific cases.
In any case, the regulation in the GDPR and UAVG precludes using an employee's fingerprints for purposes other than authentication and security purposes.
In ieder geval verzet de regeling in de AVG en UAVG zich tegen het gebruiken van vingerafdrukken van een werknemer voor andere doelen dan authenticatie en beveiligingsdoeleinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat de zaak van Jannie Knot nog altijd niet is afgehandeld

MP Beckerman asked the minister why gas-extraction damage claimant Jannie Knot still had not received compensation months after the Arbiter Bodembeweging ruled in her favour, and whether the minister would intervene. The minister acknowledged the delay, said NAM had agreed to resolve old damage claims by 1 July 2018 and that NAM would advance a payment to Knot, but declined to discuss her individual case in detail.
Because this concerns an individual case and the personal situation of a resident with damage, I do not want to go into detail on this.
Omdat het hier over een individuele casus gaat en over de persoonlijke situatie van een bewoonster met schade wil ik hier niet in detail op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat bewoners in het aardbevingsgebied problemen ondervinden met hun hypotheek

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they would investigate and provide a remedy for Groningen homeowners facing falling home values and unsaleable homes due to earthquake risk, and whether banks are supporting them. The minister answered that banks will talk with affected owners, that CBS monitors the housing market, and that existing schemes such as the Koopinstrument, NAM value-loss scheme and Commissie Bijzondere Situaties apply, with the issue part of ongoing talks with the region.
Following the report, banks, through the Dutch Banking Association, have stated they are willing to talk with Groningen homeowners experiencing mortgage problems.

Naar aanleiding van het rapport hebben banken bij monde van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken te kennen gegeven dat zij graag in gesprek gaan met Groningse huiseigenaren die problemen met hun hypotheek ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het bericht 'PGGM wil samen met Apollo een bod doen op chemietak AkzoNobel'

MPs Van den Berg and Omtzigt asked the minister about reports of a PGGM and Apollo bid for AkzoNobel's chemicals division, its job and R&D impact, and whether the government would intervene. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that divestment is a company strategic decision outside government's role, noted the company's sustainability record, and said the ministry will monitor developments without committing to action.
However, the sale of the Specialty Chemicals division is a strategic decision of AkzoNobel.
Verkoop van de divisie Specialty Chemicals is echter een strategische beslissing van AkzoNobel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen, universiteiten en musea kiezen voor vieze kolenstroom

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why hospitals, universities and museums still buy coal-based electricity, and what the government will do about greenwashing and municipal green procurement. The minister replied that the market works through guarantees of origin, that the Greenpeace analysis is not supported, that institutions choose their own supply, and that an inventory of municipal procurement and a PIANOo self-evaluation tool will follow with results in early 2019.
I have had an inventory made of the procurement requests of municipalities that took place on TenderNed.
Ik heb een inventarisatie laten maken van de inkoopaanvragen van gemeenten die in TenderNed hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Cybersecurity hoogleraren vrezen dat Nederland digitaal onder water komt te staan’ en het bijbehorende position paper

MPs Tielen and Rutte asked why the Netherlands invests little in cybersecurity research compared with German centres, whether talent is leaving, and how a knowledge fund and chairs would fit government priorities. The minister replied that cybersecurity is a priority in the coalition agreement and national agenda, that Dutch research is of high quality, and that talks with ministries and stakeholders on a research impulse and a possible institute are ongoing, with a joint letter promised in spring.
I will inform the House about this in the spring through a joint letter with these departments.
Ik zal hierover de Kamer in het voorjaar informeren via een gezamenlijke brief met deze departementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de kaarten voor U2 binnen enkele minuten waren uitverkocht

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew concert tickets for U2 sold out within minutes while hundreds were offered on resale site Seatwave, and what they would do about resale practices and a motion on ticket profiteering. The ministers said resale is under study with the sector, cannot guarantee LiveNation does not sell directly to resale sites, point to the consumer authority ACM, and refer to a separate letter on implementing the motion.
I cannot guarantee that LiveNation does not sell tickets directly to secondary ticket websites.
Ik kan niet garanderen dat LiveNation kaarten niet direct verkoopt aan secundaire ticketwebsites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Nijboer over het bericht 'Gasloos vergt nieuwe regelgeving'

MPs Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether existing regulation hinders municipalities in the energy transition, whether the Omgevingswet delay and the Motion Vos-Van Veldhoven on CO2-neutral land-use strategies are being acted on, and whether the Bro and Bouwbesluit should be amended. The minister answers that legislation will be adapted (Wet voortgang energietransitie, Warmtewet, Bouwbesluit change), that municipalities can already act via the Chw experiment, but declines to amend the Bro or Bouwbesluit in the proposed way.
I therefore currently see insufficient possibilities to amend the Bro in the proposed way.
Ik zie op dit moment dan ook niet voldoende mogelijkheden om het Bro op de voorgestelde wijze aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Van Tongeren over de houding van de NAM bij een arbitragezaak

MPs asked the minister whether he still trusts NAM to handle Groningen damage claims fairly after NAM refused fresh damage photos and sought a counter-expertise in an arbitration case already assessed at tens of thousands of euros. The minister replied that he and the Groningen Commissioner of the King monitor NAM's handling of old claims closely and trust the independent Arbiter Bodembeweging, to which NAM has committed.
For individual damage cases in procedure before the Arbiter Bodembeweging, I have confidence in the working method and independent judgment of the Arbiter.
Voor individuele schadezaken die in procedure zijn bij de Arbiter Bodembeweging geldt dat ik vertrouwen heb in de werkwijze en het onafhankelijke oordeel van de Arbiter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Kwint over het subsidiëren van privaat onderwijs door gemeenten

MPs Alkaya and Kwint asked whether municipal and national subsidies for international schools, aimed at attracting foreign investors and expats, are a responsible use of public money compared with regular schools. The minister replied that foreign investment mostly creates jobs for Dutch workers, that the subsidies were a one-off measure to reduce international school waiting lists, and that funds were not given directly to a private school group.
The central government did not provide any funds to the Amity Education Group. That was a decision of the municipality of Amsterdam.
Het Rijk heeft geen middelen beschikbaar gesteld aan de Amity Education Group. Dat betreft een besluit van de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Amsterdam minima een korting op de energierekening wil geven

MPs Beckerman and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether he would use Amsterdam's plan for an energy-bill discount for low-income households as inspiration nationally, and how he views Belgium's social tariff. The minister answered that income support is better provided through general social policy, that energy pricing should not be used for income policy, and that a municipal discount could improperly cross national policy, leaving the council to prevent this.
This is in the first instance primarily a responsibility of the municipal council, as the controlling body, to prevent that cross-over.
Het betreft hier in eerste instantie primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenteraad – als controlerend orgaan-, om die doorkruising te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over het bericht dat cijfers CBS ervoor zorgen dat de prijs van uien laag blijft

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked whether CBS onion harvest estimates, repeatedly revised, depress onion prices and whether mandatory CBS survey participation is enforced with fines. The minister answered that CBS figures inform market prices without determining them, provided five years of revision data, and that no fines apply for 2016 and 2017 under a letter of intent.
The CBS does not have data on the onion prices that growers receive.
Het CBS beschikt niet over uienprijzen die de telers ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht “Cijfers NRG: Pallas-reactor overbodig voor 98,8% nucleaire geneeskunde”

MP Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) asked the ministers whether the Pallas reactor's business case, based largely on technetium-99m, is undermined by alternative production methods such as accelerators and ASML's Lighthouse project, and what total subsidy is expected. The government answered that Pallas also targets therapeutic isotopes, that the business case is being re-examined before the final loan tranche, that a reactor remains needed for supply security, and that the Pallas loan is capped at 40 million euro for phase 1 with construction and operation intended to be privately financed.
For the decision on the last tranche of the loan that the State and the province of North Holland grant to Pallas, the business case will be reviewed again.
Ten behoeve van de besluitvorming over de laatste tranche van de lening die de Staat en de provincie Noord-Holland verlenen aan Pallas wordt de businesscase opnieuw bekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de aantallen belastingplichtigen met lage inkomens die worden geraakt door de uitfasering van de aftrek wegens geen of geringe eigenwoningschuld

An MP asked how many low-income taxpayers (income under 20,000 euro) benefit from the Hillen deduction by WOZ value, given the phase-out of the deduction for homeowners with little or no mortgage debt. The state secretary provided a table showing 173,000 such households, and argued that many have substantial box 3 wealth and that the overall effect is limited once other tax measures are considered.
That table shows, as also presented above by WOZ value, that of the households using the Hillen deduction, 173,000 (19%) had an income up to 20,000 euro.
Uit die tabel blijkt, zoals ook hiervoor weergegeven per WOZ-waarde, dat van de huishoudens die gebruikmaken van de Hillen-aftrek, er 173.000 (19%) een inkomen hadden tot € 20.000.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over bouwvertragingen in Bedum

An MP asked the minister about construction delays in Bedum caused by disputes with NAM over the extra costs of earthquake-resistant building, and whether NAM should be replaced by public steering. The minister said a new-build scheme with compensation for reasonable extra costs exists, that the developer's own concept falls outside it, and that no overview of delays is available since municipalities supervise construction.
The realisation of new-build projects and the application of building regulations take place under the supervision of the individual responsible municipalities.
Antwoord 6, 7 De realisatie van nieuwbouwprojecten en de toepassing van bouwregelgeving vindt plaats onder toezicht van de afzonderlijke verantwoordelijke gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de financiering van een kolencentrale in de Dominicaanse Republiek

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asks the government about ING's financing of the Punta Catalina coal plant in the Dominican Republic, including corruption concerns linked to Odebrecht and whether ING's coal policy and IMVO convenant apply. The government answers that ING bears its own responsibility, that existing financing commitments predate its 2015 policy, that due diligence is for ING to conduct, and that it sees no need to talk to ING's CEO.
It is the bank's own responsibility to set an appropriate sustainability policy and to account for it.
Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van een bank om een passend duurzaamheidsbeleid vast te stellen en daarover verantwoording af te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Experts: overheid moet ingrijpen bij internetapparaten’

Two MPs asked the ministers whether insecure internet-connected devices should be regulated, including a ban on proven insecure devices and a European certification mark, and what awareness campaigns and producer liability rules exist. The government acknowledged the threat, said a roadmap on secure hardware and software is being prepared with certification, awareness and liability as instruments, pointed to existing campaigns and to an EU review of product liability, and made no firm commitment to bans or a specific certification scheme.

To promote better security for IoT devices, the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, in consultation with the Ministry of Justice and Security, other departments and private parties, is currently drawing up a roadmap for secure hardware and software.

Om te bevorderen dat IoT-apparaten beter worden beveiligd, stelt het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat in samenspraak met het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, andere departementen en private partijen thans een roadmap veilige hard- en software op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over het aanstellen van “ambassadeurs” en toezichthouders

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked about how special envoys (StartupDelta and FinTech) and an AFM supervisory board member were appointed, their time commitment, pay, the plagiarism admitted by the FinTech envoy, and whether appointment procedures produce suitable people. The Minister answered that the envoys' roles and pay were set by agreements (partly via a foundation), the FinTech envoy's post had expired and was unpaid, and the AFM appointment followed a profile-based search and vetting, with pay caps under the WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Diks over het rapport «Human rights in windturbine supply chains» van ActionAid en SOMO

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government to respond to an ActionAid/SOMO report on human rights in wind turbine supply chains and whether Dutch wind park permits and subsidies require due diligence. The government acknowledged the report, said current permits lack supply-chain human rights criteria, pointed to the UN Guiding Principles and OECD guidelines, and committed to encouraging a sector IMVO covenant for wind energy without a firm binding timetable.
The cabinet encourages the wind energy sector to conclude an IMVO covenant; the government also wants to participate in that covenant itself.
Het kabinet moedigt de windenergiesector aan om een IMVO-convenant te sluiten; de overheid wil ook zelf deelnemen aan dat convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de verhuizing van het Galileo Security Monitoring Centre naar Spanje

MPs Amhaouch and Paternotte asked why the Galileo Security Monitoring Centre back-up was moved to Spain, whether the Netherlands bid, and the consequences for Dutch and British space sectors and future EU-UK cooperation. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands considered but declined to bid, Spain's bid scored best on objective criteria, and future EU-UK space cooperation is part of the ongoing Brexit negotiations.
The European Commission assessed the bids of the various member states on the basis of objective criteria.
De Europese Commissie heeft op basis van objectieve criteria de biedingen van de verschillende lidstaten beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de zorgen van bewoners van de Kustwegflats in Delfzijl

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about residents' concerns over earthquake safety and poor information in three Kustweg flats in Delfzijl, including whether the flats are safe and whether residents can see inspection reports. The minister says the Dijkzicht flat was assessed in 2015 with no acute danger but non-structural parts need securing, that the owner corporation Acantus has informed residents, and that the other two flats are still to be assessed pending NCG research.
Reinforcement advice is always shared with the owner of the home.
Versterkingsadviezen worden altijd gedeeld met de eigenaar van de woning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Beckerman over het bericht dat energiebedrijven experimenteren met prepaid energie

MPs Van Dijk and Beckerman asked whether prepaid energy pilots that bypass disconnection protections are acceptable and whether the minister would ban them. The minister replied that the voluntary pilots are small, that existing disconnection rules still apply, that no ministerial permission was required, and that the ACM and a broader debt-relief approach will be relied on.
No permission was requested or obtained.
Er is geen toestemming gevraagd of gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de overname chipbedrijf NXP door Qualcomm

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NXP's chip business is critical infrastructure, why nine regulators reviewed the Qualcomm takeover, and why the eight-year licensing remedy was chosen. The minister answered that chip design and manufacture have not met the critical-infrastructure criteria, that competition review does not cover such grounds, that jurisdictions review where a deal may affect their markets, and that the eight-year term was set by the European regulator without Dutch involvement.
These three impact criteria have so far given me no reason to classify the design and manufacture of chips as a vital process.
Deze drie impactcriteria hebben mij tot op heden geen aanleiding gegeven het ontwerpen en maken van chips aan te merken als vitaal proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over windenergie en luchthaven Lelystad

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the expansion of Lelystad Airport could harm wind energy sites and turbine heights in Flevoland, and whether the wind plans were protected and excluded from the airport's cost-benefit analysis. The Minister confirmed the conflict, said the parties are seeking ways to accommodate both projects, and stated that the cost-benefit analysis did not include effects on renewable energy.
The cost-benefit analysis concerns the social costs and benefits of the airport decision for expanding Lelystad Airport for international air traffic.
De MKBA heeft betrekking op de maatschappelijke kosten en baten van het luchthavenbesluit voor uitbreiding van Lelystad Airport voor het internationale vliegverkeer
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of Brexit for the Netherlands, focusing on a customs impact memo, customs staffing needs (500-800 extra staff), IT readiness and the timing of recruitment. The government answered that the Douane and NVWA are recruiting within existing frameworks, that analyses for internal deliberation will not be shared, and that preparations continue ahead of March 2019.
The analyses requested by your House were, however, prepared for internal deliberation and it is undesirable that they become the subject of political debate.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde analyses zijn echter opgesteld voor intern beraad en het is onwenselijk dat zij onderwerp zijn van politiek debat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kooiman over het bericht dat de aardbevingen in Groningen de gezondheid van Groningers aantasten

Two SP MPs asked whether the government accepts that earthquakes in Groningen harm residents' health, including a reported PTSD-like picture, and whether the state is responsible and will act. The minister acknowledges the health impact, says removing the causes of stress is the top priority, promises gas production reduction options and a public-law damage protocol, and commits to a health action plan from the RIVM and GGD by end of April.
Removing the causes of stress and uncertainty has the highest priority.
Het wegnemen van de oorzaken van de stress en onzekerheid heeft de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat lage- en middeninkomens in de financiële problemen komen bij gasloos wonen

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the minister whether low and middle incomes will face financial strain from switching homes off gas, citing a Milieudefensie-commissioned study, and how affordability and support for insulation will be ensured. The minister acknowledged the study, said the transition will carry costs for households and that affordability is a key starting point for the Klimaat- en Energieakkoord, pointed to existing subsidies and funds, and gave no concrete new commitments.
The cabinet's aim is to achieve the ambitious climate targets for 2030 and 2050 at the lowest possible cost for citizens and businesses.
Het is de inzet van het kabinet om de ambitieuze klimaatdoelstellingen voor 2030 en 2050 tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten voor burgers en bedrijven te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kooiman over de berichtgeving dat stress in bevingsgebied Groningen tot sterfgevallen leidt

MPs Beckerman and Kooiman (SP) asked ministers whether reports that earthquake-related stress in Groningen leads to deaths were known, and how affected people would be supported. Minister Wiebes replied that the government finds this worrying, prioritises removing the causes of stress, wants gas extraction reduced further this term, and wants damage settlement accelerated, referring to an earlier answer.
Removing the causes of the stress and uncertainty has the highest priority.
Het wegnemen van de oorzaken van de stress en onzekerheid heeft de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het blokkeren van de laagdrempelige procedure bij de Spreekuurrechter voor aardbevingsschadezaken

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked whether the Rechtbank Noord-Nederland blocked a Groningen earthquake damage case from the low-threshold Spreekuurrechter procedure after an internal intervention and contact with the NAM, and how access to justice for gas-damage victims will be ensured. The minister answers that the Spreekuurrechter pilot is for relatively simple disputes, the court itself judged the earthquake case unsuitable, the NAM was informed by letter and phone, and the new damage protocol and the EUR 200,000 fund for legal costs are being pursued.

For this deviating procedure a procedural regulation has been drawn up, which establishes that the Spreekuurrechter may decide that a case is not suitable for handling by the Spreekuurrechter, even if the parties would want it.

Voor deze afwijkende procedure is een procesreglement opgesteld en daarin is vastgelegd dat de Spreekuurrechter kan bepalen dat een zaak zich niet leent voor behandeling door de Spreekuurrechter, zelfs indien partijen dat wel zouden willen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘NAM waarschuwt voor aardbevingen in Overijssel’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the NAM's new gas extraction plan for Hardenberg, including information meetings, consultation of local authorities, chemical handling, the NAM-SodM dispute, the reversed burden of proof, and baseline surveys of buildings. The Minister answered that the procedure is at an early stage, that advisers including SodM, Tcbb and local bodies will be consulted, that an information evening will follow publication of the draft decision, and that a national independent damage scheme is being explored.
At present I still have advice requests outstanding with the Tcbb and with the municipality, province and water board.
Momenteel heb ik nog adviesvragen uitstaan bij Tcbb en bij de gemeente, provincie en het waterschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht 'Deel nieuw netwerk AkzoNobel lek als een mandje'

MP Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the newly built AkzoNobel brine pipeline network leaks, whether the measures taken are sufficient, how defective pipes were installed, whether the rest of the network is safe, and whether the old network may stay in use. The Minister answered that SodM considers the measures sufficient though work is unfinished, that up to fifteen factory-defective pipe sections were supplied, that the untested five-kilometre section is not in use, and that the investigation into other buyers is still ongoing.
In September 2016 the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) placed AkzoNobel's salt activities under intensified supervision.
In september 2016 heeft Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) de zoutactiviteiten van AkzoNobel onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Tongeren over waterzijdig inregelen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether waterside balancing of central heating systems is known to save energy, whether it is being promoted for SMEs, whether the estimated savings and payback period are correct, and whether it should be added to mandatory measures under the Environmental Management Act. The Minister confirmed awareness, said the measure will be addressed in talks with industry and Energy Agreement partners and in updating the approved measures list with a 5-year payback criterion, and said the payback estimates will be examined.
In the updating process I will examine in which sectors the measure meets the 5-year payback criterion.
In het actualisatieproces zal ik onderzoeken in welke branches de maatregel aan het criterium van 5 jaar terugverdientijd voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Veldman en Weverling over het bericht ‘Maakbedrijven trekken naar India wegens groeiend gebrek aan Nederlandse ingenieurs’

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Education about a newspaper report that manufacturing firms are moving to India due to a shortage of Dutch engineers, including expected shortages, number of firms leaving, and how other countries respond. The state secretary and minister answered that a shortage of technical talent is a growing constraint, that no integrated data exist on firms leaving or on the number of jobs lost, and that the government's Techniekpact is a model cited by other countries.
Statistics Netherlands does not keep data on the number of firms leaving the Netherlands.
Er worden (door het CBS) geen gegevens bijgehouden over aantallen bedrijven die uit Nederland vertrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Graaf over de magnesiumzoutwinning door Nedmag onder Kiel-Windeweer

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked whether Nedmag's planned magnesium salt mining under Kiel-Windeweer falls within the existing concession, whether SodM's critical advice on the Groningen geothermal project affects the mining vision, and whether mining permits should be published more widely across municipal borders. Minister Wiebes answered that the expansion fits the existing concession and 2013 mining plan (with a revised plan required if subsidence or method changes), that the geothermal concerns have no bearing on salt mining, and that the surface permit is published only in the municipality where the installation stands, as legally prescribed, while a mining plan is published across the whole affected area.
The draft approval decision (with all underlying documents) will be made available for inspection in the area covered by the mining plan.
Het ontwerpinstemmingsbesluit (met alle achterliggende documenten) zal in het gebied waarop het winningsplan betrekking heeft, ter inzage worden gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat aardbevingsdemonstranten politiebezoek kregen voorafgaand aan een geplande protestactie

Beckerman (SP) asked whether police visited earthquake-protest demonstrators at home before a planned action against NAM, based on a Facebook event list, and whether this was proportionate and a breach of the right to demonstrate. Minister Grapperhaus replied that home visits to gather information on possible public-order risks are normal police work under the mayor's responsibility, that the Groningen mayor said the method could have been less intrusive, and that the police chief spoke with the citizens concerned.
Actively contacting the persons involved following such signals by the police is one of the options for this and forms part of normal police work.
Het actief contact opnemen door de politie met betrokkene(n) naar aanleiding van dergelijke signalen is daartoe een van de mogelijkheden en maakt deel uit van het normale politiewerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de mogelijke overname van C&A door Chinese investeerders

MP Leijten asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of a possible takeover of C&A by Chinese investors, the motives of its owners, worker involvement and job protection, the implications of the Organon case for foreign acquisitions, reciprocity with China, and how other EU states handle this. The minister said C&A denied or did not confirm a sale, workers' interests are protected via works council rights and SER merger rules, foreign investment is welcome in an open economy, and the EU is pursuing a common approach and an investment screening framework.
As indicated earlier in answer to question 2, it is currently unknown whether the owners of C&A intend to sell (part of) the company.
Zoals eerder bij vraag 2 aangegeven is momenteel onbekend of de eigenaren van C&A voornemens zijn om (een deel van) het bedrijf te verkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Van Tongeren en Beckerman over de NAM-uitspraken en technische mogelijkheden voor het verminderen van gaswinning

MPs Nijboer, Van Tongeren and Beckerman asked the minister about NAM's claim that no additional safety measures were needed after a tremor, that the code red was wrongly issued, and about options to reduce Groningen gas extraction and exports of low-calorific gas.
