The minister defended SodM's assessment that the earthquake fit expected patterns, and outlined short-term limits and longer-term options to reduce gas demand, while declining to direct NAM's communications.
However, I do not decide on the way NAM presents its figures, reports and letters.
Ik ga echter niet over de wijze waarop NAM zijn cijfers, rapporten en brieven presenteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat Shell de NAM op afstand zet

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Shell's withdrawal of its 403 liability declaration for NAM affects compensation for Groningen earthquake damage and whether Shell can escape its responsibility. The minister answered that the withdrawal was known since June 2017, that NAM's legal obligations are unaffected, and that the State, Shell and ExxonMobil are negotiating to guarantee NAM's future financial obligations.
It was known that Shell had withdrawn the 403 declaration.
Het was bekend dat Shell de 403-verklaring had ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de artikelen 'Vragen en zorgen over gaswinning Zuidwest-Drenthe' en 'Opnieuw informatieavond gaswinning: Te druk, te chaotisch'

MP Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about public concerns over gas extraction by Vermilion in Zuidwest-Drenthe, including consultation practices, baseline measurements, the company's compliance record, and whether the decision was predetermined at information evenings. The minister responded that participation follows the statutory procedure, that SodM advice is weighed but not always followed, and that the company bears primary responsibility for community communication.
Although SodM's advice carries great weight, this does not mean that all advice is adopted in every case.
Hoewel de adviezen van SodM zeer zwaarwegend zijn, betekent dit niet dat in alle gevallen alle adviezen worden overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over het stellen van hogere kapitaaleisen aan leningen voor fossiele investeringen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether higher capital requirements should apply to loans for fossil investments and whether a green supporting factor should be resisted. The minister answered that capital rules serve prudential purposes and should not be used to steer investment, that other policy options are more effective, and that the government will not push for higher capital requirements on fossil lending.
No, capital requirements serve a prudential purpose and should not be used for other policy objectives.
Nee, kapitaaleisen dienen een prudentieel doel en moeten niet ingezet worden voor andere beleidsdoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

Three CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of a hard Brexit for the Netherlands, including the KPMG report on non-tariff trade barriers, planned actions, customs and inspection capacity, and information provision to businesses. The government answered that it is intensifying business information, hiring extra customs and NVWA staff, and that the cost of a hard Brexit is estimated at about 1.2% of GDP, while stressing that the EU-UK arrangements are still under negotiation.
The precise effect on employment is difficult to estimate, because trade can also shift to other countries and new jobs can therefore also arise.
Het precieze effect op de werkgelegenheid is moeilijk in te schatten, omdat handel zich ook kan verplaatsten naar andere landen en er dus ook weer nieuwe banen kunnen ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Veldman over het bericht ‘Nieuw innovatiebox-besluit stelt teleur’

MPs Lodders and Veldman asked the State Secretary of Finance about a critical press report on the new innovation box (innovatiebox) decision, including whether the scheme is accessible to entrepreneurs and which open questions remain. The State Secretary answered that entrepreneurs' experiences are largely positive, pointed to the evaluation, the flat-rate option, helpdesks and policy decisions, and acknowledged that some aspects such as aggregation level and IP access criteria are still being clarified, with a supplementary policy decision expected this year.
I therefore expect to supplement the policy decision on the new innovation box this year.
Ik verwacht het beleidsbesluit over de nieuwe innovatiebox dan ook dit jaar nog aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de procedure rond de aanleg van een 380 kV hoogspanningsverbinding van Eemshaven Oudeschip naar Vierverlaten

An MP asked whether the final investment plan and decisions for a 380 kV power line from Eemshaven to Vierverlaten should be submitted to parliament before being opened to appeal, and what instruments remain if the route should change. The minister answered that the Rijkscoördinatieregeling procedure does not provide for submission to parliament, that the decisions are final subject to appeal to the Raad van State, and that he does not intend to revisit them unless a court ruling requires it.
Submitting the inpassingsplan to the House of Representatives is not part of the legally regulated procedure.
Het voorleggen van het inpassingsplan aan de Tweede Kamer is geen onderdeel van de wettelijk geregelde procedure.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over mogelijke mijnbouwactiviteiten aan de grens met België bij Zuid-Limburg voor de winning van onder andere zink en mogelijke effecten voor de Nederlandse bie

CDA MPs asked whether Belgian mining exploration for zinc near the Dutch border, and the Einstein Telescope bid in South Limburg, threaten each other. The minister answered that the Belgian authorities did not notify the Netherlands, that a transboundary environmental assessment would be required, and that the Belgian mining could affect the telescope's noise environment, but that it is too early to judge and the matter will be investigated with the province and the Belgian authorities.
I was not informed by the Belgian authorities.
Ik ben door de Belgische autoriteiten niet op de hoogte gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over de toekomst van de vestiging Siemens in Hengelo (Overijssel)

Two CDA MPs asked the economy minister whether Siemens' Hengelo site will stay open under the Siemens name, whether Siemens Germany has been persuaded to keep jobs, and what the government is doing to save the business. The minister confirmed ongoing talks with Siemens, said serious buyers are interested, but withheld details of the scenarios and buyers, citing the sensitivity of the process.
In the interest of this process, it is not possible to make further statements about this.
In het belang van dit proces is het niet mogelijk daar verdere mededelingen over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de aanstaande sluiting van Siemens Hengelo

The SP MP Hijink asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate how effective his 'quiet diplomacy' is given the planned closure of Siemens Hengelo, why the plant closes despite orders, what public infrastructure investment was made and whether it can be recovered, and whether he will meet workers and inform parliament. The minister answered that talks with Siemens AG and local authorities continue, that the closure is a centralisation decision unrelated to order books, that investments were area-wide and not Siemens-specific, and that he sees no added value in meeting the union at this stage, without committing to new information beyond what he has.
I have little news to share with the union members at this moment and I think the conversation proposed by FNV Metaal therefore has no added value.
Ik heb de vakbondsleden op dit moment weinig nieuws te melden en vind dat het door FNV Metaal voorgestelde gesprek daarom geen toegevoegde waarde heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat geld verdienen aan CO2 kan en ook nog goed is voor het milieu

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether legal barriers hinder reuse of CO2 and whether the government will remove them. The minister answered that no barriers are known for CO2 use in building materials, pointed to the Klimaat- en Energieakkoord and the 'Ruimte in Regels' programme, and expressed enthusiasm for CO2 reuse as an emissions-reduction option.
In the case of reuse of CO2 in building materials, as described in the article referred to, I am not aware of any barriers.
In het geval van het hergebruik van CO 2 in bouwmaterialen, zoals beschreven in het artikel waaraan gerefereerd wordt, zijn mij geen belemmeringen bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het monopolie van sportbonden

D66 MPs asked whether the European Commission's ruling against the ISU's eligibility rules for skaters racing outside federation structures affects Dutch athletes, whether pro football clubs could play outside the Dutch pyramid, whether other federations sanction athletes similarly, and whether Dutch law should change. The minister replied that the ruling concerns the ISU alone, that FIFA rules allow pro clubs to play outside the calendar with federation permission, that no comparable federation sanctions are known, and that no change to Dutch law is needed.
In light of the above, I see no reason to amend laws and regulations.
In het licht van bovenstaande zie ik geen aanleiding om wet- en regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ongelijke schadevergoedingen die grondeigenaren ontvangen bij de plaatsing van hoogspanningsmasten en leidingen op en onder hun grond

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why landowners receive unequal compensation when high-voltage masts and cables are placed on or under their land, how the Belemmeringenwet Privaatrecht compulsory-tolerance rule relates to negotiated compensation, and whether past lump-sum buyouts should be revised. The minister answers that full compensation is the legal standard, that TenneT keeps no overview of individual negotiated outcomes, that the 2013 LTO agreements apply uniformly, and that no revision is planned because the principle of full compensation was applied.
I do not have an overview of the outcomes of negotiations in individual situations.
Ik heb geen overzicht van uitkomsten van onderhandelingen in individuele situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurders in Groningen die in de steek worden gelaten

MP Nijboer asks whether it is acceptable that Groningen housing corporations and tenants face prolonged uncertainty over earthquake reinforcement procedures and standards, and whether the government will provide clarity and hold corporations accountable for neglected maintenance. Minister Ollongren answers that clarity is a priority, that the norm changes only when NEN makes significant improvements, that tenants can pressure corporations through existing channels, and that she is in talks with corporations, though the minister's role on specific maintenance complaints is limited to setting the framework.
The central government is therefore making every effort to remove the resulting uncertainties, for housing corporations and other stakeholders, as quickly as possible.
Het Rijk spant zich dan ook in om de ontstane onduidelijkheden, voor woningcorporaties en andere betrokkenen, zo snel mogelijk weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de milieueffecten van bitcoins

An MP asked the minister about the environmental impact of Bitcoin mining's electricity use, whether blockchain could become a major burden, and whether climate targets account for it. The state secretary answered that Bitcoin's energy use is hard to estimate, that Dutch energy prices make mining unattractive, that energy-saving policy applies generally, and that no separate research or climate-target adjustment is planned.

Specific research into the energy use of cryptocurrencies and the technology is not appropriate, because the technology is still in its infancy and bitcoin is a global development over which I have no influence.

Specifiek onderzoek naar energiegebruik van cryptocurrencies en technologie is niet aan de orde, omdat de technologie nog in de kinderschoenen staat en de bitcoin een wereldwijde ontwikkeling is, waar ik geen invloed op heb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat Nederland de EU-duurzaamheidsdoelen niet haalt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the government favours fossil industry interests or ambitious climate policy, how it will tackle the industry's ties to the economy, and how a Klimaat- en Energieakkoord will bind heavy industry. The minister answered that the government targets a 49% greenhouse gas cut by 2030, will push the EU target to 55%, sees CCS as a transition technology, and will set sectoral reduction targets for industry within the upcoming Climate and Energy Agreement.
The cabinet will make agreements in the Climate and Energy Agreement on how the 2030 reduction target will be achieved and the role of the share of renewable energy in this.
Het kabinet zal in het Klimaat- en Energieakkoord afspraken maken op welke manier het reductiedoel in 2030 wordt gerealiseerd en de rol van het aandeel hernieuwbare energie hierin.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat klimaatmaatregelen de burgers klauwen met geld gaan kosten

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports that climate measures will cost households 50-60 euros per month by 2030, whether this is worthless and unaffordable, and why the government does not scrap the measures. The Minister answers that the figures are national additional costs of 49% CO2 reduction (about 3.5-5.5 billion euros), not household energy bills, that a global approach is needed, and that the government will pursue a cost-effective transition.
The Paris Climate Agreement is a breakthrough in the fight against further global warming, and it is our duty to do everything to realise the goals of this Agreement.
Het Klimaatakkoord van Parijs is een doorbraak in de strijd tegen de verdere opwarming van de aarde en het is onze plicht er alles aan te doen om de doelstellingen uit dit Akkoord te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de indringende brief van 15.373 (klimaat)wetenschappers over de toestand van de aarde

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the 2017 World Scientists' Warning to Humanity and whether the government shares its concerns on climate, deforestation, meat production and the sixth mass extinction. The minister acknowledges the letter, points to the Montreal Protocol and Paris Agreement as frameworks, says Dutch climate policy stays ambitious without rethinking Dutch positions, and prefers technical over volume-limiting measures for livestock emissions.
It is important that countries now also deliver.
Het is wel zaak dat landen nu ook gaan leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over contourenlijnen in het aardbevingsgebied

Nijboer and Beckerman asked whether the administrative contour lines should still determine damage assessment and reinforcement of homes in the Groningen earthquake area, and why different building norms apply outside the contour. Minister Wiebes answered that NAM is liable regardless of location, a new damage protocol without NAM's role is being negotiated, the NPR applies inside the area while outside it additional norms add no value, and he declined to comment on an individual court case.
Intensive consultation is currently taking place among all parties on a new damage protocol in which NAM no longer plays a role in assessing damage reports.
Op dit moment vindt intensief overleg plaats tussen alle betrokken partijen over een nieuw schadeprotocol, waarin NAM geen rol meer speelt in de beoordeling van schademeldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over kosten van NAM die betaald worden door EBN

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why NAM charged EUR 48.7 million in reorganisation costs to EBN, how this arises from agreements with the state, whether Ernst & Young advice was used, and who bears Groningen damage costs. The minister answered that EBN bears 40% of operator costs under cooperation agreements, that the reorganisation was audited by Ernst & Young, but declined to share the advice citing confidential business and personal information.

Because this concerns the execution of a private-law agreement between EBN and an operator and the documents contain personal and business-sensitive information, I do not have the advice or other documents from Ernst & Young.

Omdat het hier gaat om de uitvoering van een privaatrechtelijke overeenkomst tussen EBN en een operator en de stukken persoons- en bedrijfsgevoelige informatie bevatten, beschik ik niet over het advies of andere stukken van Ernst & Young.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de Staat meebetaalt aan de reorganisatie van NAM

MP Wassenberg asked whether the State, via EBN, co-pays NAM's reorganisation costs (EUR 48.7 million), whether the 1963 agreements are secret, and whether EBN was pressured to pay. Minister Wiebes answered that EBN pays 40% of operator costs under confidential private-law cooperation agreements, that an Ernst & Young audit found the calculation compliant, and that the advice cannot be shared.

Because this concerns the execution of a private-law agreement between EBN and an operator and the documents contain personal and commercially sensitive information, I do not have the advice or other documents from Ernst & Young.

Omdat het hier gaat om de uitvoering van een privaatrechtelijke overeenkomst tussen EBN en een operator en de stukken persoons- en bedrijfsgevoelige informatie bevatten, beschik ik niet over het advies of andere stukken van Ernst & Young.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Nijboer en Van Tongeren over het bericht “Echtpaar kraakt droomhuis om sloop te voorkomen”

MPs asked the minister about a couple who squatted a characteristic farmhouse in Middelstum to prevent its demolition by NAM, and whether NAM's demand that they leave within two days was acceptable. The minister said the couple left for safety reasons, that the future of the building is separate, that heritage preservation is a key principle and NAM has pledged to work toward keeping the house, and that a state housing company will be set up to manage acquired property.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de aardbeving in Groningen op maandag 8 januari 2018 met een kracht van 3.4 op de schaal van Richter

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the 8 January 2018 Groningen earthquake, including whether gas extraction should be cut further, the Loppersum cluster, damage settlement without a protocol, and inspections of dikes and chemical plants. The minister answered that extraction must come down, that a new damage protocol and monitoring measures are being prioritised, and that advice from SodM and Gasunie is awaited.
I am awaiting both advices before I can address the measures proposed by NAM.
Ik wacht beide adviezen af voordat ik kan ingaan op de voorgestelde maatregelen van de NAM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aardbeving in ‘t Zandt

An MP asked the Economic Affairs Minister about a 3.4 magnitude earthquake near Zeerijp, the number of new damage reports, whether listed heritage buildings could be demolished faster by NAM, where damage can be reported, and acceptable timelines for repair. The minister confirmed the quake, reported about 2,900 new damage reports, rejected faster demolition, described reporting channels, and said a new damage protocol is the top priority without giving a firm date.
Accelerating demolition is however not in line with the principle in damage repair and reinforcement that characteristic and landmark buildings should be preserved as far as possible.
Het versneld overgaan tot sloop is echter niet in lijn met het uitgangspunt bij schadeherstel en versterking dat karakteristieke en beeldbepalende gebouwen zoveel mogelijk behouden dienen te blijven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat de NAM de omvang van de noodzakelijke woningversterking veel te laag inschat (Herdruk)

MP Kops asks why NAM estimates only 2,800 buildings need reinforcement in the Groningen earthquake area, questioning its good faith and payment capacity. The minister replies that NAM is liable for all necessary reinforcement regardless of earlier estimates, that inspections already show 3,300 buildings needing it, that TNO will independently review NAM's calculations, and that NAM is being phased out of decision-making in the damage process.
I have asked TNO to independently assess the calculations commissioned by NAM.
Ik heb aan TNO verzocht om de berekeningen in opdracht van NAM onafhankelijk te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Jasper van Dijk over het afsluiten van gas, water en licht

Two SP MPs asked whether households failing to pay energy bills will be cut off less quickly now that suppliers must first refer them to debt assistance, and how that works, plus questions on water cut-offs, health risks and a similar water rule. The minister confirmed the referral duty, described the winter-period procedure, said a summer extension is planned, and committed to amending the water cut-off regulation with the VNG and Vewin.
I am willing to draw up a similar kind of regulation.
Ik ben bereid eenzelfde soort regeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Boeren multimiljonair dankzij subsidie'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why a wind farm on the IJsselmeer reportedly yields farmers millions on top of nearly 600 million euros in subsidies, and whether the project should be stopped. The minister defended the subsidies as compensating for innovation risks, said an overcompensation check is under way that could reduce payments, and refused to halt the project.
For this reason the decision provides that the Dutch authorities will carry out a cumulation test for the notified project one year after the installation is put into use.
Daarom is in de beschikking opgenomen dat de Nederlandse autoriteiten voor het aangemelde project een cumulatietoets uitvoeren één jaar na de datum van ingebruikname van de installatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de financiële sector vervuilers kan aanpakken

An MP asked whether a new CO2 footprint model for financial portfolios improves public transparency on sustainability and whether the sector should be bound by enforceable climate targets. The minister welcomed the model as increasing transparency, said a Climate Act is being explored and that the EU expert group will report in spring 2018, but noted the model covers only CO2, not broader environmental or social aspects.
I welcome the methodology developed by twelve Dutch financial institutions to map the CO2 footprint of the portfolio(s) of individual institutions.
Ik verwelkom de methodiek die door twaalf Nederlandse financiële instellingen is ontwikkeld om de CO 2 -voetafdruk van de portefeuille(s) van individuele instellingen in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de overname van de margarinedivisie van Unilever door KKR

An SP MP asked the Economy minister whether the government would monitor the sale of Unilever's margarine division to KKR, its effects on jobs and R&D, whether KKR's expected strategy of milking the business is an activist-shareholder excess, how stakeholders were considered, and how debt loading would be prevented. The minister said the government is in ongoing talks with Unilever to keep activities and jobs in the Netherlands, respects corporate autonomy and declines to comment on KKR's decision, and pointed to existing and forthcoming interest-deduction limits in corporate tax law.
For substantial decisions the cabinet keeps a close eye on the situation and will also examine the consequences of any adjustment to the strategy.
Het kabinet houdt bij wezenlijke beslissingen de vinger aan de pols en zal daarbij ook bezien welke gevolgen de eventuele aanpassing van de strategie zal hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de plannen voor de aanleg van een eiland voor een internationale energiehub

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a North Sea energy island could serve as an energy hub, whether government should take an active role, and where it should be located, including involvement of northern ports and provinces. The minister answered that the idea is conceptual and that the government focuses on already designated offshore wind zones, will be kept informed of the initiators' research, and that site selection is not yet on the agenda.
I am aware of the initiators' efforts and have agreed to be kept informed of the developments and outcomes of the research.
Ik ben op de hoogte van de inspanningen van de initiatiefnemers en heb afgesproken dat ik op de hoogte wordt gehouden van de ontwikkelingen en uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de artikelen 'Bewoners Zuidlaren weinig wijzer van onderzoek aardbevingsschade' en 'Ziek worden we van gedrag van de NAM'

MP Van Tongeren asks the minister why residents of Zuidlaren and Annen still lack clarity on NAM compensation for earthquake damage, whether the cost of damage investigations can exceed repair costs, and whether scratch damage should automatically be attributed to the quake. The minister acknowledges the need for transparent, independent damage handling, has asked the Tcbb to explore a nationwide damage protocol with an independent body, and will consult NAM and local authorities on speeding up settlement.

I have therefore asked the Technical Committee on Bodembeweging (Tcbb) to explore the option of establishing a uniform damage protocol for all of the Netherlands for damage caused by mining, with an independent body handling the damage.

Ik heb daarom de Technische commissie bodembeweging (Tcbb) gevraagd de optie te verkennen om voor heel Nederland een gelijkluidend schadeprotocol in te richten voor schade veroorzaakt door mijnbouw met een onafhankelijk orgaan dat de schade afhandelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Weverling over reorganisatie en bezuinigingen bij DowDuPont

MPs Dijkstra and Weverling asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the reported 500 job cuts at DuPont, the Dutch employment and investment picture of DowDuPont, and how to keep the Netherlands attractive for such firms. The minister confirmed the 500 figure applies only to DuPont, gave location-by-location employment and investment figures, and framed the chemical sector's role in decarbonisation.
Possible investments or divestments in the Netherlands resulting from these plans are not yet known.
Mogelijke investeringen of desinvesteringen in Nederland als gevolg van deze plannen zijn nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over de gaslobby

MPs Beckerman and Leijten asked ministers about gas-industry lobbying, Shell's role at Rotterdam School of Management, government access for Shell, gas infrastructure overcapacity, EU lobbying transparency, and methane emissions. The ministers answered that universities set curricula, Shell has the same access as other firms, network investments follow public consultation and regulator review, existing lobbying rules need no change, and a methane letter will follow by Q2 2018.
There is no reason to amend the existing rules and regulations on lobbying.
Er is geen aanleiding om de bestaande regels en voorschriften met betrekking tot lobbyen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat de groeiende luchtvaart het halen van klimaatdoelstellingen onmogelijk maakt

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether research showing aviation growth makes Paris climate targets unattainable is accepted, and whether plans for more flights at Schiphol and Lelystad Airport are responsible. The minister acknowledged the research, said the government will pursue global and EU measures and a forthcoming aviation policy note will address flight growth, but declined to draw conclusions in advance.
Next year I will prepare a new aviation policy note, in which I will set out my vision on the development of aviation for the coming decades.
Komend jaar zal ik een nieuwe luchtvaartnota opstellen, waarin ik mijn visie op de ontwikkeling van de luchtvaart voor de komende tientallen jaren zal formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over de hybride warmtepomp als alternatief voor gasgebruik in woningen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report showing hybrid heat pumps could cheaply make homes energy-neutral, and whether the government would appraise it, fund a steering group, and respond to a proposed ban on gas boilers. The minister said hybrid pumps can cut CO2 quickly but full decarbonisation depends on scarce, costly renewable gas, pointed to existing subsidy schemes (ISDE, SDE+, Hernieuwbare Energieregeling) rather than a new steering group, and said a future gas-boiler ban is being studied.
A ban on gas boilers in the longer term is also being examined by us.
Een verbod op gasketels op termijn nemen we daarbij eveneens in onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over het opkopen van emissierechten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a coalition of leading countries should buy up surplus EU emission allowances to raise the carbon price and speed up climate ambitions, and about the cost and benefits. The minister rejected the buy-up idea, stating that planned ETS reforms (market stability reserve and cancellation from 2023) will remove most of the surplus, and that a minimum carbon price for electricity is planned.

Once there is a formal agreement on the revision of the ETS Directive, I will send your House a letter explaining the main elements of the agreement and its consequences for the functioning of the ETS.

Zodra er een formeel akkoord is over de herziening van de ETS-richtlijn, zal ik uw Kamer een brief toesturen waarin nader ingegaan wordt op de belangrijkste elementen van het akkoord en de consequenties daarvan voor de werking van het ETS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het bericht dat de export van Gronings gas verder stijgt

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether rising exports of Groningen gas were undesirable, whether they conflict with the Chamber's wish to end export contracts early, and for export forecasts and full disclosure of export contracts. The minister replied that export volumes follow physical demand abroad, that no new export contracts have been signed since 2014, and that forecasts fall to zero by 2030, but declined full disclosure of the contracts as commercially confidential.
Since these contracts are concluded between private parties and also contain commercially confidential information, I do not intend to make them public.
Aangezien deze contracten zijn gesloten tussen private partijen en daarnaast ook bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie bevatten, ben ik niet voornemens deze openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat er een lek is geweest bij een Duitse kerncentrale

An SP MP asked the Dutch government about a reported leak at the German Emsland nuclear plant near Emmen, including its safety classification, whether ANVS would investigate, cross-border cooperation and whether the plant should be closed early. The state secretary answered that the leak was a minor INES-0 event affecting non-radioactive cooling water, that ANVS would not conduct its own investigation as the incident occurred abroad, and that nuclear safety is a German national responsibility.
No. The ANVS indicates it does not have the impression that the German supervisor and the license holder are failing to fulfil their responsibility in this unusual event.
Nee. De ANVS geeft aan niet het beeld te hebben dat de Duitse toezichthouder en de vergunninghouder in deze ongewone gebeurtenis hun verantwoordelijkheid niet goed invullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de berichtgeving over twijfels over de veiligheid van gasmeters

An MP asked the minister about reports that about 44,000 Landis+Gyr smart gas meters had a production defect, including repaired meters with a wrong glue, and about safety, replacement timing, cost and prevention. The minister answered that SodM has ordered replacement by 1 April 2018, that the consumer should not pay, and that responsibility for costs is still being examined.
SodM therefore ordered the grid operators concerned to replace the meters with the wrong glue immediately.
Daarop heeft SodM de betrokken netbeheerders gesommeerd de meters met de verkeerde lijm per direct te vervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de uitzendingen van Kassa over de veiligheid van slimme gasmeters

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why only Stedin replaced its smart gas meters quickly, whether an independent investigation could follow, whether Enexis would be pressed to inform customers correctly, who supervises meter safety, and who can force faster replacement. The Minister answered that the grid operators judged the meters not an immediate safety risk, that SodM is now investigating and has ordered replacement of meters with short threads by 1 April 2018, and that the supervisory responsibilities are being clarified through a bill.
From this it appears that the grid operators immediately stopped installing meters after the first signals from practice about the production defect.
Daaruit blijkt dat de netbeheerders direct zijn gestopt met het plaatsen van meters na de eerste signalen uit de praktijk over de productiefout.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Moorlag over het bericht dat België zijn kerncentrales langer zou openhouden

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Belgium's Tihange and Doel nuclear plants would stay open beyond 2025, whether this breaks Belgian phase-out commitments, and what the Netherlands will do to press for closure and raise it at EU level. The minister replied that Belgian energy-pact negotiations are pending, that Nederland relies on the coalition agreement, that nuclear safety is primarily Belgium's responsibility, that the ANVS has strengthened cooperation with the Belgian regulator, and that the issue can be raised through EU energy-plan consultation and bilateral channels.
The safety of the Belgian plants is first and foremost a Belgian responsibility.
De veiligheid van de Belgische centrales is op de eerste plaats een Belgische verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het sluiten van Siemens Hengelo

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Siemens' announced closure of its Hengelo plant with 600 jobs at stake, including whether the ministry knew earlier and what action it would take to keep the plant. The minister answered that the ministry was surprised by the announcement, is in close contact with Siemens and has asked it to keep the site, and will take an active role with the province and municipality if a useful role for government emerges.
I am in close contact with Siemens and have asked for the site to be retained.
Ik sta in nauw contact met Siemens en heb gevraagd om behoud van de vestiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de gevolgen van schade door aardbevingen op de gezondheid

An SP MP asks the ministers about the health effects of earthquake damage in Groningen, citing a rise in health complaints, the under-counting of damage in the NAM register, the closed damage protocol, and the NAM's close operational and financial ties to the Centrum Veilig Wonen. The minister answers that the damage process is stalled pending a new protocol, that NAM will step back from damage decisions, and that a regional fund and a public-controlled damage fund are being explored, while declining to publish the NAM-CVW contract and stating that the KPMG report was already sent to parliament.
However, the old damage-handling protocol set by NAM has been closed and damage handling has been at a standstill for some time pending a new damage protocol.
Het oude, door NAM vastgestelde protocol voor behandeling van schademeldingen is echter gesloten en de schadeafhandeling ligt al geruime tijd stil in afwachting van een nieuw schadeprotocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het verhogen van de CO2-reductiedoelstelling naar 55%

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate how the EU 2030 CO2 target would be raised to 55%, what concrete steps, timelines and allies he has, and whether stronger measures such as livestock volume limits and a ban on oil and gas production should be adopted. The minister answered that raising the target requires EU unanimity, will be pursued with like-minded states toward 2020, rejects livestock volume limits in favour of technical measures and does not consider a fossil fuel ban desirable now, while promising a Climate Act and a Climate and Energy Agreement with a letter to parliament on short notice.
On the process and planning of both the Climate Act and the Climate and Energy Agreement, I will inform your House in a letter at very short notice.
Over het proces en de planning van zowel de Klimaatwet als (de totstandkoming van) het Klimaat- en energieakkoord zal ik uw Tweede Kamer op zeer korte termijn per brief nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de Rotterdamse gemeenteraad af wil van steenkooloverslag

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Rotterdam council's motion to end coal transshipment at EMO, and whether the government will protect EMO and its workers and intervene to defend the port. The minister answered that EMO's situation is a matter between the company and the Port of Rotterdam Authority, and that he hopes the energy transition will benefit the economy and jobs.
As I indicated in my letter of 7 November (Kamerstuk 30 196, no. 560), I regard the situation of EMO in the Rotterdam port as a matter between this company and the Port of Rotterdam Authority.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 7 november jl. (Kamerstuk 30 196, nr. 560 ) heb aangegeven, beschouw ik de situatie van EMO in de Rotterdamse haven als een kwestie tussen dit bedrijf en het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over huurtoeslag in familiesituaties

An MP asked whether parents renting a home to their child in order to claim housing benefit (huurtoeslag) is acceptable and how it could be prevented. The minister said the rules allow family landlords, that the Tax Administration monitors rent levels, and that a family-specific ban would violate equal treatment, so no rule change is planned.
However, I see no feasible options to adjust the housing benefit scheme so that such a construction within the legal framework is made impossible specifically for family situations.
Ik zie echter geen uitvoerbare mogelijkheden de huurtoeslagregeling zo aan te passen dat een constructie binnen de wettelijke kaders specifiek voor familiesituaties onmogelijk wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Kröger en Van der Lee over de berichten 'CO2-uitstoot auto's in EU met een derde omlaag in 2030' en ‘Autokoper gaat weer voor groot en zwaar’

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about the EU proposal for tighter CO2 standards for new cars from 2025 and 2030, the rise in average CO2 emissions of new cars after the Autobrief II tax changes, and whether a ban on fossil-fuel car imports is planned. The state secretary answered that a detailed position will follow in a BNC-fiche, that emissions may temporarily rise but are expected to fall as zero-emission car sales grow, and that an import ban would conflict with the EU treaty on free movement.
You will shortly receive the BNC-fiche containing the cabinet position and the Dutch negotiating stance for the upcoming negotiations.
U ontvangt op korte termijn het bnc-fiche met daarin het kabinetsstandpunt en de Nederlandse inzet voor de aankomende onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “Stoot Nederlandse melkkoe meeste of minste methaan uit binnen Europa”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether differing EU member-state methods for estimating dairy cow methane emissions create an uneven playing field and whether Dutch methods should be harmonised. The minister answered that the IPCC-based, differentiated methods are mandatory and effective, that the earlier high figures were outdated and recalculated, and that no further harmonisation steps are needed.
I do not consider additional steps necessary, because the differences in calculation method are in line with international agreements and depend on the size of the source.
Ik acht aanvullende stappen niet nodig, want de verschillen in berekeningsmethode zijn overeenkomstig internationale afspraken en afhankelijk van de omvang van de bron.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Geurts en Dijkgraaf over het bericht van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek over het Living Planet Report

MPs Bruins, Geurts and Dijkgraaf asked about a CBS Living Planet Report claim that bottom trawling is a major cause of decline in North Sea benthic fauna, which Wageningen Marine Research said could not be concluded from its data, and about CBS's paid work for interest groups. The minister confirms the data sources, says CBS corrected the claim to attribute the finding to Wageningen research, and states that CBS's paid-work terms preserve its independence, while declining to go further on rectification or apology.
CBS concluded that its original report of 30 October required adjustments on some points and published a revised version on 3 November.
Het CBS is tot de conclusie gekomen dat het oorspronkelijke bericht van 30 oktober jl. op enkele punten aanpassing behoefde en heeft op 3 november jl. een aangepaste versie gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het UNEP Emissions Gap Report en het Fourth National Climate Assessment van het USGCRP

The MP asks whether the minister knows of the UNEP Emissions Gap Report 2017 and the US Fourth National Climate Assessment showing Paris targets are extremely unlikely, and what Dutch policy will be on further emission cuts, coal plant closure costs, emission reduction tables and the INEK planning. The minister confirms awareness, says Dutch ambition of 49% (possibly 55%) by 2030 is in line with Paris, declines to plan coal closures before 2018 as not relevant, and says tables and the INEK timeline depend on pending work and negotiations.
I am aware of those reports.
Ik ben bekend met die rapporten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Van Raan en Kröger over de Jonge Klimaatagenda

Three MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Young Climate Agenda, including how young people can be involved in climate policy and how its themes of work and education will be reflected in implementation. The minister acknowledged youth's importance, pointed to past support for youth participation and a Climate Envoy, and said work and education themes will be explored in coming months, including via a forthcoming SER advisory report.

In the coming months I will, together with relevant cabinet colleagues and in consultation with social partners and education, examine how these themes can be incorporated into the further elaboration of the plans.

In de komende maanden zal ik in samenwerking met de relevante collega’s uit het kabinet en in overleg met sociale partners en het onderwijs, bezien op welke wijze deze thema’s kunnen worden meegenomen in de verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Tongeren over het rapport van de Kinderombudsman over aandacht voor kinderen en jongeren in aardbevingsgebied

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Children's Ombudsman report on children and young people in the earthquake area, covering consideration of children's interests in gas extraction and repair decisions, relocation, school building safety, information for children, the earthquake lesson pack, and health research. The minister answered that child safety is central, that a school programme targets completion by 2020, that relocation is arranged with residents where possible, and that the National Coordinator Groningen will improve information and stimulate use of the lesson pack, while leaving broader research on children to be considered.
Figures on the use of the lesson pack are not known, but the findings of the Children's Ombudsman show its added value.
Cijfers over het gebruik van het lespakket zijn niet bekend, maar de bevindingen van de Kinderombudsman laten de toegevoegde waarde ervan zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de concentratie van broeikasgassen in de atmosfeer

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about rising atmospheric greenhouse gas concentrations and a PBL analysis showing the coalition agreement brings only half of the climate targets within reach, asking whether the government's plan is adequate and whether it will act decisively. The minister acknowledged the reports, argued Dutch emissions are on track for a 23% reduction by 2020 and that the 2030 49% target is the government's goal, promising a Climate Act and a Climate and Energy Agreement, while stating not all 2030 reductions will occur within this term.
we will set in motion measures in the coming period that prepare the Netherlands for a 49% reduction in 2030
we zullen de komende periode maatregelen in gang zetten die Nederland voorbereiden op een reductie van 49% in 2030
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de belastingvlucht van brillenketens

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the low corporate tax paid by large spectacle retail chains via foreign structures, whether this is aggressive tax planning, whether an advance pricing agreement with Specsavers exists and was reviewed by the inquiry committee, whether Guernsey will face withholding tax, and how ruling practice avoids distorting competition. The State Secretary refused to confirm or deny individual rulings or tax positions under the confidentiality rule of article 67 AWR, stated ruling access is equal for all, and said the government will pursue its approach against tax avoidance while keeping an attractive investment climate.
Regarding the tax affairs of an individual taxpayer, I cannot make any statements given the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over belastingaangelegenheden van een individuele belastingplichtige kan ik gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht dat er met oud-korpschef Welten een uitzonderlijke belastingdeal is gesloten

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports of an exceptional tax deal for former police chief Welten, including whether he avoids income tax on about 130,000 euros, the revenue loss, publication of the advice, and whether other top earners have similar arrangements. The State Secretary declined to discuss an individual's tax affairs citing the statutory confidentiality duty, denied involvement or prior knowledge, and declined to comment on the integrity question.
Regarding the tax affairs of an individual taxpayer, I cannot make any statements given the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act.
Over belastingaangelegenheden van een individuele belastingplichtige kan ik gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over de afschaffing van de huurtoeslag voor bewoners van vakantiewoningen

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked how residents of holiday homes were informed about the abolition of rent allowance, why notices came late, and whether municipalities were informed. The Minister replied that holiday-home renters were not separately registered and could not be informed individually, that the VNG was asked to inform municipalities, and that the statutory notice period cannot be extended.
Following this recent reporting, it has become apparent that communication about the change in rent allowance rules for holiday homes on holiday-use businesses was not clear to everyone.

Naar aanleiding van deze recente berichtgeving is gebleken dat de communicatie over de wijziging van de regels voor huurtoeslag voor vakantiewoningen op vakantiebestedingsbedrijven niet voor iedereen duidelijk is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over fiscale aspecten van specifieke uitkeringen op grond van de Duitse wet

MP Van Rooijen asked why the German ghetto pension is taxed in the Netherlands while Germany exempts it, whether it should be treated like Artikel 2-Fonds benefits, and asked for the Landsadvocaat's advice. The State Secretary confirmed the Dutch taxation under progression reservation, defended the different treatment of Artikel 2-Fonds benefits, and refused to release the advice as not customary.
It is not customary to share a Landsadvocaat's advice with the House of Representatives.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om een advies van de landsadvocaat te delen met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Raan en Van der Lee over de APA-/ATR-praktijk

MPs Leijten, Van Raan and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary of Finance how the critical assumption in informal capital rulings (that a complete and accurate picture is given to foreign tax authorities) can be met without proactive disclosure, how compliance is checked, and about exchange of information, the Belgian state aid case, the 1986-1995 suspension, hybrid entities and the value involved. The State Secretary answered that non-compliance (failure to provide information on request) ends the APA/ATR, that 19 ATRs and 40 APAs were checked in 2016 leading to three ATR terminations, and that the government does not track the total value of informal capital rulings.
Since the introduction of the APA/ATR practice, the number of rulings with an informal capital element has not been systematically recorded when registering requested and granted APAs.
Sinds de invoering van de APA-/ATR-praktijk is bij het registeren van aangevraagde en toegewezen APA’s het aantal rulings met een informeel kapitaalelement niet systematisch bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de nieuwe Europese pseudowetgeving voor belastingrulingpraktijken van EU-lidstaten en de gevolgen voor de huidige Nederlandse praktijk

MP Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the EU Code of Conduct Group's new guidance on tax rulings and its consequences for Dutch ruling practice, including transparency, publication of rulings, staffing, and the Netherlands' compliance. State Secretary Wiebes answered that the Netherlands largely complies, some Tax Authority practices may need adjustment with findings due in 2018, and that publication of all rulings is limited by confidentiality rules and burden, while offering alternative transparency measures.
I attach great importance to taxpayers, large and small, who seek advance certainty about their tax position being able to rely on confidential treatment of their data.
Ik hecht er sterk aan dat belastingplichtigen – groot en klein – die zekerheid vooraf wensen over hun fiscale situatie kunnen rekenen op vertrouwelijke omgang met hun gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over informatiebeveiliging

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about data security at the Broedkamer programme and its predecessors, including the forensic investigation into the tender, downloads of tax data, data-leak reporting and monitoring. The State Secretary answers that the investigation is still ongoing, that interim reports were not received, that some internal memos and the Oliver Wyman report cannot be published in full, and lists measures taken, though several questions are answered only partially.
Once I have received the report I will inform your House and send the report.
Zodra ik het rapport heb ontvangen zal ik uw Kamer informeren en het rapport toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Beckerman over het mogelijk steunen van de fossiele sector door middel van exportkredietverzekeringen, in dit geval Boskalis en van Oord

MPs Van Raan and Beckerman asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (Atradius DSB) would support Boskalis and Van Oord's role in the Nord Stream 2 pipeline and whether this conflicts with Paris climate goals. The government answered that a non-binding letter of interest was issued, that each application will undergo an environmental and social assessment, and that it sees no reason to exclude oil and gas projects from export credit insurance, while stating the political debate falls outside the scope of the export credit framework.
When assessing any applications, political and financial risks will be examined and an assessment of environmental and social impacts will be carried out.
Bij de beoordeling van eventuele aanvragen zal naar de politieke en financiële risico's worden gekeken en zal een beoordeling van de milieu en sociale gevolgen worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Beckerman over het steunen van de fossiele sector door middel van exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs Van Raan and Beckerman asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (EKV) support for fossil-fuel-related projects conflicts with the Paris Agreement, and asked about a phase-out plan, disclosure, coal and fossil exclusion lists and related OECD and fund matters. The Secretary of State answered that EKV is a generic, demand-driven instrument, that no phase-out plan is being prepared, that information disclosure and CSR policy are being developed, and that the government still supports ending public finance for new coal plants abroad but rejects an oil and gas exclusion list.
As described in the answer to question 2, no such plan is being worked on.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 2 beschreven wordt er niet gewerkt aan een dergelijk plan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de berichtgeving van de samenwerking tussen het Openbaar Ministerie en de Belastingdienst om criminelen in hun portemonnee te raken

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reported weak cooperation between the Public Prosecution Service and the Tax Authority in recovering criminal proceeds, including why confiscation often yields less than claimed, whether tax recovery works after failed criminal recovery, how often offshore concealment occurs, and whether multidisciplinary asset-recovery teams and more investigative capacity are warranted. The minister answered that cooperation already exists and is periodically evaluated, that figures on tax recovery and concealment are not kept, that RIEC structures are preferred over new teams, and that extra funding (5 to 20 million euro a year from 2018, plus 30 million reserved for 2018) has been provided.

The number of cases in which the Tax Authority still recovers money from criminals via tax reassessment after the criminal asset-recovery route has (partly) failed is not tracked and no figures are available.

Het aantal gevallen waarin de Belastingdienst als nog via fiscale navordering en naheffing geld terug haalt bij criminelen als het strafrechtelijke afpaktraject (deels) mislukt, wordt niet bijgehouden en cijfers zijn dan ook niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Bergkamp over vennootschapsbelasting in de jeugdhulpverlening

MPs Raemakers and Bergkamp asked whether youth care organisations fall under corporate tax and which care sectors are exempt, after a 2017 article raised confusion. The state secretaries answered that youth care providers are generally now taxable since the 2015 funding change, but may qualify for the care-institution exemption if they meet its three conditions, as other care sectors can.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de populariteit van het fonds voor gemene rekening als constructie om vermogensbelasting te ontwijken

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the rising popularity of open funds for joint account as a way to avoid wealth tax, and whether this is linked to the forthcoming UBO register. The government answered that the rise in registrations is clear but still limited, that the tax effect depends on realised returns, that it will not take legislative steps now given its caretaker status, and that it will keep monitoring and inform parliament.
At this moment, also given the caretaker status of the cabinet, I do not consider it opportune to take legislative measures.
Op dit moment vind ik het, ook gegeven de demissionaire status van het kabinet, niet opportuun om wettelijke maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weyenberg en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Rijken mijden fiscus langs nieuwe route’

Members Weyenberg and Paternotte (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that wealthy individuals use open funds for joint account (fonds voor gemene rekening) to avoid tax, and whether these funds sit outside the UBO register and enable access to allowances. The State Secretary answered that the tax saving depends on actual returns, that UBO registration for such funds is under study with the UBO register planned for summer 2018, that registrations rose to about 550 by mid-August 2017 with over 25% rejected, and that no legislative measures were taken for now given the caretaker cabinet.
At present it is being examined whether the obligation to register UBO information should also apply to funds for joint account.
Op dit moment wordt onderzocht of de verplichting tot het registreren van UBO-informatie ook moet gaan gelden voor fondsen voor gemene rekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de opschorting en stopzetting van kinderopvangtoeslag aan een groep ouders in 2014

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the suspension and termination of childcare allowance for parents in 2014, including whether letters omitted objection rights, how many cases were affected, and whether instructions were lawful. The State Secretary acknowledged shortcomings, said objection rights were standard on decisions, reported partial reversals and long objection times, and declined to give exact counts for several questions.
This working method was applied in this specific case.
Deze werkwijze is in dit specifieke geval toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Leijten over het bericht 'Elke maand honderden euro’s minder pensioen door Belastingdienst'

SP MPs asked why about 61,000 pensioners living in the Netherlands would lose hundreds of euros net per month under the new Dutch-German tax treaty, whether earlier assurances that seniors would not be affected were correct, and whether those affected were adequately informed. The state secretary answered that the 2013 income calculations, based on 2012 figures, may no longer reflect the situation given later tax changes, that the €15,000 threshold is intentional to reduce administrative burdens, that no change to the treaty is planned, and that affected residents were informed through the 2016 tax return and online channels.
It is therefore quite possible that the situation of these pensioners differs from what could be inferred from the income calculations made at the time.
Het is daarom goed mogelijk dat de situatie van deze gepensioneerden anders is dan uit de destijds gemaakte inkomensberekeningen kon worden opgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bezoek aan het congres van de International Fiscal Association

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about Ministry and Tax Authority officials attending the International Fiscal Association congress in Rio de Janeiro, including costs, programme, past participation and contacts with the tax world. The State Secretary answered that officials have attended for a long time, four people went (paid per Dutch rules), and the IFA is a non-lobby professional association whose contacts serve knowledge-building.
The International Fiscal Association is not a lobby club but an association that brings together tax advisers, corporate tax specialists, academics, governments and judges from around the world.
De International Fiscal Association is geen lobby club maar een vereniging die belastingadviseurs, bedrijfsfiscalisten, wetenschappers, overheden en rechters uit de hele wereld bij elkaar brengt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de stagnatie in de uitwisseling van belastinggegevens tussen OESO-lidstaten

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether international tax information exchange between OECD states has stagnated despite BEPS and EU measures, and what the government would do to speed implementation. The State Secretary denied any stagnation, pointed to OECD peer review progress and Dutch measures (narrowing the fiscal privilege, a UBO register, bearer share rules), and gave no commitment beyond the planned initiatives.
No, I do not share this view. There is in fact no stagnation.
Nee, ik deel deze mening niet. Van stagnatie is namelijk geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht dat 586 miljoen euro aan toeslagen bij de Belastingdienst oninbaar is

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that 586 million euros in childcare and other benefit allowances at the Tax Authority were uncollectable, and whether this amounted to fraud and what measures prevent a repeat. The State Secretary answered that most uncollectable amounts stem from bankruptcy, debt rescheduling, death or other causes rather than fraud, described collection and prevention measures, and reported reduced foreign collection amounts.
Since last year the Tax Authority has used dynamic monitoring of outstanding claims.
Sinds vorig jaar wordt door de Belastingdienst gebruik gemaakt van dynamisch monitoren van nog openstaande vorderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Raan over de APA-/ATR-praktijk

MPs Leijten and Van Raan ask the State Secretary of Finance about the APA/ATR practice, including informal capital rulings, hybrid entities, financing and royalty activities, and re-invoicing. The State Secretary answers that the EU anti-tax-avoidance directives leave the informal capital doctrine intact but reduce risk through information exchange, and that the Tax Authority now tracks informal capital rulings and exchanges information on them.
From 1 July 2017 it will be explicitly recorded how many informal capital rulings are concluded.
Vanaf 1 juli 2017 wordt expliciet bijgehouden hoeveel informeel kapitaalrulings er worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over websites als zorgtoeslag.nl en mijntheorieaanvragen.nl

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about commercial intermediary websites such as zorgtoeslag.nl and mijntheorieaanvragen.nl that resemble government sites and charge more than official services. The government answered that such intermediaries are not prohibited if they are not misleading, that legal instruments exist against deceptive sites, and that the Tax Office and CBR send warning letters and can take legal action.
When commercial websites look too much like government websites, action is taken against the sites concerned.
Als commerciële websites teveel lijken op overheidswebsites wordt actie ondernomen richting de desbetreffende sites.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de totstandkoming van een fiscaal gunstige tegemoetkoming aan chemieconcern ICL

Green Left MP Van der Lee asked the State Secretary of Finance and the ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Trade about emails suggesting a tax ruling was agreed with chemical group ICL, despite the State Secretary's claim that he did not know one existed, and about related audit, negotiation and subsidy questions. The government declined to confirm or deny a ruling citing tax secrecy, described the ICL correspondence as a letter of intent and pre-meeting, and rejected the characterisation of negotiation and subsidy as reflecting actual practice.

As indicated in the thirty-member debate of 5 July, the cabinet cannot, because of the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, confirm or deny whether an APA or ATR was issued to ICL.

Zoals in het dertigledendebat van 5 juli jl. is aangegeven, kan het kabinet vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen niet bevestigen of ontkennen of een APA (Advance Pricing Agreement) of ATR (Advance Tax Ruling) is afgegeven aan ICL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de Panama Papers in bezit zijn van de Duitse federale recherche (het Bundeskriminalamt (BKA))

An MP asked whether the Netherlands could obtain a copy or purchase of the Panama Papers data held by the German Federal Criminal Police (BKA), and what to do if not. The state secretary confirmed contact with the BKA, which has said it will share Dutch-relevant data, with conditions still under review.
Yes, official consultation has meanwhile taken place with the BKA to obtain the information relevant to the Netherlands.
Ja, inmiddels heeft ambtelijk overleg plaatsgevonden met het BKA om de voor Nederland relevante informatie in bezit te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat de Duitse recherche de zogenaamde Panama Papers heeft gekocht

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether he would contact German authorities to obtain access to the Panama Papers, share the information with Dutch tax and prosecution bodies, and publicly release the data. The State Secretary confirmed the German BKA is willing to share, that talks are ongoing, and that the Tax Administration will report aggregated progress in its half-yearly reports without individual cases, while declining to commit on public release.
As agreed when the Panama Papers appeared in 2016, the Tax Administration's half-yearly reports will inform your House of the progress of processing this information
Zoals afgesproken bij het verschijnen van de Panama Papers in 2016 wordt in de halfjaarsrapportages van de Belastingdienst uw Kamer verslag gedaan van de voortgang
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Nederland wereldwijd het belangrijkste knooppunt voor belastingconstructies is

MP Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether he was surprised by research showing the Netherlands as a major conduit in offshore corporate ownership chains, whether this serves tax avoidance, and what he will do about harm to other countries and the link with treaties. Wiebes answered that the findings do not surprise him, that international efforts against tax avoidance are underway, that he sees no role for a new study, and that the Netherlands has no full tax treaty with 19 of the 24 sink jurisdictions.
I am not aware of any figures that answer the question posed.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend die antwoord geven op de gestelde vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van der Lee over belastingontwijking door mijnbouwbedrijven via Nederland

MPs Diks and Van der Lee asked the government about tax avoidance by mining companies using Dutch financing and holding companies, including the lack of employees, trust offices, treaty misuse, UBO register access for developing-country tax authorities, and whether tax avoidance should be a priority in mining sector convenants. The State Secretary answered that Dutch structures are a risk signal but tax evasion was not proven, pointed to BEPS measures, the MLI, Addis Tax Initiative, planned partial public UBO register access, and said tax avoidance would be actively raised in convenant prioritisation.
The government will actively raise the theme of tax avoidance for consideration when setting the convenant priorities.
De overheid zal het thema belastingontwijking actief ter overweging inbrengen bij de vaststelling van de convenantprioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de grootste belastingfraude ooit in Duitsland

MP Van der Lee asked whether the German cum/ex dividend tax scheme, which allegedly cost Germany 1.5 billion euros a year, could also be used in the Netherlands and whether the government would proactively investigate. The State Secretary replied that German authorities are examining double refunds of dividend tax up to 2012, that Dutch cum/ex transactions had different tax consequences so the double-refund problem did not arise in the Netherlands, and did not commit to an investigation.
In the Netherlands, the problem of reclaiming dividend tax twice, as it manifested itself in Germany, therefore did not occur.
In Nederland heeft zich de problematiek met het tweemaal terugvragen van dividendbelasting, zoals die zich in Duitsland heeft gemanifesteerd, daarom niet voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Hijink, Ouwehand en Van Raan over het steunen van de fossiele sector dmv exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs from the SP and PvdD asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (ekv) substantially supports the fossil fuel sector, including the reported €7.3 billion Atradius DSB exposure, and whether it should be tightened to align with Paris goals. The State Secretary answered that the ekv is generic and demand-driven with no fossil-specific policy, that it is cost-covering, that about 39% of the portfolio (€6.4 billion) is fossil-related, that oil and gas transactions undergo environmental and social due diligence, and that he will not explicitly phase out support for non-Paris-aligned projects while promoting renewable and climate-related export cover.
There is no policy to support the fossil fuel sector in particular.
Er is geen beleid om de fossiele sector in het bijzonder te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de complexiteit van de regeling verlaagd tarief bij collectieve opwek of postcoderoosregeling

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Economic Affairs about the complexity of the reduced VAT rate scheme for collective renewable energy and the postcode rose scheme, including inconsistent tax office assessments, the effect of moving out of the postcode area, and whether a separate SDE+ category should be created. The government answered that VAT treatment depends on contractual arrangements, that an inventory of cases is underway, that moving out of the area can affect participation with only limited extra administrative burden, that the scheme will be evaluated this autumn, and that a separate SDE+ category would not reduce complexity and would harm effectiveness.
This autumn the evaluation of the scheme will begin.
Dit najaar zal begonnen worden met de evaluatie van de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Heerma over de indeling van uitzendbureaus en andere organisaties bij de sectorcodes sociale zekerheid, waardoor sociale lasten fors kunnen toenemen

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked why a May 2017 ministerial regulation freezes the option for new temp-work agencies to be classed in a craft sector rather than the temp sector, raising social premiums, and questioned its justification, legal basis and why parliament was not informed. Minister Asscher answered that the freeze is a temporary measure pending a definitive rule by 2019, that sector premium differences of roughly 4 to 7 percentage points result, and that the change was made quickly without prior notice to parliament.
I considered rapid action necessary given the increasing speed with which temp work has shifted away from the temp-agency sector to other sectors.
Ik achtte een snelle actie noodzakelijk gezien de toenemende snelheid waarmee de verschuiving van uitzendarbeid vanuit de sector uitzendbedrijven naar andere sectoren is opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de over de rechtmatigheid van de afvloeiingsregeling bij de douane en de FIOD in de slotwet 2016

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the early-retirement scheme with bonuses used at Customs and the FIOD in 2016 was lawfully applied, given that these services were not reorganised and the replacement scheme (remplaçantenregeling) may not have been met. The State Secretary confirms the facts, admits only five VWNW candidates have been placed so far, and maintains the scheme was applied lawfully since the ARAR sets no deadline.
After review, approval and actual payment, there is therefore a lawful expenditure in accordance with the replacement scheme.
Na toetsing, toekenning en feitelijke betaling is dan ook sprake van een rechtmatige uitgave overeenkomstig de remplaçantenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over de slechte aanpak van faillissementsfraude

MPs Van Nispen and Hijink asked the Justice and Finance ministers why so few criminal reports are drawn up for simple bankruptcy fraud, and how enforcement, capacity, cooperation and registry powers could be improved. The Minister denies police neglect, cites the fraud monitor figures, defends the existing measures and cooperation, and promises further information on a study of guarantee schemes for curators.
I do not recognise the picture that the police give too little priority.
Ik herken het beeld, dat de politie te weinig prioriteit geeft, niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over uitstel van de beslistermijn Pensioen Eigen Beheer

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of directors-major shareholders not stopping PEB accrual by 1 July 2017, how they were informed, and why the deadline should not be extended. The State Secretary answered that accrual must stop by 1 July 2017 due to tax rules, that the Tax Administration informed affected parties extensively, and that further extension is undesirable.
Further postponement is undesirable from a policy perspective and illogical because pension would then continue to accrue for even longer, which would then have to be phased out again.
Verder uitstel is beleidsmatig onwenselijk en niet logisch omdat dan nóg langer pensioen wordt opgebouwd dat vervolgens weer moet worden uitgefaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over voortvluchtige criminelen die geen belasting hoeven te betalen

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether fugitive criminals can avoid paying tax in the Netherlands because of the durable-ties residence test, and whether this makes the Netherlands a tax haven for criminals. State Secretary Wiebes replied that residence is assessed on the circumstances, that the court ruling was specific to its facts, that Dutch rules do not differ from other countries, and that he sees no reason to depart from the residence principle for fugitives.
As stated, to my knowledge Dutch tax legislation does not differ in this respect from tax legislation in other countries.
Zoals gezegd wijkt de belastingwetgeving in Nederland in dit opzicht naar mijn weten niet af van de belastingwetgeving in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Vereniging Eigen Huis wil regeling restschuld behouden’

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the tax-deductible residual mortgage debt scheme (restschuldregeling), expiring end 2017, should be extended, given that many homeowners remain underwater. The government answered that the crisis measure has served its purpose, the housing market has recovered, and it sees no reason to extend the scheme with its associated tax loss.
I therefore see no reason to extend this scheme, which was introduced as a crisis measure, with the additional tax loss that would result.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om deze regeling, die geïntroduceerd is als crisismaatregel, te verlengen met bovendien een fiscale derving als gevolg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie van 19 april 2016, Dansk Industri/Karsten Eigil Rasmussen

Two MPs asked the state secretaries whether the 2013 and 2016 European Court of Justice rulings (Experian, Dansk Industri/Rasmussen) show that the age exception in the Dutch equal treatment law and the Staffelbesluit age-based premium scales are incompatible with EU law, and what consequences this has for pension schemes. The government acknowledged the age exception in the Wgbl is likely not a correct implementation of the directive and promised to examine amendments, but maintained that the Staffelbesluit itself can be objectively justified and needs no withdrawal.

From both rulings of the European Court of Justice it can be inferred that the exception to the prohibition of age discrimination laid down in Article 8(3) of the Dutch Equal Treatment on Grounds of Age in Employment Act (Wgbl) is, on closer examination, not a correct implementation of the above Directive.

Uit de beide uitspraken van het Europese Hof van Justitie kan worden afgeleid dat de uitzondering op het verbod van leeftijdonderscheid, die is vastgelegd in artikel 8, derde lid, van de Wet gelijke behandeling op grond van leeftijd bij de arbeid (Wgbl), bij nader inzien geen juiste implementatie van de bovengenoemde Richtlijn is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Landen zetten belastingconcurrentie voort met nieuwe middelen'

SP MP Leijten asked whether international anti-avoidance measures encourage countries to create new tax breaks, whether capital is taxed less and labour more, and whether the government will act against tax competition in the EU and OECD. State Secretary Wiebes answered that agreed international measures are the most effective tool, that corporate tax revenue has risen since 2014, and that he sees no need for new initiatives yet, while promising no concrete new step.
At this moment I see no reason to take new initiatives in this regard.
Ik heb op dit moment geen aanleiding daarbij nieuwe initiatieven te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat op Malta 70.000 bedrijven staan geregistreerd met als doel om belasting te ontlopen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about reports that Malta hosts 70,000 companies registered for tax avoidance, and about Dutch monitoring of Malta-linked structures, information from North Rhine-Westphalia, and Malta's tax regime. The State Secretary said the Tax Authority treats Malta like other countries, has tightened a rule on separate private assets, is awaiting information from Germany, and declined to judge Malta's tax regime or comment on the German minister's claims.
I have no specific information at my disposal with which I can test whether tax is being evaded via so-called shell companies in Malta.
