Ik heb geen specifieke informatie tot mijn beschikking waarmee ik kan toetsen of belasting wordt ontweken via zogenoemde «shell companies» op Malta.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de hoge belasting die letselschadeslachtoffers moeten betalen omdat de vergoeding vanwege letselschade als vermogen wordt gezien

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why compensation for personal injury counts as wealth, reducing entitlement to rent and health-care allowances and raising box 3 wealth tax, and whether victims could be exempted. The State Secretary answered that such compensation is wealth like any other, that exceptions would complicate the tax system, and that he does not intend to create an exemption, though a transitional arrangement exists for certain earlier awards.
In light of the above arguments, I do not intend to provide for an exception for personal injury compensation in the savings and investments base.
Gelet op bovenstaande argumenten, ben ik niet voornemens in een uitzondering voor letselschadevergoeding voor de grondslag sparen en beleggen te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over internationaal maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen

An MP asks how the government screens environmental effects, corruption links and water impacts of Dutch firms receiving subsidies, trade missions, export credit insurance and diplomatic support, and how rejections and evaluations work. The minister answers that firms are checked against OECD-based IMVO criteria, that some applications were refused for environmental reasons, that no applications were refused for bribery concerns, and that a standing evaluation system exists, while withholding firm-specific details for business confidentiality.
For reasons of business confidentiality, no firm-specific information can be provided about withdrawn or rejected applications.
Omwille van bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid kan er geen (bedrijfs-) specifieke informatie worden verstrekt over ingetrokken of afgewezen aanvragen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de opmerkingen van de ARK over de rechtmatigheid van de totaal uit de hand gelopen kosten van de afvloeiingsregeling en over aan de Kamer beloofde onderzoeken

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Court of Audit's remarks on the early-retirement scheme, including whether applicants were advised to backdate requests to before 1 July 2016, the replacement of departed customs and FIOD staff, and the status of promised investigations. The State Secretary denied that such advice was given, stated that vacancy filling is ongoing with figures not yet available, and said the Broedkamer tender investigation is expected to finish at the end of summer with a report to parliament before the recess.
It has not been established that such advice was given.
Er is niet geconstateerd dat dergelijke adviezen zijn gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Belastingdienst in de knoop met renteheffing”

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the tax authority pays little interest on overpaid tax while charging much more on unpaid tax, and whether this is fair. The State Secretary explains that since 2012 interest is generally not refunded on overpayments, provides yearly figures on interest received and refunded, and acknowledges an asymmetry but declines to change the system citing budgetary cost.
I can well imagine that there are taxpayers who find the interest arrangement unjust.
Ik kan mij goed voorstellen dat er belastingplichtigen zijn die de regeling belastingrente onrechtvaardig vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vraag of de wet iemand verplicht de hypotheekrenteaftrek te gebruiken of niet

Omtzigt (CDA) asks whether the law obliges taxpayers to claim mortgage interest deduction, whether a net tax increase can arise for small mortgages, and how the Hillen rule and the 2013 letter should be read. State Secretary Wiebes answers that the rules are unchanged, that claiming deductions is effectively mandatory for correct returns, and that the 2013 letter's passage was unclear, though the law will be applied as written.
It has come to my attention that the passage in the letter of 11 November 2013 is being read as a standalone choice to claim or not claim interest and costs as deductions.
Antwoord 5 Mij is gebleken dat de passage in de brief van 11 november 2013 5 wordt uitgelegd als een losstaande keuze om rente en kosten al dan niet in aftrek te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Veel minder Oekraïense miljoenen bevroren dan gedacht”

An SP MP asked the government about reports that far fewer Ukrainian funds were frozen than previously claimed, and about sanctions, the Cyprus route, IMF and EU loans, and a Rostec-linked joint venture. The government answered that about EUR 380 million was reported frozen under the EU Ukraine/Russia sanctions, that the EU list is adequately identifying, that Ukraine must proceed with corruption cases, and that it cannot disclose individual tax positions.
This amount can be broken down into funds and assets.
Dit bedrag is onder te verdelen in middelen en tegoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht “Ons land ‘witwasrisico’”

The MP Nijboer asked the ministers of Finance and Justice about a Transparency International report finding that the Netherlands still lags on beneficial ownership transparency and whether they would adopt its recommendations, plus questions on bank and trust-office client screening, foreign trusts, UBO registration, and a ban on dealing with shell companies. The government answered that most recommendations are already covered by pending legislation and EU negotiations, declined to commit to some (e.g. public access to the shareholder register, extending UBO registration to foreign entities), and noted existing supervision and sanctions.
The draft bill aims to fully align Dutch rules on bearer shares with FATF international standards.
Het concept-wetsvoorstel beoogt de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving met betrekking tot aandelen aan toonder volledig in lijn te brengen met de internationale standaarden van FATF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Aantal ZZP’ers dat opdrachten misloopt verdrievoudigd, ondanks uitstel handhaving DBA'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why opdrachtgevers still avoid giving work to zzp'ers despite the suspension of DBA enforcement, and what research is underway on the criteria. The State Secretary acknowledged remaining concerns, stated that model contracts are optional, said the research on 'vrije vervanging' and 'gezagsverhouding' will be sent to the informateur and then to parliament, and aimed to clarify the timeline before the summer recess.
The results of this research will be presented to the informateur in the short term so that it
De resultaten van dit onderzoek zullen op korte termijn aan de informateur worden aangeboden opdat het
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Een op drie ondernemers niet bewust van uitfasering PEB”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that a third of entrepreneurs are unaware of the phase-out of pension in own management (PEB), and about deadlines, communication and possible extensions. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority communicates widely, that the existing grace period is sufficient, and that a longer period or later transfers are not desirable.
I consider it important that all director-major shareholders (dga's) with a PEB are well informed of the changed legislation, by which the PEB is phased out.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat alle directeur-grootaandeelhouders (hierna: dga's) met een PEB goed op de hoogte zijn van de veranderde wetgeving, waardoor het PEB wordt uitgefaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de knelpunten bij het afpakken van crimineel vermogen

An SP MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers about obstacles to confiscating criminal assets, including a financial investigator's alarm, Tax Authority–prosecution cooperation, bank secrecy abroad, notary and lawyer privilege, and slow mutual legal assistance. Minister Blok rejects the picture of a poorly functioning system, points to new cooperation arrangements and planned reports, and promises a letter before summer on cooperation outside Europe.
I do not recognise the picture the report creates that the confiscation of criminal assets is in a poor state in the Netherlands.
Het beeld dat het bericht oproept dat het in Nederland slecht is gesteld met het afpakken van crimineel vermogen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het moeten terugbetalen van huurtoeslag na een uitkering in verband met een brandverzekering

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a couple who had to repay a year of rent allowance because a fire insurance payout sat on their account on 1 January, and asked whether insurers have a duty of care, whether the tax authority can make exceptions, and whether payouts can be excluded from assets. The State Secretary answered that the civil duty of care does not extend to knowing a client's benefit receipts, that the law leaves no room for case-specific exceptions to the 1 January asset test, and that no new exception will be created.
I see no reason to create a new exception for these cases.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om voor deze gevallen een nieuwe uitzondering te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de hypotheekrenteaftrek die in sommige gevallen een hypotheekrentebijtelling blijkt

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance to confirm that a taxpayer in the fourth bracket can end up with a net mortgage-interest addition under the eigen woning tariff measure, and whether this is intended. The State Secretary confirms the calculation, explains the phased reduction of the deduction rate, notes that fiscal partner allocation or not filing is not a practical escape, and states the measure was deliberately designed to apply only a lower rate to deductible costs.

The measure therefore intends that the benefits from owner-occupied housing are not taxed at a different rate than the table rate, but only that a lower rate applies to the amount of deductible costs.

Met de maatregel is derhalve beoogd de voordelen uit eigen woning niet tegen een ander tarief dan het tabeltarief te belasten, maar uitsluitend een lager tarief toe te passen op het bedrag van de aftrekbare kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht «Omstreden belastingdeals tussen fiscus en multinationals openbaar»

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports on controversial tax arrangements between the tax authority and multinationals, why an analysis of common rulings was not sent to parliament, whether risky arrangements will stop, and what effect this has on Dutch reputation. The answer refers the MP to an earlier letter on the same subject rather than answering the questions on substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het mislopen van toeslagen vanwege incidenteel hoger uitvallen van het jaarinkomen

MP Van Raak asked whether employees can lose their childcare, housing and healthcare allowances when a one-off payout from the Individual Choice Budget (IKB) raises their annual income, and whether the government would investigate how often this happens and find solutions. Secretary Wiebes answered that allowances are tied to annual taxable income by design, that an IKB payout normally does not raise taxable income because the budget is paid out within the calendar year, that any loss of allowances cannot be separated from personal circumstances, and that he sees no reason to change the principle or investigate further.
It was a deliberate choice by the legislature to use this income measure as the benchmark for the citizen's ability to pay.
Het is een bewuste keuze van de wetgever geweest om dit inkomensgegeven als maatstaf te kiezen voor wat betreft de in aanmerking te nemen draagkracht van de burger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over aangifte schenkbelasting

An MP asked why the inheritance and gift tax return forms were only published in April and May 2017 despite rules applying from 1 January, and whether late forms could cause interest problems for taxpayers. The State Secretary explained the delay by capacity constraints from form adjustments and stated that the statutory deadlines mean no interest or deadline problems will arise.
Given the applicable filing deadline for inheritance tax (the return must be filed within 8 months of death), no problems with timely filing arise from the later availability of the return forms.

Gelet op de geldende aangiftetermijn voor erfbelasting (de aangifte moet binnen 8 maanden na overlijden worden gedaan) ontstaan geen problemen met het tijdig doen van aangifte als gevolg van het later beschikbaar komen van de aangifteformulieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Visser en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Letselschade-uitkering verkeersslachtoffer moet belastingvrij'

MPs from the VVD asked whether personal injury compensation for road accident victims should be exempt from the asset income surcharge that affects Wlz and Wmo co-payments, following a call by insurers and victim groups. The government answered that the surcharge applies in principle, that only compensation for non-material damage and claims fixed before 11 October 2010 are excluded under the hardship clause, and that it is consulting stakeholders with findings promised before summer.
I expect to be able to inform your House before the summer about the outcomes of these consultations.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer voor de zomer te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van deze overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het achteraf melden aan de Kamer dat er 55 miljoen euro extra is uitgegeven aan de inhuur van externen bij de Belastingdienst in 2016

Omtzigt asked why an extra 55 million euro spent on hiring external staff at the Tax Administration in 2016 was only reported to parliament after the fact, and how many externals were employed and where. The State Secretary explained the increase as temporary hiring for appeals, collection and the Investment Agenda, attributed the late reporting to an administrative error in the supplementary budget, gave headcounts by unit, and declined to answer the request for same-week replies.
In 2016 the information on this was mistakenly not included in the 2nd supplementary budget IX (with the Autumn Memorandum).
In 2016 is de informatie hierover abusievelijk niet verwerkt in de 2 de suppletoire begroting IX (bij de Najaarsnota).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over mogelijke privacyrisico’s in de online belastingaangifte

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority records and retains every edit a taxpayer makes in the online tax return, and on what legal basis, after a privacy complaint by the Taxpayers' Association. The State Secretary answered that only the current state of the return is stored, with prior versions overwritten, and that only process login data is retained for up to 18 months for monitoring, proof and service purposes, with no use for enforcement.
Operations the taxpayer performs before formally submitting the return are not collected or stored.
Bewerkingen die de belastingplichtige uitvoert voor het formeel insturen van de aangifte worden niet verzameld of bewaard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Bashir over schijnconstructies bij de aanleg van de Centrale As in Friesland

MPs Karabulut and Bashir asked whether sham self-employment and underpayment in building the Centrale As road in Friesland, and the Inspectorate's findings, would be addressed by enforcement, a review of provincial tendering rules, and back pay for workers. The minister replied that the courts must decide on employment status and back pay, that the Tax Authority will not comment on individuals, and that the province as main contractor can be held to account and has pledged to act.
The province of Friesland can be called upon in its role as main contracting authority to put matters in order.
De provincie Friesland kan in haar rol van hoofdopdrachtgever aangesproken worden om orde op zaken te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Bruins over de mogelijkheden om grenswerkers als expats te behandelen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether cross-border workers (grenswerkers) suffer financial disadvantage, such as missing child benefit or sick pay, and whether tax advantages could stimulate cross-border work. The State Secretary answered that financial effects depend on personal circumstances, that information provision via grensinfo.nl and a cross-border tax team is being strengthened, that existing tax compensation schemes and EU coordination rules largely avoid disadvantage, and that no extra fiscal stimulus is planned.
That is why the Cross-Border Economy and Labour Action Team formulated, as an action in its report, making the financial consequences of cross-border work transparent.

Daarom heeft het Actieteam Grensoverschrijdende Economie en Arbeid in het rapport Grenzen slechten, regio’s verbinden, mensen bewegen 2 als actie geformuleerd het inzichtelijk maken van de financiële gevolgen van werken over de grens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat de Zwitserse kiezer belastingherziening blokkeert

Merkies (SP) asked whether the government shares the European Commission's disappointment that Swiss voters rejected a corporate tax reform, whether Switzerland still fails international standards, and what steps Switzerland must take to avoid the EU blacklist. Wiebes answered that Switzerland remains committed to BEPS minimum standards, that a new proposal is expected, and that it is too early to say what is needed to stay off the blacklist.
I have good hope that the Swiss government will soon come with a new proposal that meets the international obligations.
Ik heb goede hoop dat de Zwitserse regering in de nabije toekomst met een nieuw voorstel zal komen dat aan de internationale verplichtingen voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het Trouw-artikel " Niet iedereen blij met baan plus bijstand "

An MP asked the State Secretary about Flextensie, a scheme where benefit recipients work while keeping their benefit, including an ESF subsidy to Zaanstad, whether agreements with the tax authority existed, and whether wage and social-security rules apply. The government answered that the subsidy is not yet settled and Flextensie costs are not eligible, no agreements were made, benefit recipients are not employees so client liability does not apply, and it will investigate how municipalities apply the instrument and report back.
I will have the way municipalities implement this instrument and the conditions under which it is applied investigated, and will inform you of the outcomes.

Zoals bij antwoord 6 aangegeven laat ik mij nader informeren over de wijze waarop gemeenten invulling geven aan dit instrument en onder welke condities dit instrument wordt toegepast, en zal ik u over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Harbers en Van der Linde over het bericht 'Brusselse eis zet Rotterdamse haven in financiële klem”

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the Rotterdam port's financial squeeze after the European Commission ended the corporate tax exemption for ports, and about the level playing field across EU ports. The minister replied that port investment room is not currently under pressure, that the Commission's state aid procedures against Belgium and France and the port regulation are on track, and that the Netherlands continues to press for fair competition.
At present the investment room of HbR is not under pressure and the port company is able to carry out the planned investments.
Op dit moment staat de investeringsruimte van HbR niet onder druk en is het Havenbedrijf in staat de geplande investeringen uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de ongevraagde voorlopige aanslag 2017 en de vermogensrendementsheffing

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the 2017 provisional assessment and the box 3 wealth tax, including the forfait return used for savers, whether a box 3 shift to BVs occurs, and whether the Tax Service tackles advisory firms offering loopholes. The State Secretary defended the 2.871% forfait return as attainable with a savings-investment mix, said data cannot trace box 3 money moving into BVs, and stated that advisers are monitored with possible fines or prosecution.
The Tax Service systems cannot trace whether capital contributed to BVs originates from box 3.
Uit de systemen van de Belastingdienst valt niet te herleiden of in bv’s ingebracht vermogen afkomstig is uit box 3.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de problemen met de digitale belastingaangifte voor fiscale hulpverleners zoals het feit dat wijzigingen voor toeslagen dit jaar op papier gedaan zullen moeten worden, indien d

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about digital tax filing problems for volunteer tax helpers such as unions and seniors' organisations, including paper-only filing for partners of deceased persons and loss of commercial software support. The State Secretary answered that a pilot for a deceased-person authorisation is running, that paper remains necessary in some cases, and that interim arrangements and an eHerkenning-based route for intermediaries are being developed.
In the first quarter of 2017 the Tax Administration runs a small-scale pilot with a first version of that survivor authorisation.
In het eerste kwartaal van 2017 vindt bij de Belastingdienst een kleinschalige pilot plaats met een eerste versie van die nabestaandenmachtiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over arbeidsmigranten die wel of geen motorrijtuigenbelasting (MRB) betalen en het plotseling ontbreken van cijfers daarover

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the government can no longer state how many labour migrants pay motor vehicle tax (MRB) on Dutch-registered cars, as it could in 2013, and whether it can provide a time series. The Secretary answered that a comparable estimate is possible (about 105,000 of 362,000 registered residents in February 2017) but that it cannot be compared with 2013 because the share of migrants owning cars is unknown, and pointed to declining car ownership among newer migrants.

A comparison with the 2013 figures to support the degree of MRB compliance by migrants is not possible with these figures, because one would need to know what share of migrants registered in the BRP own a car in the Netherlands and how car ownership within that group has developed.

Een vergelijking met de cijfers uit 2013 ter onderbouwing van de mate van naleving van de MRB verplichtingen door migranten is met deze cijfers echter niet mogelijk, omdat daarvoor bekend moet zijn welk deel van de in de BRP ingeschreven migranten in Nederland een auto heeft en hoe het autobezit binnen die groep zich ontwikkelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ongevraagd opgelegde voorlopige aanslagen 2017

MP Omtzigt asked whether voorlopige aanslagen were again imposed in 2017 on taxpayers who did not file a provisional return, how many, and how communication would be improved. The State Secretary answered that 228,911 taxpayers received one (average EUR 2,374), mostly due to multiple employment or Box 3 income, and that the text on the notice will be clarified starting with the 2018 notice.

In addition, the text on the provisional assessment will be adjusted following the Omtzigt motion so that it becomes even clearer that authorising the Tax Authority for automatic collection, and thus payment in instalments, is the standard.

Daarnaast wordt de tekst op de voorlopige aanslag naar aanleiding van de motie Omtzigt aangepast zodat nog duidelijker wordt dat het machtigen van de Belastingdienst tot automatische incasso en daarmee betaling in termijnen de standaard is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Groot over het bericht 'Cashen met valse scheiding populair'

MPs Omtzigt and Groot asked about reports that 'false divorces' to claim benefits are popular, and about the scale of address fraud and single-parent household trends. The State Secretary answered that address registration fraud combined with divorce is illegal and prosecutable, that married couples keep fiscal partner status unless formally divorced, gave income calculations, and described the Landelijke Aanpak Adreskwaliteit, which is continued until 2023.
If a couple does not actually separate but registers at two different addresses to obtain financial benefit, that is fraud and therefore punishable.
Als een stel niet daadwerkelijk uit elkaar gaat, maar zich op twee verschillende adressen inschrijft om financieel voordeel te genieten is dat fraude en dus strafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Kerstens over het bericht 'DHL: overheid dwingt ons tot aannemen zelfstandige bezorgers'

MPs Mei Li Vos and Kerstens asked the ministers whether the postal sector's reliance on self-employed couriers, and the postponed enforcement of the Wet DBA, encourages sham self-employment and unfair competition, and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that businesses may freely choose employment forms, that enforcement is postponed to at least 1 January 2018 with a review of criteria planned, and that the low-income employer allowance and Wet werk en zekerheid reduce cost and status gaps, but did not commit to new concrete measures against sham self-employment in postal work.
Enforcement of the Wet DBA is suspended until at least 1 January 2018, unless there are malicious actors.
Handhaving van de Wet DBA is opgeschort tot in ieder geval 1 januari 2018, tenzij sprake is van kwaadwillenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Leenders over de berichten ‘O’Leary: Ryanair-vliegtickets worden gratis’ en ‘Zwijg of je vliegt eruit’

PvdA MPs asked the government about reports that Ryanair's chief executive said the airline's low fares rest on paying pilots very little, and about pay-to-fly contracts, safety risks and possible sham employment arrangements. The government answered that it opposes poor pay and unfair competition, is working at EU level on pay-to-fly and fatigue rules, joins court cases and investigates cabin crew, but cannot comment on individual taxpayers.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act prevents the Tax Authority from making statements about individual taxpayers.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen belet het de Belastingdienst om uitspraken te doen over individuele belastingplichtigen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de eerdere en herhaalde bewering dat er geen waarschuwingen voor een RVU-heffing gevonden waren bij de belastingdienst, terwijl er nu minstens drie aan het licht gekomen zijn

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance why earlier claims that no warnings about an RVU levy existed at the Tax Authority conflict with three documents now surfacing, and demanded those documents. The State Secretary admitted an earlier nuance was needed, but refused to release the emails and documents, invoking the state-interest exception under article 68 of the Constitution and the cabinet line on internal policy communication.
On the basis of this cabinet line, I am not providing the emails and the inventory list.
Op grond van deze kabinetslijn verstrek ik de e-mails en de inventarislijst niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Groot over een regeling waarbij leenbijstand, die voor 1 januari 2017 omgezet is in een gift, niet langer leidt tot terugvordering van toeslagen en het (nog) niet uitvoeren van

Members Omtzigt and Groot asked why self-employed people whose loan assistance was converted into a grant, creating a phantom income that forced repayment of benefit allowances, still lack relief, and whether a scheme for existing cases could be proposed as the motion requested. The state secretary replies that retroactive or case-by-case compensation is unworkable, costly and unequal, that only a payment-plan route is offered, and that no problems with municipalities have been reported.
Although I understand the wish of your House, in view of the above I see no possibilities to arrive at a legally defensible and affordable tailor-made solution and to implement your motion.

Hoewel ik de wens van uw Kamer begrijp, zie ik gelet op het vorenstaande, dan ook geen mogelijkheden om tot een juridisch goed verdedigbare en tevens betaalbare maatwerkoplossing te komen en uw motie uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het terugbetalen van een toeslagschuld na een scheiding

MP Bashir asks why only the toeslag applicant, not the ex-partner, is approached by the Tax Administration to repay a childcare/benefit debt after separation, and whether the problem is known. The State Secretary explains the applicant is legally liable under the Awir, the ex-partner is jointly liable but only pursued when needed, and the applicant can recover payments from the ex-partner via regress.
Under the Awir the (ex-)partner is jointly and severally liable for the benefit debt, meaning the Tax Administration can personally hold him or her liable for payment.

De (ex-)partner is op grond van de Awir hoofdelijk aansprakelijk voor de toeslagschuld, hetgeen inhoudt dat hij persoonlijk door de Belastingdienst kan worden aangesproken op het voldoen van de schuld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vertrekregeling voor ambtenaren

MP Omtzigt asked about early-retirement schemes for civil servants, RVU levies owed by the Belastingdienst, emails on internal warnings, contracts of the Broedkamer and unauthorised spending of 38 million euro under the Investment Agenda. The government answered that the schemes follow general ARAR rules, that 24 million euro in RVU levy was paid, that the emails are withheld to protect internal advice under Article 68 of the Constitution, and that the contracts will be made available confidentially.
On the basis of this cabinet line I do not provide the emails.
Op grond van deze kabinetslijn verstrek ik de emails niet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het bericht dat de Telegraaf Media Groep (TMG) na invoering van Wet deregulering beoordeling arbeidsrelaties (Wet DBA) de verantwoordelijkheid en risico’s van de opdrachtgev

An MP asked whether TMG's new freelancer contract, which shifts damages from false self-employment onto freelancers and imposes tight signing and invoicing deadlines, is compatible with the aims of the Wet DBA. The State Secretary answered that recourse clauses are fiscally irrelevant, that recovering only wage tax and national insurance premiums is lawful while recovering employee insurance premiums is void, and that contract terms are a matter of contractual freedom the government cannot intervene in.
The cabinet cannot intervene in the contractual freedom of parties unless mandatory legal rules are breached.
Het kabinet kan niet in de contractsvrijheid van partijen ingrijpen, tenzij er dwingendrechtelijke regels worden overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over grenscontroles door de douane in het binnenland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Justice and Security about customs checks in the interior, including the end of BPM checks on foreign-plated cars, the revenue recovered, the armed status of customs officers during excise checks, and cooperation with police and the Marechaussee. The State Secretary answered that BPM checks moved to the Tax Administration in 2010, that repressive recovery yields about 1.5 million euro per year, that a study on arming excise checks is ongoing, and that the Customs service has a 24-hour contact point.
The investigation announced in this letter into whether there are situations in which excise checks can be carried out armed is ongoing.
Het in deze brief aangekondigde onderzoek of er situaties zijn waarin de accijnscontroles bewapend uitgevoerd kunnen worden, loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Groot over het bericht 'Om te winnen is elke truc toegestaan'

MPs Van Dekken and Groot asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about tax and money-laundering oversight of football finances revealed by Football Leaks, including Dutch company use, transfer-pricing of image rights, and a delayed DNB investigation. The government answered that the Tax Authority will check the leaked information and act where Dutch tax is evaded, describes existing supervision by the Tax Authority, FIOD, DNB and KNVB, and says DNB will publish its general conclusions soon.
The Tax Authority is collecting the information published in Football Leaks and will verify it, as it has done with earlier leaks.
De Belastingdienst verzamelt de informatie die wordt gepubliceerd in Football Leaks en zal deze natrekken, zoals ook bij eerdere leaks is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de Wet Deregulering Beoordeling Arbeidsrelatie (Wet DBA) en de positie van zzp’ers

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Wet DBA and the loss of assignments for zzp'ers, including whether it affects government bodies and whether the Charter's freedom of enterprise applies. The State Secretary says enforcement is suspended until at least 1 January 2018, a review of the criteria is planned, and the Charter does not apply because the Wet DBA is national law.
With the exception of evidently malicious parties, enforcement is suspended until at least 1 January 2018.
Met uitzondering van evident kwaadwillenden 5 , wordt de handhaving tot in ieder geval 1 januari 2018 opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vliet en Houwers over de schadeloosstelling van Kamerleden toekomen

Two MPs asked whether SP requirements that MPs assign their parliamentary pay to the party, with the party paying back a lower salary, and tax-deductible giving, compromise MPs' independence, the oath, and the free-mandate principle. The Minister answers that such assignment is not in itself incompatible with independence, but that the appearance of financial dependence is undesirable, and defers further judgment to a pending court case.
I do not consider it useful to make general statements on this in advance of that ruling.
Ik acht het niet zinvol om, vooruitlopend daarop, hier in algemene zin uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de inzet van uitzendkrachten bij de Belastingdienst Toeslagen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Finance about dissatisfaction among temporary agency workers at the Belastingdienst Toeslagen, their grading, qualifications, working conditions compared with permanent staff, and the structural use of temp workers. The State Secretary answered that temp workers are paid under the agency CAO and inlenersbeloning, that the Belastingdienst intends to introduce the Functiegebouw Rijk, and that temp use for structural work is justified by peaks and expected reductions, though he did not commit to changing the practice.
The Belastingdienst complies with the frameworks set for equal treatment of temporary agency workers compared with employees appointed at the Belastingdienst.
De Belastingdienst voldoet aan de kaders die gesteld zijn betreffende de gelijke behandeling van uitzendkrachten ten opzichte van medewerkers aangesteld bij de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Weyenberg over de voortdurende totale onzekerheid over het uitstel van handhaving van de wet deregulering beoordeling arbeidsrelaties

MPs Omtzigt and Van Weyenberg asked why the Belastingdienst website gave a broader definition of 'kwaadwillend' (bad-faith) in its enforcement-suspension notice than the state secretary's own definition on the Wet DBA, and who approved it. The state secretary answered that the website text was a communication error, withdrawn after three days, and that the official definition in the Handboek Loonheffingen applies, with roughly ten bad-faith cases expected.
On Friday 2 December the deviating text was replaced by a text that does match the texts exchanged with your House.
Op vrijdag 2 december jl. is die afwijkende tekst vervangen door een tekst die wel aansluit bij de met uw Kamer gewisselde teksten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over huurtoeslag voor studenten

An MP asks whether student rent allowance (huurtoeslag) for students in shared-house-number accommodation is at risk because the BAG address register only records self-contained units, and whether tenants will keep their advance payments. The minister answers that entitlement does not change, that specified student complexes will be handled separately, that wrongly granted allowance will not be recovered, and that the Belastingdienst will take up the issues with priority.
As indicated in the answers to the previous questions, the right to rent allowance does not change.
Zoals in de antwoorden op de vragen hiervoor aangegeven wordt, verandert het recht op huurtoeslag niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Omtzigt over het VVD-filmpje over de Wet Deregulering Beoordeling Arbeidsrelaties

MPs Van Weyenberg and Omtzigt asked about a VVD video implying the DBA law was postponed, the legal status of enforcement suspension, and plans to change labour law and communicate with clients. Staatssecretaris Wiebes answered that enforcement was postponed (not the law itself), that a separate policy decision is not issued, that a labour-law review is underway with a timeline, and that enforcement will focus on about ten malicious cases.
What has been postponed is, of course, the enforcement.
Wat is uitgesteld is natuurlijk de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over bijlage 4 bij de Tweede voortgangsrapportage Wet DBA

MP Klein asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the 'kwaadwillenden' (malicious parties) exception in annex 4 to the Wet DBA progress report could cover almost all organisations, whether staffing and costs are affected, and whether the annex should be better communicated and clarified. The State Secretary answers that the exception covers only exceptional cases of fraud or deceit, estimated at about ten, that enforcement is folded into existing audit planning at no extra cost, and that communication is being done through news items, letters to associations and other channels.
Naturally, this does not concern an independent professional about whom there is noise regarding the authority relationship.
Vanzelfsprekend gaat het daarbij dus niet om een zelfstandige professional bij wie er ruis is over de gezagsrelatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het persoonsgebonden budget en huurtoeslag

MP Voortman asked whether persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) leftovers wrongly count as assets for housing benefit (huurtoeslag), causing repayments, and whether a 3,000 euro threshold left some people without relief. The government confirmed that leftover PGB money counts as assets under the box 3 rules, but agreed to offer relief to this group through the hardship clause and to set this out in a ministerial regulation.
People who qualify can report to the Tax Administration/Toeslagen, which will still disregard the leftover personal budget when calculating the allowance.

Mensen die hiervoor in aanmerking komen kunnen zich melden bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen die het restant persoonsgebonden budget alsnog buiten beschouwing zal laten bij de berekening van de toeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over het door de fiscus meetellen van een PGB-restant voor de vermogenstoets voor toeslagen

Two D66 MPs asked whether a leftover personal budget (pgb) owed back to a care office can count as debt under the box 3 wealth test and whether this wrongly makes some recipients lose housing benefit. The government confirmed the pgb remainder can be declared as debt above the 3,000 euro threshold, but agreed to a hardship arrangement via the Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen for affected cases and to a ministerial regulation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de samenwerking tussen Belastingdienst en OM bij het afpakken van crimineel vermogen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked whether cooperation between the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the Tax Authority on seizing criminal assets is still insufficient, whether OM's claim that Tax Authority referrals are declining is accurate, how the AAFD protocol is implemented, and what measures will be taken, including OM's suggestions for a training course and wider use of the Afpak-app. The minister rejects the claim of declining cooperation, describes the protocol procedures, RIEC and regional examples, says the Afpak-app is available and that no further measures are needed, while committing only to continued dialogue and attention to a regional contact point and best practices.
I do not recognise the picture that cooperation in this area between the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the Tax Authority is declining.
Ik herken mij niet in het beeld dat de samenwerking op dit terrein tussen het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de Belastingdienst terugloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de vorstelijke vertrekregelingen bij de Belastingdienst en het gapend AOW-gat bij Defensie

Two CDA MPs asked the Defence and Finance ministers about the suspended defence pay talks, the AOW (state pension) gap for former defence staff, and the generous early-retirement scheme at the Tax Administration. The minister answered that talks have resumed, that a new AOW arrangement is being pursued in response to court rulings and that Finance is not her responsibility, while distinguishing the two schemes' purposes.
As employer, I have the responsibility to make a provision for the AOW gap of civilians and military personnel in (former) service at Defence.
Als werkgever heb ik de verantwoordelijkheid om een voorziening te treffen voor het AOW-gat van burgers en militairen in (voormalige) dienst bij Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Groot over een datalek bij de Belastingdienst

MPs Oosenbrug and Groot asked about a data leak at the Tax Authority in which taxpayer data on CD-ROMs was sent to the wrong tax consultant, and whether affected taxpayers should have been informed. State Secretary Wiebes answered that the leak was reported to the Dutch DPA, that the risk was low so individual notification was not required, and that the Tax Authority tightened checks and is digitising the extension process.
The scope of the data leak is not exactly known.
De omvang van het datalek is niet exact bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht “Nederland notoire dwarsligger in aanpak van belastingontwijking”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about Dutch resistance to EU anti-tax-avoidance measures, including a 10% minimum tax on royalties and interest, rulings exchange, the participation exemption and hybrid mismatches with the US. The State Secretary answered that the 10% compromise was dropped for lack of unanimity, that Dutch positions were defended on efficiency grounds, and that the government would send its position on the hybrid mismatch proposal later.
The government's position on this proposal will, as usual, be sent to your House in the form of a BNC fiche.
Het kabinetsstandpunt over dit voorstel zal zoals gebruikelijk in de vorm van een BNC-fiche naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het telefonisch intrekken van bezwaren

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Tax Authority work instruction allowing objections to be withdrawn by phone without written confirmation, which the questions argue conflicts with the Awb. The State Secretary admits the instruction was contra legem, says it has been ended and the instruction is being amended, and explains that the phone-withdrawal count cannot be fully aggregated and affected taxpayers may be reinstated on request.
This specific work instruction did not comply with laws and regulations and should never have been adopted at all.
Deze specifieke werkinstructie was niet conform wet – en regelgeving en had dus überhaupt niet mogen worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Groot over belastingschulden van amateur voetbalclubs

MPs Van Dekken and Groot asked the ministers about tax debts at amateur football clubs, how the KNVB and the Tax Authority share information on suspected fraud, and whether the KNVB licensing system and club accounts can help prevent it. The State Secretary answered that contact with the KNVB is regular, that the Tax Authority is bound by fiscal secrecy and cannot share fraud data with the KNVB, and that the KNVB will explore sporting sanctions while criminal investigations are not disclosed.
The Tax Authority has a general fiscal confidentiality obligation that also applies towards the KNVB licensing committee.
De Belastingdienst heeft een algemene fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht die ook werkt jegens de KNVB licentiecommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de financiële curatele van de Belastingdienst

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the early retirement scheme, the Tax Administration's continuity risks, the Auditdienst Rijk and Algemene Rekenkamer reports, and the procurement and hiring freeze during financial curatorship. State Secretary Wiebes answered that the scheme's premium cap and RVU levy were not discussed in negotiations or warned about in advance, that a temporary commitment stop applied from 13 to 26 October 2016, and that several figures would be provided later once final.

For the questions whose answers depend on the precise number of departing and Switch-transferring staff under the scheme, and where this outflow takes place, the answers will still be provided once this number is definitively established.

Voor de vragen waarop de antwoorden samenhangen met het precieze aantal vertrekkende en in Switch instromende medewerkers op basis van de regeling en waar deze uitstroom plaatsvindt, geldt nog steeds dat deze worden beantwoord zodra dit aantal definitief vaststaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad dat ZZP’ers hun huur kunnen aftrekken

MP Bashir (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Supreme Court ruling that self-employed people can deduct rent for a home office, including questions on who qualifies, budgetary cost, retroactivity and whether the rules will be changed. The State Secretary answered that the ruling has no retroactive effect, estimated the current cost at about 20 million euros with possible growth, and announced an amendment in the Belastingplan 2017 to align rented and owned home-office treatment, offset by a higher deduction percentage for mixed costs.
I do not consider the outcome of the ruling of 12 August 2016 balanced and therefore I am preparing an amendment note within the Belastingplan 2017 package.
Om voormelde redenen acht ik de uitkomst van het arrest van 12 augustus 2016 niet evenwichtig en daarom bereid ik in het kader van het pakket Belastingplan 2017 een nota van wijziging voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Bosman over de aangekondigde sluiting van de Windward Island Bank (WIB) op Saba

MPs Aukje de Vries and Bosman asked whether the Windward Island Bank will close its Saba branch, what the consequences are, and whether the resulting single-bank situation and the stricter BES financial regulation are justified. The minister confirmed the closure, said the remaining bank RBC would hold a de facto monopoly that may be undesirable, attributed the decision mainly to poor financial results rather than regulation, and committed to ongoing consultation with the island government and supervisors to keep ATMs and at least one bank operating.
I am considering, in consultation with the parties involved, whether there are options to keep this ATM operational next year as well.
Ik bezie, in overleg met betrokken partijen, of er mogelijkheden bestaan om deze geldautomaat ook volgend jaar operationeel te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uit de hand gelopen reorganisatie van de Belastingdienst

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance, in 18 numbered questions, about the Tax Authority reorganisation (Switch, the exit scheme of about 500 million euro, approval by the Investment Committee, budget transfers, deputy bailiffs and outflow pace). The State Secretary answers that procedures were not followed so internal checks could not operate, that budget releases were made in two tranches, and that a planned cost overrun was not reported to parliament in spring to protect negotiations.
In my letter of 4 October and during the General Financial Considerations on 5 October I indicated that the procedures were not followed, so internal checks and balances could not do their work.

In mijn brief van 4 oktober jl. en tijdens de Algemene Financiële Beschouwingen op woensdag 5 oktober jl. heb ik aangegeven dat de procedures niet zijn gevolgd, waardoor interne checks and balances hun werk niet hebben kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Fiscus weert publiek in rechtszaal’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the public was excluded from a tax court hearing on the savings tax case, and how this fits government transparency goals. The State Secretary answered that tax hearings are closed by default for privacy and business-data reasons, that the Tax Authority opposed the journalist's presence, and that it will instruct inspectors to agree to public hearings in mass objection procedures while publication of anonymised judgments continues.
Hearings in tax procedures take place in principle behind closed doors.
Zittingen in belastingprocedures vinden in beginsel achter gesloten deuren plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de verkoop van elektrische en hybride auto’s fors is afgenomen

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about reports that sales of electric and hybrid cars fell, whether the 2016 rise in the company car tax (bijtelling) explains it, and how this fits with climate, air quality and energy goals and earlier motions to stimulate electric driving. The minister answered that electric car sales keep growing steadily, that the PHEV decline is partly due to the tax change, that EU-level emission standards are the preferred instrument, and that he will inform parliament further in the autumn on the Groot motion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de leegloop bij de belastingdienst

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the departure wave at the Belastingdienst, including sign-up numbers for the voluntary exit scheme, costs, the agreement with unions and changes to its conditions. Wiebes reported that about 7,280 fte expressed interest and around 4,960 fte had chosen a variant, admitted the broad opening was a wrong choice, and gave cost figures and a timeline of changes, with the answer on continuity risks still open.
In hindsight, this broad opening was a wrong choice, and a more targeted definition of the target group and a time limit would have been preferable.
Achteraf bezien is deze brede openstelling een verkeerde keuze geweest en had een meer gerichte doelgroepbepaling en een afbakening in de tijd de voorkeur moeten hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Smaling over het bericht “Nederland faciliteert omstreden bouwproject”

Two SP MPs asked whether Dutch-based shell companies facilitate HKND's Nicaragua canal project that allegedly violates human rights and harms the environment, and what the government did about warnings. The government answered that tax authorities cannot assess human rights, that trust offices must screen integrity risks and DNB supervises them but cannot share its findings, that concerns were shared with Nicaragua and Dutch firms, and that Dutch firms should apply due diligence.
Whether TMF Group adequately performed its gatekeeper function in this case is supervisory-confidential information and therefore cannot be shared by DNB.
Of TMF Group in dit geval zijn poortwachterfunctie adequaat heeft uitgevoerd, is toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie en kan derhalve niet door DNB worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het artikel ‘Gaan Wiebes en de VVD door met ondernemers pesten?’

MP Klein asks whether self-employed contractors without staff cannot fully indemnify clients against wage-tax liability under the approved model contracts, whether this is unfair competition, whether temporary measures for escrow (g-rekening) accounts will be taken, and what the Tax Authority thinks of model contracts allowing recovery of insurance premiums from contractors. The State Secretary replies that clients following approved model contracts are protected from back-tax assessments, that no interim escrow measures are planned while the g-rekening review continues, and that recovery of wage tax and national insurance contributions from workers is lawful while recovery of employer-borne premiums is void.

As long as clients and self-employed contractors comply with the model contract they use, the client is in fact protected from back-tax assessments and from liability claims under the fiscal joint-employer liability rule.

Indien en zo lang opdrachtgevers en zzp’ers de door hen gebruikte modelovereenkomst naleven is de opdrachtgever dus feitelijk gevrijwaard van naheffingsaanslagen en ook van aansprakelijkstellingen op grond van de fiscale inlenersaansprakelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het UNCTAD-rapport 'Trade Misinvoicing in Primary Commodities in Developing Countries'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about a UNCTAD report alleging systematic export overinvoicing of primary commodities to the Netherlands, implying missing import data and possible capital flight or tax avoidance. The State Secretary answered that the figures may reflect plausible explanations such as buyer nationality, resale during transport, and changed destinations, denied that data is missing, saw no evidence of capital flight or tax avoidance, and declined to adopt the recommended country and company level research.
I have no indications that the differences were caused by efforts toward capital flight or tax avoidance.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de verschillen zijn veroorzaakt door het streven naar kapitaalvlucht of belastingontwijking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de onzekerheid over de uitvoering van de Wet deregulering beoordeling arbeidsrelaties

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about uncertainty over the Wet DBA, including Belastingdienst positions on zzp'ers in construction, the meaning of 'langere duur dan gebruikelijk', and whether the law changes the employee/entrepreneur definitions. The State Secretary answers that the DBA does not change the legal definitions, that the Belastingdienst gives advance certainty via model agreements, and that a rule of thumb for 'langere duur' has been approved.
Nothing changes about those boundaries; what was allowed remains allowed and what was not allowed remains not allowed.
Er verandert niets aan die grenzen; dat wat toegestaan was, blijft toegestaan en dat wat niet toegestaan was, blijft niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over de definitie van staatssteun inzake investeringen in havens in een richtlijn

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries (VVD) asked whether the government had raised the port state-aid issue with the European Commission and about the timing of EU guidance on subsidies to seaports. The minister answered that the Netherlands urged the Commission to publish state-aid guidance for seaports and to speed up revision of the block exemption, that the Commission has no current plans for such guidance, and that the Dutch corporate tax exemption for ports was ended while similar exemptions in Belgium and France are under formal investigation.
Together with the EP rapporteur for the new port regulation, Mr Fleckenstein, I sent a letter in June to EU Competition Commissioner Ms Vestager.
Samen met de EP rapporteur voor de nieuwe havenverordening, dhr. Fleckenstein, heb ik in juni jl. een brief gestuurd aan de EU Commissaris voor mededinging, mw. Vestager.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over de huur van panden voor een azc in Maastricht

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked about the COA's lease of Parkweg 20 and Blekerij 52 in Maastricht for an asylum centre, including the rent, the transaction history, vetting of the owner, and links to an FIOD investigation. The State Secretary answered that rents are not disclosed for commercial reasons, that the COA checked the owner via a notary who found no links, and that the FIOD does not inform other bodies about its investigations.
The COA does not make lease contracts public. A lease contract contains information that affects the economic and financial interests of the COA.
Het COA maakt geen huurcontracten openbaar. Een huurcontract bevat informatie die de economische en financiële belangen van het COA raken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat huishoudens veel meer milieubelasting betalen dan de vervuilende industrie

An SP MP asked why households pay far more environmental tax than heavy industry, the relative burden of energy costs across income groups, and whether consumers will really benefit from the 2016 energy tax changes. The state secretary provided indicative tables showing that energy tax is set by consumption rather than income, that the average household energy bill falls by about 100 euro in 2016, and that the government aims to decarbonise housing without committing to new measures on the household-industry gap.
The costs of energy – and also the tax payable on it – do not depend on income, but are determined by consumption.
De kosten voor energie – en ook de te betalen belasting daarover – hangen echter niet af van het inkomen, maar worden bepaald aan de hand van het verbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over belastingrente

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the asymmetry in tax interest: interest is charged on a reclaimed tax credit but not paid on a refund from backward loss offset, and about the falling amounts of interest paid since the regime changed. The State Secretary declined to comment on a pending Supreme Court case, defended the deliberate legislative choice, and largely answered the factual questions with figures, though he refused to reconsider the regime.
As long as cases are before the courts, it is not appropriate or desirable to give a judgment on them.
Zolang zaken onder de rechter zijn, is het niet gepast en gewenst om daarover een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over het mogelijk maken om een hypotheek met hoge rente stapsgewijs en boetevrij om te zetten in een hypotheek met een lager rentepercentage

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked whether existing mortgage holders could convert high-rate mortgages stepwise and penalty-free to lower rates, and whether banks may still charge early-repayment fees under the new EU Mortgage Credit Directive. The minister explained that fees must now reflect actual losses for new mortgages, that the AFM is still investigating compliance for existing contracts, and that no standardised stepwise conversion guide will be published.
There is currently no overview available showing how the various mortgage lenders in the Netherlands calculate the early repayment compensation.
Er is op dit moment geen overzicht voorhanden waarin wordt weergegeven op welke wijze de verschillende hypotheekverstrekkers in Nederland de vergoeding bij vervroegde aflossing berekenen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het bericht dat de Persgroep na invoering van de Wet deregulering beoordeling arbeidsrelaties (Wet DBA) de verantwoordelijkheid van de opdrachtgever afschuift op zzp’ers

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether clauses in Persgroep's freelance journalist terms shifting liability, tax and premium burdens onto freelancers are compatible with the DBA law's aims, and whether such clauses are permissible. The State Secretary answered that clauses about recourse are not relevant to the tax assessment of a working relationship, that recourse of wage tax and premiums on the worker is lawful while recourse of employer premiums is void, that Persgroep removed the clauses on 8 July, and that parties have contractual freedom to include termination clauses.
Moreover, De Persgroep removed the said provisions on 8 July.
Overigens heeft De Persgroep op 8 juli jl. genoemde bepalingen geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat PSA Groep (Peugeot Citroën) de werkelijke verbruikscijfers van auto’s bekend heeft gemaakt

MPs Madlener and Tony van Dijck asked whether the new WLTP test method would raise measured CO2 emissions and tax revenue, and what it means for consumers, air quality policy and milieuzones. The government answered that WLTP will likely raise measured CO2 figures but is a technical change not intended to increase tax revenue, promised a bill by end 2016 with details on financial effects, and said WLTP does not affect air quality policy.
For the implementation of the WLTP in the car taxes, a legislative amendment is necessary.
Voor de implementatie van de WLTP in de autobelastingen is een wetswijziging noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Merkies over defensiebedrijven die via Nederland belasting ontwijken

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked whether large defence companies use Dutch holdings to avoid tax, how much corruption and holding data is tracked, and whether research into the sector's use of the Dutch tax climate is needed. The State Secretary answered that such data is not kept, corruption is addressed through EU and national anti-money-laundering and criminal rules, and that no specific sector-focused research is planned.
This data is not kept as such.
Deze gegevens worden niet als zodanig bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de fiscale behandeling van zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp-ers)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the ministry, UWV and Belastingdienst apply rules on freelancers (zzp-ers) to avoid employment relationships, including use of the g-rekening payment account via brokers and whether freelancers should be allowed to use it. The State Secretary answered that these bodies must ensure no employment relationship exists, that they do not use g-rekeningen in their own hiring, that deblocking does not prevent later recovery of levies, and that extending the g-rekening to freelancers is being considered pending a modernisation study.
The Ministry of Finance, the Belastingdienst and the UWV must, like other clients, ensure in their processes that there is in fact no employment relationship when hiring zzp-ers.

Het Ministerie van Financiën, de Belastingdienst en het UWV moeten, net als andere opdrachtgevers, in hun processen borgen dat er ook feitelijk geen sprake is van een dienstbetrekking bij de inhuur van zzp’ers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de buitensporige belastingdruk voor eenverdieners

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the high tax burden on single-earner households, including the Reformatorisch Dagblad calculations that a rise in gross pay can leave net income unchanged or lower, and asked whether the government would propose measures to make work pay for single earners. The State Secretary disputed the newspaper's figures, said net income rises with higher gross pay though marginal pressure is high due to benefit phase-outs, stated the government will decide on income measures after the summer based on the latest forecasts, and offered no concrete new proposal.

The cabinet will decide after the summer, based on the latest purchasing power figures in the Macro Economic Outlook, whether there is a need to take measures to improve the purchasing power of specific groups.

Het kabinet zal na de zomer op basis van de meest recente cijfers over de koopkracht, die zijn opgenomen in de Macro Economische Verkenning, besluiten of er een noodzaak is maatregelen te nemen om de koopkracht van specifieke groepen te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over de berichten ‘Politiek neemt zzp'ers niet serieus’ en ‘Zzp'er in de war door wet tegen schijnzelfstandigheid’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about uncertainty among freelancers and clients over the Dutch DBA law on false self-employment and model contracts, and whether the Tax Authority is cooperative. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority is cooperative and that the DBA law stays in its current form, citing ongoing information campaigns, model contracts and branch-specific account teams.
The Tax Authority has a cooperative attitude towards the submitters of contracts.
De Belastingdienst heeft een coöperatieve houding naar de indieners van overeenkomsten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over de risico’s op privacyproblemen en identiteitsfraude door de verspreiding van het Burger Servicenummer (BSN) bij paspoortkopieën en door de koppeling aan het B

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the BSN printed on passport copies and its linkage to the VAT number create identity fraud and privacy risks, and whether the Belastingdienst has a legal basis for that linkage. The Staatssecretaris answered that the BSN carries no greater risk than other passport data, that no fraud cases are known from the VAT link, that Wabb permits the use, and that a consultation with ANWB and hospitality bodies and a campaign will be started.
Stating the Burger Servicenummer (BSN) on travel documents carries no greater risk than stating the other personal data on travel documents.
Het vermelden van het Burger Servicenummer (BSN) op reisdocumenten draagt geen grotere risico's mee dan het vermelden van de andere persoonsgegevens op reisdocumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de elektronische berichtenbox

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the electronic mailbox (Berichtenbox): whether the Belastingdienst must accept and answer digital messages, usage figures for MijnOverheid and MijnToeslagen, the post-by-paper maatwerk policy and acceptgiro timing. The State Secretary answers that a second channel is not required in principle but personal help must remain available, gives usage figures, and states that the acceptgiro timing and bezwaar information are adequate.
I do not share the view that there must always be a second channel for sending messages to or receiving messages from the Belastingdienst.
Ik deel niet de mening dat er altijd een tweede kanaal moet zijn om berichten in te sturen naar of te ontvangen van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Opdrachtgevers haken af door afschaffing VAR’

MP Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that clients were withdrawing from freelancer hiring after the VAR was abolished, and about how the Tax Authority supervises model agreements under the DBA Act. The State Secretary replied that the DBA Act does not change the legal test for employment, outlined guidance and case statistics, and explained the enforcement approach, burden of proof and transitional arrangements.
After the summer recess I will therefore send you a letter giving you insight into what the Tax Authority has achieved with partners in various sectors
Na het zomerreces stuur ik u daarom een brief waarin ik u inzicht geef over hetgeen door de Belastingdienst met de partners in verschillende sectoren is bereikt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de enorme prijsstijgingen als gevolg van directe en indirecte belastingverhogingen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about price rises caused by tax increases, the link to stagnating purchasing power, and whether to cut VAT, excise and corporate tax or introduce a flat tax. The government denied purchasing power has stagnated, pointed to a EUR 5 billion labour tax cut, and rejected the flat tax and the broad tax cuts as budget-costly and distributionally unbalanced.
These burden-increasing measures were at the time necessary to restore public finances to order.
Deze lastenverzwarende maatregelen waren destijds noodzakelijk om de overheidsfinanciën weer op orde te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een verbod op de anti-Israëlische Boycot, Desinvestering en Sancties (BDS)-beweging

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether publicly funded bodies should be banned from boycotting Israeli products, whether the ANBI status of BDS-linked organisations such as docP should be revoked, and about reported supermarket patrols. The minister answered that consumers may investigate product origins, that ANBI status is granted and revoked only by the Tax Authority under neutral criteria, and that no ban on boycotts is planned.
The cabinet has no power to revoke a granted ANBI status.
Het kabinet heeft geen bevoegdheid om een verleende ANBI-status in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het bericht ‘Miljoenenroof Mozambique liep deels via Amsterdam’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch trust company TMF, which managed the Dutch shell company Ematum B.V. tied to a Mozambique bond, had fulfilled its gatekeeper duties and what supervisors can do to detect such fraud. The minister explained the trust-office gatekeeper obligations, the supervisory and enforcement tools of DNB and the Belastingdienst, and planned tightening of the Wet toezicht trustkantoren, while declining to judge TMF's conduct and citing legal secrecy on reports.
With this bill the aim is to make the regulatory framework for trust offices stricter.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt beoogd het regelgevend kader voor trustkantoren strenger te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de belangenverstrengeling van belastinghoogleraren

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked about the affiliations of tax professors with accountancy and law firms, conflicts of interest, lobbying influence on tax policy, and a register of side jobs. The government answered that such side jobs are acceptable under the Dutch research code, that transparency is required through university websites, that consultation and advice paragraphs are used, and that it sees no need for a national register.
It is the responsibility of civil servants, the cabinet and MPs to reach balanced judgments based on available information and by listening to the views of parties involved.

Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van ambtenaren, het kabinet en Kamerleden om op basis van beschikbare informatie en door te luisteren naar geluiden van betrokken partijen tot afgewogen oordelen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smaling over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst een bom legt onder gratis OV voor ouderen

MPs Bashir and Smaling asked whether the Tax Authority should bring free public transport for elderly residents under the VAT compensation fund and why it targets Capelle aan den IJssel. The state secretary replied that providing free transport is a municipal choice, that the VAT compensation law excludes benefits given to individual third parties such as transport cards, and that the Capelle audit was routine supervision.
Whether or not to provide public transport free of charge is a decision made by decentralised governments.
Het al dan niet gratis verstrekken van OV is een afweging, die door decentrale overheden wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Jasper van Dijk over de productie van euromunten

MPs Merkies and Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Royal Dutch Mint's use of Poongsan roundels, a supplier also linked to cluster munitions, and about ministry oversight of state-owned enterprises. The State Secretary answered that the Mint raised the issue with the MDWG, that the ministry approves roundel orders and will block Poongsan purchases while it makes cluster munitions, and that the state will use the case as a general warning to other state holdings.

As promised in the General Consultation of 2 June on the KNM, the ministry will also in future ensure through the coin contract that no Poonsang roundels are purchased for producing Dutch euro coins as long as this company also makes cluster munitions.

Zoals toegezegd in Algemeen Overleg van 2 juni j.l. over KNM zal het ministerie ook in de toekomst via het muntcontract borgen dat er geen rondellen van Poonsang worden afgenomen voor de productie van Nederlandse euromunten zolang dit bedrijf ook clustermunitie maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over het bericht in De Telegraaf van 6 april 2016 ‘Platteland eist groter deel rijksuitkering’

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked about a Telegraaf report that rural municipalities demand a larger share of the state fund, and about AEF's recommendation to redistribute EUR 88 million toward smaller municipalities. Minister Plasterk answered that the fund managers adopted only one third of the new formula for 2016, that full implementation would shift funds toward rural municipalities, and that a decision will follow after consulting the Rfv and VNG without giving a firm date.
In deciding how the fund managers handle the study's results, the advice received from the Rfv and VNG will be taken into account.
Bij de besluitvorming over hoe de fondsbeheerders met de resultaten van het onderzoek omgaan worden de ontvangen adviezen van de Rfv en VNG betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Bashir over het feit dat ouderparen waarvan één partner ernstig ziek is fiscaal ongelijk behandeld worden

MPs Siderius and Bashir (SP) asked whether couples where one partner is seriously ill are unfairly treated by the tax system compared with single parents, given lower child benefit and a higher tax burden, and whether they will be compensated. The State Secretary of Finance answers that the comparison is partial, that income support for the chronically ill runs through other schemes and municipal SMI, that the combination credit is a participation tool not meant for income support, and that the SMI policy will be reviewed with a vision letter this autumn.
There is no question of exclusion from income support for couples in which one partner is seriously ill.
Er is geen sprake van uitsluiting van inkomensondersteuning voor ouderparen waarvan één partner ernstig ziek is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het bericht 'Luxemburg volhardt met geheime rulings'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Luxembourg is making oral tax rulings despite EU transparency rules, whether it should be held to account and whether Dutch rulings are ever oral. The State Secretary answered that Luxembourg's finance minister denied oral rulings, that oral rulings are undesirable under the new EU directive, and that in the Netherlands rulings are always recorded in writing.
If member states do not comply with the agreements in Directive 2015/2376/EU, I am of the view that these member states should be called to account by the other member states.
Indien lidstaten zich niet houden aan de afspraken in de Richtlijn 2015/2376/EU, ben ik van mening dat deze lidstaten hierop moeten worden aangesproken door de andere lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de fiscale behandeling van zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp-ers)

An MP asks whether the Tax Authority and UWV have ensured that DBA-based contracts with self-employed workers (zzp-ers) prevent any employment relationship, and asks about the use and sanctions of the g-rekening for chain and user liability. The state secretary answers that measures are in place but individual employment relationships cannot be ruled out, that using the g-rekening to hold back part of invoice sums is not misuse, and that misuse can lead to termination of the account agreement, civil action or criminal prosecution.
However, it cannot be ruled out that in individual cases there is nevertheless an employment relationship.
Het is echter niet uit te sluiten dat er in individuele gevallen toch sprake is van een dienstbetrekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de complexiteit van het belastingstelsel en mogelijke verbetering van voorlichting en informatievoorziening aan belastingplichtigen

An MP asks whether the complexity of the Dutch tax system, illustrated by the elderly tax credit (ouderenkorting) and the partner income-allocation rules, can be simplified and whether taxpayers receive adequate information. The Secretary of State confirms the rules' effects, explains the allocation options in the tax return software, says simplification is taken seriously, and reports that the Belastingdienst is improving information provision and examining simplifying the income averaging procedure.
The cabinet takes the need for simplification very seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de noodzaak tot vereenvoudiging zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de toekenning van kinderopvangtoeslag voor vierjarige kinderen met een beperking die een wenprogramma doorlopen

An SP MP asked whether children with disabilities starting a transition ('wen') programme at age four are registered as school pupils, which cuts off daycare allowance, and whether this discourages parents from working. The minister answers that the rules are clear, that BSO allowance applies once a child attends primary school, and that municipalities can provide supplementary support through social medical indication, so no structural change is planned.
Where necessary, an additional provision can be made for children with a disability via the municipality.
Daar waar nodig kan er voor kinderen met een beperking een aanvullende voorziening worden getroffen via de gemeente
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over de gevolgen voor gedupeerde ouders van de uitspraak in de fraudezaak met kinderopvangtoeslag door eigenaar van kinderopvang de Parel

MP Heerma asked whether victims of the De Parel childcare fraud, who face repayment demands and fines, can be treated as victims and offered a payment or victim arrangement. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority must recover benefits paid to parents who did not meet the rules, that no fines were imposed, that standard and personal payment arrangements exist, and that the victim scheme has been checked proactively without any eligible parent found, while promising to examine the possibility of holding parents liable.
Regarding the criminal trajectory, it does not befit me to give a judgment on this.
Ten aanzien van het strafrechtelijke traject past het mij niet om hierover een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de verzending per post van persoonsgegevens in combinatie met het Burgerservicenummer
