An MP asked the Interior Minister and State Secretary of Finance whether sending letters by post that combine names, addresses and the citizen service number (BSN) risks misuse if lost, and what measures will prevent it. The minister answered that the Postwet provides reliability guarantees, that the BSN aids identification and no legal ban exists on combining these data, and that no new measures are planned, while declining to implement a motion on separating the VAT number from the BSN for self-employed persons due to administrative risks.
There are no legal restrictions prohibiting the use of a combination of these data in correspondence from or with the government.
Er zijn geen wettelijke beperkingen die het gebruik van een combinatie van deze gegevens in correspondentie van of met de overheid verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over corruptie bij de douane in de haven van Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Security and Justice about corruption among customs officers in the Port of Rotterdam, including whether the problem is structural, what measures are taken, and whether an independent inquiry will be held. The government denies a structural problem, describes preventive and disciplinary measures and new controls, says it cannot give a complete overview of smuggled goods, and declines an independent investigation, citing existing monitoring programmes.

The Customs service and the Public Prosecution Service do not have information to provide a complete overview of products (drugs, weapons) that entered in the past five years through bribery of customs personnel.

De Douane en het OM beschikken niet over informatie om een compleet overzicht te kunnen geven van producten (drugs, wapens) die de afgelopen vijf jaar via omkoping van douanepersoneel zijn binnengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Bashir over een BTW- constructie bij de schadeafwikkeling van aardbevingsschade in Groningen

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a VAT construction in compensation for Groningen earthquake damage, where NAM allegedly deducted VAT on property purchases and payments went to a NAM-chosen notary. The State Secretary answered that tax confidentiality (art. 67 AWR) prevents answering the case-specific questions, while answering general VAT rules on compensation, invoicing and the Supreme Court ruling of 2015, and announced withdrawal of a 2011 tolerance decision.
Given the tax confidentiality obligation, it is not possible to give you information about a specific taxpayer.
Gelet op de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht is het niet mogelijk aan u informatie over een specifieke belastingplichtige te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de NAM BTW-constructie

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Economic Affairs about a VAT construction by NAM in which damage compensation to Groningen earthquake victims was invoiced in NAM's name, so that VAT could be reclaimed, and whether this could be criminal or burdened victims. The State Secretary answered that VAT on repair services is generally due but declined to give details about NAM's specific arrangements citing tax confidentiality (art. 67 AWR), and refused to give victims legal immunity or request a tax ruling.
Given the fiscal confidentiality duty of art. 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot go into this matter concretely.
Gelet op de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht van art. 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet concreet ingaan op deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Zzp’er verwacht schade door nieuwe wetgeving”

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that freelancers expect harm from the new Wet DBA and about unclear enforcement, sector support, boetes and administrative burden. The government answered that the Belastingdienst will not enforce repressively until 1 May 2017 except in three named situations, that it will publish questions and answers and a summary of inquiries, and that it monitors implementation through consultations and stakeholder channels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Staatssecretaris Wiebes en zijn eigen Belastingdienst hanteren verschillende criteria rond (schijn)zelfstandigheid”

MP Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority treats a freelancer doing the same work as an employee, such as a temporary replacement, as an employment relationship, and why clients cannot hire self-employed people as replacements. The State Secretary answered that clients may hire freelancers for temporary replacement, that such an arrangement is judged on its own fiscal merits, and that it becomes an employment relationship only if the replacement works in the same way and under the same conditions as the employee replaced.
A working relationship, including a temporary one replacing someone employed, is assessed on its own fiscal merits.
Een arbeidsrelatie, ook een tijdelijke ter vervanging van iemand die in loondienst is, wordt op zijn eigen fiscale merites beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het bericht “Grote Nederlandse bedrijven houden miljarden in hun zak”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a SOMO report claiming large Dutch companies cost the Dutch tax authority about 1.5 billion euro a year through avoidance, and about the consistency with earlier corporate tax analyses. The State Secretary disputes the 1.5 billion figure, says the report cannot separate avoidance from tax incentives, maintains the earlier analysis, and states the government supports international agreements on profit taxation and transparency.
The conclusion of the study is in my view not that the Dutch tax authority loses 1.5 billion euro in tax through avoidance by large companies.
De conclusie van het onderzoek is naar mijn mening niet dat de Nederlandse fiscus 1,5 miljard euro aan belasting misloopt door belastingontwijking door grote bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de uitvoering van de motie over belasten van het werkelijk rendement op vermogen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance, in 13 questions, what has been done to implement the motion on taxing actual returns on wealth, how the Tax Authority's investment agenda and pre-filled tax return constrain such legislation, and what obstacles financial institutions face. The State Secretary answered that a study is ongoing, a progress report will follow on Prinsjesdag, and that feasibility and data questions cannot yet be settled.
On Prinsjesdag this year you will receive a progress report on this study.
Op Prinsjesdag dit jaar ontvangt u een voortgangsrapportage van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Groot over de onrust bij zzp’ers in de media over de Wet DBA

MPs Mei Li Vos and Groot asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Wet DBA, including whether intermediaries and payroll firms shift the risk of social premium back-payments onto contractors and whether the information campaign reaches clients. The State Secretary answered that the Act restores a balance of responsibilities, that the intermediary arrangement does not remove clients' risk, and that the Tax Authority runs a broad campaign aimed at both clients and contractors.
Yes, I am aware of the phenomenon described.
Ja, ik ben met het geschetste verschijnsel bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek van de Belastingdienst naar strafbare feiten aan de hand van de Panama Papers

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance when the Tax Authority would obtain the Panama Papers data, why journalists would not share it earlier, and how it could gain lawful access for enforcement. The State Secretary answered that the data would be available via an online database from 9 May, that the Tax Authority had contacted the newspaper and the JITSIC network, and that delay risks evidence loss, which the Tax Authority, FIOD and prosecutors confirmed.
I myself sought contact with the editorial board of Trouw with the request to make the underlying data available earlier.
Ik heb zelf contact gezocht met de hoofdredactie van Trouw met het verzoek om de achterliggende gegevens eerder beschikbaar te maken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over de Belastingdienst die in publiekscontacten in Friesland niet in het Fries communiceert

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked whether the Tax Authority refuses to speak Frisian on its public phone line in Friesland and whether it must comply with the Frisian Language Use Act. The government answered that Leeuwarden tax office can communicate in Frisian in person and in writing, that the national Tax Telephone Service is not obliged to offer Frisian, and that it will discuss the DINGtiid advice on a language officer before deciding on follow-up.
It is true that taxpayers are not spoken to in Frisian on the Tax Telephone Service.
Het klopt dat belastingplichtigen bij de Belastingtelefoon niet in het Fries te woord worden gestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Merkies over de onthulling in de Panama Papers dat een Rotterdams notariskantoor mee heeft gewerkt aan dubieuze financiële constructies

MPs Van Nispen and Merkies asked whether a Rotterdam notary firm helping set up dubious financial structures, revealed by the Panama Papers, breached notarial duties and whether investigation is warranted. The Minister said he awaits the outcome of an investigation by the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, which the firm itself reported, and sees no reason yet for broader inquiry into Dutch notaries and lawyers, while stating that helping move money out of the tax authorities' view is not a notary's task and is criminal.
Pending the outcome of that, I refrain from judging the situation and for now see no reason to launch broader investigation into Dutch lawyers and notaries.

In afwachting van de resultaten hiervan onthoud ik mij van een oordeel over de situatie en zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding om een breder onderzoek naar Nederlandse advocaten en notarissen in te stellen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Omtzigt aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de bizarre nieuwe wereld van de zzp’er

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the uncertainty facing freelancers (zzp'ers) under the new DBA rules replacing the VAR, including vague model contracts, enforcement of contract compliance, and readiness before 1 May 2016. The State Secretary answers that the model contracts are workable, that compliance is judged reasonably, that the Belastingdienst will process pending contracts in 6-8 weeks, and that the transition is adequately supported.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over "de gemeente Rotterdam die kinderopvangaanbieders zelf de hoogte van de ouderbijdrage laat vaststellen"

The MP asked whether Rotterdam letting childcare providers set and collect parental contributions raises privacy, fraud and proportionality concerns. The minister answered that setting parental fees for children without childcare benefit is a municipal responsibility, that the Rijk handles the childcare allowance and that the new funding system does not give providers access to parents' income data, and promised a study on municipal practices around summer.
It is up to municipalities to decide how the parental contribution is set for children without entitlement to the childcare allowance.
Het is aan gemeenten om te bepalen hoe de ouderbijdrage wordt vastgesteld voor kinderen zonder recht op kinderopvangtoeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verloren cassatie waar de diensten van een magnetiseur als gelijkwaardig werden betiteld aan die van BIG-geregistreerde psychologen en psychiaters

An SP MP asked the Health and Finance ministers about a Supreme Court ruling that treated a magnetiser's services as equivalent to those of BIG-registered psychologists and psychiatrists for VAT exemption, and about alleged fraud and the revenue loss. The State Secretary replied that the ruling forces a broader application of the medical VAT exemption under fiscal neutrality, that the policy decision was updated, that about 28 million euro structural annual loss results (52 million total exemption cost), that the Tax Service does not intervene in individual court cases, and that reopening is only possible in exceptional circumstances.
The cabinet does not interfere in these cases and does not pronounce on them.
Het kabinet mengt zich niet in deze zaken en doet daar ook geen uitspraak over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de criteria gezag, arbeid en loon

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the criteria of authority, labour and pay used to assess freelance work, including past inspection options, the 80% figure, clarity of the authority criterion, payroll and intermediary relations, and opting-in. The State Secretary answers that the criteria come from the Civil Code and are sufficiently clear, that model agreements give certainty, and that the authority test is applied to the actual contractual terms, while committing to no new action.
The three criteria of authority, labour and pay come from the Civil Code.
De drie criteria gezag, arbeid en loon komen uit het Burgerlijk Wetboek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Gesthuizen over de samenwerking tussen het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en Belastingdienst in ontnemingskwesties

MPs Van Nispen and Gesthuizen asked why cooperation between the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the Tax Authority on confiscating criminal assets was so weak for eighteen years and why the AAFD protocol came only in 2015. The minister replied that cooperation does exist, that the protocol is not a dead letter, and that the Prosecution Service and Tax Authority will tighten the rules and the Lower House will be informed later.
Following the recommendations of the Investigation Committee, the College of Procurators-General is revising the Aanwijzing and Instructie on asset confiscation.
Naar aanleiding van de aanbevelingen van de Onderzoekscommissie herziet het College van procureurs-generaal de Aanwijzing en de Instructie afpakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Neppérus over het bericht dat ZZP-ers niet langer meer in de zorg kunnen werken

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Neppérus asked whether the Tax Authority's rejection of a freelancer's model contract in care, and an alleged conflict with the Wkkgz, would stop self-employed care workers from working in care after the VAR expires. The government denied any conflict, said the Wkkgz does not hinder self-employed work in care and that no legal amendment is needed, while noting that false self-employment must be prevented.
The Wkkgz does not form an obstacle to working as a self-employed person in care.
De Wkkgz vormt geen belemmering om als zzp’er in de zorg werkzaam te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over mogelijke maatregelen naar aanleiding van de gepleegde fraude met dieselauto’s

MPs Hoogland asked the government about possible measures following the diesel emissions fraud at Volkswagen, covering prosecution, regulation, testing (WLTP and RDE), type approval and fiscal options. The government answered that no facts currently justify a criminal investigation, that Dutch national bans on type-approved diesel cars are legally excluded, and that it is pursuing stricter EU-level testing and market surveillance rules.
There are currently no facts or circumstances known on the basis of which the Public Prosecution Service can start a criminal investigation.
Er zijn thans geen feiten of omstandigheden bekend geworden op grond waarvan het Openbaar Ministerie een strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Grashoff over het oplossen van de problematiek rondom het zogenaamde ‘papieren inkomen’

MPs Voortman and Grashoff asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Social Affairs about the unresolved problem of 'papieren inkomen' arising from debt-forgiveness of Bbz start-up loans, which raises tax-credit (toeslag) income tests. The government confirms the problem persists, says a structural fix via taxation is under study with municipalities and other departments, promises to inform the Ombudsman and the House by year-end, and defers any retroactive arrangement.
Once a solution is in view, we will inform the Ombudsman and the House of Representatives.
Als een oplossing in beeld is, zullen wij de Ombudsman en de Tweede Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over verrekenen van toeslagen en uiterste aanvraagdatum van toeslagen

MP Bashir asked the State Secretary of Finance whether benefit clawback (dwangverrekening) only applies to benefit debts, when it occurs, whether other debts can trigger it, and why the 1 September application deadline exists. The State Secretary answered that clawback applies only to benefit debts after a payment arrangement fails, that the tax authority offers a standard 24-month plan and individual arrangements, that payments can be suspended under the Awir for address doubts, and that he sees no need to change the 1 September deadline or the rules.
Offsetting of benefits under this power only arises where there is a benefit debt and not where there is a tax debt.
Verrekening van toeslagen op grond van deze bevoegdheid is alleen aan de orde als er sprake is van een toeslagschuld en niet als er sprake is van een belastingschuld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over fiscale trucs voor vermogenden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax schemes allowing wealthy people to reduce tax by moving savings from box 3 into a BV or business account, the use of loss relief, dga salaries, and the business succession facility. The State Secretary answered that business accounts do not escape wealth tax under the asset-labelling doctrine, that data on such cases is unavailable, and that the succession facility's evaluation is still being studied.
It is not possible to determine with the available data how much use is made of this and what the budgetary impact is.
Het is niet mogelijk om met de beschikbare data te bepalen hoeveel hiervan gebruik wordt gemaakt en wat het budgettair beslag is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over ‘fiscaal onderdak Rostec’

An MP asked the government whether Rostec's arms-exporting subsidiary Rosoboronexport, linked to the BUK missile, should be denied tax residence in the Netherlands, and about the EU sanctions on Rostec's director Chemezov. The government answered that the sanctions and the 2014 listing were in place, that tax confidentiality prevents detail on a single company, and that the Netherlands cannot refuse a company's seat based on its activities.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act, the cabinet cannot provide further information about individual taxpayers (legal persons).

Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet geen verdere informatie verstrekken over individueel belastingplichtige (rechts)personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het ontduiken van btw-regels door internetbedrijven die zich op de Nederlandse markt richten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how VAT on electronic services sold to Dutch consumers by foreign providers is collected, whether foreign providers face the same VAT-number and payment-provider obligations as Dutch firms, and whether online ad sales fall under electronic services. The State Secretary answered that foreign providers can register via the one-stop shop (about 3,000 per quarter in 2015, roughly 50 million euro net), that the Tax Authority supervises through risk-based enforcement, that there is no unfair competition, and declined to meet payment providers.
As indicated above, there is no unfair competition between domestic and foreign entrepreneurs.
Zoals hiervoor is aangegeven is er geen sprake van oneerlijke concurrentie tussen binnenlandse en buitenlandse ondernemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de Belastingtelefoon wederom een onvoldoende heeft gekregen

The MP asks why the Tax Authority's helpline (Belastingtelefoon) again received a poor rating from the Consumentenbond, why service has not improved since 2014, and what concrete measures will be taken. The State Secretary replies that the consumer test covers highly specialised questions, that the Tax Authority's own IPSOS research shows 89% of questions answered correctly, and that complex questions will be redirected to the website library or tax advisers, with no commitment to a specific rating target.

The Tax Authority is working towards a new way of interaction with a sharper distinction between status and general substantive questions on the one hand, and more complex, case-specific questions on the other.

De Belastingdienst werkt toe naar een nieuwe manier van interactie met een scherper onderscheid tussen status- en meer algemeen-inhoudelijke vragen enerzijds, en complexere, casusspecifieke vragen anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Groot over de onrust bij zzp’ers in de media over de Wet DBA

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about uncertainty among freelancers over the Wet DBA, including whether the Tax Authority's website guidance is clear enough and whether intermediaries become more attractive to clients. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority is simplifying its information and running a broad communication campaign, that model contracts are optional, and that the Act does not change the legal definition of employment versus entrepreneurship.
The Tax Authority endorses the importance of good information and recognises the concern that freelancers do not derive certainty from the text on the Tax Authority's website.
De Belastingdienst onderschrijft het belang van een goede voorlichting en herkent het geluid dat zzp'ers geen zekerheid ontlenen aan de tekst op de website van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de foutmelding op de website van de Belastingdienst op de eerste aangiftedag

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about website overload and login errors on the Tax Authority portal on the first filing day, and about the discontinuation of the downloadable filing program easytax. The State Secretary answered all 13 questions, explaining capacity expansion, that peak-time overload is occasional and that users are asked to file in spread-out fashion, and that easytax was phased out in favour of online filing.
Question 13: Can you answer these questions one by one and within two weeks? Answer 13: Yes
Vraag 13 Kunt u deze vragen één voor één en binnen twee weken beantwoorden? Antwoord 13 Ja
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Groot over privacylekken bij de Belastingdienst

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Finance about privacy breaches and wrongly registered residence ('ghost occupancy') at the Tax Authority, which halt benefit payments, including whether there are system errors, whether the Authority will meet the Data Protection Authority's deadline, whether breaches of confidentiality should be corrected faster, and whether affected citizens will be compensated. The State Secretary answered that the root cause lies in the Personal Records Database, that the Tax Authority corrects its systems and calculations once a report is made, that a new fast-track protocol was introduced in 2015 with extra attention since early 2016, and that affected persons receive owed benefits with possible damages claimed through the complaints procedure.
Once this is known to the Tax Authority, it will be resolved.
Zodra dit bij de Belastingdienst wel bekend is, wordt dit opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Pieter Heerma over de voortslepende zaak rondom de voormalige kinderopvang de Parel

MPs Siderius and Heerma asked whether the childcare benefit system's past vulnerability to fraud, the reliance on recommendations from schools and municipalities, the unpaid parental contributions, enforcement and recovery, and the hardship faced by parents affected by the De Parel case justified changes or relief. The State Secretary replied that the 2011 DigiD loophole was closed, that parents remain responsible for their applications, that recovery follows legal obligations with objections and payment arrangements available, and that he cannot discuss individual cases or the municipal costs of hardship.
Because of the duty of confidentiality, individual cases cannot be discussed.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht kan niet ingegaan worden op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over het bericht 'Wiebes boos om Braziliaanse belastingactie tegen Nederland'

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked the State Secretary of Finance about Brazil placing the Netherlands on its grey list over preferential holding company tax treatment, its effect on Dutch firms, treaty renegotiation, anti-abuse clauses, disclosure of Dutch-Brazilian exchanges, and parallels with Mongolia and Malawi terminating tax treaties. The State Secretary answered that the listing is unjustified, Brazil has not clarified its criterion, treaty talks stalled since 2008 but are being revived with anti-abuse measures, diplomatic correspondence cannot be shared, and the Mongolia and Malawi cases are unrelated.
Given the confidentiality of diplomatic exchanges, I cannot go into detail on this in the answers to these parliamentary questions.
Met het oog op de vertrouwelijkheid van het diplomatieke verkeer, kan ik daar in de antwoorden op deze Kamervragen niet in detail op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Merkies over de belastingvoordelen voor Shell, Total en ENI in Nigeria

SP MPs asked the government to react to an ActionAid report on tax holidays worth 3.3 billion dollars for Shell, Total and ENI in Nigeria, and whether such incentives help poor countries, and asked about Dutch involvement and aid to Nigeria. The minister answered that tax incentives should be used narrowly, that Nigeria is responsible for its own incentive design, that the Netherlands did not actively help Shell obtain its incentive, that tax holidays show weak effects and the OECD and IMF advise restraint, and gave Nigeria aid figures.
The Dutch government does not support individual Dutch companies in obtaining favourable tax treatment in developing countries.
De Nederlandse overheid geeft geen ondersteuning aan individuele Nederlandse bedrijven om een gunstige fiscale behandeling in ontwikkelingslanden te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de over de rol van belastingparadijzen in het vergroten van de wereldwijde ongelijkheid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about Oxfam's report on global inequality, billionaire wealth, and the role of tax havens, including whether tax avoidance worsens inequality and how BEPS measures stop profit shifting. The State Secretary answered that inequality stems from many factors, that BEPS targets companies rather than wealthy individuals, that transparency measures such as the Common Reporting Standard address individual evasion, and that the report did not clearly show money flows from the Netherlands to the named tax havens.
The BEPS project of the OECD and G20 and the recently proposed EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Package target internationally operating companies, not (wealthy) individuals.

Het BEPS project van de OESO en de G20 en het recent door de Europese Commissie voorgestelde «Anti tax Avoidance Package» richten zich op internationaal opererende bedrijven, niet op (rijke) individuen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over de rapporten van de Auditdienst Rijk

Two MPs (Ronnes and Omtzigt, CDA) asked the Finance, Justice and Security, and Defence ministers about the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) audit reports, including a list of 2015 reports, when each was sent to parliament, and the status of six announced audits. The government answered that it sent most reports promptly, gave dates for each, said some audits are unfinished or were commissioned by other ministers, and committed to publishing the reports on the ministries' websites.
The study referred to under b is being carried out on the instructions of the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and has not yet been completed.
Het onderzoek bedoeld onder b wordt uitgevoerd in opdracht van de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst startende ondernemers laat wachten

MP Van Weyenberg (D66) asked whether the Tax Authority's delays in issuing VAT numbers to start-up entrepreneurs, a recurring January peak, were foreseen and what will prevent repetition. State Secretary Wiebes answered that extra capacity was deployed but proved insufficient this year, that processing times have fallen to seven working days, and that the Tax Authority knows of no hardship and has received no complaints.
Measures have now been taken to clear the backlog.
Inmiddels zijn maatregelen getroffen om de achterstand weg te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Segers over de BTW-plicht van gemeenten bij ambtelijke fusies

MPs Schouten and Segers asked why municipalities merging their civil service must pay VAT on services from the joint organisation, and whether an exemption would be introduced. The Staatssecretaris confirmed awareness, explained the cooperation exemption's conditions, and announced a policy change extending the exemption to services used 70% or more for non-taxed municipal activities, largely solving the problem.
I will publish this policy change in the usual way, whereby under the Besluit Fiscaal Bestuursrecht the past will not be revisited ex officio.
Ik zal deze beleidswijziging op de gebruikelijke wijze publiceren, waarbij conform het Besluit Fiscaal Bestuursrecht ambtshalve niet op het verleden wordt teruggekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Kerstens over het bericht Pakket kopzorgen PostNL

Two MPs from the PvdA asked whether the Tax Authority (Belastingdienst) favours PostNL by failing to enforce against false self-employment of its parcel couriers, and whether UWV and PostNL are linked. The State Secretary answered that enforcement has been ineffective under the VAR regime, that the Wet DBA will allow stricter enforcement from 2016-2017, and that UWV and PostNL have no referral arrangement.
Enforcement by the Tax Authority at the client is therefore currently futile.
Handhaving door de Belastingdienst bij de opdrachtgever is nu dus vruchteloos.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over naheffingen voor zzp’ers in de zorg

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Finance how many self-employed care workers had their VAR-wuo converted into a VAR-loon, how large the resulting back-tax assessments were, and whether these could be undone given the changed Tax Authority assessment practice from October 2013. The State Secretary answered that 257 care workers were converted in 2013, 104 in 2015, that the average correction was EUR 14,000, and that no change in assessment practice occurred, so legal remedies via objection and appeal remain the route.
It is procedurally incorrect to assume that a VAR-wuo can be requested.
Het is procedureel niet juist om te veronderstellen dat een VAR-wuo kan worden aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Merkies en Grashoff over de belastingontwijking door wapenproducenten

MPs Bruins, Merkies and Grashoff asked whether seven of the ten largest arms producers use Dutch tax structures, whether they have rulings, and whether their substance is adequate. The State Secretary declined to give information on individual taxpayers under confidentiality rules, explained the substance test and risk-based supervision, and said public country-by-country reporting awaits an EU impact assessment.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I cannot provide information about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik geen informatie verstrekken over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het bericht dat de overheid pakketbezorger PostNL bevoordeelt

An MP asked whether the Tax Authority favours PostNL by accepting a 'replaceability' clause in its contracts, which may encourage bogus self-employment in parcel delivery. The State Secretary answered that tax secrecy prevents comment on individuals, that free-substitution clauses are assessed by the same standard for any client, and that the Tax Authority has no own discretion, while the new DBA bill would allow enforcement where practice diverges from contracts.
The confidentiality duty of article 67 of the General Tax Act prevents statements about individual taxpayers.
De geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen verhindert het om uitlatingen over individuele belastingplichtigen te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de uitwerking van de dienstverleningsovereenkomst-vrijstelling

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the DVO exemption (for service agreements between public bodies) is applied, including whether the competition criterion must be tested and how it applies to a municipal enforcement officer (BOA) working under an inter-municipal service agreement. The State Secretary said the exemption is applied as intended, that it does not cover activities a municipality could outsource to the market, and that the exemption is not a dead letter.
I see no reason to amend the statutory text on this point, since this would not materially change anything for stakeholders or for implementation.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de wettekst op dit punt alsnog aan te passen, aangezien dit materieel niet tot een wijziging leidt voor belanghebbenden en voor de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over naar aanleiding van reactie aan de Eerste Kamer, vergaderjaar 2015–2016, 34 036, F

MP Klein asked the State Secretary of Finance, following up on a letter to the Senate, how many self-employed workers (zzp'ers) the Tax Administration, Finance Ministry and UWV hire, whether they may be replaced, and how this fits EU procurement and employment-relationship rules. The State Secretary answered that the ministries and UWV hire 111, 21 and 119 zzp'ers directly, that third-party hires cannot be tracked, that substitution is allowed only exceptionally with consent, and that the Wet DBA will require them to verify the absence of an employment relationship.
The Tax Administration and the Ministry of Finance do not have data on the number of zzp'ers hired through third parties.
De Belastingdienst en het Ministerie van Financiën beschikken niet over gegevens omtrent aantallen zzp'ers die via derden worden ingehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Geurts over de heffing van btw op subsidies voor rietlandbeheerders in de Weerribben en Wieden

Two MPs asked whether the government will help secure a VAT-free subsidy arrangement for reed-land managers in the Weerribben and Wieden after a tax inspector ruled them VAT-liable. The Secretary of State confirmed the ruling, said the arrangement cannot avoid VAT under EU rules as proposed, and pointed to alternative structures (a collective or a combined entity) and possible amendment of the provincial subsidy scheme while giving no firm commitment to a specific fix.

Within the framework of laws and regulations there is willingness to look, on a proposal from the parties involved, at a sector proposal for reed-land management under which no VAT is levied on the reed-land managers.

Binnen het kader van wet- en regelgeving bestaat de bereidheid om op voorstel van betrokken partijen te kijken naar een voorstel van de sector om te komen tot rietlandbeheer waarbij geen heffing van btw plaatsvindt bij de rietlandbeheerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bashir over de weinig coulante houding van de Belastingdienst bij vermissingszaken

MPs Van Nispen and Bashir asked why the Tax Administration persisted with a payment order and showed little leniency toward the relatives of a missing taxpayer, and whether it follows a protocol for missing persons. The State Secretary acknowledged the handling was regrettable, described an ongoing protocol with Slachtofferhulp Nederland and a planned verification via the national missing persons register.

The letter the trustee sent to the Tax Administration should have led to immediately blocking all ongoing activities and pursuing settlement of outstanding tax matters in consultation with the trustee.

De brief die de bewindvoerder aan de Belastingdienst heeft gestuurd, had ertoe moeten leiden alle lopende activiteiten onmiddellijk te blokkeren en in overleg met de bewindvoerder afwikkeling van lopende belastingaangelegenheden na te streven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Veldhoven over het beleid om op basis van de typegoedkeuringswaarde CO2 gedifferentieerde belastingen vast te stellen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Veldhoven asked whether the Finance Ministry knew of the growing gap between type-approval and real-world CO2 figures used for car taxes, and why no alternative basis was studied, plus the Volkswagen tax impact and planned action. The state secretary answered that the ministry was aware through TNO and Court of Audit work, that alternatives were judged impractical pending the WLTP test, that Volkswagen-related revenue losses are expected to be very limited and clarity is expected in early 2016, and that Autobrief II measures address the plug-in hybrid gap.
The cabinet is aware of the gap between standard and real-world consumption and has informed the House on several occasions.
Het kabinet is bekend met de afwijking tussen norm- en praktijkverbruik en heeft daar uw Kamer bij verschillende gelegenheden over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vliet over de berichten dat de vrijstelling vennootschapsbelastingplicht voor zeehavens mogelijk vervalt voordat dat er sprake is van een gelijk speelveld in de EU

An MP asked why the government would let the corporate tax exemption for seaports lapse before a level playing field exists in the EU, and whether the exemption could be kept. The Secretary of State explains that the exemption is likely state aid the Commission will require ending from 1 January 2017 after a one-year transition, and that Nederland faces court-ordered recovery if it keeps it, so it has warned ports and Parliament accordingly.
That is why the cabinet has called on the European Commission to issue state aid guidelines for seaports to provide that clarity.
Vandaar dat het kabinet de Europese Commissie heeft opgeroepen te komen met richtsnoeren staatssteun voor zeehavens om die duidelijkheid te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de groeiende geldnood

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about rising household debt arrears and proposed a flat tax, lower VAT and corporate tax, and phasing out allowances, arguing this would reduce the state's role. Minister Asscher answered that arrears reflect income losses, defended the progressive tax and allowance system, rejected the flat tax, and said the government had not accepted the claim that large redistribution necessarily curbs growth.
I do not share this view. The current tax system is individual and progressive and aimed at stimulating labour participation.
Deze mening deel ik niet. Het huidige belastingsysteem is individueel en progressief en gericht op het stimuleren van arbeidsparticipatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat Nederland interesse heeft in de transactietaks

An MP from the PVV asked the Finance Ministry whether the Netherlands intends to join the group negotiating a financial transaction tax, and about Estonia's withdrawal, the coalition agreement's conditions, effects on finance and pensions, a possible UK court challenge, and whether the EU should be left. The minister replied that the Netherlands has not joined the enhanced cooperation group, that no deal exists yet, that any deal will be assessed against the coalition criteria and shared with parliament, and that tax is a national competence while international cooperation remains important.
As previously promised to your House, I will share this assessment with the House.
Zoals eerder in uw Kamer toegezegd, zal ik deze appreciatie dan met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Harbers over het bericht ‘De enorme interesse voor vergunningen voor internetgokken in Nederland’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Harbers asked about the expected size of the online gambling market, the revenue impact of uniform gambling tax rates of 24% or 25%, expected channelling rates and enforcement options. The government estimated the 2014 market at about 232 million euros, reported a lower revenue estimate than previously assumed if uniform rates were adopted, and said full enforcement against illegal online operators is unrealistic, so successful initial channelling is crucial.
At my request, three trade associations of online gambling operators made a closer estimate of the size of the Dutch online gambling market in 2014.

Op mijn verzoek hebben drie brancheorganisaties van online kansspelaanbieders, Speel Verantwoord, European Gaming and Betting Association en Remote Gaming Association, een nadere inschatting gemaakt van de omvang van de Nederlandse markt voor online kansspelen in 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht ‘Nederland blokkeerde belastingherzieningen’

Senator-level MP Merkies (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Netherlands systematically blocked EU tax reforms on business tax benefits such as the innovation box, and why. The State Secretary denied chairing or steering the Code of Conduct group, explained the modified nexus approach compromise and the Dutch aim of keeping the box open to SMEs, and said the 2010 tax-ruling exchange was only a temporary study reservation later withdrawn.
The Code of Conduct group discussed patent and innovation boxes within the EU on several occasions.
Er is in de Gedragscodegroep een aantal keren gesproken over patent- en innovatieboxen binnen de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie de Nederlandse tax ruling als illegale staatssteun bestempelt

The SP MP Merkies asked the State Secretary of Finance how the Dutch tax ruling for Starbucks could be reconciled with the European Commission's finding of illegal state aid, including the TNMM method, royalty payments, and effective tax burden. The State Secretary defended the TNMM method and the arm's length principle, said the Commission's case concerns an individual ruling, and argued that the price of imported beans and royalties were not decisive for the Dutch taxable profit.
The European Commission's decision concerns an individual case.
Het besluit van de Europese Commissie betreft een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het terugvorderen van ten onrechte verleende belastingvoordelen bij sjoemelende autofabrikanten

An MP asked whether tax benefits given to Volkswagen cars should be recovered after the emissions fraud, and whether lost tax revenue from CO2 misreporting would be pursued. The State Secretary said the NOx fraud is outside the scope of CO2-based tax incentives, that an investigation into possible CO2 irregularities and their tax consequences has started, and that Volkswagen will bear any additional levies, but could not yet quantify lost revenue.
I have therefore started an investigation into the possible consequences of these irregularities for tax collection.
Ik ben daarom een onderzoek gestart naar de mogelijke gevolgen van deze onregelmatigheden voor de belastingheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Schouten over het verdwijnen van de blauwe envelop, het gebruik van de berichtenbox en de ouderenservice van de ouderenbonden

MPs Omtzigt and Schouten asked about complaints over abolishing the paper blue envelope, digital-only delivery via the Berichtenbox, and the future of the elderly tax-help service run by senior unions. Secretary Wiebes answered that support for less digitally capable people will continue, that the elderly service receives a one-year 2016 contribution, and that the first digital-only letter is the 2016 allowance continuation notice with a 6-week objection period preserved.
To ensure the first fully digital delivery of allowance messages in the Berichtenbox takes place responsibly, the Tax Administration starts with the notice on continuation of allowances.

Om te zorgen dat de eerste volledig digitale bezorging van toeslagberichten in de Berichtenbox ook verantwoord plaatsvindt, begint de Belastingdienst met het bericht over de continuering van toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het besluit van de Europese Commissie aangaande Starbucks

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the European Commission's decision that the Starbucks tax ruling constituted state aid, whether the full decision will be published, the government's cooperation with Starbucks, the BEPS implications for intangibles and hybrid mismatches, and the transfer pricing decree. The State Secretary answered that the confidential version was received, Dutch consultation on confidential data is ongoing with a reply to follow within weeks, and that BEPS changes are largely in line with existing Dutch policy, though the transfer pricing decree will be revised later.
I expect to be able to inform the House further within a few weeks about the government's response and view on the decision.
Ik verwacht Uw Kamer binnen enkele weken nader te kunnen informeren over de reactie en zienswijze van het kabinet op het besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Segers over het onterecht in rekening brengen van informatie- en executiekosten door gerechtsdeurwaarders

MPs asked whether bailiffs wrongly charge information and execution costs, including unjustified bank attachments, and how often tax-authority attachments are pointless. The minister answered that the KBvG reported four disciplinary complaints and the BFT three investigations in five years, that no further consultation is needed, and that roughly 130,000 to 135,000 attachments are levied yearly with electronic information requests and the VISH index used to reduce pointless attachments.
In view of the information provided by the BFT and the KBvG, I see no reason to enter into additional discussions on this matter.
Gelet op de verstrekte informatie van het BFT en de KBvG zie ik geen aanleiding aanvullende gesprekken hierover aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Neppérus over de pilots voor het eID (elektronische identiteit) stelsel

MPs De Caluwé and Neppérus asked whether a bank-login pilot with the Tax Administration could start before evaluation criteria for the eID pilots were discussed with the House, and whether it would wait for that discussion. The minister confirmed the criteria would be sent in time for the 25 November consultation, but said the bank pilot starts mid-December, after that meeting, with a small group and wider use from 1 March.
The State Secretary for Finance will inform you in a separate letter in more detail about the evaluation criteria for the bank pilot.
De Staatssecretaris van Financiën zal u in een separate brief nader informeren over de evaluatiecriteria voor de bankenpilot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt, Bashir, Tony van Dijck en Van Vliet over de afschaffing van de oldtimervrijstelling

MPs from CDA, SP, PVV and Van Vliet asked the Finance State Secretary about the revenue estimates for abolishing the classic-car tax exemption, the number of diesel and LPG cars affected, and the cost of extending transitional rules to them. The State Secretary defended revised revenue estimates of roughly 60 to 70 million euros, gave a table of affected vehicles, and rejected extending transitional rules to diesel and LPG cars because of budget and air-quality concerns.

In my letter on the classic car measure I only intended to indicate that, to reach the estimated revenue of 137 million euros, the second part of the revenue, the replacement cars, would need to yield 82 million euros in motor vehicle tax.

Ik heb in mijn brief over de oldtimermaatregel slechts willen aangegeven dat, om de geraamde opbrengst van € 137 miljoen te halen, het tweede deel van de opbrengst, de vervangende auto's, € 82 miljoen aan MRB zou moeten opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de berichtgeving dat de belastingdienst kweekbenodigdheden voor de hennepteelt heeft doorverkocht op een veiling

An MP asked whether the Tax Authority wrongly auctioned cannabis-cultivation equipment seized for tax debts, in conflict with Opiumwet article 11a, and how such sales will be prevented. The minister answered that the seizure was fiscal, predated article 11a's entry into force, that a national procedure now requires police consultation and destruction of such goods, and declined to disclose sale proceeds.
Information on the sale proceeds falls under the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the Invorderingswet 1990.
Informatie over de verkoopopbrengst valt onder de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Invorderingswet 1990.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Staat de in Nederland geheven dividendbelasting moet terugbetalen aan particuliere beleggers die elders in de Europese Unie wonen

Merkies (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance how the CJEU ruling requiring the Netherlands to refund dividend tax to non-resident portfolio shareholders would affect revenue, timing, box 3 rules and other EU states, and what measures would cover any shortfall. Wiebes answered that the ruling mainly affects non-resident individuals with portfolio holdings (estimated shortfall EUR 39m one-off and EUR 13m structural, subject to the Hoge Raad ruling), that a three-year refund period applies, that legislation or a policy decision will follow, and that implications for other member states cannot be generalised.
The ruling means that non-resident individual shareholders may in certain cases be entitled to a refund of dividend tax.
Het arrest leidt ertoe dat buitenlandse particuliere aandeelhouders in voorkomende gevallen mogelijk recht krijgen op een teruggave van dividendbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Neppérus en Koolmees over dubbele belasting voor Nederlanders met de Amerikaanse nationaliteit

MPs Omtzigt, Neppérus and Koolmees asked the State Secretary of Finance about double taxation of Dutch citizens who also hold US nationality, covering US taxation of foreign benefits, home sale gains, BV loans, investment restrictions and IRS penalties. The State Secretary answered that the US applies nationality-based taxation under the 1992 treaty, that no concrete cases of double taxation are known, that no treaty renegotiation or OECD agenda item is planned, and that the US sets its own penalty regime.
I have no concrete signals that there is suddenly double taxation.
Ik heb geen concrete signalen dat er nu opeens sprake zou zijn van dubbele belastingheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Hoogland over de berichtgeving rondom de fraude met emissiesoftware door Volkswagen

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance and of Infrastructure and Environment how Volkswagen manipulated emissions tests, whether other brands or EU countries are affected, how US and EU testing differ, and what should be done to check Dutch and EU effects. The government referred several answers to earlier answers, confirmed NOx emissions in practice are much higher than the EU norm, said the RDW cannot yet determine vehicle numbers, and described that the German type-approval authority KBA has set Volkswagen a deadline for a remedy.
As soon as the necessary data are available, the RDW will determine the numbers.
Zodra de noodzakelijke gegevens beschikbaar zijn zal de RDW de aantallen achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de BTW-plicht voor agrarisch natuur- en landschapsbeheer

An MP asked whether VAT should not be charged on payments for agricultural nature and landscape management, whether the payments remain cost-covering, and whether farmers would be compensated if VAT applied. The government replied that payments are based on income loss and labour, that VAT would make them non-cost-covering, but that the tax authority has ruled no VAT is due on the subsidies received via collectives, and it gave no commitment to compensation.
The position is that there is no VAT liability for the subsidy received from the province for implementing the management packages by the farmers who together form the collective.

Het standpunt luidt dat er geen BTW-plicht is voor de subsidie die van de provincie wordt ontvangen in het kader van de uitvoering van de beheerpakketten door de betrokken agrariërs die samen het collectief vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Merkies, Smaling en Van Bommel over het bericht “Afspraken VN-top stellen arme landen teleur”

MPs from the SP asked why no international tax body was created to combat tax avoidance, how much developing countries lose to profit shifting, and what the UN Addis Ababa conference means for aid and Dutch policy. The minister answered that BEPS and a compromise on the UN tax committee are the main routes, that loss estimates are unreliable, and that the outcome supports the SDGs without new pledges.
Owing to the lack of unambiguous data, it is currently impracticable to give a ratio between total development aid and the taxes developing countries lose through tax avoidance by multinationals.

Bij gebrek aan eenduidige gegevens is het thans ondoenlijk om een verhouding aan te geven tussen de totale ontwikkelingshulp en de belastingen die ontwikkelingslanden mislopen als gevolg van belastingontwijking door multinationals.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat tientallen miljoenen in de zorg aan onnodig fiscaal advies verspild zijn

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether medical specialists' founding of new companies to keep entrepreneurial status was unnecessary after declaration rules changed, and about the role of tax advice and Article 3.5 Wet IB 2001. The State Secretary answered that the loss of direct declaration rights generally does not by itself establish entrepreneurship, that the Tax Service did not pressure parties, and that eligibility depends on all relevant risks, with the government open to contracts being submitted to the Tax Service.
I note that in practice some unclarity has arisen about the extent of the personnel risks to be borne.
Ik merk hierbij op dat in de praktijk enige onduidelijkheid is gerezen over de omvang van de te lopen personeelsrisico's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over mogelijke belastingontwijking door Walmart

The SP MP Merkies asks the State Secretary of Finance about a report alleging that Walmart uses Dutch and Luxembourg holding companies to dodge taxes, and about whether the Netherlands facilitates such avoidance. The State Secretary rejects the tax-haven label, points to Dutch transparency measures and OECD/EU work on country-by-country reporting, and declines to explain Walmart's subsidiaries or their motives citing confidentiality under article 67 AWR.
Because of the confidentiality obligation in article 67 AWR, I cannot address your question why Walmart has five subsidiaries in the Netherlands and what activities they carry out.

Voorts kan ik vanwege de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 AWR niet ingaan op uw vraag waarom Walmart in Nederland over vijf dochterondernemingen beschikt en welke activiteiten zij ontplooien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Fokke over de vennootschapsbelasting

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about corporate tax (VpB) treatment of municipal land development companies, including whether each project is taxed separately, how land positions are valued, and when land should be written down to agricultural value. The government answered that taxation depends on case facts and that projects may be netted only where activities are interwoven, that separate valuation follows BBV rules, and that talks with the VNG resumed, with a planned BBV change from 1 January 2016.
The consultation was already ongoing again at the time the article appeared.
Het overleg was al weer gaande ten tijde van het verschijnen van het artikel
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de rol van Nederland in het faciliteren van belastingontwijking vanuit Griekenland

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Netherlands facilitates tax avoidance from Greece through letterbox companies, and about Greek tax collection, the Lagarde list, and the troika's negotiating conduct. The minister denied that Dutch letterbox firms facilitate avoidance, refused to give company-specific or nationality-based information citing tax confidentiality, and gave general answers on Greek reforms and the bailout process.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot provide information on individual taxpayers.
Ik kan op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen informatie geven over individuele belastingplichtigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Fokke over het voorkomen van onevenredig banenverlies in de provincies Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland en Limburg door de reorganisatie van de Belastingdienst

MPs De Vries and Fokke asked whether the Tax Authority reorganisation has been instructed to prevent disproportionate job losses in Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland and Limburg, and whether the De Vries motion will be honoured. The State Secretary answered that a detailed plan follows in autumn, that unions and the works council are consulted but municipalities are not initiated, and that regional employment effects will be reported later by the Minister for Housing and Government Employment, with the De Vries and Groot-Schouten motions taken into account.
I can commit that the De Vries motion will be taken into account in the picture the Minister intends to present to you.
Ik kan toezeggen dat de motie De Vries (Kamerstuk 31 490, nr. 126 ) wordt meegenomen in het beeld dat de Minister u wil schetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het stopzetten van toeslagen voor dak- en thuislozen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority stops allowances for homeless people who share a postal address, and whether it will stop doing so. The State Secretary answered that shared postal addresses are not a criterion for stopping allowances, but acknowledged a handling error for people who changed from a home address to a postal address, and said affected people will receive new decisions.
Merely that several persons use the same postal address is not a criterion for stopping allowances.
Sec het feit dat er door meerdere personen gebruik wordt gemaakt van hetzelfde postadres is geen criterium om toeslagen stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht “Lerato wordt gek van brieven Belastingdienst”

An MP asked whether the Tax Authority would commission an independent investigation into its complaint handling after repeated erroneous letters to a child, and how it compensates damages including forced house sale and non-material harm. The State Secretary declined an independent inquiry, citing the volume of errors, said complaint coordinators exist and apologies were made, and explained that compensation requires unlawful conduct and is assessed case by case, with non-material damage limited to specific grounds.
An independent investigation into such errors will not change that.
Een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar dergelijke fouten zal daar geen verandering in brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over het bericht ‘Havens verliezen hun belastingvrijstelling’

MPs Albert de Vries and Groot asked whether the European Commission has moved to a new phase and issued an ultimatum over the temporary corporate tax exemption for Dutch seaports, how the Commission treats indirect state aid to ports in other member states, and what alternatives exist. The Secretary of State declined to disclose the content or outcome of ongoing talks with the Commission and did not assess alternatives, referring instead to the earlier answers, while noting that talks aim to avoid forced recovery of the aid from 1 January 2016.
The talks between the cabinet and the European Commission are still ongoing.
Het gesprek tussen het kabinet en de Europese Commissie is nog steeds gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de btw op verkoop van grond

An SGP MP asked whether VAT is avoided when municipal development costs for streets and green space are charged directly to buyers, and whether a general arrangement between the tax authority, municipalities and developers exists or can be initiated. The State Secretary of Finance answered that the Wro obliges municipalities to recover these costs, that costs charged as exploitation contributions are VAT-free, that no general arrangement exists, and that he would facilitate clarity if VNG or the developers' association asks.

If the VNG and/or the Association of Dutch Project Development Companies raises this with me because they wish to obtain clarity on these situations, I am of course willing to promote that this clarity is provided.

Indien de VNG en/of de Vereniging van Nederlandse Projektontwikkeling Maatschappijen dit bij mij aankaart omdat men over deze situaties duidelijkheid wenst te verkrijgen, ben ik uiteraard graag bereid te bevorderen dat deze duidelijkheid wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het uitwisselen van de pensioengegevens van Nederlanders die in de Tweede Wereldoorlog in Duitse eenheden gediend hebben en daarvoor pensioenen ontvingen

Rep. Omtzigt asks why Dutch tax authorities did not receive data on German military pensions paid to Dutch volunteers in WWII, whether such pensions fall under the treaty exemption, and what has been agreed with Germany. The Secretary of State confirms German pensions are taxable in Germany, that Germany cannot provide a full overview, that Kriegsbeschadigtenrenten are exempt in Germany and only available via individual requests, and commits to re-assess the taxing of recent discoveries.
Germany is therefore not able to indicate in general which pensions are paid to which persons.
Duitsland is dus niet in staat om in het algemeen aan te geven welke pensioenen aan welke personen worden betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de buitenlandse financiering van islamitische instellingen

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked ministers about foreign funding of Islamic institutions, the AIVD's remit, and ANBI transparency obligations for mosques and churches. The government answered that the RAND study revealed nothing new, that it will apply ANBI publication rules from 2016 and revoke status where obligations are unmet, and that intelligence services investigate foreign influence only where serious suspicions arise.
No public statements can be made about how the AIVD concretely organises its investigations.
Over de wijze waarop de AIVD concreet onderzoeken inricht, kunnen in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Helvert over het boetebeleid dat gemeenten hanteren middels de buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaren en over het overnemen van een parkeerkaartje

MPs Oskam and Van Helvert asked about inconsistent municipal fining policy by enforcement officers (boa's), whether boa's should take on more police fining powers, and the legality of transferring a parking ticket. The government replied that local enforcement differences are a municipal matter, it opposes extending boa fining powers into police territory, and it will not change the fiscal parking rules, while noting that no administrative fine but a tax assessment is imposed for ticket transfer.
Given local circumstances and differences in the nature and extent of nuisance, there is no need for national uniformity in government action against local nuisance.
Gelet op de lokale omstandigheden en verschillen in de aard en omvang van overlast is er geen noodzaak tot (landelijke) eenheid in overheidsoptreden bij de aanpak van lokale overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Albert de Vries over de gevolgen van de reorganisatie bij de Belastingdienst voor de provincies Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland en Limburg

MPs Fokke and Albert de Vries asked whether the Belastingdienst reorganisation would disproportionately hit Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland and Limburg, and how the parliamentary motion on regional fairness would be implemented. The state secretary replied that the effects are not yet clear and that the Minister for Housing and Civil Service will inform the House later, taking the motion into account.
The Minister for Housing and Civil Service will inform you at a later stage about the regional employment effects within central government
De Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst zal u in een later stadium informeren over de regionale werkgelegenheidseffecten bij de rijksoverheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat medisch specialisten volgens de Belastingdienst nog steeds zelfstandig ondernemers zijn

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether the Tax Authority's view that medical specialists remain self-employed contradicts government policy on integrated care funding and whether the costs of cooperative models were unnecessary. The minister answered that the government's position is unchanged, that self-employment depends on facts and circumstances, and that the transition subsidy aims to make employment a real option.
The cabinet has not changed its position on the self-employment of medical specialists.
Het kabinet heeft zijn standpunt ten aanzien van het ondernemerschap van medisch specialisten niet gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over het dreigende gat in de begroting door de snel stijgende verkoop van o.a. de Volvo XC90

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked the State Secretary of Finance about the fiscal risk from rising sales of plug-in hybrids such as the Volvo XC90 T8, the low company-car tax base, the Algemene Rekenkamer's recommendations on tax incentives for efficient cars, and whether the bijtelling increase should be accelerated. The State Secretary answered most questions with figures on lost tax revenue and referred the test-method and actual-consumption questions to other sources, but declined to accelerate the measure, citing lack of support and practical objections, and deferred the rest to the Autobrief 2.0.
In autumn 2014 I informed the House of the need to include additional measures for 2016 in the car taxes.
Ik heb in het najaar van 2014 de Kamer geïnformeerd over de noodzaak om aanvullende maatregelen voor het jaar 2016 voor de autobelastingen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de uitzending ‘Belastingparadijs Nederland’ van Rambam

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Rambam broadcast on Dutch tax rulings and tax avoidance, including shell companies, substance requirements, NFIA promotion and whether ruling requests involve negotiation. The State Secretary defended the ruling practice within legal limits, said substance requirements were tightened in 2013 with spot checks and information exchange, and denied that tax rates are negotiated.
There is no negotiation with the Tax Authority, not even when advance certainty is requested.
Er wordt niet onderhandeld met de Belastingdienst, ook niet wanneer wordt verzocht om zekerheid vooraf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de fiscale vrijstelling voor SNL-subsidies

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretaries whether the tax exemption for SNL nature and landscape management subsidies, which applied until 2013, has been approved by the European Commission for 2014 onward, and what the consequences are for tax returns and the timeline. The government answered that the exemption falls under a state aid notification covering provincial schemes, that the Commission began questioning the notification on 13 May 2015, and that approval is not expected before the last quarter of 2015, while taxpayers may rely on national law but face recovery with interest if approval is refused.
Where possible, the Dutch authorities involved are making efforts to obtain a prompt response from the Commission.
Waar mogelijk spannen de betrokken Nederlandse autoriteiten zich in om spoedig een reactie te krijgen van de Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het niet meer mogen afschrijven van productie- en ammoniakrechten

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Economic Affairs about the Tax Authority's decision to stop depreciation of production and ammonia rights, and whether this was agreed with the agricultural sector. The government answered that depreciation of production rights is allowed because their temporariness is demonstrable, that ammonia rights may be written off in 2014 and 2015 given the PAS, and that the Landelijke Landbouwnormen 2014 will be corrected.
The Landelijke Landbouwnormen 2014 will be adjusted on the point of production rights and ammonia rights.
De Landelijke Landbouwnormen 2014 zullen op het punt van de productierechten en ammoniakrechten aangepast worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het niet meer mogen afschrijven van productie- en ammoniakrechten

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Economic Affairs whether they knew of reports that the tax authority would correct depreciation of production and ammonia rights, and whether they would refrain from corrections and fines until consultation with accountants and the agricultural sector was completed. The State Secretary answered that he had decided to allow the depreciation and referred to earlier answers.
I have decided to allow the depreciation.
Ik heb besloten de afschrijving toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Groot over Roemeense voetbalfraude

Two MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports that Dutch letterbox firms facilitated Romanian football transfer fraud, and whether Dutch tax rules and treaties can prevent such structures. The minister said transfer fraud should be tackled, pointed to existing matchfixing platforms and a Niet-Melders project, said tax authorities already share information on football, and argued a source-tax on payments abroad would be disproportionately harmful.
I agree that (transfer) fraud in sport should be tackled.
Ik deel de mening dat (transfer)fraude in de sport aangepakt dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt over het artikel “Werkgevers klagen over ‘straf’ op sociaal plan

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked whether the RVU levy on voluntary early-retirement severance payments discourages employers from using voluntary schemes and pushes toward forced dismissals, and whether the rules should be relaxed. The state secretary answered that the levy applies only outside objective criteria, that a 10% efficiency margin applies to voluntary schemes, and that the government will not relax the levy because it has raised average retirement age, though it denied that the Tax Authority tightened its advance-ruling practice.
Within the package of labour market measures, the cabinet does not consider it desirable to relax the RVU levy.
Het kabinet vindt het binnen het pallet van arbeidsmarktmaatregelen niet wenselijk de RVU-heffing te versoepelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over vrijwillig vertrek versus gedwongen ontslag

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Finance whether the Tax Authority tightened the rules on voluntary redundancy schemes since 2013, removing advance certainty and raising the 52% RVU levy, and whether this pushes employers toward forced dismissals. The government denies any tightening, says the 2005 rules are enforced and that a 2013 policy decision allows ex-post testing with a 10% margin, and sees no trend toward forced dismissals.
No, that is not correct. The Tax Authority enforces the legislation as it was established in 2005.
Nee, dat klopt niet. De Belastingdienst handhaaft de wetgeving zoals deze in 2005 tot stand is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over ontduiken van btw-regels door internetbedrijven die zich op de Nederlandse markt richten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about foreign internet companies serving Dutch consumers via Dutch-language sites and iDEAL payments without paying Dutch VAT, and whether payment providers and Google Adwords should be obliged to check VAT numbers, and whether the FIOD should investigate. The State Secretary answered that the 21% VAT rate applies regardless of payment method, that VAT is owed by all providers equally, that an EU-level framework rather than a national measure is appropriate, that he is unaware of large-scale fraud or Google facilitating it, and that investigations start with the Belastingdienst and the FIOD only if warranted.
I am not aware that there is "massive tax evasion by foreign entrepreneurs" nor that Google Adwords would be cooperating with it.
Het is mij niet bekend dat sprake is van «enorme belastingontduiking door buitenlandse ondernemers» en evenmin dat Google Adwords daaraan zou meewerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Siderius over de financiële en sociale gevolgen van de wet hervorming kindregelingen voor de kinderalimentatie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice, Social Affairs and Finance about the financial and social effects of the Wet hervorming kindregelingen on child maintenance, including whether recipients lose out and whether the scheme leads to conflicts and a flood of maintenance cases. The minister answers that most recipients gain, that effects depend on individual cases, that the Raad voor de rechtspraak expects some extra change requests, and that no compensation is planned.
The exact consequences for child maintenance depend heavily on the facts and circumstances of a specific case.
De exacte gevolgen voor kinderalimentatie zijn sterk afhankelijk van de feiten en omstandigheden in een specifiek geval.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bashir over ‘de dubbele petten bij Bijzonder Beheer Rabobank’

An SP MP asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about alleged 'double hats' at Rabobank's Bijzonder Beheer unit, its subsidiary Bodemgoed buying assets of failing clients, the transparency of auctions, and use of the BMKB guarantee scheme. The government defended the practice as in the client's interest, rejected concerns about deliberate harm to clients, and provided purchase and portfolio figures while stating it saw no reason to intervene.
Due to confidentiality of company data, payments to individual banks are not disclosed.
Vanwege vertrouwelijkheid van bedrijfsgegevens worden uitkeringen aan individuele banken niet geopenbaard
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Rebel en Van der Staaij over de rokende gokker

MPs asked why Holland Casino expanded and made attractive smoking rooms with gambling machines, whether this is lawful and consistent with anti-smoking policy, and whether the government will change it. The government answered that such rooms are lawful under the Tabakswet provided the NVWA's criteria are met, that the offer should not be more attractive than outside the room, and agreed to talk with Holland Casino about a prevention pledge.
Smoking rooms, however, are exempt from the smoking ban, and the way Holland Casino has set up its smoking rooms does not conflict with the rules on this.
Rookruimten zijn echter uitgezonderd van het rookverbod en de manier waarop Holland Casino haar rookruimten heeft ingericht is niet strijdig met de regels daaromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de toepassing van resolutie BTW-283

Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether VAT entrepreneurship is a requirement under resolution BTW-283, whether the MFS II funding change justifies narrowing its scope, and whether it should be extended to MFS 1 and 2 subsidies for development organisations. Wiebes answered that entrepreneurship is a condition assessed under the Wet op de omzetbelasting, that the resolution will be clarified but not restricted, and that extending it to all MFS II recipients is not possible on VAT grounds.
The resolution will shortly be updated and clarified but not restricted.
De resolutie wordt binnenkort geactualiseerd en verduidelijkt maar niet beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht over een Huissens gezin dat het huis moest verkopen door fouten van de Belastingdienst

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that a family in Huissen had to sell their home due to Tax Authority errors, whether the Tax Authority admitted its mistake, and why compensation is not offered proactively. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case citing tax confidentiality, said compensation depends on circumstances and is handled via a published claims scheme with decisions within eight weeks, and rejected proactive offers.
The tax confidentiality obligation prevents me from addressing this individual case.
De fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht belet mij om in te gaan op dit individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het massaal ontduiken van belastingen door UberPOP-chauffeurs

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Finance, in twelve questions, about tax evasion by UberPOP drivers, including whether they meet their tax obligations, how many have registered as entrepreneurs, and whether Uber can be compelled to supply data. The State Secretary declined most substance citing the tax secrecy rule (art. 67 AWR), said the tax authority cannot currently verify compliance, and pointed to enforcement strategy, cooperation with the ILT and data-sharing rules.
It is not possible for me to establish this at this moment.
Het is voor mij niet mogelijk om dit op dit moment vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt over kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked whether a working father whose wife is in a nursing home in a coma can receive childcare allowance for his three children, and whether divorce or municipal social-medical support could solve this. The minister confirmed no entitlement under current rules, pointed to municipal social-medical indication (SMI) support and contact already made with the municipality, and rejected amending the childcare act.
I understand that first contact between Mr K. and his municipality to find a solution has now been made.
Ik heb begrepen dat het eerste contact tussen de heer K. en zijn woongemeente om tot een oplossing te komen inmiddels is gelegd.
