Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het personeelsbestand van de Belastingdienst

MP Bashir asked the State Secretary of Finance about the size and grading of the Tax Authority's management team and workforce over the past ten years. The State Secretary answered in detail with headcount tables, noting that top-management bands agreed with BZK have stayed constant and that management numbers have barely changed while operational staff grew by about 666 FTE.
No separate administration is kept that specifies per tax instrument how many people work on assessment respectively special collection.
Er wordt geen aparte administratie bijgehouden die per belastingmiddel specificeert hoeveel mensen werken voor heffing respectievelijk bijzondere inning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de naleving van de beslagvrije voet door schuldeisers

MP Schouten (ChristenUnie) asked whether creditors are routinely breaching the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) and what the government will do, including faster government connection to the attachment register and Tax Authority repayment with retroactive effect. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem is substantial, announced simplification of the calculation rules, a phased connection of bailiffs to the register with government connection still requiring preparation, and said the Tax Authority generally does not repay retroactively unless the debtor is not at fault.
I do not have data showing how many people must live on an income below the applicable protected minimum.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens waaruit blijkt hoeveel mensen moeten rondkomen van een inkomen onder de voor hen van toepassing zijnde beslagvrije voet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Karabulut over de ANBI-status van Stichting Rohamaa

MPs Bashir and Karabulut asked why the ANBI status of Stichting Rohamaa was granted, whether it complies with transparency rules and international law, and whether it should be revoked and the ANBI list cleaned up. The government answered that the status was granted in 2011 under neutral criteria, declined to discuss the specific case citing legal confidentiality, said status can be revoked if an entity no longer serves the general interest, and stated the Tax Administration conducts risk-based supervision of about 65,000 ANBIs.
I cannot make any statements about the specific aspects of granting the ANBI status to Stichting Rohomaa on the basis of the statutory duty of confidentiality.
Over de specifieke aspecten van het verlenen van de ANBI-status aan Stichting Rohomaa kan ik geen mededelingen doen op grond van de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat door een solidariteitsheffing de belastingen voor middeninkomens worden verhoogd

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether it is unjust that middle-income earners pay a solidarity levy to fund water board tax exemptions for people on low incomes, and whether water boards should be abolished. The government answered that water board costs, including exemptions, are shared by all taxpayers, that exemption policy is a Rijk responsibility, and that efficiency targets are on track, but it did not answer the question on abolishing the water boards.
So it is not the case that the exemption costs are borne by one particular category or by a particular group of persons within a category.
Het is dus niet zo dat de kwijtscheldingskosten door één bepaalde categorie of door een bepaalde groep personen binnen een categorie worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het artikel ‘HSBC hielp klanten bij belastingontduiking’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that HSBC helped clients evade tax, including how Dutch authorities obtained the data, how many Dutch tax evaders were found, whether foreign banks can be prosecuted, and how black savings via Switzerland and Dutch BVs are being curbed. The State Secretary answered that 130 Dutch holders were investigated, 48 were found non-compliant with about 2.3 million euro recovered, Switzerland cooperation and a new automatic exchange regime are being pursued, and no action was taken against HSBC itself.
Cooperation by a bank in tax evasion and avoidance is in my view undesirable.
Het meewerken van een bank aan belastingontduiking en -ontwijking is naar mijn mening onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat het “Aangifteseizoen start met een overbelaste site fiscus”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority's website, overloaded on the first day of the 2014 income tax filing season, has been overloaded before, how many people can log in simultaneously, and how it will prevent overload and track failed logins. The State Secretary answered that overload had occurred only for a few hours on two days, that a cap of about 45,000 concurrent users is deliberately enforced, that capacity is being increased gradually, and that the filing deadline was extended to 1 May.
It is neither realistic nor efficient to enable all people to file their returns at all times simultaneously.
Het is niet realistisch en doelmatig om alle mensen in staat te stellen te allen tijde tegelijkertijd hun aangifte te kunnen laten doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groot over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over het terugvorderen van uitgekeerde toeslagen vanwege het samenwonen met een vreemdeling zonder rechtmatig verblijf

Two MPs asked the State Secretaries whether a Council of State ruling means people in special circumstances no longer automatically lose benefits when a partner without lawful residence lives with them, and what the ruling's scope and practical consequences are. The government answered that the ruling is limited to the specific facts of that individual case, that it changes no policy or practice at the Tax Authority, and that it is consistent with earlier rulings.
The scope of this ruling is limited to this individual case, because it is based on the specific facts and circumstances of the case, from which no general conclusion can be drawn.

De reikwijdte van deze uitspraak is beperkt tot dit individuele geval omdat die gebaseerd is op de specifieke feiten en omstandigheden van het geval waaraan geen algemene conclusie kan worden verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over hulp bij de aangifte inkomstenbelasting

MP Bashir (SP) asked whether abolishing electronic signatures on tax returns harms organisations helping vulnerable people, such as Stichting Door en Voor, that file returns for clients unable to do so themselves, and what solution is envisaged. Staatssecretaris Wiebes refers to earlier answers, says a varied range of signing options exists, and states that no organisation has reported to the Tax Administration that no alternative works for it.
To date, no organisations have made themselves known to the Tax Administration for which no alternative has proved workable.
Er hebben zich tot op heden geen organisaties bekend gemaakt bij de Belastingdienst waarvoor geen enkel alternatief werkbaar is gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de ingangsdatum van de subsidieregeling energiebelasting voor sportverenigingen

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked why the energy-tax refund for sports clubs is being abolished, whether clubs face higher costs in 2015 with no refund or subsidy available for that year, and how provinces and clubs are affected. The minister replied that the 2014 refund is still paid in 2015, the new energy-saving subsidy starts 1 January 2016 with no transitional compensation, and the change is designed to reward sustainability investment and is compatible with provincial schemes.
No compensation can be claimed for the calendar year 2015.
Over het kalenderjaar 2015 kan geen compensatie worden aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over automatische uitwisseling van tax rulings

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance about automatic exchange of tax rulings between EU member states, including whether the 2012 Code of Conduct Group document commits states to automatic exchange. The State Secretary answered that no automatic exchange of rulings has yet been agreed, only spontaneous exchange under the Administrative Cooperation Directive, and that the Commission's announced directive proposal is welcomed, while the Group's discussions remain confidential.
The Council of the European Union, when establishing the Code of Conduct Group, determined that the Group's discussions are confidential.
De Raad van de Europese Unie heeft bij de instelling van de Gedragscodegroep bepaald dat de besprekingen van de Groep vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het effect van de Europese BTW regels voor elektronische diensten op kleine ondernemers, die per 1 januari 2015 van kracht zijn geworden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the effect of the 2015 EU VAT rules for electronic services on small businesses, including reports of firms ceasing cross-border activity, and whether a threshold or exemption could be introduced. The State Secretary said the rules are EU law leaving no national room for deviation, that no direct signals of closures had reached the tax service, and that he will consult business organisations on making information more accessible but sees no national scope for a threshold.
However, as noted above, these are rules laid down in the VAT Directive and a number of implementing and Commission regulations.
Zoals hiervoor is opgemerkt gaat het echter om regels die zijn vastgelegd in de BTW-richtlijn en een aantal uitvoerings- en commissieverordeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Oosenbrug over het doen van belastingaangifte door mensen met psychi(atri)sche, maatschappelijke en verslavingsproblemen

MPs Groot and Oosenbrug asked whether abolishing the electronic signature (pincode) for tax returns has made it harder for vulnerable citizens and the intermediary organisations helping them, and whether the government will act. The State Secretary says alternatives exist (commercial software, DigiD with proxy, Belastingdienst help) and that intermediaries have been advised, but commits to no new measures for this group.
For the group referred to in the question, in my judgement there are sufficient options to obtain (free) help with filing the tax return.
Voor de in de vraag bedoelde groep zijn er naar mijn oordeel voldoende mogelijkheden om (gratis) hulp te krijgen bij het doen van de belastingaangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de toepassing van resolutie BTW-283

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the application of resolution BTW-283, which gives zero-rated VAT treatment to Dutch development NGOs carrying out services for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and whether MFS-funded projects qualify. The State Secretary explained the conditions for the zero rate and that MFS subsidies must be assessed case by case, and said the EU VAT Directive does not allow refunds to non-entrepreneurs, but made no commitment to change the rules.
Whether that is the case depends in part on the circumstances (such as the conditions) under which the subsidy is provided.
Of dat zo is, is mede afhankelijk van de omstandigheden (zoals de voorwaarden) waaronder de subsidie wordt verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de premiepercentages bij een pensioenrichtleeftijd lager dan 67 jaar

An MP asks whether pension schemes with an entry date on the first of the month the member turns 67 must be recalculated under the Witteveen framework and at what cost. The state secretaries confirm recalculation is required where the full fiscal room is used, but grant a temporary two-year exemption from actuarial recalculation for these schemes to ease administrative burden.
It is not known how many pension schemes this issue affects.
Het is niet bekend bij hoeveel pensioenregelingen deze problematiek speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de nieuwe regels voor btw op elektronische diensten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the new EU VAT rules for electronic services from 2015, including the terminology used, administrative burdens, MOSS registration, VIES reliability, and fraud risks. The State Secretary answered that the rules are EU-mandated with little national policy room, that information was provided via the Belastingdienst website, and that he will explore with business organisations whether the information can be made more accessible.
However, I see the importance for Dutch business in this and therefore I will have examined whether we can make the information provided on this subject more accessible.
Ik zie echter het belang van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven in deze en laat daarom onderzoeken of we de geboden informatie over deze materie nog toegankelijker kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over pensioenopbouw door IB-ondernemers bij een beroepspensioenregeling

Two MPs asked why self-employed income-tax payers in mandatory occupational pension schemes are assessed on profit from three years earlier, and what relief exists for someone who became partly disabled, so that their pension premium more than doubled. The government answered that a reference year (t-3) gives time to fix the maximum pensionable income, that special rules apply for illness, disability and starters, that it is always allowed to use a lower amount, and that pension funds and social partners decide on premium-free continuation and discretion.
It is always fiscally permitted to assume a lower amount than the maximum that may be taken into account as pensionable income.
Het is fiscaal altijd toegestaan om van een lager bedrag uit te gaan dan het bedrag dat ten hoogste als pensioengevend loon in aanmerking mag worden genomen.

Antwoord schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kerstens en Groot (Beiden PvdA) en het lid Pieter Heerma (CDA) over het convenant dat de uitzendsector heeft gesloten met de Belastingdienst waardoor oneerlijke concurrentie en

Three MPs (Kerstens, Groot of PvdA and Pieter Heerma of CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a covenant between the Tax Authority and the staffing sector that allegedly enables unfair competition and displacement through extraterritorial cost allocation, and asked about oversight, the estimated EUR 250 million revenue loss and whether the covenant should be terminated. The answer was not given in this text: it only states that the questions were answered by letter on a related request from another MP, so the substance of the answers is not present.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de invoering van het minimumloon en de eerstedagmelding in Duitsland en de gigantische administratieve lasten die dat oplevert voor Nederlandse werkgevers

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about Germany's minimum wage law and its first-day notification requirement, which he said burdens Dutch employers and workers with heavy administrative obligations, including German-language documents, high fines, and questions about EU law compliance. The State Secretary answered that the obligations exist, that the German customs authority is the competent body, that the Netherlands considers the administrative burden a restriction on free movement of services but leaves final judgement to the EU Court of Justice, and that no exemption or EU-level challenge is planned for now.
The answer to the question of whether there is an unjustified trade barrier is ultimately for the European Court of Justice.
Het antwoord op de vraag of sprake is van een ongerechtvaardigde handelsbelemmering is uiteindelijk aan het Europese Hof van Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over Uber

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries about Uber's UberPOP service continuing despite fines and a court ruling, its Dutch expansion, tax and criminal liability of drivers, and how the government will enforce the rules. The government replies that the ILT will keep enforcing the law and the court-ordered penalty, that the Belastingdienst applies VAT rules case by case, and that information for drivers will be expanded.
This means that Uber forfeits a penalty payment for each new violation the ILT establishes, up to a maximum of €100,000.
Dat betekent dat Uber bij elke nieuwe door de ILT geconstateerde overtreding een dwangsom verbeurt, tot een maximum van € 100.000,-.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Geurts, Van Meenen en Schouten over de uitspraak van het Hof Arnhem-Leeuwarden, die de Belastingdienst in het ongelijk stelde en bepaalde dat deelkwalificaties wel in aanmerking k

MPs Omtzigt, Geurts, Van Meenen and Schouten asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education about a Court of Appeal ruling that part-qualifications qualify for the education wage-tax reduction, including whether the Tax Service's corrections will be suspended, how firms are compensated, and whether bankruptcies or dropouts resulted. The government answered that it will file a cassation appeal before 29 January 2015, that corrections can be held pending the Supreme Court ruling on objection request, that refunds follow any Supreme Court outcome, and that it has no data on affected firms, students or bankruptcies.
I intend to file a cassation appeal against this ruling.
Ik ben voornemens om tegen deze uitspraak in cassatie te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de voorlopige aanslag 2015

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why provisional tax assessments for 2015 were issued differently from previous years, why taxpayers were surprised, whether they were also facing a 2014 assessment, and whether they would be informed about instalment payments without extra costs. The answer refers to a separate letter sent the same day that answers these questions, with footnotes linking to each question.
I have answered the questions of Member Bashir in my letter of today on the same subject
De vragen van het lid Bashir heb ik beantwoord in mijn brief van vandaag over hetzelfde onderwerp
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Karabulut en Yücel over de invordering van belasting- en toeslagschulden door de Belastingdienst

MPs Schouten, Karabulut and Yücel asked whether the Tax Authority's recovery of tax and benefit debts ignores personal circumstances and the subsistence allowance (beslagvrije voet), pushing people deeper into debt, and how the motion on respecting the subsistence allowance will be implemented. The State Secretary acknowledged the Tax Authority cannot always account for personal circumstances, pointed to payment arrangements and the duty of debtors to act, exempted single parents from set-off against the child budget, and promised to discuss the report's recommendations with the LOSR and inform parliament.
The Tax Authority makes every effort to respect the subsistence allowance in line with the Schouten et al. motion.
De Belastingdienst spant zich maximaal in om conform de motie Schouten c.s. de beslagvrije voet te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over inzage rulingpraktijken

Klaver (GroenLinks) asked whether the government had requested all Luxembourg tax rulings concerning Dutch companies and wealthy individuals, and why Germany was given access to the Dutch ruling practice. Wiebes answered that Dutch tax interest in Luxembourg rulings is still being examined and that rulings will be requested if warranted, while defending bilateral exchange of rulings and the fiscal secrecy duty against calls for public disclosure.
At present it is being examined whether, and if so in which cases, there is Dutch tax interest in relation to Luxembourg rulings.
Op dit moment wordt uitgezocht of, en zo ja in welke gevallen, er Nederlands heffingsbelang is in relatie tot Luxemburgse rulings.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over getuigenissen van belastingambtenaren in rechtbanken

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority's handling of testimony by tax officials in court, including the Brutra bankruptcy case, the non-appeal against disclosure of a tipster's name, and witness preparation. The State Secretary answers that tax officials may invoke confidentiality in court, that no specific guidance exists on preparing witnesses, and that the Tax Authority applies risk-based control regardless of lawsuits.
There are almost continuous legal proceedings between the Tax Authority and taxpayers, and it is customary that I do not inform the House case by case.
Er lopen vrijwel continu gerechtelijke procedures tussen de Belastingdienst en belastingplichtigen waarbij het de gewoonte is dat ik de Kamer niet per geval informeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever, Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat een zwaar gesubsidieerde elektrische auto bijna net zoveel fijnstof produceert als een benzinewagen

Three PVV MPs asked whether the government will stop subsidising electric cars after a report claimed they emit almost as much fine particulate matter as petrol cars, and whether VAT and registration tax should be cut instead. Minister Kamp answered that total particulate emissions including brake and tyre wear are about a third lower for electric cars, that subsidies will be reconsidered in the Autobrief 2.0, and that the 160,000 euro-per-car figure is not recognised.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de pensioenmaximering op € 100.000 en de verlaging van de opbouw, die bij heel veel werkgevers niet tijdig wordt doorgevoerd en de fiscale gevolgen die dat kan hebben

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Social Affairs about the EUR 100,000 pension accrual cap, the risk that employers fail to adapt schemes in time, and the tax and legal consequences including dual or part-time employment cases. The State Secretary answered each question, explaining the glijclausule option, the per-employment application of the cap, the limited legal risk for employers, and that no treaty changes are needed.
As far as can be seen, the risk of a claim is therefore very small.
Naar het zich laat aanzien is het risico op een claim daarom zeer gering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over de berichtgeving “Nederland verzette zich tegen OESO-aanpak belastingontwijking”

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the Dutch innovation box, which can benefit firms whose R&D is done abroad, undermines its purpose and whether the Netherlands opposed the OECD's tighter approach to patent boxes. The State Secretary answered that the box requires sufficient substance in the Netherlands, that the Netherlands backed a transfer-pricing approach instead of the nexus approach, and that the box will not be amended via the Fiscale verzamelwet 2015.
The cabinet does not have the picture that the Dutch innovation box enables abuse of internal transfer prices by international concerns.
Het kabinet heeft niet het beeld dat de Nederlandse innovatiebox misbruik van de interne verrekenprijzen van internationale concerns mogelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over “de afkoop van kleine pensioenen"

An MP asked whether the government had agreed with pension bodies to postpone payment of small pension buy-outs and whether the fiscal timing and the continued-work requirement could be relaxed. The government said the discussed solution proved unworkable under tax rules, but an adopted amendment now allows postponing the buy-out to the first day of the month after reaching the AOW age without the continued-work requirement.
This was also reported in the letter of 2 July about the buy-out of a small pension.
Dit is ook gemeld in de brief van 2 juli jl. over de afkoop van een klein pensioen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over “de pensioenuitkering en afkoop klein pensioen op verjaardag”

MP Vermeij asked whether the tax authority requires pensions to start only on the pensioner's birthday from 1 January 2015, and how this squares with the government's July 2014 letter on buying out small pensions. The state secretary replied that tax rules have not changed on pension start dates, that the timing of payouts is for pension providers, and that an amendment Vermeij co-sponsored now lets small-pension buyouts be deferred to the first day of the month after the AOW age.
This is not new as of 1 January 2015; the changes to the Witteveen scheme on that date change nothing about the pension start date or the pension target age.
Dit is niet nieuw per 1 januari 2015; de wijzigingen van het Witteveenkader per die datum veranderen niets aan de pensioeningangsdatum of de pensioenrichtleeftijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over belastingontwijking door multinationals

An SP MP asked the state secretary of Finance about multinational tax avoidance via Luxembourg, Dutch advance rulings and transfer pricing, public country-by-country reporting, and whether the Netherlands is a conduit country. The state secretary answered that Luxembourg's tax application cannot be judged, that advance rulings are only given within Dutch law, that Dutch support for public CbC reporting is limited to an impact study by 2018, and that tax avoidance requires international cooperation.
I cannot give a judgement on how Luxembourg's tax law or the tax treaties it has concluded should be applied in these cases.
Een oordeel over de wijze waarop het Luxemburgse belastingrecht of de door Luxemburg gesloten belastingverdragen op deze gevallen toegepast moet worden kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt over conflicten over kinderalimentatie als gevolg van de Wet hervorming kindregelingen

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked whether the abolition of the child-maintenance tax deduction (LOK) from 2015 would cause disputes over alimony and what parents should do. The minister says the reform may affect existing alimony, points parents to advice channels and to courts, and notes the Raad voor de Rechtspraak will advise on a calculation rule early next year.
The request in the motion to develop a standard calculation rule for changing child maintenance amounts due to the child benefits reform has been placed with the Council for the Judiciary.

Het verzoek in de motie om te komen tot een standaardrekenregel voor wijziging van het kinderalimentatiebedrag als gevolg van de Wet hervorming kindregelingen is neergelegd bij de Raad voor de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Eind van blauwe envelop is nabij’

Rep. Krol asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority will phase out paper correspondence, including for income tax, benefits and motor vehicle tax, and how elderly citizens without digital access would be protected. The State Secretary answered that digital correspondence is the goal, to be introduced gradually after legal changes, with proxy arrangements and a safety net for citizens unable to use digital channels.
It will also remain possible in individual cases, where truly necessary, to provide a paper copy of an electronic message.
Het zal ook mogelijk blijven om in individuele gevallen, waarin dat echt nodig is, een papieren kopie van een elektronisch bericht te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over uitwisseling van persoonsgegevens tussen Belastingdienst, AIVD, politie en justitie

An MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers how personal data exchange between the Tax Administration, AIVD, police and prosecution works under the convenant and article 43c of the tax implementing regulation, including transparency, oversight by the CBP, and ANPR data. The ministers answered that exchanges rest on statutory bases, are limited to necessary purposes and published in working agreements, while acknowledging that the number of prosecution requests is not aggregated.
A request is always made under the Code of Criminal Procedure and must at all times meet the requirements set out in it.
Vordering vindt altijd plaats op grond van het Wetboek van Strafvordering, en moet te allen tijde voldoen aan de daarin opgenomen vereisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over storingen bij de Belastingdienst

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about repeated outages on the Belastingdienst website and whether they were resolved, how the BelastingTelefoon was affected, whether late filings and payments would be penalised, and whether a paper VAT return could be offered during outages. The State Secretary answered that outages stemmed from a platform migration, that late filing and payment during outages would not be penalised under existing coulance rules, and that a paper VAT return would not be reintroduced because of workload and administrative burden.
This standard coulance provided sufficient accommodation for this outage.
Deze standaardcoulance bood voor deze storing voldoende tegemoetkoming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Zzp’ers komen langs zijlijn te staan’

Mr Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the new rules would push self-employed teachers into employment relationships and whether the enforcement practice in education should change before parliament is informed of the outcome of consultations with the education sector. The State Secretary denied that new rules create a stronger employment relationship, stated that enforcement in education has not changed, and said the outcome of the consultations is expected in Q4 2014, depending on testing a draft convenant.
The Tax Authority expects to have completed the consultations with the education sector in the fourth quarter of 2014.
De Belastingdienst verwacht in het vierde kwartaal 2014 de overleggen met de onderwijssector te hebben afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Oosenbrug over de uitwisseling van persoonsgegevens van miljoenen Nederlanders door de Belastingdienst, AIVD, politie en Justitie

MPs Schouw and Oosenbrug asked why the Tax Administration's data exchange with AIVD, police and prosecution was only disclosed after a convenant was concluded, and questioned the shared ANPR camera use and retention periods. The ministers answered that a legal basis in art. 67 AWR and the Uitvoeringsregeling applies, that the Tax Administration keeps only fiscally relevant plate data, and pointed to existing privacy supervision and legal remedies, without committing to new measures.
There was therefore no reason to send these convenants to your House.
Er bestond dus geen aanleiding deze convenanten aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over belastingvrij schenken in 2015

An MP asked the ministers whether the temporary increased gift-tax exemption for home purchase or renovation in 2014 could still be used via a 'Groninger akte' (deferred-payment deed) in 2015, and whether the rules required a house to be owned at the time of the gift. The government answered that the exemption requires the recipient to already own the home in 2014, that spending may extend to 2016 for renovations, and that a Groninger akte does not change the regular conditions.
The temporarily increased exemption for maintenance or improvement can only be used if the recipient of the gift already owns the home in 2014.
Er kan alleen gebruik worden gemaakt van de tijdelijk verruimde vrijstelling voor onderhoud of verbetering indien de begunstigde van de schenking de eigen woning al in 2014 heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst geen btw-voordeel geeft aan bewoners die gezamenlijk zonne-energie willen betrekken

Smaling (SP) asked why cooperative neighbourhood solar projects under the postcoderoos scheme receive no VAT benefit, and whether a VAT advantage will be introduced. Staatssecretaris Wiebes replied that EU-based VAT rules offer no special regime, that such cooperatives are treated as entrepreneurs with input-VAT deduction, and that officials have discussed the matter with sector groups.
The tax authority grants no VAT benefit to projects falling under the so-called postcoderoos scheme.
De belastingdienst kent geen BTW-voordeel toe aan projecten die binnen de zogenaamde «postcoderoos-regeling» vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de lucratieve bijstand

MP Van Klaveren asks whether it is absurd that a single mother on welfare can receive over 2,000 euros net per month, whether this should be changed, and whether the marginal tax burden should be tackled via a flat tax and dismantling the benefits system. Staatssecretaris Wiebes acknowledges the poverty trap for single parents, says the child-benefit reform will resolve it from 2015, and states the government aims to promote employment and balanced incomes, but does not commit to a flat tax or dismantling the allowances system.
Through the revision of the child benefit arrangements, the poverty trap will be resolved from 2015.
Door de herziening van de kindregelingen wordt de armoedeval per 2015 opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de naheffing voor miljoenen belastingbetalers

MP Van Klaveren asks the State Secretary of Finance about an unexpected tax surcharge for millions of taxpayers in 2014, why it was not addressed earlier, and whether a flat tax would simplify matters. The State Secretary answers that the phase-out of income-dependent tax credits could not be processed in time, that taxpayers are informed via existing contact moments and the Tax Office website, and that a flat tax is not principled government policy but remains open for discussion.
From the moment this measure was decided upon, it was known that this measure could no longer be processed in time.
Vanaf het moment dat tot deze maatregel werd besloten was bekend dat deze maatregel niet meer tijdig verwerkt kon worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat vijf miljoen Nederlanders een naheffing van €150 tegemoet kunnen zien door fout fiscus

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether a late-applied change to income-dependent tax credits leaves about five million taxpayers facing an average extra €150 at assessment, and how this was allowed to happen. The State Secretary confirms the cause (the change could not be built into the 2014 wage-tax tables and provisional assessment in time), says the situation is regrettable, rejects the word 'error', and denies any link to a separate EU levy.
I therefore wish to distance myself from the qualification 'error'.
Van de kwalificatie «fout» wil ik dan ook afstand nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de bezwaarschriften tegen het fictieve rendement van de vermogensrendementsheffing

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about the thousands of objections against the fictitious return on the wealth yield tax and why no settlement agreement is offered like in the classic-car case. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Administration handles the objections individually where no grievance applies, that the cost savings from collective handling are acknowledged, and that options to tax actual returns, including a capital gains tax, are still under study.
Without further investigation, the budgetary impact of honouring the objections cannot be stated.
Zonder nader onderzoek is het budgettaire beslag bij honorering van de bezwaarschriften niet aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over misbruik van de innovatiebox

Omtzigt (CDA) asked whether the innovation box allows Dutch firms to move innovation abroad and still pay only about 5% tax, and whether this loophole would be closed. Staatssecretaris Wiebes replied that in practice no such constructions are known, that the box is not a loophole, but he will propose a clarifying amendment in the Fiscale verzamelwet 2015.

To remove the unclarity and possible undesirable consequences of applying the innovation box in the situation described, I will make a proposal to adjust the innovation box in the Fiscale verzamelwet 2015 bill.

Om de onduidelijkheid en eventuele onwenselijke gevolgen van de toepassing van de innovatiebox in de beschreven situatie weg te nemen, zal ik in het wetsvoorstel Fiscale verzamelwet 2015 een voorstel tot aanpassing van de innovatiebox doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Wolbert over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden over een in de thuiszorg werkzame verpleegkundige

MPs Mei Li Vos and Wolbert asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling treating a home-care nurse as a self-employed entrepreneur for income tax, asking about enforcement consequences for VAR-wuo declarations in care, the impact on about 1,200 freelancers who received a VAR-loon, and the relation to the eight criteria for entrepreneurship. The State Secretary answered that the ruling is not a generic rule for care in kind, that VAR declarations depend on the facts presented, that the affected group was offered a pilot-based new VAR-wuo, and that the Tax Administration applies the same criteria set out in case law.
The Tax Administration does not give such a generic interpretation to this court ruling.
Een dergelijke generieke uitleg geeft de Belastingdienst niet aan deze uitspraak van het hof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de miljardenkosten van toeslagen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about rising allowance costs (toeslagen), whether the childcare and healthcare allowance growth shows the system is unsustainable, and whether abolishing the allowances and introducing a low flat tax would reduce dependence and boost growth. The State Secretary answers that the healthcare allowance is being reduced by half a million recipients in 2015, that the wider reform will be discussed with parliamentary groups before any proposals, and that the government aims to lower labour and business taxes.
I do not want to anticipate the outcomes of the various discussions I wish to have with the parliamentary groups on the reform of the system and the research to be carried out in that context.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de diverse gesprekken die ik wil voeren met de fracties over de stelselherziening en de in dat kader te verrichten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over het bericht dat WVA wordt teruggevorderd bij transportbedrijven

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked why the Belastingdienst is reclaiming the education wage-tax discount (AV Onderwijs) from transport firms, and how education quality and eligibility are checked. The minister answered that about 36 firms face recovery for €3.5 million, that the Belastingdienst verifies WVA conditions while the Inspectie judges education quality, and that recovery cannot be repaired retroactively.
At 36 companies the AV onderwijs has been reclaimed, for a total amount of about €3.5 million.
Bij 36 bedrijven heeft terugvordering van de AV onderwijs plaatsgevonden, voor een totaalbedrag van circa € 3,5 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Omtzigt over de naheffing bij 5 miljoen Nederlanders

An MP asks why the government did not disclose earlier the estimated 800 million euro reclaimed from 5 to 6 million taxpayers caused by the incomplete implementation of the tax credit phase-outs, and when ministers knew of the problem. The State Secretary gives indicative amounts, explains the systems constraints, and states the issue was communicated and known since 2013, while rejecting the term 'errors' and announcing communication steps.
From the moment this measure was decided, it was therefore clear that the phase-out in 2014 would lead to additional payments or lower refunds on the final assessment in 2015 for 2014.
Vanaf het moment dat tot deze maatregel werd besloten was dus duidelijk dat de afbouw in 2014 zou leiden tot bijbetalingen of lagere teruggaven bij de definitieve aanslag in 2015 over 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over spaarders die tegenwoordig sparen in een bv

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether savers moving savings into a holding company (spaargeld-bv) to avoid the box 3 wealth tax is fair, and about the tax, benefit and AWBZ consequences. The State Secretary said the cabinet will examine alternatives to the wealth yield tax, that a savings BV only becomes attractive for very large fortunes, and that the government will monitor the situation and act if needed.
In view of that sense of injustice, the cabinet will examine alternatives to the existing wealth yield tax, with the aim of making a further assessment.
Mede met het oog op dat gevoel van onrechtvaardigheid gaat het kabinet alternatieven onderzoeken voor de bestaande vermogensrendementsheffing, met het doel hierover een nadere afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over onvolledige beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de grote stapel aan fiscale voorstellen rond Prinsjesdag

The MP asked the State Secretary to answer earlier questions 5 and 6 on why more tax bills were not spread across the year, and whether part of the fiscal package could be sent to parliament in spring. The State Secretary answered that the government aims for spread but capacity is limited, outlining the spring 2015 Fiscale verzamelwet, a Fiscale vereenvoudigingswet and other bills.
The cabinet aims to spread the submission of fiscal bills over the year.
Het kabinet streeft naar spreiding van de indiening van fiscale wetsvoorstellen over het jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Omtzigt inzake naheffingen bij scholengemeenschappen

MPs Rog and Omtzigt asked about Tax Authority back-tax assessments on school communities for lunch-supervision volunteer allowances, including whether they reach back five years and whether they fit the participation policy. The state secretary defended the volunteer exemption rules, said the Tax Authority can correct up to five years and may impose fines, and declined to intervene or ask for reduced penalties.
I cannot make further statements about individual cases in the context of these questions.
Over individuele gevallen kan ik in het kader van deze vragen geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de werkwijze van de Belastingdienst na een WSNP-uitspraak

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority offsets debts incurred before a WSNP debt-rescheduling order against childcare and other allowance advances, and what the legal basis is. The State Secretary replied that Tax Authority policy excludes offsetting during debt rescheduling, that individual errors can occur, and that the legal basis is Article 301(3) of the Bankruptcy Act, which the Tax Authority applies by analogy to offsetting.
The Tax Authority's policy explicitly states that during statutory debt rescheduling no offsetting takes place between the debt claimed for verification and childcare allowance advances to be paid.

Antwoord 1, 3 en 4 In het beleid 2 van de Belastingdienst is expliciet vastgelegd dat er gedurende de wettelijke schuldsanering geen verrekening plaatsvindt van de ter verificatie aangemelde toeslagschuld met uit te betalen toeslagvoorschotten 3 .
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Nijboer, Yücel en Hamer over fraude met kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Nijboer, Yücel and Hamer asked the State Secretary of Finance about a childcare benefit fraud case, parents facing large repayments and eviction, and whether the Tax Authority recovers from fraudulent providers. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases citing confidentiality, explained that parents are liable for repayment and can appeal, outlined recovery practices, and said the motion on reducing repayments will be addressed in the next half-year report.
Because of the duty of confidentiality, I cannot discuss individual cases in public.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik niet in de openbaarheid op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de voorwaarden voor een ANBI-status

Mr Van Klaveren asks the State Secretary of Finance whether a foundation holding ANBI status, Stichting Democratie en Media, may legitimately favour left-leaning media subsidy applications while rejecting right-leaning ones. The State Secretary confirms the foundation's ANBI status, says an ANBI may serve a specific ideological segment, and states that the Belastingdienst's ANBI team assesses both statutes and practice, but declines to comment on supervision of an individual institution.
I cannot make any statements about the supervision of an individual institution.
Over het toezicht op een individuele instelling kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de tax gap en de weigering van de regering om een aangenomen motie niet uit te voeren

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance about the Dutch tax gap, the Belastingdienst's enforcement capacity, and why the government did not carry out an adopted motion to halve the tax gap. The State Secretary answers that the macro VAT gap study was published, business cases will not be disclosed for enforcement reasons, the motion was removed from the open-motions list and will be reinstated, and a tax gap study for direct taxes is not yet available.
For this reason it is the firm policy that business cases are not made public.
Om deze reden is vaste lijn dat businesscases niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst cijfers heeft gemanipuleerd over het aantal boekenonderzoeken

MP Bashir asked whether the Tax Authority manipulated figures on book audits, how many promised audits actually took place, and what the whistleblowers' claims mean for the minister's responsibility. The State Secretary replied that an Auditdienst Rijk review found no sign of systematic manipulation of registration, that 18 examined files did not meet the audit definition and were removed, and that individual manipulation cannot be excluded but would be disapproved.
The investigation gives no reason to assume that, as suggested in the broadcast, the registration of the investigations is manipulated.
Het onderzoek geeft geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat er, zoals in de uitzending werd gesuggereerd, gemanipuleerd wordt met de registratie van de onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de berichten van mogelijke fraude bij de Staatsloterij

An MP from D66 asked the state secretaries of Justice and Security and of Finance about reports of possible fraud at the Staatsloterij, including when indications arose, whether the draw should be suspended, and the government's responsibility as sole shareholder and over the Kansspelautoriteit. The state secretaries answered that the Kansspelautoriteit is conducting its own investigation into compliance with licence conditions, that the ministries were only informed afterwards, that the Kansspelautoriteit has not seen grounds for measures, and that it is for the regulator to conclude the investigation and set its timeline.
The Kansspelautoriteit does not make statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken doet de Kansspelautoriteit geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kerstens en Groot over mogelijkheden de Wet Normering Topinkomens te omzeilen

MPs Kerstens and Groot asked whether topfunctionarissen could exceed the WNT pay norm by shifting pay into tax-free work expenses, and whether such schemes should be made unlawful. The minister replied that no gap exists, citing the gebruikelijkheidscriterium and a practical €2,400 threshold, and promised to examine tightening the criterion and clarifying the WNT framework.
The State Secretary of Finance has committed to examining whether the customary-practice criterion needs further tightening in this context.
De Staatssecretaris van Financiën heeft toegezegd te onderzoeken of het gebruikelijkheidscriterium in dit kader nadere aanscherping behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over modernisering van de liquidatieverliesregeling

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the liquidation loss scheme for subsidiaries should be modernised, including relaxing the non-continuation requirement, pro-rata treatment, loss recognition without liquidation and the share-price-based calculation. State Secretary Wiebes answered that the scheme is deliberately robust to prevent abuse and double loss relief, and saw no reason to revise it.
I therefore see insufficient reason to revise the current liquidation loss scheme on this point.
Ik zie dan ook onvoldoende aanleiding de huidige liquidatieverliesregeling op dit punt te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over onzalige accijnsverhogingen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether excise increases on fuels yielded little or a net loss, whether fuel sales dropped, and whether the planned 2015 inflation adjustment would be cancelled. The State Secretary referred to his cover letter for most questions and said the 2014 excise revenue trend and falling sales do not justify cancelling the 2015 inflation correction.

Neither the development of fuel excise revenue in the first half of 2014 nor the trend of declining fuel sales, due among other things to a more fuel-efficient vehicle fleet and the economic situation, give cause to suspend the inflation correction as of 1 January 2015.

Noch de ontwikkeling van de accijnsopbrengst van brandstoffen in het eerste halfjaar van 2014 noch de trend van teruglopende brandstofverkopen als gevolg van onder meer een zuiniger wordend wagenpark en de economische situatie geven aanleiding om de inflatiecorrectie per 1 januari 2015 buiten werking te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de CBS cijfers van de verkoop van diesel en LPG

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why CBS figures show sharp falls in diesel and LPG sales after the excise increase, and whether the excise hike still yields the expected revenue. The State Secretary said he takes the CBS data as objective, gave revised revenue forecasts by fuel type, declined to reverse the increase, and deferred some answers to a separate cover letter.
I have taken note of the CBS figures on fuel sales.
Ik heb kennis genomen van de CBS-cijfers over de verkoop van brandstof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de Stichting Meldpunt Collectief Onrecht

An MP asked ministers whether the ECHR ruling on inheritance tax exemptions for businesses versus individuals closed the door on claims by the Stichting Meldpunt Collectief Onrecht, and whether such foundations using false expectations for financial gain are permissible, and what ACM and the Reclame Code Commissie can do without consumer complaints. The Minister answered that the ECHR ruling is final and inadmissible, that the civil courts and ACM would judge the foundation's conduct, that no new complaints have reached ACM, and that ACM and the RCC have enforcement tools, with the RCC cautious about acting ex officio.
The Court answers the question put to it in the negative and declares the applicants inadmissible.
Het Hof beantwoordt de voorgelegde vraag ontkennend, en verklaart de verzoekers niet-ontvankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de toepassing van de onderwijsvrijstelling

MP Bashir (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance how the VAT education exemption applies to technology lessons, why it does not fall under the general decree listing exempt education, and why belastingkantoren (tax offices) might apply it differently in the MadScience case, and whether CRKBO certification could serve as a checkable standard. The State Secretary answered that technology lessons are exempt when part of regular curricula or given by listed providers, that tax offices should apply rules uniformly, that individual cases cannot be discussed, and that CRKBO certification covers only vocational education so a wider exemption is not possible within the law.
Regarding individual taxpayers, I do not provide information pursuant to Article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over individuele belastingplichtigen doe ik gelet op art. 67 van de AWR geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het uitbreiden van de pilot voor zzp’ers in de zorg

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked the State Secretaries about the pilot allowing self-employed care workers (zzp'ers) to obtain VAR-wuo statements, including how many were contacted, how many enrolled, and whether the pilot would continue. The State Secretary answered that about 650 contracts were concluded, that all care offices participated, and that the pilot's future depends on the long-term care reform and a short-term review of alternative business models.
However, no registration is kept of the reasons why self-employed persons decline participation in the pilot.
Er wordt echter geen registratie bijgehouden van de motieven waarom zzp'ers afzien van deelname aan de pilot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Keijzer over het btw-tarief voor dirigenten

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance to clarify the VAT rate applicable to conductors leading rehearsals, for both permanent and substitute conductors, and how the Tax Authority assesses whether rehearsals are necessary for performances. The State Secretary answered that rehearsals closely linked to and necessary for public performances fall under the reduced rate for performing artists regardless of whether the conductor is permanent or substitute, that the Tax Authority accepts the Haarlem court ruling and will include this in a new decision, and that conductors can demonstrate necessity with a written statement from the choir or orchestra.
This position will be included in a new decision on goods and services subject to the reduced VAT rate, to be published soon in the Staatscourant.
Dit standpunt zal worden opgenomen in een nieuw besluit over goederen en diensten waarvoor het verlaagde btw-tarief geldt dat binnenkort in de Staatscourant zal worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de mogelijke wijziging van het Sportbesluit

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about possible changes to the VAT sports exemption after the Bridport judgment, including effects on municipalities and sports clubs. The government answered that the Bridport ruling requires reviewing the exemption, that no decision or cost estimate has been made yet, and that the review will weigh all financial and legal aspects.
As stated, a carefully considered decision on the design of the sports exemption will be taken after weighing all financial, organisational, legal, administrative and implementation aspects.

Zoals gemeld zal met afweging van alle financiële, organisatorische, juridische, administratieve en uitvoeringsaspecten een weloverwogen besluit worden genomen over de vormgeving van de sportvrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de grote stapel aan fiscale voorstellen rond Prinsjesdag

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Finance whether a heavy batch of tax proposals dropped around Prinsjesdag leaves too little time for implementation by the Tax Administration, and why more bills could not be submitted in spring. The State Secretary declined to comment on the characterisation, pointed to measures already notified to parliament, and said remaining measures would be announced on Prinsjesdag with the Tax Administration's implementation capacity checked.
At this moment I cannot address suggestions that a heavy batch of fiscal policy files would be dropped on parliament's table on Prinsjesdag.
Op dit moment kan ik niet ingaan op suggesties als dat er op Prinsjesdag een zware stapel fiscale beleidsdossiers bij het parlement op tafel zou worden gedropt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de schenkingsregeling bij een koophuis

MP Bashir asked the State Secretary of Finance about the temporarily expanded gift-tax exemption for home purchases, which was used far more than the 20,000 expected, and about its revenue loss, effect on house prices and whether it should be extended. The government answered that exact figures are not yet available, estimated a cumulative revenue loss of about 100 million euros over 30 years, and said the temporary exemption will not be extended.
Exact realisation figures will only become available after the tax return data has been processed in the Tax Administration's automated systems.
Exacte realisatiecijfers zullen pas beschikbaar komen nadat de aangiftegegevens zijn verwerkt in de geautomatiseerde systemen van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “EU berispt Nederland om belastingregels bedrijven”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about EU criticism of Dutch tax rules for multinationals, including calls to act on aggressive tax planning and a Commission remark that tax-climate warnings would appear in country recommendations. The State Secretary replied that the Netherlands already acts against tax avoidance, that Dutch rules are sound, that a formal state-aid investigation into a Starbucks APA has been opened, and that a letter on corporate tax revenue decline and a position on a beneficial-ownership register will follow.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over de voorgenomen aanpassing van het Sportbesluit

Rep. Van Veen asks whether the State Secretary of Finance signalled to sports parties a far-reaching revision of the Sportbesluit after the Bridport CJEU ruling, and about its financial and municipal consequences. The government confirms the Bridport ruling prompted reconsideration of the VAT sports exemption, says the financial impact is not yet quantified and will be assessed carefully, and promises a decision later via the Fiscale Verzamelwet 2015.
A substantiation of the amount has (for the time being) not been shared with us.
Een onderbouwing van het bedrag is (vooralsnog) niet met ons gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bisschop over de toegang van ge-moedsbezwaarden tot Nationale Hypotheek Garantie (NHG)

SGP MPs asked whether conscientious objectors recognised by a court, who refuse life-insurance coverage, can obtain a maximum NHG-guaranteed mortgage, and whether a 100% financing model backed by a buy-out amount, or separate case assessment, could be considered. The minister answered that NHG can be granted without life insurance if the bank demonstrably bears the mortgage-death risk, that this is the lender's choice, and that the fund's structure rules out a motor-insurance-style model or case-by-case assessment.
It is up to the lender to assess whether it is willing to do so in such cases.
Het is aan de geldverstrekker te beoordelen of zij hiertoe in voorkomende gevallen bereid is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het EU-advies om onder andere belastingen op consumptiegoederen te verhogen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about an EU Eurogroup statement urging Dutch labour tax reduction offset by higher consumption or environmental taxes, and whether the government would commit to no tax increases until 2017. The State Secretary confirmed the statement, said tax shifting is for member states to decide, and promised a broader letter on the tax system after the summer, without committing to the requested tax freeze.
Whether and how tax shifting takes place is, given the sovereignty of Member States in fiscal matters, up to the Member States themselves.
Of en hoe verschuiving van belastingen plaatsvindt, is gezien de soevereiniteit van de Lidstaten op fiscaal gebied aan de Lidstaten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van van het lid Karabulut over onrust onder huurders door een fout van de Belastingdienst

MP Karabulut asked about unrest among hundreds of Welbions tenants after the Tax Authority wrongly demanded retroactive repayment of rent allowance, and how many such demands were issued and how the error happened. The State Secretary confirms the procedural error, says the demands were reversed and the allowance paid within days, that about 390 cases were affected through an error in the landlord administration, and that measures are being taken to prevent recurrence.
The wrongful reclaims have been reversed and the rent allowance, which had also wrongly been stopped, was paid out to the tenants concerned a few days after the original payment date.
De onterechte terugvorderingen zijn hersteld en de huurtoeslag, die eveneens ten onrechte gestopt was, is enkele dagen na de oorspronkelijke betaaldatum aan de betrokken huurders uitgekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Ojik over "het bericht dat een gezin de dupe is geworden van een bedrag aan teveel ontvangen kinderopvangtoeslag dat terugbetaald dient te worden”

MPs Van Ojik and Ulenbelt asked about a family forced to repay childcare allowance after an administrative error, and whether repayment is applied for mere paperwork gaps. The government answered that missing address data alone does not trigger repayment, that parents can supplement data before repayment, and that individual cases cannot be discussed due to confidentiality.
Due to the duty of confidentiality, I, the State Secretary of Finance, cannot address the situation of the people from the Hart van Nederland report.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik, de staatssecretaris van Financiën, hier niet ingaan op de situatie van de mensen uit de reportage van Hart van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en De Rouwe over de oldtimermaatregel

Members Omtzigt and De Rouwe (CDA) asked about the implementation of the oldtimer vehicle tax exemption, including information given to owners, the handling of bills and objections, and revenue estimates. The government answered that rushed implementation strained the Tax Authority's information and processing, that bills were sent in April and May 2014 with thousands of objections received, and that current data are insufficient to revise the EUR 137 million revenue estimate.
The very short implementation period of the oldtimer measure has put the implementation by the Tax Authority and the information provided to taxpayers under pressure.
De zeer korte implementatietijd van de oldtimermaatregel heeft er toe geleid dat de uitvoering door de Belastingdienst en de voorlichting aan de belastingplichtigen onder druk is komen te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Neppérus en Koolmees over de fiscale behandeling van uitkeringen uit het Artikel 2-fonds aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën

MPs Neppérus and Koolmees asked how Artikel 2-fonds payments from Germany are taxed and whether they count toward income-dependent allowances, and whether this can be changed. Secretary Wiebes answered that the payments count as taxable income and thus reduce allowances, that excluding them would be principled wrong and set a precedent for other benefits, but he will ask the Landsadvocaat to study the option and report back.
I will inform the House of the outcome of this study and my findings arising from it.
Over de uitkomst van dit onderzoek en mijn bevindingen naar aanleiding daarvan zal ik Uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Tony van Dijck over het ontbreken van democratische controle op de kosten van het Energieakkoord

PVV MPs Klever and Tony van Dijck asked whether the government accepts that the Energieakkoord lacks a carefully substantiated cost calculation and asked for an overview of direct and indirect costs, including tax revenue loss and private damage. Minister Kamp rejects the claim that the calculation is missing, points to the PBL and ECN analyses and promised annual energy projections (NEV) from October 2014, but did not provide the requested overview.
Are you willing to send the Chamber an overview of all costs arising from the Energy Agreement?
Bent u bereid om alsnog een overzicht van alle uit het Energieakkoord voortvloeiende kosten naar de Kamer te sturen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde, Neppérus en Litjens over fraude met vertrouwelijke gegevens die per reguliere post verzonden worden

MPs De Liefde, Neppérus and Litjens asked about fraud with confidential data sent by regular post, how often it occurs, who is liable, whether government letters should omit identifiers like BSN and bank numbers, and whether separate or courier delivery could reduce risk. Minister Plasterk answered that the postal law and regulator do not track misuse, liability is set by contracts or the universal service, identifiers are necessary for communication, and no new agreements or mandatory changes are planned, pointing to existing measures and digital channels.
It is therefore not possible to establish how often confidential data sent by post is misused.
Het is dan ook niet mogelijk te achterhalen hoe vaak er misbruik wordt gemaakt van vertrouwelijke gegevens die met de post worden verstuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Kuzu over de berichten dat het rijk schulden erger maakt door het inhouden van toeslagen en de stijging van het aantal mensen dat onder beschermingsbewind is geplaatst

MPs Schouten and Kuzu asked whether the state worsens household debts by clawing back excess childcare and other benefit advances, and about the rise in people placed under protective administration (beschermingsbewind). The state secretary acknowledged the repayment problem, described repayment arrangements and the protection of the subsistence allowance, said the Rijksincassovisie would address it, and referred to a separate letter for the protective administration questions.
If the benefit applicant cannot pay the amount under the standard payment arrangement, he can ask for a tailored payment arrangement.
Wanneer de toeslagaanvrager het bedrag van de standaard betalingsregeling niet kan opbrengen, kan hij om een betalingsregeling op maat vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Marcouch over coulance voor kerkgenootschappen ten aanzien van de publicatieplicht voor ANBI’s

Two MPs asked why church communities get until 1 January 2016 to meet the ANBI publication requirement while mosques and other faiths must comply from 2014, and whether that is fair. The State Secretary explained the transitional rule is for church bodies covered by group rulings that lack their own RSIN, applied in practice to all religious bodies including mosques, and that about 2,000 ANBIs (none religious) will lose status for not complying.
That means, for example, that mosques also have until 1 January 2016.
Dat betekent dat bijvoorbeeld ook moskeeën tot 1 januari 2016 de tijd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat meer dan 3.000 huiseigenaren van zonnepanelen een forse naheffingsaanslag hebben gekregen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that over 3,000 solar panel owners received large back-tax assessments for failing to file quarterly VAT returns. The State Secretary defended the fines as proportionate, pointed to existing coulance and exemption options, and rejected a yearly VAT filing exception for this group.
I therefore do not consider the fine for failing to file on time and the minimum fine for failing to pay the tax due on time to be disproportionate.
Ik acht de boete wegens het niet tijdig doen van aangifte en de minimumboete wegens het niet tijdig betalen van de verschuldigde belasting dan ook niet disproportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst winst van WK-pooltjes wil gaan belasten (Herdruk)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority intends to tax winnings from World Cup pools above EUR 454 and whether this is absurd, including for bingo and raffles. The State Secretary answered that the 29% gambling tax applies to pools outside the private sphere above that threshold, that the Tax Authority is not actively hunting pool organisers and has other priorities, and gave no concrete new measures.

As I also stated in my answer to the question from MP Koolmees, it is definitely not the case that the Tax Authority is now actively hunting Dutch people who organise a World Cup pool among family or friends.

Zoals ik ook in mijn antwoord op de vraag van het Kamerlid Koolmees heb gesteld, is het beslist niet zo dat de Belastingdienst nu actief jacht maakt op Nederlanders die in familie- of vriendenkring een WK-poule organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over de afkoop van kleine pensioenen

An MP asked whether the pension start date for small pensions, and their buy-out, could be shifted to the prevailing AOW age, and whether the government would discuss pension rule changes with social partners. The government answered that no legal obstacles exist, that the working-on requirement was waived by a 2012 policy decision, and that social partners are already adjusting pension rules.
There are no legal obstacles to setting this pension start date in the collective pension scheme at or after the prevailing AOW age.
Er zijn geen wettelijke belemmeringen om deze in de collectieve pensioenregeling te bepalen pensioeningangsdatum te stellen op of na de geldende AOW-leeftijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van Laar over het rapport van Oxfam Novib over belastingontwijking door bedrijven

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about an Oxfam Novib report on corporate tax avoidance and its effect on developing countries' revenues, and about Dutch efforts on the OECD BEPS project and country-by-country reporting. The government answered that the 100% revenue claim anticipates a forthcoming study, pointed to Dutch treaty and technical assistance efforts, said developing countries are being involved in BEPS, and described EU country-by-country reporting rules with an evaluation due in 2018.
Without knowledge of that report, the question posed cannot be answered.
Zonder kennis van dat rapport is de gestelde vraag niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over het Oxfam-rapport Business Among Friends

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Merkies asked the State Secretary about the Oxfam report on corporate tax avoidance, the arm's length principle, transfer pricing improvements, and the role of developing countries in OECD standard-setting. The State Secretary answered that the arm's length principle works imperfectly but is not itself the cause of avoidance, that BEPS work targets profit shifting, and that developing countries are involved through dialogue and capacity building.
The Netherlands attaches importance to these action points and actively contributes to seeking improvements.
Nederland hecht belang aan deze actiepunten en draagt actief bij aan het zoeken naar verbeteringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de vergoeding voor rietlandbeheer

MPs Geurts, Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked why subsidies paid by provinces to nature managers are exempt from VAT while payments from nature managers to reed cutters are subject to VAT, and asked about the basis for a possible exemption. The State Secretary explained the VAT treatment under EU case law, that the subsidy scheme is taxable only where the payment is consumed, and that stakeholders and government are exploring a restructured single-entity arrangement.

Representatives of private reed managers, Staatsbosbeheer, Natuurmonumenten, the province of Overijssel and the Ministry of Economic Affairs are examining whether the relationship between reed managers and land owners can be changed and formalised so that there is a single entity.

Vertegenwoordigers van de particuliere rietlandbeheerders, Staatsbosbeheer, Natuurmonumenten, de provincie Overijssel en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken onderzoeken of de relatie tussen rietlandbeheerders en terreineigenaren zodanig gewijzigd en geformaliseerd kan worden, dat sprake is van één entiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het nog steeds onbeantwoorde Wob- en grondwetsverzoek inzake het onderzoek naar de gevolgen van de accijnsverhogingen

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance to disclose all documents on the excise duty study, including all versions, and to list them with a disclosure decision per document under article 68 of the Constitution. The State Secretary answered that article 68 is not wider in practice than the Wob for this purpose, that no document list is required, and that he will not provide one, though he is accountable for the analysis and will discuss it in debate.

Drawing up the list of all internal documents you requested is unusual in exchanges between parliament and cabinet, and I see no special facts or circumstances that would warrant doing so in this case.

Het opstellen van de door u gevraagde lijst met allerlei interne documenten is in het verkeer tussen het parlement en het kabinet ongebruikelijk en ik zie geen bijzondere feiten of omstandigheden om in dit geval wel over te gaan tot het opstellen van zo'n lijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over Montana Beheer en de toezichthouders

An SP MP asked the ministers of Finance and Justice about the Montana Beheer investment fraud, complaints made to the AFM from 2010, and why the regulator and the FIOD took so long to act, and whether delays generally harm victims. The minister answered that the AFM and FIOD acted within normal deadlines and due care, described the steps taken, and saw no reason for additional measures, while promising to review if delays are signalled in future.
The AFM and the FIOD acted within the regular time limits and due care standards in this case.
De AFM en de FIOD hebben in deze zaak gehandeld binnen de reguliere termijnen en zorgvuldigheidsnormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de werving, de rechtspositie en de bevoegdheden van politievrijwilligers

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about recruitment, legal status, powers and armament of police volunteers, including the lack of in- and outflow data, the staff ratio, allowance taxation and the basis for weapons decisions. The minister largely answers that targets and figures will follow later, defends the allowance and weapons arrangements, and agrees that individual weapons decisions should not be published.
From this year I will send your House annually the National Police management plan that I have adopted.
Ik zend uw Kamer vanaf dit jaar wel jaarlijks het door mij vastgestelde Beheersplan Nationale Politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het WOB-verzoek dat het lid Omtzigt bij de regeling van werkzaamheden van de Tweede Kamer van 28 mei 2014 heeft gedaan

Omtzigt asked whether the minister's letter on the diesel and LPG excise evaluation amounts to a refusal of his WOB (public access) request for all documents, and when a decision would be taken. Minister Wiebes answered that the request was treated as a request under article 68 of the Constitution rather than the WOB, and that the non-aggregated oil company data is withheld for confidentiality reasons, which the WOB also requires.
I have made clear that I do not disclose information from the oil companies because it concerns commercially confidential and competitively sensitive information.
Ik heb kenbaar gemaakt dat ik informatie die afkomstig is van de oliemaatschappijen niet openbaar maak omdat het bedrijfsvertrouwelijke en concurrentiegevoelige informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Groot over het alarmerende bericht dat de integriteit van trustkantoren in het geding is

MPs Nijboer and Groot asked the Finance Minister about DNB findings that trust offices take unacceptable risks with Dutch limited partnerships (cv-structures), lack separation of functions and source-of-funds checks. The minister agrees the findings are worrying, points to new integrity rules (RibWtt 2014) effective 2015, and says tax avoidance via these structures falls outside last year's measures and is being addressed internationally.
Soon I will publish the new Regulation on Integrity of Business Operations under the Trust Offices Supervision Act (RibWtt 2014).
Binnenkort zal ik de nieuwe Regeling Integere Bedrijfsvoering Wet toezicht trustkantoren (RibWtt 2014) publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de evaluatie van de accijnsverhoging op diesel en LPG

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about the evaluation of the fuel excise increase, including which pump-owner organisations gave input, BOVAG's doubts about CBS data and the cross-border effects. The State Secretary answered that the evaluation was based on oil company, CBS and tax authority data, that BOVAG's 2 May letter was not answered directly but BOVAG was invited to talk, and that the first-quarter 2014 results gave no reason for further measures despite some cross-border effects.
A number of oil companies cooperated in the research. These companies provided data to Finance on a confidential basis.
Aan het onderzoek heeft een aantal oliemaatschappijen meegewerkt. Deze maatschappijen hebben op vertrouwelijke basis gegevens aan Financiën ter beschikking gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het afkopen van een klein pensioen

Mr Omtzigt asked the ministers about problems with buying out small pensions before retirement, including effects on rent allowance, AOW partner allowance and benefits, and whether the government would reverse or prevent buy-outs. The government answered that it sees no feasible way to reverse past buy-outs or compensate those affected, but will work with pension providers on better information and will inform parliament before the summer recess.
I deeply regret that people have suffered adverse financial consequences from the buy-out of a small pension.
Ik betreur het ten zeerste dat mensen nadelige financiële gevolgen hebben ondervonden van de afkoop van een klein pensioen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pieter Heerma over het feit dat België op dit moment akkoord gaat met het feit dat kranten 0% btw in rekening brengen op hun digitale abonnementen

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked why Belgium, Luxembourg and France apply reduced VAT to digital newspapers and e-books while the Netherlands does not, and what the government will do about it. The Secretary of State answered that from 1 January 2015 EU rules will tax electronic services at the buyer's country rate, and that a reduced rate for digital versus physical products requires new EU legislation, which Netherlands will push for during the Commission's coming VAT evaluation.

In that context the Netherlands will work to ensure that, when the European Commission proposes any amendment to the VAT Directive concerning digital products, Member States pursue priority treatment of it.

Nederland zal zich in dat kader er voor inzetten dat, wanneer de Europese Commissie een voorstel voor eventuele aanpassing van de btw-richtlijn met betrekking tot digitale producten doet, een prioritaire behandeling wordt nagestreefd door de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over garanties in het kader van het bid voor het Europees Kampioenschap voetbal in 2020

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Health about why government guarantees for the Euro 2020 football bid, including tax exemptions and a no-new-legislation commitment, were signed before parliament was informed, and requested documents and details of the tax guarantees.
