The minister replies that guarantees were kept within existing legal frameworks, that parliament was informed once the bid was finalized, that the tax guarantees do not create specific exemptions beyond existing law, and that some documents will be sent later or are publicly available.
I then informed the House that same day about the submission of the bid and the government guarantees I signed on behalf of the state, which form part of the bid.
Ik heb vervolgens de Kamer die dag terstond geïnformeerd over het uitbrengen van het bid en de overheidsgaranties die ik namens het Rijk heb ondertekend en onderdeel uitmaken van het bid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Klaver over het voorkomen van witwassen van Russische vermogens

MPs Servaes and Klaver asked how the government implemented a motion calling for heightened vigilance against money laundering of Russian officials' and oligarchs' assets, and about Navalny's claims that Western police obstructed investigations and that 90% of Russian corruption money is laundered in the West. The minister replied that the Wwft's risk-based regime already requires heightened vigilance, that supervisors issued guidance and circulars, that FIUs cooperated on Ukraine and Russia, and that the government could not verify Navalny's claims, with the OM reporting no contact from Navalny's foundation.
Ultimately it is up to the institutions themselves to determine the degree of risk and which measures to take.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de instellingen zelf om de mate van het risico te bepalen en welke maatregelen men neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Koolmees over Verklaring arbeidsrelatie (VAR) voor zzp’ers

MPs from D66 asked the government how the Tax Authority can grant and then withdraw VAR-WUO declarations for care freelancers working through agencies, and how many were reviewed and reclassified. The minister explained that VARs are assessed on submitted facts, that roughly 900 of about 1,500 reviewed cases were reclassified as employment, and that the pilot was extended to address the problem.
The cabinet will shortly start an interdepartmental policy study on freelancers to examine whether laws and regulations for freelancers and employees are sufficiently in balance.

Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een Interdepartementaal Beleidsonderzoek (IBO) starten met betrekking tot zzp'ers om te bezien of wet- en regelgeving voor zzp'ers en werknemers voldoende in balans zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over de aftrek weekenduitgaven voor gehandicapten

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Health about tax deductibility of weekend care costs for severely disabled institutional residents, including the 'moral obligation' criterion and a specific case where the child's own income may have excluded deduction. The government affirms that the moral-obligation test is marginal in practice, that the Belastingdienst applies it generously, and it will propose extending the deduction to curatele (curatorship) alongside mentorschap in a future law change.
I will submit a legislative amendment to this end when the opportunity arises.
Ik zal hiertoe bij gelegenheid een wetswijziging indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de oproep van de directievoorzitter van Vitens om de waterbelasting af te schaffen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Vitens chief's call to abolish the water tax, whether other EU countries levy similar taxes, whether tax makes up over 30% of tap water bills, and whether it should be halved. The State Secretary answered that Denmark has a similar tax, the Dutch tax replaced an unsustainable VAT measure, water prices vary by region, and a review of bottlenecks with the sector will be sent to parliament soon.
My predecessor committed that possible bottlenecks in the water tax would be examined together with the sector.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft daarbij toegezegd dat samen met de sector mogelijke knelpunten in de leidingwaterbelasting zullen worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Klaver over het nieuws dat de fiscale structuur van Philip Morris wel in Nederland blijft

Opposition MPs Merkies and Klaver asked whether Philip Morris's Dutch tax holding structure remains only for tax reasons, whether tax rulings must be re-tested after mass layoffs, and about support and secret agreements. The State Secretary refused to give information on individual taxpayers under tax secrecy, said the company keeps a significant presence (about 140 jobs), and denied any secret agreements outside legal frameworks.
Based on the secrecy obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot provide information about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik geen informatie geven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het belastingregime voor lokale energiecoöperaties

An MP asked whether the tax regime for local energy cooperatives creates VAT, energy-tax and network-cost obstacles for member participation and business cases. The minister answered that the reduced energy-tax rate is a stimulus, that VAT liability depends on facts and circumstances, and that the 10-year investment guarantee will not be extended.
I am not willing to extend the 10-year period.
Ik ben niet bereid de periode van 10 jaar te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat de werkdruk bij de Belastingdienst nog altijd te hoog is

The SP MP Merkies asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that workload at the Tax Administration remains too high despite planned cuts of about 1,000 FTE, and whether staffing and workload are being monitored. The State Secretary Wiebes acknowledged temporary workload from reorganisation and reassignment, cited staffing figures (28,107 FTE end 2012, 28,857 end 2013), said workload is monitored through staff surveys and consultation with works councils, and confirmed taxpayers should be able to get answers on their filings.
I am kept informed about this by the service management.
Ik word hierover door de dienstleiding op de hoogte gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over de aftrekbaarheid van trapliften als specifieke zorgkosten

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance why a stairlift, previously deductible as a specific care cost, was made non-deductible from 2014 despite the Tax Authority's website having said otherwise, and whether the cost should be allowed under the legitimate expectations principle. The State Secretary answered that the 2014 exclusion of home adaptations was deliberate, that the website disclaimer warned rules could change, that cash-basis rules mean 2014 payments are not deductible, and that no legitimate-expectations exception applies to general public information.
Providing general information by the Tax Authority cannot lead to treatment deviating from the law by applying the legitimate expectations principle.
Het verstrekken van algemene voorlichting door de Belastingdienst kan niet leiden tot een van de wet afwijkende behandeling met toepassing van het vertrouwensbeginsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat Rusland af wil van het huidige belastingverdrag met Nederland

Senator Merkies (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Russia wants to replace the current tax treaty with the Netherlands, including Russia's reasons, timing and the Dutch response. The State Secretary answered that Russia proposed a partial revision to align the 1996 treaty with the current OECD model, that the Netherlands agreed to official-level negotiations, and that the revision was listed in the periodic overview of treaties under negotiation.
In response to Russia's request, I therefore proposed that official-level negotiations be started on a possible revision of the tax treaty between the two countries.
In reactie op het verzoek uit Rusland heb ik dan ook voorgesteld dat op ambtelijk niveau besprekingen worden aangegaan over een mogelijke aanpassing van het belastingverdrag tussen de beide landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Neppérus over het bericht elektrische auto kost fiscus zeker half miljard

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance whether tax incentives for electric cars cost the treasury over 500 million euros against a budget of 125 million, and asked for a breakdown of such schemes and a response to calls for their revision. The State Secretary did not recognise the 500 million figure, explained that the 125 million corresponds to the MIA and Vamil budgets (which cover broader environmental investments), said any overrun would be covered intertemporally, listed current car-related tax schemes and promised a fuller analysis in the upcoming Autobrief II.
I will return to these questions extensively in the aforementioned Autobrief.
Op deze vragen zal ik uitgebreid terugkomen in de bovengenoemde Autobrief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Schouw over de lastenstijging bij provincies

MPs Koolmees and Schouw asked the State Secretary of Finance about a reported rise in provincial tax revenue from opcenten on motor vehicle tax, how much of it stems from national policy, when provinces were informed of the change, and whether provinces should be compensated through a rate cut. The State Secretary said the volume effect is not solely due to national policy, that provinces were informed on Prinsjesdag with prior consultation, and rejected a compensation arrangement since provinces set their own rates within statutory maxima.
That effect is also determined by how provinces estimate the development of the vehicle fleet in their own province (number, type and weight).
Dat effect wordt ook bepaald door hoe provincies de ontwikkeling van het wagenpark in de eigen provincie inschatten (aantal, soort en gewicht).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de berichten dat multinationals massaal belasting ontwijken in ontwikkelingslanden

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies (SP) asked whether OECD tax reforms go far enough against profit shifting harming developing countries, and about transfer pricing losses in Africa and the Dutch role. Secretary Wiebes answered that the OECD rules already prevent profit shifting, that technical assistance to developing countries is supported, and that the Tax Authority's transfer pricing capacity has been expanded.
That all countries aim to be able to tax as large a share as reasonably possible of multinationals' profits is obvious.
Dat alle landen ernaar streven binnen het redelijke een zo groot mogelijk deel van de winst van multinationals te mogen belasten ligt voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Nijboer over het bevriezen van Oekraïense tegoeden en het voorkomen van belastingontwijking via Nederland door de Oekraïense elite

MPs Servaes and Nijboer asked about the amount of Ukrainian assets frozen in the Netherlands and how the FIU reported only one suspicious transaction linked to Ukraine, and whether the government would investigate how the assets came to the Netherlands and improve supervision. The minister declined to give amounts or breakdowns citing secrecy rules, explained the separate legal procedures for freezing and reporting, and committed to examine the cases and feed the results into an anti-money-laundering policy monitor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de ernstige gevolgen van de in 2013 doorgevoerde accijnsverhoging op alcoholhoudende dranken

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the alleged severe effects of the 2013 excise increase on alcoholic drinks, including falling sales, lost VAT, job losses and bankruptcies. The State Secretary answered that data are only available in the Financieel Jaarverslag, that no direct link can be drawn between excise and VAT or employment, that bankruptcy data are unavailable, and that the excise rise was needed for the budget agreement.
Contact with Statistics Netherlands revealed that an overview of bankruptcies in the drinks sector is not available.
Uit contact met het CBS is gebleken dat een overzicht van faillissementen in de drankensector niet beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Koolmees over VAR-verklaringen voor zzp’ers

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers about the Belastingdienst's handling of VAR declarations for self-employed workers (zzp'ers), including reports of fewer VAR-WUO grants in healthcare and revocations for 250 people tied to care intermediaries. The government replied that the criteria have not changed, that enforcement against false self-employment has increased, and that a planned joint-liability rule for clients and an online VAR module are under development.
The statutory confidentiality obligation means that no statements can be made about individual cases.
De in de wet verankerde geheimhoudingsverplichting maakt dat over individuele gevallen geen mededelingen kunnen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Tony Van Dijck over het bericht dat zzp-ers in de zorg geen VAR-WUO (Verklaring Arbeidsrelatie Winst Uit Onderneming) meer krijgen van de belastingdienst

MPs Agema and Tony Van Dijck asked whether the Tax Authority's refusal to issue VAR-WUO declarations to self-employed care workers, which hurts patients who rely on agency-placed carers, is known and how it will be addressed. The government acknowledged the problem, said the Tax Authority reclassified 257 cases and issued 900 VAR-loon decisions after review while stressing genuine self-employment must still be recognised, and pointed to direct contracting pilots and ongoing labour-market attention.
I see the problem that is connected to this, although it is not a scale suggested in the broadcast.
Ik zie de problematiek die hier mee samenhangt, hoewel het niet om een schaal gaat die in de uitzending werd gesuggereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Bruins Slot over de problemen van zzp’ers in de zorg om een VAR-wuo te krijgen of te behouden

MPs Omtzigt and Bruins Slot asked how the Tax Authority assesses VAR-wuo self-employment declarations for care workers, and whether withdrawals are leaving zzp'ers without clients. The government answers that the assessment follows uniform legal criteria, that care provision in kind generally implies employment with the institution, and that the policy is unchanged, while noting a pilot allowing direct contracting with care offices and some withdrawals were wrongly made.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de voorwaarden voor uitstel van betaling voor ondernemers

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the conditions for payment deferral for entrepreneurs, the discretion of tax collectors, supervision of individual arrangements, complaint handling and ministerial approval for enforcement against large firms. The State Secretary answered in detail, describing regular, special and short-term deferral rules, the internal guidelines and hierarchical supervision, and the ministry's approval procedure, while acknowledging that individual officials may reach different conclusions.
For that reason it is not entirely ruled out that different employees reach different conclusions; it remains human work.
Het is om die reden niet geheel uitgesloten dat verschillende medewerkers tot een verschillende conclusie komen; het blijft mensenwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat Nederlandse bedrijven voor een miljard in het krijt staan bij de fiscus

MP Nijboer asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports that Dutch businesses owe the tax authority about one billion euros, including whether the tax authority is losing money through the payment deferral scheme, whether arrears are still tracked, whether collateral is required, and whether the tax authority acts too passively in bankruptcies. The State Secretary disputed the one-billion figure, stated that deferred amounts are recovered later and that losses from bankruptcy fell, provided the 2011-2013 arrears figures, and rejected the need to change the approach.
I do not recognise this picture. First, it is not clear what the 1 billion euro amount is based on.
Ik herken dit beeld niet. Ten eerste is niet duidelijk waar het bedrag van € 1 miljard op is gebaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de onvoldoende voor de BelastingTelefoon

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Consumentenbond's failing grade for the Tax Phone service and whether callers get correct information. The State Secretary answered that 86% of tax-substance questions were answered correctly in 2012 and 2013 per external mystery calls, that the Tax Phone will be strengthened for complex questions, and that tax advice questions will no longer be answered.
The Tax Administration will discuss the outcomes and research methods with the Consumentenbond.
De Belastingdienst gaat met de Consumentenbond in gesprek over de uitkomsten en onderzoeksmethoden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het opzeggen van het belastingverdrag met Nederland door Malawi

MPs Klaver asked why Malawi terminated its tax treaty with the Netherlands, whether talks on a new treaty have begun, and why a 2013 IBFD study omitted Malawi. The State Secretary replied that Malawi's reasons are unclear, a new treaty was agreed at official level in August 2013 but the termination leaves a treaty gap, and he will inform the House if a country terminates a treaty.
Are you willing, in future, when a country decides to terminate the tax treaty with the Netherlands, to inform the House of this immediately by letter?
Bent u bereid in het vervolg wanneer een land besluit het belastingverdrag met Nederland op te zeggen de Kamer per ommegaande hierover per brief te informeren?
Antwoord op vragen van de Leden Van Ojik en Klaver en Omtzigt over Oekraïense vermogens die in Nederland gestald worden en de rol die de Nederlandse ambassade hierin speelt

MPs Van Ojik, Klaver and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch embassy in Kiev actively invited companies to a November 2013 seminar on investing in the Netherlands, whether attendees were linked to EU-sanctioned persons, and how trust offices and FIU reports relate to Ukrainian assets. The minister answered that the embassy did not actively approach companies, that the attendee list is not shared for privacy reasons, that no sanctioned person attended, and that embassy promotion events and trust office presentations are not centrally registered.
These reports of unusual transactions are then assessed by FIU, and based on the information available to FIU, FIU may decide to report the unusual transactions as suspicious to law enforcement.

Deze meldingen van ongebruikelijke transacties worden vervolgens door FIU beoordeeld en op basis van de bij FIU beschikbare informatie kan FIU besluiten de ongebruikelijke transacties als verdacht door te melden aan de opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver en Omtzigt over Oekraïense vermogens die in Nederland gestald worden en de rol die de Nederlandse ambassade hierin speelt

MPs Van Ojik, Klaver and Omtzigt asked about trust offices and the Dutch embassy in Kiev hosting a November seminar on the Dutch fiscal climate, including whether the presentations fit OECD substance rules, whether they would be shared, the guest list, and the number of anti-money-laundering reports on Ukrainian funds. The minister answered that the seminar was a public event within embassy tasks, that none of the 18 EU-sanctioned persons attended, that FIU-Nederland received 1475 linked transactions and two unusual trust-office reports, and that gatekeepers self-police under DNB supervision, while leaving several questions (presentations, guest list) unanswered.
The Cabinet is of the view that facilitating this meeting falls within the standing mandate of the embassies.
Het Kabinet is van mening dat het faciliteren van deze bijeenkomst past binnen de staande taakopdracht van de ambassades.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Neppérus over het bericht dat varkenshouders teleurgesteld zijn in EZ

Two VVD MPs asked why the loose-housing sow stall with feeding stalls was excluded from the Maatlat duurzame veehouderij, thereby losing access to MIA and Vamil tax schemes, and whether the ministry should be making such system choices. The state secretary answered that the exclusion reflects that this system is now the legal minimum for group housing of sows, that the scheme is meant to reward above-standard innovators, and that varkenshouders can still qualify through other housing types, so no change is planned.
It is an entrepreneur's decision which housing system is chosen.
Het is een ondernemersbeslissing welk huisvestingssysteem wordt gekozen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over het artikel “ook zoon Janoekovitsj sluisde vermogen weg via Nederlandse belastingroute”

GreenLeft MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked whether Dutch tax structures (Mako Holding, Artvin Holding) were used to channel money from Ukraine's Janukovych family, and whether the Netherlands would support a public beneficial-ownership register and freeze assets. The government answered that tax secrecy prevents details on individual taxpayers, described existing anti-money-laundering and beneficial-ownership rules and a planned restricted central shareholder register, and said EU sanctions on Ukrainian officials were being prepared.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, no information can be given about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan geen informatie worden gegeven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
